en: The book of the words of Tobit, the son of Tobiel, the son of Ananiel, the son of Aduel, the son of Gabael, of the seed of Asiel, of the tribe of Naphtali;
target: Di buk a di wod dem a Tuobit, di son a Tuobiel, di son a Ananiel, di son a Aduel, di son a Gabiel, a di siid a Asiel, a di traib a Naftalai;

en: who in the days of Enemessar king of the Assyrians was carried away captive out of Thisbe, which is on the right hand of Kedesh Naphtali in Galilee above Asher.
target: uufa, ina di die dem a Enemesaar king a di Asiirian dem, dem did kyari gwe kiaptiv fram Tisbe, we de pan di rait an saida Kidesh Naftalai ina Gyalalii abov Asha.

en: I, Tobit walked in the ways of truth and righteousness all the days of my life, and I did many acts of almsgiving for my people and my nation, who went with me into the land of the Assyrians, to Nineveh.
target: Mi, Tuobit, waak ina di wie dem a chruut an raichosnis aal di die dem a mi laif, an mi du nof ak a gi aalms tu mi piipl an mi nieshan, uu go wid mi ina di lan a di Asiirian dem, tu Ninive.

en: When I was in my own country, in the land of Israel, while I was yet young, all the tribe of Naphtali my father fell away from the house of Jerusalem, which was chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, that all the tribes should sacrifice there, and the temple, the dwelling of the Most High, was consecrated and built there for all ages.
target: Wen mi de ina mi uon konchri, ina di lan a Izrel, wails mi stil yong, aal di traib a Naftalai mi faada ton we fram di ous a Jeruusalem, we did chuuz out a aal di traib dem a Izrel, dat aal di traib dem shud sakrifais de, an di templ, di dwelin plies a di Mos Ai, did kansikriet an bil de fi aal iej.

en: All the tribes which fell away together sacrificed to the heifer Baal, and so did the house of Naphtali my father.
target: Aal di traib dem we ton we tugeda sakrifais tu di efa Baal, an so di ous a Naftalai mi faada du tu.

en: I alone went often to Jerusalem at the feasts, as it has been ordained to all Israel by an everlasting decree, having the first fruits and the tenths of my increase, and that which was first shorn; and I gave them at the altar to the priests the sons of Aaron.
target: Mi aluon go aafn tu Jeruusalem a di fiis dem, az it ben aadin tu aal Izrel bai a evaalastin dikrii, an mi av di fos fruut dem an di tent dem a mi inkriis, an we did fos shier; an mi gi dem a di aalta tu di priis dem di son dem a Ieran.

en: I gave a tenth part of all my increase to the sons of Levi, who ministered at Jerusalem. A second tenth part I sold away, and went, and spent it each year at Jerusalem.
target: Mi gi a tent paat a aal mi inkriis tu di son dem a Liivai, uu minista a Jeruusalem. A sekan tent paat mi sel we, an go, an spen it iich ier a Jeruusalem.

en: A third tenth I gave to them to whom it was appropriate, as Deborah my father’s mother had commanded me, because I was left an orphan by my father.
target: A tod tent mi gi tu dem uu it fit fi, az Debora mi faada mada did koman mi, bikaaz mi faada lef mi aafan.

en: When I became a man, I took as wife Anna, a descendant of our own family. With her, I became the father of Tobias.
target: Wen mi ton man, mi tek Ana fi waif, a uman fram wi uon famli. Wid ar, mi ton di faada a Tobaias.

en: When I was carried away captive to Nineveh, all my kindred and my relatives ate of the bread of the Gentiles;
target: Wen dem kyari mi we kiaptiv tu Ninive, aal mi kin an mi relitiv dem iit a di bred a di Jentailz;

en: but I kept myself from eating,
target: bot mi kip miself fram iit,

en: because I remembered God with all my soul.
target: bikaaz mi rememba Gad wid aal mi suol.

en: So the Most High gave me grace and favor in the sight of Enemessar, and I was his purchasing agent.
target: So di Mos Ai gi mi gries an fieva ina di sait a Enemesaar, an mi a im porchesin iejent.

en: And I went into Media, and left ten talents of silver in trust with Gabael, the brother of Gabrias, at Rages of Media.
target: An mi go ina Miidia, an lef ten talent a silva ina chros wid Gabiel, di breda a Gabraias, a Riejiz a Miidia.

en: And when Enemessar was dead, Sennacherib his son reigned in his place. In his time, the highways were troubled, and I could no longer go into Media.
target: An wen Enemesaar ded, Senakerib im son rien ina im plies. Ina im taim, di aiwie dem did chrobl, an mi kud no langga go ina Miidia.

en: In the days of Enemessar, I did many acts of almsgiving for my people: I gave my bread to the hungry,
target: Ina di die dem a Enemesaar, mi du nof ak a gi aalms tu mi piipl: mi gi mi bred tu di ongri,

en: and my garments to the naked. If I saw any of my kindred dead, and thrown out on the wall of Nineveh, I buried him.
target: an mi gaament dem tu di niekid. Ef mi si eni a mi kin ded, an chruo out pan di waal a Ninive, mi beri im.

en: If Sennacherib the king killed any, when he came fleeing from Judea, I buried them privately; for in his wrath he killed many; and the bodies were sought for by the king, and were not found.
target: Ef Senakerib di king kil enibadi, wen im kom a ron we fram Juudia, mi beri dem praivitli; kaa ina im raat im kil nof; an di king soch fi di badi dem, an dem no fain.

en: But one of the Ninevites went and showed to the king concerning me, how I buried them, and hid myself; and when I knew that I was sought for to be put to death, I withdrew myself for fear.
target: Bot wan a di Ninivait dem go an tel di king bout mi, ou mi beri dem, an aid miself; an wen mi nuo dat dem a soch fi mi fi put mi tu det, mi widraa miself kaa mi fried.

en: And all my goods were forcibly taken away, and there was nothing left to me, save my wife Anna and my son Tobias.
target: An aal mi gudz dem tek we bai fuos, an notn no lef tu mi, siev mi waif Ana an mi son Tobaias.

en: No more than fifty five days passed before two of his sons killed him, and they fled into the mountains of Ararat. And Sarchedonus his son reigned in his place; and he appointed Achiacharus my brother Anael’s son over all the accounts of his kingdom, and over all his affairs.
target: No muo dan fifti-faiv die paas bifuo tuu a im son dem kil im, an dem ron we ina di mountn dem a Ararat. An Saarkidonos im son rien ina im plies; an im apoint Akiakaros mi breda Anael son uova aal di akount dem a im kindom, an uova aal im afier dem.

en: Achiacharus requested me, and I came to Nineveh. Now Achiacharus was cupbearer, keeper of the signet, steward, and overseer of the accounts. Sarchedonus appointed him next to himself, but he was my brother’s son.
target: Akiakaros aks fi mi, an mi kom tu Ninive. Nou Akiakaros a kopbiera, kiipa a di signet, styuuad, an uovasia a di akount dem. Saarkidonos apoint im neks tu imself, bot im a mi breda son.

en: Now when I had come home again, and my wife Anna was restored to me, and my son Tobias, in the feast of Pentecost, which is the holy feast of the seven weeks, there was a good dinner prepared for me, and I sat down to eat.
target: Nou wen mi kom uom agen, an mi waif Ana did risuor bak tu mi, an mi son Tobaias, ina di fiis a Pentikost, we a di uoli fiis a di sevn wiik dem, dem pripier a gud dina fi mi, an mi sidong fi iit.

en: I saw abundance of meat, and I said to my son, “Go and bring whatever poor man you find of our kindred, who is mindful of the Lord. See, I wait for you.”
target: Mi si nof miit, an mi se tu mi son, “Go an bring eni pua man yu fain a wi kin, uu mainful a di Laad. Si, mi a wiet fi yu.”

en: Then he came, and said, “Father, one of our kindred is strangled, and has been cast out in the marketplace.”
target: Den im kom, an se, “Faada, wan a wi kin strangl, an dem kyas im out ina di maakitplies.”

en: Before I had tasted anything, I sprang up, and took him up into a chamber until the sun had set.
target: Bifuo mi ties eniting, mi spring op, an tek im op ina a chiemba til di son go dong.

en: Then I returned, washed myself, ate my bread in heaviness,
target: Den mi riton, waash miself, iit mi bred ina evinis,

en: and remembered the prophecy of Amos, as he said, “Your feasts will be turned into mourning, and all your mirth into lamentation.
target: an rememba di prafisi a Aamos, az im se, “Unu fiis dem wi ton ina muornin, an aal unu mirt ina lamentieshan.

en: So I wept: and when the sun had set, I went and dug a grave, and buried him.
target: So mi baal: an wen di son go dong, mi go an dig a griev, an beri im.

en: My neighbors mocked me, and said, “He is no longer afraid to be put to death for this matter; and yet he fled away. See, he buries the dead again.”
target: Mi nieba dem maak mi, an se, “Im no fried agen fi dem put im tu det fi dis mata; an yet im ron we. Si, im a beri di ded agen.”

en: The same night I returned from burying him, and slept by the wall of my courtyard, being polluted; and my face was uncovered.
target: Di siem nait mi riton fram beri im, an sliip bai di waal a mi kuotyaad, an mi bii paliuut; an mi fies no kovad.

en: I didn’t know that there were sparrows in the wall. My eyes were open and the sparrows dropped warm dung into my eyes, and white films came over my eyes. I went to the physicians, and they didn’t help me; but Achiacharus nourished me, until I went into Elymais.
target: Mi no nuo dat spiaro de ina di waal. Mi ai dem uopm an di spiaro dem jrap waam dong ina mi ai dem, an wait film dem kom uova mi ai dem. Mi go tu di fizishan dem, an dem no elp mi; bot Akiakaros norish mi, til mi go ina Elimais.

en: My wife Anna wove cloth in the women’s chambers,
target: Mi waif Ana wuov klaat ina di uman dem chiemba,

en: and sent the work back to the owners. They on their part paid her wages, and also gave her a kid.
target: an sen di wok bak tu di uona dem. Dem pan dem paat pie ar wiej dem, an gi ar a kid tu.

en: But when it came to my house, it began to cry, and I said to her, “Where did this kid come from? Is it stolen? Give it back to the owners; for it is not lawful to eat anything that is stolen.”
target: Bot wen it kom tu mi ous, it staat krai, an mi se tu ar, “We dis kid kom fram? It stiil? Gi it bak tu di uona dem; kaa it no laaful fi iit eniting we stiil.”

en: But she said, “It has been given to me for a gift more than the wages.” I didn’t believe her, and I asked her to return it to the owners; and I was ashamed of her. But she answered and said to me, “Where is your almsgiving and your righteous deeds? See, you and all your works are known.”
target: Bot shi se, “Dem gi it tu mi fi a gif muo dan di wiej dem.” Mi no biliiv ar, an mi aks ar fi riton it tu di uona dem; an mi ashiem a ar. Bot shi ansa an se tu mi, “We yu aalms-givin an yu raichos diid dem de? Si, yu an aal yu wok dem nuo.”

en: I was grieved and wept, and prayed in sorrow, saying,
target: Mi griiv an baal, an prier ina saro, a se,

en: “O Lord, you are righteous, and all your works and all your ways are mercy and truth, and you judge true and righteous judgment forever.
target: “O Laad, yu raichos, an aal yu wok dem an aal yu wie dem a mersi an chruut, an yu joj chruu an raichos jojment faareva.

en: Remember me, and look at me. Don’t take vengeance on me for my sins and my ignorances, and the sins of my fathers who sinned before you.
target: Rememba mi, an luk pan mi. No tek venjans pan mi fi mi sin dem an mi ignarans dem, an di sin dem a mi faada dem uu sin bifuo yu.

en: For they disobeyed your commandments. You gave us as plunder, for captivity, for death, and for a proverb of reproach to all the nations among whom we are dispersed.
target: Kaa dem disuobie yu komanment dem. Yu gi wi az plonda, fi kiaptiviti, fi det, an fi a proverba riproach tu aal di nieshan dem mongks uu wi skata.

en: Now your judgments are many and true, that you should deal with me according to my sins and the sins of my fathers, because we didn’t keep your commandments, for we didn’t walk in truth before you.
target: Nou yu jojment dem nof an chruu, dat yu shud diil wid mi akaadin tu mi sin dem an di sin dem a mi faada dem, bikaaz wi no kip yu komanment dem, kaa wi no waak ina chruut bifuo yu.

en: Now deal with me according to that which is pleasing in your sight. Command my spirit to be taken from me, that I may be released, and become earth. For it is more profitable for me to die rather than to live, because I have heard false reproaches, and there is much sorrow in me. Command that I be released from my distress, now, and go to the everlasting place. Don’t turn your face away from me.”
target: Nou diil wid mi akaadin tu we pliiz ina yu sait. Koman mi Spirit fi tek we fram mi, dat mi mien relis, an ton ort. Kaa it muo prafit fi mi fi ded dan fi liv, bikaaz mi ier faals riproach dem, an nof saro de ina mi. Koman dat dem relis mi fram mi jischres, nou, an go tu di evaalastin plies. No ton yu fies we fram mi.”

en: The same day it happened to Sarah the daughter of Raguel in Ecbatana of Media, that she also was reproached by her father’s maidservants;
target: Di siem die it apn tu Siera di daata a Raguel ina Ekbatana a Miidia, dat shi tu did riproach bai ar faada miidservant dem;

en: because that she had been given to seven husbands, and Asmodaeus the evil spirit killed them, before they had lain with her. And they said to her, “Do you not know that you strangle your husbands? You have had already seven husbands, and you haven’t borne the name of any one of them.
target: bikaaz dat shi did gi tu sevn ozban, an Asmuodios di iivl spirit kil dem, bifuo dem lai wid ar. An dem se tu ar, “Yu no nuo dat yu a strangl yu ozban dem? Yu don av sevn ozban aredi, an yu no bier di niem a eni wan a dem.

en: Why do you scourge us? If they are dead, go your ways with them. Let us never see either son or daughter from you.”
target: Wai yu a flog wi? Ef dem ded, go yu wie wid dem. Mek wi neva si niida son nor daata fram yu.”

en: When she heard these things, she was grieved exceedingly, so that she thought about hanging herself. Then she said, “I am the only daughter of my father. If I do this, it will be a reproach to him, and I will bring down his old age with sorrow to the grave.”
target: Wen shi ier dem ting ya, shi griiv tomoch, so dat shi tingk bout ang arself. Den shi se, “Mi a di onli daata a mi faada. Ef mi du dis, it wi bi a riproach tu im, an mi wi bring dong im uol iej wid saro tu di griev.”

en: Then she prayed by the window, and said, “Blessed are you, O Lord my God, and blessed is your holy and honorable name forever! Let all your works praise you forever!
target: Den shi prier bai di winda, an se, “Bles yu bi, O Laad mi Gad, an bles a yu uoli an onarebl niem faareva! Mek aal yu wok dem priez yu faareva!

en: And now, Lord, I have set my eyes and my face toward you.
target: An nou, Laad, mi set mi ai dem an mi fies tuwaad yu.

en: Command that I be released from the earth, and that I no longer hear reproach.
target: Koman dat dem relis mi fram di ort, an dat mi no ier riproach no muo.

en: You know, Lord, that I am pure from all sin with man,
target: Yu nuo, Laad, dat mi pyuor fram aal sin wid man,

en: and that I never polluted my name or the name of my father in the land of my captivity. I am the only daughter of my father, and he has no child that will be his heir, nor brother near him, nor son belonging to him, that I should keep myself for a wife to him. Seven husbands of mine are dead already. Why should I live? If it doesn’t please you to kill me, command some regard to be had of me, and mercy shown me, and that I hear no more reproach.”
target: an dat mi neva paliuut mi niem or di niem a mi faada ina di lan a mi kiaptiviti. Mi a di onli daata a mi faada, an im av no pikni we wi bi im ier, nor breda nier im, nor son we bilang tu im, dat mi shud kip miself fi a waif tu im. Sevn ozban a main don ded. Wai mi shud liv? Ef it no pliiz yu fi kil mi, koman dat dem av som rigaad fi mi, an shuo mersi tu mi, an dat mi ier no muo riproach.”

en: The prayer of both was heard before the glory of the great God.
target: Di prier a buot ier bifuo di gluori a di griet Gad.

en: Raphael also was sent to heal them both, to scale away the white films from Tobit’s eyes, and to give Sarah the daughter of Raguel for a wife to Tobias the son of Tobit; and to bind Asmodaeus the evil spirit; because it belonged to Tobias that he should inherit her. At that very time, Tobit returned and entered into his house, and Sarah the daughter of Raguel came down from her upper chamber.
target: Rafael tu did sen fi iil dem buot, fi skiel we di wait film dem fram Tuobit ai dem, an fi gi Siera di daata a Raguel fi a waif tu Tobaias di son a Tuobit; an fi bain Asmuodios di iivl spirit; bikaaz it bilang tu Tobaias dat im shud inherit ar. A dat veri taim, Tuobit riton an enta ina im ous, an Siera di daata a Raguel kom dong fram ar opa chiemba.

en: In that day Tobit remembered the money which he had left in trust with Gabael in Rages of Media,
target: Ina dat die Tuobit rememba di moni we im did lef ina chros wid Gabiel ina Riejiz a Miidia,

en: and he said to himself, I have asked for death; why do I not call my son Tobias, that I may explain to him about the money before I die?
target: an im se tu imself, Mi aks fi det; wai mi no kaal mi son Tobaias, dat mi mien eksplien tu im bout di moni bifuo mi ded?

en: And he called him, and said, “My child, if I die, bury me. Don’t despise your mother. Honor her all the days of your life, and do that which is pleasing to her, and don’t grieve her.
target: An im kaal im, an se, “Mi pikni, ef mi ded, beri mi. No dispaiz yu mada. Ona ar aal di die dem a yu laif, an du we pliiz tu ar, an no griiv ar.

en: Remember, my child, that she has seen many dangers for you, when you were in her womb. When she is dead, bury her by me in one grave.
target: Rememba, mi pikni, dat shi si nof dienja fi yu, wen yu de ina ar wuum. Wen shi ded, beri ar bai mi ina wan griev.

en: My child, be mindful of the Lord our God all your days, and don’t let your will be set to sin and to transgress his commandments: do righteousness all the days of your life, and don’t follow the ways of unrighteousness.
target: Mi pikni, bi mainful a di Laad wi Gad aal yu die dem, an no mek yu wil set tu sin an tu chransgres im komanment dem: du raichosnis aal di die dem a yu laif, an no fala di wie dem a onraichosnis.

en: For if you do what is true, your deeds will prosperously succeed for you, and for all those who do righteousness.
target: Kaa ef yu du we chruu, yu diid dem wi sokses prafitabli fi yu, an fi aal dem uu du raichosnis.

en: Give alms from your possessions. When you give alms, don’t let your eye be envious. Don’t turn away your face from any poor man, and the face of God won’t be turned away from you.
target: Gi aalms fram yu pozeshan dem. Wen yu gi aalms, no mek yu ai envi. No ton we yu fies fram eni pua man, an di fies a Gad no wi ton we fram yu.

en: As your possessions are, do almsgiving from it according to your abundance. If you have little, don’t be afraid to give alms according to that little;
target: Az yu pozeshan dem bi, du aalms-givin fram it akaadin tu yu abondans. Ef yu av likl, no fried fi gi aalms akaadin tu dat likl;

en: for you lay up a good treasure for yourself against the day of necessity;
target: kaa yu a lie op a gud chrezha fi yuself gens di die a nisesiti;

en: because almsgiving delivers from death, and doesn’t allow you to come into darkness.
target: bikaaz aalms-givin diliva fram det, an no lou yu fi kom ina daaknis.

en: Almsgiving is a good gift in the sight of the Most High for all who practice it.
target: Aalms-givin a a gud gif ina di sait a di Mos Ai fi aal uu praktis it.

en: Beware, my child, of all sexual immorality, and take first a wife from the descendants of your fathers. Don’t take a strange wife, who is not of your father’s tribe; for we are the descendants of the prophets. Remember, my child, that Noah, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, our fathers of old time, all took wives of their kindred, and were blessed in their children, and their seed will inherit the land.
target: Biwier, mi pikni, a aal sekshal imaraliti, an tek fos a waif fram di disendant dem a yu faada dem. No tek a schrienj waif, uu no a yu faada traib; kaa wi a di disendant dem a di prafit dem. Rememba, mi pikni, dat Nuowa, Iebraham, Aizak, an Jiekob, wi faada dem a uol taim, aal tek waif a dem kin, an dem bles ina dem pikni, an dem siid wi inherit di lan.

en: And now, my child, love your kindred, and don’t scorn your kindred and the sons and the daughters of your people in your heart, to take a wife of them; for in scornfulness is destruction and much trouble, and in idleness is decay and great lack; for idleness is the mother of famine.
target: An nou, mi pikni, lov yu kin, an no skuorn yu kin an di son dem an di daata dem a yu piipl ina yu aart, fi tek a waif a dem; kaa ina skuornfulnis de dischroshon an nof chrobl, an ina aidlnis de dikie an griet lak; kaa aidlnis a di mada a famin.

en: Don’t let the wages of any man who works for you wait with you, but give it to him out of hand. If you serve God, you will be rewarded. Take heed to yourself, my child, in all your works, and be discreet in all your behavior.
target: No mek di wiej dem a eni man uu wok fi yu wiet wid yu, bot gi it tu im out a an. Ef yu sorv Gad, yu wi get riwaad. Tek iid tu yuself, mi pikni, ina aal yu wok dem, an bi diskriit ina aal yu bieevia.

en: And what you yourself hate, do to no man. Don’t drink wine to drunkenness, and don’t let drunkenness go with you on your way.
target: An we yu yuself iet, du tu no man. No jringk wain tu jrongknis, an no mek jrongknis go wid yu pan yu wie.

en: Give of your bread to the hungry, and of your garments to those who are naked. Give alms from all your abundance. Don’t let your eye be envious when you give alms.
target: Gi a yu bred tu di ongri, an a yu gaament dem tu dem uu niekid. Gi aalms fram aal yu abondans. No mek yu ai envi wen yu gi aalms.

en: Pour out your bread on the burial of the righteous, and give nothing to sinners.
target: Puor out yu bred pan di berial a di raichos, an gi notn tu sina dem.

en: Ask counsel of every man who is wise, and don’t despise any counsel that is profitable.
target: Aks kounsl a evri man uu waiz, an no dispaiz eni kounsl we prafit.

en: Bless the Lord your God at all times, and ask of him that your ways may be made straight, and that all your paths and counsels may prosper; for every nation has no counsel; but the Lord himself gives all good things, and he humbles whom he will, as he will. And now, my child, remember my commandments, and let them not be blotted out of your mind.
target: Bles di Laad yu Gad a aal taim, an aks a im dat yu wie dem mien mek schriet, an dat aal yu paat dem an kounsl dem mien prasper; kaa evri nieshan av no kounsl; bot di Laad imself gi aal gud ting dem, an im ombl uu im wil, az im wil. An nou, mi pikni, rememba mi komanment dem, an no mek dem blat out a yu main.

en: And now I explain to you about the ten talents of silver, which I left in trust with Gabael the son of Gabrias at Rages of Media.
target: An nou mi eksplien tu yu bout di ten talent a silva, we mi lef ina chros wid Gabiel di son a Gabraias a Riejiz a Miidia.

en: And fear not, my child, because we are made poor. You have much wealth, if you fear God, and depart from all sin, and do that which is pleasing in his sight.”
target: An no fier, mi pikni, bikaaz wi mek pua. Yu av nof welt, ef yu fier Gad, an dipaat fram aal sin, an du we pliiz ina im sait.”

en: Then Tobias answered and said to him, “Father, I will do all things, whatever you have commanded me.
target: Den Tobaias ansa an se tu im, “Faada, mi wi du aal ting, eniting yu koman mi.

en: But how could I receive the money, since I don’t know him?”
target: Bot ou mi kud get di moni, sins mi no nuo im?”

en: He gave him the signed bond, and said to him, “Seek a man who will go with you, and I will give him wages, while I still live; and go and receive the money.”
target: Im gi im di sain ban, an se tu im, “Siik a man uu wi go wid yu, an mi wi gi im wiej, wails mi stil liv; an go an get di moni.”

en: He went to seek a man, and found Raphael who was an angel;
target: Im go fi siik a man, an fain Rafael uu a wan ienjel;

en: and he didn’t know it. He said to him, “Can I go with you to Rages of Media? Do you know those places well?”
target: an im no nuo it. Im se tu im, “Mi kyan go wid yu tu Riejiz a Miidia? Yu nuo dem plies de wel?”

en: The angel said to him, “I will go with you. I know the way well. I have lodged with our brother Gabael.”
target: Di ienjel se tu im, “Mi wi go wid yu. Mi nuo di wie wel. Mi laj wid wi breda Gabiel.”

en: Tobias said to him, “Wait for me, and I will tell my father.”
target: Tobaias se tu im, “Wiet fi mi, an mi wi tel mi faada.”

en: He said to him, “Go, and don’t wait. And he went in and said to his father, “See, I have found someone who will go with me.” But he said, “Call him to me, that I may know of what tribe he is, and whether he be a trustworthy man to go with you.”
target: Im se tu im, “Go, an no wiet. An im go in an se tu im faada, “Si, mi fain sombadi uu wi go wid mi.” Bot im se, “Kaal im tu mi, dat mi mien nuo a wa traib im bi, an weda im bi a chroswoerti man fi go wid yu.”

en: So he called him, and he came in, and they saluted one another.
target: So im kaal im, an im kom in, an dem saluut wan aneda.

en: And Tobit said to him, “Brother, of what tribe and of what family are you? Tell me.”
target: An Tuobit se tu im, “Breda, a wa traib an a wa famli yu bi? Tel mi.”

en: He said to him, “Do you seek a tribe and a family, or a hired man which will go with your son?” And Tobit said to him, “I want to know, brother, your kindred and your name.”
target: Im se tu im, “Yu a siik a traib an a famli, or a aia man we wi go wid yu son?” An Tuobit se tu im, “Mi waant fi nuo, breda, yu kin an yu niem.”

en: And he said, “I am Azarias, the son of Ananias the great, of your kindred.”
target: An im se, “Mi a Azaraias, di son a Ananaias di griet, a yu kin.”

en: And he said to him, “Welcome, brother. Don’t be angry with me, because I sought to know your tribe and family. You are my brother, of an honest and good lineage; for I knew Ananias and Jathan, the sons of Shemaiah the great, when we went together to Jerusalem to worship, and offered the firstborn, and the tenths of our increase; and they didn’t go astray in the error of our kindred. My brother, you are of a great stock.
target: An im se tu im, “Welkom, breda. No vex wid mi, bikaaz mi soch fi nuo yu traib an famli. Yu a mi breda, a a anes an gud liniij; kaa mi nuo Ananaias an Jietan, di son dem a Shemaia di griet, wen wi go tugeda tu Jeruusalem fi woship, an aafa di fosbaan, an di tent dem a wi inkriis; an dem no go aschrie ina di era a wi kin. Mi breda, yu a a griet stak.

en: But tell me, what wages should I give you? A drachma a day, and those things that be necessary for you, as to my son?
target: Bot tel mi, wa wiej mi shud gi yu? A drakma a die, an dem ting we niseseri fi yu, az tu mi son?

en: And moreover, if you both return safe and sound, I will add something to your wages.”
target: An muuova, ef unu buot riton sief an soun, mi wi ad somting tu yu wiej dem.”

en: And so they agreed. And he said to Tobias, “Prepare yourself for the journey. May God prosper you.” So his son prepared what was needful for the journey, and his father said to him, “Go with this man; but God, who dwells in heaven, will prosper your journey. May his angel go with you.” Then they both departed, and the young man’s dog went with them.
target: An so dem agrii. An im se tu Tobaias, “Pripier yuself fi di jorni. Mie Gad prasper yu.” So im son pripier we niidful fi di jorni, an im faada se tu im, “Go wid dis man; bot Gad, uu dwel ina evn, wi prasper yu jorni. Mie im ienjel go wid yu.” Den dem buot dipaat, an di yong man daag go wid dem.

en: But Anna his mother wept, and said to Tobit, “Why have you sent away our child? Isn’t he the staff of our hand, in going in and out before us?
target: Bot Ana im mada baal, an se tu Tuobit, “Wai yu sen we wi pikni? Im no di staaf a wi an, ina go in an out bifuo wi?

en: Don’t be greedy to add money to money; but let it be as refuse compared to our child.
target: No griidi fi ad moni tu moni; bot mek it bi az refyuuz kompier tu wi pikni.

en: For what the Lord has given us to live is enough for us.”
target: Kaa we di Laad don gi wi fi liv a inof fi wi.”

en: Tobit said to her, “Don’t worry, my sister. He will return safe and sound, and your eyes will see him.
target: Tuobit se tu ar, “No wori, mi sista. Im wi riton sief an soun, an yu ai dem wi si im.

en: For a good angel will go with him. His journey will be prospered, and he will return safe and sound.”
target: Kaa a gud ienjel wi go wid im. Im jorni wi prasper, an im wi riton sief an soun.”

en: So she stopped weeping.
target: So shi tap baal.

en: Now as they went on their journey, they came at evening to the river Tigris, and they lodged there.
target: Nou az dem go pan dem jorni, dem kom a iivnin tu di riva Taigris, an dem laj de.

en: But the young man went down to wash himself, and a fish leaped out of the river, and would have swallowed up the young man.
target: Bot di yong man go dong fi waash imself, an a fish liip out a di riva, an wuda swaala op di yong man.

en: But the angel said to him, “Grab the fish!” So the young man grabbed the fish, and hauled it up onto the land.
target: Bot di ienjel se tu im, “Grab di fish!” So di yong man grab di fish, an aal it op pan di lan.

en: And the angel said to him, “Cut the fish open, and take the heart, the liver, and the bile, and keep them with you.”
target: An di ienjel se tu im, “Kot di fish uopm, an tek di aart, di liva, an di bail, an kip dem wid yu.”

en: And the young man did as the angel commanded him; but they roasted the fish, and ate it. And they both went on their way, till they drew near to Ecbatana.
target: An di yong man du az di ienjel koman im; bot dem ruos di fish, an iit it. An dem buot go pan dem wie, til dem jraa nier tu Ekbatana.

en: The young man said to the angel, “Brother Azarias, of what use is the heart, the liver, and the bile of the fish?”
target: Di yong man se tu di ienjel, “Breda Azaraias, a wa yuus di aart, di liva, an di bail a di fish?”

en: He said to him, “About the heart and the liver: If a demon or an evil spirit troubles anyone, we must burn those and make smoke of them before the man or the woman, and the affliction will flee.
target: Im se tu im, “Bout di aart an di liva: Ef a diimon or a iivl spirit chrobl enibadi, wi mos bon dem an mek smuok a dem bifuo di man or di uman, an di aflikshan wi ron we.

en: But as for the bile, it is good to anoint a man that has white films in his eyes, and he will be healed.”
target: Bot az fi di bail, it gud fi anoint a man we av wait film dem ina im ai dem, an im wi get iil.”

en: But when they drew near to Rages,
target: Bot wen dem jraa nier tu Riejiz,

en: the angel said to the young man, “Brother, today we will lodge with Raguel. He is your kinsman. He has an only daughter named Sarah. I will speak about her, that she should be given to you for a wife.
target: di ienjel se tu di yong man, “Breda, tide wi wi laj wid Raguel. Im a yu kinzman. Im av a onli daata niem Siera. Mi wi taak bout ar, dat dem shud gi ar tu yu fi a waif.

en: For her inheritance belongs to you, and you only are of her kindred.
target: Kaa ar inheritans bilang tu yu, an yu aluon a ar kin.

en: The maid is fair and wise. And now hear me, and I will speak to her father. When we return from Rages we will celebrate the marriage; for I know that Raguel may in no way marry her to another according to the law of Moses, or else he would be liable to death, because it belongs to you to take the inheritance, rather than any other.”
target: Di miid fier an waiz. An nou ier mi, an mi wi taak tu ar faada. Wen wi riton fram Riejiz wi wi selibriet di marij; kaa mi nuo dat Raguel kyaan ina no wie mari ar tu aneda akaadin tu di laa a Muoziz, or els im wuda laiabl tu det, bikaaz it bilang tu yu fi tek di inheritans, raada dan eni ada.”

en: Then the young man said to the angel, “Brother Azarias, I have heard that this maid has been given to seven men, and that they all perished in the bride-chamber.
target: Den di yong man se tu di ienjel, “Breda Azaraias, mi ier dat dis miid did gi tu sevn man, an dat dem aal ded ina di braid-chiemba.

en: Now I am the only son of my father, and I am afraid, lest I go in and die, even as those before me. For a demon loves her, which harms no man, but those which come to her. Now I fear lest I die, and bring my father’s and my mother’s life to the grave with sorrow because of me. They have no other son to bury them.”
target: Nou mi a di onli son a mi faada, an mi fried, les mi go in an ded, iivn az dem bifuo mi. Kaa a diimon lov ar, we aam no man, bot dem uu kom tu ar. Nou mi fier les mi ded, an bring mi faada an mi mada laif tu di griev wid saro bikaaz a mi. Dem av no ada son fi beri dem.”

en: But the angel said to him, “Don’t you remember the words which your father commanded you, that you should take a wife of your own kindred? Now hear me, brother; for she will be your wife. Don’t worry about the demon; for this night she will be given you as wife.
target: Bot di ienjel se tu im, “Yu no rememba di wod dem we yu faada koman yu, dat yu shud tek a waif a yu uon kin? Nou ier mi, breda; kaa shi wi bi yu waif. No wori bout di diimon; kaa dis nait dem wi gi ar tu yu az waif.

en: And when you come into the bride-chamber, you must take the ashes of incense, and must lay upon them some of the heart and liver of the fish, and must make smoke with them.
target: An wen yu kom ina di braid-chiemba, yu mos tek di ashiz a insens, an mos lie pan dem som a di aart an liva a di fish, an mos mek smuok wid dem.

en: The demon will smell it, and flee away, and never come again any more. But when you go near to her, both of you rise up, and cry to God who is merciful. He will save you, and have mercy on you. Don’t be afraid, for she was prepared for you from the beginning; and you will save her, and she will go with you. And I suppose that you will have children with her.” When Tobias heard these things, he loved her, and his soul was strongly joined to her.
target: Di diimon wi smel it, an ron we, an neva kom agen no muo. Bot wen yu go nier tu ar, unu buot raiz op, an krai tu Gad uu mersiful. Im wi siev yu, an av mersi pan yu. No fried, kaa shi did pripier fi yu fram di bignin; an yu wi siev ar, an shi wi go wid yu. An mi supuoz dat yu wi av pikni wid ar.” Wen Tobaias ier dem ting ya, im lov ar, an im suol jain schrang tu ar.

en: They came to Ecbatana, and arrived at the house of Raguel. But Sarah met them; and she greeted them, and they her. Then she brought them into the house.
target: Dem kom tu Ekbatana, an araiv a di ous a Raguel. Bot Siera met dem; an shi griit dem, an dem griit ar. Den shi bring dem ina di ous.

en: Raguel said to Edna his wife, “This young man really resembles Tobit my cousin!”
target: Raguel se tu Edna im waif, “Dis yong man riali rizembl Tuobit mi kozn!”

en: And Raguel asked them, “Where are you two from, kindred?” They said to him, “We are of the sons of Naphtali, who are captives in Nineveh.”
target: An Raguel aks dem, “We unu tuu kom fram, kin?” Dem se tu im, “Wi a a di son dem a Naftalai, uu kiaptiv ina Ninive.”

en: He said to them, “Do you know Tobit our brother?” They said, “We know him.” Then he said to them, “Is he in good health?”
target: Im se tu dem, “Unu nuo Tuobit wi breda?” Dem se, “Wi nuo im.” Den im se tu dem, “Im ina gud elt?”

en: They said, “He is both alive, and in good health.” Tobias said, “He is my father.”
target: Dem se, “Im alaiv, an ina gud elt tu.” Tobaias se, “Im a mi faada.”

en: And Raguel sprang up, and kissed him, wept,
target: An Raguel spring op, an kis im, baal,

en: blessed him, and said to him, “You are the son of an honest and good man.” When he had heard that Tobit had lost his sight, he was grieved, and wept;
target: bles im, an se tu im, “Yu a di son a a anes an gud man.” Wen im ier dat Tuobit did luuz im sait, im griiv, an baal;

en: and Edna his wife and Sarah his daughter wept. They received them gladly; and they killed a ram of the flock, and served them meat. But Tobias said to Raphael, “Brother Azarias, speak of those things of which you talked about in the way, and let the matter be finished.”
target: an Edna im waif an Siera im daata baal. Dem risiiv dem gladli; an dem kil a ram a di flak, an sorv dem miit. Bot Tobaias se tu Rafael, “Breda Azaraias, taak a dem ting de a we yu taak bout pan di wie, an mek di mata finish.”

en: So he communicated the thing to Raguel. Raguel said to Tobias, “Eat, drink, and make merry:
target: So im komyuunikiet di ting tu Raguel. Raguel se tu Tobaias, “Iit, jringk, an mek meri:

en: for it belongs to you to take my child. However I will tell you the truth.
target: kaa it bilang tu yu fi tek mi pikni. Oueva mi wi tel yu di chruut.

en: I have given my child to seven men of our relatives, and whenever they came in to her, they died in the night. But for the present be merry.” And Tobias said, “I will taste nothing here, until you all make a covenant and enter into that covenant with me.”
target: Mi don gi mi pikni tu sevn man a wi relitiv dem, an weneva dem kom in tu ar, dem ded ina di nait. Bot fi nou bi meri.” An Tobaias se, “Mi wi ties notn ya, til unu aal mek a kovnant an enta ina dat kovnant wid mi.”

en: Raguel said, “Take her to yourself from now on according to custom. You are her relative, and she is yours. The merciful God will give all good success to you.”
target: Raguel se, “Tek ar tu yuself fram nou pan akaadin tu kostom. Yu a ar relitiv, an shi a yuoz. Di mersiful Gad wi gi aal gud sokses tu yu.”

en: And he called his daughter Sarah, and took her by the hand, and gave her to be wife of Tobias, and said, “See, take her to yourself after the law of Moses, and lead her away to your father.” And he blessed them.
target: An im kaal im daata Siera, an tek ar bai di an, an gi ar fi waif a Tobaias, an se, “Si, tek ar tu yuself afta di laa a Muoziz, an liid ar we tu yu faada.” An im bles dem.

en: He called Edna his wife, then took a book, wrote a contract, and sealed it.
target: Im kaal Edna im waif, den tek a buk, ruot a kanchrak, an siil it.

en: Then they began to eat.
target: Den dem staat fi iit.

en: And Raguel called his wife Edna, and said to her, “Sister, prepare the other chamber, and bring her in there.”
target: An Raguel kaal im waif Edna, an se tu ar, “Sista, pripier di ada chiemba, an bring ar in de.”

en: She did as he asked her, and brought her in there. She wept, and she received the tears of her daughter, and said to her,
target: Shi du az im aks ar, an bring ar in de. Shi baal, an shi risiiv di tierz a ar daata, an se tu ar,

en: “Be comforted, my child. May the Lord of heaven and earth give you favor for this your sorrow. Be comforted, my daughter.”
target: “Bi komfot, mi pikni. Mie di Laad a evn an ort gi yu fieva fi dis yu saro. Bi komfot, mi daata.”

en: When they had finished their supper, they brought Tobias in to her.
target: Wen dem finish dem sopa, dem bring Tobaias in tu ar.

en: But as he went, he remembered the words of Raphael, and took the ashes of the incense, and put the heart and the liver of the fish on them, and made smoke with them.
target: Bot az im go, im rememba di wod dem a Rafael, an tek di ashiz a di insens, an put di aart an di liva a di fish pan dem, an mek smuok wid dem.

en: When the demon smelled that smell, it fled into the uppermost parts of Egypt, and the angel bound him.
target: Wen di diimon smel dat smel, it ron we ina di opamos paat dem a Iijipt, an di ienjel bain im.

en: But after they were both shut in together, Tobias rose up from the bed, and said, “Sister, arise, and let’s pray that the Lord may have mercy on us.”
target: Bot afta dem buot shot in tugeda, Tobaias raiz op fram di bed, an se, “Sista, araiz, an mek wi prier dat di Laad mien av mersi pan wi.”

en: And Tobias began to say, “Blessed are you, O God of our fathers, and blessed is your holy and glorious name forever. Let the heavens bless you, and all your creatures.
target: An Tobaias staat fi se, “Bles yu bi, O Gad a wi faada dem, an bles a yu uoli an gluorias niem faareva. Mek di evn dem bles yu, an aal yu kriicha dem.

en: You made Adam, and gave him Eve his wife for a helper and support. From them came the seed of men. You said, it is not good that the man should be alone. Let’s make him a helper like him.
target: Yu mek Aadam, an gi im Iiv im waif fi a elpa an sopuot. Fram dem kom di siid a man dem. Yu se, it no gud dat di man shud bi aluon. Mek wi mek im a elpa laik im.

en: And now, O Lord, I take not this my sister for lust, but in truth. Command that I may find mercy and grow old with her.”
target: An nou, O Laad, mi no tek dis mi sista fi los, bot ina chruut. Koman dat mi mien fain mersi an gruo uol wid ar.”

en: She said with him, “Amen.” And they both slept that night.
target: Shi se wid im, “Aamen.” An dem buot sliip dat nait.

en: Raguel arose, and went and dug a grave,
target: Raguel araiz, an go an dig a griev,

en: saying, “Lest he also should die.”
target: a se, “Les im tu shud ded.”

en: And Raguel came into his house,
target: An Raguel kom ina im ous,

en: and said to Edna his wife, “Send one of the maidservants, and let them see if he is alive. If not, we will bury him, and no man will know it.”
target: an se tu Edna im waif, “Sen wan a di miidservant dem, an mek dem si ef im alaiv. Ef no, wi wi beri im, an no man wi nuo it.”

en: So the maidservant opened the door, and went in, and found them both sleeping,
target: So di miidservant uopm di duor, an go in, an fain dem buot a sliip,

en: and came out, and told them that he was alive.
target: an kom out, an tel dem dat im alaiv.

en: Then Raguel blessed God, saying, “Blessed are you, O God, with all pure and holy blessing! Let your saints bless you, and all your creatures! Let all your angels and your elect bless you forever!
target: Den Raguel bles Gad, a se, “Bles yu bi, O Gad, wid aal pyuor an uoli blesin! Mek yu sient dem bles yu, an aal yu kriicha dem! Mek aal yu ienjel dem an yu ilek bles yu faareva!

en: Blessed are you, because you have made me glad; and it has not happened to me as I suspected; but you have dealt with us according to your great mercy.
target: Bles yu bi, bikaaz yu mek mi glad; an it no apn tu mi az mi did sospek; bot yu diil wid wi akaadin tu yu griet mersi.

en: Blessed are you, because you have had mercy on two that were the only begotten children of their parents. Show them mercy, O Lord. Fulfill their life in health with gladness and mercy.
target: Bles yu bi, bikaaz yu av mersi pan tuu we a di onli bigetn pikni a dem pierent dem. Shuo dem mersi, O Laad. Fulfil dem laif ina elt wid gladnis an mersi.

en: He commanded his servants to fill the grave.
target: Im koman im saavant dem fi fil di griev.

en: He kept the wedding feast for them fourteen days.
target: Im kip di wedn fiis fi dem fuotiin die.

en: Before the days of the wedding feast were finished, Raguel sware to him, that he should not depart till the fourteen days of the wedding feast were fulfilled;
target: Bifuo di die dem a di wedn fiis finish, Raguel swier tu im, dat im shud no dipaat til di fuotiin die dem a di wedn fiis fulfil;

en: and that then he should take half of his goods, and go in safety to his father; and the rest, said he, when my wife and I die.
target: an dat den im shud tek aaf a im gudz, an go ina siefiti tu im faada; an di res, im se, wen mi waif an mi ded.

en: And Tobias called Raphael, and said to him,
target: An Tobaias kaal Rafael, an se tu im,

en: “Brother Azarias, take with you a servant and two camels, and go to Rages of Media to Gabael, and receive the money for me, and bring him to the wedding feast,
target: “Breda Azaraias, tek wid yu a saavant an tuu kiamel, an go tu Riejiz a Miidia tu Gabiel, an get di moni fi mi, an bring im tu di wedn fiis,

en: because Raguel has sworn that I must not depart.
target: bikaaz Raguel don swier dat mi mos no dipaat.

en: My father counts the days; and if I wait long, he will be very grieved.
target: Mi faada kount di die dem; an ef mi wiet lang, im wi griiv badli.

en: So Raphael went on his way, and lodged with Gabael, and gave him the signed bond; so he brought forth the bags with their seals, and gave them to him.
target: So Rafael go pan im wie, an laj wid Gabiel, an gi im di sain ban; so im bring fuot di bag dem wid dem siil, an gi dem tu im.

en: Then they rose up early in the morning together, and came to the wedding feast. Tobias blessed his wife.
target: Den dem raiz op orli ina di maanin tugeda, an kom tu di wedn fiis. Tobaias bles im waif.

en: Tobit his father counted every day. When the days of the journey were expired, and they didn’t come,
target: Tuobit im faada kount evri die. Wen di die dem a di jorni don, an dem no kom,

en: he said, “Is he perchance detained? Or is Gabael perchance dead, and there is no one to give him the money?”
target: im se, “Im perchans ditien? Or Gabiel perchans ded, an no wan no de fi gi im di moni?”

en: He was very grieved.
target: Im griiv badli.

en: But his wife said to him, “The child has perished, seeing he waits long.” She began to bewail him, and said,
target: Bot im waif se tu im, “Di pikni ded, a si im wiet lang.” Shi staat fi biwiel im, an se,

en: “I care about nothing, my child, since I have let you go, the light of my eyes.”
target: “Mi no kier bout notn, mi pikni, sins mi mek yu go, di lait a mi ai dem.”

en: Tobit said to her, “Hold your peace. Don’t worry. He is in good health.”
target: Tuobit se tu ar, “Uol yu piis. No wori. Im ina gud elt.”

en: And she said to him, “Hold your peace. Don’t deceive me. My child has perished.” And she went out every day into the way by which they went, and ate no bread in the day-time, and didn’t stop bewailing her son Tobias for whole nights, until the fourteen days of the wedding feast were expired, which Raguel had sworn that he should spend there. Then Tobias said to Raguel, “Send me away, for my father and my mother look no more to see me.”
target: An shi se tu im, “Uol yu piis. No disiiv mi. Mi pikni ded.” An shi go out evri die ina di wie bai we dem go, an iit no bred ina di die-taim, an no tap biwiel ar son Tobaias fi uol nait dem, til di fuotiin die dem a di wedn fiis don, we Raguel did swier dat im shud spen de. Den Tobaias se tu Raguel, “Sen mi we, kaa mi faada an mi mada no luk no muo fi si mi.”

en: But his father-in-law said to him, “Stay with me, and I will send to your father, and they will declare to him how things go with you.”
target: Bot im faada-in-laa se tu im, “Stie wid mi, an mi wi sen tu yu faada, an dem wi diklier tu im ou ting go wid yu.”

en: Tobias said, “No. Send me away to my father.”
target: Tobaias se, “No. Sen mi we tu mi faada.”

en: Raguel arose, and gave him Sarah his wife, and half his goods, servants and cattle and money;
target: Raguel araiz, an gi im Siera im waif, an aaf im gudz, saavant dem an kiatl an moni;

en: and he blessed them, and sent them away, saying, “The God of heaven will prosper you, my children, before I die.”
target: an im bles dem, an sen dem we, a se, “Di Gad a evn wi prasper unu, mi pikni dem, bifuo mi ded.”

en: And he said to his daughter, “Honor your father-in-law and your mother-in-law. They are now your parents. Let me hear a good report of you.” Then he kissed her. Edna said to Tobias, “May the Lord of heaven restore you, dear brother, and grant to me that I may see your children of my daughter Sarah, that I may rejoice before the Lord. See, I commit my daughter to you in special trust. Don’t cause her grief.
target: An im se tu im daata, “Ona yu faada-in-laa an yu mada-in-laa. Dem nou a yu pierent dem. Mek mi ier a gud ripuot a yu.” Den im kis ar. Edna se tu Tobaias, “Mie di Laad a evn ristuor yu, dier breda, an grant tu mi dat mi mien si yu pikni dem a mi daata Siera, dat mi mien rijais bifuo di Laad. Si, mi komit mi daata tu yu ina speshal chros. No kaaz ar griif.

en: After these things Tobias also went his way, blessing God because he had prospered his journey; and he blessed Raguel and Edna his wife. Then he went on his way until they drew near to Nineveh.
target: Afta dem ting ya Tobaias tu go im wie, a bles Gad bikaaz im did prasper im jorni; an im bles Raguel an Edna im waif. Den im go pan im wie til dem jraa nier tu Ninive.

en: Raphael said to Tobias, “Don’t you know, brother, how you left your father?
target: Rafael se tu Tobaias, “Yu no nuo, breda, ou yu lef yu faada?

en: Let’s run forward before your wife, and prepare the house.
target: Mek wi ron faawad bifuo yu waif, an pripier di ous.

en: But take in your hand the bile of the fish.” So they went their way, and the dog went after them.
target: Bot tek ina yu an di bail a di fish.” So dem go dem wie, an di daag go afta dem.

en: Anna sat looking around toward the path for her son.
target: Ana sidong a luk roun tuwaad di paat fi ar son.

en: She saw him coming, and said to his father, “See, your son is coming with the man that went with him!”
target: Shi si im a kom, an se tu im faada, “Si, yu son a kom wid di man we go wid im!”

en: Raphael said, “I know, Tobias, that your father will open his eyes.
target: Rafael se, “Mi nuo, Tobaias, dat yu faada wi uopm im ai dem.

en: Therefore anoint his eyes with the bile, and being pricked with it, he will rub, and will make the white films fall away. Then he will see you.”
target: So anoint im ai dem wid di bail, an wen it prik im, im wi rob, an wi mek di wait film dem faal we. Den im wi si yu.”

en: Anna ran to him, and fell upon the neck of her son, and said to him, “I have seen you, my child! I am ready to die.” They both wept.
target: Ana ron tu im, an faal pan di nek a ar son, an se tu im, “Mi si yu, mi pikni! Mi redi fi ded.” Dem buot baal.

en: Tobit went toward the door and stumbled; but his son ran to him,
target: Tuobit go tuwaad di duor an stombl; bot im son ron tu im,

en: and took hold of his father. He rubbed the bile on his father’s eyes, saying, “Cheer up, my father.”
target: an tek uol a im faada. Im rob di bail pan im faada ai dem, a se, “Chier op, mi faada.”

en: When his eyes began to hurt, he rubbed them.
target: Wen im ai dem staat fi ort, im rob dem.

en: Then the white films peeled away from the corners of his eyes; and he saw his son, and fell upon his neck.
target: Den di wait film dem piil we fram di kaana dem a im ai dem; an im si im son, an faal pan im nek.

en: He wept, and said, “Blessed are you, O God, and blessed is your name forever! Blessed are all your holy angels!
target: Im baal, an se, “Bles yu bi, O Gad, an bles a yu niem faareva! Bles a aal yu uoli ienjel dem!

en: For you scourged, and had mercy on me. See, I see my son Tobias.” And his son went in rejoicing, and told his father the great things that had happened to him in Media.
target: Kaa yu flog, an av mersi pan mi. Si, mi si mi son Tobaias.” An im son go in a rijais, an tel im faada di griet ting dem we did apn tu im ina Miidia.

en: Tobit went out to meet his daughter-in-law at the gate of Nineveh, rejoicing and blessing God. Those who saw him go marveled, because he had received his sight.
target: Tuobit go out fi miit im daata-in-laa a di giet a Ninive, a rijais an a bles Gad. Dem uu si im go maavl, bikaaz im did get im sait.

en: Tobit gave thanks before them, because God had shown mercy on him. When Tobit came near to Sarah his daughter-in-law, he blessed her, saying, “Welcome, daughter! Blessed is God who has brought you to us, and blessed are your father and your mother.” And there was joy among all his kindred who were at Nineveh.
target: Tuobit gi tangks bifuo dem, bikaaz Gad did shuo mersi pan im. Wen Tuobit kom nier tu Siera im daata-in-laa, im bles ar, a se, “Welkom, daata! Bles a Gad uu bring yu tu wi, an bles a yu faada an yu mada.” An jai de mongks aal im kin uu de a Ninive.

en: Achiacharus and Nasbas his brother’s son came.
target: Akiakaros an Nasbas im breda son kom.

en: Tobias’ wedding feast was kept seven days with great gladness.
target: Tobaias wedn fiis kip sevn die wid griet gladnis.

en: And Tobit called his son Tobias, and said to him, “See, my child, that the man which went with you have his wages, and you must give him more.”
target: An Tuobit kaal im son Tobaias, an se tu im, “Si, mi pikni, dat di man we go wid yu get im wiej dem, an yu mos gi im muo.”

en: And he said to him, “Father, it is no harm to me to give him the half of those things which I have brought;
target: An im se tu im, “Faada, it no aam mi fi gi im di aaf a dem ting we mi bring;

en: for he has led me for you in safety, and he cured my wife, and brought my money, and likewise cured you.”
target: kaa im liid mi fi yu ina siefiti, an im kyuor mi waif, an bring mi moni, an laikwaiz kyuor yu.”

en: The old man said, “It is due to him.”
target: Di uol man se, “It juu tu im.”

en: And he called the angel, and said to him, “Take half of all that you have brought.”
target: An im kaal di ienjel, an se tu im, “Tek aaf a aal we yu bring.”

en: Then he called them both privately, and said to them, “Bless God, and give him thanks, and magnify him, and give him thanks in the sight of all that live, for the things which he has done with you. It is good to bless God and exalt his name, showing forth with honor the works of God. Don’t be slack to give him thanks.
target: Den im kaal dem buot praivitli, an se tu dem, “Bles Gad, an gi im tangks, an magnifai im, an gi im tangks ina di sait a aal we liv, fi di ting dem we im du wid unu. It gud fi bles Gad an egzalt im niem, a shuo fuot wid ona di wok dem a Gad. No slak fi gi im tangks.

en: It is good to conceal the secret of a king, but to reveal gloriously the works of God. Do good, and evil won’t find you.
target: It gud fi kansiil di siikrit a a king, bot fi riviil gluoriasli di wok dem a Gad. Du gud, an iivl no wi fain yu.

en: Good is prayer with fasting, almsgiving, and righteousness. A little with righteousness is better than much with unrighteousness. It is better to give alms than to lay up gold.
target: Gud a prier wid faastin, aalms-givin, an raichosnis. A likl wid raichosnis beta dan nof wid onraichosnis. It beta fi gi aalms dan fi lie op guol.

en: Almsgiving delivers from death, and it purges away all sin. Those who give alms and do righteousness will be filled with life;
target: Aalms-givin diliva fram det, an it porj we aal sin. Dem uu gi aalms an du raichosnis wi ful wid laif;

en: but those who sin are enemies to their own life.
target: bot dem uu sin a enimi tu dem uon laif.

en: Surely I will conceal nothing from you. I have said, ‘It is good to conceal the secret of a king, but to reveal gloriously the works of God.’
target: Syuorli mi wi kansiil notn fram unu. Mi don se, ‘It gud fi kansiil di siikrit a a king, bot fi riviil gluoriasli di wok dem a Gad.’

en: And now, when you prayed, and Sarah your daughter-in-law, I brought the memorial of your prayer before the Holy One. When you buried the dead, I was with you likewise.
target: An nou, wen yu prier, an Siera yu daata-in-laa, mi bring di memuorial a unu prier bifuo di Uoli Wan. Wen yu beri di ded, mi de wid yu laikwaiz.

en: And when you didn’t delay to rise up, and leave your dinner, that you might go and cover the dead, your good deed was not hidden from me. I was with you.
target: An wen yu no dilie fi raiz op, an lef yu dina, dat yu maita go an kova di ded, yu gud diid no aid fram mi. Mi de wid yu.

en: And now God sent me to heal you and Sarah your daughter-in-law.
target: An nou Gad sen mi fi iil yu an Siera yu daata-in-laa.

en: I am Raphael, one of the seven holy angels which present the prayers of the saints and go in before the glory of the Holy One.”
target: Mi a Rafael, wan a di sevn uoli ienjel dem we prizent di prier dem a di sient dem an go in bifuo di gluori a di Uoli Wan.”

en: And they were both troubled, and fell upon their faces; for they were afraid.
target: An dem buot chrobl, an faal pan dem fies; kaa dem fried.

en: And he said to them, “Don’t be afraid. You will all have peace; but bless God forever.
target: An im se tu dem, “No fried. Unu aal wi av piis; bot bles Gad faareva.

en: For I came not of any favor of my own, but by the will of your God. Therefore bless him forever.
target: Kaa mi kom no a eni fieva a mi uon, bot bai di wil a unu Gad. So bles im faareva.

en: All these days I appeared to you. I didn’t eat or drink, but you all saw a vision.
target: Aal dem die ya mi apier tu unu. Mi no iit or jringk, bot unu aal si a vizhan.

en: Now give God thanks, because I ascend to him who sent me. Write in a book all the things which have been done.”
target: Nou gi Gad tangks, bikaaz mi asen tu im uu sen mi. Rait ina a buk aal di ting dem we don du.”

en: Then they rose up, and saw him no more.
target: Den dem raiz op, an si im no muo.

en: They confessed the great and wonderful works of God, and how the angel of the Lord had appeared to them.
target: Dem kanfes di griet an wondaful wok dem a Gad, an ou di ienjel a di Laad did apier tu dem.

en: And Tobit wrote a prayer for rejoicing, and said, “Blessed is God who lives forever! Blessed is his kingdom!
target: An Tuobit ruot a prier fi rijaisin, an se, “Bles a Gad uu liv faareva! Bles a im kindom!

en: For he scourges, and shows mercy. He leads down to the grave, and brings up again. There is no one who will escape his hand.
target: Kaa im flog, an shuo mersi. Im liid dong tu di griev, an bring op agen. No wan no de we wi eskiep im an.

en: Give thanks to him before the Gentiles, all you children of Israel! For he has scattered us among them.
target: Gi tangks tu im bifuo di Jentailz, aal unu pikni a Izrel! Kaa im skata wi mongks dem.

en: Declare his greatness, there. Extol him before all the living, because he is our Lord, and God is our Father forever.
target: Diklier im grietnis, de. Egzalt im bifuo aal di livin, bikaaz im a wi Laad, an Gad a wi Faada faareva.

en: He will scourge us for our sins, and will again show mercy, and will gather us out of all the nations among whom you are all scattered.
target: Im wi flog wi fi wi sin dem, an wi agen shuo mersi, an wi gyada wi out a aal di nieshan dem mongks uu unu aal skata.

en: If you turn to him with your whole heart and with your whole soul, to do truth before him, then he will turn to you, and won’t hide his face from you. See what he will do with you. Give him thanks with your whole mouth. Bless the Lord of righteousness. Exalt the everlasting King. I give him thanks in the land of my captivity, and show his strength and majesty to a nation of sinners. Turn, you sinners, and do righteousness before him. Who can tell if he will accept you and have mercy on you?
target: Ef unu ton tu im wid unu uol aart an wid unu uol suol, fi du chruut bifuo im, den im wi ton tu unu, an no wi aid im fies fram unu. Si we im wi du wid unu. Gi im tangks wid unu uol mout. Bles di Laad a raichosnis. Egzalt di evaalastin King. Mi gi im tangks ina di lan a mi kiaptiviti, an shuo im schrengt an majisti tu a nieshan a sina dem. Ton, unu sina dem, an du raichosnis bifuo im. Uu kyan tel ef im wi aksep unu an av mersi pan unu?

en: I exalt my God. My soul exalts the King of heaven, and rejoices in his greatness.
target: Mi egzalt mi Gad. Mi suol egzalt di King a evn, an rijais ina im grietnis.

en: Let all men speak, and let them give him thanks in Jerusalem.
target: Mek aal man taak, an mek dem gi im tangks ina Jeruusalem.

en: O Jerusalem, the holy city, he will scourge you for the works of your sons, and will again have mercy on the sons of the righteous.
target: O Jeruusalem, di uoli siti, im wi flog yu fi di wok dem a yu son dem, an wi agen av mersi pan di son dem a di raichos.

en: Give thanks to the Lord with goodness, and bless the everlasting King, that his tabernacle may be built in you again with joy, and that he may make glad in you those who are captives, and love in you forever those who are miserable.
target: Gi tangks tu di Laad wid gudnis, an bles di evaalastin King, dat im tabernakl mien bil ina yu agen wid jai, an dat im mien mek glad ina yu dem uu kiaptiv, an lov ina yu faareva dem uu mizrabl.

en: Many nations will come from afar to the name of the Lord God with gifts in their hands, even gifts to the King of heaven. Generations of generations will praise you, and sing songs of rejoicing.
target: Nof nieshan wi kom fram afaar tu di niem a di Laad Gad wid gif dem ina dem an, iivn gif dem tu di King a evn. Jenerieshan a jenerieshan dem wi priez yu, an sing sang a rijaisin.

en: All those who hate you are cursed. All those who love you forever will be blessed.
target: Aal dem uu iet yu a kors. Aal dem uu lov yu faareva wi bles.

en: Rejoice and be exceedingly glad for the sons of the righteous; for they will be gathered together and will bless the Lord of the righteous.
target: Rijais an bi eksiidinli glad fi di son dem a di raichos; kaa dem wi gyada tugeda an wi bles di Laad a di raichos.

en: Oh blessed are those who love you. They will rejoice for your peace. Blessed are all those who mourned for all your scourges; because they will rejoice for you when they have seen all your glory. They will be made glad forever.
target: O bles a dem uu lov yu. Dem wi rijais fi yu piis. Bles a aal dem uu muorn fi aal yu flogin dem; bikaaz dem wi rijais fi yu wen dem si aal yu gluori. Dem wi mek glad faareva.

en: Let my soul bless God the great King.
target: Mek mi suol bles Gad di griet King.

en: For Jerusalem will be built with sapphires, emeralds, and precious stones; your walls and towers and battlements with pure gold.
target: Kaa Jeruusalem wi bil wid safaiya dem, emral dem, an preshos stuon dem; yu waal dem an towa dem an batlment dem wid pyuor guol.

en: The streets of Jerusalem will be paved with beryl, carbuncle, and stones of Ophir.
target: Di schriit dem a Jeruusalem wi piev wid beril, kaabongkl, an stuon dem a Uofir.

en: All her streets will say, “Hallelujah!” and give praise, saying, “Blessed be God, who has exalted you forever!”
target: Aal ar schriit dem wi se, “Aliluuya!” an gi priez, a se, “Bles bi Gad, uu egzalt yu faareva!”

en: Then Tobit finished giving thanks.
target: Den Tuobit finish a gi tangks.

en: He was fifty-eight years old when he lost his sight. After eight years, he received it again. He gave alms and he feared the Lord God more and more, and gave thanks to him.
target: Im a fifti-eit ier uol wen im luuz im sait. Afta eit ier, im get it agen. Im gi aalms an im fier di Laad Gad muo an muo, an gi tangks tu im.

en: Now he grew very old; and he called his son with the six sons of his son, and said to him, “My child, take your sons. See, I have grown old, and am ready to depart out of this life.
target: Nou im gruo veri uol; an im kaal im son wid di siks son dem a im son, an se tu im, “Mi pikni, tek yu son dem. Si, mi gruo uol, an redi fi dipaat out a dis laif.

en: Go into Media, my child, for I surely believe all the things which Jonah the prophet spoke of Nineveh, that it will be overthrown, but in Media there will rather be peace for a season. Our kindred will be scattered on the earth from the good land. Jerusalem will be desolate, and the house of God in it will be burned up, and will be desolate for a time.
target: Go ina Miidia, mi pikni, kaa mi syuorli biliiv aal di ting dem we Juona di prafit taak a Ninive, dat it wi uovachruo, bot ina Miidia piis wi rada de fi a siizn. Wi kin wi skata pan di ort fram di gud lan. Jeruusalem wi desolet, an di ous a Gad ina it wi bon op, an wi desolet fi a taim.

en: God will again have mercy on them, and bring them back into the land, and they will build the house, but not like to the former house, until the times of that age are fulfilled. Afterward they will return from the places of their captivity, and build up Jerusalem with honor. The house of God will be built in it forever with a glorious building, even as the prophets spoke concerning it.
target: Gad wi agen av mersi pan dem, an bring dem bak ina di lan, an dem wi bil di ous, bot no laik tu di faama ous, til di taim dem a dat iej fulfil. Aftawod dem wi riton fram di plies dem a dem kiaptiviti, an bil op Jeruusalem wid ona. Di ous a Gad wi bil ina it faareva wid a gluorias bildin, iivn az di prafit dem taak bout it.

en: And all the nations will turn to fear the Lord God truly, and will bury their idols.
target: An aal di nieshan dem wi ton fi fier di Laad Gad chruuli, an wi beri dem aidol.

en: All the nations will bless the Lord, and his people will give thanks to God, and the Lord will exalt his people; and all those who love the Lord God in truth and righteousness will rejoice, showing mercy to our kindred.
target: Aal di nieshan dem wi bles di Laad, an im piipl wi gi tangks tu Gad, an di Laad wi egzalt im piipl; an aal dem uu lov di Laad Gad ina chruut an raichosnis wi rijais, a shuo mersi tu wi kin.

en: And now, my child, depart from Nineveh, because those things which the prophet Jonah spoke will surely come to pass.
target: An nou, mi pikni, dipaat fram Ninive, bikaaz dem ting we di prafit Juona taak wi syuorli kom tu paas.

en: But you must keep the law and the ordinances, and show yourself merciful and righteous, that it may be well with you.
target: Bot yu mos kip di laa an di aadinans dem, an shuo yuself mersiful an raichos, dat it mien bi wel wid yu.

en: Bury me decently, and your mother with me. Don’t stay at Nineveh. See, my child, what Aman did to Achiacharus who nourished him, how out of light he brought him into darkness, and all the recompense that he made him. Achiacharus was saved, but the other had his recompense, and he went down into darkness. Manasses gave alms, and escaped the snare of death which he set for him; but Aman fell into the snare, and perished.
target: Beri mi diisentli, an yu mada wid mi. No stie a Ninive. Si, mi pikni, we Aaman du tu Akiakaros uu norish im, ou out a lait im bring im ina daaknis, an aal di rekompens we im mek im. Akiakaros siev, bot di ada get im rekompens, an im go dong ina daaknis. Manasiz gi aalms, an eskiep di snier a det we im set fi im; bot Aaman faal ina di snier, an ded.

en: And now, my children, consider what almsgiving does, and how righteousness delivers.” While he was saying these things, he gave up the ghost in the bed; but he was one hundred fifty eight years old. Tobias buried him magnificently.
target: An nou, mi pikni dem, kansida we aalms-givin du, an ou raichosnis diliva.” Wails im a se dem ting ya, im gi op di guos ina di bed; bot im a wan onjred fifti-eit ier uol. Tobaias beri im magnifisentli.

en: When Anna died, he buried her with his father. But Tobias departed with his wife and his sons to Ecbatana to Raguel his father-in-law,
target: Wen Ana ded, im beri ar wid im faada. Bot Tobaias dipaat wid im waif an im son dem tu Ekbatana tu Raguel im faada-in-laa,

en: and he grew old in honor, and he buried his father-in-law and mother-in-law magnificently, and he inherited their possessions, and his father Tobit’s.
target: an im gruo uol ina ona, an im beri im faada-in-laa an mada-in-laa magnifisentli, an im inherit dem pozeshan dem, an im faada Tuobit pozeshan dem.

en: He died at Ecbatana of Media, being one hundred twenty seven years old.
target: Im ded a Ekbatana a Miidia, a wan onjred twenti-sevn ier uol.

en: Before he died, he heard of the destruction of Nineveh, which Nebuchadnezzar and Ahasuerus took captive. Before his death, he rejoiced over Nineveh.
target: Bifuo im ded, im ier a di dischroshon a Ninive, we Nebukadnezar an Aazuueros tek kiaptiv. Bifuo im det, im rijais uova Ninive.

en: In the twelfth year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar, who reigned over the Assyrians in Nineveh, the great city, in the days of Arphaxad, who reigned over the Medes in Ecbatana,
target: Ina di twelv ier a di ruul a Nebukadnezar, uu did ruul uova di Asiirian dem ina Ninive, di big siti, ina di die dem a Aafaksad, uu did ruul uova di Miid dem ina Ekbatana,

en: and built around Ecbatana walls of hewn stones three cubits broad and six cubits long, and made the height of the wall seventy cubits, and its breadth fifty cubits,
target: an bil ron Ekbatana waal dem mek a kiev stuon, trii kiubit braad an siks kiubit lang, an mek di ait a di waal sebnti kiubit, an im bred fifti kiubit,

en: and set its towers at its gates one hundred cubits high, and its breadth in the foundation was sixty cubits,
target: an set im towa dem a im giet dem wan onjred kiubit ai, an im bred ina di foundieshan did siksti kiubit,

en: and made its gates, even gates that were raised to the height of seventy cubits, and their breadth forty cubits, for his mighty army to go out of, and the setting in array of his footmen—
target: an mek im giet dem, giet dem we riez op tu di ait a sebnti kiubit, an dem bred fuoti kiubit, fi im maiti aami fi go out a dem, an fi im futman dem set dem iina aarie—

en: in those days King Nebuchadnezzar made war with King Arphaxad in the great plain. This plain is on the borders of Ragau.
target: ina dem die de King Nebukadnezar mek waar wid King Aafaksad ina di big plien. Dis plien de pan di baada dem a Ragau.

en: There came to meet him all that lived in the hill country, and all that lived by Euphrates, Tigris, and Hydaspes, and in the plain of Arioch the king of the Elymaeans. Many nations of the sons of Chelod assembled themselves to the battle.
target: Dem kom fi miit im, aal uu liv ina di il konchri, an aal uu liv bai Yuufretiiz, Taigris, an Aidaspiiz, an ina di plien a Ariok di king a di Elimiyan dem. Nof nieshan a di son dem a Kelod gyada demself tu di batl.

en: And Nebuchadnezzar king of the Assyrians sent to all who lived in Persia, and to all who lived westward, to those who lived in Cilicia, Damascus, Libanus, Antilibanus, and to all who lived along the sea coast,
target: An Nebukadnezar king a di Asiirian dem sen tu aal uu liv ina Persha, an tu aal uu liv weswad, tu dem uu liv ina Silisha, Damaskos, Libanos, Antilibanos, an tu aal uu liv alang di sii kuos,

en: and to those among the nations that were of Carmel and Gilead, and to the higher Galilee and the great plain of Esdraelon,
target: an tu dem mongks di nieshan dem we a Kaamel an Giliad, an tu di opa Gyalalii an di big plien a Esdrelon,

en: and to all who were in Samaria and its cities, and beyond Jordan to Jerusalem, Betane, Chellus, Kadesh, the river of Egypt, Tahpanhes, Rameses, and all the land of Goshen,
target: an tu aal uu did de ina Sameria an im siti dem, an biian Jaadn tu Jeruusalem, Betani, Kelos, Kaadesh, di riva a Iijipt, Tapanes, Ramesez, an aal di lan a Guoshen,

en: until you come above Tanis and Memphis, and to all that lived in Egypt, until you come to the borders of Ethiopia.
target: tel yu kom abov Taanis an Memfis, an tu aal uu liv ina Iijipt, tel yu kom tu di baada dem a Iitiuopia.

en: All those who lived in all the land made light of the commandment of Nebuchadnezzar king of the Assyrians, and didn’t go with him to the war; for they were not afraid of him, but he was before them as one man. They turned away his messengers from their presence without effect, and with disgrace.
target: Aal dem uu liv ina aal di lan tek lait a di komanment a Nebukadnezar king a di Asiirian dem, an no go wid im tu di waar; kaa dem neva fried a im, bot im did bifuo dem az wan man. Dem ton we im mesenja dem fram dem prezens widout notn apn, an wid disgrais.

en: And Nebuchadnezzar was exceedingly angry with all this land, and he swore by his throne and kingdom that he would surely be avenged upon all the borders of Cilicia, Damascus, and Syria, that he would kill with his sword all the inhabitants of the land of Moab, the children of Ammon, all Judea, and all who were in Egypt, until you come to the borders of the two seas.
target: An Nebukadnezar did wel wel beks wid aal dis lan, an im swier bai im chuon an kindom se im wuda fi shuo tek riveng pan aal di baada dem a Silisha, Damaskos, an Siiria, se im wuda kil wid im suod aal di piipl dem uu liv ina di lan a Muab, di pikni dem a Amon, aal Juudia, an aal uu did de ina Iijipt, tel yu kom tu di baada dem a di tuu sii dem.

en: And he set the battle in array with his army against King Arphaxad in the seventeenth year; and he prevailed in his battle, and turned to flight all the army of Arphaxad, with all his horses and all his chariots.
target: An im set di batl iina aarie wid im aami gens King Aafaksad ina di sebntiin ier; an im priviel ina im batl, an ton tu flait aal di aami a Aafaksad, wid aal im aas dem an aal im chariet dem.

en: He took possession of his cities. He came to Ecbatana and took the towers, plundered its streets, and turned its beauty into shame.
target: Im tek pozeshan a im siti dem. Im kom tu Ekbatana an tek di towa dem, plonda im schriit dem, an ton im byuuti tu shiem.

en: He took Arphaxad in the mountains of Ragau, struck him through with his darts, and utterly destroyed him to this day.
target: Im tek Aafaksad ina di mountn dem a Ragau, chuk im chruu wid im daat dem, an mash im op uotali tu dis die.

en: He returned with them to Nineveh, he and all his company of mixed nations—an exceedingly great multitude of men of war. There he took his ease and banqueted, he and his army, for one hundred twenty days.
target: Im rityon wid dem tu Ninive, im an aal im kompini a miks nieshan dem—wan wel big moltityuud a man a waar. De im tek im iiz an bankwet, im an im aami, fi wan onjred twenti die.

en: In the eighteenth year, the twenty-second day of the first month, there was talk in the house of Nebuchadnezzar king of the Assyrians that he should be avenged on all the land, even as he spoke.
target: Ina di ietiin ier, di twenti-sekan die a di fos mont, taak did de ina di ous a Nebukadnezar king a di Asiirian dem se im shud tek riveng pan aal di lan, iivn az im taak.

en: He called together all his servants and all his great men, and communicated with them his secret counsel, and with his own mouth, recounted the wickedness of all the land.
target: Im kaal tugeda aal im saavant dem an aal im big man dem, an taak wid dem im siikrit kounsl, an wid im uon mout, tel out di wikidnis a aal di lan.

en: They decreed to destroy all flesh which didn’t follow the word of his mouth.
target: Dem dikrii fi mash op aal flesh we neva fala di wod a im mout.

en: When he had ended his counsel, Nebuchadnezzar king of the Assyrians called Holofernes the chief captain of his army, who was second to himself, and said to him,
target: Wen im don im kounsl, Nebukadnezar king a di Asiirian dem kaal Olofernes di chiif kiaptin a im aami, uu did sekan tu imself, an se tu im,

en: “The great king, the lord of all the earth, says: ‘See, you must go out from my presence, and take with you men who trust in their strength, to one hundred twenty thousand footmen and twelve thousand horses with their riders.
target: “Di big king, di smol-laad a aal di ort, se: ‘Si, yu mos go out fram mi prezens, an tek wid yu man uu chros ina dem schrent, tu wan onjred twenti touzn futman an twelv touzn aas wid dem raida dem.

en: And you must go out against all the west country, because they disobeyed the commandment of my mouth.
target: An yu mos go out gens aal di wes konchri, kaa dem disobie di komanment a mi mout.

en: You must declare to them that they should prepare earth and water, because I will go out in my wrath against them, and will cover the whole face of the earth with the feet of my army, who will plunder them.
target: Yu mos diklier tu dem se dem shud pripier ort an waata, kaa mi wi go out ina mi raat gens dem, an wi kova di uol fies a di ort wid di fut dem a mi aami, uu wi plonda dem.

en: Their slain will fill their valleys and brooks, and the river will be filled with their dead until it overflows.
target: Dem slain wi ful dem vali an bruk dem, an di riva wi ful wid dem ded til im uovafluo.

en: I will lead them as captives to the utmost parts of all the earth.
target: Mi wi liid dem az kiaptiv tu di fordis paat dem a aal di ort.

en: But you must go forth, and take all their borders for me first. If they will yield themselves to you, then you must reserve them for me until the day of their reproof.
target: Bot yu mos go fuot, an tek aal dem baada fi mi fos. Ef dem wi gi demself op tu yu, den yu mos rizoerv dem fi mi tel di die a dem riproof.

en: As for those who resist, your eye must not spare; but you must give them up to be slain and to be plundered in all your land.
target: Fa dem uu rizis, yu yai mos no spier; bot yu mos gi dem op fi get slain an fi get plonda ina aal yu lan.

en: For as I live, and by the power of my kingdom, I have spoken, and I will do this with my hand.
target: Kaa az mi liv, an bai di powa a mi kindom, mi taak, an mi wi du dis wid mi an.

en: Moreover, you must not transgress anything of the commandments of your lord, but you must surely accomplish them, as I have commanded you. You must not defer to do them.’ ”
target: Moreova, yu mos no transgres notn a di komanment dem a yu smol-laad, bot yu mos shuo du dem, az mi koman yu. Yu mos no difa fi du dem.’ ”

en: So Holofernes went out from the presence of his lord, and called all the governors, the captains, and officers of the army of Asshur.
target: So Olofernes go out fram di prezens a im smol-laad, an kaal aal di govana dem, di kiaptin dem, an afisa dem a di aami a Ashur.

en: He counted chosen men for the battle, as his lord had commanded him, to one hundred twenty thousand, with twelve thousand archers on horseback.
target: Im kount chuozn man fi di batl, az im smol-laad koman im, tu wan onjred twenti touzn, wid twelv touzn aacha pan aasbak.

en: He arranged them as a great multitude is ordered for the war.
target: Im arienj dem az wan big moltityuud aada fi di waar.

en: He took camels, donkeys, and mules for their baggage, an exceedingly great multitude, and sheep, oxen, and goats without number for their provision,
target: Im tek kyamel dem, dongki dem, an myuul dem fi dem bagij, wan wel big moltityuud, an shiip, aksn, an guot widout nomba fi dem provijan,

en: and a large supply of rations for every man, and a huge amount of gold and silver out of the king’s house.
target: an wan big soplai a rashan fi evri man, an wan yuuj amount a guol an silva out a di king ous.

en: He went out, he and all his army, on their journey, to go before King Nebuchadnezzar, and to cover all the face of the earth westward with their chariots, horsemen, and chosen footmen.
target: Im go out, im an aal im aami, pan dem jorni, fi go bifuo King Nebukadnezar, an fi kova aal di fies a di ort weswad wid dem chariet dem, aasman dem, an chuozn futman dem.

en: A great company of various nations went out with them like locusts and like the sand of the earth. For they could not be counted by reason of their multitude.
target: Wan big kompini a vierios nieshan go out wid dem laik lokos an laik di san a di ort. Kaa dem kudna kount bikaaz a dem moltityuud.

en: And they departed out of Nineveh three days’ journey toward the plain of Bectileth, and encamped from Bectileth near the mountain which is at the left hand of the Upper Cilicia.
target: An dem dipaat out a Ninive trii die jorni tord di plien a Bektailet, an enkyamp fram Bektailet nier di mountn we de a di lef an a di Opa Silisha.

en: And he took all his army, his footmen, horsemen, and chariots, and went away from there into the hill country,
target: An im tek aal im aami, im futman dem, aasman dem, an chariet dem, an go we fram de ina di il konchri,

en: and destroyed Put and Lud, and plundered all the children of Rasses and the children of Ishmael, which were along the wilderness to the south of the land of the Chellians.
