target: an mash op Put an Lud, an plonda aal di pikni dem a Rasez an di pikni dem a Ishmel, we did alang di wildanis tu di sout a di lan a di Keliyan dem.

en: And he went over Euphrates, and went through Mesopotamia, and broke down all the high cities that were upon the river Arbonai, until you come to the sea.
target: An im go uova Yuufretiiz, an go chruu Mesopotiemia, an bruk dong aal di ai siti dem we did pan di riva Aabonai, tel yu kom tu di sii.

en: And he took possession of the borders of Cilicia, and killed all who resisted him, and came to the borders of Japheth, which were toward the south, opposite Arabia.
target: An im tek pozeshan a di baada dem a Silisha, an kil aal uu rizis im, an kom tu di baada dem a Jaafet, we did tord di sout, apozit Ariebia.

en: He surrounded all the children of Midian, and set their tents on fire, and plundered their sheepfolds.
target: Im soroun aal di pikni dem a Midian, an set dem tent dem pan faiya, an plonda dem shiipfoul dem.

en: He went down into the plain of Damascus in the days of wheat harvest, and set all their fields on fire, and utterly destroyed their flocks and herds, plundered their cities, laid their plains waste, and struck all their young men with the edge of the sword.
target: Im go dong ina di plien a Damaskos ina di die dem a wiit aarves, an set aal dem fiil dem pan faiya, an mash op dem flak dem an oerd dem uotali, plonda dem siti dem, lies dem plien dem wies, an chuk aal dem yong man dem wid di ej a di suod.

en: And the fear and the dread of him fell upon those who lived on the sea coast, upon those who were in Sidon and Tyre, those who lived in Sur and Ocina, and all who lived in Jemnaan. Those who lived in Azotus and Ascalon feared him exceedingly.
target: An di fier an di jred a im fel pan dem uu liv pan di sii kuos, pan dem uu did ina Saidon an Taiya, dem uu liv ina Sor an Osina, an aal uu liv ina Jemnaan. Dem uu liv ina Azuotos an Askalon fier im wel wel.

en: And they sent to him messengers with words of peace, saying,
target: An dem sen tu im mesenja dem wid wod dem a piis, a se,

en: “See, we the servants of Nebuchadnezzar the great king lie before you. Use us as it is pleasing in your sight.
target: “Si, wi di saavant dem a Nebukadnezar di big king lai bifuo yu. Yuuz wi az im pliizin ina yu sait.

en: See, our dwellings, and all our country, and all our fields of wheat, and our flocks and herds, and all the sheepfolds of our tents, lie before your face. Use them as it may please you.
target: Si, wi dwelin dem, an aal wi konchri, an aal wi fiil dem a wiit, an wi flak dem an oerd dem, an aal di shiipfoul dem a wi tent dem, lai bifuo yu fies. Yuuz dem az im mie pliz yu.

en: See, even our cities and those who dwell in them are your servants. Come and deal with them as it is good in your eyes.”
target: Si, iivn wi siti dem an dem uu dwel ina dem a yu saavant dem. Kom an diil wid dem az im gud ina yu yai dem.”

en: So the men came to Holofernes, and declared to him according to these words.
target: So di man dem kom tu Olofernes, an diklier tu im akordin tu dem wod ya.

en: He came down toward the sea coast, he and his army, and set garrisons in the high cities, and took out of them chosen men for allies.
target: Im kom dong tord di sii kuos, im an im aami, an set gyarisn dem ina di ai siti dem, an tek out a dem chuozn man fi alai dem.

en: They received him, they and all the country round about them, with garlands and dances and timbrels.
target: Dem risiiv im, dem an aal di konchri ron bout dem, wid gaalan dem an daans dem an timbrel dem.

en: He cast down all their borders, and cut down their sacred groves. It had been given to him to destroy all the gods of the land, that all the nations would worship Nebuchadnezzar only, and that all their tongues and their tribes would call upon him as a god.
target: Im kaas dong aal dem baada dem, an kot dong dem siekrid gruov dem. Im did get aada fi mash op aal di iladem a di lan, dat aal di nieshan dem wuda worship Nebukadnezar onli, an dat aal dem tong dem an dem traib dem wuda kaal pan im az wan ila.

en: Then he came toward Esdraelon near to Dotaea, which is opposite the great ridge of Judea.
target: Den im kom tord Esdrelon nier tu Dotiea, we apozit di big rij a Juudia.

en: He encamped between Geba and Scythopolis. He was there a whole month, that he might gather together all the baggage of his army.
target: Im enkyamp bitwiin Giiba an Skaitopolis. Im did de wan uol mont, dat im mait gyada tugeda aal di bagij a im aami.

en: The children of Israel who lived in Judea heard all that Holofernes the chief captain of Nebuchadnezzar king of the Assyrians had done to the nations, and how he had plundered all their temples and destroyed them utterly.
target: Di pikni dem a Izrel uu liv ina Juudia ier aal we Olofernes di chiif kiaptin a Nebukadnezar king a di Asiirian dem did du tu di nieshan dem, an ou im plonda aal dem templ dem an mash dem op uotali.

en: They were exceedingly afraid at his approach, and were troubled for Jerusalem and for the temple of the Lord their God;
target: Dem did wel wel fried a im aproch, an did chrobl fi Jeruusalem an fi di templ a di Laad dem Gad;

en: because they had newly come up from the captivity, and all the people of Judea were recently gathered together; and the vessels, the altar, and the house were consecrated after being profaned.
target: bikaaz dem did nyuuli kom op fram di kiaptiviti, an aal di piipl a Juudia did riisnli gyada tugeda; an di vesl dem, di aalta, an di ous did kansikriet afta dem get profien.

en: And they sent into every border of Samaria, to Konae, to Beth-horon, Belmaim, Jericho, to Choba, Aesora, and to the valley of Salem;
target: An dem sen ina evri baada a Sameria, tu Kuonae, tu Bet-oron, Belmaim, Jeriko, tu Kuoba, Aesora, an tu di vali a Sielem;

en: and they occupied beforehand all the tops of the high mountains, fortified the villages that were in them, and stored supplies for the provision of war, for their fields were newly reaped.
target: an dem okiupai bifuoan aal di tap dem a di ai mountn dem, fuotifai di vilij dem we did ina dem, an stuor soplai dem fi di provijan a waar, kaa dem fiil dem did nyuuli riip.

en: Joakim the high priest, who was in those days at Jerusalem, wrote to those who lived in Bethulia and Betomesthaim, which is opposite Esdraelon toward the plain that is near to Dothaim,
target: Joakim di ai priis, uu did ina dem die de a Jeruusalem, ruot tu dem uu liv ina Betuulia an Betomestaim, we apozit Esdrelon tord di plien we nier tu Dotaim,

en: charging them to seize upon the ascents of the hill country; because by them was the entrance into Judea, and it was easy to stop them from approaching, since the approach was narrow, with space for two men at the most.
target: a chaaj dem fi siiz pan di asent dem a di il konchri; bikaaz bai dem did di entrans ina Juudia, an im did iizi fi stap dem fram aproch, sins di aproch did naro, wid spies fi tuu man a di muos.

en: And the children of Israel did as Joakim the high priest had commanded them, as did the council of elders of all the people of Israel, which was in session at Jerusalem.
target: An di pikni dem a Izrel du az Joakim di ai priis koman dem, az di kounsl a elda dem a aal di piipl a Izrel du tu, we did ina seshan a Jeruusalem.

en: And every man of Israel cried to God with great earnestness, and with great earnestness they humbled their souls.
target: An evri man a Izrel krai tu Gad wid big oernisnis, an wid big oernisnis dem ombl dem suol dem.

en: They, their wives, their children, their cattle, and every sojourner, hireling, and servant bought with their money put sackcloth on their loins.
target: Dem, dem waif dem, dem pikni dem, dem kyatl dem, an evri sojorna, aialing, an saavant baat wid dem moni put saklaat pan dem lainz.

en: Every man and woman of Israel, including the little children and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, fell prostrate before the temple, cast ashes upon their heads, and spread out their sackcloth before the Lord. They put sackcloth around the altar.
target: Evri man an uman a Izrel, inkluudin di likl pikni dem an di piipl uu liv a Jeruusalem, fel praschriet bifuo di templ, kaas ashiz pan dem ed dem, an spred out dem saklaat bifuo di Laad. Dem put saklaat ron di aalta.

en: They cried to the God of Israel earnestly with one consent, that he would not give their children as prey, their wives as plunder, the cities of their inheritance to destruction, and the sanctuary to being profaned and being made a reproach, for the nations to rejoice at.
target: Dem krai tu di Gad a Izrel oernisli wid wan konsent, dat im wudna gi dem pikni dem az prie, dem waif dem az plonda, di siti dem a dem ineritans tu distroksan, an di sankchueri tu get profien an mek wan riprooch, fi di nieshan dem fi rijois a.

en: The Lord heard their voice, and looked at their affliction. The people continued fasting many days in all Judea and Jerusalem before the sanctuary of the Lord Almighty.
target: Di Laad ier dem vais, an luk a dem aflikshan. Di piipl kontinyu faas nof die ina aal Juudia an Jeruusalem bifuo di sankchueri a di Laad Olmaiti.

en: And Joakim the high priest, and all the priests who stood before the Lord, and those who ministered to the Lord, had their loins dressed in sackcloth and offered the continual burnt offering, the vows, and the free gifts of the people.
target: An Joakim di ai priis, an aal di priis dem uu stu bifuo di Laad, an dem uu minista tu di Laad, did av dem lainz jres ina saklaat an aafa di kontinyual boern aafrin, di vou dem, an di frii gif dem a di piipl.

en: They had ashes on their turbans. They cried to the Lord with all their power, that he would look upon all the house of Israel for good.
target: Dem did av ashiz pan dem toorban dem. Dem krai tu di Laad wid aal dem powa, dat im wuda luk pan aal di ous a Izrel fi gud.

en: Holofernes, the chief captain of the army of Asshur, was told that the children of Israel had prepared for war, had shut up the passages of the hill country, had fortified all the tops of the high hills, and had set up barricades in the plains.
target: Olofernes, di chiif kiaptin a di aami a Ashur, get tel se di pikni dem a Izrel did pripier fi waar, did shot op di pasij dem a di il konchri, did fuotifai aal di tap dem a di ai il dem, an did set op barikied dem ina di plien dem.

en: Then he was exceedingly angry, and he called all the princes of Moab, the captains of Ammon, and all the governors of the sea coast,
target: Den im did wel wel beks, an im kaal aal di prins dem a Muab, di kiaptin dem a Amon, an aal di govana dem a di sii kuos,

en: and he said to them, “Tell me now, you sons of Canaan, who are these people who dwell in the hill country? What are the cities that they inhabit? How large is their army? Where is their power and their strength? What king is set over them, to be the leader of their army?
target: an im se tu dem, “Tel mi nou, unu son dem a Kienan, uu a dem piipl ya uu dwel ina di il konchri? Wa a di siti dem we dem inabit? Ou laaj a dem aami? We dem powa an dem schrent de? Wa king set uova dem, fi bi di liida a dem aami?

en: Why have they turned their backs, that they should not come and meet me, more than all who dwell in the west?”
target: Wa mek dem ton dem bak, dat dem shudna kom an miit mi, muor dan aal uu dwel ina di wes?”

en: Then Achior, the leader of all the children of Ammon, said to him, “Let my lord now hear a word from the mouth of your servant, and I will tell you the truth concerning these people who dwell in this hill country, near to the place where you dwell. No lie will come out of the mouth of your servant.
target: Den Akior, di liida a aal di pikni dem a Amon, se tu im, “Mek mi smol-laad nou ier wan wod fram di mout a yu saavant, an mi wi tel yu di chuut bout dem piipl ya uu dwel ina dis il konchri, nier tu di plies we yu dwel. No lai wi kom out a di mout a yu saavant.

en: These people are descended from the Chaldeans.
target: Dem piipl ya a disendant fram di Kaldiyan dem.

en: They sojourned before this in Mesopotamia, because they didn’t want to follow the gods of their fathers, which were in the land of the Chaldeans.
target: Dem sojorn bifuo dis ina Mesopotiemia, bikaaz dem neva waahn fala di iladem a dem faada dem, we did ina di lan a di Kaldiyan dem.

en: They departed from the way of their parents, and worshiped the God of heaven, the God whom they knew. Their parents cast them out from the face of their gods, and they fled into Mesopotamia and sojourned there many days.
target: Dem dipaat fram di wie a dem pierent dem, an worship di Gad a evn, di Gad uu dem nyuu. Dem pierent dem kaas dem out fram di fies a dem iladem, an dem fli ina Mesopotiemia an sojorn de nof die.

en: Then their God commanded them to depart from the place where they sojourned, and to go into the land of Canaan. They lived there, and prospered with gold and silver, and with exceedingly much cattle.
target: Den dem Gad koman dem fi dipaat fram di plies we dem sojorn, an fi go ina di lan a Kienan. Dem liv de, an prasper wid guol an silva, an wid wel nof kyatl.

en: Then they went down into Egypt, for a famine covered all the land of Canaan. They sojourned there until they had grown up. They became a great multitude there, so that one could not count the population of their nation.
target: Den dem go dong ina Iijipt, kaa wan famin kova aal di lan a Kienan. Dem sojorn de tel dem gro op. Dem bikom wan big moltityuud de, so dat nobadi kudna kount di papilieshan a dem nieshan.

en: Then the king of Egypt rose up against them, and dealt subtly with them, and brought them low, making them labor in brick, and made them slaves.
target: Den di king a Iijipt ruoz op gens dem, an diil sotli wid dem, an bring dem luo, mek dem lieba ina brik, an mek dem sliev dem.

en: They cried to their God, and he struck all the land of Egypt with incurable plagues; so the Egyptians cast them out of their sight.
target: Dem krai tu dem Gad, an im chuk aal di lan a Iijipt wid plieg dem we kyaahn kior; so di Iijipshan dem kaas dem out a dem sait.

en: God dried up the Red sea before them,
target: Gad jrai op di Red Sii bifuo dem,

en: and brought them into the way of Sinai Kadesh-Barnea and they cast out all that lived in the wilderness.
target: an bring dem ina di wie a Sainai Kaadesh-Baania an dem kaas out aal uu liv ina di wildanis.

en: They lived in the land of the Amorites, and they destroyed by their strength everyone in Heshbon. Passing over Jordan, they possessed all the hill country.
target: Dem liv ina di lan a di Amuorait dem, an dem mash op bai dem schrent evriwan ina Eshbon. A paas uova Jaadn, dem pozes aal di il konchri.

en: They cast out before them the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite, the Shechemite, and all the Girgashites, and they lived in that country many days.
target: Dem kaas out bifuo dem di Kienanait, di Perizait, di Jebusait, di Shekemait, an aal di Goergashait dem, an dem liv ina dat konchri nof die.

en: And while they didn’t sin before their God, they prospered, because God who hates sin was with them.
target: An wail dem neva sin bifuo dem Gad, dem prasper, bikaaz Gad uu iet sin did wid dem.

en: But when they departed from the way which he appointed them, they were destroyed in many severe battles, and were led captives into a land that was not theirs. The temple of their God was razed to the ground, and their cities were taken by their adversaries.
target: Bot wen dem dipaat fram di wie we im apoint dem, dem get mash op ina nof siviir batl dem, an get liid kiaptiv ina wan lan we neva fi dem. Di templ a dem Gad get riez tu di grong, an dem siti dem tek bai dem advoersari dem.

en: And now they have returned to their God, and have come up from the dispersion where they were dispersed, and have possessed Jerusalem, where their sanctuary is, and are settled in the hill country; for it was desolate.
target: An nou dem rityon tu dem Gad, an kom op fram di dispoershan we dem dispoers, an pozes Jeruusalem, we dem sankchueri de, an setl ina di il konchri; kaa im did desoliet.

en: And now, my lord and master, if there is any error in this people, and they sin against their God, we will find out what this thing is in which they stumble, and we will go up and overcome them.
target: An nou, mi smol-laad an maasta, ef eni era de ina dem piipl ya, an dem sin gens dem Gad, wi wi fain out wa dis ting a we dem stombl ina, an wi wi go op an uovakom dem.

en: But if there is no lawlessness in their nation, let my lord now pass by, for their Lord may defend them, and their God be for them, and we will be a reproach before all the earth.”
target: Bot ef no laalisnis no de ina dem nieshan, mek mi smol-laad nou paas bai, kaa dem Laad mie difen dem, an dem Gad bi fi dem, an wi wi bi wan riprooch bifuo aal di ort.”

en: When Achior had finished speaking these words, all the people standing around the tent complained. The great men of Holofernes, and all who lived by the sea side and in Moab, said that he should be cut to pieces.
target: Wen Akior don spiik dem wod ya, aal di piipl a stan ron di tent komplien. Di big man dem a Olofernes, an aal uu liv bai di sii said an ina Muab, se dat im shud kot tu piisiz.

en: For, they said, “We will not be afraid of the children of Israel, because, see, they are a people that has no power nor might to make the battle strong.
target: Kaa, dem se, “Wi wi no fried a di pikni dem a Izrel, bikaaz, si, dem a wan piipl we no av no powa no maita fi mek di batl schrang.

en: Therefore now we will go up, and they will be a prey to be devoured by all your army, Lord Holofernes.”
target: So nou wi wi go op, an dem wi bi wan prie fi get divour bai aal yu aami, Laad Olofernes.”

en: And when the disturbance of the men that were around the council had ceased, Holofernes the chief captain of the army of Asshur said to Achior and to all the children of Moab before all the people of the foreigners:
target: An wen di distorbans a di man dem we did ron di kounsl don, Olofernes di chiif kiaptin a di aami a Ashur se tu Akior an tu aal di pikni dem a Muab bifuo aal di piipl a di farina dem:

en: “And who are you, Achior, and the mercenaries of Ephraim, that you have prophesied among us as today, and have said that we should not make war with the people of Israel, because their God will defend them? And who is God but Nebuchadnezzar?
target: “An uu a yu, Akior, an di moersineri dem a Ifraim, dat yu prafisai mongks wi az tide, an se dat wi shudna mek waar wid di piipl a Izrel, bikaaz dem Gad wi difen dem? An uu a Gad bot Nebukadnezar?

en: He will send forth his might, and will destroy them from the face of the earth, and their God will not deliver them; but we his servants will strike them as one man. They will not sustain the might of our cavalry.
target: Im wi sen fuot im mait, an wi mash dem op fram di fies a di ort, an dem Gad wi no diliva dem; bot wi im saavant dem wi chuk dem az wan man. Dem wi no sostien di mait a wi kyavalri.

en: For with them we will burn them up. Their mountains will be drunken with their blood. Their plains will be filled with their dead bodies. Their footsteps will not stand before us, but they will surely perish, says King Nebuchadnezzar, lord of all the earth; for he said, ‘The words that I have spoken will not be in vain.’
target: Kaa wid dem wi wi boern dem op. Dem mountn dem wi jronk wid dem blod. Dem plien dem wi ful wid dem ded badi dem. Dem futstep dem wi no stan bifuo wi, bot dem wi shuo perish, se King Nebukadnezar, smol-laad a aal di ort; kaa im se, ‘Di wod dem we mi taak wi no bi ina vien.’

en: But you, Achior, mercenary of Ammon, who have spoken these words in the day of your sin, will see my face no more from this day, until I am avenged of the people of those that came out of Egypt.
target: Bot yu, Akior, moersineri a Amon, uu taak dem wod ya ina di die a yu sin, wi si mi fies no muor fram dis die, tel mi tek riveng pan di piipl a dem we kom out a Iijipt.

en: And then the sword of my army, and the multitude of those who serve me, will pass through your sides, and you will fall among their slain when I return.
target: An den di suod a mi aami, an di moltityuud a dem uu saarv mi, wi paas chruu yu said dem, an yu wi faal mongks dem slain wen mi rityon.

en: Then my servants will bring you back into the hill country, and will set you in one of the cities by the passes.
target: Den mi saavant dem wi bring yu bak ina di il konchri, an wi set yu ina wan a di siti dem bai di paas dem.

en: You will not perish until you are destroyed with them.
target: Yu wi no perish tel yu get mash op wid dem.

en: And if you hope in your heart that they will not be taken, don’t let your countenance fall. I have spoken it, and none of my words will fall to the ground.”
target: An ef yu uop ina yu aat dat dem wi no tek, no mek yu kountinans faal. Mi taak im, an non a mi wod dem wi faal tu di grong.”

en: Then Holofernes commanded his servants who waited in his tent to take Achior, and bring him back to Bethulia, and deliver him into the hands of the children of Israel.
target: Den Olofernes koman im saavant dem uu wiet ina im tent fi tek Akior, an bring im bak tu Betuulia, an diliva im ina di an dem a di pikni dem a Izrel.

en: So his servants took him, and brought him out of the camp into the plain, and they moved from the midst of the plains into the hill country, and came to the springs that were under Bethulia.
target: So im saavant dem tek im, an bring im out a di kyamp ina di plien, an dem muuv fram di migl a di plien dem ina di il konchri, an kom tu di spring dem we did anda Betuulia.

en: When the men of the city saw them on the top of the hill, they took up their weapons, and went out of the city against them to the top of the hill. Every man that used a sling kept them from coming up, and threw stones at them.
target: Wen di man dem a di siti si dem pan di tap a di il, dem tek op dem wepan dem, an go out a di siti gens dem tu di tap a di il. Evri man we yuuz sling kep dem fram kom op, an chruo stuon a dem.

en: They took cover under the hill, bound Achior, cast him down, left him at the foot of the hill, and went away to their lord.
target: Dem tek kova anda di il, bain Akior, kaas im dong, lef im a di fut a di il, an go we tu dem smol-laad.

en: But the children of Israel descended from their city, and came to him, untied him, led him away into Bethulia, and presented him to the rulers of their city,
target: Bot di pikni dem a Izrel disen fram dem siti, an kom tu im, ontai im, liid im we ina Betuulia, an prizent im tu di ruula dem a dem siti,

en: which were in those days Ozias the son of Micah, of the tribe of Simeon, and Chabris the son of Gothoniel, and Charmis the son of Melchiel.
target: we did ina dem die de Ozaias di son a Maika, a di traib a Simion, an Kabris di son a Gotoniel, an Kaarmis di son a Melkiel.

en: Then they called together all the elders of the city; and all their young men ran together, with their women, to the assembly. They set Achior in the midst of all their people. Then Ozias asked him what had happened.
target: Den dem kaal tugeda aal di elda dem a di siti; an aal dem yong man dem ron tugeda, wid dem uman dem, tu di asembli. Dem set Akior ina di migl a aal dem piipl. Den Ozaias aaks im wa apm.

en: He answered and declared to them the words of the council of Holofernes, and all the words that he had spoken in the midst of the princes of the children of Asshur, and all the great words that Holofernes had spoken against the house of Israel.
target: Im ansa an diklier tu dem di wod dem a di kounsl a Olofernes, an aal di wod dem we im taak ina di migl a di prins dem a di pikni dem a Ashur, an aal di big wod dem we Olofernes taak gens di ous a Izrel.

en: Then the people fell down and worshiped God, and cried, saying,
target: Den di piipl fel dong an worship Gad, an krai, a se,

en: “O Lord God of heaven, see their arrogance, and pity the low estate of our people. Look upon the face of those who are consecrated to you this day.”
target: “Oo Laad Gad a evn, si dem arogans, an piti di luo estiet a wi piipl. Luk pan di fies a dem uu kansikriet tu yu tide.”

en: They comforted Achior, and praised him exceedingly.
target: Dem komfot Akior, an priez im wel wel.

en: Then Ozias took him out of the assembly into his house, and made a feast for the elders. They called on the God of Israel for help all that night.
target: Den Ozaias tek im out a di asembli ina im ous, an mek wan fiis fi di elda dem. Dem kaal pan di Gad a Izrel fi elp aal dat nait.

en: The next day Holofernes commanded all his army and all the people who had come to be his allies, that they should move their camp toward Bethulia, seize the passes of the hill country, and make war against the children of Israel.
target: Di neks die Olofernes koman aal im aami an aal di piipl uu kom fi bi im alai dem, dat dem shud muuv dem kyamp tord Betuulia, siiz di paas dem a di il konchri, an mek waar gens di pikni dem a Izrel.

en: Every mighty man of them moved that day. The army of their men of war was one hundred seventy thousand footmen, plus twelve thousand horsemen, besides the baggage and the men who were on foot among them—an exceedingly great multitude.
target: Evri maiti man a dem muuv dat die. Di aami a dem man a waar did wan onjred sebnti touzn futman, plos twelv touzn aasman, bisaid di bagij an di man dem we did pan fut mongks dem—wan wel big moltityuud.

en: They encamped in the valley near Bethulia, by the fountain. They spread themselves in breadth over Dothaim even to Belmaim, and in length from Bethulia to Cyamon, which is near Esdraelon.
target: Dem enkyamp ina di vali nier Betuulia, bai di fountn. Dem spred demself ina bred uova Dotaim iivn tu Belmaim, an ina lent fram Betuulia tu Saiamon, we nier Esdrelon.

en: But the children of Israel, when they saw the multitude of them, were terrified, and everyone said to his neighbor, “Now these men will lick up the face of all the earth. Neither the high mountains, nor the valleys, nor the hills will be able to bear their weight.
target: Bot di pikni dem a Izrel, wen dem si di moltityuud a dem, did terifai, an evriwan se tu im nieba, “Nou dem man ya wi lik op di fies a aal di ort. Naida di ai mountn dem, no di vali dem, no di il dem wi ebl bier dem wiet.

en: Every man took up his weapons of war, and when they had kindled fires upon their towers, they remained and watched all that night.
target: Evri man tek op im wepan dem a waar, an wen dem kindl faiya dem pan dem towa dem, dem rimien an wach aal dat nait.

en: But on the second day Holofernes led out all his cavalry in the sight of the children of Israel which were in Bethulia,
target: Bot pan di sekan die Olofernes liid out aal im kyavalri ina di sait a di pikni dem a Izrel we did ina Betuulia,

en: viewed the ascents to their city, and searched out the springs of the waters, seized upon them, and set garrisons of men of war over them. Then he departed back to his people.
target: vyuu di asent dem tu dem siti, an saach out di spring dem a di waata dem, siiz pan dem, an set gyarisn dem a man a waar uova dem. Den im dipaat bak tu im piipl.

en: All the rulers of the children of Esau, all the leaders of the people of Moab, and the captains of the sea coast came to him and said,
target: Aal di ruula dem a di pikni dem a Iisau, aal di liida dem a di piipl a Muab, an di kiaptin dem a di sii kuos kom tu im an se,

en: “Let our lord now hear a word, that there not be losses in your army.
target: “Mek wi smol-laad nou ier wan wod, dat no laas no de ina yu aami.

en: For this people of the children of Israel do not trust in their spears, but in the height of the mountains where they dwell, for it is not easy to come up to the tops of their mountains.
target: Kaa dem piipl ya a di pikni dem a Izrel no chros ina dem spier dem, bot ina di ait a di mountn dem we dem dwel, kaa im no iizi fi kom op tu di tap dem a dem mountn dem.

en: And now, my lord, don’t fight against them as men fight who join battle, and there will not so much as one man of your people perish.
target: An nou, mi smol-laad, no fait gens dem az man fait uu jain batl, an no so moch az wan man a yu piipl wi perish.

en: Remain in your camp, and keep every man of your army safe. Let your servants get possession of the water spring, which flows from the foot of the mountain,
target: Rimien ina yu kyamp, an kip evri man a yu aami sief. Mek yu saavant dem get pozeshan a di waata spring, we fluo fram di fut a di mountn,

en: because all the inhabitants of Bethulia get their water from there. Then thirst will kill them, and they will give up their city. Then we and our people will go up to the tops of the mountains that are near, and will camp upon them, to watch that not one man gets out of the city.
target: bikaaz aal di piipl uu liv a Betuulia get dem waata fram de. Den toers wi kil dem, an dem wi gi op dem siti. Den wi an wi piipl wi go op tu di tap dem a di mountn dem we nier, an wi kyamp pan dem, fi wach dat no wan man get out a di siti.

en: They will be consumed with famine—they, their wives, and their children. Before the sword comes against them they will be laid low in the streets where they dwell.
target: Dem wi konsum wid famin—dem, dem waif dem, an dem pikni dem. Bifuo di suod kom gens dem dem wi lie luo ina di schriit dem we dem dwel.

en: And you will pay them back with evil, because they rebelled, and didn’t meet your face in peace.”
target: An yu wi pie dem bak wid iivl, bikaaz dem rebel, an neva miit yu fies ina piis.”

en: Their words were pleasing in the sight of Holofernes and in the sight of all his servants; and he ordered them to do as they had spoken.
target: Dem wod dem did pliizin ina di sait a Olofernes an ina di sait a aal im saavant dem; an im aada dem fi du az dem taak.

en: And the army of the children of Ammon moved, and with them five thousand of the children of Asshur, and they encamped in the valley. They seized the waters and the springs of the waters of the children of Israel.
target: An di aami a di pikni dem a Amon muuv, an wid dem faiv touzn a di pikni dem a Ashur, an dem enkyamp ina di vali. Dem siiz di waata dem an di spring dem a di waata dem a di pikni dem a Izrel.

en: The children of Esau went up with the children of Ammon, and encamped in the hill country near Dothaim. They sent some of them toward the south, and toward the east, near Ekrebel, which is near Chusi, that is upon the brook Mochmur. The rest of the army of the Assyrians encamped in the plain, and covered all the face of the land. Their tents and baggage were pitched upon it in a great crowd. They were an exceedingly great multitude.
target: Di pikni dem a Iisau go op wid di pikni dem a Amon, an enkyamp ina di il konchri nier Dotaim. Dem sen som a dem tord di sout, an tord di iis, nier Ekrebel, we nier Kuusai, dat de pan di bruk Mokmuur. Di res a di aami a di Asiirian dem enkyamp ina di plien, an kova aal di fies a di lan. Dem tent dem an bagij did pich pan im ina wan big kroud. Dem did wan wel big moltityuud.

en: The children of Israel cried to the Lord their God, for their spirit fainted; for all their enemies had surrounded them. There was no way to escape out from among them.
target: Di pikni dem a Izrel krai tu di Laad dem Gad, kaa dem spirit fient; kaa aal dem enimi dem soroun dem. No wie neva de fi eskiep out fram mongks dem.

en: All the army of Asshur remained around them, their footmen and their chariots and their horsemen, for thirty-four days. All their vessels of water ran dry for all the inhabitants of Bethulia.
target: Aal di aami a Ashur rimien ron dem, dem futman dem an dem chariet dem an dem aasman dem, fi terti-fuor die. Aal dem vesl dem a waata ron jrai fi aal di piipl uu liv a Betuulia.

en: The cisterns were emptied, and they had no water to drink their fill for one day; for they rationed drink by measure.
target: Di sistern dem emti, an dem no av no waata fi jringk dem ful fi wan die; kaa dem rashan jringk bai meja.

en: Their young children were discouraged. The women and the young men fainted for thirst. They fell down in the streets of the city, and in the passages of the gates. There was no longer any strength in them.
target: Dem yong pikni dem did diskorij. Di uman dem an di yong man dem fient fi toers. Dem fel dong ina di schriit dem a di siti, an ina di pasij dem a di giet dem. No schrent neva lef ina dem no muor.

en: All the people, including the young men, the women, and the children, were gathered together against Ozias, and against the rulers of the city. They cried with a loud voice, and said before all the elders,
target: Aal di piipl, inkluudin di yong man dem, di uman dem, an di pikni dem, gyada tugeda gens Ozaias, an gens di ruula dem a di siti. Dem krai wid wan loud vais, an se bifuo aal di elda dem,

en: “God be judge between all of you and us, because you have done us great wrong, in that you have not spoken words of peace with the children of Asshur.
target: “Gad bi joj bitwiin aal a unu an wi, bikaaz unu du wi big rang, ina dat unu no spiik wod dem a piis wid di pikni dem a Ashur.

en: Now we have no helper; but God has sold us into their hands, that we should be laid low before them with thirst and great destruction.
target: Nou wi no av no elpa; bot Gad sel wi ina dem an dem, dat wi shud lie luo bifuo dem wid toers an big distroksan.

en: And now summon them, and deliver up the whole city as prey to the people of Holofernes, and to all his army.
target: An nou somon dem, an diliva op di uol siti az prie tu di piipl a Olofernes, an tu aal im aami.

en: For it is better for us to be captured by them. For we will be servants, and our souls will live, and we will not see the death of our babies before our eyes, and our wives and our children fainting in death.
target: Kaa im beta fi wi get kiapcha bai dem. Kaa wi wi bi saavant dem, an wi suol dem wi liv, an wi wi no si di det a wi biebi dem bifuo wi yai dem, an wi waif dem an wi pikni dem a fient ina det.

en: We take to witness against you the sky and the earth, and our God and the Lord of our fathers, who punishes us according to our sins and the sins of our fathers. Do what we have said today!”
target: Wi tek fi witnis gens yu di skai an di ort, an wi Gad an di Laad a wi faada dem, uu ponish wi akordin tu wi sin dem an di sin dem a wi faada dem. Du wa wi se tide!”

en: And there was great weeping of all with one consent in the midst of the assembly; and they cried to the Lord God with a loud voice.
target: An big wiipin did de a aal wid wan konsent ina di migl a di asembli; an dem krai tu di Laad Gad wid wan loud vais.

en: And Ozias said to them, “Brothers, be of good courage! Let us endure five more days, during which the Lord our God will turn his mercy toward us; for he will not forsake us utterly.
target: An Ozaias se tu dem, “Breda dem, bi a gud korij! Mek wi endior faiv muor die, juurin wich di Laad wi Gad wi ton im mersi tord wi; kaa im wi no fosiek wi uotali.

en: But if these days pass, and no help comes to us, I will do what you say.”
target: Bot ef dem die ya paas, an no elp kom tu wi, mi wi du wa yu se.”

en: Then he dispersed the people, every man to his own camp; and they went away to the walls and towers of their city. He sent the women and children into their houses. They were brought very low in the city.
target: Den im dispoers di piipl, evri man tu im uon kyamp; an dem go we tu di waal dem an towa dem a dem siti. Im sen di uman dem an pikni dem ina dem ous dem. Dem did bring wel luo ina di siti.

en: In those days Judith heard about this. She was the daughter of Merari, the son of Ox, the son of Joseph, the son of Oziel, the son of Elkiah, the son of Ananias, the son of Gideon, the son of Raphaim, the son of Ahitub, the son of Elihu, the son of Eliab, the son of Nathanael, the son of Salamiel, the son of Salasadai, the son of Israel.
target: Ina dem die de Juudit ier bout dis. Shi did di daata a Merari, di son a Aks, di son a Juozif, di son a Oziel, di son a Elkaia, di son a Ananaias, di son a Gideon, di son a Rafaaim, di son a Aaitub, di son a Elaiu, di son a Elaiab, di son a Natanael, di son a Salamiel, di son a Salasadai, di son a Izrel.

en: Her husband was Manasses, of her tribe and of her family. He died in the days of barley harvest.
target: Ar ozban did Manasez, a ar traib an a ar famili. Im dai ina di die dem a baali aarves.

en: For he stood over those who bound sheaves in the field, and was overcome by the burning heat, and he fell on his bed, and died in his city Bethulia. So they buried him with his fathers in the field which is between Dothaim and Balamon.
target: Kaa im stu uova dem uu bain shiiv dem ina di fiil, an get uovakom bai di boernin iit, an im fel pan im bed, an dai ina im siti Betuulia. So dem beri im wid im faada dem ina di fiil we de bitwiin Dotaim an Balamon.

en: Judith was a widow in her house three years and four months.
target: Juudit did wan widuo ina ar ous trii ier an fuor mont.

en: She made herself a tent upon the roof of her house, and put on sackcloth upon her loins. The garments of her widowhood were upon her.
target: Shi mek arself wan tent pan di ruuf a ar ous, an put pan saklaat pan ar lainz. Di gaament dem a ar widuoud did pan ar.

en: And she fasted all the days of her widowhood, except the eves of the Sabbaths, the Sabbaths, the eves of the new moons, the new moons, and the feasts and joyful days of the house of Israel.
target: An shi faas aal di die dem a ar widuoud, eksep di iiv dem a di Sabat dem, di Sabat dem, di iiv dem a di nyuu muun dem, di nyuu muun dem, an di fiis dem an jaiful die dem a di ous a Izrel.

en: She was beautiful in appearance, and lovely to behold. Her husband Manasses had left her gold, silver, menservants, maidservants, cattle, and lands. She remained on those lands.
target: Shi did byuutiful ina apiarans, an lovli fi biuol. Ar ozban Manasez did lef ar guol, silva, mansaavant dem, miedsaavant dem, kyatl, an lan dem. Shi rimien pan dem lan de.

en: No one said anything evil about her, for she feared God exceedingly.
target: Nobadi no se notn iivl bout ar, kaa shi fier Gad wel wel.

en: She heard the evil words of the people against the governor, because they fainted for lack of water; and Judith heard all the words that Ozias spoke to them, how he swore to them that he would deliver the city to the Assyrians after five days.
target: Shi ier di iivl wod dem a di piipl gens di govana, bikaaz dem fient fi lak a waata; an Juudit ier aal di wod dem we Ozaias spiik tu dem, ou im swier tu dem se im wuda diliva di siti tu di Asiirian dem afta faiv die.

en: So she sent her maid, who was over all things that she had, to summon Ozias, Chabris, and Charmis, the elders of her city.
target: So shi sen ar mied, uu did uova aal ting we shi av, fi somon Ozaias, Kabris, an Kaarmis, di elda dem a ar siti.

en: They came to her, and she said to them, “Hear me now, O you rulers of the inhabitants of Bethulia! For your word that you have spoken before the people this day is not right. You have set the oath which you have pronounced between God and you, and have promised to deliver the city to our enemies, unless within these days the Lord turns to help you.
target: Dem kom tu ar, an shi se tu dem, “Ier mi nou, oo unu ruula dem a di piipl uu liv a Betuulia! Kaa unu wod we unu spiik bifuo di piipl dis die no rait. Unu set di uot we unu pronuons bitwiin Gad an unu, an pramis fi diliva di siti tu wi enimi dem, onles widin dem die ya di Laad ton fi elp unu.

en: Now who are you that you have tested God this day, and stand in the place of God among the children of men?
target: Nou uu a unu dat unu tes Gad dis die, an stan ina di plies a Gad mongks di pikni dem a man?

en: Now try the Lord Almighty, and you will never know anything.
target: Nou trai di Laad Olmaiti, an unu wi neva nuo notn.

en: For you will not find the depth of the heart of man, and you will not perceive the things that he thinks. How will you search out God, who has made all these things, and know his mind, and comprehend his purpose? No, brothers, don’t provoke the Lord our God to anger!
target: Kaa unu wi no fain di dep a di aat a man, an unu wi no posiib di ting dem we im tingk. Ou unu wi saach out Gad, uu mek aal dem ting ya, an nuo im main, an komprien im poerpos? No, breda dem, no provuok di Laad wi Gad tu angga!

en: For if he has not decided to help us within these five days, he has power to defend us in such time as he will, or to destroy us before the face of our enemies.
target: Kaa ef im no disaid fi elp wi widin dem faiv die ya, im av powa fi difen wi ina soch taim az im wi, ar fi mash wi op bifuo di fies a wi enimi dem.

en: But don’t you pledge the counsels of the Lord our God! For God is not like a human being, that he should be threatened, neither is he like a son of man, that he should be won over by pleading.
target: Bot no unu plej di kounsl dem a di Laad wi Gad! Kaa Gad no laik wan yuuman biin, dat im shud get chretn, naida im no laik wan son a man, dat im shud get win uova bai pliedin.

en: Therefore let’s wait for the salvation that comes from him, and call upon him to help us. He will hear our voice, if it pleases him.
target: So mek wi wiet fi di salvieshan we kom fram im, an kaal pan im fi elp wi. Im wi ier wi vais, ef im pliz im.

en: For there arose none in our age, neither is there any of us today, tribe, or kindred, or family, or city, which worship gods made with hands, as it was in the former days;
target: Kaa non no araiz ina wi iej, naida non a wi no de tide, traib, ar kindred, ar famili, ar siti, we worship iladem mek wid an dem, az im did ina di faama die dem;

en: for which cause our fathers were given to the sword, and for plunder, and fell with a great destruction before our enemies.
target: fi wich kaaz wi faada dem did get gi tu di suod, an fi plonda, an fel wid wan big distroksan bifuo wi enimi dem.

en: But we know no other god beside him. Therefore we hope that he will not despise us, nor any of our people.
target: Bot wi no nuo no ada ila bisaid im. So wi uop dat im wi no dispaiz wi, no non a wi piipl.

en: For if we are captured, all Judea will be captured and our sanctuary will be plundered; and he will require our blood for profaning it.
target: Kaa ef wi get kiapcha, aal Juudia wi get kiapcha an wi sankchueri wi get plonda; an im wi rikwaya wi blod fi profien im.

en: The slaughter of our brothers, the captivity of the land, and the desolation of our inheritance, he will bring on our heads among the Gentiles, wherever we will be in bondage. We will be an offense and a reproach to those who take us for a possession.
target: Di slaata a wi breda dem, di kiaptiviti a di lan, an di desolieshan a wi ineritans, im wi bring pan wi ed dem mongks di Jentailz, weeva wi wi bi ina bandij. Wi wi bi wan ofens an wan riprooch tu dem uu tek wi fi wan pozeshan.

en: For our bondage will not be ordered to favor; but the Lord our God will turn it to dishonor.
target: Kaa wi bandij wi no aada tu fieva; bot di Laad wi Gad wi ton im tu disana.

en: And now, brothers, let’s show an example to our brothers, because their soul depends on us, and the sanctuary, the house, and the altar depend on us.
target: An nou, breda dem, mek wi shuo wan egzampl tu wi breda dem, bikaaz dem suol dipen pan wi, an di sankchueri, di ous, an di aalta dipen pan wi.

en: Besides all this let’s give thanks to the Lord our God, who tries us, even as he did our fathers also.
target: Bisaid aal dis mek wi gi tangks tu di Laad wi Gad, uu trai wi, iivn az im du wi faada dem tu.

en: Remember all the things which he did to Abraham, and all the things in which he tried Isaac, and all the things which happened to Jacob in Mesopotamia of Syria, when he kept the sheep of Laban his mother’s brother.
target: Rimemba aal di ting dem we im du tu Iebraham, an aal di ting dem ina wich im trai Aizak, an aal di ting dem we apm tu Jiekob ina Mesopotiemia a Siiria, wen im kep di shiip dem a Lieban im mada breda.

en: For he has not tried us in the fire, as he did them, to search out their hearts, neither has he taken vengeance on us; but the Lord scourges those who come near to him, to admonish them.”
target: Kaa im no trai wi ina di faiya, az im du dem, fi saach out dem aat dem, naida im no tek venjans pan wi; bot di Laad skoerj dem uu kom nier tu im, fi admanish dem.”

en: And Ozias said to her, “All that you have spoken, you have spoken with a good heart. There is no one who will deny your words.
target: An Ozaias se tu ar, “Aal we yu spiik, yu spiik wid wan gud aat. Nobadi no de uu wi dinai yu wod dem.

en: For this is not the first day on which your wisdom is shown; but from the beginning of your days all the people have known your understanding, because the disposition of your heart is good.
target: Kaa dis a no di fos die pan wich yu wizdom shuo; bot fram di biginin a yu die dem aal di piipl nuo yu andastandin, bikaaz di dispozishan a yu aat gud.

en: But the people were exceedingly thirsty, and compelled us to do as we spoke to them, and to bring an oath upon ourselves, which we will not break.
target: Bot di piipl did wel wel toersti, an kompel wi fi du az wi spiik tu dem, an fi bring wan uot pan wiself, we wi wi no bruk.

en: And now pray for us, because you are a godly woman, and the Lord will send us rain to fill our cisterns, and we will faint no more.”
target: An nou prie fi wi, bikaaz yu a wan uoli uman, an di Laad wi sen wi rien fi ful wi sistern dem, an wi wi fient no muor.”

en: Then Judith said to them, “Hear me, and I will do a thing, which will go down to all generations among the children of our people.
target: Den Juudit se tu dem, “Ier mi, an mi wi du wan ting, we wi go dong tu aal jinarieshan mongks di pikni dem a wi piipl.

en: You must all stand at the gate tonight. I will go out with my maid. Within the days after which you said that you would deliver the city to our enemies, the Lord will deliver Israel by my hand.
target: Unu aal mos stan a di giet tunaait. Mi wi go out wid mi mied. Widin di die dem afta wich unu se dat unu wuda diliva di siti tu wi enimi dem, di Laad wi diliva Izrel bai mi an.

en: But you must not inquire of my act; for I will not tell you until the things are finished that I will do.”
target: Bot unu mos no inkwaiya a mi ak; kaa mi wi no tel unu tel di ting dem don we mi wi du.”

en: Then Ozias and the rulers said to her, “Go in peace. May the Lord God be before you, to take vengeance on our enemies.”
target: Den Ozaias an di ruula dem se tu ar, “Go ina piis. Mek di Laad Gad bi bifuo yu, fi tek venjans pan wi enimi dem.”

en: So they returned from the tent, and went to their stations.
target: So dem rityon fram di tent, an go tu dem stieshan dem.

en: But Judith fell facedown, and put ashes upon her head, and uncovered the sackcloth with which she was clothed. The incense of that evening was now being offered at Jerusalem in the house of God, and Judith cried to the Lord with a loud voice, and said,
target: Bot Juudit fel fiesdong, an put ashiz pan ar ed, an onkova di saklaat we shi did kloud wid. Di insens a dat iivnin did nou a get aafa a Jeruusalem ina di ous a Gad, an Juudit krai tu di Laad wid wan loud vais, an se,

en: “O Lord God of my father Simeon, into whose hand you gave a sword to take vengeance on the strangers who loosened the belt of a virgin to defile her, uncovered her thigh to her shame, and profaned her womb to her reproach; for you said, ‘It must not be so;’ and they did so.
target: “Oo Laad Gad a mi faada Simion, ina uu an yu gi wan suod fi tek venjans pan di schrienja dem uu luusn di belt a wan voerjin fi difail ar, onkova ar tai tu ar shiem, an profien ar wuumb tu ar riprooch; kaa yu se, ‘Im mos no bi so;’ an dem du so.

en: Therefore you gave their rulers to be slain, and their bed, which was ashamed for her who was deceived, to be dyed in blood, and struck the servants with their masters, and the masters upon their thrones;
target: So yu gi dem ruula dem fi get slain, an dem bed, we did ashiem fi ar uu get disiiv, fi get dai ina blod, an chuk di saavant dem wid dem maasta dem, an di maasta dem pan dem chuon dem;

en: and gave their wives for a prey, and their daughters to be captives, and all their spoils to be divided among your dear children; which were moved with zeal for you, and abhorred the pollution of their blood, and called upon you for aid. O God, O my God, hear me also who am a widow.
target: an gi dem waif dem fi wan prie, an dem daata dem fi bi kiaptiv dem, an aal dem spail dem fi divaid mongks yu dier pikni dem; we did muuv wid ziil fi yu, an abhor di polyuushan a dem blod, an kaal pan yu fi ied. Oo Gad, oo mi Gad, ier mi tu uu a wan widuo.

en: For you did the things that were before those things, and those things, and such as come after; and you planned the things which are now, and the things which are to come. The things which you planned came to pass.
target: Kaa yu du di ting dem we did bifuo dem ting de, an dem ting de, an soch az kom afta; an yu plan di ting dem we a nou, an di ting dem we a fi kom. Di ting dem we yu plan kom tu paas.

en: Yes, the things which you determined stood before you, and said, ‘See, we are here; for all your ways are prepared, and your judgment is with foreknowledge.’
target: Ies, di ting dem we yu ditoermin stu bifuo yu, an se, ‘Si, wi de ya; kaa aal yu wie dem pripier, an yu jojment de wid fuonolij.’

en: For, see, the Assyrians are multiplied in their power. They are exalted with horse and rider. They were proud of the strength of their footmen. They have trusted in shield, spear, bow, and sling. They don’t know that you are the Lord who breaks the battles. ‘The Lord’ is your name.
target: Kaa, si, di Asiirian dem moltiplai ina dem powa. Dem egzalt wid aas an raida. Dem did proud a di schrent a dem futman dem. Dem chros ina shiil, spier, bou, an sling. Dem no nuo dat yu a di Laad uu bruk di batl dem. Di Laad a yu niem.

en: Break their strength in your power, and bring down their force in your wrath; for they intend to profane your sanctuary, and to defile the tabernacle where your glorious name rests, and to destroy the horn of your altar with the sword.
target: Bruk dem schrent ina yu powa, an bring dong dem fuos ina yu raat; kaa dem inten fi profien yu sankchueri, an fi difail di tabernakl we yu gluorias niem res, an fi mash op di aan a yu aalta wid di suod.

en: Look at their pride, and send your wrath upon their heads. Give into my hand, which am a widow, the might that I have conceived.
target: Luk a dem praid, an sen yu raat pan dem ed dem. Gi ina mi an, we a wan widuo, di mait we mi konsiiv.

en: Strike by the deceit of my lips the servant with the prince, and the prince with his servant. Break down their arrogance by the hand of a woman.
target: Chuk bai di disiit a mi lip dem di saavant wid di prins, an di prins wid im saavant. Bruk dong dem arogans bai di an a wan uman.

en: For your power stands not in numbers, nor your might in strong men, but you are a God of the afflicted. You are a helper of the oppressed, a helper of the weak, a protector of the forsaken, a savior of those who are without hope.
target: Kaa yu powa no stan ina nomba dem, no yu mait ina schrang man dem, bot yu a wan Gad a di afliktid dem. Yu a wan elpa a di opres dem, wan elpa a di wiik dem, wan protekta a di fosiekn dem, wan sievya a dem uu de widout uop.

en: Please, please, God of my father, and God of the inheritance of Israel, Lord of the heavens and of the earth, Creator of the waters, King of all your creation, hear my prayer.
target: Pliiz, pliiz, Gad a mi faada, an Gad a di ineritans a Izrel, Laad a di evn dem an a di ort, Krietor a di waata dem, King a aal yu krieshan, ier mi prier.

en: Make my speech and deceit to be their wound and bruise, who intend hard things against your covenant, your holy house, the top of Zion, and the house of the possession of your children.
target: Mek mi spiich an disiit fi bi dem wuund an bruuz, uu inten aad ting dem gens yu kovnant, yu uoli ous, di tap a Zaian, an di ous a di pozeshan a yu pikni dem.

en: Make every nation and tribe of yours to know that you are God, the God of all power and might, and that there is no other who protects the people of Israel but you.”
target: Mek evri nieshan an traib a yuoz fi nuo dat yu a Gad, di Gad a aal powa an mait, an dat no ada no de uu protek di piipl a Izrel bot yu.”

en: When she had ceased to cry to the God of Israel, and had finished saying all these words,
target: Wen shi don krai tu di Gad a Izrel, an don se aal dem wod ya,

en: that she rose up where she had fallen down, called her maid, and went down into the house that she lived on the Sabbath days and on her feast days.
target: dat shi ruoz op we shi did faal dong, kaal ar mied, an go dong ina di ous we shi liv pan di Sabat die dem an pan ar fiis die dem.

en: She pulled off the sackcloth which she had put on, took off the garments of her widowhood, washed her body all over with water, anointed herself with rich ointment, braided the hair of her head, and put a tiara upon it. She put on her garments of gladness, which she used to wear in the days of the life of Manasses her husband.
target: Shi pul aaf di saklaat we shi put pan, tek aaf di gaament dem a ar widuoud, wash ar badi aal uova wid waata, anaint arself wid rich aintment, bried di ier a ar ed, an put wan tiara pan im. Shi put pan ar gaament dem a gladnis, we shi yuuz fi wier ina di die dem a di laif a Manasez ar ozban.

en: She took sandals for her feet, and put on her anklet, bracelets, rings, earrings, and all her jewelry. She made herself very beautiful to deceive the eyes of all men who would see her.
target: Shi tek sandal dem fi ar fut dem, an put pan ar angklet, brieslet dem, ring dem, iering dem, an aal ar juulri. Shi mek arself wel byuutiful fi disiiv di yai dem a aal man uu wuda si ar.

en: She gave her maid a leather container of wine and a flask of oil, and filled a bag with roasted grain, lumps of figs, and fine bread. She packed all her vessels together, and laid them upon her.
target: Shi gi ar mied wan leda kontiena a wain an wan flaask a ail, an ful wan bag wid ruos grien, lomp dem a fig, an fain bred. Shi pak aal ar vesl dem tugeda, an lie dem pan ar.

en: They went out to the gate of the city of Bethulia, and found Ozias and the elders of the city, Chabris and Charmis standing by it.
target: Dem go out tu di giet a di siti a Betuulia, an fain Ozaias an di elda dem a di siti, Kabris an Kaarmis, a stan bai im.

en: But when they saw her, that her countenance was altered and her apparel was changed, they were greatly astonished by her beauty and said to her,
target: Bot wen dem si ar, dat ar kountinans did alta an ar aparel did chienj, dem did wel astanish bai ar byuuti an se tu ar,

en: “May the God of our fathers give you favor, and accomplish your purposes to the glory of the children of Israel, and to the exaltation of Jerusalem.” Then she worshiped God,
target: “Mek di Gad a wi faada dem gi yu fieva, an akomplish yu poerpos dem tu di gluori a di pikni dem a Izrel, an tu di egzaltieshan a Jeruusalem.” Den shi worship Gad,

en: and said to them, “Command that they open the gate of the city for me, and I will go out to accomplish the things you spoke with me about.” And they commanded the young men to open to her, as she had spoken;
target: an se tu dem, “Koman dat dem opn di giet a di siti fi mi, an mi wi go out fi akomplish di ting dem unu spiik wid mi bout.” An dem koman di yong man dem fi opn tu ar, az shi taak;

en: and they did so. Then Judith went out, she, and her handmaid with her. The men of the city watched her until she had gone down the mountain, until she had passed the valley, and they could see her no more.
target: an dem du so. Den Juudit go out, shi, an ar anmied wid ar. Di man dem a di siti wach ar tel shi go dong di mountn, tel shi paas di vali, an dem kudna si ar no muor.

en: They went straight onward in the valley. The watch of the Assyrians met her;
target: Dem go schriet anwad ina di vali. Di wach a di Asiirian dem miit ar;

en: and they took her, and asked her, “Of what people are you? Where are you coming from? Where are you going?” She said, “I am a daughter of the Hebrews. I am fleeing away from their presence, because they are about to be given you to be consumed.
target: an dem tek ar, an aaks ar, “A wa piipl yu a? We yu a kom fram? We yu a go?” Shi se, “Mi a wan daata a di Iibruu dem. Mi a fli we fram dem prezens, bikaaz dem bout fi get gi unu fi get konsum.

en: I am coming into the presence of Holofernes the chief captain of your army, to declare words of truth. I will show him a way that he can go and win all the hill country, and there will not be lacking of his men one person, nor one life.”
target: Mi a kom ina di prezens a Olofernes di chiif kiaptin a unu aami, fi diklier wod dem a chuut. Mi wi shuo im wan wie dat im kyan go an win aal di il konchri, an no wan a im man dem wi lak, no wan persn, no wan laif.”

en: Now when the men heard her words, and considered her countenance, her beauty was exceedingly marvelous in their eyes. They said to her,
target: Nou wen di man dem ier ar wod dem, an kansida ar kountinans, ar byuuti did wel wel maavlos ina dem yai dem. Dem se tu ar,

en: “You have saved your life, in that you have hurried to come down to the presence of our master. Now come to his tent. Some of us will guide you until they deliver you into his hands.
target: “Yu siev yu laif, ina dat yu ori fi kom dong tu di prezens a wi maasta. Nou kom tu im tent. Som a wi wi gaid yu tel dem diliva yu ina im an dem.

en: But when you stand before him, don’t be afraid in your heart, but declare to him what you just said, and he will treat you well.”
target: Bot wen yu stan bifuo im, no fried ina yu aat, bot diklier tu im wa yu jos se, an im wi chriit yu wel.”

en: They chose out of them a hundred men, and appointed them to accompany her and her maid; and they brought them to the tent of Holofernes.
target: Dem chuuz out a dem wan onjred man, an apoint dem fi akompini ar an ar mied; an dem bring dem tu di tent a Olofernes.

en: And there was great excitement throughout all the camp, for her coming was reported among the tents. They came and surrounded her as she stood outside Holofernes’ tent, until they told him about her.
target: An big eksaitment did de chruout aal di kyamp, kaa ar komin did ripuot mongks di tent dem. Dem kom an soroun ar az shi stu outsaid Olofernes tent, tel dem tel im bout ar.

en: They marveled at her beauty, and marveled at the children of Israel because of her. Each one said to his neighbor, “Who would despise these people, who have among them such women? For it is not good that one man of them be left, seeing that, if they are let go, they will be able to deceive the whole earth.
target: Dem maavl a ar byuuti, an maavl a di pikni dem a Izrel bikaaz a ar. Iich wan se tu im nieba, “Uu wuda dispaiz dem piipl ya, uu av mongks dem soch uman dem? Kaa im no gud dat wan man a dem lef, a si dat, ef dem let go, dem wi ebl disiiv di uol ort.

en: Then the guards of Holofernes and all his servants came out and brought her into the tent.
target: Den di gyaad dem a Olofernes an aal im saavant dem kom out an bring ar ina di tent.

en: And Holofernes was resting upon his bed under the canopy, which was woven with purple, gold, emeralds, and precious stones.
target: An Olofernes did a res pan im bed anda di kianopi, we did wuovn wid poerpl, guol, emeral dem, an preshos stuon dem.

en: And they told him about her; and he came out into the space before his tent, with silver lamps going before him.
target: An dem tel im bout ar; an im kom out ina di spies bifuo im tent, wid silva lamp dem a go bifuo im.

en: But when Judith had come before him and his servants, they all marveled at the beauty of her countenance. She fell down upon her face and bowed down to him, but his servants raised her up.
target: Bot wen Juudit kom bifuo im an im saavant dem, dem aal maavl a di byuuti a ar kountinans. Shi fel dong pan ar fies an bou dong tu im, bot im saavant dem riez ar op.

en: Holofernes said to her, “Woman, take courage. Don’t be afraid in your heart; for I never hurt anyone who has chosen to serve Nebuchadnezzar, the king of all the earth.
target: Olofernes se tu ar, “Uman, tek korij. No fried ina yu aat; kaa mi neva oert nobadi uu chuuz fi saarv Nebukadnezar, di king a aal di ort.

en: And now, if your people who dwell in the hill country had not slighted me, I would not have lifted up my spear against them; but they have done these things to themselves.
target: An nou, ef yu piipl uu dwel ina di il konchri neva slait mi, mi wudna lif op mi spier gens dem; bot dem du dem ting ya tu demself.

en: And now tell me why you fled from them and came to us; for you have come to save yourself. Take courage! You will live tonight, and hereafter;
target: An nou tel mi wa mek yu fli fram dem an kom tu wi; kaa yu kom fi siev yuself. Tek korij! Yu wi liv tunaait, an iiraafta;

en: for there is no one that will wrong you, but all will treat you well, as is done to the servants of King Nebuchadnezzar my lord.”
target: kaa nobadi no de uu wi rang yu, bot aal wi chriit yu wel, az dem du tu di saavant dem a King Nebukadnezar mi smol-laad.”

en: And Judith said to him, “Receive the words of your servant, and let your handmaid speak in your presence, and I won’t lie to my lord tonight.
target: An Juudit se tu im, “Risiiv di wod dem a yu saavant, an mek yu anmied spiik ina yu prezens, an mi wi no lai tu mi smol-laad tunaait.

en: If you will follow the words of your handmaid, God will bring the thing to pass perfectly with you; and my lord will not fail to accomplish his purposes.
target: Ef yu wi fala di wod dem a yu anmied, Gad wi bring di ting tu paas poerfekli wid yu; an mi smol-laad wi no fiel fi akomplish im poerpos dem.

en: As Nebuchadnezzar king of all the earth lives, and as his power lives, who has sent you for the preservation of every living thing, not only do men serve him by you, but also the beasts of the field, the cattle, and the birds of the sky will live through your strength, in the time of Nebuchadnezzar and of all his house.
target: Az Nebukadnezar king a aal di ort liv, an az im powa liv, uu sen yu fi di prezavieshan a evri livin ting, no onli man dem saarv im bai yu, bot tu di biis dem a di fiil, di kyatl dem, an di boerd dem a di skai wi liv chruu yu schrent, ina di taim a Nebukadnezar an a aal im ous.

en: For we have heard of your wisdom and the subtle plans of your soul. It has been reported in all the earth that you only are brave in all the kingdom, mighty in knowledge, and wonderful in feats of war.
target: Kaa wi ier a yu wizdom an di sotl plan dem a yu suol. Im ripuot ina aal di ort dat yu onli a briev ina aal di kindom, maiti ina nolij, an wandaful ina fiit dem a waar.

en: And now as concerning the matter which Achior spoke in your council, we have heard his words; for the men of Bethulia saved him, and he declared to them all that he had spoken before you.
target: An nou bout di mata we Akior spiik ina yu kounsl, wi ier im wod dem; kaa di man dem a Betuulia siev im, an im diklier tu dem aal we im spiik bifuo yu.

en: Therefore, O lord and master, don’t neglect his word, but lay it up in your heart, for it is true; for our people will not be punished, neither will the sword prevail against them, unless they sin against their God.
target: So, oo smol-laad an maasta, no niglek im wod, bot lie im op ina yu aat, kaa im chuu; kaa wi piipl wi no get ponish, naida di suod wi priviel gens dem, onles dem sin gens dem Gad.

en: And now, that my lord may not be defeated and frustrated in his purpose, and that death may fall upon them, their sin has overtaken them, by which they will provoke their God to anger, whenever they do wickedness.
target: An nou, dat mi smol-laad mie no get difiit an froschriet ina im poerpos, an dat det mie faal pan dem, dem sin uovatek dem, bai wich dem wi provuok dem Gad tu angga, weneva dem du wikidnis.

en: Since their food failed them, and all their water was scant, they took counsel to kill their livestock, and determined to consume all those things which God charged them by his laws that they should not eat.
target: Sins dem fuud fiel dem, an aal dem waata did skyaas, dem tek kounsl fi kil dem laivstak, an ditoermin fi konsum aal dem ting de we Gad chaaj dem bai im laa dem dat dem shudna iit.

en: They are resolved to spend the first fruits of the grain and the tithes of the wine and the oil, which they had consecrated and reserved for the priests who stand before the face of our God in Jerusalem, which it is not fitting for any of the people so much as to touch with their hands.
target: Dem rizalv fi spen di fos fruut dem a di grien an di taid dem a di wain an di ail, we dem kansikriet an rizoerv fi di priis dem uu stan bifuo di fies a wi Gad ina Jeruusalem, we im no fitin fi non a di piipl so moch az fi toch wid dem an dem.

en: They have sent some to Jerusalem, because they also that dwell there have done this thing, to bring them permission from the council of elders.
target: Dem sen som tu Jeruusalem, bikaaz dem tu we dwel de du dis ting, fi bring dem poermishan fram di kounsl a elda dem.

en: When these instructions come to them and they do it, they will be given to you to be destroyed the same day.
target: Wen dem instrokshan ya kom tu dem an dem du im, dem wi get gi tu yu fi get mash op di siem die.

en: Therefore I your servant, knowing all this, fled away from their presence. God sent me to work things with you, at which all the earth will be astonished, even as many as hear it.
target: So mi yu saavant, a nuo aal dis, fli we fram dem prezens. Gad sen mi fi wok ting dem wid yu, a wich aal di ort wi astanish, iivn az nof uu ier im.

en: For your servant is religious, and serves the God of heaven day and night. Now, my lord, I will stay with you; and your servant will go out by night into the valley. I will pray to God, and he will tell me when they have committed their sins.
target: Kaa yu saavant a rilijos, an saarv di Gad a evn die an nait. Nou, mi smol-laad, mi wi stie wid yu; an yu saavant wi go out bai nait ina di vali. Mi wi prie tu Gad, an im wi tel mi wen dem komit dem sin dem.

en: Then I will come and tell you. Then you can go out with all your army, and there will be none of them that will resist you.
target: Den mi wi kom an tel yu. Den yu kyan go out wid aal yu aami, an nobadi a dem no de uu wi rizis yu.

en: And I will lead you through the midst of Judea, until you come to Jerusalem. I will set your throne in the midst of it. You will drive them as sheep that have no shepherd, and a dog will not so much as open his mouth before you; for these things were told me according to my foreknowledge, and were declared to me, and I was sent to tell you.”
target: An mi wi liid yu chruu di migl a Juudia, tel yu kom tu Jeruusalem. Mi wi set yu chuon ina di migl a im. Yu wi jraiv dem az shiip we no av no shepad, an wan daag wi no so moch az opn im mout bifuo yu; kaa dem ting ya did get tel mi akordin tu mi fuonolij, an did diklier tu mi, an mi get sen fi tel yu.”

en: Her words were pleasing in the sight of Holofernes and of all his servants. They marveled at her wisdom, and said,
target: Ar wod dem did pliizin ina di sait a Olofernes an a aal im saavant dem. Dem maavl a ar wizdom, an se,

en: “There is not such a woman from one end of the earth to the other, for beauty of face and wisdom of words.”
target: “No soch uman no de fram wan en a di ort tu di ada, fi byuuti a fies an wizdom a wod dem.”

en: Holofernes said to her, “God did well to send you before the people, that might would be in our hands, and destruction among those who slighted my lord.
target: Olofernes se tu ar, “Gad du wel fi sen yu bifuo di piipl, dat mait wuda bi ina wi an dem, an distroksan mongks dem uu slait mi smol-laad.

en: And now you are beautiful in your countenance, and wise in your words. If you will do as you have spoken, your God will be my God, and you will dwell in the palace of King Nebuchadnezzar, and will be renowned through the whole earth.”
target: An nou yu byuutiful ina yu kountinans, an waiz ina yu wod dem. Ef yu wi du az yu spiik, yu Gad wi bi mi Gad, an yu wi dwel ina di palas a King Nebukadnezar, an wi rinoun chruu di uol ort.”

en: He commanded that she should be brought in where his silver vessels were set, and asked that his servants should prepare some of his own delicacies for her, and that she should drink from his own wine.
target: Im koman dat shi shud get bring in we im silva vesl dem set, an aaks dat im saavant dem shud pripier som a im uon delikesi dem fi ar, an dat shi shud jringk fram im uon wain.

en: And Judith said, “I can’t eat of it; it might become an occasion of stumbling; but provision will be made for me from the things that have come with me.”
target: An Juudit se, “Mi kyaahn iit a im; im mait bikom wan akiezhan a stomblin; bot provijan wi mek fi mi fram di ting dem we kom wid mi.”

en: And Holofernes said to her, “But if the things that are with you should run out, from where will we be able to give you more like it? For there is none of your people with us.”
target: An Olofernes se tu ar, “Bot ef di ting dem we de wid yu shud ron out, fram we wi wi ebl gi yu muor laik im? Kaa non a yu piipl no de wid wi.”

en: And Judith said to him, “As your soul lives, my lord, your servant will not use up those things that are with me until the Lord works by my hand the things that he has determined.”
target: An Juudit se tu im, “Az yu suol liv, mi smol-laad, yu saavant wi no yuuz op dem ting de we de wid mi tel di Laad wok bai mi an di ting dem we im ditoermin.”

en: Then Holofernes’ servants brought her into the tent, and she slept until midnight. Then she rose up toward the morning watch,
target: Den Olofernes saavant dem bring ar ina di tent, an shi sliip tel miglnait. Den shi ruoz op tord di maanin wach,

en: and sent to Holofernes, saying, “Let my lord now command that they allow your servant to go out to pray.”
target: an sen tu Olofernes, a se, “Mek mi smol-laad nou koman dat dem alou yu saavant fi go out fi prie.”

en: Holofernes commanded his guards that they should not stop her. She stayed in the camp three days, and went out every night into the valley of Bethulia and washed herself at the fountain of water in the camp.
target: Olofernes koman im gyaad dem dat dem shudna stap ar. Shi stie ina di kyamp trii die, an go out evri nait ina di vali a Betuulia an wash arself a di fountn a waata ina di kyamp.

en: And when she came up, she implored the Lord God of Israel to direct her way to the triumph of the children of his people.
target: An wen shi kom op, shi impluor di Laad Gad a Izrel fi dairek ar wie tu di chraiomf a di pikni dem a im piipl.

en: She came in clean and remained in the tent until she ate her food toward evening.
target: Shi kom in kliin an rimien ina di tent tel shi iit ar fuud tord iivnin.

en: On the fourth day, Holofernes made a feast for his own servants only, and called none of the officers to the banquet.
target: Pan di fuot die, Olofernes mek wan fiis fi im uon saavant dem onli, an kaal non a di afisa dem tu di bankwet.

en: And he said to Bagoas the eunuch, who had charge over all that he had, “Go now, and persuade this Hebrew woman who is with you that she come to us, and eat and drink with us.
target: An im se tu Bagoas di yuunok, uu did av chaaj uova aal we im av, “Go nou, an poersuied dis Iibruu uman uu de wid yu dat shi kom tu wi, an iit an jringk wid wi.

en: For see, it would be a disgrace if we will let such a woman go, not having had her company; for if we don’t draw her to ourselves, she will laugh us to scorn.”
target: Kaa si, im wuda bi wan disgrais ef wi wi let soch wan uman go, no av ar kompini; kaa ef wi no jraa ar tu wiself, shi wi laaf wi tu skaarn.”

en: Bagoas went from the presence of Holofernes, and came in to her, and said, “Let this fair lady not fear to come to my lord, and to be honored in his presence, and to drink wine and be merry with us, and to be made this day as one of the daughters of the children of Asshur who serve in Nebuchadnezzar’s palace.”
target: Bagoas go fram di prezens a Olofernes, an kom in tu ar, an se, “Mek dis fier liedi no fier fi kom tu mi smol-laad, an fi get ana ina im prezens, an fi jringk wain an bi meri wid wi, an fi get mek dis die az wan a di daata dem a di pikni dem a Ashur uu saarv ina Nebukadnezar palas.”

en: Judith said to him, “Who am I, that I should contradict my lord? For whatever would be pleasing in his eyes, I will do speedily, and this will be my joy to the day of my death.”
target: Juudit se tu im, “Uu a mi, dat mi shud kanchradik mi smol-laad? Kaa wateva wuda pliizin ina im yai dem, mi wi du spiidili, an dis wi bi mi jai tu di die a mi det.”

en: She arose, and decked herself with her apparel and all her woman’s attire; and her servant went and laid fleeces on the ground for her next to Holofernes, which she had received from Bagoas for her daily use, that she might sit and eat upon them.
target: Shi aruoz, an dek arself wid ar aparel an aal ar uman ataiya; an ar saavant go an lie fliis dem pan di grong fi ar neks tu Olofernes, we shi did risiiv fram Bagoas fi ar dieli yuus, dat shi mait sit an iit pan dem.

en: Judith came in and sat down, and Holofernes’ heart was ravished with her. His passion was aroused, and he exceedingly desired her company. He was watching for a time to deceive her from the day that he had seen her.
target: Juudit kom in an sidong, an Olofernes aat did ravish wid ar. Im pashan aruoz, an im wel wel dizaiya ar kompini. Im did a wach fi wan taim fi disiiv ar fram di die dat im si ar.

en: Holofernes said to her, “Drink now, and be merry with us.”
target: Olofernes se tu ar, “Jringk nou, an bi meri wid wi.”

en: Judith said, “I will drink now, my lord, because my life is magnified in me this day more than all the days since I was born.”
target: Juudit se, “Mi wi jringk nou, mi smol-laad, bikaaz mi laif magnifai ina mi dis die muor dan aal di die dem sins mi baan.”

en: Then she took and ate and drank before him what her servant had prepared.
target: Den shi tek an iit an jringk bifuo im wa ar saavant pripier.

en: Holofernes took great delight in her, and drank exceedingly much wine, more than he had drunk at any time in one day since he was born.
target: Olofernes tek big dilait ina ar, an jringk wel nof wain, muor dan im eva jringk a eni taim ina wan die sins im baan.

en: But when the evening had come, his servants hurried to depart. Bagoas shut the tent outside, and dismissed those who waited from the presence of his lord. They went away to their beds; for they were all weary, because the feast had been long.
target: Bot wen di iivnin kom, im saavant dem ori fi dipaat. Bagoas shot di tent outsaid, an dismis dem uu wiet fram di prezens a im smol-laad. Dem go we tu dem bed dem; kaa dem aal did wiiri, bikaaz di fiis did lang.

en: But Judith was left alone in the tent, with Holofernes lying along upon his bed; for he was drunk with wine.
target: Bot Juudit did lef aluon ina di tent, wid Olofernes a lai alang pan im bed; kaa im did jronk wid wain.

en: Judith had said to her servant that she should stand outside her bedchamber, and wait for her to come out, as she did daily; for she said she would go out to her prayer. She spoke to Bagoas according to the same words.
target: Juudit did se tu ar saavant dat shi shud stan outsaid ar bedchiema, an wiet fi ar fi kom out, az shi du dieli; kaa shi se shi wuda go out tu ar prier. Shi spiik tu Bagoas akordin tu di siem wod dem.

en: All went away from her presence, and none was left in the bedchamber, small or great. Judith, standing by his bed, said in her heart, O Lord God of all power, look in this hour upon the works of my hands for the exaltation of Jerusalem.
target: Aal go we fram ar prezens, an non neva lef ina di bedchiema, smol ar big. Juudit, a stan bai im bed, se ina ar aat, Oo Laad Gad a aal powa, luk ina dis oura pan di wok dem a mi an dem fi di egzaltieshan a Jeruusalem.

en: For now is the time to help your inheritance, and to do the thing that I have purposed to the destruction of the enemies which have risen up against us.
target: Kaa nou a di taim fi elp yu ineritans, an fi du di ting we mi poerpos tu di distroksan a di enimi dem we riez op gens wi.

en: She came to the bedpost which was at Holofernes’ head, and took down his sword from there.
target: Shi kom tu di bedpuos we did a Olofernes ed, an tek dong im suod fram de.

en: She drew near to the bed, took hold of the hair of his head, and said, “Strengthen me, O Lord God of Israel, this day.”
target: Shi jraa nier tu di bed, tek uol a di ier a im ed, an se, “Schrentn mi, oo Laad Gad a Izrel, dis die.”

en: She struck twice upon his neck with all her might and cut off his head,
target: Shi chuk twais pan im nek wid aal ar mait an kot aaf im ed,

en: tumbled his body down from the bed, and took down the canopy from the posts. After a little while she went out, and gave Holofernes’ head to her maid;
target: tombl im badi dong fram di bed, an tek dong di kianopi fram di puos dem. Afta wan likl wail shi go out, an gi Olofernes ed tu ar mied;

en: and she put it in her bag of food. They both went out together to prayer, according to their custom. They passed through the camp, circled around that valley, and went up to the mountain of Bethulia, and came to its gates.
target: an shi put im ina ar bag a fuud. Dem buot go out tugeda tu prier, akordin tu dem kostom. Dem paas chruu di kyamp, soerkl ron dat vali, an go op tu di mountn a Betuulia, an kom tu im giet dem.

en: Judith said afar off to the watchmen at the gates, “Open, open the gate, now. God is with us, even our God, to show his power yet in Israel, and his might against the enemy, as he has done even this day.”
target: Juudit se afaar aaf tu di wachman dem a di giet dem, “Opn, opn di giet, nou. Gad de wid wi, iivn wi Gad, fi shuo im powa yet ina Izrel, an im mait gens di enimi, az im du iivn dis die.”

en: When the men of her city heard her voice, they made haste to go down to the gate of their city, and they called together the elders of the city.
target: Wen di man dem a ar siti ier ar vais, dem mek ies fi go dong tu di giet a dem siti, an dem kaal tugeda di elda dem a di siti.

en: They all ran together, both small and great, for it seemed unbelievable to them that she had come. They opened the gate and received them, making a fire to give light, and surrounded them.
target: Dem aal ron tugeda, buot smol an big, kaa im siim onbiliivabl tu dem dat shi kom. Dem opn di giet an risiiv dem, mek wan faiya fi gi lait, an soroun dem.

en: She said to them with a loud voice, “Praise God! Praise him! Praise God, who has not taken away his mercy from the house of Israel, but has destroyed our enemies by my hand tonight!”
target: Shi se tu dem wid wan loud vais, “Priez Gad! Priez im! Priez Gad, uu no tek we im mersi fram di ous a Izrel, bot mash op wi enimi dem bai mi an tunaait!”

en: Then she took the head out of the bag and showed it, and said to them, “See, the head of Holofernes, the chief captain of the army of Asshur, and see, the canopy under which he laid in his drunkenness. The Lord struck him by the hand of a woman.
target: Den shi tek di ed out a di bag an shuo im, an se tu dem, “Si, di ed a Olofernes, di chiif kiaptin a di aami a Ashur, an si, di kianopi anda wich im lie ina im jronknis. Di Laad chuk im bai di an a wan uman.

en: And as the Lord lives, who preserved me in my way that I went, my countenance deceived him to his destruction, and he didn’t commit sin with me, to defile and shame me.”
