target: An az di Laad liv, uu prizoerv mi ina mi wie dat mi go, mi kountinans disiiv im tu im distroksan, an im neva komit sin wid mi, fi difail an shiem mi.”

en: All the people were exceedingly amazed, and bowed themselves, and worshiped God, and said with one accord, “Blessed are you, O our God, who have this day humiliated the enemies of your people.”
target: Aal di piipl did wel wel amiez, an bou demself, an worship Gad, an se wid wan akaard, “Bles a yu, oo wi Gad, uu dis die ombl di enimi dem a yu piipl.”

en: Ozias said to her, “Blessed are you, daughter, in the sight of the Most High God, above all the women upon the earth; and blessed is the Lord God, who created the heavens and the earth, who directed you to cut off the head of the prince of our enemies.
target: Ozaias se tu ar, “Bles a yu, daata, ina di sait a di Mos Ai Gad, abov aal di uman dem pan di ort; an bles a di Laad Gad, uu kriet di evn dem an di ort, uu dairek yu fi kot aaf di ed a di prins a wi enimi dem.

en: For your hope will not depart from the heart of men that remember the strength of God forever.
target: Kaa yu uop wi no dipaat fram di aat a man dem dat rimemba di schrent a Gad fuoreva.

en: May God turn these things to you for a perpetual praise, to visit you with good things, because you didn’t spare your life by reason of the affliction of our people, but prevented our ruin, walking a straight way before our God.” And all the people said, “Amen! Amen!”
target: Mek Gad ton dem ting ya tu yu fi wan poerpechual priez, fi vizit yu wid gud ting dem, bikaaz yu neva spier yu laif bai riizn a di aflikshan a wi piipl, bot privent wi ruin, a waak wan schriet wie bifuo wi Gad.” An aal di piipl se, “Amen! Amen!”

en: Judith said to them, “Hear me now, brothers, and take this head, and hang it upon the battlement of your wall.
target: Juudit se tu dem, “Ier mi nou, breda dem, an tek dis ed, an ang im pan di batlment a unu waal.

en: It will be, so soon as the morning appears, and the sun comes up on the earth, you must each take up his weapons of war, and every valiant man of you go out of the city. You must set a captain over them, as though you would go down to the plain toward the watch of the children of Asshur; but you men must not go down.
target: Im wi bi, so suun az di maanin apier, an di son kom op pan di ort, unu evriwan mos tek op im wepan dem a waar, an evri valiant man a unu go out a di siti. Unu mos set wan kiaptin uova dem, az duo unu wuda go dong tu di plien tord di wach a di pikni dem a Ashur; bot unu man dem mos no go dong.

en: These will take up their full armor, and will go into their camp and rouse up the captains of the army of Asshur. They will run together to Holofernes’ tent. They won’t find him. Fear will fall upon them, and they will flee before your face.
target: Dem ya wi tek op dem ful aama, an wi go ina dem kyamp an rouz op di kiaptin dem a di aami a Ashur. Dem wi ron tugeda tu Olofernes tent. Dem wi no fain im. Fier wi faal pan dem, an dem wi fli bifuo unu fies.

en: You men, and all that inhabit every border of Israel, must pursue them and overthrow them as they go.
target: Unu man dem, an aal uu inabit evri baada a Izrel, mos poersuu dem an uovachruo dem az dem go.

en: But before you do these things, summon Achior the Ammonite to me, that he may see and know him that despised the house of Israel, and that sent him to us, as it were to death.
target: Bot bifuo unu du dem ting ya, somon Akior di Amuonait tu mi, dat im mie si an nuo im dat dispaiz di ous a Izrel, an dat sen im tu wi, az im wier tu det.

en: And they called Achior out of the house of Ozias; but when he came, and saw the head of Holofernes in a man’s hand in the assembly of the people, he fell upon his face, and his spirit failed.
target: An dem kaal Akior out a di ous a Ozaias; bot wen im kom, an si di ed a Olofernes ina wan man an ina di asembli a di piipl, im fel pan im fies, an im spirit fiel.

en: But when they had recovered him, he fell at Judith’s feet, bowed down to her, and said, “Blessed are you in every tent of Judah! In every nation, those who hear your name will be troubled.
target: Bot wen dem rikuva im, im fel a Juudit fut dem, bou dong tu ar, an se, “Bles a yu ina evri tent a Juuda! Ina evri nieshan, dem uu ier yu niem wi chrobl.

en: Now tell me all the things that you have done in these days.” And Judith declared to him in the midst of the people all the things that she had done, from the day that she went out until the time that she spoke to them.
target: Nou tel mi aal di ting dem we yu du ina dem die ya.” An Juudit diklier tu im ina di migl a di piipl aal di ting dem we shi du, fram di die dat shi go out tel di taim dat shi spiik tu dem.

en: But when she finished speaking, the people shouted with a loud voice, and made a joyful noise in their city.
target: Bot wen shi don spiik, di piipl shout wid wan loud vais, an mek wan jaiful naiz ina dem siti.

en: But when Achior saw all the things that the God of Israel had done, he believed in God exceedingly, and circumcised the flesh of his foreskin, and was joined to the house of Israel, to this day.
target: Bot wen Akior si aal di ting dem we di Gad a Izrel du, im biliiv ina Gad wel wel, an soerkomsaiz di flesh a im fuoskin, an jain tu di ous a Izrel, tu dis die.

en: But as soon as the morning arose, they hanged the head of Holofernes upon the wall, and every man took up his weapons, and they went forth by bands to the ascents of the mountain.
target: Bot az suun az di maanin aruoz, dem ang di ed a Olofernes pan di waal, an evri man tek op im wepan dem, an dem go fuot bai band dem tu di asent dem a di mountn.

en: But when the children of Asshur saw them, they sent word to their leaders, and they went to their captains and tribunes, and to every one of their rulers.
target: Bot wen di pikni dem a Ashur si dem, dem sen wod tu dem liida dem, an dem go tu dem kiaptin dem an chribuun dem, an tu evriwan a dem ruula dem.

en: They came to Holofernes’ tent, and said to him that was over all that he had, “Wake our lord up, now, for the slaves have been bold to come down against us to battle, that they may be utterly destroyed.”
target: Dem kom tu Olofernes tent, an se tu im dat did uova aal we im av, “Wiek wi smol-laad op, nou, kaa di sliev dem ben buol fi kom dong gens wi tu batl, dat dem mie get mash op uotali.”

en: Bagoas went in, and knocked at the outer door of the tent; for he supposed that Holofernes was sleeping with Judith.
target: Bagoas go in, an nak a di outa duor a di tent; kaa im supuoz dat Olofernes did a sliip wid Juudit.

en: But when no one answered, he opened it, went into the bedchamber, and found him cast upon the threshold dead; and his head had been taken from him.
target: Bot wen nobadi no ansa, im opn im, go ina di bedchiema, an fain im kaas pan di chreshuol ded; an im ed did tek fram im.

en: He cried with a loud voice, with weeping, groaning, and shouting, and tore his garments.
target: Im krai wid wan loud vais, wid wiipin, gruonin, an shoutin, an tier im gaament dem.

en: He entered into the tent where Judith lodged, and he didn’t find her. He leaped out to the people, and cried aloud,
target: Im enta ina di tent we Juudit laj, an im neva fain ar. Im liip out tu di piipl, an krai aloud,

en: “The slaves have dealt treacherously! One woman of the Hebrews has brought shame upon the house of King Nebuchadnezzar; for, see, Holofernes lies upon the ground, and his head is not on him!”
target: “Di sliev dem diil chrecharosli! Wan uman a di Iibruu dem bring shiem pan di ous a King Nebukadnezar; kaa, si, Olofernes lai pan di grong, an im ed no de pan im!”

en: But when the rulers of the army of Asshur heard this, they tore their tunics, and their souls were troubled exceedingly. There were cries and an exceedingly great noise in the midst of the camp.
target: Bot wen di ruula dem a di aami a Ashur ier dis, dem tier dem tuunik dem, an dem suol dem did chrobl wel wel. Krai dem an wan wel big naiz did de ina di migl a di kyamp.

en: When those who were in the tents heard, they were amazed at what happened.
target: Wen dem uu did ina di tent dem ier, dem did amiez a wa apm.

en: Trembling and fear fell upon them, and no man dared stay any more in the sight of his neighbor, but rushing out with one accord, they fled into every way of the plain and of the hill country.
target: Chremblin an fier fel pan dem, an no man dier stie no muor ina di sait a im nieba, bot a rosh out wid wan akaard, dem fli ina evri wie a di plien an a di il konchri.

en: Those who had encamped in the hill country round about Bethulia fled away. And then the children of Israel, every one who was a warrior among them, rushed out upon them.
target: Dem uu enkyamp ina di il konchri ron bout Betuulia fli we. An den di pikni dem a Izrel, evriwan uu did wan warior mongks dem, rosh out pan dem.

en: Ozias sent to Betomasthaim, Bebai, Chobai, and Chola, and to every border of Israel, to tell about the things that had been accomplished, and that all should rush upon their enemies to destroy them.
target: Ozaias sen tu Betomastaim, Bebai, Kuobai, an Kuola, an tu evri baada a Izrel, fi tel bout di ting dem we apm, an dat aal shud rosh pan dem enimi dem fi mash dem op.

en: But when the children of Israel heard this, they all fell upon them with one accord, and struck them to Chobai. Yes, and in like manner also, people from Jerusalem and from all the hill country came (for men had told them about what happened in their enemies’ camp), and those who were in Gilead and in Galilee fell upon their flank with a great slaughter, until they were past Damascus and its borders.
target: Bot wen di pikni dem a Izrel ier dis, dem aal fel pan dem wid wan akaard, an chuk dem tu Kuobai. Ies, an ina laik mana tu, piipl fram Jeruusalem an fram aal di il konchri kom (kaa man dem tel dem bout wa apm ina dem enimi dem kyamp), an dem uu did ina Giliad an ina Gyalalii fel pan dem flank wid wan big slaata, tel dem paas Damaskos an im baada dem.

en: The rest of the people who lived at Bethulia fell upon the camp of Asshur, and plundered them, and were enriched exceedingly.
target: Di res a di piipl uu liv a Betuulia fel pan di kyamp a Ashur, an plonda dem, an did en-rich wel wel.

en: The children of Israel returned from the slaughter, and got possession of that which remained. The villages and the cities that were in the hill country and in the plain country took many spoils; for there was an exceedingly great supply.
target: Di pikni dem a Izrel rityon fram di slaata, an get pozeshan a dat we rimien. Di vilij dem an di siti dem we did ina di il konchri an ina di plien konchri tek nof spail dem; kaa wan wel big soplai did de.

en: Joakim the high priest, and the council of elders of the children of Israel who lived in Jerusalem, came to see the good things which the Lord had showed to Israel, and to see Judith and to greet her.
target: Joakim di ai priis, an di kounsl a elda dem a di pikni dem a Izrel uu liv ina Jeruusalem, kom fi si di gud ting dem we di Laad shuo tu Izrel, an fi si Juudit an fi griit ar.

en: When they came to her, they all blessed her with one accord, and said to her, “You are the exaltation of Jerusalem! You are the great glory of Israel! You are the great rejoicing of our people!
target: Wen dem kom tu ar, dem aal bles ar wid wan akaard, an se tu ar, “Yu a di egzaltieshan a Jeruusalem! Yu a di big gluori a Izrel! Yu a di big rijoisin a wi piipl!

en: You have done all these things by your hand. You have done with Israel the things that are good, and God is pleased with it. May you be blessed by the Almighty Lord forever!” And all the people said, “Amen!”
target: Yu du aal dem ting ya bai yu an. Yu du wid Izrel di ting dem we gud, an Gad pliiz wid im. Mek yu get bles bai di Olmaiti Laad fuoreva!” An aal di piipl se, “Amen!”

en: And the people plundered the camp for thirty days; and they gave Holofernes’ tent to Judith, along with all his silver cups, his beds, his bowls, and all his furniture. She took them, placed them on her mule, prepared her wagons, and piled them on it.
target: An di piipl plonda di kyamp fi terti die; an dem gi Olofernes tent tu Juudit, alang wid aal im silva kop dem, im bed dem, im boul dem, an aal im foernicha. Shi tek dem, plies dem pan ar myuul, pripier ar wagan dem, an pail dem pan im.

en: And all the women of Israel ran together to see her; and they blessed her, and made a dance among them for her. She took branches in her hand, and distributed them to the women who were with her.
target: An aal di uman dem a Izrel ron tugeda fi si ar; an dem bles ar, an mek wan daans mongks dem fi ar. Shi tek branch dem ina ar an, an dischribuut dem tu di uman dem uu did wid ar.

en: Then they made themselves garlands of olive, she and those who were with her, and she went before all the people in the dance, leading all the women. All the men of Israel followed in their armor with garlands, and with songs in their mouths.
target: Den dem mek demself gaalan dem a aliv, shi an dem uu did wid ar, an shi go bifuo aal di piipl ina di daans, a liid aal di uman dem. Aal di man dem a Izrel fala ina dem aama wid gaalan dem, an wid sang dem ina dem mout dem.

en: And Judith began to sing this song of thanksgiving in all Israel, and all the people sang with loud voices this song of praise.
target: An Juudit bigin fi sing dis sang a tangksgivin ina aal Izrel, an aal di piipl sang wid loud vais dem dis sang a priez.

en: Judith said, “Begin a song to my God with timbrels. Sing to my Lord with cymbals. Make melody to him with psalm and praise. Exalt him, and call upon his name.
target: Juudit se, “Bigin wan sang tu mi Gad wid timbrel dem. Sing tu mi Laad wid simbal dem. Mek melodi tu im wid saam an priez. Egzalt im, an kaal pan im niem.

en: For the Lord is the God that crushes battles. For in his armies in the midst of the people, he delivered me out of the hand of those who persecuted me.
target: Kaa di Laad a di Gad dat krosh batl dem. Kaa ina im aami dem ina di migl a di piipl, im diliva mi out a di an a dem uu poersikyuut mi.

en: Asshur came out of the mountains from the north. He came with ten thousands of his army. Its multitude stopped the torrents. Their horsemen covered the hills.
target: Ashur kom out a di mountn dem fram di naat. Im kom wid ten touzn dem a im aami. Im moltityuud stap di torent dem. Dem aasman dem kova di il dem.

en: He said that he would burn up my borders, kill my young men with the sword, throw my nursing children to the ground, give my infants up as prey, and make my virgins a plunder.
target: Im se dat im wuda boern op mi baada dem, kil mi yong man dem wid di suod, chruo mi noersin pikni dem tu di grong, gi mi infant dem op az prie, an mek mi voerjin dem wan plonda.

en: “The Almighty Lord brought them to nothing by the hand of a woman.
target: “Di Olmaiti Laad bring dem tu notn bai di an a wan uman.

en: For their mighty one didn’t fall by young men, neither did sons of the Titans strike him. Tall giants didn’t attack him, but Judith the daughter of Merari made him weak with the beauty of her countenance.
target: Kaa dem maiti wan neva faal bai yong man dem, naida son dem a di Taitan dem chuk im. Taal jaiant dem neva atak im, bot Juudit di daata a Merari mek im wiik wid di byuuti a ar kountinans.

en: “For she put off the apparel of her widowhood for the exaltation of those who were distressed in Israel. She anointed her face with ointment, bound her hair in a tiara, and took a linen garment to deceive him.
target: “Kaa shi put aaf di aparel a ar widuoud fi di egzaltieshan a dem uu did dischres ina Izrel. Shi anaint ar fies wid aintment, bain ar ier ina wan tiara, an tek wan linin gaament fi disiiv im.

en: Her sandal ravished his eye. Her beauty took his soul prisoner. The sword passed through his neck.
target: Ar sandal ravish im yai. Ar byuuti tek im suol prizna. Di suod paas chruu im nek.

en: “The Persians quaked at her daring. The Medes were daunted at her boldness.
target: “Di Pershan dem kwiek a ar dierin. Di Miid dem did daant a ar buolnis.

en: “Then my lowly ones shouted aloud. My oppressed people were terrified and trembled for fear. They lifted up their voices and the enemy fled.
target: “Den mi luoli wan dem shout aloud. Mi opres piipl did terifai an chrembl fi fier. Dem lif op dem vais dem an di enimi fli.

en: The children of slave-girls pierced them through, and wounded them as fugitives’ children. They perished by the army of my Lord.
target: Di pikni dem a sliev-gyaal dem piirs dem chruu, an wuund dem az fyuujitiv pikni dem. Dem perish bai di aami a mi Laad.

en: “I will sing to my God a new song: O Lord, you are great and glorious, marvelous in strength, invincible.
target: “Mi wi sing tu mi Gad wan nyuu sang: Oo Laad, yu big an gluorias, maavlos ina schrent, invinsibl.

en: Let all your creation serve you; for you spoke, and they were made. You sent out your spirit, and it built them. There is no one who can resist your voice.
target: Mek aal yu krieshan saarv yu; kaa yu spiik, an dem get mek. Yu sen out yu Spirit, an im bil dem. Nobadi no de uu kyan rizis yu vais.

en: For the mountains will be moved from their foundations with the waters, and the rocks will melt as wax at your presence: But you are yet merciful to those who fear you.
target: Kaa di mountn dem wi muuv fram dem foundieshan dem wid di waata dem, an di rak dem wi melt az waks a yu prezens: Bot yu yet moersiful tu dem uu fier yu.

en: For all sacrifice is little for a sweet savor, and all the fat is very little for a whole burnt offering to you; but he who fears the Lord is great continually.
target: Kaa aal sakrifais likl fi wan swiit sieva, an aal di fat wel likl fi wan uol boern aafrin tu yu; bot im uu fier di Laad big kontinyuali.

en: “Woe to the nations who rise up against my people! The Lord Almighty will take vengeance on them in the day of judgment and put fire and worms in their flesh; and they will weep and feel their pain forever.”
target: “Wuo tu di nieshan dem uu riez op gens mi piipl! Di Laad Olmaiti wi tek venjans pan dem ina di die a jojment an put faiya an woerm dem ina dem flesh; an dem wi wiip an fiil dem pien fuoreva.”

en: Now when they came to Jerusalem, they worshiped God. When the people were purified, they offered their whole burnt offerings, their free will offerings, and their gifts.
target: Nou wen dem kom tu Jeruusalem, dem worship Gad. Wen di piipl did pyuurifai, dem aafa dem uol boern aafrin dem, dem frii wil aafrin dem, an dem gif dem.

en: Judith dedicated all Holofernes’ stuff, which the people had given her, and gave the canopy, which she had taken for herself out of his bedchamber, for a gift to the Lord.
target: Juudit dedikiet aal Olofernes stof, we di piipl gi ar, an gi di kianopi, we shi tek fi arself out a im bedchiema, fi wan gif tu di Laad.

en: And the people continued feasting in Jerusalem before the sanctuary for three months, and Judith remained with them.
target: An di piipl kontinyu fiis ina Jeruusalem bifuo di sankchueri fi trii mont, an Juudit rimien wid dem.

en: After these days, everyone departed to his own inheritance. Judith went away to Bethulia, and remained in her own possession, and was honorable in her time in all the land.
target: Afta dem die ya, evriwan dipaat tu im uon ineritans. Juudit go we tu Betuulia, an rimien ina ar uon pozeshan, an did anarabl ina ar taim ina aal di lan.

en: Many desired her, but no man knew her all the days of her life from the day that Manasses her husband died and was gathered to his people.
target: Nof dizaiya ar, bot no man nyuu ar aal di die dem a ar laif fram di die dat Manasez ar ozban dai an get gyada tu im piipl.

en: She increased in greatness exceedingly; and she grew old in her husband’s house, to one hundred five years. She let her maid go free. Then she died in Bethulia. They buried her in the cave of her husband Manasses.
target: Shi inkriis ina biginis wel wel; an shi gro uol ina ar ozban ous, tu wan onjred faiv ier. Shi mek ar mied go frii. Den shi dai ina Betuulia. Dem beri ar ina di kiev a ar ozban Manasez.

en: The house of Israel mourned for her seven days. She distributed her goods before she died to all those who were nearest of kin to Manasses her husband, and to those who were nearest of her own family.
target: Di ous a Izrel muorn fi ar sebn die. Shi dischribuut ar gud dem bifuo shi dai tu aal dem uu did niaris a kin tu Manasez ar ozban, an tu dem uu did niaris a ar uon famili.

en: There was no one who made the children of Israel afraid any more in the days of Judith, nor for a long time after her death.
target: De nobadi no de uu mek di pikni dem a Izrel fried no muor ina di die dem a Juudit, no fi wan lang taim afta ar det.

en: Love righteousness, all you who are judges of the earth. Think of the Lord with a good mind. Seek him in singleness of heart,
target: Lov raichosnis, aal a unu uu a joj dem a di ort. Ting bout di Laad wid a gud main, an siik im wid a singl aat,

en: because he is found by those who don’t put him to the test, and is manifested to those who trust him.
target: bikaaz dem fain im uu no tes im, an im shuo imself tu dem uu chros im.

en: for crooked thoughts separate from God. His power convicts when it is tested, and exposes the foolish;
target: kaa krukid taat dem separet fram Gad. Im powa konvik wen dem tes it, an eksuoz di fuulish dem;

en: because wisdom will not enter into a soul that devises evil, nor dwell in a body that is enslaved by sin.
target: bikaaz wizdam wi no go ina a suol wa divaiz iivl, nar dwel ina a badi wa sin uol az sliev.

en: For a holy spirit of discipline will flee deceit, and will depart from thoughts that are without understanding, and will be ashamed when unrighteousness has come in.
target: Kaa a uoli Spirit a disiplin wi ron we fram disiet, an wi lef taat dem wa no av andastandin, an wi shiem wen onraichosnis kom in.

en: For wisdom is a spirit who loves man, and she will not hold a blasphemer guiltless for his lips, because God is witness of his inmost self, and is a true overseer of his heart, and a hearer of his tongue.
target: Kaa wizdam a wan Spirit wa lov man, an shi wi no uol a blasfiima giltilis fi im lip dem, bikaaz Gad a witnis a im inmos self, an a chuu uovasier a im aat, an a ier a im tong.

en: Because the spirit of the Lord has filled the world, and that which holds all things together knows what is said.
target: Bikaaz di Spirit a di Laad don ful op di worl, an da wa uol aal ting tugeda nuo wa dem se.

en: Therefore no one who utters unrighteous things will be unseen; neither will justice, when it convicts, pass him by.
target: So nobadi uu taak onraichos ting dem wi go onsiin; niida jostis, wen it konvik, wi paas im bai.

en: For in his counsels the ungodly will be searched out, and the sound of his words will come to the Lord to bring his lawless deeds to conviction;
target: Kaa ina im kounsl dem di ongodli wi get sorch out, an di soun a im wod dem wi kom tu di Laad fi bring im laalis diid dem tu konvikshan;

en: because a jealous ear listens to all things, and the noise of murmurings is not hidden.
target: bikaaz a jelos ier lisn tu aal ting, an di naiz a mormorin dem no aid.

en: Beware then of unprofitable murmuring, and keep your tongue from slander; because no secret utterance will go on its way void, and a lying mouth destroys a soul.
target: So wach out fi onprafitabl mormorin, an kip yu tong fram slanda; bikaaz no siikrit wod wi go pan im wie emti, an a laiin mout distrai a suol.

en: Don’t court death in the error of your life. Don’t draw destruction upon yourselves by the works of your hands;
target: No kuot det ina di ero a yu laif. No jraa distrokshan pan unuself bai di wok a yu an dem;

en: because God didn’t make death, neither does he delight when the living perish.
target: bikaaz Gad no ben mek det, niida im dilait wen di livin dem perish.

en: For he created all things that they might have being. The generative powers of the world are wholesome, and there is no poison of destruction in them, nor has Hades royal dominion upon earth;
target: Kaa im kriet aal ting so dem mait av biin. Di powa dem wa mek laif ina di worl a uolsom, an no paizn a distrokshan de ina dem, nar Iidis av raayal dominion pan ort;

en: for righteousness is immortal,
target: kaa raichosnis a imoortal,

en: but ungodly men by their hands and their words summon death; deeming him a friend they pined away. They made a covenant with him, because they are worthy to belong with him.
target: bot ongodli man dem bai dem an an dem wod kaal det fi kom; dem ting se im a fren, an dem pain we. Dem mek a kovnant wid im, bikaaz dem worti fi bilang wid im.

en: For they said within themselves, with unsound reasoning, “Our life is short and sorrowful. There is no healing when a man comes to his end, and no one was ever known who was released from Hades.
target: Kaa dem se ina demself, wid onsoun riiznin, “Wi laif shaat an saraful. No iilin no de wen man kom tu im en, an nobadi no eva nuo uu get riliis fram Iidis.

en: Because we were born by mere chance, and hereafter we will be as though we had never been, because the breath in our nostrils is smoke, and reason is a spark kindled by the beating of our heart,
target: Bikaaz wi baan bai mier chans, an afta wi wi bi az duo wi neva ben, bikaaz di bret ina wi naasjril a smuok, an riizn a wan spaak kinl bai di biitin a wi aat,

en: which being extinguished, the body will be turned into ashes, and the spirit will be dispersed as thin air.
target: wa wen it out, di badi wi ton tu ashiz, an di Spirit wi skata az tin ier.

en: Our name will be forgotten in time. No one will remember our works. Our life will pass away as the traces of a cloud, and will be scattered as is a mist, when it is chased by the rays of the sun, and overcome by its heat.
target: Wi niem wi get faget ina taim. Nobadi wi memba wi wok dem. Wi laif wi paas we az di chries a wan kloud, an wi skata az mist, wen di rie dem a di son chies it, an im iit uovakom it.

en: For our allotted time is the passing of a shadow, and our end doesn’t retreat, because it is securely sealed, and no one turns it back.
target: Kaa wi taim wa dem alot a di paasin a wan shado, an wi en no go bak, bikaaz it siil op sekiur, an nobadi no ton it bak.

en: “Come therefore and let’s enjoy the good things that exist. Let’s use the creation earnestly as in our youth.
target: “Kom so den an mek wi enjai di gud ting dem wa de ya. Mek wi yuuz di krietion aanisli az ina wi yuut.

en: Let’s fill ourselves with costly wine and perfumes, and let no spring flower pass us by.
target: Mek wi ful wiself wid kaastli wain an porfyuum dem, an mek no spring flowa paas wi bai.

en: Let’s crown ourselves with rosebuds before they wither.
target: Mek wi kroun wiself wid ruozbod dem bifuo dem widda.

en: Let none of us go without his share in our proud revelry. Let’s leave tokens of mirth everywhere, because this is our portion, and this is our lot.
target: Mek non a wi go widout im shier ina wi proud revelri. Mek wi lef tuokn a mort evriwe, bikaaz dis a wi puoshan, an dis a wi lat.

en: Let’s oppress the righteous poor. Let’s not spare the widow, nor regard the gray hair of the old man.
target: Mek wi opres di raichos puo. Mek wi no spier di wido, nar rigyaad di grie ier a di uol man.

en: But let our strength be a law of righteousness; for that which is weak is proven useless.
target: Bot mek wi chrent bi a laa a raichosnis; kaa wa wiik pruuv yuuslis.

en: But let’s lie in wait for the righteous man, because he annoys us, is contrary to our works, reproaches us with sins against the law, and charges us with sins against our discipline.
target: Bot mek wi lai ina wiet fi di raichos man, bikaaz im anai wi, im agens wi wok dem, im ripuoch wi wid sin dem agens di laa, an im chaaj wi wid sin dem agens wi disiplin.

en: He professes to have knowledge of God, and calls himself a child of the Lord.
target: Im profes fi av nalij a Gad, an kaal imself a pikni a di Laad.

en: He became a reproach to our thoughts.
target: Im ton a ripuoch tu wi taat dem.

en: He is grievous to us even to look at, because his life is unlike other men’s, and his paths are strange.
target: Im griivos tu wi iivn fi luk pan, bikaaz im laif no laik ada man dem laif, an im paat dem schrienj.

en: We were regarded by him as something worthless, and he abstains from our ways as from uncleanness. He calls the latter end of the righteous happy. He boasts that God is his father.
target: Im rigyaad wi az sitn wortlis, an im kip imself fram wi wie dem az fram onkliinnis. Im kaal di laata en a di raichos dem api. Im buos se Gad a im faada.

en: Let’s see if his words are true. Let’s test what will happen at the end of his life.
target: Mek wi si if im wod dem chuu. Mek wi tes wa wi apn a di en a im laif.

en: For if the righteous man is God’s son, he will uphold him, and he will deliver him out of the hand of his adversaries.
target: Kaa if di raichos man a Gads son, im wi opuol im, an im wi diliva im outa di an a im adveseri dem.

en: Let’s test him with insult and torture, that we may find out how gentle he is, and test his patience.
target: Mek wi tes im wid insolt an taacha, so wi mait fain out ou jentl im bi, an tes im pieshans.

en: Let’s condemn him to a shameful death, for he will be protected, according to his words.”
target: Mek wi kondem im tu a shiemful det, kaa im wi get protek, akardin tu im wod dem.”

en: Thus they reasoned, and they were led astray; for their wickedness blinded them,
target: Az dem riizn so, an dem get led aschrie; kaa dem wikidnis blain dem,

en: and they didn’t know the mysteries of God, neither did they hope for wages of holiness, nor did they discern that there is a prize for blameless souls.
target: an dem neva nuo di mischri dem a Gad, niida dem uop fi wiejiz a uolinis, nar dem disorn se a praiz de fi blemlis suol dem.

en: Because God created man for incorruption, and made him an image of his own eternity;
target: Bikaaz Gad kriet man fi inkoropshan, an mek im wan imij a im uon itoorniti;

en: but death entered into the world by the envy of the devil, and those who belong to him experience it.
target: bot det kom ina di worl chuu di envi a di devl, an dem uu bilang tu im ekspiriens it.

en: But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of God, and no torment will touch them.
target: Bot di suol dem a di raichos dem de ina di an a Gad, an no taament wi toch dem.

en: In the eyes of the foolish they seemed to have died. Their departure was considered a disaster,
target: Ina di yai dem a di fuulish dem dem siim fi ded. Dem dipaacha kansida a dizaasta,

en: and their travel away from us ruin, but they are in peace.
target: an dem chravl we fram wi a ruin, bot dem de ina piis.

en: For even if in the sight of men they are punished, their hope is full of immortality.
target: Kaa iivn if ina man dem sait dem get ponish, dem uop ful a imoortaliti.

en: Having been disciplined a little, they will receive great good; because God tested them, and found them worthy of himself.
target: Afta dem get disiplin a likl, dem wi get griet gud; bikaaz Gad tes dem, an fain dem worti a imself.

en: He tested them like gold in the furnace, and he accepted them as a whole burnt offering.
target: Im tes dem laik guol ina di fornis, an im aksep dem az a uol bon aafrin.

en: In the time of their visitation they will shine. They will run back and forth like sparks among stubble.
target: Ina di taim a dem vizitieshan dem wi shain. Dem wi ron bak an fuot laik spaak dem mong stobl.

en: They will judge nations and have dominion over peoples. The Lord will reign over them forever.
target: Dem wi joj nieshan dem an av dominion uova piipl dem. Di Laad wi rien uova dem fareva.

en: Those who trust him will understand truth. The faithful will live with him in love, because grace and mercy are with his chosen ones.
target: Dem uu chros im wi andastan chuut. Di fietful dem wi liv wid im ina lov, bikaaz gries an mersi de wid im chuozn wan dem.

en: But the ungodly will be punished even as their reasoning deserves, those who neglected righteousness and revolted from the Lord;
target: Bot di ongodli dem wi get ponish iivn az dem riiznin dizorv, dem uu neglek raichosnis an rivolt fram di Laad;

en: for he who despises wisdom and discipline is miserable. Their hope is void and their toils unprofitable. Their works are useless.
target: kaa uu dispaiz wizdam an disiplin mizrabl. Dem uop vaid an dem tail onprafitabl. Dem wok dem yuuslis.

en: Their wives are foolish and their children are wicked.
target: Dem waif dem fuulish an dem pikni dem wikid.

en: Their descendants are cursed. For the barren woman who is undefiled is happy, she who has not conceived in transgression. She will have fruit when God examines souls.
target: Dem disendant dem kors. Kaa di baren uman uu ondefail a api, shi uu no kansiiv ina chransgreshan. Shi wi av fruut wen Gad egzamin suol dem.

en: So is the eunuch which has done no lawless deed with his hands, nor imagined wicked things against the Lord; for a precious gift will be given to him for his faithfulness, and a delightful inheritance in the Lord’s sanctuary.
target: So tu di yuunak uu don no laalis diid wid im an dem, nar imajin wikid ting dem agens di Laad; kaa a preshos gif wi gi tu im fi im fietfulnis, an a dilaitful ineritans ina di Laads sankchuari.

en: For good labors have fruit of great renown. The root of understanding can’t fail.
target: Kaa gud lieba dem av fruut a griet rinoun. Di ruut a andastandin kyaan fiel.

en: But children of adulterers will not come to maturity. The seed of an unlawful union will vanish away.
target: Bot pikni a adoltara dem wi no kom tu machuuriti. Di siid a wan onlaaful yuunian wi vanish we.

en: For if they live long, they will not be esteemed, and in the end, their old age will be without honor.
target: Kaa if dem liv lang, dem wi no get estiim, an ina di en, dem uol iej wi de widout ana.

en: If they die young, they will have no hope, nor consolation in the day of judgment.
target: If dem ded yong, dem wi av no uop, nar kansolieshan ina di die a jojment.

en: For the end of an unrighteous generation is always grievous.
target: Kaa di en a wan onraichos jenarieshan aalwiez griivos.

en: It is better to be childless with virtue, for immortality is in the memory of virtue, because it is recognized both before God and before men.
target: It beta fi av no pikni wid vochuu, kaa imoortaliti de ina di memri a vochuu, bikaaz dem rekonnaiz it bifuo Gad an bifuo man dem.

en: When it is present, people imitate it. They long after it when it has departed. Throughout all time it marches, crowned in triumph, victorious in the competition for the prizes that are undefiled.
target: Wen it de ya, piipl imitet it. Dem lang fi it wen it gaan. Chuout aal taim it maach, kroun ina chraiomf, vikchuorios ina di kompetishan fi di praiz dem wa ondefail.

en: But the multiplying brood of the ungodly will be of no profit, and their illegitimate offshoots won’t take deep root, nor will they establish a sure hold.
target: Bot di moltiplaiin bruud a di ongodli dem wi bi a no prafit, an dem ilijitimet afshuut dem wi no tek diip ruut, nar dem wi establis a shuur uol.

en: For even if they grow branches and flourish for a season, standing unsure, they will be shaken by the wind. They will be uprooted by the violence of winds.
target: Kaa iivn if dem gruo branchiz an florish fi a siizn, a tan onshuur, di win wi shiek dem. Di vaiolens a win dem wi opruut dem.

en: Their branches will be broken off before they come to maturity. Their fruit will be useless, never ripe to eat, and fit for nothing.
target: Dem branchiz wi bruk af bifuo dem machuur. Dem fruut wi yuuslis, neva raip fi iit, an fit fi notn.

en: For unlawfully conceived children are witnesses of wickedness against parents when they are investigated.
target: Kaa onlaafuli kansiiv pikni dem a witnis a wikidnis agens pierent dem wen dem investigiet dem.

en: But a righteous man, even if he dies before his time, will be at rest.
target: Bot a raichos man, iivn if im ded bifuo im taim, wi de a res.

en: For honorable old age is not that which stands in length of time, nor is its measure given by number of years,
target: Kaa anarebl uol iej a no da wa tan ina lent a taim, nar im meja gi bai nomba a ier dem,

en: but understanding is gray hair to men, and an unspotted life is ripe old age.
target: bot andastandin a grie ier tu man dem, an a onspotid laif a raip uol iej.

en: Being found well-pleasing to God, someone was loved. While living among sinners he was transported.
target: Wan smadi fain se im wel-pliizin tu Gad, an dem lov im. Wail im a liv mong sina dem im get chranspuot we.

en: He was caught away, so that evil would not change his understanding, or guile deceive his soul.
target: Dem kyaach im we, so iivl wudn chienj im andastandin, nar gail disiiv im suol.

en: For the fascination of wickedness obscures the things which are good, and the whirl of desire perverts an innocent mind.
target: Kaa di fasinieshan a wikidnis obskiur di ting dem wa gud, an di worl a dizaya povort a inosent main.

en: Being made perfect quickly, he filled a long time;
target: Im mek porfek kwikli, an im ful a lang taim;

en: for his soul was pleasing to the Lord. Therefore he hurried out of the midst of wickedness.
target: kaa im suol pliizin tu di Laad. So im ori outa di mids a wikidnis.

en: But the peoples saw and didn’t understand, not considering this, that grace and mercy are with his chosen, and that he visits his holy ones;
target: Bot di piipl dem si an no andastan, dem no kansida dis, se gries an mersi de wid im chuozn wan dem, an se im vizit im uoli wan dem;

en: but a righteous man who is dead will condemn the ungodly who are living, and youth who is quickly perfected will condemn the many years of an unrighteous man’s old age.
target: bot a raichos man uu ded wi kondem di ongodli dem uu a liv, an yuut uu mek porfek kwikli wi kondem di muos ier dem a wan onraichos man uol iej.

en: For the ungodly will see a wise man’s end, and won’t understand what the Lord planned for him, and why he safely kept him.
target: Kaa di ongodli dem wi si a waiz man en, an wi no andastan wa di Laad plan fi im, an wai im kip im sief.

en: They will see, and they will despise; but the Lord will laugh them to scorn. After this, they will become a dishonored carcass and a reproach among the dead forever;
target: Dem wi si, an dem wi dispaiz; bot di Laad wi laaf dem tu skaan. Afta dis, dem wi ton a disana kaakas an a ripuoch mong di ded dem fareva;

en: because he will dash them speechless to the ground, and will shake them from the foundations. They will lie utterly waste. They will be in anguish and their memory will perish.
target: bikaaz im wi dash dem spiichlis tu di grong, an wi shiek dem fram di foundieshan dem. Dem wi lai otli wies. Dem wi de ina angwish an dem memri wi perish.

en: They will come with coward fear when their sins are counted. Their lawless deeds will convict them to their face.
target: Dem wi kom wid kouad fier wen dem sin dem kount. Dem laalis diid dem wi konvik dem tu dem fies.

en: Then the righteous man will stand in great boldness before the face of those who afflicted him, and those who make his labors of no account.
target: Den di raichos man wi tan ina griet buolnis bifuo di fies a dem uu aflik im, an dem uu mek im lieba dem a no akount.

en: When they see him, they will be troubled with terrible fear, and will be amazed at the marvel of salvation.
target: Wen dem si im, fier wa teribl wi chrobl dem, an dem wi amiez a di maavl a salvieshan.

en: They will speak among themselves repenting, and for distress of spirit they will groan, “This was he whom we used to hold in derision, as a parable of reproach.
target: Dem wi taak mong demself a ripent, an fi dischres a Spirit dem wi gruon, “Dis a im uu wi yuus tu uol ina dirijan, az a parabl a ripuoch.

en: We fools considered his life madness, and his end without honor.
target: Wi fuul dem kansida im laif madnis, an im en widout ana.

en: How was he counted among sons of God? How is his lot among saints?
target: Ou im kount mong son dem a Gad? Ou im lat de mong uoli wan dem?

en: Truly we went astray from the way of truth. The light of righteousness didn’t shine for us. The sun didn’t rise for us.
target: Chuuli wi go aschrie fram di wie a chuut. Di lait a raichosnis neva shain fi wi. Di son neva raiz fi wi.

en: We took our fill of the paths of lawlessness and destruction. We traveled through trackless deserts, but we didn’t know the Lord’s way.
target: Wi tek wi ful a di paat dem a laalisnis an distrokshan. Wi chravl chuu dezat dem wa av no chrak, bot wi neva nuo di Laads wie.

en: What did our arrogance profit us? What good have riches and boasting brought us?
target: Wa wi arogans prafit wi? Wa gud richiz an buostin bring wi?

en: Those things all passed away as a shadow, like a rumor that runs by,
target: Dem ting aal paas we az a shado, laik a ruuma wa ron bai,

en: like a ship passing through the billowy water, which, when it has gone by, there is no trace to be found, no pathway of its keel in the waves.
target: laik a ship wa a paas chuu di bili waata, wa, wen it gaan bai, no chries no de fi fain, no paatwie a im kiil ina di wiev dem.

en: Or it is like when a bird flies through the air, no evidence of its passage is found, but the light wind, lashed with the stroke of its pinions, and torn apart with the violent rush of the moving wings, is passed through. Afterwards no sign of its coming remains.
target: Ar it laik wen a bord flai chuu di ier, no evidens a im pasij fain, bot di lait win, lash wid di chruok a im pinian dem, an tuor apaat wid di vaiolent rosh a di muuvin wing dem, paas chuu. Afta, no sain a im komin rimien.

en: Or it is like when an arrow is shot at a mark, the air it divided closes up again immediately, so that men don’t know where it passed through.
target: Ar it laik wen a aro shuut a wan maak, di ier wa it divaid kluoz op agen imediately, so man dem no nuo we it paas chuu.

en: So we also, as soon as we were born, ceased to be; and we had no sign of virtue to show, but we were utterly consumed in our wickedness.”
target: So wi tu, az suun az wi baan, wi siiz fi bi; an wi av no sain a vochuu fi shuo, bot wi otli konsyuum ina wi wikidnis.”

en: Because the hope of the ungodly man is like chaff carried by the wind, and as foam vanishing before a tempest; and is scattered like smoke by the wind, and passes by as the remembrance of a guest who stays just a day.
target: Bikaaz di uop a di ongodli man laik chaaf wa di win kyari, an az fuom wa vanish bifuo a tempest; an it skata laik smuok bai di win, an paas bai az di rimembrans a wan ges uu stie jos wan die.

en: But the righteous live forever. Their reward is in the Lord, and the care for them with the Most High.
target: Bot di raichos dem liv fareva. Dem riwaad de ina di Laad, an di kier fi dem de wid di Mos Ai.

en: Therefore they will receive the crown of royal dignity and the diadem of beauty from the Lord’s hand, because he will cover them with his right hand, and he will shield them with his arm.
target: So dem wi get di kroun a raayal digniti an di daiadem a byuuti fram di Laads an, bikaaz im wi kova dem wid im rait an, an im wi shiil dem wid im aam.

en: He will take his zeal as complete armor, and will make the whole creation his weapons to punish his enemies:
target: Im wi tek im ziil az kompliit aama, an wi mek di uol krietion im wepon dem fi ponish im enimi dem:

en: He will put on righteousness as a breastplate, and will wear impartial judgment as a helmet.
target: Im wi put aan raichosnis az a brespliet, an wi wier impaashal jojment az a elmet.

en: He will take holiness as an invincible shield.
target: Im wi tek uolinis az a shiil wa kyaan biit.

en: He will sharpen stern wrath for a sword. The universe will go with him to fight against his frenzied foes.
target: Im wi shaapn storn raat fi a suord. Di yuunivors wi go wid im fi fait agens im frenzi fuo dem.

en: Shafts of lightning will fly with true aim. They will leap to the mark from the clouds, as from a well-drawn bow.
target: Shaaft a laitnin wi flai wid chuu iem. Dem wi liip tu di maak fram di kloud dem, az fram a wel-jraan buo.

en: Hailstones full of wrath will be hurled as from a catapult. The water of the sea will be angered against them. Rivers will sternly overwhelm them.
target: Ielstuon dem ful a raat wi orl az fram a kyatapolt. Di waata a di sii wi anga agens dem. Riva dem wi stornli uovawelm dem.

en: A mighty wind will encounter them. It will winnow them away like a tempest. So lawlessness will make all the land desolate. Their evil-doing will overturn the thrones of princes.
target: A maiti win wi enounta dem. It wi wino dem we laik a tempest. So laalisnis wi mek aal di lan dezolet. Dem iivl-duuin wi uovaton di chruon dem a prins dem.

en: Hear therefore, you kings, and understand. Learn, you judges of the ends of the earth.
target: Ier so den, unu king dem, an andastan. Laan, unu joj dem a di en dem a di ort.

en: Give ear, you rulers who have dominion over many people, and make your boast in multitudes of nations,
target: Gi ier, unu ruula dem uu av dominion uova muos piipl, an mek unu buos ina moltityuud a nieshan dem,

en: because your dominion was given to you from the Lord, and your sovereignty from the Most High. He will search out your works, and will inquire about your plans,
target: bikaaz unu dominion gi tu unu fram di Laad, an unu sovrinti fram di Mos Ai. Im wi sorch out unu wok dem, an wi inkwaiya bout unu plan dem,

en: because being officers of his kingdom, you didn’t judge rightly, nor did you keep the law, nor did you walk according to God’s counsel.
target: bikaaz az afisa dem a im kindom, unu neva joj raitli, nar unu kip di laa, nar unu waak akardin tu Gads kounsl.

en: He will come upon you awfully and swiftly, because a stern judgment comes on those who are in high places.
target: Im wi kom pan unu aafuli an swifli, bikaaz a storn jojment kom pan dem uu de ina ai plies dem.

en: For the man of low estate may be pardoned in mercy, but mighty men will be mightily tested.
target: Kaa di man a luo estiet mait get paadn ina mersi, bot maiti man dem wi get maitili tes.

en: For the Sovereign Lord of all will not be impressed with anyone, neither will he show deference to greatness; because it is he who made both small and great, and cares about them all;
target: Kaa di Sovran Laad a aal wi no impres wid nobadi, niida im wi shuo deferens tu grietnis; bikaaz a im mek buot smaal an griet, an im kier bout dem aal;

en: but the scrutiny that comes upon the powerful is strict.
target: bot di skruutini wa kom pan di powaful dem a strik.

en: Therefore, my words are to you, O princes, that you may learn wisdom and not fall away.
target: So, mi wod dem a tu unu, O prins dem, so unu mait laan wizdam an no faal we.

en: For those who have kept the things that are holy in holiness will be made holy. Those who have been taught them will find what to say in defense.
target: Kaa dem uu kip di ting dem wa uoli ina uolinis wi mek uoli. Dem uu get taat dem wi fain wa fi se ina difens.

en: Therefore set your desire on my words. Long for them, and you princes will be instructed.
target: So set unu dizaya pan mi wod dem. Lang fi dem, an unu prins dem wi get inschrok.

en: Wisdom is radiant and doesn’t fade away; and is easily seen by those who love her, and found by those who seek her.
target: Wizdam riediant an it no fied we; an dem uu lov ar si ar iizi, an dem uu siik ar fain ar.

en: She anticipates those who desire her, making herself known.
target: Shi antisipiet dem uu dizaya ar, a mek arself nuo.

en: He who rises up early to seek her won’t have difficulty, for he will find her sitting at his gates.
target: Uu raiz op orli fi siik ar wi no av difikolti, kaa im wi fain ar a sidong a im giet dem.

en: For to think upon her is perfection of understanding, and he who watches for her will quickly be free from care;
target: Kaa fi ting pan ar a porfekshan a andastandin, an uu waach fi ar wi kwikli frii fram kier;

en: because she herself goes around, seeking those who are worthy of her, and in their paths she appears to them graciously, and in every purpose she meets them.
target: bikaaz shi arself go roun, a siik dem uu worti a ar, an ina dem paat shi apier tu dem grieshosli, an ina evri porpos shi miit dem.

en: For her true beginning is desire for discipline; and desire for discipline is love.
target: Kaa ar chuu biginin a dizaya fi disiplin; an dizaya fi disiplin a lov.

en: And love is observance of her laws. To give heed to her laws confirms incorruption.
target: An lov a obzorvans a ar laa dem. Fi gi iid tu ar laa dem konform inkoropshan.

en: Incorruption brings closeness to God.
target: Inkoropshan bring kluosnis tu Gad.

en: So then desire for wisdom promotes to a kingdom.
target: So den dizaya fi wizdam promuot tu a kindom.

en: If therefore you delight in thrones and sceptres, you princes of peoples, honor wisdom, that you may reign forever.
target: If so unu dilait ina chruon dem an septa dem, unu prins dem a piipl dem, ana wizdam, so unu mait rien fareva.

en: But what wisdom is, and how she came into being, I will declare. I won’t hide mysteries from you; but I will explore from her first beginning, bring the knowledge of her into clear light, and I will not pass by the truth.
target: Bot wa wizdam bi, an ou shi kom ina biin, mi wi diklier. Mi wi no aid mischri dem fram unu; bot mi wi ekspluor fram ar fos biginin, bring di nalij a ar ina klier lait, an mi wi no paas bai di chuut.

en: Indeed, I won’t travel with consuming envy, because envy will have no fellowship with wisdom.
target: Fi chuu, mi wi no chravl wid konsyuumin envi, bikaaz envi wi av no feloship wid wizdam.

en: But a multitude of wise men is salvation to the world, and an understanding king is stability for his people.
target: Bot a moltityuud a waiz man dem a salvieshan tu di worl, an a andastandin king a stabiliti fi im piipl.

en: Therefore be instructed by my words, and you will profit.
target: So get inschrok bai mi wod dem, an unu wi prafit.

en: I myself am also mortal, like everyone else, and am a descendant of one formed first and born of the earth.
target: Mi miself a moortal tu, laik evribadi els, an a disendant a wan uu faam fos an baan a di ort.

en: I molded into flesh in the time of ten months in my mother’s womb, being compacted in blood from the seed of man and pleasure of marriage.
target: Mi muol ina flesh ina di taim a ten mont ina mi mada wuum, a kompak ina blod fram di siid a man an di pleja a marij.

en: I also, when I was born, drew in the common air, and fell upon the kindred earth, uttering, like all, for my first voice, the same cry.
target: Mi tu, wen mi baan, jraa in di kaman ier, an faal pan di kindred ort, a ota, laik aal, fi mi fos vais, di siem krai.

en: I was nursed with care in swaddling clothes.
target: Dem nors mi wid kier ina swadlin kluoz dem.

en: For no king had a different beginning,
target: Kaa no king av a difrent biginin,

en: but all men have one entrance into life, and a common departure.
target: bot aal man av wan entrans ina laif, an a kaman dipaacha.

en: For this cause I prayed, and understanding was given to me. I asked, and a spirit of wisdom came to me.
target: Fi dis kaaz mi kaal pan, an andastandin gi tu mi. Mi aks, an a Spirit a wizdam kom tu mi.

en: I preferred her before sceptres and thrones. I considered riches nothing in comparison to her.
target: Mi prifo ar bifuo septa dem an chruon dem. Mi kansida richiz notn ina komparison tu ar.

en: Neither did I liken to her any priceless gem, because all gold in her presence is a little sand, and silver will be considered as clay before her.
target: Niida mi laikn eni praislis jem tu ar, bikaaz aal guol ina ar prezens a likl san, an silva wi kansida az klie bifuo ar.

en: I loved her more than health and beauty, and I chose to have her rather than light, because her bright shining is never laid to sleep.
target: Mi lov ar muo dan elt an byuuti, an mi chuuz fi av ar raada dan lait, bikaaz ar brait shainin neva lei tu sliip.

en: All good things came to me with her, and innumerable riches are in her hands.
target: Aal gud ting dem kom tu mi wid ar, an richiz wa kyaan kount de ina ar an dem.

en: And I rejoiced over them all because wisdom leads them; although I didn’t know that she was their mother.
target: An mi rijois uova dem aal bikaaz wizdam liid dem; duo mi neva nuo se shi a dem mada.

en: As I learned without guile, I impart without grudging. I don’t hide her riches.
target: Az mi laan widout gail, mi impaat widout grojin. Mi no aid ar richiz.

en: For she is a treasure for men that doesn’t fail, and those who use it obtain friendship with God, commended by the gifts which they present through discipline.
target: Kaa shi a wan chreja fi man dem wa no fiel, an dem uu yuuz it abtien frenship wid Gad, komend bai di gif dem wa dem prezent chuu disiplin.

en: But may God grant that I may speak his judgment, and to conceive thoughts worthy of what has been given me; because he is one who guides even wisdom and who corrects the wise.
target: Bot mie Gad grant se mi mait spiik im jojment, an kansiiv taat dem worti a wa gi tu mi; bikaaz im a wan uu gaid iivn wizdam an uu korek di waiz dem.

en: For both we and our words are in his hand, with all understanding and skill in various crafts.
target: Kaa buot wi an wi wod dem de ina im an, wid aal andastandin an skil ina vierios kraaf dem.

en: For he himself gave me an unerring knowledge of the things that are, to know the structure of the universe and the operation of the elements;
target: Kaa im imself gi mi an onerin nalij a di ting dem wa de, fi nuo di schrokcha a di yuunivors an di oprieshan a di eliment dem;

en: the beginning, end, and middle of times; the alternations of the solstices and the changes of seasons;
target: di biginin, en, an migl a taim dem; di altanieshan dem a di solstis dem an di chienj dem a siizn dem;

en: the circuits of years and the positions of stars;
target: di sorkit dem a ier dem an di pozishan dem a staar dem;

en: the natures of living creatures and the raging of wild beasts; the violence of winds and the thoughts of men; the diversities of plants and the powers of roots.
target: di niecha dem a livin kriicha dem an di riejin a wail biis dem; di vaiolens a win dem an di taat dem a man dem; di daivorsiti dem a plaant dem an di powa dem a ruut dem.

en: All things that are either secret or manifest I learned,
target: Aal ting wa siikrit ar manifes mi laan,

en: for wisdom, that is the craftsman of all things, taught me. For there is in her a spirit that is quick to understand, holy, unique, manifold, subtle, freely moving, clear in utterance, unpolluted, distinct, invulnerable, loving what is good, keen, unhindered,
target: kaa wizdam, wa a di kraafsman a aal ting, taat mi. Kaa ina ar a Spirit de wa kwik fi andastan, uoli, yuuniik, manifuol, sotl, friili muuvin, klier ina otarans, onpolyutid, distink, invulnerabl, lovin wa gud, kiin, oninda,

en: beneficent, loving toward man, steadfast, sure, free from care, all-powerful, all-surveying, and penetrating through all spirits that are quick to understand, pure, most subtle.
target: benefisent, lovin tuwaad man, stedfaas, shuur, frii fram kier, aal-powaful, aal-sorvein, an penetrietin chuu aal Spirit dem wa kwik fi andastan, pyuur, muos sotl.

en: For wisdom is more mobile than any motion. Yes, she pervades and penetrates all things by reason of her purity.
target: Kaa wizdam muo muobail dan eni muoshan. Yes, shi porvied an penetriet aal ting bikaaz a ar pyuuriti.

en: For she is a breath of the power of God, and a pure emanation of the glory of the Almighty. Therefore nothing defiled can find entrance into her.
target: Kaa shi a wan bret a di powa a Gad, an a pyuur emanieshan a di gluori a di Olmaiti. So notn defail kyaan fain entrans ina ar.

en: For she is a reflection of everlasting light, an unspotted mirror of the working of God, and an image of his goodness.
target: Kaa shi a wan riflekshan a evaalastin lait, a onspotid mira a di wokin a Gad, an a imij a im gudnis.

en: Although she is one, she has power to do all things. Remaining in herself, she renews all things. From generation to generation passing into holy souls, she makes friends of God and prophets.
target: Duo shi a wan, shi av powa fi du aal ting. A rimien ina arself, shi rinyuu aal ting. Fram jenarieshan tu jenarieshan a paas ina uoli suol dem, shi mek fren dem a Gad an prafit dem.

en: For God loves nothing as much as one who dwells with wisdom.
target: Kaa Gad lov notn az moch az wan uu dwel wid wizdam.

en: For she is fairer than the sun, and above all the constellations of the stars. She is better than light.
target: Kaa shi fiera dan di son, an abov aal di konstelieshan dem a di staar dem. Shi beta dan lait.

en: For daylight yields to night, but evil does not prevail against wisdom.
target: Kaa dielait gi wie tu nait, bot iivl no priviel agens wizdam.

en: But she reaches from one end to the other with full strength, and orders all things well.
target: Bot shi riich fram wan en tu di ada wid ful chrent, an aada aal ting wel.

en: I loved her and sought her from my youth. I sought to take her for my bride. I became enamoured by her beauty.
target: Mi lov ar an saat ar fram mi yuut. Mi saat fi tek ar fi mi braid. Mi get enamor bai ar byuuti.

en: She glorifies her noble birth by living with God. The Sovereign Lord of all loves her.
target: Shi gluorifai ar nuobl bort bai livin wid Gad. Di Sovran Laad a aal lov ar.

en: For she is initiated into the knowledge of God, and she chooses his works.
target: Kaa shi inishiet ina di nalij a Gad, an shi chuuz im wok dem.

en: But if riches are a desired possession in life, what is richer than wisdom, which makes all things?
target: Bot if richiz a wan dizaya pozeshan ina laif, wa rich a dan wizdam, wa mek aal ting?

en: And if understanding is effective, who more than wisdom is a craftsman of the things that exist?
target: An if andastandin efektif, uu muo dan wizdam a kraafsman a di ting dem wa egzis?

en: If a man loves righteousness, the fruits of wisdom’s labor are virtues, for she teaches soberness, understanding, righteousness, and courage. There is nothing in life more profitable for people than these.
target: If man lov raichosnis, di fruut dem a wizdam lieba a vochuu dem, kaa shi tiich suobanis, andastandin, raichosnis, an korij. Notn ina laif no muo prafitabl fi piipl dan dem ya.

en: And if anyone longs for wide experience, she knows the things of old, and infers the things to come. She understands subtleties of speeches and interpretations of dark sayings. She foresees signs and wonders, and the issues of seasons and times.
target: An if eniwan lang fi waid ekspiriens, shi nuo di ting dem a uol, an info di ting dem fi kom. Shi andastan sotlti dem a spiich dem an intapritieshan dem a daak seyin dem. Shi fuosii sain dem an wanda dem, an di ishuu dem a siizn dem an taim dem.

en: Therefore I determined to take her to live with me, knowing that she is one who would give me good counsel, and encourage me in cares and grief.
target: So mi ditermin fi tek ar fi liv wid mi, a nuo se shi a wan uu wuda gi mi gud kounsl, an enkorij mi ina kier dem an griif.

en: Because of her, I will have glory among multitudes, and honor in the sight of elders, though I am young.
target: Bikaaz a ar, mi wi av gluori mong moltityuud dem, an ana ina di sait a elda dem, duo mi yong.

en: I will be found keen when I give judgment. I will be admired in the presence of rulers.
target: Dem wi fain mi kiin wen mi gi jojment. Dem wi admaiya mi ina di prezens a ruula dem.

en: When I am silent, they will wait for me. When I open my lips, they will heed what I say. If I continue speaking, they will put their hands on their mouths.
target: Wen mi sailent, dem wi wiet fi mi. Wen mi uopn mi lip dem, dem wi iid wa mi se. If mi kontinyuu spiikin, dem wi put dem an pan dem mout.

en: Because of her, I will have immortality, and leave behind an eternal memory to those who come after me.
target: Bikaaz a ar, mi wi av imoortaliti, an lef bihaind a itoornal memri tu dem uu kom afta mi.

en: I will govern peoples. Nations will be subjected to me.
target: Mi wi govaan piipl dem. Nieshan dem wi get sobjek tu mi.

en: Dreaded monarchs will fear me when they hear of me. Among the people, I will show myself to be good, and courageous in war.
target: Jred monaak dem wi fier mi wen dem ier bout mi. Mong di piipl, mi wi shuo miself fi bi gud, an koriejos ina waar.

en: When I come into my house, I will find rest with her. For conversation with her has no bitterness, and living with her has no pain, but gladness and joy.
target: Wen mi kom ina mi ous, mi wi fain res wid ar. Kaa kanvasieshan wid ar av no bitanis, an livin wid ar av no pien, bot gladnis an jai.

en: When I considered these things in myself, and thought in my heart how immortality is in kinship to wisdom,
target: Wen mi kansida dem ting ya ina miself, an taat ina mi aat ou imoortaliti de ina kinship tu wizdam,

en: and in her friendship is good delight, and in the labors of her hands is wealth that doesn’t fail, and understanding is in her companionship, and great renown in having fellowship with her words, I went about seeking how to take her to myself.
target: an ina ar frenship a gud dilait, an ina di lieba dem a ar an dem a welt wa no fiel, an andastandin de ina ar kompaniansip, an griet rinoun ina avin feloship wid ar wod dem, mi go bout a siik ou fi tek ar tu miself.

en: Now I was a clever child, and received a good soul.
target: Nou mi a wan kleva pikni, an get a gud suol.

en: Or rather, being good, I came into an undefiled body.
target: Ar raada, az mi gud, mi kom ina a ondefail badi.

en: But perceiving that I could not otherwise possess wisdom unless God gave her to me— yes, and to know and understand by whom the grace is given— I pleaded with the Lord and implored him, and with my whole heart I said:
target: Bot az mi posiivi se mi kudn adawaiz poses wizdam onles Gad gi ar tu mi— yes, an fi nuo an andastan bai uum di gries gi— mi pliid wid di Laad an impluor im, an wid mi uol aat mi se:

en: “O God of my ancestors and Lord of mercy, who made all things by your word;
target: “O Gad a mi ansesta dem an Laad a mersi, uu mek aal ting bai yu wod;

en: and by your wisdom you formed man, that he should have dominion over the creatures that were made by you,
target: an bai yu wizdam yu faam man, so im shuda av dominion uova di kriicha dem wa yu mek,

en: and rule the world in holiness and righteousness, and execute judgment in uprightness of soul,
target: an ruul di worl ina uolinis an raichosnis, an egzikyuut jojment ina opraitnis a suol,

en: give me wisdom, her who sits by you on your thrones. Don’t reject me from among your servants,
target: gi mi wizdam, ar uu sidong bai yu pan yu chruon dem. No rijek mi fram mong yu sorvant dem,

en: because I am your servant and the son of your handmaid, a weak and short-lived man, with little power to understand judgment and laws.
target: bikaaz mi a yu sorvant an di son a yu anmied, a wiik man wa laif shaat, wid likl powa fi andastan jojment an laa dem.

en: For even if a man is perfect among the sons of men, if the wisdom that comes from you is not with him, he will count for nothing.
target: Kaa iivn if man porfek mong di son dem a man dem, if di wizdam wa kom fram yu no de wid im, im wi kount fi notn.

en: You chose me to be king of your people, and a judge for your sons and daughters.
target: Yu chuuz mi fi bi king a yu piipl, an a joj fi yu son dem an daata dem.

en: You gave a command to build a sanctuary on your holy mountain, and an altar in the city where you live, a copy of the holy tent which you prepared from the beginning.
target: Yu gi a komaan fi bil a sankchuari pan yu uoli mountn, an a aalta ina di siti we yu liv, a kapi a di uoli tent wa yu pripier fram di biginin.

en: Wisdom is with you and knows your works, and was present when you were making the world, and understands what is pleasing in your eyes, and what is right according to your commandments.
target: Wizdam de wid yu an nuo yu wok dem, an de de wen yu a mek di worl, an andastan wa pliizin ina yu yai dem, an wa rait akardin tu yu komaanment dem.

en: Send her from the holy heavens, and ask her to come from the throne of your glory, that being present with me she may work, and I may learn what pleases you well.
target: Sen ar fram di uoli evn dem, an aks ar fi kom fram di chruon a yu gluori, so az shi de wid mi shi mait wok, an mi mait laan wa pliiz yu wel.

en: For she knows all things and understands, and she will guide me prudently in my actions. She will guard me in her glory.
target: Kaa shi nuo aal ting an andastan, an shi wi gaid mi pruudentli ina mi akshan dem. Shi wi gyaad mi ina ar gluori.

en: So my works will be acceptable. I will judge your people righteously, and I will be worthy of my father’s throne.
target: So mi wok dem wi akseptabl. Mi wi joj yu piipl raichosli, an mi wi worti a mi faada chruon.

en: For what man will know the counsel of God? Or who will conceive what the Lord wills?
target: Kaa wa man wi nuo di kounsl a Gad? Ar uu wi kansiiv wa di Laad wil?

en: For the thoughts of mortals are unstable, and our plans are prone to fail.
target: Kaa di taat dem a moortal dem onstiebl, an wi plan dem pruon fi fiel.

en: For a perishable body weighs down the soul. The earthy tent burdens a mind that is full of cares.
target: Kaa a perishabl badi wie doun di suol. Di orti tent borden a main wa ful a kier dem.

en: We can hardly guess the things that are on earth, and we find the things that are close at hand with labor; but who has traced out the things that are in the heavens?
target: Wi kyaan aarly ges di ting dem wa de pan ort, an wi fain di ting dem wa kluos a an wid lieba; bot uu don chries out di ting dem wa de ina di evn dem?

en: Who gained knowledge of your counsel, unless you gave wisdom, and sent your holy spirit from on high?
target: Uu gien nalij a yu kounsl, onles yu gi wizdam, an sen yu uoli Spirit fram pan ai?

en: It was thus that the ways of those who are on earth were corrected, and men were taught the things that are pleasing to you. They were saved through wisdom.”
target: A so di wie dem a dem uu de pan ort get korek, an man dem get taat di ting dem wa pliizin tu yu. Dem get siev chuu wizdam.”

en: Wisdom guarded to the end the first formed father of the world, who was created alone, and delivered him out of his own transgression,
target: Wizdam gyaad tu di en di fos-faam faada a di worl, uu kriet aluon, an diliva im outa im uon chransgreshan,

en: and gave him strength to rule over all things.
target: an gi im chrent fi ruul uova aal ting.

en: But when an unrighteous man fell away from her in his anger, he perished himself in the rage with which he killed his brother.
target: Bot wen a onraichos man faal we fram ar ina im anga, im perish imself ina di riej wid wa im kil im breda.

en: When for his cause the earth was drowning with a flood, wisdom again saved it, guiding the righteous man’s course by a paltry piece of wood.
target: Wen fi im kaaz di ort a jroun wid a flod, wizdam siev it agen, a gaid di raichos man kuors bai a paaltri piis a wud.

en: Moreover, when nations consenting together in wickedness had been confounded, wisdom knew the righteous man, and preserved him blameless to God, and kept him strong when his heart yearned toward his child.
target: Muuova, wen nieshan dem a kansent tugeda ina wikidnis get konfound, wizdam nuo di raichos man, an prizorv im blemlis tu Gad, an kip im chrang wen im aat yorn tuwaad im pikni.

en: While the ungodly were perishing, wisdom delivered a righteous man, when he fled from the fire that descended out of heaven on the five cities.
target: Wail di ongodli dem a perish, wizdam diliva a raichos man, wen im ron we fram di faiya wa disen outa evn pan di faiv siti dem.

en: To whose wickedness a smoking waste still witnesses, and plants bearing fair fruit that doesn’t ripen, a disbelieving person has a memorial: a standing pillar of salt.
target: Tu uu wikidnis a smuokin wies stil witnis, an plaant dem wa bier fier fruut wa no raip, a disbiliivin porsn av a memorial: a tandin pila a saalt.

en: For having passed wisdom by, not only were they disabled from recognising the things which are good, but they also left behind them for their life a monument of their folly, to the end that where they stumbled, they might fail even to be unseen;
target: Kaa az dem paas wizdam bai, no uonli dem disable fram rekonnaiz di ting dem wa gud, bot dem lef bihaind dem fi dem laif a monyument a dem foli tu, tu di en se we dem stombl, dem mait fiel iivn fi go onsiin;

en: but wisdom delivered those who waited on her out of troubles.
target: bot wizdam diliva dem uu wiet pan ar outa chrobl dem.

en: When a righteous man was a fugitive from a brother’s wrath, wisdom guided him in straight paths. She showed him God’s kingdom, and gave him knowledge of holy things. She prospered him in his toils, and multiplied the fruits of his labor.
target: Wen a raichos man a fyujitiv fram a breda raat, wizdam gaid im ina schriet paat dem. Shi shuo im Gads kindom, an gi im nalij a uoli ting dem. Shi prasper im ina im tail dem, an moltiplai di fruut dem a im lieba.

en: When in their covetousness men dealt harshly with him, she stood by him and made him rich.
target: Wen ina dem kovetosnis man dem diil aashli wid im, shi tan bai im an mek im rich.

en: She guarded him from enemies, and she kept him safe from those who lay in wait. Over his severe conflict, she watched as judge, that he might know that godliness is more powerful than every one.
target: Shi gyaad im fram enimi dem, an shi kip im sief fram dem uu lai ina wiet. Uova im sevier konflik, shi waach az joj, so im mait nuo se uolinis muo powaful dan evriwan.

en: When a righteous man was sold, wisdom didn’t forsake him, but she delivered him from sin. She went down with him into a dungeon,
target: Wen a raichos man get suol, wizdam neva fosiek im, bot shi diliva im fram sin. Shi go doun wid im ina a donjan,

en: and in bonds she didn’t depart from him, until she brought him the sceptre of a kingdom, and authority over those that dealt like a tyrant with him. She also showed those who had mockingly accused him to be false, and gave him eternal glory.
target: an ina banz shi neva lef im, til shi bring im di septa a wan kindom, an atariti uova dem uu diil laik a tairant wid im. Shi shuo tu dem uu mak ingli akyuuz im fi bi faals, an gi im itoornal gluori.

en: Wisdom delivered a holy people and a blameless seed from a nation of oppressors.
target: Wizdam diliva a uoli piipl an a blemlis siid fram a nieshan a opresa dem.

en: She entered into the soul of a servant of the Lord, and withstood terrible kings in wonders and signs.
target: Shi enta ina di suol a wan sorvant a di Laad, an widstan teribl king dem ina wanda dem an sain dem.

en: She rendered to holy men a reward of their toils. She guided them along a marvelous way, and became to them a covering in the day-time, and a starry flame through the night.
target: Shi renda tu uoli man dem a riwaad a dem tail dem. Shi gaid dem alang a maavilos wie, an ton tu dem a kovarin ina di die-taim, an a staari fliem chuu di nait.

en: She brought them over the Red sea, and led them through much water;
target: Shi bring dem uova di Red Sii, an led dem chuu moch waata;

en: but she drowned their enemies, and she cast them up from the bottom of the deep.
target: bot shi jroun dem enimi dem, an shi kyaas dem op fram di batom a di diip.

en: Therefore the righteous plundered the ungodly, and they sang praise to your holy name, O Lord, and extolled with one accord your hand that fought for them,
target: So di raichos dem plonda di ongodli dem, an dem sing priez tu yu uoli niem, O Laad, an ekstuol wid wan akaad yu an wa fait fi dem,

en: because wisdom opened the mouth of the mute, and made the tongues of babes to speak clearly.
target: bikaaz wizdam uopn di mout a di myuut, an mek di tong dem a biebi dem spiik klierli.

en: Wisdom prospered their works in the hand of a holy prophet.
target: Wizdam prasper dem wok dem ina di an a wan uoli prafit.

en: They traveled through a desert without inhabitant, and they pitched their tents in trackless regions.
target: Dem chravl chuu a dezat widout inabitant, an dem pich dem tent dem ina rieshan dem wa av no chrak.

en: They withstood enemies and repelled foes.
target: Dem widstan enimi dem an ripel fuo dem.

en: They thirsted, and they called upon you, and water was given to them out of the flinty rock, and healing of their thirst out of the hard stone.
target: Dem torsti, an dem kaal pan yu, an waata gi tu dem outa di flinti rak, an iilin a dem torst outa di aad stuon.

en: For by what things their foes were punished, by these they in their need were benefited.
target: Kaa bai wa ting dem dem fuo dem get ponish, bai dem ya dem ina dem niid get benefit.

en: When enemies were troubled with clotted blood instead of a river’s ever-flowing fountain,
target: Wen enimi dem chrobl wid klotid blod insted a wan riva eva-flouin fountain,

en: to rebuke the decree for the slaying of babies, you gave them abundant water beyond all hope,
target: fi ribyuuk di dikrii fi di sliein a biebi dem, yu gi dem abondant waata biyan aal uop,

en: having shown by the thirst which they had suffered how you punished the adversaries.
target: az yu shuo bai di torst wa dem sofa ou yu ponish di adveseri dem.

en: For when they were tried, although disciplined in mercy, they learned how the ungodly were tormented, being judged with wrath.
target: Kaa wen dem get chrai, duo dem disiplin ina mersi, dem laan ou di ongodli dem get taament, a joj wid raat.

en: For you tested these as a father admonishing them; but you searched out those as a stern king condemning them.
target: Kaa yu tes dem ya az a faada a admonish dem; bot yu sorch out dem de az a storn king a kondem dem.

en: Yes and whether they were far off or near, they were equally distressed;
target: Yes an weda dem faar af ar nier, dem dischres iikwali;

en: for a double grief seized them, and a groaning at the memory of things past.
target: kaa a dobl griif siiz dem, an a gruonin a di memri a ting dem wa paas.

en: For when they heard that through their own punishments the others benefited, they recognized the Lord.
target: Kaa wen dem ier se chuu dem uon ponishment dem di ada dem benefit, dem rekonnaiz di Laad.

en: For him who long before was thrown out and exposed they stopped mocking. In the end of what happened, they marveled, having thirsted in another manner than the righteous.
target: Kaa im uu lang bifuo get chruo out an ekspuoz dem tap mak. Ina di en a wa apn, dem maavl, az dem torsti ina anada mana dan di raichos dem.

en: But in return for the senseless imaginings of their unrighteousness, by which they were led astray to worship irrational reptiles and wretched vermin, you sent upon them a multitude of irrational creatures to punish them,
target: Bot ina ritoorn fi di senslis imajinin dem a dem onraichosnis, bai wa dem get led aschrie fi woship irashanal reptail dem an rechid voormin, yu sen pan dem a moltityuud a irashanal kriicha dem fi ponish dem,

en: that they might learn that by what things a man sins, by these he is punished.
target: so dem mait laan se bai wa ting dem man sin, bai dem ya im get ponish.

en: For your all-powerful hand that created the world out of formless matter didn’t lack means to send upon them a multitude of bears, fierce lions,
target: Kaa yu aal-powaful an wa kriet di worl outa faamlis mata neva lak miinz fi sen pan dem a moltityuud a bier dem, fiers laian dem,

en: or newly-created and unknown wild beasts, full of rage, either breathing out a blast of fiery breath, or belching out smoke, or flashing dreadful sparks from their eyes;
target: ar nyuu-krietid an onnuo wail biis dem, ful a riej, aida a briit out a blaas a faiyari bret, ar a belch out smuok, ar a flash jredful spaak dem fram dem yai dem;

en: which had power not only to consume them by their violence, but to destroy them even by the terror of their sight.
target: wa av powa no uonli fi konsyuum dem bai dem vaiolens, bot fi distrai dem iivn bai di tero a dem sait.

en: Yes and without these they might have fallen by a single breath, being pursued by justice, and scattered abroad by the breath of your power; but you arranged all things by measure, number, and weight.
target: Yes an widout dem ya dem mait faal bai wan singl bret, a get porsyuu bai jostis, an skata abraad bai di bret a yu powa; bot yu arienj aal ting bai meja, nomba, an wiet.

en: For to be greatly strong is yours at all times. Who could withstand the might of your arm?
target: Kaa fi bi grietli chrang a yuors a aal taim. Uu kud widstan di mait a yu aam?

en: Because the whole world before you is as a grain in a balance, and as a drop of dew that comes down upon the earth in the morning.
target: Bikaaz di uol worl bifuo yu a az wan grien ina wan balens, an az wan jrap a dyuu wa kom doun pan di ort ina di maanin.

en: But you have mercy on all men, because you have power to do all things, and you overlook the sins of men to the end that they may repent.
target: Bot yu av mersi pan aal man, bikaaz yu av powa fi du aal ting, an yu uovaluk di sin dem a man dem tu di en se dem mait ripent.

en: For you love all things that are, and abhor none of the things which you made; for you never would have formed anything if you hated it.
target: Kaa yu lov aal ting wa de, an abor non a di ting dem wa yu mek; kaa yu neva wuda faam notn if yu iet it.

en: How would anything have endured unless you had willed it? Or that which was not called by you, how would it have been preserved?
target: Ou eniting wuda endyuur onles yu wil it? Ar da wa yu no kaal, ou it wuda prizorv?

en: But you spare all things, because they are yours, O Sovereign Lord, you who love the living.
target: Bot yu spier aal ting, bikaaz dem a yuors, O Sovran Laad, yu uu lov di livin dem.

en: For your incorruptible spirit is in all things.
target: Kaa yu inkoroptibl Spirit de ina aal ting.

en: Therefore you convict little by little those who fall from the right way, and, reminding them by the things by which they sin, you admonish them, that escaping from their wickedness they may believe in you, O Lord.
target: So yu konvik likl bai likl dem uu faal fram di rait wie, an, a rimain dem bai di ting dem bai wa dem sin, yu admonish dem, so az dem eskiep fram dem wikidnis dem mait biliiv ina yu, O Laad.

en: For truly the old inhabitants of your holy land,
target: Kaa chuuli di uol inabitant dem a yu uoli lan,

en: hating them because they practiced detestable works of enchantments and unholy rites—
target: a iet dem bikaaz dem praktis ditesabl wok dem a enchaanment dem an onuoli rait dem—

en: merciless slaughters of children and sacrificial banquets of men’s flesh and of blood—
target: mersilis slaata dem a pikni dem an sakrifishal bankwet dem a man dem flesh an a blod—

en: allies in a fellowship, and murderers of their own helpless babes, it was your counsel to destroy by the hands of our fathers;
target: alai dem ina wan feloship, an modara dem a dem uon elplis biebi dem, a yu kounsl it ben fi distrai bai di an dem a wi faada dem;

en: that the land which in your sight is most precious of all might receive a worthy colony of God’s servants.
target: so di lan wa ina yu sait a muos preshos a aal mait get a worti kalani a Gads sorvant dem.

en: Nevertheless you even spared these as men, and you sent hornets as forerunners of your army, to cause them to perish little by little.
