target: Nedales yu spier iivn dem ya az man dem, an yu sen aanit dem az fuorona dem a yu aami, fi kaaz dem fi perish likl bai likl.

en: Not that you were unable to subdue the ungodly under the hand of the righteous in battle, or by terrible beasts or by a stern word to make away with them at once,
target: No se yu neva iebl fi sobdyuu di ongodli dem anda di an a di raichos dem ina bakl, ar bai teribl biis dem ar bai a storn wod fi mek we wid dem wan taim,

en: but judging them little by little you gave them a chance to repent, not being ignorant that their nature by birth was evil, their wickedness inborn, and that their manner of thought would never be changed.
target: bot a joj dem likl bai likl yu gi dem a chans fi ripent, no biin ignarant se dem niecha bai bort a iivl, dem wikidnis inbaan, an se dem mana a taat wuda neva chienj.

en: For they were a cursed seed from the beginning. It wasn’t through fear of any that you left them unpunished for their sins.
target: Kaa dem a wan kors siid fram di biginin. A no chuu fier a nobadi yu lef dem onponish fi dem sin dem.

en: For who will say, “What have you done?” Or “Who will withstand your judgment?” Who will accuse you for the perishing of nations which you caused? Or who will come and stand before you as an avenger for unrighteous men?
target: Kaa uu wi se, “Wa yu don du?” Ar “Uu wi widstan yu jojment?” Uu wi akyuuz yu fi di perishin a nieshan dem wa yu kaaz? Ar uu wi kom an tan bifuo yu az a avenja fi onraichos man dem?

en: For there isn’t any God beside you that cares for all, that you might show that you didn’t judge unrighteously.
target: Kaa no Gad no de baisaida yu wa kier fi aal, se yu mait shuo se yu neva joj onraichosli.

en: No king or prince will be able to confront you about those whom you have punished.
target: No king ar prins wi iebl fi konfront yu bout dem uu yu ponish.

en: But being righteous, you rule all things righteously, deeming it a thing alien from your power to condemn one who doesn’t deserve to be punished.
target: Bot az yu raichos, yu ruul aal ting raichosli, a diim it a ting elien fram yu powa fi kondem wan uu no dizorv fi get ponish.

en: For your strength is the source of righteousness, and your sovereignty over all makes you to forbear all.
target: Kaa yu chrent a di suors a raichosnis, an yu sovrinti uova aal mek yu forbier aal.

en: For when men don’t believe that you are perfect in power, you show your strength, and in dealing with those who think this, you confuse their boldness.
target: Kaa wen man dem no biliiv se yu porfek ina powa, yu shuo yu chrent, an ina diilin wid dem uu ting dis, yu konfyuuz dem buolnis.

en: But you, being sovereign in strength, judge in gentleness, and with great forbearance you govern us; for the power is yours whenever you desire it.
target: Bot yu, az yu sovrin ina chrent, joj ina jentlnis, an wid griet forbierans yu govaan wi; kaa di powa a yuors wenever yu dizaya it.

en: But you taught your people by such works as these, how the righteous must be kind. You made your sons to have good hope, because you give repentance when men have sinned.
target: Bot yu taat yu piipl bai soch wok dem az dem ya, ou di raichos mos bi kain. Yu mek yu son dem av gud uop, bikaaz yu gi ripentans wen man dem don sin.

en: For if on those who were enemies of your servants and deserving of death, you took vengeance with so great deliberation and indulgence, giving them times and opportunities when they might escape from their wickedness,
target: Kaa if pan dem uu a enimi dem a yu sorvant dem an dizorvin a det, yu tek venjans wid so griet deliberieshan an indoljens, a gi dem taim dem an apachuniti dem wen dem mait eskiep fram dem wikidnis,

en: with how great care you judged your sons, to whose fathers you gave oaths and covenants of good promises!
target: wid ou griet kier yu joj yu son dem, tu uu faada dem yu gi uot dem an kovnant dem a gud pramis dem!

en: Therefore while you discipline us, you scourge our enemies ten thousand times more, to the intent that we may ponder your goodness when we judge, and when we are judged may look for mercy.
target: So wail yu disiplin wi, yu skorj wi enimi dem ten touzn taim muo, tu di intent se wi mait panda yu gudnis wen wi joj, an wen wi get joj wi mait luk fi mersi.

en: Therefore also the unrighteous that lived in a life of folly, you tormented through their own detestable things.
target: So tu di onraichos dem wa liv ina a laif a foli, yu taament chuu dem uon ditesabl ting dem.

en: For truly they went astray very far in the ways of error, taking as gods those animals which even among their enemies were held in dishonor, deceived like foolish babes.
target: Kaa chuuli dem go aschrie veri faar ina di wie dem a ero, a tek az iladem dem animal dem wa iivn mong dem enimi dem get uol ina disana, a get disiiv laik fuulish biebi dem.

en: Therefore, as to unreasoning children, you sent your judgment to mock them.
target: So, az tu onriiznin pikni dem, yu sen yu jojment fi mak dem.

en: But those who would not be admonished by mild correction will experience the deserved judgment of God.
target: Bot dem uu wudn get admonish bai mail korection wi ekspiriens di dizorv jojment a Gad.

en: For through the sufferings they were indignant of, being punished in these creatures which they supposed to be gods, they saw and recognized as the true God him whom they previously refused to know. Therefore also the result of extreme condemnation came upon them.
target: Kaa chuu di sofarin dem dem a indignant a, a get ponish ina dem kriicha dem wa dem supuoz fi bi iladem, dem si an rekonnaiz az di chuu Gad im uu dem priiviosli rifyuuz fi nuo. So tu di rizolt a ekschriim kondemnieshan kom pan dem.

en: For truly all men who had no perception of God were foolish by nature, and didn’t gain power to know him who exists from the good things that are seen. They didn’t recognize the craftsman from his works.
target: Kaa chuuli aal man dem uu av no posepshan a Gad a fuulish bai niecha, an neva gien powa fi nuo im uu egzis fram di gud ting dem wa dem si. Dem neva rekonnaiz di kraafsman fram im wok dem.

en: But they thought that either fire, or wind, or swift air, or circling stars, or raging water, or luminaries of heaven were gods that rule the world.
target: Bot dem taat se aida faiya, ar win, ar swif ier, ar sorklin staar dem, ar riejin waata, ar lyuuminari dem a evn a iladem wa ruul di worl.

en: If it was through delight in their beauty that they took them to be gods, let them know how much better their Sovereign Lord is than these, for the first author of beauty created them.
target: If a chuu dilait ina dem byuuti dem tek dem fi bi iladem, mek dem nuo ou moch beta dem Sovran Laad a dan dem ya, kaa di fos aata a byuuti kriet dem.

en: But if it was through astonishment at their power and influence, then let them understand from them how much more powerful he who formed them is.
target: Bot if a chuu astanishment a dem powa an influens, den mek dem andastan fram dem ou moch muo powaful im uu faam dem bi.

en: For from the greatness of the beauty of created things, mankind forms the corresponding perception of their Maker.
target: Kaa fram di grietnis a di byuuti a krietid ting dem, mankaind faam di korrespondin posepshan a dem Mieka.

en: But yet for these men there is but small blame, for they too perhaps go astray while they are seeking God and desiring to find him.
target: Bot yet fi dem man ya a smaal bliem de uonli, kaa dem tu poraps go aschrie wail dem a siik Gad an a dizaya fi fain im.

en: For they diligently search while living among his works, and they trust their sight that the things that they look at are beautiful.
target: Kaa dem dilijentli sorch wail dem a liv mong im wok dem, an dem chros dem sait se di ting dem wa dem luk pan a byuutiful.

en: But again even they are not to be excused.
target: Bot agen iivn dem no fi get ekskyuuz.

en: For if they had power to know so much, that they should be able to explore the world, how is it that they didn’t find the Sovereign Lord sooner?
target: Kaa if dem av powa fi nuo so moch, se dem shuda iebl fi ekspluor di worl, ou it se dem neva fain di Sovran Laad suuna?

en: But they were miserable, and their hopes were in dead things, who called them gods which are works of men’s hands, gold and silver, skillfully made, and likenesses of animals, or a useless stone, the work of an ancient hand.
target: Bot dem a mizrabl, an dem uop dem de ina ded ting dem, uu kaal dem iladem wa a wok dem a man dem an dem, guol an silva, skilfuli mek, an laiknis dem a animal dem, ar a yuuslis stuon, di wok a wan ienshent an.

en: Yes and some woodcutter might saw down a tree that is easily moved, skillfully strip away all its bark, and fashion it in attractive form, make a useful vessel to serve his life’s needs.
target: Yes an wan wudkota mait saa doun a chrii wa iizi fi muuv, skilfuli schrip we aal im baak, an fashan it ina atrakiv faam, mek a yuusful vesl fi sorv im laif niid dem.

en: Burning the scraps from his handiwork to cook his food, he eats his fill.
target: A bon di skrap dem fram im andiwok fi kuk im fuud, im iit im ful.

en: Taking a discarded scrap which served no purpose, a crooked piece of wood and full of knots, he carves it with the diligence of his idleness, and shapes it by the skill of his idleness. He shapes it in the image of a man,
target: A tek a diskaadid skrap wa sorv no porpos, a krukid piis a wud an ful a nat dem, im kaav it wid di dilijens a im aidlnis, an shiep it bai di skil a im aidlnis. Im shiep it ina di imij a wan man,

en: or makes it like some worthless animal, smearing it with something red, painting it red, and smearing over every stain in it.
target: ar mek it laik wan wortlis animal, a smier it wid sitn red, a pient it red, an a smier uova evri stien ina it.

en: Having made a worthy chamber for it, he sets it in a wall, securing it with iron.
target: Afta im mek a worti chiemba fi it, im set it ina wan waal, a sekiur it wid aian.

en: He plans for it that it may not fall down, knowing that it is unable to help itself (for truly it is an image, and needs help).
target: Im plan fi it se it mait no faal doun, a nuo se it oniebl fi elp imself (kaa chuuli it a wan imij, an niid elp).

en: When he makes his prayer concerning goods and his marriage and children, he is not ashamed to speak to that which has no life.
target: Wen im mek im prier kansornin gud dem an im marij an pikni dem, im no shiem fi spiik tu da wa av no laif.

en: Yes, for health, he calls upon that which is weak. For life, he implores that which is dead. For aid, he supplicates that which has no experience. For a good journey, he asks that which can’t so much as move a step.
target: Yes, fi elt, im kaal pan da wa wiik. Fi laif, im impluor da wa ded. Fi ied, im soplikiet da wa av no ekspiriens. Fi a gud jorni, im aks da wa kyaan iivn muuv wan step.

en: And for profit in business and good success of his hands, he asks ability from that which has hands with no ability.
target: An fi prafit ina biznis an gud sokses a im an dem, im aks abiliti fram da wa av an dem wid no abiliti.

en: Again, one preparing to sail, and about to journey over raging waves, calls upon a piece of wood more fragile than the vessel that carries him.
target: Agen, wan a pripier fi siel, an bout fi jorni uova riejin wiev dem, kaal pan a piis a wud muo frajail dan di vesl wa kyari im.

en: For the hunger for profit planned it, and wisdom was the craftsman who built it.
target: Kaa di ongga fi prafit plan it, an wizdam a di kraafsman uu bil it.

en: Your providence, O Father, guides it along, because even in the sea you gave a way, and in the waves a sure path,
target: Yu provident, O Faada, gaid it alang, bikaaz iivn ina di sii yu gi a wie, an ina di wiev dem a shuur paat,

en: showing that you can save out of every danger, that even a man without skill may put to sea.
target: a shuo se yu kyaan siev outa evri dienja, se iivn a man widout skil mait put tu sii.

en: It is your will that the works of your wisdom should not be ineffective. Therefore men also entrust their lives to a little piece of wood, and passing through the surge on a raft come safely to land.
target: A yu wil se di wok dem a yu wizdam shudn bi inefektiv. So man dem tu entros dem laif tu a likl piis a wud, an a paas chuu di sorj pan a raaf dem kom siefli tu lan.

en: For in the old time also, when proud giants were perishing, the hope of the world, taking refuge on a raft, your hand guided the seed of generations of the race of men.
target: Kaa ina di uol taim tu, wen proud jaiant dem a perish, di uop a di worl, a tek refyuuj pan a raaf, yu an gaid di siid a jenarieshan dem a di ries a man dem.

en: For blessed is wood through which comes righteousness;
target: Kaa bles a wud chuu wa raichosnis kom;

en: but the idol made with hands is accursed, itself and he that made it; because his was the working, and the perishable thing was called a god.
target: bot di aidol mek wid an dem a kors, imself an im uu mek it; bikaaz im a di wokin, an di perishabl ting get kaal a ila.

en: For both the ungodly and his ungodliness are alike hateful to God;
target: Kaa buot di ongodli an im ongodlinis a laik ietful tu Gad;

en: for truly the deed will be punished together with him who committed it.
target: kaa chuuli di diid wi get ponish tugeda wid im uu komit it.

en: Therefore also there will be a visitation among the idols of the nation, because, though formed of things which God created, they were made a detestable thing, stumbling blocks to the souls of men, and a snare to the feet of the foolish.
target: So tu a vizitieshan wi de mong di aidol dem a di nieshan, bikaaz, duo dem faam a ting dem wa Gad kriet, dem mek a ditesabl ting, stomblin blak dem tu di suol dem a man dem, an a snier tu di fut dem a di fuulish dem.

en: For the devising of idols was the beginning of sexual immorality, and the invention of them the corruption of life.
target: Kaa di divaizin a aidol dem a di biginin a sekshual imoraliti, an di invenshan a dem a di koropshan a laif.

en: For they didn’t exist from the beginning, and they won’t exist forever.
target: Kaa dem neva egzis fram di biginin, an dem wi no egzis fareva.

en: For by the boastfulness of men they entered into the world, and therefore a speedy end was planned for them.
target: Kaa bai di buosfulnis a man dem dem enta ina di worl, an so a spiidi en plan fi dem.

en: For a father worn with untimely grief, making an image of the child quickly taken away, now honored him as a god which was then a dead human being, and delivered to those that were under him mysteries and solemn rites.
target: Kaa wan faada wuon wid ontaimli griif, a mek a imij a di pikni wa kwikli tek we, nou ana im az a ila wa den a wan ded yuuman biin, an diliva tu dem uu anda im mischri dem an solem rait dem.

en: Afterward the ungodly custom, in process of time grown strong, was kept as a law, and the engraved images received worship by the commandments of princes.
target: Aftawod di ongodli kostom, ina pruoses a taim a gruo chrang, kip az a laa, an di ingriev imij dem get woship bai di komaanment dem a prins dem.

en: And when men could not honor them in presence because they lived far off, imagining the likeness from afar, they made a visible image of the king whom they honored, that by their zeal they might flatter the absent as if present.
target: An wen man dem kudn ana dem ina prezens bikaaz dem liv faar af, a imajin di laiknis fram afaar, dem mek a vizibl imij a di king uu dem ana, se bai dem ziil dem mait flata di absent az if im prezent.

en: But worship was raised to a yet higher pitch, even by those who didn’t know him, urged forward by the ambition of the craftsman;
target: Bot woship get riez tu a yet ai a pich, iivn bai dem uu neva nuo im, a orj faawod bai di ambishan a di kraafsman;

en: for he, wishing perhaps to please his ruler, used his art to force the likeness toward a greater beauty.
target: kaa im, a wish poraps fi pliiz im ruula, yuuz im aat fi fuos di laiknis tuwaad a grieta byuuti.

en: So the multitude, allured by reason of the grace of his handiwork, now consider an object of devotion him that a little before was honored as a man.
target: So di moltityuud, a get aluur bai riizn a di gries a im andiwok, nou kansida a objekt a divuoshan im wa a likl bifuo get ana az a man.

en: And this became an ambush, because men, in bondage either to calamity or to tyranny, invested stones and stocks with the Name that shouldn’t be shared.
target: An dis ton a ambush, bikaaz man dem, ina bandij aida tu kalamiti ar tu tirani, inves stuon dem an stak dem wid di Niem wa shudn shier.

en: Afterward it was not enough for them to go astray concerning the knowledge of God, but also, while they live in a great war of ignorance, they call a multitude of evils peace.
target: Aftawod it neva inof fi dem fi go aschrie kansornin di nalij a Gad, bot tu, wail dem liv ina a griet waar a ignarans, dem kaal a moltityuud a iivl dem piis.

en: For either slaughtering children in solemn rites, or celebrating secret mysteries, or holding frenzied revels of strange customs,
target: Kaa aida a slaata pikni dem ina solem rait dem, ar a selibriet siikrit mischri dem, ar a uol frenzi revel dem a schrienj kostom dem,

en: no longer do they guard either life or purity of marriage, but one brings upon another either death by treachery, or anguish by adultery.
target: no langga dem gyaad aida laif ar pyuuriti a marij, bot wan bring pan anada aida det bai chrechari, ar angwish bai adoltri.

en: And all things confusedly are filled with blood and murder, theft and deceit, corruption, faithlessness, tumult, perjury,
target: An aal ting konfyuuzli ful op wid blod an moda, teef an disiet, koropshan, fietlisnis, tyumolt, porjari,

en: confusion about what is good, forgetfulness of favors, ingratitude for benefits, defiling of souls, confusion of sex, disorder in marriage, adultery and wantonness.
target: konfyuujan bout wa gud, fagetfulnis a fieva dem, ingratityuud fi benefit dem, defailin a suol dem, konfyuujan a seks, disaada ina marij, adoltri an wantannis.

en: For the worship of idols that may not be named is a beginning and cause and end of every evil.
target: Kaa di woship a aidol dem wa mait no niem a wan biginin an kaaz an en a evri iivl.

en: For their worshipers either make merry to madness, or prophesy lies, or live unrighteously, or lightly commit perjury.
target: Kaa dem woshipa dem aida mek meri tu madnis, ar prafisai lai dem, ar liv onraichosli, ar laitli komit porjari.

en: For putting their trust in lifeless idols, when they have sworn a wicked oath, they expect not to suffer harm.
target: Kaa a put dem chros ina laiflis aidol dem, wen dem don swier a wikid uot, dem ekspek no fi sofa aam.

en: But on both counts, the just doom will pursue them, because they had evil thoughts of God by giving heed to idols, and swore unrighteously in deceit through contempt for holiness.
target: Bot pan buot kount dem, di jos duum wi porsyuu dem, bikaaz dem av iivl taat dem a Gad bai a gi iid tu aidol dem, an swier onraichosli ina disiet chuu kontempt fi uolinis.

en: For it is not the power of things by which men swear, but it is the just penalty for those who sin that always visits the transgression of the unrighteous.
target: Kaa a no di powa a ting dem bai wa man dem swier, bot a di jos penalti fi dem uu sin wa aalwiez vizit di chransgreshan a di onraichos dem.

en: But you, our God, are gracious and true, patient, and in mercy ordering all things.
target: Bot yu, wi Gad, a grieshos an chuu, pieshent, an ina mersi a aada aal ting.

en: For even if we sin, we are yours, knowing your dominion; but we will not sin, knowing that we have been accounted yours.
target: Kaa iivn if wi sin, wi a yuors, a nuo yu dominion; bot wi wi no sin, a nuo se wi get akount az yuors.

en: For to be acquainted with you is perfect righteousness, and to know your dominion is the root of immortality.
target: Kaa fi akwaint wid yu a porfek raichosnis, an fi nuo yu dominion a di ruut a imoortaliti.

en: For we weren’t led astray by any evil plan of men’s, nor yet by painters’ fruitless labor, a form stained with varied colors,
target: Kaa wi neva get led aschrie bai eni iivl plan a man dem, nar yet bai pienta dem fruutlis lieba, a faam stien wid vierid kola dem,

en: the sight of which leads fools into lust. Their desire is for the breathless form of a dead image.
target: di sait a wa liid fuul dem ina los. Dem dizaya a fi di bretlis faam a wan ded imij.

en: Lovers of evil things, and worthy of such hopes, are those who make, desire, and worship them.
target: Lova dem a iivl ting dem, an worti a soch uop dem, a dem uu mek, dizaya, an woship dem.

en: For a potter, kneading soft earth, laboriously molds each article for our service. He fashions out of the same clay both the vessels that minister to clean uses, and those of a contrary sort, all in like manner. What should be the use of each article of either sort, the potter is the judge.
target: Kaa wan pata, a niid saaf ort, lieboriosli muol iich aatikl fi wi sorvis. Im fashan outa di siem klie buot di vesl dem wa minista tu kliin yuus dem, an dem a wan kontreri saat, aal ina laik mana. Wa shuda bi di yuus a iich aatikl a aida saat, di pata a di joj.

en: Also, laboring to an evil end, he molds a vain god out of the same clay, he who, having but a little before been made of earth, after a short space goes his way to the earth out of which he was taken, when he is required to give back the soul which was lent him.
target: Tu, a lieba tu a iivl en, im muol a vien ila outa di siem klie, im uu, az im a likl bifuo get mek a ort, afta a shaat spies go im wie tu di ort outa wa im tek, wen dem rikwaiya im fi gi bak di suol wa lent im.

en: However he has anxious care, not because his powers must fail, nor because his span of life is short; but he compares himself with goldsmiths and silversmiths, and he imitates molders in brass, and considers it great that he molds counterfeit gods.
target: Oweda im av angshos kier, no bikaaz im powa dem mos fiel, nar bikaaz im span a laif shaat; bot im kompier imself wid guolsmit dem an silvasmit dem, an im imitiet muolda dem ina braas, an kansida it griet se im muol kountafit iladem.

en: His heart is ashes. His hope is of less value than earth. His life is of less honor than clay,
target: Im aat a ashiz. Im uop a les valyuu dan ort. Im laif a les ana dan klie,

en: because he was ignorant of him who molded him, and of him that inspired into him an active soul, and breathed into him a vital spirit.
target: bikaaz im ignarant a im uu muol im, an a im wa inspaiya ina im a aktiv suol, an briit ina im a vaital Spirit.

en: But he accounted our life to be a game, and our lifetime a festival for profit; for, he says, one must get gain however one can, even if it is by evil.
target: Bot im akount wi laif fi bi a giem, an wi laiftaim a festival fi prafit; kaa, im se, wan mos get gien ouever wan kyaan, iivn if it bai iivl.

en: For this man, beyond all others, knows that he sins, out of earthy matter making brittle vessels and engraved images.
target: Kaa dis man, biyan aal ada dem, nuo se im sin, outa orti mata a mek britl vesl dem an ingriev imij dem.

en: But most foolish and more miserable than a baby, are the enemies of your people, who oppressed them;
target: Bot muos fuulish an muo mizrabl dan a biebi, a di enimi dem a yu piipl, uu opres dem;

en: because they even considered all the idols of the nations to be gods, which have neither the use of eyes for seeing, nor nostrils for drawing breath, nor ears to hear, nor fingers for handling, and their feet are helpless for walking.
target: bikaaz dem iivn kansida aal di aidol dem a di nieshan dem fi bi iladem, wa av niida di yuus a yai dem fi siin, nar naasjril dem fi jraa bret, nar iez fi ier, nar finga dem fi andlin, an dem fut dem elplis fi waakin.

en: For a man made them, and one whose own spirit is borrowed molded them; for no one has power as a man to mold a god like himself.
target: Kaa wan man mek dem, an wan uu uon Spirit a baro muol dem; kaa nobadi no av powa az a man fi muol a ila laik imself.

en: But, being mortal, he makes a dead thing by the work of lawless hands; for he is better than the objects of his worship, since he indeed had life, but they never did.
target: Bot, az im moortal, im mek a ded ting bai di wok a laalis an dem; kaa im beta dan di objekt dem a im woship, sins im indiid av laif, bot dem neva did.

en: Yes, and they worship the creatures that are most hateful, for, being compared as to lack of sense, these are worse than all others;
target: Yes, an dem woship di kriicha dem wa muos ietful, kaa, az dem kompier az tu lak a sens, dem ya wos dan aal ada dem;

en: Neither, as seen beside other creatures, are they beautiful, so that one should desire them, but they have escaped both the praise of God and his blessing.
target: Niida, az dem si baisaida ada kriicha dem, dem byuutiful, so wan shuda dizaya dem, bot dem eskiep buot di priez a Gad an im blesin.

en: For this cause, they were deservedly punished through creatures like those which they worship, and tormented through a multitude of vermin.
target: Fi dis kaaz, dem dizorvli get ponish chuu kriicha dem laik dem wa dem woship, an get taament chuu a moltityuud a voormin.

en: Instead of this punishment, you, giving benefits to your people, prepared quails for food, a delicacy to satisfy the desire of their appetite,
target: Insted a dis ponishment, yu, a gi benefit dem tu yu piipl, pripier kwiel dem fi fuud, a delikesi fi satisfai di dizaya a dem apitait,

en: to the end that your enemies, desiring food, might for the hideousness of the creatures sent among them, loathe even the necessary appetite; but these, your people, having for a short time suffered lack, might even partake of delicacies.
target: tu di en se yu enimi dem, a dizaya fuud, mait fi di aidiosnis a di kriicha dem wa sen mong dem, luot iivn di nesiseri apitait; bot dem ya, yu piipl, az dem sofa lak fi a shaat taim, mait iivn paatiek a delikesi dem.

en: For it was necessary that inescapable lack should come upon those oppressors, but that to these it should only be showed how their enemies were tormented.
target: Kaa it nesiseri se ineskiepabl lak shuda kom pan dem opresa dem, bot se tu dem ya it shuda uonli shuo ou dem enimi dem get taament.

en: For even when terrible raging of wild beasts came upon your people, and they were perishing by the bites of crooked serpents, your wrath didn’t continue to the end;
target: Kaa iivn wen teribl riejin a wail biis dem kom pan yu piipl, an dem a perish bai di bait dem a krukid sorpant dem, yu raat neva kontinyuu tu di en;

en: but for admonition were they troubled for a short time, having a token of salvation to put them in remembrance of the commandment of your law;
target: bot fi admonishan dem chrobl fi a shaat taim, az dem av a tuokn a salvieshan fi put dem ina rimembrans a di komaanment a yu laa;

en: for he who turned toward it was not saved because of that which was seen, but because of you, the Savior of all.
target: kaa uu ton tuwaad it neva siev bikaaz a da wa dem si, bot bikaaz a yu, di Sievya a aal.

en: Yes, and in this you persuaded our enemies that you are he who delivers out of every evil.
target: Yes, an ina dis yu posuied wi enimi dem se yu a im uu diliva outa evri iivl.

en: For the bites of locusts and flies truly killed them. No healing for their life was found, because they were worthy to be punished by such things.
target: Kaa di bait dem a luokos dem an flai dem chuuli kil dem. No iilin fi dem laif fain, bikaaz dem worti fi get ponish bai soch ting dem.

en: But your children weren’t overcome by the very fangs of venomous dragons, for your mercy passed by where they were and healed them.
target: Bot yu pikni dem neva uovakom bai di veri fang dem a venamos jragan dem, kaa yu mersi paas bai we dem de an iil dem.

en: For they were bitten to put them in remembrance of your oracles, and were quickly saved, so they would not fall into deep forgetfulness and become unable to respond to your kindness.
target: Kaa dem get bitn fi put dem ina rimembrans a yu orakl dem, an dem kwikli siev, so dem wudn faal ina diip fagetfulnis an ton oniebl fi rispon tu yu kainnis.

en: For truly it was neither herb nor poultice that cured them, but your word, O Lord, which heals all people.
target: Kaa chuuli a neva orb nar poultis wa kyuor dem, bot yu wod, O Laad, wa iil aal piipl.

en: For you have authority over life and death, and you lead down to the gates of Hades, and lead up again.
target: Kaa yu av atariti uova laif an det, an yu liid doun tu di giet dem a Iidis, an liid op agen.

en: But though a man kills by his wickedness, he can’t retrieve the spirit that has departed or release the imprisoned soul.
target: Bot duo man kil bai im wikidnis, im kyaan richriiv di Spirit wa don dipaat ar riliis di imprizn suol.

en: But it is not possible to escape your hand;
target: Bot it no pasibl fi eskiep yu an;

en: for ungodly men, refusing to know you, were scourged in the strength of your arm, pursued with strange rains and hails and relentless storms, and utterly consumed with fire.
target: kaa ongodli man dem, a rifyuuz fi nuo yu, get skorj ina di chrent a yu aam, a get porsyuu wid schrienj rien dem an iel dem an relentlis staam dem, an otli konsyuum wid faiya.

en: For, what was most marvelous, in the water which quenches all things, the fire burned hotter; for the world fights for the righteous.
target: Kaa, wa a muos maavilos, ina di waata wa kwench aal ting, di faiya bon ata; kaa di worl fait fi di raichos dem.

en: For at one time the flame was restrained, that it might not burn up the creatures sent against the ungodly, but that these themselves as they looked might see that they were chased by the judgment of God.
target: Kaa a wan taim di fliem get rischrien, so it mait no bon op di kriicha dem wa sen agens di ongodli dem, bot se dem de demself az dem luk mait si se jojment a Gad a chies dem.

en: At another time even in the midst of water it burns more intensely than fire, that it may destroy the produce of an unrighteous land.
target: A anada taim iivn ina di mids a waata it bon muo intensli dan faiya, so it mait distrai di prodyuus a wan onraichos lan.

en: Instead of these things, you gave your people angels’ food to eat, and you provided ready-to-eat bread for them from heaven without toil, able to give every pleasant flavor, and agreeable to every taste.
target: Insted a dem ting ya, yu gi yu piipl ienjel dem fuud fi iit, an yu provaid redi-fi-iit bred fi dem fram evn widout tail, iebl fi gi evri plezant flieva, an agriiabl tu evri ties.

en: For your nature showed your sweetness toward your children, while that bread, serving the desire of the eater, changed itself according to every man’s choice.
target: Kaa yu niecha shuo yu swiitnis tuwaad yu pikni dem, wail da bred de, a sorv di dizaya a di iita, chienj imself akardin tu evri man chuais.

en: But snow and ice endured fire, and didn’t melt, that people might know that fire was destroying the fruits of the enemies, burning in the hail and flashing in the rains;
target: Bot snuo an ais endyuur faiya, an neva melt, so piipl mait nuo se faiya a distrai di fruut dem a di enimi dem, a bon ina di iel an a flash ina di rien dem;

en: and that this fire, again, in order that righteous people may be nourished, has even forgotten its own power.
target: an se dis faiya, agen, so raichos piipl mait get norish, iivn faget im uon powa.

en: For the creation, ministering to you, its maker, strains its force against the unrighteous for punishment and in kindness, slackens it on behalf of those who trust in you.
target: Kaa di krietion, a minista tu yu, im mieka, schrien im fuos agens di onraichos dem fi ponishment an ina kainnis, slakn it pan bialf a dem uu chros ina yu.

en: Therefore at that time also, converting itself into all forms, it ministered to your all-nourishing bounty, according to the desire of those who had need,
target: So a da taim de tu, a konvort imself ina aal faam dem, it minista tu yu aal-norishin bounti, akardin tu di dizaya a dem uu av niid,

en: that your children, whom you loved, O Lord, might learn that it is not the growth of crops that nourishes a man, but that your word preserves those who trust you.
target: so yu pikni dem, uu yu lov, O Laad, mait laan se a no di gruot a krap dem wa norish man, bot se yu wod prizorv dem uu chros yu.

en: For that which was not destroyed by fire, melted away when it was simply warmed by a faint sunbeam,
target: Kaa da wa faiya neva distrai, melt we wen it jos waam bai wan fient sonbiim,

en: that it might be known that we must rise before the sun to give you thanks, and must pray to you at the dawning of the light;
target: so it mait nuo se wi mos raiz bifuo di son fi gi yu tangks, an mos prie tu yu a di daanin a di lait;

en: for the hope of the unthankful will melt as the winter’s hoar frost, and will flow away as water that has no use.
target: kaa di uop a di ontangkful wi melt az di winta oar fraas, an wi fluo we az waata wa av no yuus.

en: For your judgments are great, and hard to interpret; therefore undisciplined souls went astray.
target: Kaa yu jojment dem griet, an aad fi intaprit; so ondisciplin suol dem go aschrie.

en: For when lawless men had supposed that they held a holy nation in their power, they, prisoners of darkness, and bound in the chains of a long night, kept close beneath their roofs, lay exiled from the eternal providence.
target: Kaa wen laalis man dem supuoz se dem uol a uoli nieshan ina dem powa, dem, prizna dem a daaknis, an boun ina di chien dem a wan lang nait, kip kluos anda dem ruuf dem, lai egzaail fram di itoornal provident.

en: For while they thought that they were unseen in their secret sins, they were divided from one another by a dark curtain of forgetfulness, stricken with terrible awe, and very troubled by apparitions.
target: Kaa wail dem taat se dem onsiin ina dem siikrit sin dem, dem divaid fram wan anada bai a daak kortn a fagetfulnis, a get schrikn wid teribl aa, an veri chrobl bai aparishan dem.

en: For neither did the dark recesses that held them guard them from fears, but terrifying sounds rang around them, and dismal phantoms appeared with unsmiling faces.
target: Kaa niida di daak rises dem wa uol dem gyaad dem fram fier dem, bot terifaiin soun dem ring roun dem, an dizmal fantom dem apier wid onsmailin fies dem.

en: And no power of fire prevailed to give light, neither were the brightest flames of the stars strong enough to illuminate that gloomy night;
target: An no powa a faiya priviel fi gi lait, niida di braitis fliem dem a di staar dem chrang inof fi ilyuuminiet da gluumi nait de;

en: but only the glimmering of a self-kindled fire appeared to them, full of fear. In terror, they considered the things which they saw to be worse than that sight, on which they could not gaze.
target: bot uonli di glimarin a wan self-kinl faiya apier tu dem, ful a fier. Ina tero, dem kansida di ting dem wa dem si fi bi wos dan da sait de, pan wa dem kudn giez.

en: The mockeries of their magic arts were powerless, now, and a shameful rebuke of their boasted understanding:
target: Di makari dem a dem majik aat dem powalis, nou, an a shiemful ribyuuk a dem buostid andastandin:

en: For those who promised to drive away terrors and disorders from a sick soul, these were sick with a ludicrous fearfulness.
target: Kaa dem uu pramis fi jraiv we tero dem an disaada dem fram a sik suol, dem ya sik wid a lyuudikros fierfulnis.

en: For even if no troubling thing frighted them, yet, scared with the creeping of vermin and hissing of serpents,
target: Kaa iivn if no chroblin ting fraitn dem, yet, a get skier wid di kriipin a voormin an di isin a sorpant dem,

en: they perished trembling in fear, refusing even to look at the air, which could not be escaped on any side.
target: dem perish a chrembl ina fier, a rifyuuz iivn fi luk pan di ier, wa kudn eskiep pan eni said.

en: For wickedness, condemned by a witness within, is a coward thing, and, being pressed hard by conscience, always has added forecasts of the worst.
target: Kaa wikidnis, kondem bai wan witnis widin, a wan kouad ting, an, az it get pres aad bai kanshens, it aalwiez av adid fuorkyaas dem a di wos.

en: For fear is nothing else but a surrender of the help which reason offers;
target: Kaa fier a notn els bot a sorenda a di elp wa riizn aafa;

en: and from within, the expectation of being less prefers ignorance of the cause that brings the torment.
target: an fram widin, di ekspektieshan fi bi les prifo ignarans a di kaaz wa bring di taament.

en: But they, all through the night which was powerless indeed, and which came upon them out of the recesses of powerless Hades, sleeping the same sleep,
target: Bot dem, aal chuu di nait wa powalis indiid, an wa kom pan dem outa di rises dem a powalis Iidis, a sliip di siem sliip,

en: now were haunted by monstrous apparitions, and now were paralyzed by their soul’s surrendering; for sudden and unexpected fear came upon them.
target: nou get aant bai monstros aparishan dem, an nou get paralais bai dem suol sorendain; kaa sodn an onekspektid fier kom pan dem.

en: So then whoever it might be, sinking down in his place, was kept captive, shut up in that prison which was not barred with iron;
target: So den uuever it mait bi, a sink doun ina im plies, dem kip im kyaptiv, a get shot op ina da prizn de wa neva baar wid aian;

en: for whether he was a farmer, or a shepherd, or a laborer whose toils were in the wilderness, he was overtaken, and endured that inescapable sentence; for they were all bound with one chain of darkness.
target: kaa weda im a faama, ar a shepad, ar a liebara uu tail dem de ina di wildanis, im get uovatiek, an endyuur da ineskiepabl sentens de; kaa dem aal boun wid wan chien a daaknis.

en: Whether there was a whistling wind, or a melodious sound of birds among the spreading branches, or a measured fall of water running violently,
target: Weda a wislin win de, ar a meluodios soun a bord dem mong di spredin branch dem, ar a mejad faal a waata a ron vaiolentli,

en: or a harsh crashing of rocks hurled down, or the swift course of animals bounding along unseen, or the voice of wild beasts harshly roaring, or an echo rebounding from the hollows of the mountains, all these things paralyzed them with terror.
target: ar a aash krashin a rak dem wa orl doun, ar di swif kuors a animal dem a bound alang onsiin, ar di vais a wail biis dem aashli a ruor, ar a eko a ribound fram di alo dem a di mountn dem, aal dem ting ya paralais dem wid tero.

en: For the whole world was illuminated with clear light, and was occupied with unhindered works,
target: Kaa di uol worl get ilyuuminiet wid klier lait, an a okyupai wid oninda wok dem,

en: while over them alone was spread a heavy night, an image of the darkness that should afterward receive them; but to themselves, they were heavier than darkness.
target: wail uova dem aluon a evi nait spred, a imij a di daaknis wa shuda aftawod get dem; bot tu demself, dem evier dan daaknis.

en: But for your holy ones there was great light. Their enemies, hearing their voice but not seeing their form, counted it a happy thing that they had not suffered,
target: Bot fi yu uoli wan dem a griet lait de. Dem enimi dem, a ier dem vais bot no si dem faam, kount it a api ting se dem neva sofa,

en: yet for that they do not hurt them, though wronged by them before, they are thankful; and because they had been at variance with them, they begged for pardon.
target: yet fi se dem no ort dem, duo dem rang dem bifuo, dem tangkful; an bikaaz dem ben a varians wid dem, dem beg fi paadn.

en: Therefore you provided a burning pillar of fire, to be a guide for your people’s unknown journey, and a harmless sun for their glorious exile.
target: So yu provaid a bonin pila a faiya, fi bi a gaid fi yu piipl onnuo jorni, an a aamlis son fi dem gluorios egzaail.

en: For the Egyptians well deserved to be deprived of light and imprisoned by darkness, they who had imprisoned your children, through whom the incorruptible light of the law was to be given to the race of men.
target: Kaa di Iijipshan dem wel dizorv fi get dipraiv a lait an imprizn bai daaknis, dem uu imprizn yu pikni dem, chuu uum di inkoroptibl lait a di laa ben fi gi tu di ries a man dem.

en: After they had taken counsel to kill the babes of the holy ones, and when a single child had been abandoned and saved to convict them of their sin, you took away from them their multitude of children, and destroyed all their army together in a mighty flood.
target: Afta dem tek kounsl fi kil di biebi dem a di uoli wan dem, an wen wan singl pikni get aband an siev fi konvik dem a dem sin, yu tek we fram dem dem moltityuud a pikni dem, an distrai aal dem aami tugeda ina wan maiti flod.

en: Our fathers were made aware of that night beforehand, that, having sure knowledge, they might be cheered by the oaths which they had trusted.
target: Wi faada dem get mek awier a da nait de bifuoan, so, az dem av shuur nalij, dem mait chiir bai di uot dem wa dem chros.

en: Salvation of the righteous and destruction of the enemies was expected by your people.
target: Salvieshan a di raichos dem an distrokshan a di enimi dem yu piipl ekspek.

en: For as you took vengeance on the adversaries, by the same means, calling us to yourself, you glorified us.
target: Kaa az yu tek venjans pan di adveseri dem, bai di siem miinz, a kaal wi tu yuself, yu gluorifai wi.

en: For holy children of good men offered sacrifice in secret, and with one consent they agreed to the covenant of the divine law, that they would partake alike in the same good things and the same perils, the fathers already leading the sacred songs of praise.
target: Kaa uoli pikni dem a gud man dem aafa sakrifais ina siikrit, an wid wan kansent dem agrii tu di kovnant a di divain laa, se dem wuda paatiek alaik ina di siem gud ting dem an di siem peril dem, di faada dem don a liid di siekrid sang dem a priez.

en: But the discordant cry of the enemies echoed back, and a pitiful voice of lamentation for children was spread abroad.
target: Bot di diskaadant krai a di enimi dem eko bak, an a pitiful vais a lamentieshan fi pikni dem spred abraad.

en: Both servant and master were punished with the same just doom, and the commoner suffering the same as king;
target: Buot sorvant an maasta get ponish wid di siem jos duum, an di kamana a sofa di siem az king;

en: Yes, they all together, under one form of death, had corpses without number. For the living were not sufficient even to bury them, since at a single stroke, their most cherished offspring was consumed.
target: Yes, dem aal tugeda, anda wan faam a det, av kaaps dem widout nomba. Kaa di livin dem neva sifizhent iivn fi beri dem, sins a wan singl chruok, dem muos cherish afspring get konsyuum.

en: For while they were disbelieving all things by reason of the enchantments, upon the destruction of the firstborn they confessed the people to be God’s children.
target: Kaa wail dem a disbiliiv aal ting bikaaz a di enchaanment dem, pan di distrokshan a di fosbaan dem konfes di piipl fi bi Gads pikni dem.

en: For while peaceful silence wrapped all things, and night in her own swiftness was half spent,
target: Kaa wail piisful sailens rap aal ting, an nait ina ar uon swifnis a aaf spen,

en: your all-powerful word leaped from heaven, from the royal throne, a stern warrior, into the midst of the doomed land,
target: yu aal-powaful wod liip fram evn, fram di raayal chruon, a storn warior, ina di mids a di duum lan,

en: bearing as a sharp sword your authentic commandment, and standing, it filled all things with death, and while it touched the sky it stood upon the earth.
target: a bier az a shaap suord yu atentik komaanment, an a tan, it ful aal ting wid det, an wail it toch di skai it tan pan di ort.

en: Then immediately apparitions in dreams terribly troubled them, and unexpected fears came upon them.
target: Den imediately aparishan dem ina jriim dem teribli chrobl dem, an onekspektid fier dem kom pan dem.

en: And each, one thrown here half dead, another there, made known why he was dying;
target: An iich, wan a get chruo ya aaf ded, anada de, mek nuo wai im a ded;

en: for the dreams, disturbing them, forewarned them of this, that they might not perish without knowing why they were afflicted.
target: kaa di jriim dem, a distorb dem, fuowaarn dem a dis, so dem mait no perish widout a nuo wai dem get aflik.

en: The experience of death also touched the righteous, and a multitude were destroyed in the wilderness, but the wrath didn’t last long.
target: Di ekspiriens a det tu toch di raichos dem, an a moltityuud get distrai ina di wildanis, bot di raat neva laas lang.

en: For a blameless man hurried to be their champion, bringing the weapon of his own ministry, prayer, and the atoning sacrifice of incense. He withstood the indignation and set an end to the calamity, showing that he was your servant.
target: Kaa wan blemlis man ori fi bi dem champian, a bring di wepon a im uon minischri, prier, an di atuonin sakrifais a insens. Im widstan di indignieshan an set a en tu di kalamiti, a shuo se im a yu sorvant.

en: And he overcame the anger, not by strength of body, not by force of weapons, but by his word, he subdued the avenger by bringing to remembrance oaths and covenants made with the fathers.
target: An im uovakom di anga, no bai chrent a badi, no bai fuos a wepon dem, bot bai im wod, im sobdyuu di avenja bai a bring tu rimembrans uot dem an kovnant dem wa mek wid di faada dem.

en: For when the dead had already fallen in heaps one upon another, he intervened and stopped the wrath, and cut off its way to the living.
target: Kaa wen di ded dem don faal ina iip dem wan pan anada, im intaviin an tap di raat, an kot af im wie tu di livin dem.

en: For the whole world was pictured on his long robe, and the glories of the fathers were upon the engraving of the four rows of precious stones, and your majesty was upon the diadem on his head.
target: Kaa di uol worl pikcha pan im lang ruob, an di gluori dem a di faada dem de pan di ingrievin a di fuo ruo dem a preshos stuon dem, an yu majesti de pan di daiadem pan im ed.

en: The destroyer yielded to these, and they feared; for it was enough only to test the wrath.
target: Di distraaya yiil tu dem ya, an dem fier; kaa it inof uonli fi tes di raat.

en: But indignation without mercy came upon the ungodly to the end; for God also foreknew their future,
target: Bot indignieshan widout mersi kom pan di ongodli dem tu di en; kaa Gad tu fuonuo dem fyuucha,

en: how, having changed their minds to let your people go, and having sped them eagerly on their way, they would change their minds and pursue them.
target: ou, az dem chienj dem main fi mek yu piipl go, an az dem spiid dem iigali pan dem wie, dem wuda chienj dem main an porsyuu dem.

en: For while they were yet in the midst of their mourning, and lamenting at the graves of the dead, they made another foolish decision, and pursued as fugitives those whom they had begged to leave and driven out.
target: Kaa wail dem yet ina di mids a dem muornin, an a lament a di grieve dem a di ded dem, dem mek anada fuulish disijan, an porsyuu az fyujitiv dem dem uu dem beg fi liiv an jraiv out.

en: For the doom which they deserved was drawing them to this end, and it made them forget the things that had happened to them, that they might fill up the punishment which was yet lacking from their torments,
target: Kaa di duum wa dem dizorv a jraa dem tu dis en, an it mek dem faget di ting dem wa apn tu dem, so dem mait ful op di ponishment wa yet lak fram dem taament dem,

en: and that your people might journey on by a marvelous road, but they themselves might find a strange death.
target: an se yu piipl mait jorni aan bai a maavilos ruod, bot dem demself mait fain a schrienj det.

en: For the whole creation, each part in its diverse kind, was made new again, complying with your commandments, that your servants might be kept unharmed.
target: Kaa di uol krietion, iich paat ina im daivors kain, get mek nyuu agen, a komplai wid yu komaanment dem, so yu sorvant dem mait kip onaam.

en: Then the cloud that overshadowed the camp was seen, and dry land rising up out of what had been water, out of the Red sea an unhindered highway, and a grassy plain out of the violent surge,
target: Den di kloud wa uovashado di kyamp get siin, an jrai lan a raiz op outa wa ben waata, outa di Red Sii a oninda aiwie, an a graasi plien outa di vaiolent sorj,

en: by which they passed over with all their army, these who were covered with your hand, having seen strange marvels.
target: bai wa dem paas uova wid aal dem aami, dem ya uu get kova wid yu an, az dem si schrienj maavl dem.

en: For like horses they roamed at large, and they skipped about like lambs, praising you, O Lord, who was their deliverer.
target: Kaa laik aas dem dem ruom a laaj, an dem skip bout laik lam dem, a priez yu, O Laad, uu a dem dilivara.

en: For they still remembered the things that happened in the time of their sojourning, how instead of bearing cattle, the land brought forth lice, and instead of fish, the river spewed out a multitude of frogs.
target: Kaa dem stil memba di ting dem wa apn ina di taim a dem sojornin, ou insted a a bier kyatl, di lan bring fuot lais, an insted a fish, di riva spyuu out a moltityuud a frag dem.

en: But afterwards, they also saw a new kind of birds, when, led on by desire, they asked for luxurious dainties;
target: Bot aftawod, dem tu si a nyuu kain a bord dem, wen, a get led aan bai dizaya, dem aks fi lokshuorios dienti dem;

en: for, to comfort them, quails came up for them from the sea.
target: kaa, fi komfot dem, kwiel dem kom op fi dem fram di sii.

en: Punishments came upon the sinners, not without the signs that were given beforehand by the violence of the thunder, for they justly suffered through their own wickednesses, for the hatred which they practiced toward guests was grievous indeed.
target: Ponishment dem kom pan di sina dem, no widout di sain dem wa gi bifuoan bai di vaiolens a di tonda, kaa dem josli sofa chuu dem uon wikidnis dem, kaa di ietred wa dem praktis tuwaad ges dem a griivos indiid.

en: For while the others didn’t receive the strangers when they came to them, the Egyptians made slaves of guests who were their benefactors.
target: Kaa wail di ada dem neva risiiv di schrienja dem wen dem kom tu dem, di Iijipshan dem mek sliev a ges dem uu a dem benefakta dem.

en: And not only so, but while punishment of some sort will come upon the former, since they received as enemies those who were aliens;
target: An no uonli so, bot wail ponishment a wan saat wi kom pan di faama dem, sins dem risiiv az enimi dem dem uu a ielian dem;

en: because these first welcomed with feastings, and then afflicted with dreadful toils, those who had already shared with them in the same rights.
target: bikaaz dem ya fos welkom wid fiistin dem, an den aflik wid jredful tail dem, dem uu don shier wid dem ina di siem rait dem.

en: And moreover they were stricken with loss of sight (even as were those others at the righteous man’s doors), when, being surrounded with yawning darkness, they each looked for the passage through his own door.
target: An muuova dem get schrikn wid las a sait (iivn az dem ada dem a di raichos man duor dem), wen, az daaknis wa yaanin soroun dem, dem iich luk fi di pasij chuu im uon duor.

en: For as the notes of a lute vary the character of the rhythm, even so the elements, changing their order one with another, continuing always in its sound, as may clearly be conjectured from the sight of the things that have happened.
target: Kaa az di nuot dem a wan lyuut vieri di kyarakta a di ridim, iivn so di eliment dem, a chienj dem aada wan wid anada, a kontinyuu aalwiez ina im soun, az mait klierli get konjekcha fram di sait a di ting dem wa don apn.

en: For creatures of the dry land were turned into creatures of the waters, and creatures that swim moved upon the land.
target: Kaa kriicha dem a di jrai lan ton ina kriicha dem a di waata dem, an kriicha dem wa swim muuv pan di lan.

en: Fire kept the mastery of its own power in water, and water forgot its quenching nature.
target: Faiya kip di maasteri a im uon powa ina waata, an waata faget im kwenchin niecha.

en: On the contrary, flames didn’t consume flesh of perishable creatures that walked among them, neither did they melt the crystalline grains of ambrosial food that were melted easily.
target: Pan di kontreri, fliem dem neva konsyuum flesh a perishabl kriicha dem wa waak mong dem, niida dem melt di kristalain grien dem a ambruozhal fuud wa melt iizi.

en: For in all things, O Lord, you magnified your people, and you glorified them and didn’t lightly regard them, standing by their side in every time and place.
target: Kaa ina aal ting, O Laad, yu magnifai yu piipl, an yu gluorifai dem an neva laitli rigaad dem, a tan bai dem said ina evri taim an plies.

en: I enjoy three things, and they are beautiful before the Lord and men: the agreement of kindred, the friendship of neighbors, and a woman and her husband who walk together in agreement.
target: Mi enjai chrii ting, an dem byuutiful bifuo di Laad an man: di agriiment a fambili, di frenship a nieba dem, an a uman an ar ozban uu waak tugeda ina agriiment.

en: But my soul hates three sorts of people, and I am greatly offended at their life: a poor man who is arrogant, a rich man who is a liar, and an old fool who is an adulterer.
target: Bot mi suol iet chrii saat a piipl, an dem laif aafend mi nof nof: a puo man uu aarogant, a rich man uu a laiya, an a uol fuul uu a adoltara.

en: If you gathered nothing in your youth, how could you find anything in your old age?
target: Ef yu gyada notn ina yu yuut, ou yu wuda fain eniting ina yu uol iej?

en: How beautiful a thing is judgment in the gray-haired, and for elders to know good counsel!
target: Ou byuutiful a ting a jojment ina di grie-ier uan dem, an fi elda dem fi nuo gud kounsl!

en: How beautiful is the wisdom of old men, and understanding and counsel to men who are in honor!
target: Ou byuutiful a di wizdam a uol man dem, an andastandin an kounsl tu man dem uu ina ana!

en: Much experience is the crown of the aged. Their glory is the fear of the Lord.
target: Nof expiriens a di kroun a di iej uan dem. Dem gluori a di fiir a di Laad.

en: There are nine things that I have thought of, and in my heart counted happy, and the tenth I will utter with my tongue: a man who has joy with his children, and a man who lives and sees the fall of his enemies.
target: Dier a nain ting we mi ting bout, an ina mi aat mi kount dem api, an di tent mi wi taak wid mi tong: a man uu av jai wid im pikni dem, an a man uu liv an si di faal a im enimi dem.

en: Happy is he who dwells with a wife of understanding, he who has not slipped with his tongue, and he who has not served a man who is unworthy of him.
target: Api a im uu dwel wid a waif uu andastan, im uu no slip wid im tong, an im uu no sorv a man uu onworti a im.

en: Happy is he who has found prudence, and he who speaks in the ears of those who listen.
target: Api a im uu fain prudens, an im uu taak ina di iirz a dem uu lisn.

en: How great is he who has found wisdom! Yet there is none greater than one who fears the Lord.
target: Ou griet a im uu fain wizdam! Bot non no grieta dan uan uu fiir di Laad.

en: The fear of the Lord surpasses all things. To whom will he who holds it be likened?
target: Di fiir a di Laad sipaas aal ting. Tu uu im uu uol it wi bi laikn?

en: [Reader’s note: Verse 12 is omitted by the best authorities.]
target: [Riida nuot: Vors twelv a lef out bai di bes atariti dem.]

en: Any wound but a wound of the heart! Any wickedness but the wickedness of a woman!
target: Eni woun bot a woun a di aat! Eni wikidnis bot di wikidnis a a uman!

en: Any calamity but a calamity from those who hate me! Any vengeance but the vengeance of enemies!
target: Eni kalamiti bot a kalamiti fram dem uu iet mi! Eni venjans bot di venjans a enimi dem!

en: There is no venom worse than a snake’s venom. There is no wrath worse than an enemy’s wrath.
target: Dier a no venom wos dan a sniek venom. Dier a no raat wos dan a enimi raat.

en: I would rather dwell with a lion and a dragon than keep house with a wicked woman.
target: Mi wuda raada dwel wid a laian an a dragan dan kiip ous wid a wikid uman.

en: The wickedness of a woman changes her appearance, and darkens her countenance like that of a bear.
target: Di wikidnis a a uman chienj ar apierans, an daakn ar fies laik da a bier.

en: Her husband will sit among his neighbors, and when he hears it, he sighs bitterly.
target: Ar ozban wi sidong mongx im nieba dem, an wen im ier it, im sai bitali.

en: All malice is small compared to the malice of a woman. Let the portion of a sinner fall on her.
target: Aal malis smaal kompier tu di malis a a uman. Mek di paashan a a sina faal pan ar.

en: As walking up a sandy hill is to the feet of the aged, so is a wife full of words to a quiet man.
target: Az waakin op a sandi il tu di fut a di iej uan dem, so a waif ful a wod tu a kwaiet man.

en: Don’t be ensnared by a woman’s beauty. Don’t desire a woman for her beauty.
target: No get ensnier bai a uman byuuti. No dizaiya a uman fi ar byuuti.

en: There is anger, impudence, and great reproach if a woman supports her husband.
target: Dier a anga, impiudens, an griet ripruoch ef a uman sapuot ar ozban.

en: A wicked woman is abasement of heart, sadness of countenance, and a wounded heart. A woman who won’t make her husband happy is like hands that hang down, and weak knees.
target: A wikid uman a abiesment a aat, sadnis a fies, an a woun aat. A uman uu naa mek ar ozban api a laik an dem we ang dong, an wiik nii dem.

en: The beginning of sin came from a woman. Because of her, we all die.
target: Di biginin a sin kom fram a uman. Bikaaz a ar, wi aal ded.

en: Don’t give water an outlet, and don’t give a wicked woman freedom of speech.
target: No gi waata a outlet, an no gi a wikid uman friidom a spiich.

en: If she doesn’t go as you direct, cut her away from your flesh.
target: Ef shi no go az yu dairek, kot ar awie fram yu flesh.

en: Happy is the husband of a good wife. The number of his days will be doubled.
target: Api a di ozban a a gud waif. Di nomba a im die dem wi dobl.

en: A faithful wife gives joy to her husband. He will fulfill his years in peace.
target: A fietful waif gi jai tu ar ozban. Im wi fulfil im ier dem ina piis.

en: A good wife is a great gift. She will be given to those who fear the Lord.
target: A gud waif a a griet gif. Shi wi gi tu dem uu fiir di Laad.

en: Whether a man is rich or poor, a good heart makes a cheerful face at all times.
target: Weda a man rich ar puo, a gud aat mek a chiirful fies aal di taim.

en: Of three things my heart was afraid, and concerning the fourth kind I made supplication: The slander of a city, the assembly of a mob, and a false accusation. All these are more grievous than death.
target: A chrii ting mi aat ben fried, an bout di fuot kain mi mek soplikieshan: Di slanda a a siti, di asembli a a mab, an a faals akiuzieshan. Aal a dem muor griivos dan det.

en: A grief of heart and sorrow is a woman who is jealous of another woman. Her tongue-lashing makes it known to all.
target: A griif a aat an sara a a uman uu jelas a anada uman. Ar tong-lashin mek it nuo tu aal.

en: A wicked woman is like a chafing yoke. He who takes hold of her is like one who grasps a scorpion.
target: A wikid uman laik a yoke we chafe. Im uu uol ar a laik uan uu graas a skaapian.

en: A drunken woman causes great wrath. She will not cover her own shame.
target: A jrongk uman kaaz griet raat. Shi naa kova ar uon shiem.

en: The fornication of a woman is in the lifting up of her eyes; it will be known by her eyelids.
target: Di faanikieshan a a uman a ina di liftin op a ar ai dem; it wi nuo bai ar ailid dem.

en: Keep strict watch on a headstrong daughter, or she will find liberty for herself, and use it.
target: Kiip strik wach pan a edstrang daata, ar shi wi fain libati fi arself, an yuuz it.

en: Watch out for an impudent eye, and don’t be surprised if it sins against you.
target: Wach out fi a impiudent ai, an no sopraiz ef it sin gens yu.

en: She will open her mouth like a thirsty traveller, and drink from every water that is near. She will sit down at every post, and open her quiver to any arrow.
target: Shi wi uopn ar mout laik a torsti chravla, an jringk fram evri waata we nier. Shi wi sidong a evri puos, an uopn ar kwiva tu eni aro.

en: The grace of a wife will delight her husband. Her knowledge will strengthen his bones.
target: Di gries a a waif wi dilait ar ozban. Ar nalij wi strentn im buon dem.

en: A silent woman is a gift of the Lord. There is nothing worth so much as a well-instructed person.
target: A sailent uman a a gif a di Laad. Dier a notn wort so moch az a wel-instrok porsn.

en: A modest woman is grace upon grace. There are no scales that can weigh the value of a self-controlled person.
target: A madest uman a gries pan gries. Dier a no skiel we kyan wie di valyu a a self-kantrol porsn.

en: As the sun when it arises in the highest places of the Lord, so is the beauty of a good wife in her well-organized home.
target: Az di son wen it araiz ina di aiis plies dem a di Laad, so a di byuuti a a gud waif ina ar wel-aaganaiz uom.

en: As the lamp that shines upon the holy lampstand, so is the beauty of the face on a well-proportioned body.
target: Az di lamp we shain pan di uoli lampstan, so a di byuuti a di fies pan a wel-praposhan badi.

en: As the golden pillars are upon a base of silver, so are beautiful feet with the breasts of one who is steadfast.
target: Az di guoln pila dem pan a bies a silva, so byuutiful fut wid di bres dem a uan uu stedfaas.

en: For two things my heart is grieved, and for the third anger comes upon me: a warrior who suffers for poverty, men of understanding who are counted as garbage, and one who turns back from righteousness to sin— the Lord will prepare him for the sword!
target: Fi tuu ting mi aat griiv, an fi di tord anga kom pan mi: a wariya uu sofa fi pavati, man a andastandin uu kount az gyaabij, an uan uu ton bak fram raichosnis tu sin— di Laad wi pripier im fi di suod!

en: It is difficult for a merchant to keep himself from wrong doing, and for a retailer to be acquitted of sin.
target: It difikolt fi a morchant fi kiip imself fram rang duin, an fi a riitiela fi get akwuit a sin.

en: Many have sinned for profit. He who seeks to multiply wealth will turn his eye away.
target: Meni sin fi prafit. Im uu siik fi moltiplai welt wi ton im ai awie.

en: As a nail will stick fast between the joinings of stones, so sin will thrust itself in between buying and selling.
target: Az a niel wi stik faas bitwiin di jainin dem a stuon, so sin wi chros itself ina bitwiin baiin an selin.

en: Unless a person holds on diligently to the fear of the Lord, his house will be overthrown quickly.
target: Onles a porsn uol aan dilijentli tu di fiir a di Laad, im ous wi uovachruon kwikli.

en: In the shaking of a sieve, the refuse remains, so does the filth of man in his thoughts.
target: Ina di shiekin a a siv, di refyuuz rimien, so di filt a man ina im taat dem.

en: The furnace tests the potter’s vessels; so the test of a person is in his thoughts.
target: Di fornis tes di pata veisl dem; so di tes a a porsn a ina im taat dem.

en: The fruit of a tree discloses its cultivation, so is the utterance of the thought of a person’s heart.
target: Di fruut a a chrii diskloz ou it kolchiveit, so a di otarans a di taat a a porsn aat.

en: Praise no man before you hear his thoughts, for this is how people are tested.
target: No priez no man bifuo yu ier im taat dem, kaa dis a ou piipl tes.

en: If you follow righteousness, you will obtain it, and put it on like a long robe of glory.
target: Ef yu fala raichosnis, yu wi obtien it, an put it aan laik a lang ruob a gluori.

en: Birds will return to their own kind, so truth will return to those who practice it.
target: Bord dem wi riton tu dem uon kain, so chuut wi riton tu dem uu praktis it.

en: The lion lies in wait for prey. So does sin for those who do evil.
target: Di laian lai ina wiet fi prie. So sin fi dem uu du iivl.

en: The discourse of a godly man is always wise, but the fool changes like the moon.
target: Di diskours a a raichos man aalwiez waiz, bot di fuul chienj laik di muun.

en: Limit your time among people void of understanding, but persevere among the thoughtful.
target: Limit yu taim mongx piipl vaid a andastandin, bot posiviir mongx di taatful dem.

en: The talk of fools is offensive. Their laughter is wantonly sinful.
target: Di taak a fuul dem ofensiv. Dem laafta wantanli sinful.

en: Their talk with much swearing makes hair stand upright. Their strife makes others plug their ears.
target: Dem taak wid moch swierin mek ier tan oprait. Dem straif mek ada piipl plog dem iirz.

en: The strife of the proud leads to bloodshed. Their abuse of each other is a grievous thing to hear.
target: Di straif a di proud liid tu blodshed. Dem abyuuz a iich ada a a griivos ting fi ier.

en: He who reveals secrets destroys trust, and will not find a close friend.
target: Im uu riviil siikrit distrai chros, an naa fain a kluos fren.

en: Love a friend, and keep faith with him; but if you reveal his secrets, you will not follow him;
target: Lov a fren, an kiip fiet wid im; bot ef yu riviil im siikrit dem, yu naa fala im;

en: for as a man has destroyed his enemy, so you have destroyed the friendship of your neighbor.
target: kaa az a man distrai im enimi, so yu distrai di frenship a yu nieba.

en: As a bird which you have released out of your hand, so you have let your neighbor go, and you will not catch him again.
target: Az a bord we yu riliis outa yu an, so yu let yu nieba go, an yu naa kech im agen.

en: Don’t pursue him, for he has gone far away, and has escaped like a gazelle out of the snare.
target: No posyuu im, kaa im gaan faar awie, an eskiep laik a gazel outa di snier.

en: For a wound may be bound up, and after abuse there may be reconciliation; but he who reveals secrets is without hope.
target: Kaa a woun kyan bong op, an aafta abyuuz dier kyan bi rekansilieshan; bot im uu riviil siikrit dem a widout uop.

en: One who winks the eye contrives evil things; and those who know him will keep their distance.
target: Uan uu wingk im ai kantraiv iivl ting dem; an dem uu nuo im wi kiip dem distans.

en: When you are present, he will speak sweetly, and will admire your words; but afterward he will twist his speech and set a trap in your words.
target: Wen yu prezant, im wi taak swiitli, an wi admaiya yu wod dem; bot aaftawod im wi twis im spiich an set a trap ina yu wod dem.

en: I have hated many things, but nothing like him. The Lord will hate him.
target: Mi iet meni ting, bot notn laik im. Di Laad wi iet im.

en: One who casts a stone straight up casts it on his own head. A deceitful blow opens wounds.
target: Uan uu kaas a stuon striet op kaas it pan im uon ed. A disiitful bluo uopn woun dem.

en: He who digs a pit will fall into it. He who sets a snare will be caught in it.
target: Im uu dig a pit wi faal ina it. Im uu set a snier wi kaat ina it.

en: He who does evil things, they will roll back upon him, and he will not know where they came from.
target: Im uu du iivl ting dem, dem wi ruol bak pan im, an im naa nuo we dem kom fram.

en: Mockery and reproach are from the arrogant. Vengeance lies in wait for them like a lion.
target: Makri an ripruoch kom fram di aarogant dem. Venjans lai ina wiet fi dem laik a laian.

en: Those who rejoice at the fall of the godly will be caught in a snare. Anguish will consume them before they die.
target: Dem uu rijais a di faal a di raichos dem wi kaat ina a snier. Angwish wi kansyuum dem bifuo dem ded.

en: Wrath and anger, these also are detestable things. A sinner will possess them.
target: Raat an anga, dem tuu a ditestebl ting dem. A sina wi pozes dem.

en: He who takes vengeance will find vengeance from the Lord, and he will surely make his sins firm.
target: Im uu tek venjans wi fain venjans fram di Laad, an im wi shuor mek im sin dem form.

en: Forgive your neighbor the hurt that he has done, and then your sins will be pardoned when you pray.
target: Fagiv yu nieba di ort we im du, an den yu sin dem wi paadn wen yu prie.

en: Does anyone harbor anger against another and expect healing from the Lord?
target: Enibadi aaba anga gens anada an expek iilin fram di Laad?

en: Upon a man like himself he has no mercy, and does he make supplication for his own sins?
target: Pan a man laik imself im av no mersi, an im mek soplikieshan fi im uon sin dem?

en: He himself, being flesh, nourishes wrath. Who will make atonement for his sins?
target: Imself, biin flesh, norish raat. Uu wi mek atonment fi im sin dem?

en: Remember your last end, and stop enmity. Remember corruption and death, and be true to the commandments.
target: Memba yu laas en, an tap enmiti. Memba koropshan an det, an bi chuu tu di komanment dem.

en: Remember the commandments, and don’t be angry with your neighbor. Remember the covenant of the Highest, and overlook ignorance.
target: Memba di komanment dem, an no bex wid yu nieba. Memba di kovnant a di Mos Ai, an uovaluk ignarans.

en: Abstain from strife, and you will diminish your sins, for a passionate man will kindle strife.
target: Abstien fram straif, an yu wi diminish yu sin dem, kaa a pashanet man wi kindl straif.

en: A man who is a sinner will trouble friends and sow discord among those who are at peace.
target: A man uu a sina wi chrobl fren dem an suo diskaad mongx dem uu a piis.

en: As is the fuel of the fire, so it will burn; and as the stoutness of the strife is, so it will burn. As is the strength of the man, so will be his wrath; and as is his wealth, so he will exalt his anger.
target: Az a di fyuuel a di faiya, so it wi bon; an az a di stoutnis a di straif, so it wi bon. Az a di strent a di man, so wi bi im raat; an az a im welt, so im wi egzaalt im anga.

en: A contention begun in haste kindles a fire; and hasty fighting sheds blood.
target: A kantenshan bigin ina ies kindl a faiya; an iesti faitin shed blod.

en: If you blow on a spark, it will burn; and if you spit upon it, it will be quenched. Both of these come out of your mouth.
target: Ef yu bluo pan a spaak, it wi bon; an ef yu spit pan it, it wi kwench. Buot a dem kom outa yu mout.

en: Curse the whisperer and double-tongued, for he has destroyed many who were at peace.
target: Kos di wispara an dobl-tong uan, kaa im distrai meni uu ben a piis.

en: A slanderer has shaken many, and dispersed them from nation to nation. It has pulled down strong cities and overthrown the houses of great men.
target: A slandara shek meni, an dispoors dem fram nieshan tu nieshan. It pul dong strang siti dem an uovachruo di ous dem a griet man dem.

en: A slanderer has cast out brave women and deprived them of their labors.
target: A slandara kaas out briev uman dem an dipraiv dem a dem lieba.

en: He who listens to it will not find rest, nor will he live quietly.
target: Im uu lisn tu it naa fain res, nar wi im liv kwaietli.

en: The stroke of a whip makes a mark in the flesh, but the stroke of a tongue will break bones.
target: Di struok a a wip mek a maak ina di flesh, bot di struok a a tong wi briek buon dem.

en: Many have fallen by the edge of the sword, yet not so many as those who have fallen because of the tongue.
target: Meni faal bai di ej a di suod, bot no so meni az dem uu faal bikaaz a di tong.

en: Happy is he who is sheltered from it, who has not passed through its wrath, who has not drawn its yoke, and has not been bound with its bands.
target: Api a im uu shelta fram it, uu no paas chruu it raat, uu no jraa it yoke, an no ben bong wid it ban dem.

en: For its yoke is a yoke of iron, and its bands are bands of brass.
target: Kaa it yoke a a yoke a aiyan, an it ban dem a ban a braas.

en: Its death is an evil death, and Hades is better than it.
target: It det a a iivl det, an Iidis beta dan it.

en: It will not have rule over godly men. They will not be burned in its flame.
target: It naa av ruul uova raichos man dem. Dem naa bon ina it fliem.

en: Those who forsake the Lord will fall into it. It will burn among them, and won’t be quenched. It will be sent against them like a lion. It will destroy them like a leopard.
target: Dem uu fasiek di Laad wi faal ina it. It wi bon mongx dem, an naa kwench. It wi sen gens dem laik a laian. It wi distrai dem laik a lepad.

en: As you hedge your possession about with thorns, and secure your silver and your gold,
target: Az yu ej yu pozeshan bout wid toon dem, an sikyuur yu silva an yu guol,

en: so make a balance and a weight for your words, and make a door and a bar for your mouth.
target: so mek a balans an a wiet fi yu wod dem, an mek a duor an a baar fi yu mout.

en: Take heed so that you don’t slip with it, or you will fall before one who lies in wait.
target: Tek iid so yu no slip wid it, ar yu wi faal bifuo uan uu lai ina wiet.

en: He who shows mercy will lend to his neighbor. He who strengthens him with his hand keeps the commandments.
target: Im uu shuo mersi wi len tu im nieba. Im uu strentn im wid im an kiip di komanment dem.

en: Lend to your neighbor in time of his need. Repay your neighbor on time.
target: Len tu yu nieba ina taim a im niid. Ripie yu nieba pan taim.

en: Confirm your word, and keep faith with him; and at all seasons you will find what you need.
target: Konform yu wod, an kiip fiet wid im; an a aal siizn yu wi fain wa yu niid.

en: Many have considered a loan to be a windfall, and have given trouble to those who helped them.
target: Meni kansida a luon fi bi a winfaal, an gi chrobl tu dem uu elp dem.

en: Until he has received, he will kiss a man’s hands. For his neighbor’s money he will speak submissively. Then when payment is due, he will prolong the time, return excuses, and complain about the season.
target: Ontil im risiev, im wi kis a man an dem. Fi im nieba moni im wi taak sobmisivli. Den wen piement juu, im wi pralong di taim, riton exkyuuz dem, an komplien bout di siizn.

en: If he prevails, the creditor will hardly receive half; and he will count it as a windfall. If not, he has deprived him of his money, and he has gotten him for an enemy without cause. He will pay him with cursing and railing. Instead of honor, he will pay him disgrace.
target: Ef im priviel, di kredita aali wi risiev aaf; an im wi kount it az a winfaal. Ef no, im dipraiv im a im moni, an im get im fi a enimi widout kaaz. Im wi pie im wid kosin an rielin. Insted a ana, im wi pie im disgriez.

en: Many on account of fraud have turned away. They are afraid of being defrauded for nothing.
target: Meni bikaaz a fraad ton awie. Dem fried fi get difraad fi notn.

en: However be patient with a man in poor estate. Don’t keep him waiting for your gift.
target: Oueva bi pieshent wid a man ina puo estiet. No kiip im wietin fi yu gif.

en: Help a poor man for the commandment’s sake. According to his need don’t send him empty away.
target: Elp a puo man fi di komanment siek. Akaadin tu im niid no sen im awie emti.

en: Lose your money for a brother and a friend. Don’t let it rust under a stone and be lost.
target: Luuz yu moni fi a breda an a fren. No mek it ros anda a stuon an lus.

en: Allocate your treasure according to the commandments of the Most High and it will profit you more than gold.
target: Alokiet yu treja akaadin tu di komanment dem a di Mos Ai an it wi prafit yu muor dan guol.

en: Store up almsgiving in your store-chambers and it will deliver you out of all affliction.
target: Stuur op aamzgivin ina yu stuur-chiemba dem an it wi diliva yu outa aal aflikshan.

en: It will fight for you against your enemy better than a mighty shield and a ponderous spear.
target: It wi fait fi yu gens yu enimi beta dan a maiti shiil an a evi spiir.

en: A good man will be surety for his neighbor. He who has lost shame will fail him.
target: A gud man wi bi shuuriti fi im nieba. Im uu lus shiem wi fiel im.

en: Don’t forget the kindness of your guarantor, for he has given his life for you.
target: No faget di kainnis a yu gyaranta, kaa im gi im laif fi yu.

en: A sinner will waste the property of his guarantor.
target: A sina wi wies di prapati a im gyaranta.

en: He who is thankless will fail him who delivered him.
target: Im uu tangkles wi fiel im uu diliva im.

en: Being surety has undone many who were prospering and shaken them as a wave of the sea. It has driven mighty men from their homes. They wandered among foreign nations.
target: Biin shuuriti ondu meni uu ben prasperin an shek dem laik a wiev a di sii. It jraiv maiti man dem fram dem uom dem. Dem wanda mongx farin nieshan dem.

en: A sinner who falls into suretiship and undertakes contracts for work will fall into lawsuits.
target: A sina uu faal ina shuuritiship an andatiek kantrak fi wok wi faal ina laasuut dem.

en: Help your neighbor according to your power, and be careful not to fall yourself.
target: Elp yu nieba akaadin tu yu powa, an bi kierful no fi faal yuself.

en: The essentials of life are water, bread, a garment, and a house for privacy.
target: Di esenshal dem a laif a waata, bred, a gaament, an a ous fi praivisi.

en: Better is the life of a poor man under a shelter of logs than sumptuous fare in another man’s house.
target: Beta a di laif a a puo man anda a shelta a lag dem dan somchuos fier ina anada man ous.

en: With little or with much, be well satisfied.
target: Wid likl ar wid moch, bi wel satisfai.

en: It is a miserable life to go from house to house. Where you are a guest, you dare not open your mouth.
target: It a a mizirebl laif fi go fram ous tu ous. We yu a ges, yu no dier uopn yu mout.

en: You will entertain, serve drinks, and have no thanks. In addition to this, you will hear bitter words.
target: Yu wi entatien, sorv jringk dem, an av no tangks. In adishan tu dis, yu wi ier bita wod dem.

en: “Come here, you sojourner, set a table, and if you have anything in your hand, feed me with it.”
target: “Kom ier, yu sojorna, set a tiebl, an ef yu av eniting ina yu an, fiid mi wid it.”

en: “Leave, you sojourner, for an honored guest is here. My brother has come to be my guest. I need my house.”
target: “Liiv, yu sojorna, kaa a anad ges ier. Mi breda kom fi bi mi ges. Mi niid mi ous.”

en: These things are grievous to a man of understanding: The scolding about lodging and the insults of creditors.
target: Dem ting griivos tu a man a andastandin: Di skuoldin bout lajin an di insult dem a kredita dem.

en: He who loves his son will continue to lay stripes upon him, that he may have joy from him in the end.
target: Im uu lov im son wi kantinyu fi lie straip pan im, dat im kyan av jai fram im ina di en.

en: He who chastises his son will have profit from him, and will brag about him among his acquaintances.
target: Im uu chastaiz im son wi av prafit fram im, an wi brag bout im mongx im akwientans dem.

en: He who teaches his son will provoke his enemy to jealousy. Before friends, he will rejoice in him.
target: Im uu tiich im son wi provuok im enimi tu jelosi. Bifuo fren dem, im wi rijais ina im.

en: His father dies, and is as though he had not died; for he has left one behind him like himself.
target: Im faada ded, an a az duo im no ben ded; kaa im lef uan baka im laik imself.

en: In his life, he saw his son and rejoiced. When he died, it was without regret.
target: Ina im laif, im si im son an rijais. Wen im ded, it ben widout rigret.
