en: He left behind him an avenger against his enemies, and one to repay kindness to his friends.
target: Im lef baka im a avenja gens im enimi dem, an uan fi ripie kainnis tu im fren dem.

en: He who makes too much of his son will bind up his wounds. His heart will be troubled at every cry.
target: Im uu mek tuu moch a im son wi bain op im woun dem. Im aat wi chrobl a evri krai.

en: An unbroken horse becomes stubborn. An unrestrained son becomes headstrong.
target: A onbruokn aas bikom stobon. A onristriend son bikom edstrang.

en: Pamper your child, and he will make you afraid. Play with him, and he will grieve you.
target: Pampa yu pikni, an im wi mek yu fried. Plie wid im, an im wi griiv yu.

en: Don’t laugh with him, or you will have sorrow with him, and will gnash your teeth in the end.
target: No laaf wid im, ar yu wi av sara wid im, an wi gnash yu tiit ina di en.

en: Give him no liberty in his youth, and don’t ignore his follies.
target: Gi im no libati ina im yuut, an no ignuor im fali dem.

en: Bow down his neck in his youth, and beat him on the sides while he is a child, or he will become stubborn, and be disobedient to you, and there will be sorrow to your soul.
target: Bou dong im nek ina im yuut, an biit im pan im said dem wail im a pikni, ar im wi bikom stobon, an disobey yu, an dier wi bi sara tu yu suol.

en: Discipline your son, and give him work, or his shameless behavior will be an offense to you.
target: Disiplin yu son, an gi im wok, ar im shiemles biyevia wi bi a ofens tu yu.

en: Better is a poor man who is healthy and fit, than a rich man who is afflicted in his body.
target: Beta a a puo man uu elti an fit, dan a rich man uu aflik ina im badi.

en: Health and fitness are better than all gold, and a strong body better than wealth without measure.
target: Elt an fitnis beta dan aal guol, an a strang badi beta dan welt widout meja.

en: There is no wealth better than health of body. There is no gladness above the joy of the heart.
target: Dier a no welt beta dan elt a badi. Dier a no gladnis abov di jai a di aat.

en: Death is better than a bitter life, and eternal rest than a continual sickness.
target: Det beta dan a bita laif, an itoornal res dan a kantinyual siknis.

en: Good things poured out upon a mouth that is closed are like food offerings laid upon a grave.
target: Gud ting dem puor out pan a mout we kloz a laik fuud aafrin dem lied pan a griev.

en: What does an offering profit an idol? For it can’t eat or smell. So is he who is punished by the Lord,
target: Wa a aafrin prafit a aidol? Kaa it kyaa iit ar smel. So a im uu ponish bai di Laad,

en: seeing with his eyes and groaning, like a eunuch embracing a virgin and groaning.
target: a si wid im ai dem an a gruon, laik a yuunok a embries a vorjin an a gruon.

en: Don’t give your soul to sorrow. Don’t afflict yourself deliberately.
target: No gi yu suol tu sara. No aflik yuself dilibaretli.

en: Gladness of heart is the life of a man. Cheerfulness of a man lengthens his days.
target: Gladnis a aat a di laif a a man. Chiirfulnis a a man lentn im die dem.

en: Love your own soul, and comfort your heart. Remove sorrow far from you, for sorrow has destroyed many, and there is no profit in it.
target: Lov yu uon suol, an komfat yu aat. Rimuuv sara faar fram yu, kaa sara distrai meni, an dier a no prafit ina it.

en: Envy and wrath shorten life. Anxiety brings old age before its time.
target: Envi an raat shaatn laif. Angzaiyati bring uol iej bifuo it taim.

en: Those who are cheerful and merry will benefit from their food.
target: Dem uu chiirful an meri wi benefit fram dem fuud.

en: Wakefulness that comes from riches consumes the flesh, and anxiety about it takes away sleep.
target: Wiekfulnis we kom fram richiz kansyuum di flesh, an angzaiyati bout it tek awie sliip.

en: Wakeful anxiety will crave slumber. In a severe disease, sleep will be broken.
target: Wiekful angzaiyati wi kriev slomba. Ina a siviir diziiz, sliip wi bruk.

en: A rich man toils in gathering money together. When he rests, he is filled with his good things.
target: A rich man tail ina gyaderin moni tugeda. Wen im res, im ful wid im gud ting dem.

en: A poor man toils in lack of substance. When he rests, he becomes needy.
target: A puo man tail ina lak a sobstans. Wen im res, im bikom niidi.

en: He who loves gold won’t be justified. He who follows destruction will himself have his fill of it.
target: Im uu lov guol naa get jostifai. Im uu fala distrokshan wi imself av im fil a it.

en: Many have been given over to ruin for the sake of gold. Their destruction meets them face to face.
target: Meni get gi uova tu ruin fi di siek a guol. Dem distrokshan miit dem fies tu fies.

en: It is a stumbling block to those who sacrifice to it. Every fool will be taken by it.
target: It a a stomblin blak tu dem uu sakrifais tu it. Evri fuul wi tek bai it.

en: Blessed is the rich person who is found blameless, and who doesn’t go after gold.
target: Bles a di rich porsn uu fain bliemles, an uu no go aafta guol.

en: Who is he, that we may call him blessed? For he has done wonderful things among his people.
target: Uu a im, dat wi kyan kaal im bles? Kaa im du wandaful ting dem mongx im piipl.

en: Who has been tried by it, and found perfect? Then let him boast. Who has had the power to transgress, and has not transgressed? And to do evil, and has not done it?
target: Uu ben chrai bai it, an fain porfek? Den mek im buos. Uu av di powa fi transgres, an no transgres? An fi du iivl, an no du it?

en: His prosperity will be made sure. The congregation will proclaim his almsgiving.
target: Im prasperiti wi mek shuur. Di kanggrigieshan wi pro kliem im aamzgivin.

en: Do you sit at a great table? Don’t be greedy there. Don’t say, “There is a lot of food on it!”
target: Yu sidong a a griet tiebl? No bi griidi dier. No se, “Dier a nof fuud pan it!”

en: Remember that a greedy eye is a wicked thing. What has been created more greedy than an eye? Therefore it sheds tears from every face.
target: Memba dat a griidi ai a a wikid ting. Wa kriet muor griidi dan a ai? Dierfuo it shed tiirz fram evri fies.

en: Don’t stretch your hand wherever it looks. Don’t thrust yourself with it into the dish.
target: No strech yu an weieva it luk. No chros yuself wid it ina di dish.

en: Consider your neighbor’s feelings by your own. Be discreet in every point.
target: Kansida yu nieba fiilin dem bai yu uon. Bi diskriit ina evri paint.

en: Eat like a human being those things which are set before you. Don’t eat greedily, or you will be hated.
target: Iit laik a yuuman biin dem ting we set bifuo yu. No iit griidili, ar yu wi get iet.

en: Be first to stop for manners’ sake. Don’t be insatiable, or you will offend.
target: Bi fos fi tap fi mana siek. No bi insieshebl, ar yu wi aafend.

en: And if you sit among many, Don’t reach out your hand before them.
target: An ef yu sidong mongx meni, no riich out yu an bifuo dem.

en: How sufficient to a well-mannered man is a very little. He doesn’t breathe heavily in his bed.
target: Ou sofishent tu a wel-manad man a a veri likl. Im no briid evili ina im bed.

en: Healthy sleep comes from moderate eating. He rises early, and his wits are with him. The pain of wakefulness, colic, and griping are with an insatiable man.
target: Elti sliip kom fram madaret iitin. Im raiz orli, an im wit dem wid im. Di pien a wiekfulnis, kalik, an graipin a wid a insieshebl man.

en: And if you have been forced to eat, rise up in the middle of it, and you will have rest.
target: An ef yu get fuos fi iit, raiz op ina di migl a it, an yu wi av res.

en: Hear me, my son, and don’t despise me, and in the end you will appreciate my words. In all your works be skillful, and no disease will come to you.
target: Ier mi, mi son, an no dispaiz mi, an ina di en yu wi aprishiet mi wod dem. Ina aal yu wok dem bi skilful, an no diziiz wi kom tu yu.

en: People bless him who is liberal with his food. The testimony of his excellence will be believed.
target: Piipl bles im uu libaral wid im fuud. Di testimuoni a im excelens wi biliiv.

en: The city will murmur at him who is a stingy with his food. The testimony of his stinginess will be accurate.
target: Di siti wi morma a im uu stinji wid im fuud. Di testimuoni a im stinjinis wi akioret.

en: Don’t show yourself valiant in wine, for wine has destroyed many.
target: No shuo yuself valiant ina wain, kaa wain distrai meni.

en: The furnace tests the temper of steel by dipping; so does wine test hearts in the quarreling of the proud.
target: Di fornis tes di tempa a stiil bai dipin; so wain tes aat dem ina di kwarlin a di proud dem.

en: Wine is as good as life to men, if you drink it in moderation. What life is there to a man who is without wine? It has been created to make men glad.
target: Wain gud az laif tu man dem, ef yu jringk it ina madarieshan. Wa laif dier tu a man uu widout wain? It kriet fi mek man dem glad.

en: Wine drunk in season and in moderation is joy of heart and gladness of soul:
target: Wain jrongk ina siizn an ina madarieshan a jai a aat an gladnis a suol:

en: Wine drunk excessively is bitterness of soul, with provocation and conflict.
target: Wain jrongk excesivli a bitanis a suol, wid pravuokieshan an kanflik.

en: Drunkenness increases the rage of a fool to his hurt. It diminishes strength and adds wounds.
target: Jrongknis inkriis di riej a a fuul tu im ort. It diminish strent an ad woun dem.

en: Don’t rebuke your neighbor at a banquet of wine. Don’t despise him in his mirth. Don’t speak a word of reproach to him. Don’t distress him by making demands of him.
target: No ribyuuk yu nieba a a bankwet a wain. No dispaiz im ina im mort. No taak a wod a ripruoch tu im. No distres im bai mekin diman pan im.

en: Have they made you ruler of a feast? Don’t be lifted up. Be among them as one of them. Take care of them first, and then sit down.
target: Dem mek yu ruula a a fiis? No lif op yuself. Bi mongx dem az uan a dem. Tek kier a dem fos, an den sidong.

en: And when you have done all your duties, take your place, that you may be gladdened on their account, and receive a wreath for your good service.
target: An wen yu don aal yu juuti dem, tek yu plies, dat yu kyan gladn pan dem akaunt, an risiev a riit fi yu gud sorvis.

en: Speak, you who are older, for it’s your right, but with sound knowledge; and don’t interrupt the music.
target: Taak, yu uu uolda, kaa a yu rait, bot wid soun nalij; an no intarop di myuuzik.

en: Don’t pour out talk where there is a performance of music. Don’t display your wisdom at the wrong time.
target: No puor out taak we dier a a poformans a myuuzik. No displie yu wizdam a di rang taim.

en: As a ruby signet in a setting of gold, so is a music concert at a wine banquet.
target: Az a ruubi signet ina a setin a guol, so a a myuuzik kansort a a wain bankwet.

en: As an emerald signet in a work of gold, so is musical melody with pleasant wine.
target: Az a emrald signet ina a wok a guol, so a myuuzikal melodi wid plezant wain.

en: Speak, young man, if you are obliged to, but no more than twice, and only if asked.
target: Taak, yong man, ef yu abla ij tu, bot no muor dan twais, an onli ef aaks.

en: Sum up your speech, many things in few words. Be as one who knows and yet holds his tongue.
target: Som op yu spiich, meni ting ina fyuu wod. Bi az uan uu nuo an yet uol im tong.

en: When among great men, don’t behave as their equal. When another is speaking, don’t babble.
target: Wen mongx griet man dem, no biyev az dem iikwal. Wen anada a taak, no babl.

en: Lightning speeds before thunder. Approval goes before one who is modest.
target: Laitnin spiid bifuo tonda. Apruuval go bifuo uan uu madest.

en: Rise up in good time, and don’t be last. Go home quickly and don’t loiter
target: Raiz op ina gud taim, an no bi laas. Go uom kwikli an no laita

en: Amuse yourself there and do what is in your heart. Don’t sin by proud speech.
target: Amyuuz yuself dier an du wa ina yu aat. No sin bai proud spiich.

en: For these things bless your Maker, who gives you to drink freely of his good things.
target: Fi dem ting bles yu Mieka, uu gi yu fi jringk friili a im gud ting dem.

en: He who fears the Lord will receive discipline. Those who seek him early will find favor.
target: Im uu fiir di Laad wi risiev disiplin. Dem uu siik im orli wi fain fieva.

en: He who seeks the law will be filled with it, but the hypocrite will stumble at it.
target: Im uu siik di laa wi ful wid it, bot di ipokrit wi stombl a it.

en: Those who fear the Lord will find true judgment, and will kindle righteous acts like a light.
target: Dem uu fiir di Laad wi fain chuu jojment, an wi kindl raichos ak dem laik a lait.

en: A sinful man shuns reproof, and will find a judgment according to his will.
target: A sinful man shon ripruuf, an wi fain a jojment akaadin tu im wil.

en: A sensible person won’t neglect a thought. An insolent and proud man won’t crouch in fear, even after he has done a thing by himself without counsel.
target: A sensibl porsn naa neglek a taat. A insolent an proud man naa krouch ina fiir, iivn aafta im du a ting bai imself widout kounsl.

en: Do nothing without counsel, but when you have acted, don’t regret it.
target: Du notn widout kounsl, bot wen yu ak, no rigret it.

en: Don’t go in a way of conflict. Don’t stumble in stony places.
target: No go ina a wie a kanflik. No stombl ina stuoni plies dem.

en: Don’t be overconfident on a smooth road.
target: No bi uovakanfident pan a smuud ruod.

en: Beware of your own children.
target: Bewier a yu uon pikni dem.

en: In every work guard your own soul, for this is the keeping of the commandments.
target: Ina evri wok gyaad yu uon suol, kaa dis a di kiipin a di komanment dem.

en: He who believes the law gives heed to the commandment. He who trusts in the Lord will suffer no loss.
target: Im uu biliiv di laa gi iid tu di komanment. Im uu chros ina di Laad wi sofa no laas.

en: No evil will happen to him who fears the Lord, but in trials once and again he will deliver him.
target: No iivl wi apm tu im uu fiir di Laad, bot ina chraial dem uans an agen im wi diliva im.

en: A wise man will not hate the law, but he who is a hypocrite about it is like a boat in a storm.
target: A waiz man naa iet di laa, bot im uu a ipokrit bout it a laik a buot ina a staam.

en: A man of understanding will put his trust in the law. And the law is faithful to him, as when one asks a divine oracle.
target: A man a andastandin wi put im chros ina di laa. An di laa fietful tu im, az wen uan aaks a divain orakl.

en: Prepare your speech, and so you will be heard. Bind up instruction, and make your answer.
target: Pripier yu spiich, an so yu wi ier. Bain op instrokshan, an mek yu ansa.

en: The heart of a fool is like a cartwheel. His thoughts are like a rolling axle.
target: Di aat a a fuul laik a kyaatwiil. Im taat dem laik a ruolin aksl.

en: A stallion horse is like a mocking friend. He neighs under every one who sits upon him.
target: A staalyan aas laik a makin fren. Im nie anda evri uan uu sidong pan im.

en: Why does one day excel another, when all the light of every day in the year is from the sun?
target: Wai uan die excel anada, wen aal di lait a evri die ina di ier kom fram di son?

en: They were distinguished by the Lord’s knowledge, and he varied seasons and feasts.
target: Dem distingwish bai di Laads nalij, an im vieri siizn dem an fiis dem.

en: Some of them he exalted and consecrated, and some of them he has made ordinary days.
target: Som a dem im egzaalt an kansikriet, an som a dem im mek aadineri die dem.

en: And all men are from the ground. Adam was created from dust.
target: An aal man dem kom fram di grong. Aadam kriet fram dos.

en: In the abundance of his knowledge the Lord distinguished them, and made their ways different.
target: Ina di abundans a im nalij di Laad distingwish dem, an mek dem wie dem difrent.

en: Some of them he blessed and exalted, and some of them he consecrated and brought near to himself. Some of them he cursed and brought low, and overthrew them from their place.
target: Som a dem im bles an egzaalt, an som a dem im kansikriet an braat nier tu imself. Som a dem im kos an braat luo, an uovachruo dem fram dem plies.

en: As the clay of the potter in his hand, all his ways are according to his good pleasure, so men are in the hand of him who made them, to give to them according to his judgment.
target: Az di klie a di pata ina im an, aal im wie dem akaadin tu im gud pleja, so man dem ina di an a im uu mek dem, fi gi tu dem akaadin tu im jojment.

en: Good is the opposite of evil, and life is the opposite of death; so the sinner is the opposite of the godly.
target: Gud a di apozit a iivl, an laif a di apozit a det; so di sina a di apozit a di raichos uan.

en: Look upon all the works of the Most High like this, they come in pairs, one against another.
target: Luk pan aal di wok dem a di Mos Ai laik dis, dem kom ina pier, uan gens anada.

en: I was the last on watch, like one who gleans after the grape gatherers.
target: Mi ben di laas pan wach, laik uan uu gliin aafta di griep gyadara dem.

en: By the Lord’s blessing I arrived before them, and filled my winepress like one who gathers grapes.
target: Bai di Laads blesin mi araiv bifuo dem, an ful mi wainpres laik uan uu gyada griep dem.

en: Consider that I labored not for myself alone, but for all those who seek instruction.
target: Kansida dat mi lieba no fi miself aluon, bot fi aal dem uu siik instrokshan.

en: Hear me, you great men of the people, and listen with your ears, you rulers of the congregation.
target: Ier mi, unu griet man dem a di piipl, an lisn wid unu iirz, unu ruula dem a di kanggrigieshan.

en: To son and wife, to brother and friend, don’t give power over yourself while you live, and don’t give your goods to another, or you will regret it and must ask for them.
target: Tu son an waif, tu breda an fren, no gi powa uova yuself wail yu liv, an no gi yu gudz tu anada, ar yu wi rigret it an afi aaks fi dem.

en: While you still live and breath is in you, don’t give yourself over to anybody.
target: Wail yu stil liv an bret ina yu, no gi yuself uova tu enibadi.

en: For it is better that your children should ask from you than that you should look to the hand of your children.
target: Kaa it beta dat yu pikni dem shuda aaks fram yu dan dat yu shuda luk tu di an a yu pikni dem.

en: Excel in all your works. Don’t bring a stain on your honor.
target: Excel ina aal yu wok dem. No bring a stien pan yu ana.

en: In the day that you end the days of your life, in the time of death, distribute your inheritance.
target: Ina di die dat yu en di die dem a yu laif, ina di taim a det, distribyuut yu ineritans.

en: Fodder, a stick, and burdens are for a donkey. Bread, discipline, and work are for a servant.
target: Fada, a stik, an borden dem fi a danki. Bred, disiplin, an wok fi a sorvant.

en: Set your slave to work, and you will find rest. Leave his hands idle, and he will seek liberty.
target: Set yu sliev tu wok, an yu wi fain res. Liiv im an dem aidl, an im wi siik libati.

en: Yoke and whip will bow the neck. For an evil slave there are racks and tortures.
target: Yoke an wip wi bou di nek. Fi a iivl sliev dier a rak dem an taacha dem.

en: Send him to labor, that he not be idle, for idleness teaches much mischief.
target: Sen im tu lieba, dat im no bi aidl, kaa aidlnis tiich moch mischif.

en: Set him to work, as is fit for him. If he doesn’t obey, make his chains heavy.
target: Set im tu wok, az fit fi im. Ef im no obie, mek im chien dem evi.

en: Don’t be excessive toward any. Do nothing unjust.
target: No bi excesiv tuwad eni. Du notn onjos.

en: If you have a slave, treat him like yourself, because you have bought him with blood.
target: Ef yu av a sliev, chriit im laik yuself, bikaaz yu bai im wid blod.

en: If you have a slave, treat him like yourself. For like your own soul, you will need him. If you treat him ill, and he departs and runs away,
target: Ef yu av a sliev, chriit im laik yuself. Kaa laik yu uon suol, yu wi niid im. Ef yu chriit im il, an im dipaat an ron awie,

en: which way will you go to seek him?
target: wich wie yu wi go fi siik im?

en: Vain and false hopes are for a man void of understanding. Dreams give wings to fools.
target: Vien an faals uop dem fi a man vaid a andastandin. Driim dem gi wing tu fuul dem.

en: As one who grasps at a shadow and follows after the wind, so is he who sets his mind on dreams.
target: Az uan uu graas a a shado an fala aafta di win, so a im uu set im main pan driim dem.

en: The vision of dreams is a reflection, the likeness of a face near a face.
target: Di vizhan a driim dem a a riflekshan, di laiknis a a fies nier a fies.

en: From an unclean thing what can be cleansed? From that which is false what can be true?
target: Fram a onkliin ting wa kyan klenz? Fram dat we faals wa kyan bi chuu?

en: Divinations, and soothsayings, and dreams, are vain. The heart has fantasies like a woman in labor.
target: Divinieshan dem, an suutseyin dem, an driim dem, a vien. Di aat av fantasi dem laik a uman ina lieba.

en: If they are not sent in a visitation from the Most High, don’t give your heart to them.
target: Ef dem no sen ina a vizitieshan fram di Mos Ai, no gi yu aat tu dem.

en: For dreams have led many astray. They have failed by putting their hope in them.
target: Kaa driim dem led meni astrie. Dem fiel bai putin dem uop ina dem.

en: Without lying the law will be fulfilled. Wisdom is complete in a faithful mouth.
target: Widout laiin di laa wi fulfil. Wizdam kompliit ina a fietful mout.

en: A well-instructed man knows many things. He who has much experience will declare understanding.
target: A wel-instrok man nuo meni ting. Im uu av moch expiriens wi diklier andastandin.

en: He who has no experience knows few things. But he who has traveled increases cleverness.
target: Im uu av no expiriens nuo fyuu ting. Bot im uu chravl inkriis klevanis.

en: I have seen many things in my travels. My understanding is more than my words.
target: Mi si meni ting ina mi chravl dem. Mi andastandin muor dan mi wod dem.

en: I was often in danger even to death. I was preserved because of these experiences.
target: Mi ben aafn ina dienja iivn tu det. Mi prizorv bikaaz a dem expiriens dem.

en: The spirit of those who fear the Lord will live, for their hope is in him who saves them.
target: Di spirit a dem uu fiir di Laad wi liv, kaa dem uop a ina im uu siev dem.

en: Whoever fears the Lord won’t be afraid, and won’t be a coward, for he is his hope.
target: Uueva fiir di Laad naa fried, an naa bi a kouad, kaa im a im uop.

en: Blessed is the soul of him who fears the Lord. To whom does he give heed? Who is his support?
target: Bles a di suol a im uu fiir di Laad. Tu uu im gi iid? Uu a im sapuot?

en: The eyes of the Lord are on those who love him, a mighty protection and strong support, a cover from the hot blast, a shade from the noonday sun, a guard from stumbling, and a help from falling.
target: Di ai dem a di Laad pan dem uu lov im, a maiti protekshan an strang sapuot, a kova fram di at blaas, a shied fram di nuunde son, a gyaad fram stomblin, an a elp fram faalin.

en: He raises up the soul, and enlightens the eyes. He gives health, life, and blessing.
target: Im riez op di suol, an enlaitn di ai dem. Im gi elt, laif, an blesin.

en: He who sacrifices a thing wrongfully gotten, his offering is made in mockery. The mockeries of wicked men are not acceptable.
target: Im uu sakrifais a ting rangfuli gatan, im aafrin mek ina makri. Di makri dem a wikid man dem no akseptabl.

en: The Most High has no pleasure in the offerings of the ungodly, Neither is he pacified for sins by the multitude of sacrifices.
target: Di Mos Ai av no pleja ina di aafrin dem a di onraichos dem, niida im pasifai fi sin dem bai di moltityuud a sakrifais dem.

en: Like one who kills a son before his father’s eyes is he who brings a sacrifice from the goods of the poor.
target: Laik uan uu kil a son bifuo im faada ai dem a im uu bring a sakrifais fram di gudz a di puo dem.

en: The bread of the needy is the life of the poor. He who deprives him of it is a man of blood.
target: Di bred a di niidi a di laif a di puo dem. Im uu dipraiv im a it a a man a blod.

en: Like one who murders his neighbor is he who takes away his living. Like a shedder of blood is he who deprives a hireling of his hire.
target: Laik uan uu morda im nieba a im uu tek awie im livin. Laik a sheda a blod a im uu dipraiv a aiyalin a im aiya.

en: When one builds, and another pulls down, what profit do they have but toil?
target: Wen uan bil, an anada pul dong, wa prafit dem av bot tail?

en: When one prays, and another curses, whose voice will the Lord listen to?
target: Wen uan prie, an anada kos, uus vais di Laad wi lisn tu?

en: He who washes himself after touching a dead body, and touches it again, what does he gain by his washing?
target: Im uu wash imself aafta tochin a ded badi, an toch it agen, wa im gien bai im washin?

en: Even so a man fasting for his sins, and going again, and doing the same, who will listen to his prayer? What profit does he have in his humiliation?
target: Iivn so a man faasin fi im sin dem, an a go agen, an a du di siem, uu wi lisn tu im prier? Wa prafit im av ina im yuumilieshan?

en: He who keeps the law multiplies offerings. He who heeds the commandments sacrifices a peace offering.
target: Im uu kiip di laa moltiplai aafrin dem. Im uu iid di komanment dem sakrifais a piis aafrin.

en: He who returns a kindness offers fine flour. He who gives to the poor sacrifices a thank offering.
target: Im uu riton a kainnis aafa fain flowa. Im uu gi tu di puo dem sakrifais a tangk aafrin.

en: To depart from wickedness pleases the Lord. To depart from unrighteousness is an atoning sacrifice.
target: Fi dipaat fram wikidnis pliiz di Laad. Fi dipaat fram onraichosnis a a atonin sakrifais.

en: See that you don’t appear in the presence of the Lord empty.
target: Si dat yu no apiir ina di prezans a di Laad emti.

en: For all these things are done because of the commandment.
target: Kaa aal dem ting du bikaaz a di komanment.

en: The offering of the righteous enriches the altar. The sweet fragrance of it is before the Most High.
target: Di aafrin a di raichos uan enrich di aalta. Di swiit friegrans a it bifuo di Mos Ai.

en: The sacrifice of a righteous man is acceptable. It won’t be forgotten.
target: Di sakrifais a a raichos man akseptabl. It naa faget.

en: Glorify the Lord with generosity. Don’t reduce the first fruits of your hands.
target: Gluorifai di Laad wid jenarasiti. No ridyuus di fos fruut dem a yu an dem.

en: In every gift show a cheerful countenance, And dedicate your tithe with gladness.
target: Ina evri gif shuo a chiirful fies, an dedikiet yu tait wid gladnis.

en: Give to the Most High according as he has given. As your hand has found, give generously.
target: Gi tu di Mos Ai akaadin az im gi. Az yu an fain, gi jenarosli.

en: For the Lord repays, and he will repay you sevenfold.
target: Kaa di Laad ripie, an im wi ripie yu sevnfuol.

en: Don’t plan to bribe him with gifts, for he will not receive them. Don’t set your mind on an unrighteous sacrifice, For the Lord is the judge, and with him is no respect of persons.
target: No plan fi braib im wid gif dem, kaa im naa risiev dem. No set yu main pan a onraichos sakrifais, kaa di Laad a di joj, an wid im a no rispek a porsn dem.

en: He won’t accept any person against a poor man. He will listen to the prayer of him who is wronged.
target: Im naa aksep eni porsn gens a puo man. Im wi lisn tu di prier a im uu rang.

en: He will in no way despise the supplication of the fatherless or the widow, when she pours out her tale.
target: Im naa dispaiz di soplikieshan a di faadales ar di wido, wen shi puor out ar tiel.

en: Don’t the tears of the widow run down her cheek? Isn’t her cry against him who has caused them to fall?
target: Di tiirz dem a di wido no ron dong ar chiik? Ar krai no gens im uu kaaz dem fi faal?

en: He who serves God according to his good pleasure will be accepted. His supplication will reach to the clouds.
target: Im uu sorv Gad akaadin tu im gud pleja wi aksep. Im soplikieshan wi riich tu di kloud dem.

en: The prayer of the humble pierces the clouds. until it comes near, he will not be comforted. He won’t depart until the Most High visits and he judges righteously and executes judgment.
target: Di prier a di ombl piirs di kloud dem. Ontil it kom nier, im naa komfat. Im naa dipaat ontil di Mos Ai vizit an im joj raichosli an exekyuut jojment.

en: And the Lord will not be slack, neither will he be patient toward them, until he has crushed the loins of the unmerciful. He will repay vengeance to the heathen until he has taken away the multitude of the arrogant and broken in pieces the sceptres of the unrighteous,
target: An di Laad naa slak, niida wi im bi pieshent tuwad dem, ontil im krosh di lain dem a di onmersiful dem. Im wi ripie venjans tu di iitn dem ontil im tek awie di moltityuud a di aarogant dem an bruk ina piisiz di septa dem a di onraichos dem,

en: until he has rendered to every man according to his deeds, and repaid the works of men according to their plans, until he has judged the cause of his people, and he will make them rejoice in his mercy.
target: ontil im renda tu evri man akaadin tu im diid dem, an ripie di wok dem a man dem akaadin tu dem plan dem, ontil im joj di kaaz a im piipl, an im wi mek dem rijais ina im mersi.

en: Mercy is as welcome in the time of his affliction, as clouds of rain in the time of drought.
target: Mersi welkom ina di taim a im aflikshan, az kloud dem a rien ina di taim a drout.

en: Have mercy upon us, O Lord the God of all, and look at us with favor;
target: Av mersi pan wi, O Laad di Gad a aal, an luk pan wi wid fieva;

en: and send your fear upon all the nations.
target: an sen yu fiir pan aal di nieshan dem.

en: Lift up your hand against the foreign nations and let them see your mighty power.
target: Lif op yu an gens di farin nieshan dem an mek dem si yu maiti powa.

en: As you showed your holiness in us before them, so be magnified in them before us.
target: Az yu shuo yu uolinis ina wi bifuo dem, so bi magnifai ina dem bifuo wi.

en: Let them know you, as we also have known you, that there is no God but only you, O God.
target: Mek dem nuo yu, az wi tu nuo yu, dat dier a no Gad bot onli yu, O Gad.

en: Show new signs, and work various wonders. Glorify your hand and your right arm.
target: Shuo nyuu sain dem, an wok vierios wanda dem. Gluorifai yu an an yu rait aam.

en: Raise up indignation and pour out wrath. Take away the adversary and destroy the enemy.
target: Riez op indignieshan an puor out raat. Tek awie di advasari an distrai di enimi.

en: Hasten the time and remember your oath. Let them declare your mighty works.
target: Iesn di taim an memba yu uot. Mek dem diklier yu maiti wok dem.

en: Let him who escapes be devoured by raging fire. May those who harm your people find destruction.
target: Mek im uu eskiep get divour bai riejin faiya. Mie dem uu aam yu piipl fain distrokshan.

en: Crush the heads of the rulers of the enemies who say, “There is no one but ourselves.”
target: Krosh di ed dem a di ruula dem a di enimi dem uu se, “Dier a non bot wiself.”

en: Gather all the tribes of Jacob together, and take them for your inheritance, as from the beginning.
target: Gyada aal di traib dem a Jiekob tugeda, an tek dem fi yu ineritans, az fram di biginin.

en: O Lord, have mercy upon the people that is called by your name, and upon Israel, whom you likened to a firstborn.
target: O Laad, av mersi pan di piipl dat kaal bai yu niem, an pan Izrel, uu yu laikn tu a fosbaan.

en: Have compassion upon the city of your sanctuary, Jerusalem, the place of your rest.
target: Av kompashan pan di siti a yu sangkchuari, Jeruusalem, di plies a yu res.

en: Fill Zion. Exalt your oracles and fill your people with your glory.
target: Fil Zaian. Egzaalt yu orakl dem an ful yu piipl wid yu gluori.

en: Give testimony to those who were your creatures in the beginning, and fulfill the prophecies that have been spoken in your name.
target: Gi testimuoni tu dem uu ben yu kriicha dem ina di biginin, an fulfil di prafisi dem we taak ina yu niem.

en: Reward those who wait for you, and men will put their trust in your prophets.
target: Riwaad dem uu wiet fi yu, an man dem wi put dem chros ina yu prafit dem.

en: Listen, O Lord, to the prayer of your servants, according to the blessing of Aaron concerning your people; and all those who are on the earth will know that you are the Lord, the eternal God.
target: Lisn, O Laad, tu di prier a yu sorvant dem, akaadin tu di blesin a Ieran kansoornin yu piipl; an aal dem uu pan di ort wi nuo dat yu a di Laad, di itoornal Gad.

en: The belly will eat any food, but one food is better than another.
target: Di beli wi iit eni fuud, bot uan fuud beta dan anada.

en: The mouth tastes meats taken in hunting, so does an understanding heart detect false speech.
target: Di mout ties miit dem tek ina ontin, so a andastandin aat ditek faals spiich.

en: A contrary heart will cause heaviness. A man of experience will pay him back.
target: A kantreri aat wi kaaz evinis. A man a expiriens wi pie im bak.

en: A woman will receive any man, but one daughter is better than another.
target: A uman wi risiev eni man, bot uan daata beta dan anada.

en: The beauty of a woman cheers the countenance. A man desires nothing more.
target: Di byuuti a a uman chiir di fies. A man dizaiya notn muor.

en: If kindness and humility are on her tongue, her husband is not like other sons of men.
target: Ef kainnis an yuumiliti pan ar tong, ar ozban no laik ada son dem a man dem.

en: He who gets a wife gets his richest treasure, a help meet for him and a pillar of support.
target: Im uu get a waif get im richis treja, a elp miit fi im an a pila a sapuot.

en: Where no hedge is, the property will be plundered. He who has no wife will mourn as he wanders.
target: We no ej de, di prapati wi plonda. Im uu av no waif wi muorn az im wanda.

en: For who would trust a nimble robber who skips from city to city? Even so, who would trust a man who has no nest, and lodges wherever he finds himself at nightfall?
target: Kaa uu wuda chros a nimbl raba uu skip fram siti tu siti? Iivn so, uu wuda chros a man uu av no nes, an laj weieva im fain imself a naitfaal?

en: Every friend will say, “I also am his friend”; but there is a friend which is only a friend in name.
target: Evri fren wi se, “Mi tu a im fren”; bot dier a a fren we onli a fren ina niem.

en: Isn’t there a grief in it even to death when a companion and friend is turned into an enemy?
target: Dier no a griif ina it iivn tu det wen a kompanyan an fren ton ina a enimi?

en: O wicked imagination, why were you formed to cover the dry land with deceit?
target: O wikid imajinieshan, wai yu faam fi kova di jrai lan wid disiit?

en: There is a companion who rejoices in the gladness of a friend, but in time of affliction will be against him.
target: Dier a a kompanyan uu rijais ina di gladnis a a fren, bot ina taim a aflikshan wi bi gens im.

en: There is a companion who for the belly’s sake labors with his friend, yet in the face of battle will carry his shield.
target: Dier a a kompanyan uu fi di beli siek lieba wid im fren, bot ina di fies a batl wi kyari im shiil.

en: Don’t forget a friend in your soul. Don’t be unmindful of him in your riches.
target: No faget a fren ina yu suol. No bi onmainful a im ina yu richiz.

en: Every counselor extols counsel, but some give counsel in their own interest.
target: Evri kounsla egzaalt kounsl, bot som gi kounsl ina dem uon intres.

en: Let your soul beware of a counselor, and know in advance what is his interest (for he will take counsel for himself), or he may cast the lot against you,
target: Mek yu suol bewier a a kounsla, an nuo ina advans wa a im intres (kaa im wi tek kounsl fi imself), ar im kyan kaas di lat gens yu,

en: and say to you, “Your way is good.” Then he will stand near you, to see what will happen to you.
target: an se tu yu, “Yu wie gud.” Den im wi tan nier yu, fi si wa wi apm tu yu.

en: Don’t take counsel with one who looks askance at you. Hide your counsel from those who are jealous of you.
target: No tek kounsl wid uan uu luk askans a yu. Aid yu kounsl fram dem uu jelas a yu.

en: Don’t consult with a woman about her rival, with a coward about war, with a merchant about business, with a buyer about selling, with an envious man about thankfulness, with an unmerciful man about kindliness, with a sluggard about any kind of work, with a hireling in your house about finishing his work, or with an idle servant about much business. Pay no attention to these in any matter of counsel.
target: No kansolt wid a uman bout ar raival, wid a kouad bout waar, wid a morchant bout biznis, wid a baiya bout selin, wid a envios man bout tangkfulnis, wid a onmersiful man bout kainlinis, wid a slogad bout eni kain a wok, wid a aiyalin ina yu ous bout finishin im wok, ar wid a aidl sorvant bout moch biznis. Pie no atenshan tu dem ina eni mata a kounsl.

en: But rather be continually with a godly man, whom you know to be a keeper of the commandments, who in his soul is as your own soul, and who will grieve with you, if you fail.
target: Bot raada bi kantinyuali wid a raichos man, uu yu nuo fi bi a kiipa a di komanment dem, uu ina im suol a az yu uon suol, an uu wi griiv wid yu, ef yu fiel.

en: Make the counsel of your heart stand, for there is no one more faithful to you than it.
target: Mek di kounsl a yu aat tan, kaa dier a non muor fietful tu yu dan it.

en: For a man’s soul is sometimes inclined to inform him better than seven watchmen who sit on high on a watch-tower.
target: Kaa a man suol somtaim inklain fi infaam im beta dan sevn wachman uu sidong ai pan a wach-towa.

en: Above all this ask the Most High that he may direct your way in truth.
target: Abov aal dis aaks di Mos Ai dat im kyan dairek yu wie ina chuut.

en: Let reason be the beginning of every work. Let counsel go before every action.
target: Mek riizn bi di biginin a evri wok. Mek kounsl go bifuo evri akshan.

en: As a token of the changing of the heart,
target: Az a tuokn a di chienjin a di aat,

en: four kinds of things rise up: good and evil, life and death. That which rules over them continually is the tongue.
target: fuor kain a ting raiz op: gud an iivl, laif an det. Dat we ruul uova dem kantinyuali a di tong.

en: There is one who is clever and the instructor of many, and yet is unprofitable to his own soul.
target: Dier a uan uu kleva an di instrokta a meni, an yet onprafitabl tu im uon suol.

en: There is one who is subtle in words, and is hated. He will be destitute of all food.
target: Dier a uan uu sotl ina wod dem, an get iet. Im wi destityuut a aal fuud.

en: For grace was not given to him from the Lord, because he is deprived of all wisdom.
target: Kaa gries no ben gi tu im fram di Laad, bikaaz im dipraiv a aal wizdam.

en: There is one who is wise to his own soul; and the fruits of his understanding are trustworthy in the mouth.
target: Dier a uan uu waiz tu im uon suol; an di fruut dem a im andastandin chros-worti ina di mout.

en: A wise man will instruct his own people. The fruits of his understanding are trustworthy.
target: A waiz man wi instrok im uon piipl. Di fruut dem a im andastandin chros-worti.

en: A wise man will be filled with blessing. All those who see him will call him happy.
target: A waiz man wi ful wid blesin. Aal dem uu si im wi kaal im api.

en: The life of a man is counted by days. The days of Israel are innumerable.
target: Di laif a a man kount bai die dem. Di die dem a Izrel inyuumarebl.

en: The wise man will inherit confidence among his people. His name will live forever.
target: Di waiz man wi inerit kanfidens mongx im piipl. Im niem wi liv fareva.

en: My son, test your soul in your life. See what is evil for it, and don’t give in to it.
target: Mi son, tes yu suol ina yu laif. Si wa iivl fi it, an no gi ina tu it.

en: For not all things are profitable for all men. Not every soul has pleasure in everything.
target: Kaa no aal ting prafitabl fi aal man dem. No evri suol av pleja ina evriting.

en: Don’t be insatiable in any luxury. Don’t be greedy in the things that you eat.
target: No bi insieshebl ina eni logjri. No bi griidi ina di ting dem we yu iit.

en: For overeating brings disease, and gluttony causes nausea.
target: Kaa uovaiitin bring diziiz, an glotni kaaz naazya.

en: Because of gluttony, many have perished, but he who takes heed will prolong his life.
target: Bikaaz a glotni, meni pierish, bot im uu tek iid wi pralong im laif.

en: Honor a physician according to your need with the honors due to him, for truly the Lord has created him.
target: Ana a fizishan akaadin tu yu niid wid di ana dem juu tu im, kaa chuuli di Laad kriet im.

en: For healing comes from the Most High, and he will receive a gift from the king.
target: Kaa iilin kom fram di Mos Ai, an im wi risiev a gif fram di king.

en: The skill of the physician will lift up his head. He will be admired in the sight of great men.
target: Di skil a di fizishan wi lif op im ed. Im wi admaiya ina di sait a griet man dem.

en: The Lord created medicines out of the earth. A prudent man will not despise them.
target: Di Laad kriet medsn dem outa di ort. A pruudent man naa dispaiz dem.

en: Wasn’t water made sweet with wood, that its power might be known?
target: Waata no ben mek swiit wid wud, dat it powa mait nuo?

en: He gave men skill that he might be glorified in his marvelous works.
target: Im gi man dem skil dat im kyan gluorifai ina im maarvelos wok dem.

en: With them he heals and takes away pain.
target: Wid dem im iil an tek awie pien.

en: With these, the pharmacist makes a mixture. God’s works won’t be brought to an end. From him, peace is upon the face of the earth.
target: Wid dem, di faarmasis mek a mixcha. Gads wok dem naa braat tu a en. Fram im, piis pan di fies a di ort.

en: My son, in your sickness don’t be negligent, but pray to the Lord, and he will heal you.
target: Mi son, ina yu siknis no bi neglijent, bot prie tu di Laad, an im wi iil yu.

en: Put away wrong doing, and direct your hands in righteousness. Cleanse your heart from all sin.
target: Put awie rang duin, an dairek yu an dem ina raichosnis. Klenz yu aat fram aal sin.

en: Give a sweet savor and a memorial of fine flour, and pour oil on your offering, according to your means.
target: Gi a swiit sieva an a memuorial a fain flowa, an puor ail pan yu aafrin, akaadin tu yu miinz.

en: Then give place to the physician, for truly the Lord has created him. Don’t let him leave you, for you need him.
target: Den gi plies tu di fizishan, kaa chuuli di Laad kriet im. No mek im liiv yu, kaa yu niid im.

en: There is a time when recovery is in their hands.
target: Dier a a taim wen rikova a ina dem an.

en: For they also will ask the Lord to prosper them in diagnosis and in healing for the maintenance of life.
target: Kaa dem tu wi aaks di Laad fi prasper dem ina daiagnuosis an ina iilin fi di mientinans a laif.

en: He who sins before his Maker, let him fall into the hands of the physician.
target: Im uu sin bifuo im Mieka, mek im faal ina di an dem a di fizishan.

en: My son, let your tears fall over the dead, and as one who suffers grievously, begin lamentation. Wind up his body with due honor. Don’t neglect his burial.
target: Mi son, mek yu tiirz faal uova di ded, an az uan uu sofa griivosli, bigin lamentieshan. Wain op im badi wid juu ana. No neglek im berial.

en: Make bitter weeping and make passionate wailing. Let your mourning be according to his merit, for one day or two, or you will be spoken evil of; and so be comforted for your sorrow.
target: Mek bita wiipin an mek pashanet wielin. Mek yu muornin bi akaadin tu im merit, fi uan die ar tuu, ar yu wi get taak iivl a; an so bi komfat fi yu sara.

en: For from sorrow comes death. Sorrow of heart saps one’s strength.
target: Kaa fram sara kom det. Sara a aat sap uan strent.

en: In calamity, sorrow also remains. A poor man’s life is grievous to the heart.
target: Ina kalamiti, sara tu rimien. A puo man laif griivos tu di aat.

en: Don’t give your heart to sorrow. Put it away, remembering the end.
target: No gi yu aat tu sara. Put it awie, membarin di en.

en: Don’t forget it, for there is no returning again. You do him no good, and you would harm yourself.
target: No faget it, kaa dier a no ritornin agen. Yu du im no gud, an yu wuda aam yuself.

en: Remember my end, for so also will yours be: yesterday for me, and today for you.
target: Memba mi en, kaa so tu yuon wi bi: yestide fi mi, an tide fi yu.

en: When the dead is at rest, let his remembrance rest. Be comforted for him when his spirit departs from him.
target: Wen di ded a res, mek im rimembrans res. Bi komfat fi im wen im spirit dipaat fram im.

en: The wisdom of the scribe comes by the opportunity of leisure. He who has little business can become wise.
target: Di wizdam a di skraib kom bai di apachuniti a leja. Im uu av likl biznis kyan bikom waiz.

en: How could he become wise who holds the plow, who glories in the shaft of the goad, who drives oxen and is occupied in their labors, and who mostly talks about bulls?
target: Ou im kuda bikom waiz uu uol di plou, uu gluori ina di shaaft a di guod, uu jraiv aksn an akiupai ina dem lieba, an uu muosli taak bout bul dem?

en: He will set his heart upon turning his furrows. His lack of sleep is to give his heifers their fodder.
target: Im wi set im aat pan tornin im foro dem. Im lak a sliip a fi gi im efa dem dem fada.

en: So is every craftsman and master artisan who passes his time by night as by day, those who cut engravings of signets. His diligence is to make great variety. He sets his heart to preserve likeness in his portraiture, and is careful to finish his work.
target: So a evri kraafsman an maasta aatizan uu paas im taim bai nait az bai die, dem uu kot enggrievin dem a signet dem. Im dilijens a fi mek griet varaiyati. Im set im aat fi prizorv laiknis ina im puorchret, an kierful fi finish im wok.

en: So too is the smith sitting by the anvil and considering the unwrought iron. The smoke of the fire will waste his flesh. He toils in the heat of the furnace. The noise of the hammer deafens his ear. His eyes are upon the pattern of the object. He will set his heart upon perfecting his works. He will be careful to adorn them perfectly.
target: So tu a di smit sidong bai di anvil an kansidarin di onraat aiyan. Di smuok a di faiya wi wies im flesh. Im tail ina di iit a di fornis. Di naiz a di ama defn im iir. Im ai dem pan di patan a di abjek. Im wi set im aat pan porfektin im wok dem. Im wi kierful fi adoon dem porfektli.

en: So is the potter sitting at his work and turning the wheel around with his feet, who is always anxiously set at his work. He produces his handiwork in quantity.
target: So a di pata sidong a im wok an tornin di wiil arong wid im fut, uu aalwiez angkshosli set a im wok. Im prodyuus im andiwok ina kwantiti.

en: He will fashion the clay with his arm and will bend its strength in front of his feet. He will apply his heart to finish the glazing. He will be careful to clean the kiln.
target: Im wi fashan di klie wid im aam an wi ben it strent ina front a im fut dem. Im wi aplai im aat fi finish di gliezin. Im wi kierful fi kliin di kiln.

en: All these put their trust in their hands. Each becomes skillful in his own work.
target: Aal a dem put dem chros ina dem an. Iich bikom skilful ina im uon wok.

en: Without these no city would be inhabited. Men wouldn’t reside as foreigners or walk up and down there.
target: Widout dem no siti wuda inabit. Man dem naa rizaid az farina dem ar waak op an dong dier.

en: They won’t be sought for in the council of the people. They won’t mount on high in the congregation. They won’t sit on the seat of the judge. They won’t understand the covenant of judgment. Neither will they declare instruction and judgment. They won’t be found where parables are.
target: Dem naa siik fi ina di kounsl a di piipl. Dem naa mount pan ai ina di kanggrigieshan. Dem naa sidong pan di siit a di joj. Dem naa andastan di kovnant a jojment. Niida wi dem diklier instrokshan an jojment. Dem naa fain we parabl dem de.

en: But they will maintain the fabric of the age. Their prayer is in the handiwork of their craft.
target: Bot dem wi mientien di fabrik a di iej. Dem prier a ina di andiwok a dem kraaft.

en: Not so he who has applied his soul and meditates in the law of the Most High. He will seek out the wisdom of all the ancients and will be occupied with prophecies.
target: No so im uu aplai im suol an medite it ina di laa a di Mos Ai. Im wi siik out di wizdam a aal di ienshent dem an wi akiupai wid prafisi dem.

en: He will keep the sayings of the men of renown and will enter in amidst the subtleties of parables.
target: Im wi kiip di seyin dem a di man dem a rinaun an wi enta ina amids di sotlti dem a parabl dem.

en: He will seek out the hidden meaning of proverbs and be conversant in the dark sayings of parables.
target: Im wi siik out di idn miinin a pravarb dem an bi konvoorsant ina di daak seyin dem a parabl dem.

en: He will serve among great men and appear before him who rules. He will travel through the land of foreign nations, for he has learned what is good and evil among men.
target: Im wi sorv mongx griet man dem an apiir bifuo im uu ruul. Im wi chravl chruu di lan a farin nieshan dem, kaa im lorn wa gud an iivl mongx man dem.

en: He will apply his heart to return early to the Lord who made him, and will make supplication before the Most High, and will open his mouth in prayer, and will ask for pardon for his sins.
target: Im wi aplai im aat fi ritorn orli tu di Laad uu mek im, an wi mek soplikieshan bifuo di Mos Ai, an wi uopn im mout ina prier, an wi aaks fi paadn fi im sin dem.

en: If the great Lord wills, he will be filled with the spirit of understanding; he will pour forth the words of his wisdom and in prayer give thanks to the Lord.
target: Ef di griet Laad wil, im wi ful wid di spirit a andastandin; im wi puor fuot di wod dem a im wizdam an ina prier gi tangks tu di Laad.

en: He will direct his counsel and knowledge, and he will meditate in his secrets.
target: Im wi dairek im kounsl an nalij, an im wi medite it ina im siikrit dem.

en: He will show the instruction which he has been taught and will glory in the law of the covenant of the Lord.
target: Im wi shuo di instrokshan we im tiich an wi gluori ina di laa a di kovnant a di Laad.

en: Many will commend his understanding. So long as the world endures, it won’t be blotted out. His memory won’t depart. His name will live from generation to generation.
target: Meni wi komend im andastandin. So lang az di worl endyuor, it naa blat out. Im memri naa dipaat. Im niem wi liv fram jenerieshan tu jenerieshan.

en: Nations will declare his wisdom. The congregation will proclaim his praise.
target: Nieshan dem wi diklier im wizdam. Di kanggrigieshan wi pro kliem im priez.

en: If he continues, he will leave a greater name than a thousand. If he finally rests, it is enough for him.
target: Ef im kantinyu, im wi liiv a grieta niem dan a touzn. Ef im fainali res, it inof fi im.

en: Yet more I will utter, which I have thought about. I am filled like the full moon.
target: Yet muor mi wi taak, we mi ting bout. Mi ful laik di ful muun.

en: Listen to me, you holy children, and bud forth like a rose growing by a brook of water.
target: Lisn tu mi, unu uoli pikni dem, an bod fuot laik a ruoz a gruo bai a bruk a waata.

en: Give a sweet fragrance like frankincense. Put forth flowers like a lily. Scatter a sweet smell and sing a song of praise. Bless the Lord for all his works!
target: Gi a swiit friegrans laik frankinsens. Put fuot flowa dem laik a lili. Skata a swiit smel an sing a sang a priez. Bles di Laad fi aal im wok dem!

en: Magnify his name and give utterance to his praise with the songs on your lips and with harps! Say this when you utter his praise:
target: Magnifai im niem an gi otarans tu im priez wid di sang dem pan yu lip dem an wid aap dem! Se dis wen yu taak im priez:

en: All the works of the Lord are exceedingly good, and every command will be done in its time.
target: Aal di wok dem a di Laad exiid ingli gud, an evri komaan wi du ina it taim.

en: No one can say, “What is this?” “Why is that?” for at the proper time they will all be sought out. At his word, the waters stood as a heap, as did the reservoirs of water at the word of his mouth.
target: Non kyan se, “Wa a dis?” “Wai a dat?” kaa a di prapa taim dem aal wi siik out. A im wod, di waata dem ben tan az a iip, az di rezavwaa dem a waata a di wod a im mout.

en: At his command all his good pleasure is fulfilled. There is no one who can hinder his salvation.
target: A im komaan aal im gud pleja fulfil. Dier a non uu kyan inda im salvieshan.

en: The works of all flesh are before him. It’s impossible to be hidden from his eyes.
target: Di wok dem a aal flesh bifuo im. It impasibl fi aid fram im ai dem.

en: He sees from everlasting to everlasting. There is nothing too wonderful for him.
target: Im si fram eva laastin tu eva laastin. Dier a notn tuu wandaful fi im.

en: No one can say, “What is this?” “Why is that?” for all things are created for their own uses.
target: Non kyan se, “Wa a dis?” “Wai a dat?” kaa aal ting kriet fi dem uon yuus dem.

en: His blessing covered the dry land as a river and saturated it as a flood.
target: Im blesin kova di jrai lan az a riva an sachureit it az a flod.

en: As he has made the waters salty, so the heathen will inherit his wrath.
target: Az im mek di waata dem saalti, so di iitn dem wi inerit im raat.

en: His ways are plain to the holy. They are stumbling blocks to the wicked.
target: Im wie dem plien tu di uoli dem. Dem a stomblin blak dem tu di wikid dem.

en: Good things are created from the beginning for the good. So are evil things for sinners.
target: Gud ting dem kriet fram di biginin fi di gud dem. So a iivl ting dem fi sina dem.

en: The main things necessary for the life of man are water, fire, iron, salt, wheat flour, and honey, milk, the blood of the grape, oil, and clothing.
target: Di mien ting dem nesiseri fi di laif a man a waata, faiya, aiyan, saalt, wiit flowa, an oni, milk, di blod a di griep, ail, an kluodin.

en: All these things are for good to the godly, but for sinners, they will be turned into evils.
target: Aal dem ting fi gud tu di raichos dem, bot fi sina dem, dem wi ton ina iivl dem.

en: There are winds that are created for vengeance, and in their fury they lay on their scourges heavily. In the time of reckoning, they pour out their strength, and will appease the wrath of him who made them.
target: Dier a win dem we kriet fi venjans, an ina dem fyuri dem lie pan dem skaaj dem evili. Ina di taim a rek nin, dem puor out dem strent, an wi apiiz di raat a im uu mek dem.

en: Fire, hail, famine, and death— all these are created for vengeance—
target: Faiya, iel, famin, an det— aal dem kriet fi venjans—

en: wild beasts’ teeth, scorpions, adders, and a sword punishing the ungodly to destruction.
target: wail biis dem tiit, skaapian dem, ada dem, an a suod a ponish di onraichos dem tu distrokshan.

en: They will rejoice in his commandment, and will be made ready upon earth when needed. In their seasons, they won’t disobey his command.
target: Dem wi rijais ina im komanment, an wi mek redi pan ort wen niid. Ina dem siizn dem, dem naa disobey im komaan.

en: Therefore from the beginning I was convinced, and I thought it through and left it in writing:
target: Dierfuo fram di biginin mi ben konvins, an mi ting it chruu an lef it ina raitin:

en: All the works of the Lord are good. He will supply every need in its time.
target: Aal di wok dem a di Laad gud. Im wi soplai evri niid ina it taim.

en: No one can say, “This is worse than that,” for they will all be well approved in their time.
target: Non kyan se, “Dis wos dan dat,” kaa dem aal wi wel appruuv ina dem taim.

en: Now with all your hearts and voices, sing praises and bless the Lord’s name!
target: Nou wid aal unu aat dem an vais dem, sing priez dem an bles di Laads niem!

en: Great travail is created for every man. A heavy yoke is upon the sons of Adam, from the day of their coming forth from their mother’s womb, until the day for their burial in the mother of all things.
target: Griet traviel kriet fi evri man. A evi yoke pan di son dem a Aadam, fram di die a dem komin fuot fram dem mada womb, ontil di die fi dem berial ina di mada a aal ting.

en: The expectation of things to come, and the day of death, trouble their thoughts, and cause fear in their hearts.
target: Di expektieshan a ting dem tu kom, an di die a det, chrobl dem taat dem, an kaaz fiir ina dem aat dem.

en: From him who sits on a throne of glory, even to him who is humbled in earth and ashes,
target: Fram im uu sidong pan a chruon a gluori, iivn tu im uu ombl ina ort an ashiz,

en: from him who wears purple and a crown, even to him who is clothed in burlap,
target: fram im uu wier porpl an a kroun, iivn tu im uu kluod ina borlap,

en: there is wrath, jealousy, trouble, unrest, fear of death, anger, and strife. In the time of rest upon his bed, his night sleep changes his knowledge.
target: dier a raat, jelosi, chrobl, onres, fiir a det, anga, an straif. Ina di taim a res pan im bed, im nait sliip chienj im nalij.

en: He gets little or no rest, and afterward in his sleep, as in a day of keeping watch, he is troubled in the vision of his heart, as one who has escaped from the front of battle.
target: Im get likl ar no res, an aaftawod ina im sliip, az ina a die a kiipin wach, im chrobl ina di vizhan a im aat, az uan uu eskiep fram di front a batl.

en: In the very time of his deliverance, he awakens, and marvels that the fear is nothing.
target: Ina di veri taim a im dilivarans, im awiekn, an maarvl dat di fiir a notn.

en: To all creatures, human and animal, and upon sinners sevenfold more,
target: Tu aal kriicha dem, yuuman an animal, an pan sina dem sevnfuol muor,

en: come death, bloodshed, strife, sword, calamities, famine, suffering, and plague.
target: kom det, blodshed, straif, suod, kalamiti dem, famin, sofarin, an plieg.

en: All these things were created for the wicked, and because of them the flood came.
target: Aal dem ting kriet fi di wikid dem, an bikaaz a dem di flod kom.

en: All things that are of the earth turn to the earth again. All things that are of the waters return into the sea.
target: Aal ting we a di ort ton tu di ort agen. Aal ting we a di waata dem ritorn ina di sii.

en: All bribery and injustice will be blotted out. Good faith will stand forever.
target: Aal braibri an injostis wi blat out. Gud fiet wi tan fareva.

en: The goods of the unjust will be dried up like a river, and like a great thunder in rain will go off in noise.
target: Di gudz a di onjos dem wi jrai op laik a riva, an laik a griet tonda ina rien wi go aaf ina naiz.

en: In opening his hands, a man will be made glad; so lawbreakers will utterly fail.
target: Ina uopnin im an dem, a man wi glad; so laabrieka dem wi otali fiel.

en: The children of the ungodly won’t grow many branches, and are as unhealthy roots on a sheer rock.
target: Di pikni dem a di onraichos dem naa gruo meni branch dem, an a az onelti ruut dem pan a shiir rak.

en: The reeds by every water or river bank will be plucked up before all grass.
target: Di riid dem bai evri waata ar riva bank wi plok op bifuo aal graas.

en: Kindness is like a garden of blessings. Almsgiving endures forever.
target: Kainnis laik a gaadn a blesin dem. Aamzgivin endyuor fareva.

en: The life of one who labors and is content will be made sweet. He who finds a treasure is better than both.
target: Di laif a uan uu lieba an kantent wi mek swiit. Im uu fain a treja beta dan buot.

en: Children and the building of a city establish a name. A blameless wife is better than both.
target: Pikni dem an di bildin a a siti istablish a niem. A bliemles waif beta dan buot.

en: Wine and music rejoice the heart. The love of wisdom is better than both.
target: Wain an myuuzik rijais di aat. Di lov a wizdam beta dan buot.

en: The pipe and the lute make pleasant melody. A pleasant tongue is better than both.
target: Di paip an di luut mek plezant melodi. A plezant tong beta dan buot.

en: Your eye desires grace and beauty, but the green shoots of grain more than both.
target: Yu ai dizaiya gries an byuuti, bot di griin shuut dem a grien muor dan buot.

en: A friend and a companion is always welcome, and a wife with her husband is better than both.
target: A fren an a kompanyan aalwiez welkom, an a waif wid ar ozban beta dan buot.

en: Relatives and helpers are for a time of affliction, but almsgiving rescues better than both.
target: Relativ dem an elpa dem fi a taim a aflikshan, bot aamzgivin reskyu beta dan buot.

en: Gold and silver will make the foot stand sure, and counsel is esteemed better than both.
target: Guol an silva wi mek di fut tan shuur, an kounsl istiim beta dan buot.

en: Riches and strength will lift up the heart. The fear of the Lord is better than both. There is nothing lacking in the fear of the Lord. In it, there is no need to seek help.
target: Richiz an strent wi lif op di aat. Di fiir a di Laad beta dan buot. Dier a notn lakin ina di fiir a di Laad. Ina it, dier a no niid fi siik elp.

en: The fear of the Lord is like a garden of blessing and covers a man more than any glory.
target: Di fiir a di Laad laik a gaadn a blesin an kova a man muor dan eni gluori.

en: My son, don’t lead a beggar’s life. It is better to die than to beg.
target: Mi son, no liid a bega laif. It beta fi ded dan fi beg.

en: A man who looks to the table of another, his life is not to be considered a life. He will pollute his soul with another person’s food, but a wise and well-instructed person will beware of that.
target: A man uu luk tu di tiebl a anada, im laif no fi kansida a laif. Im wi palyuut im suol wid anada porsn fuud, bot a waiz an wel-instrok porsn wi bewier a dat.

en: Begging will be sweet in the mouth of the shameless, but it kindles a fire in his belly.
target: Begin wi bi swiit ina di mout a di shiemles uan, bot it kindl a faiya ina im beli.

en: O death, how bitter is the memory of you to a man who is at peace in his possessions, to the man who has nothing to distract him and has prosperity in all things, and who still has strength to enjoy food!
target: O det, ou bita a di memri a yu tu a man uu a piis ina im pozeshan dem, tu di man uu av notn fi distrak im an av prasperiti ina aal ting, an uu stil av strent fi enjai fuud!

en: O death, your sentence is acceptable to a man who is needy and who fails in strength, who is in extreme old age, is distracted about all things, is perverse, and has lost patience!
target: O det, yu sentens akseptabl tu a man uu niidi an uu fiel ina strent, uu ina extriim uol iej, distrak bout aal ting, povors, an lus pieshens!

en: Don’t be afraid of the sentence of death. Remember those who have been before you and who come after. This is the sentence from the Lord over all flesh.
target: No fried a di sentens a det. Memba dem uu ben bifuo yu an uu kom aafta. Dis a di sentens fram di Laad uova aal flesh.

en: And why do you refuse when it is the good pleasure of the Most High? Whether life lasts ten, or a hundred, or a thousand years, there is no inquiry about life in Hades.
target: An wai yu rifyuuz wen it a di gud pleja a di Mos Ai? Weda laif laas ten, ar a onjred, ar a touzn ier, dier a no inkwairi bout laif ina Iidis.

en: The children of sinners are detestable children and they frequent the dwellings of the ungodly.
target: Di pikni dem a sina dem ditestabl pikni an dem frikwent di dwelin dem a di onraichos dem.

en: The inheritance of sinners’ children will perish and with their posterity will be a perpetual disgrace.
target: Di ineritans a sina dem pikni wi pierish an wid dem pasteriti wi bi a porpechual disgriez.

en: Children will complain of an ungodly father, because they suffer disgrace because of him.
target: Pikni dem wi komplien a a onraichos faada, bikaaz dem sofa disgriez bikaaz a im.

en: Woe to you, ungodly men, who have forsaken the law of the Most High God!
target: Wuo tu unu, onraichos man dem, uu fasiek di laa a di Mos Ai Gad!

en: If you are born, you will be born to a curse. If you die, a curse will be your portion.
target: Ef yu baan, yu wi baan tu a kos. Ef yu ded, a kos wi bi yu paashan.

en: All things that are of the earth will go back to the earth; so the ungodly will go from a curse to perdition.
target: Aal ting we a di ort wi go bak tu di ort; so di onraichos dem wi go fram a kos tu pordishan.

en: The mourning of men is about their bodies; but the evil name of sinners will be blotted out.
target: Di muornin a man dem bout dem badi dem; bot di iivl niem a sina dem wi blat out.

en: Have regard for your name, for it continues with you longer than a thousand great treasures of gold.
target: Av rigaad fi yu niem, kaa it kantinyu wid yu langa dan a touzn griet treja dem a guol.

en: A good life has its number of days, but a good name continues forever.
target: A gud laif av it nomba a die dem, bot a gud niem kantinyu fareva.

en: My children, follow instruction in peace. But wisdom that is hidden and a treasure that is not seen, what benefit is in them both?
target: Mi pikni dem, fala instrokshan ina piis. Bot wizdam we aid an a treja we no si, wa benefit ina dem buot?

en: Better is a man who hides his foolishness than a man who hides his wisdom.
target: Beta a a man uu aid im fuulishnis dan a man uu aid im wizdam.

en: Therefore show respect for my words; for it is not good to retain every kind of shame. Not everything is approved by all in good faith.
target: Dierfuo shuo rispek fi mi wod dem; kaa it no gud fi ritien evri kain a shiem. No evriting appruuv bai aal ina gud fiet.

en: Be ashamed of sexual immorality before father and mother, of a lie before a prince and a mighty man,
target: Bi ashiem a sekshual imoraliti bifuo faada an mada, a a lai bifuo a prins an a maiti man,

en: of an offense before a judge and ruler, of sin before the congregation and the people, of unjust dealing before a partner and friend,
target: a a ofens bifuo a joj an ruula, a sin bifuo di kanggrigieshan an di piipl, a onjos diilin bifuo a paatna an fren,

en: and of theft in the place where you sojourn. Be ashamed in regard of the truth of God and his covenant, of leaning on your elbow at dinner, of contemptuous behavior in the matter of giving and taking,
target: an a tiifri ina di plies we yu sojorn. Bi ashiem kansoornin di chuut a Gad an im kovnant, a liinin pan yu elbo a dina, a kantemchuos biyevia ina di mata a givin an tekin,

en: of silence before those who greet you, of looking at a woman who is a prostitute,
target: a sailens bifuo dem uu griit yu, a lukin a a uman uu a prastityuut,

en: of turning away your face from a kinsman, of taking away a portion or a gift, of gazing at a woman who has a husband,
target: a tornin awie yu fies fram a kinzman, a tekin awie a paashan ar a gif, a giezin a a uman uu av a ozban,

en: of meddling with his maid—and don’t come near her bed, of abusive speech to friends—and after you have given, don’t insult,
target: a medlin wid im mied—an no kom nier ar bed, a abyuusiv spiich tu fren dem—an aafta yu gi, no insult,

en: of repeating and speaking what you have heard, and of revealing of secrets.
target: a ripiitin an taakin wa yu ier, an a riviilin a siikrit dem.

en: So you will be ashamed of the right things and find favor in the sight of every man.
target: So yu wi ashiem a di rait ting dem an fain fieva ina di sait a evri man.

en: Don’t be ashamed of these things, and don’t sin to save face:
target: No bi ashiem a dem ting, an no sin fi siev fies:

en: of the law of the Most High and his covenant, of judgment to do justice to the ungodly,
target: a di laa a di Mos Ai an im kovnant, a jojment fi du jostis tu di onraichos uan,

en: of reckoning with a partner and with travellers, of a gift from the inheritance of friends,
target: a reknin wid a paatna an wid chravla dem, a a gif fram di ineritans a fren dem,

en: of exactness of scales and weights, of getting much or little,
target: a egzakt nis a skiel dem an wiet dem, a getin moch ar likl,

en: of bargaining dealing with merchants, of frequent correction of children, and of making the back of an evil slave to bleed.
target: a baarginin diilin wid morchant dem, a friikwent karekshan a pikni dem, an a mekin di bak a a iivl sliev bliid.

en: A seal is good where an evil wife is. Where there are many hands, lock things up.
target: A siil gud we a iivl waif de. We dier a meni an, lak ting dem op.

en: Whatever you hand over, let it be by number and weight. In giving and receiving, let all be in writing.
target: Wateva yu an uova, mek it bi bai nomba an wiet. Ina givin an risiivin, mek aal bi ina raitin.

en: Don’t be ashamed to instruct the unwise and foolish, and one of extreme old age who contends with those who are young. So you will be well instructed indeed and approved in the sight of every living man.
target: No bi ashiem fi instrok di onwaiz an fuulish dem, an uan a extriim uol iej uu kanten wid dem uu yong. So yu wi wel instrok indiid an appruuv ina di sait a evri livin man.

en: A daughter is a secret cause of wakefulness to a father. Care for her takes away sleep— in her youth, that she may pass the flower of her age; when she is married, that she may be hated;
target: A daata a a siikrit kaaz a wiekfulnis tu a faada. Kier fi ar tek awie sliip— ina ar yuut, dat shi kyan paas di flowa a ar iej; wen shi marid, dat shi kyan get iet;

en: in her virginity, that she may be defiled and be with child in her father’s house; when she has a husband, that she may transgress; and when she is married, that she may be barren.
target: ina ar vorjiniti, dat shi kyan difail an bi wid pikni ina ar faada ous; wen shi av a ozban, dat shi kyan transgres; an wen shi marid, dat shi kyan bi baren.

en: Keep a strict watch over a headstrong daughter, or she will make you a laughingstock to your enemies, a byword in the city and notorious among the people, and shame you in public.
target: Kiip a strik wach uova a edstrang daata, ar shi wi mek yu a laafin stak tu yu enimi dem, a baawod ina di siti an notuorios mongx di piipl, an shiem yu ina poblik.

en: Don’t gaze at every beautiful body. Don’t sit in the midst of women.
target: No giez a evri byuutiful badi. No sidong ina di migl a uman dem.

en: For from garments comes a moth, and from a woman comes a woman’s wickedness.
target: Kaa fram gaament dem kom a maat, an fram a uman kom a uman wikidnis.

en: Better is the wickedness of a man than a pleasant woman, a woman who puts you to shame and disgrace.
target: Beta a di wikidnis a a man dan a plezant uman, a uman uu put yu tu shiem an disgriez.

en: I will make mention now of the works of the Lord, and will declare the things that I have seen. The Lord’s works are in his words.
target: Mi wi mek menshan nou a di wok dem a di Laad, an wi diklier di ting dem we mi si. Di Laads wok dem ina im wod dem.

en: The sun that gives light looks at all things. The Lord’s work is full of his glory.
target: Di son we gi lait luk a aal ting. Di Laads wok ful a im gluori.

en: The Lord has not given power to the saints to declare all his marvelous works, which the Almighty Lord firmly settled, that the universe might be established in his glory.
target: Di Laad no gi powa tu di sient dem fi diklier aal im maarvelos wok dem, we di Olmaiti Laad formli setl, dat di yuunivers kyan istablish ina im gluori.

en: He searches out the deep and the heart. He has understanding of their secrets. For the Most High knows all knowledge. He sees the signs of the world.
target: Im soorch out di diip an di aat. Im av andastandin a dem siikrit dem. Kaa di Mos Ai nuo aal nalij. Im si di sain dem a di worl.

en: He declares the things that are past and the things that will be, and reveals the traces of hidden things.
target: Im diklier di ting dem we paas an di ting dem we wi bi, an riviil di tries dem a idn ting dem.

en: No thought escapes him. There is not a word hidden from him.
target: No taat eskiep im. Dier a no wod idn fram im.

en: He has ordered the mighty works of his wisdom. He is from everlasting to everlasting. Nothing has been added to them, nor diminished from them. He had no need of any counselor.
target: Im aada di maiti wok dem a im wizdam. Im fram eva laastin tu eva laastin. Notn ad tu dem, nar diminish fram dem. Im av no niid a eni kounsla.

en: How desirable are all his works! One may see this even in a spark.
target: Ou dizairabl a aal im wok dem! Uan kyan si dis iivn ina a spaak.

en: All these things live and remain forever in all manner of uses. They are all obedient.
target: Aal dem ting liv an rimien fareva ina aal maner a yuus dem. Dem aal obiidient.

en: All things are in pairs, one opposite the other. He has made nothing imperfect.
target: Aal ting ina pier dem, uan apozit di ada. Im mek notn imporfek.

en: One thing establishes the good things of another. Who could ever see enough of his glory?
target: Uan ting istablish di gud ting dem a anada. Uu kuda eva si inof a im gluori?

en: The pride of the heavenly heights is the clear sky, the appearance of heaven, in the spectacle of its glory.
target: Di praid a di evnli ait dem a di kliir skai, di apierans a evn, ina di spektakl a it gluori.

en: The sun, when it appears, bringing tidings as it rises, is a marvelous instrument, the work of the Most High.
target: Di son, wen it apiir, bringin taidin dem az it raiz, a a maarvelos instroment, di wok a di Mos Ai.

en: At noon, it dries up the land. Who can stand against its burning heat?
target: A nuun, it jrai op di lan. Uu kyan tan gens it bonin iit?

en: A man tending a furnace is in burning heat, but the sun three times more, burning up the mountains, breathing out fiery vapors, and sending out bright beams, it blinds the eyes.
target: A man tendin a fornis ina bonin iit, bot di son chrii taim muor, a bon op di mountn dem, a briid out faiyari viepa dem, an a sen out brait biim dem, it blain di ai dem.

en: Great is the Lord who made it. At his word, he hastens on its course.
target: Griet a di Laad uu mek it. A im wod, it iesn pan it kuors.

en: The moon marks the changing seasons, declares times, and is a sign for the world.
target: Di muun maak di chienjin siizn dem, diklier taim dem, an a a sain fi di worl.

en: From the moon is the sign of feast days, a light that wanes when it completes its course.
target: Fram di muun a di sain a fiis die dem, a lait we wien wen it kompliit it kuors.

en: The month is called after its name, increasing wonderfully in its changing— an instrument of the army on high, shining in the structure of heaven,
target: Di mont kaal aafta it niem, a inkriis wandafuli ina it chienjin— a instroment a di aami pan ai, a shain ina di strokcha a evn,

en: the beauty of heaven, the glory of the stars, an ornament giving light in the highest places of the Lord.
target: di byuuti a evn, di gluori a di staar dem, a aanament a gi lait ina di aiis plies dem a di Laad.

en: At the word of the Holy One, they will stand in due order. They won’t faint in their watches.
target: A di wod a di Uoli Uan, dem wi tan ina juu aada. Dem naa fient ina dem wach dem.

en: Look at the rainbow, and praise him who made it. It is exceedingly beautiful in its brightness.
target: Luk a di rienbuo, an priez im uu mek it. It exiid ingli byuutiful ina it braitnis.

en: It encircles the sky with its glorious circle. The hands of the Most High have stretched it out.
target: It insoorkl di skai wid it gluorios sorkl. Di an dem a di Mos Ai strech it out.

en: By his commandment, he makes the snow fall and swiftly sends the lightnings of his judgment.
target: Bai im komanment, im mek di snuo faal an swifli sen di laitnin dem a im jojment.

en: Therefore the storehouses are opened, and clouds fly out like birds.
target: Dierfuo di stuur ous dem uopn, an kloud dem flai out laik bord dem.

en: By his mighty power, he makes the clouds strong and the hailstones are broken in pieces.
target: Bai im maiti powa, im mek di kloud dem strang an di ielstuon dem bruk ina piis dem.

en: At his appearing, the mountains will be shaken. At his will, the south wind will blow.
target: A im apiirin, di mountn dem wi shek. A im wil, di sout win wi bluo.

en: The voice of his thunder rebukes the earth. So does the northern storm and the whirlwind. Like birds flying down, he sprinkles the snow. It falls down like the lighting of locusts.
target: Di vais a im tonda ribyuuk di ort. So di naadan staam an di wirlwin. Laik bord dem a flai dong, im sprinkl di snuo. It faal dong laik di laitin a luokos dem.

en: The eye is dazzled at the beauty of its whiteness. The heart is amazed as it falls.
target: Di ai dazl a di byuuti a it waitnis. Di aat amiez az it faal.

en: He also pours out frost on the earth like salt. When it is freezes, it has points like thorns.
target: Im tu puor out fraas pan di ort laik saalt. Wen it friiz, it av paint dem laik toon dem.

en: The cold north wind blows and ice freezes on the water. It settles on every pool of water. The water puts it on like it was a breastplate.
target: Di kuol naat win bluo an ais friiz pan di waata. It setl pan evri puul a waata. Di waata put it aan laik it ben a brespliet.

en: It will devour the mountains, burn up the wilderness, and consume the green grass like fire.
target: It wi divour di mountn dem, bon op di wildanis, an kansyuum di griin graas laik faiya.

en: A mist coming speedily heals all things. A dew coming after heat brings cheerfulness.
target: A mis komin spiidili iil aal ting. A juu komin aafta iit bring chiirfulnis.

en: By his counsel, he has calmed the deep and planted islands in it.
target: Bai im kounsl, im kaam di diip an plaant ailan dem ina it.

en: Those who sail on the sea tell of its dangers. We marvel when we hear it with our ears.
target: Dem uu siel pan di sii tel a it dienja dem. Wi maarvl wen wi ier it wid wi iirz.

en: There are also those strange and wondrous works in it— variety of all that has life and the huge creatures of the sea.
target: Dier a tu dem strienj an wondros wok dem ina it— varaiyati a aal we av laif an di yuuj kriicha dem a di sii.

en: Because of him, his messengers succeed. By his word, all things hold together.
target: Bikaaz a im, im mesinja dem soksiid. Bai im wod, aal ting uol tugeda.

en: We may say many things, but couldn’t say enough. The summary of our words is, “He is everything!”
target: Wi kyan se meni ting, bot kyaa se inof. Di somari a wi wod dem a, “Im a evriting!”

en: How could we have strength to glorify him? For he is himself the greater than all his works.
target: Ou wi kuda av strent fi gluorifai im? Kaa im imself grieta dan aal im wok dem.

en: The Lord is awesome and exceedingly great! His power is marvelous!
target: Di Laad aasom an exiid ingli griet! Im powa maarvelos!

en: Glorify the Lord and exalt him as much as you can! For even yet, he will surpass that. When you exalt him, summon your full strength. Don’t be weary, because you can’t praise him enough.
target: Gluorifai di Laad an egzaalt im az moch az unu kyan! Kaa iivn yet, im wi sipaas dat. Wen unu egzaalt im, soman unu ful strent. No bi wiiri, bikaaz unu kyaa priez im inof.

en: Who has seen him, that he may describe him? Who can magnify him as he is?
target: Uu si im, dat im kyan diskraib im? Uu kyan magnifai im az im a?
