en: Many things greater than these are hidden, for we have seen just a few of his works.
target: Meni ting grieta dan dem aid, kaa wi si jos a fyuu a im wok dem.

en: For the Lord made all things. He gave wisdom to the godly.
target: Kaa di Laad mek aal ting. Im gi wizdam tu di raichos dem.

en: Let us now praise famous men, our ancestors in their generations.
target: Mek wi nou priez fiemos man dem, wi ansesta dem ina dem jenerieshan dem.

en: The Lord created great glory in them— his mighty power from the beginning.
target: Di Laad kriet griet gluori ina dem— im maiti powa fram di biginin.

en: Some ruled in their kingdoms and were men renowned for their power, giving counsel by their understanding. Some have spoken in prophecies,
target: Som ruul ina dem kindom dem an ben man dem rinaun fi dem powa, a gi kounsl bai dem andastandin. Som taak ina prafisi dem,

en: leaders of the people by their counsels, and by their understanding, giving instruction for the people. Their words in their instruction were wise.
target: liida dem a di piipl bai dem kounsl dem, an bai dem andastandin, a gi instrokshan fi di piipl. Dem wod dem ina dem instrokshan ben waiz.

en: Some composed musical tunes, and set forth verses in writing,
target: Som kompuoz myuuzikal tyuun dem, an set fuot vuors dem ina raitin,

en: rich men endowed with ability, living peaceably in their homes.
target: rich man dem endou wid abiliti, a liv piisabli ina dem uom dem.

en: All these were honored in their generations, and were outstanding in their days.
target: Aal a dem ana ina dem jenerieshan dem, an ben outstandin ina dem die dem.

en: Some of them have left a name behind them, so that others declare their praises.
target: Som a dem lef a niem baka dem, so dat ada dem diklier dem priez dem.

en: But of others, there is no memory. They perished as though they had not been. They become as though they had not been born, they and their children after them.
target: Bot a ada dem, dier a no memri. Dem pierish az duo dem no ben. Dem bikom az duo dem no ben baan, dem an dem pikni dem aafta dem.

en: But these were men of mercy, whose righteous deeds have not been forgotten.
target: Bot dem ben man dem a mersi, uus raichos diid dem no faget.

en: A good inheritance remains with their offspring. Their children are within the covenant.
target: A gud ineritans rimien wid dem afspring. Dem pikni dem widin di kovnant.

en: Their offspring stand fast, with their children, for their sakes.
target: Dem afspring tan faas, wid dem pikni dem, fi dem siek.

en: Their offspring will remain forever. Their glory won’t be blotted out.
target: Dem afspring wi rimien fareva. Dem gluori naa blat out.

en: Their bodies were buried in peace. Their name lives to all generations.
target: Dem badi dem beri ina piis. Dem niem liv tu aal jenerieshan dem.

en: People will declare their wisdom. The congregation proclaims their praise.
target: Piipl wi diklier dem wizdam. Di kanggrigieshan pro kliem dem priez.

en: Enoch pleased the Lord, and was taken up, an example of repentance to all generations.
target: Iinak pliiz di Laad, an get tek op, a egzampl a ripentans tu aal jenerieshan dem.

en: Noah was found perfect and righteous. In the season of wrath, he kept the human race alive. Therefore a remnant was left on the earth when the flood came.
target: Nuowa fain porfek an raichos. Ina di siizn a raat, im kiip di yuuman ries alaiv. Dierfuo a remnant lef pan di ort wen di flod kom.

en: Everlasting covenants were made with him, that all flesh should no more be blotted out by a flood.
target: Evalaastin kovnant dem mek wid im, dat aal flesh shuda no muor blat out bai a flod.

en: Abraham was a great father of a multitude of nations. There was none found like him in glory,
target: Iebraham ben a griet faada a a moltityuud a nieshan dem. Dier ben non fain laik im ina gluori,

en: who kept the law of the Most High, and was taken into covenant with him. In his flesh he established the covenant. When he was tested, he was found faithful.
target: uu kiip di laa a di Mos Ai, an get tek ina kovnant wid im. Ina im flesh im istablish di kovnant. Wen im tes, im fain fietful.

en: Therefore he assured him by an oath that the nations would be blessed through his offspring, that he would multiply him like the dust of the earth, exalt his offspring like the stars, and cause them to inherit from sea to sea, and from the Euphrates River to the utmost parts of the earth.
target: Dierfuo im ashuor im bai a uot dat di nieshan dem wuda bles chruu im afspring, dat im wuda moltiplai im laik di dos a di ort, egzaalt im afspring laik di staar dem, an kaaz dem fi inerit fram sii tu sii, an fram di Yuufretiiz Riva tu di otmuos paat dem a di ort.

en: In Isaac also, he established the same assurance for Abraham his father’s sake, the blessing of all men, and the covenant.
target: Ina Aizak tu, im istablish di siem ashuorans fi Iebraham im faada siek, di blesin a aal man dem, an di kovnant.

en: He made it rest upon the head of Jacob. He acknowledged him in his blessings, gave to him by inheritance, and divided his portions. He distributed them among twelve tribes.
target: Im mek it res pan di ed a Jiekob. Im aknalij im ina im blesin dem, gi tu im bai ineritans, an divaid im paashan dem. Im distribyuut dem mongx twelv traib dem.

en: He brought out of him a man of mercy, who found favor in the sight of all people, a man loved by God and men, even Moses, whose memory is blessed.
target: Im braat outa im a man a mersi, uu fain fieva ina di sait a aal piipl, a man lov bai Gad an man dem, iivn Muoziz, uus memri bles.

en: He made him equal to the glory of the saints, and magnified him in the fears of his enemies.
target: Im mek im iikwal tu di gluori a di sient dem, an magnifai im ina di fiir dem a im enimi dem.

en: By his words he caused the wonders to cease. God glorified him in the sight of kings. He gave him commandments for his people and showed him part of his glory.
target: Bai im wod dem im kaaz di wanda dem fi siiz. Gad gluorifai im ina di sait a king dem. Im gi im komanment dem fi im piipl an shuo im paat a im gluori.

en: He consecrated him in his faithfulness and meekness. He chose him out of all people.
target: Im kansikriet im ina im fietfulnis an miiknis. Im chuuz im outa aal piipl.

en: He made him to hear his voice, led him into the thick darkness, and gave him commandments face to face, even the law of life and knowledge, that he might teach Jacob the covenant, and Israel his judgments.
target: Im mek im ier im vais, led im ina di tik daaknis, an gi im komanment dem fies tu fies, iivn di laa a laif an nalij, dat im kyan tiich Jiekob di kovnant, an Izrel im jojment dem.

en: He exalted Aaron, a holy man like Moses, even his brother, of the tribe of Levi.
target: Im egzaalt Ieran, a uoli man laik Muoziz, iivn im breda, a di traib a Liivai.

en: He established an everlasting covenant with him, and gave him the priesthood of the people. He blessed him with stateliness, and dressed him in a glorious robe.
target: Im istablish a evalaastin kovnant wid im, an gi im di priisud a di piipl. Im bles im wid stietlinis, an jres im ina a gluorios ruob.

en: He clothed him in perfect splendor, and strengthened him with symbols of authority: the linen trousers, the long robe, and the ephod.
target: Im kluod im ina porfek splenda, an strentn im wid simbal dem a atariti: di linin chrouza dem, di lang ruob, an di efod.

en: He encircled him with pomegranates; with many golden bells around him, to make a sound as he went, to make a sound that might be heard in the temple, for a reminder for the children of his people;
target: Im insoorkl im wid pamigranit dem; wid meni guoln bel dem arong im, fi mek a soun az im go, fi mek a soun we kyan ier ina di templ, fi a rimainda fi di pikni dem a im piipl;

en: with a holy garment, with gold, blue, and purple, the work of the embroiderer; with an oracle of judgment—Urim and Thummim;
target: wid a uoli gaament, wid guol, bluu, an porpl, di wok a di embroidara; wid a orakl a jojment—Yuurim an Tumim;

en: with twisted scarlet, the work of the craftsman; with precious stones engraved like a signet, in a setting of gold, the work of the jeweller, for a reminder engraved in writing, after the number of the tribes of Israel;
target: wid twistid skaalet, di wok a di kraafsman; wid preshos stuon dem enggriev laik a signet, ina a setin a guol, di wok a di juuela, fi a rimainda enggriev ina raitin, aafta di nomba a di traib dem a Izrel;

en: with a crown of gold upon the mitre, having engraved on it, as on a signet, “HOLINESS”, an ornament of honor, the work of an expert, the desires of the eyes, goodly and beautiful.
target: wid a kroun a guol pan di maita, avin enggriev pan it, az pan a signet, “UOLINIS”, a aanament a ana, di wok a a expot, di dizaiya dem a di ai dem, gudli an byuutiful.

en: Before him there never have been anything like it. No stranger put them on, but only his sons and his offspring perpetually.
target: Bifuo im dier neva ben eniting laik it. No strienja put dem aan, bot onli im son dem an im afspring porpechuali.

en: His sacrifices must be wholly burned, twice every day continually.
target: Im sakrifais dem mos bi uoli bon, twais evri die kantinyuali.

en: Moses consecrated him, and anointed him with holy oil. It was an everlasting covenant with him and to his offspring, all the days of heaven, to minister to the Lord, to serve as a priest, and to bless his people in his name.
target: Muoziz kansikriet im, an anaint im wid uoli ail. It ben a evalaastin kovnant wid im an tu im afspring, aal di die dem a evn, fi minista tu di Laad, fi sorv az a priis, an fi bles im piipl ina im niem.

en: He chose him out of all living to offer sacrifice to the Lord— incense, and a sweet fragrance, for a memorial, to make atonement for your people.
target: Im chuuz im outa aal livin fi aafa sakrifais tu di Laad— insens, an a swiit friegrans, fi a memuorial, fi mek atonment fi unu piipl.

en: He gave to him in his commandments, authority in the covenants of judgments, to teach Jacob the testimonies, and to enlighten Israel in his law.
target: Im gi tu im ina im komanment dem, atariti ina di kovnant dem a jojment dem, fi tiich Jiekob di testimuoni dem, an fi enlaitn Izrel ina im laa.

en: Strangers conspired against him and envied him in the wilderness: Dathan and Abiram with their company, and the congregation of Korah, with wrath and anger.
target: Strienja dem kanspaiya gens im an envi im ina di wildanis: Dietan an Abairam wid dem kompani, an di kanggrigieshan a Kuora, wid raat an anga.

en: The Lord saw it, and it displeased him. In the wrath of his anger, they were destroyed. He did wonders upon them, to consume them with flaming fire.
target: Di Laad si it, an it displiiz im. Ina di raat a im anga, dem distrai. Im du wanda dem pan dem, fi kansyuum dem wid fliemin faiya.

en: He added glory to Aaron, and gave him a heritage. He divided to him the first fruits of the increase, and prepared bread of first fruits in abundance.
target: Im ad gluori tu Ieran, an gi im a eritej. Im divaid tu im di fos fruut dem a di inkriis, an pripier bred a fos fruut dem ina abundans.

en: For they eat the sacrifices of the Lord, which he gave to him and to his offspring.
target: Kaa dem iit di sakrifais dem a di Laad, we im gi tu im an tu im afspring.

en: However, in the land of the people, he has no inheritance, and he has no portion among the people, for the Lord himself is your portion and inheritance.
target: Oueva, ina di lan a di piipl, im av no ineritans, an im av no paashan mongx di piipl, kaa di Laad imself a yu paashan an ineritans.

en: Phinehas the son of Eleazar is the third in glory, in that he was zealous in the fear of the Lord, and stood fast when the people turned away, and he made atonement for Israel.
target: Finias di son a Eliaza a di tord ina gluori, ina dat im ben zelos ina di fiir a di Laad, an tan faas wen di piipl ton awie, an im mek atonment fi Izrel.

en: Therefore, a covenant of peace was established for him, that he should be leader of the sanctuary and of his people, that he and his offspring should have the dignity of the priesthood forever.
target: Dierfuo, a kovnant a piis istablish fi im, dat im shuda bi liida a di sangkchuari an a im piipl, dat im an im afspring shuda av di digniti a di priisud fareva.

en: Also he made a covenant with David the son of Jesse, of the tribe of Judah. The inheritance of the king is his alone from son to son. So the inheritance of Aaron is also to his seed.
target: Tu im mek a kovnant wid Dievid di son a Jesi, a di traib a Juuda. Di ineritans a di king a im aluon fram son tu son. So di ineritans a Ieran a tu tu im siid.

en: May God give you wisdom in your heart to judge his people in righteousness, that their good things may not be abolished, and that their glory may endure for all their generations.
target: Mie Gad gi unu wizdam ina unu aat fi joj im piipl ina raichosnis, dat dem gud ting dem kyan no abalish, an dat dem gluori kyan endyuor fi aal dem jenerieshan dem.

en: Joshua the son of Nun was valiant in war, and was the successor of Moses in prophecies. He was made great according to his name for the saving of God’s elect, to take vengeance on the enemies that rose up against them, that he might give Israel their inheritance.
target: Jashua di son a Non ben valiant ina waar, an ben di soksesa a Muoziz ina prafisi dem. Im mek griet akaadin tu im niem fi di sievin a Gads elek, fi tek venjans pan di enimi dem we raiz op gens dem, dat im kyan gi Izrel dem ineritans.

en: How he was glorified in the lifting up his hands, and in stretching out his sword against the cities!
target: Ou im gluorifai ina di liftin op im an dem, an ina strechin out im suod gens di siti dem!

en: Who before him stood so firm? For the Lord himself brought his enemies to him.
target: Uu bifuo im tan so form? Kaa di Laad imself braat im enimi dem tu im.

en: Didn’t the sun go back by his hand? Didn’t one day become as two?
target: Di son no go bak bai im an? Uan die no bikom az tuu?

en: He called upon the Most High, the Mighty One, when his foes pressed in all around him, and the great Lord heard him.
target: Im kaal pan di Mos Ai, di Maiti Uan, wen im fuo dem pres ina aal arong im, an di griet Laad ier im.

en: With hailstones of mighty power, he caused war to break violently upon the nation, and on the slope he destroyed those who resisted, so that the nations might know his armor, how he fought in the sight of the Lord; for he followed the Mighty One.
target: Wid ielstuon dem a maiti powa, im kaaz waar fi briek vaientli pan di nieshan, an pan di sluop im distrai dem uu rizis, so dat di nieshan dem kyan nuo im aama, ou im fait ina di sait a di Laad; kaa im fala di Maiti Uan.

en: Also in the time of Moses, he did a work of mercy— he and Caleb the son of Jephunneh— in that they withstood the adversary, hindered the people from sin, and stilled their wicked complaining.
target: Tu ina di taim a Muoziz, im du a wok a mersi— im an Kieleb di son a Jefuni— ina dat dem widstan di advasari, inda di piipl fram sin, an stil dem wikid komplienin.

en: And of six hundred thousand people on foot, they two alone were preserved to bring them into their inheritance, into a land flowing with milk and honey.
target: An a siks onjred touzn piipl pan fut, dem tuu aluon prizorv fi bring dem ina dem ineritans, ina a lan a fluoin wid milk an oni.

en: The Lord gave strength to Caleb, and it remained with him to his old age, so that he entered the hill country, and his offspring obtained it for an inheritance,
target: Di Laad gi strent tu Kieleb, an it rimien wid im tu im uol iej, so dat im enta di il kontri, an im afspring obtien it fi a ineritans,

en: that all the children of Israel might see that it is good to follow the Lord.
target: dat aal di pikni dem a Izrel kyan si dat it gud fi fala di Laad.

en: Also the judges, every one by his name, all whose hearts didn’t engage in immorality, and who didn’t turn away from the Lord— may their memory be blessed!
target: Tu di joj dem, evri uan bai im niem, aal uus aat dem no engiej ina imoraliti, an uu no ton awie fram di Laad— mie dem memri bi bles!

en: May their bones flourish again out of their place. May the name of those who have been honored be renewed in their children.
target: Mie dem buon dem florish agen outa dem plies. Mie di niem a dem uu ben ana rinyuud ina dem pikni dem.

en: Samuel, the prophet of the Lord, loved by his Lord, established a kingdom and anointed princes over his people.
target: Samiuel, di prafit a di Laad, lov bai im Laad, istablish a kindom an anaint prins dem uova im piipl.

en: By the law of the Lord he judged the congregation, and the Lord watched over Jacob.
target: Bai di laa a di Laad im joj di kanggrigieshan, an di Laad wach uova Jiekob.

en: By his faithfulness he was proved to be a prophet. By his words he was known to be faithful in vision.
target: Bai im fietfulnis im pruuv fi bi a prafit. Bai im wod dem im nuo fi bi fietful ina vizhan.

en: When his enemies pressed on him on every side, he called upon the Lord, the Mighty One, with the offering of the suckling lamb.
target: Wen im enimi dem pres pan im pan evri said, im kaal pan di Laad, di Maiti Uan, wid di aafrin a di soklin lam.

en: Then the Lord thundered from heaven. He made his voice heard with a mighty sound.
target: Den di Laad tonda fram evn. Im mek im vais ier wid a maiti soun.

en: He utterly destroyed the rulers of the Tyrians and all the princes of the Philistines.
target: Im otali distrai di ruula dem a di Tairian dem an aal di prins dem a di Filistain dem.

en: Before the time of his age-long sleep, he testified in the sight of the Lord and his anointed, “I have not taken any man’s goods, so much as a sandal;” and no one accused him.
target: Bifuo di taim a im iej-lang sliip, im testifai ina di sait a di Laad an im anaintid uan, “Mi no tek eni man gudz, so moch az a sandal;” an non akiuuz im.

en: Even after he fell asleep, he prophesied, and showed the king his end, and lifted up his voice from the earth in prophecy, to blot out the wickedness of the people.
target: Iivn aafta im faal asliip, im prafisai, an shuo di king im en, an lif op im vais fram di ort ina prafisi, fi blat out di wikidnis a di piipl.

en: After him, Nathan rose up to prophesy in the days of David.
target: Aafta im, Nietan raiz op fi prafisai ina di die dem a Dievid.

en: As is the fat when it is separated from the peace offering, so was David separated from the children of Israel.
target: Az a di fat wen it separeit fram di piis aafrin, so Dievid separeit fram di pikni dem a Izrel.

en: He played with lions as with kids, and with bears as with lambs of the flock.
target: Im plie wid laian dem az wid kid dem, an wid bier dem az wid lam dem a di flak.

en: In his youth didn’t he kill a giant, and take away reproach from the people when he lifted up his hand with a sling stone, and beat down the boasting Goliath?
target: Ina im yuut im no kil a jaiyant, an tek awie ripruoch fram di piipl wen im lif op im an wid a sling stuon, an biit dong di buosin Golaiat?

en: For he called upon the Most High Lord, and he gave him strength in his right hand to kill a man mighty in war, to exalt the horn of his people.
target: Kaa im kaal pan di Mos Ai Laad, an im gi im strent ina im rait an fi kil a man maiti ina waar, fi egzaalt di aan a im piipl.

en: So they glorified him for his tens of thousands, and praised him for the blessings of the Lord, in that a glorious diadem was given to him.
target: So dem gluorifai im fi im ten dem a touzn dem, an priez im fi di blesin dem a di Laad, ina dat a gluorios daiyadem gi tu im.

en: For he destroyed the enemies on every side, and defeated the Philistines his adversaries. He broke their horn in pieces to this day.
target: Kaa im distrai di enimi dem pan evri said, an difiit di Filistain dem im advasari dem. Im bruk dem aan ina piis dem tu dis die.

en: In every work of his he gave thanks to the Holy One Most High with words of glory. He sang praise with his whole heart, and loved him who made him.
target: Ina evri wok a im im gi tangks tu di Uoli Uan Mos Ai wid wod dem a gluori. Im sing priez wid im uol aat, an lov im uu mek im.

en: He set singers before the altar, to make sweet melody by their music.
target: Im set singa dem bifuo di aalta, fi mek swiit melodi bai dem myuuzik.

en: He gave beauty to the feasts, and set in order the seasons to completion while they praised his holy name, and the sanctuary resounded from early morning.
target: Im gi byuuti tu di fiis dem, an set ina aada di siizn dem tu komplishan wail dem priez im uoli niem, an di sangkchuari rizaun fram orli maanin.

en: The Lord took away his sins, and exalted his horn forever. He gave him a covenant of kings, and a glorious throne in Israel.
target: Di Laad tek awie im sin dem, an egzaalt im aan fareva. Im gi im a kovnant a king dem, an a gluorios chruon ina Izrel.

en: After him a wise son rose up, who because of him lived in security.
target: Aafta im a waiz son raiz op, uu bikaaz a im liv ina sikyuuriti.

en: Solomon reigned in days of peace. God gave him rest all around, that he might set up a house for his name, and prepare a sanctuary forever.
target: Soloman rien ina die dem a piis. Gad gi im res aal arong, dat im kyan set op a ous fi im niem, an pripier a sangkchuari fareva.

en: How wise you were made in your youth, and filled as a river with understanding!
target: Ou waiz yu mek ina yu yuut, an ful az a riva wid andastandin!

en: Your influence covered the earth, and you filled it with parables and riddles.
target: Yu influens kova di ort, an yu ful it wid parabl dem an ridl dem.

en: Your name reached to the far away islands, and you were loved for your peace.
target: Yu niem riich tu di faar awie ailan dem, an yu lov fi yu piis.

en: For your songs, proverbs, parables, and interpretations, the countries marveled at you.
target: Fi yu sang dem, pravarb dem, parabl dem, an intopritieshan dem, di kontri dem maarvl a yu.

en: By the name of the Lord God, who is called the God of Israel, you gathered gold like tin, and multiplied silver like lead.
target: Bai di niem a di Laad Gad, uu kaal di Gad a Izrel, yu gyada guol laik tin, an moltiplai silva laik led.

en: You bowed your loins to women, and in your body you were brought into subjection.
target: Yu bou yu lain dem tu uman dem, an ina yu badi yu braat ina sobjekshan.

en: You blemished your honor, and defiled your offspring, to bring wrath upon your children. I was grieved for your folly,
target: Yu blemish yu ana, an difail yu afspring, fi bring raat pan yu pikni dem. Mi griiv fi yu fali,

en: because the sovereignty was divided, and a disobedient kingdom ruled out of Ephraim.
target: bikaaz di savrinti divaid, an a disobidient kindom ruul outa Iifrem.

en: But the Lord will never forsake his mercy. He won’t destroy any of his works, nor blot out the posterity of his elect. He won’t take away the offspring of him who loved him. He gave a remnant to Jacob, and to David a root from his own family.
target: Bot di Laad wi neva fasiek im mersi. Im naa distrai eni a im wok dem, nar blat out di pasteriti a im elek. Im naa tek awie di afspring a im uu lov im. Im gi a remnant tu Jiekob, an tu Dievid a ruut fram im uon fambili.

en: So Solomon rested with his fathers. Of his offspring, he left behind him Rehoboam, the foolishness of the people, and one who lacked understanding, who made the people revolt by his counsel. Also Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, and gave a way of sin to Ephraim.
target: So Soloman res wid im faada dem. A im afspring, im lef baka im Riiobuom, di fuulishnis a di piipl, an uan uu lak andastandin, uu mek di piipl rivolt bai im kounsl. Tu Jerobuom di son a Niibat, uu mek Izrel sin, an gi a wie a sin tu Iifrem.

en: Their sins were multiplied exceedingly, until they were removed from their land.
target: Dem sin dem moltiplai exiid ingli, ontil dem rimuuv fram dem lan.

en: For they sought out all manner of wickedness, until vengeance came upon them.
target: Kaa dem siik out aal maner a wikidnis, ontil venjans kom pan dem.

en: Then Elijah arose, the prophet like fire. His word burned like a torch.
target: Den Eliija araiz, di prafit laik faiya. Im wod bon laik a taach.

en: He brought a famine upon them, and by his zeal made them few in number.
target: Im braat a famin pan dem, an bai im ziil mek dem fyuu ina nomba.

en: By the word of the Lord he shut up the heavens. He brought down fire three times.
target: Bai di wod a di Laad im shot op di evn dem. Im braat dong faiya chrii taim.

en: How you were glorified, O Elijah, in your wondrous deeds! Whose glory is like yours?
target: Ou yu gluorifai, O Eliija, ina yu wondros diid dem! Uus gluori laik yuon?

en: You raised up a dead man from death, from Hades, by the word of the Most High.
target: Yu riez op a ded man fram det, fram Iidis, bai di wod a di Mos Ai.

en: You brought down kings to destruction, and honorable men from their sickbeds.
target: Yu braat dong king dem tu distrokshan, an anarebl man dem fram dem sikbed dem.

en: You heard rebuke in Sinai, and judgments of vengeance in Horeb.
target: Yu ier ribyuuk ina Sainai, an jojment dem a venjans ina Uoreb.

en: You anointed kings for retribution, and prophets to succeed after you.
target: Yu anaint king dem fi retribyuushan, an prafit dem fi soksiid aafta yu.

en: You were taken up in a tempest of fire, in a chariot of fiery horses.
target: Yu get tek op ina a tempest a faiya, ina a chariot a faiyari aas dem.

en: You were recorded for reproofs in their seasons, to pacify anger, before it broke out into wrath, to turn the heart of the father to the son, and to restore the tribes of Jacob.
target: Yu rekaad fi ripruuf dem ina dem siizn dem, fi pasifai anga, bifuo it briek out ina raat, fi ton di aat a di faada tu di son, an fi ristuor di traib dem a Jiekob.

en: Blessed are those who saw you, and those who have been beautified with love; for we also will surely live.
target: Bles a dem uu si yu, an dem uu biinyuutifai wid lov; kaa wi tu wi shuor liv.

en: Elijah was wrapped in a whirlwind. Elisha was filled with his spirit. In his days he was not moved by the fear of any ruler, and no one brought him into subjection.
target: Eliija rap ina a wirlwin. Eliisha ful wid im spirit. Ina im die dem im no muuv bai di fiir a eni ruula, an non braat im ina sobjekshan.

en: Nothing was too hard for him. When he was buried, his body prophesied.
target: Notn ben tuu aad fi im. Wen im beri, im badi prafisai.

en: As in his life he did wonders, so his works were also marvelous in death.
target: Az ina im laif im du wanda dem, so im wok dem tu maarvelos ina det.

en: For all this the people didn’t repent. They didn’t depart from their sins, until they were carried away as a plunder from their land, and were scattered through all the earth. The people were left very few in number, but with a ruler from the house of David.
target: Fi aal dis di piipl no ripent. Dem no dipaat fram dem sin dem, ontil dem kyari awie az a plonda fram dem lan, an skata chruu aal di ort. Di piipl lef veri fyuu ina nomba, bot wid a ruula fram di ous a Dievid.

en: Some of them did that which was right, but some multiplied sins.
target: Som a dem du dat we rait, bot som moltiplai sin dem.

en: Hezekiah fortified his city, and brought water into its midst. He tunneled through rock with iron, and built cisterns for water.
target: Ezekaia faatifai im siti, an braat waata ina it migl. Im tonl chruu rak wid aiyan, an bil sistern dem fi waata.

en: In his days Sennacherib invaded, and sent Rabshakeh, and departed. He lifted up his hand against Zion, and boasted great things in his arrogance.
target: Ina im die dem Senakerib invied, an sen Rabshaki, an dipaat. Im lif op im an gens Zaian, an buos griet ting dem ina im aarogans.

en: Then their hearts and their hands were shaken, and they were in pain, as women in labor.
target: Den dem aat dem an dem an dem shek, an dem ben ina pien, az uman dem ina lieba.

en: But they called upon the Lord who is merciful, spreading out their hands to him. The Holy One quickly heard them out of Heaven, and delivered them by the hand of Isaiah.
target: Bot dem kaal pan di Laad uu mersiful, a spred out dem an dem tu im. Di Uoli Uan kwikli ier dem outa Evn, an diliva dem bai di an a Aizaia.

en: He struck the camp of the Assyrians, and his angel utterly destroyed them.
target: Im straik di kyamp a di Asiirian dem, an im ienjel otali distrai dem.

en: For Hezekiah did that which was pleasing to the Lord, and was strong in the ways of his ancestor David, which Isaiah the prophet commanded, who was great and faithful in his vision.
target: Kaa Ezekaia du dat we pliizin tu di Laad, an ben strang ina di wie dem a im ansesta Dievid, we Aizaia di prafit komaan, uu ben griet an fietful ina im vizhan.

en: In his days the sun went backward. He prolonged the life of the king.
target: Ina im die dem di son go bakwod. Im pralong di laif a di king.

en: He saw by an excellent spirit what would come to pass in the future; and he comforted those who mourned in Zion.
target: Im si bai a excelent spirit wa wuda kom tu paas ina di fyuu cha; an im komfat dem uu muorn ina Zaian.

en: He showed the things that would happen through the end of time, and the hidden things before they came.
target: Im shuo di ting dem we wuda apm chruu di en a taim, an di idn ting dem bifuo dem kom.

en: The memory of Josiah is like the composition of incense prepared by the work of the perfumer. It will be sweet as honey in every mouth, and like music at a banquet of wine.
target: Di memri a Josaia laik di kompozishan a insens pripier bai di wok a di porfyuuma. It wi swiit az oni ina evri mout, an laik myuuzik a a bankwet a wain.

en: He did what was right in the reforming of the people, and took away the detestable things of sin.
target: Im du wa rait ina di rifaamin a di piipl, an tek awie di ditestabl ting dem a sin.

en: He set his heart right toward the Lord. In lawless days, he made godliness prevail.
target: Im set im aat rait tuwad di Laad. Ina laales die dem, im mek raichosnis priviel.

en: Except David, Hezekiah, and Josiah, all were wicked, because they abandoned the law of the Most High. The kings of Judah came to an end.
target: Exsep Dievid, Ezekaia, an Josaia, aal ben wikid, bikaaz dem abandon di laa a di Mos Ai. Di king dem a Juuda kom tu a en.

en: They gave their power to others, and their glory to a foreign nation.
target: Dem gi dem powa tu ada dem, an dem gluori tu a farin nieshan.

en: They set the chosen city of the sanctuary on fire and made her streets desolate, as it was written by the hand of Jeremiah.
target: Dem set di chuozn siti a di sangkchuari pan faiya an mek ar striit dem desolet, az it ben rait bai di an a Jeremaia.

en: For they mistreated him; yet he was consecrated in the womb to be a prophet, to root out, to afflict, to destroy and likewise to build and to plant.
target: Kaa dem mischriit im; bot im kansikriet ina di womb fi bi a prafit, fi ruut out, fi aflik, fi distrai an laikwaiz fi bil an fi plaant.

en: Ezekiel saw the vision of glory, which God showed him on the chariot of the cherubim.
target: Iziikiel si di vizhan a gluori, we Gad shuo im pan di chariot a di kerubim dem.

en: For truly he remembered the enemies in rainstorm, and to do good to those who directed their ways aright.
target: Kaa chuuli im memba di enimi dem ina rienstorm, an fi du gud tu dem uu dairek dem wie dem araait.

en: Also of the twelve prophets, may their bones flourish again out of their place. He comforted the people of Jacob, and delivered them by confident hope.
target: Tu a di twelv prafit dem, mie dem buon dem florish agen outa dem plies. Im komfat di piipl a Jiekob, an diliva dem bai kanfident uop.

en: How will we magnify Zerubbabel? He was like a signet ring on the right hand.
target: Ou wi wi magnifai Zerobabel? Im ben laik a signet ring pan di rait an.

en: So was Jesus the son of Josedek, who in their days built the house, and exalted a people holy to the Lord, prepared for everlasting glory.
target: So ben Jiizas di son a Josedek, uu ina dem die dem bil di ous, an egzaalt a piipl uoli tu di Laad, pripier fi evalaastin gluori.

en: Also of Nehemiah the memory is great. He raised up for us fallen walls, set up the gates and bars, and rebuilt our houses.
target: Tu a Niimaia di memri griet. Im riez op fi wi faal dong waal dem, set op di giet dem an baar dem, an ribil wi ous dem.

en: No man was created upon the earth like Enoch, for he was taken up from the earth.
target: No man kriet pan di ort laik Iinak, kaa im get tek op fram di ort.

en: Nor was there a man born like Joseph, a leader of his kindred, a supporter of the people. Even his bones were cared for.
target: Nar ben dier a man baan laik Juozif, a liida a im kindred, a sapuota a di piipl. Iivn im buon dem kier fi.

en: Shem and Seth were honored among men, but above every living thing in the creation was Adam.
target: Shem an Set ben ana mongx man dem, bot abov evri livin ting ina di krieshan ben Aadam.

en: It was Simon, the son of Onias, the high priest, who in his life repaired the house, and in his days strengthened the temple.
target: It ben Saiman, di son a Onaias, di ai priis, uu ina im laif ripier di ous, an ina im die dem strentn di templ.

en: The foundation was built by him to the height of the double walls, the lofty retaining walls of the temple enclosure.
target: Di foundieshan bil bai im tu di ait a di dobl waal dem, di laafti ritienin waal dem a di templ enkluoja.

en: In his days, a water cistern was dug, the brazen vessel like the sea in circumference.
target: Ina im die dem, a waata sistern dog, di braas veisl laik di sii ina sorkomfrans.

en: He planned to save his people from ruin, and fortified the city against siege.
target: Im plan fi siev im piipl fram ruin, an faatifai di siti gens siij.

en: How glorious he was when the people gathered around him as he came out of the house of the veil!
target: Ou gluorios im ben wen di piipl gyada arong im az im kom outa di ous a di viel!

en: He was like the morning star among clouds, like the full moon,
target: Im ben laik di maanin staar mongx kloud dem, laik di ful muun,

en: like the sun shining on the temple of the Most High, like the rainbow shining in clouds of glory,
target: laik di son a shain pan di templ a di Mos Ai, laik di rienbuo a shain ina kloud dem a gluori,

en: like roses in the days of first fruits, like lilies by a water spring, like the shoot of the frankincense tree in summer time,
target: laik ruoz dem ina di die dem a fos fruut dem, laik lili dem bai a waata spring, laik di shuut a di frankinsens chrii ina soma taim,

en: like fire and incense in the censer, like a vessel of beaten gold adorned with all kinds of precious stones,
target: laik faiya an insens ina di sensa, laik a veisl a biitn guol adoon wid aal kain a preshos stuon dem,

en: like an olive tree loaded with fruit, and like a cypress growing high among the clouds.
target: laik a aliv chrii luod wid fruut, an laik a saipres a gruo ai mongx di kloud dem.

en: When he put on his glorious robe, and clothed himself in perfect splendor, ascending to the holy altar, he made the court of the sanctuary glorious.
target: Wen im put aan im gluorios ruob, an kluod imself ina porfek splenda, a asend tu di uoli aalta, im mek di kuort a di sangkchuari gluorios.

en: When he received the portions out of the priests’ hands, as he stood by the hearth of the altar, with his kindred like a garland around him, he was like a young cedar in Lebanon surrounded by the trunks of palm trees.
target: Wen im risiev di paashan dem outa di priis dem an dem, az im tan bai di aat a di aalta, wid im kindred laik a gaalan arong im, im ben laik a yong siida ina Lebanan soround bai di chrongk dem a paam chrii dem.

en: All the sons of Aaron in their glory, held the Lord’s offering in their hands before all the congregation of Israel.
target: Aal di son dem a Ieran ina dem gluori, eld di Laads aafrin ina dem an dem bifuo aal di kanggrigieshan a Izrel.

en: Finishing the service at the altars, that he might arrange the offering of the Most High, the Almighty,
target: A finish di sorvis a di aalta dem, dat im kyan arienj di aafrin a di Mos Ai, di Olmaiti,

en: he stretched out his hand to the cup of libation, and poured out the cup of the grape. He poured it out at the foot of the altar, a sweet smelling fragrance to the Most High, the King of all.
target: im strech out im an tu di kop a laibieshan, an puor out di kop a di griep. Im puor it out a di fut a di aalta, a swiit smelin friegrans tu di Mos Ai, di King a aal.

en: Then the sons of Aaron shouted. They sounded the trumpets of beaten work. They made a great fanfare to be heard, for a reminder before the Most High.
target: Den di son dem a Ieran shout. Dem soun di chompit dem a biitn wok. Dem mek a griet fanfier fi ier, fi a rimainda bifuo di Mos Ai.

en: Then all the people together hurried, and fell down to the ground on their faces to worship their Lord, the Almighty, God Most High.
target: Den aal di piipl tugeda ori, an faal dong tu di grong pan dem fies dem fi worship dem Laad, di Olmaiti, Gad Mos Ai.

en: The singers also praised him with their voices. There was a sweet melody in the whole house.
target: Di singa dem tu priez im wid dem vais dem. Dier ben a swiit melodi ina di uol ous.

en: And the people implored the Lord Most High, in prayer before him who is merciful, until the worship of the Lord was finished, and so they accomplished his service.
target: An di piipl impluor di Laad Mos Ai, ina prier bifuo im uu mersiful, ontil di worship a di Laad finish, an so dem akomplish im sorvis.

en: Then he went down, and lifted up his hands over the whole congregation of the children of Israel, to give blessing to the Lord with his lips, and to glory in his name.
target: Den im go dong, an lif op im an dem uova di uol kanggrigieshan a di pikni dem a Izrel, fi gi blesin tu di Laad wid im lip dem, an fi gluori ina im niem.

en: He bowed himself down in worship the second time, to declare the blessing from the Most High.
target: Im bou imself dong ina worship di sekan taim, fi diklier di blesin fram di Mos Ai.

en: Now bless the God of all, who everywhere does great things, who exalts our days from the womb, and deals with us according to his mercy.
target: Nou bles di Gad a aal, uu evriwe du griet ting dem, uu egzaalt wi die dem fram di womb, an diil wid wi akaadin tu im mersi.

en: May he grant us joyfulness of heart, and that peace may be in our days in Israel for the days of eternity,
target: Mie im grant wi jaifulnis a aat, an dat piis kyan bi ina wi die dem ina Izrel fi di die dem a itoorniti,

en: to entrust his mercy with us, and let him deliver us in his time!
target: fi enchros im mersi wid wi, an mek im diliva wi ina im taim!

en: With two nations my soul is vexed, and the third is no nation:
target: Wid tuu nieshan dem mi suol veks, an di tord a no nieshan:

en: Those who sit on the mountain of Samaria, the Philistines, and the foolish people who live in Shechem.
target: Dem uu sidong pan di mountn a Samieria, di Filistain dem, an di fuulish piipl uu liv ina Shekem.

en: I have written in this book the instruction of understanding and knowledge, I Jesus, the son of Sirach Eleazar, of Jerusalem, who out of his heart poured forth wisdom.
target: Mi rait ina dis buk di instrokshan a andastandin an nalij, mi Jiizas, di son a Sairak Eliaza, a Jeruusalem, uu outa im aat puor fuot wizdam.

en: Blessed is he who will exercise these things. He who lays them up in his heart will become wise.
target: Bles a im uu wi egzasaiz dem ting. Im uu lie dem op ina im aat wi bikom waiz.

en: For if he does them, he will be strong in all things, for the light of the Lord is his guide.
target: Kaa ef im du dem, im wi strang ina aal ting, kaa di lait a di Laad a im gaid.

en: I will give thanks to you, O Lord, O King, and will praise you, O God my Savior. I give thanks to your name,
target: Mi wi gi tangks tu yu, O Laad, O King, an wi priez yu, O Gad mi Sievia. Mi gi tangks tu yu niem,

en: for you have been my protector and helper, and delivered my body out of destruction, and out of the snare of a slanderous tongue, from lips that fabricate lies. You were my helper before those who stood by,
target: kaa yu ben mi protekta an elpa, an diliva mi badi outa distrokshan, an outa di snier a a slandaros tong, fram lip dem we fabrikiet lai dem. Yu ben mi elpa bifuo dem uu tan bai,

en: and delivered me, according to the abundance of your mercy and of your name, from the gnashings of teeth ready to devour, out of the hand of those seeking my life, out of the many afflictions I endured,
target: an diliva mi, akaadin tu di abundans a yu mersi an a yu niem, fram di gnashin dem a tiit redi fi divour, outa di an a dem a siik mi laif, outa di meni aflikshan dem mi endyuor,

en: from the choking of a fire on every side, and out of the midst of fire that I hadn’t kindled,
target: fram di chuokin a a faiya pan evri said, an outa di migl a faiya we mi no ben kindl,

en: out of the depth of the belly of Hades, from an unclean tongue, and from lying words—
target: outa di dept a di beli a Iidis, fram a onkliin tong, an fram laiin wod dem—

en: the slander of an unrighteous tongue to the king. My soul drew near to death. My life was near to Hades.
target: di slanda a a onraichos tong tu di king. Mi suol jraa nier tu det. Mi laif ben nier tu Iidis.

en: They surrounded me on every side. There was no one to help me. I was looking for human help, and there was none.
target: Dem soround mi pan evri said. Dier ben non fi elp mi. Mi ben a luk fi yuuman elp, an dier ben non.

en: Then I remembered your mercy, O Lord, and your working which has been from everlasting, how you deliver those who wait for you, and save them out of the hand of their enemies.
target: Den mi memba yu mersi, O Laad, an yu wokin we ben fram eva laastin, ou yu diliva dem uu wiet fi yu, an siev dem outa di an a dem enimi dem.

en: I lifted up my prayer from the earth, and prayed for deliverance from death.
target: Mi lif op mi prier fram di ort, an prie fi dilivarans fram det.

en: I called upon the Lord, the Father of my Lord, that he would not forsake me in the days of affliction, in the time when there was no help against the proud.
target: Mi kaal pan di Laad, di Faada a mi Laad, dat im wuda no fasiek mi ina di die dem a aflikshan, ina di taim wen dier ben no elp gens di proud dem.

en: I will praise your name continually. I will sing praise with thanksgiving. My prayer was heard.
target: Mi wi priez yu niem kantinyuali. Mi wi sing priez wid tangksgivin. Mi prier ier.

en: You saved me from destruction and delivered me from the evil time. Therefore I will give thanks and praise to you, and bless the name of the Lord.
target: Yu siev mi fram distrokshan an diliva mi fram di iivl taim. Dierfuo mi wi gi tangks an priez tu yu, an bles di niem a di Laad.

en: When I was yet young, before I went abroad, I sought wisdom openly in my prayer.
target: Wen mi ben yet yong, bifuo mi go abraad, mi siik wizdam uopnli ina mi prier.

en: Before the temple I asked for her. I will seek her out even to the end.
target: Bifuo di templ mi aaks fi ar. Mi wi siik ar out iivn tu di en.

en: From the first flower to the ripening grape my heart delighted in her. My foot walked in uprightness. From my youth I followed her steps.
target: Fram di fos flowa tu di raipnin griep mi aat dilait ina ar. Mi fut waak ina opraitnis. Fram mi yuut mi fala ar step dem.

en: I inclined my ear a little, and received her, and found for myself much instruction.
target: Mi inklain mi iir a likl, an risiev ar, an fain fi miself moch instrokshan.

en: I profited in her. I will give glory to him who gives me wisdom.
target: Mi prafit ina ar. Mi wi gi gluori tu im uu gi mi wizdam.

en: For I determined to practice her. I was zealous for that which is good. I will never be put to shame.
target: Kaa mi ditormin fi praktis ar. Mi ben zelos fi dat we gud. Mi wi neva put tu shiem.

en: My soul has wrestled with her. In my conduct I was exact. I spread out my hands to the sky above, and bewailed my ignorances of her.
target: Mi suol resl wid ar. Ina mi kondok mi ben egzakt. Mi spred out mi an dem tu di skai abov, an biwiel mi ignarans dem a ar.

en: I directed my soul to her. In purity I found her. I got myself a heart joined with her from the beginning. Therefore I won’t be forsaken.
target: Mi dairek mi suol tu ar. Ina pyuuriti mi fain ar. Mi get miself a aat jain wid ar fram di biginin. Dierfuo mi naa fasiek.

en: My belly also was troubled to seek her. Therefore I have gained a good possession.
target: Mi beli tu chrobl fi siik ar. Dierfuo mi gien a gud pozeshan.

en: The Lord gave me a tongue for my reward. I will praise him with it.
target: Di Laad gi mi a tong fi mi riwaad. Mi wi priez im wid it.

en: Draw near to me, all you who are uneducated, and live in the house of instruction.
target: Jraa nier tu mi, aal unu uu onedyukiet, an liv ina di ous a instrokshan.

en: Why therefore are you all lacking in these things, and your souls are very thirsty?
target: Wai dierfuo unu aal lakin ina dem ting, an unu suol dem veri torsti?

en: I opened my mouth and spoke, “Get her for yourselves without money.”
target: Mi uopn mi mout an taak, “Get ar fi unuself widout moni.”

en: Put your neck under the yoke, and let your soul receive instruction. She is near to find.
target: Put unu nek anda di yoke, an mek unu suol risiev instrokshan. Shi nier fi fain.

en: See with your eyes how I labored just a little and found for myself much rest.
target: Si wid unu ai dem ou mi lieba jos a likl an fain fi miself moch res.

en: Get instruction with a great sum of silver, and gain much gold by her.
target: Get instrokshan wid a griet som a silva, an gien moch guol bai ar.

en: May your soul rejoice in his mercy, and may you all not be put to shame in praising him.
target: Mie unu suol rijais ina im mersi, an mie unu aal no put tu shiem ina priezin im.

en: Work your work before the time comes, and in his time he will give you your reward.
target: Wok unu wok bifuo di taim kom, an ina im taim im wi gi unu unu riwaad.

en: All wisdom comes from the Lord, and is with him forever.
target: Aal wizdom kom fram di Laad, an a wid im fareva.

en: Who can count the sand of the seas, the drops of rain, and the days of eternity?
target: Uu kyan kount di san a di sii dem, di jrap a rien, an di die dem a iterniti?

en: Who will search out the height of the sky, the breadth of the earth, the deep, and wisdom?
target: Uu wi saach out di ait a di skai, di bredt a di ort, di diip, an wizdom?

en: Wisdom has been created before all things, and the understanding of prudence from everlasting.
target: Wizdom ben mek bifuo aal ting, an di andastandin a prudens fram eva-lastin.

en: [Reader’s note: Verse 5 is omitted by the best authorities: The source of wisdom is God’s word in the highest heaven, and her ways are the eternal commandments.]
target: [Riida nuot: Vors faib a lef out bai di bes atariti dem: Di suos a wizdom a Gads wod ina di aies evn, an ar wie dem a di iternal komanment dem.]

en: To whom has the root of wisdom been revealed? Who has known her shrewd counsels?
target: Tu uum di ruut a wizdom ben shuo? Uu av nuo ar shruud kounsl dem?

en: [Reader’s note: Verse 7 is omitted by the best authorities: To whom was the knowledge of wisdom manifested? Who has understood her abundant experience?]
target: [Riida nuot: Vors sevn a lef out bai di bes atariti dem: Tu uum di nalij a wizdom ben shuo out? Uu av andastan ar plenti ekspiriens?]

en: There is one wise, greatly to be feared, sitting upon his throne: the Lord.
target: De a wan waiz, griet fi fia, a sidong pan im chuon: di Laad.

en: He created her. He saw and measured her. He poured her out upon all his works.
target: Im mek ar. Im si an meja ar. Im puor ar out pan aal im wok dem.

en: She is with all flesh according to his gift. He gave her freely to those who love him.
target: Shi de wid aal flesh akadin tu im gif. Im gi ar frii tu dem uu lov im.

en: The fear of the Lord is glory, exultation, gladness, and a crown of rejoicing.
target: Di fia a di Laad a gluori, big op, gladnis, an a kroun a rijaisin.

en: The fear of the Lord will delight the heart, and will give gladness, joy, and length of days.
target: Di fia a di Laad wi mek di aat api, an wi gi gladnis, jai, an lent a die dem.

en: Whoever fears the Lord, it will go well with him at the last. He will be blessed in the day of his death.
target: Uueva fia di Laad, it wi go wel wid im a di laas. Im wi bles ina di die a im det.

en: To fear the Lord is the beginning of wisdom. It was created together with the faithful in the womb.
target: Fi fia di Laad a di biginin a wizdom. It ben mek tugeda wid di fietful ina di wuum.

en: She laid an eternal foundation with men. She will be trusted among their offspring.
target: Shi put dong a iternal foundieshan wid man dem. Shi wi chos mong dem pikni dem.

en: To fear the Lord is the fullness of wisdom. She inebriates men with her fruits.
target: Fi fia di Laad a di fulnis a wizdom. Shi mek man dem jrongk wid ar fruut dem.

en: She will fill all her house with desirable things, and her storehouses with her produce.
target: Shi wi ful op aal ar ous wid ting we piipl waant, an ar stuor-ous dem wid wa shi mek.

en: The fear of the Lord is the crown of wisdom, making peace and perfect health to flourish.
target: Di fia a di Laad a di kroun a wizdom, a mek piis an porfek elt flourish.

en: He both saw and measured her. He rained down skill and knowledge of understanding, and exalted the honor of those who hold her fast.
target: Im si an meja ar tu. Im rien dong skil an nalij a andastandin, an lif op di ana a dem uu uol ar faas.

en: To fear the Lord is the root of wisdom. Her branches are length of days.
target: Fi fia di Laad a di ruut a wizdom. Ar branch dem a lent a die dem.

en: [Reader’s note: Verse 21 is omitted by the best authorities: The fear of the Lord drives away sins. Where it resides, it will turn away all anger.]
target: [Riida nuot: Vors twenti-wan a lef out bai di bes atariti dem: Di fia a di Laad jraiv we sin dem. We it tan, it wi ton we aal anga.]

en: Unjust wrath can never be justified, for his wrath tips the scale to his downfall.
target: Onjos raat kyaa neva jos, kaa im raat tip di skiel tu im dongfaal.

en: A man that is patient will resist for a season, and afterward gladness will spring up to him.
target: A man we a pieshent wi rizis fi a siizn, an afta dat gladnis wi spring op tu im.

en: He will hide his words until the right moment, and the lips of many will tell of his understanding.
target: Im wi aid im wod dem til di rait muoment, an di lip a nof piipl wi tel a im andastandin.

en: A wise saying is in the treasures of wisdom; but godliness is a detestable thing to a sinner.
target: A waiz seyin de ina di treja dem a wizdom; bot fi liv raichos a a ting we sinna iet.

en: If you desire wisdom, keep the commandments and the Lord will give her to you freely;
target: If yu waant wizdom, kip di komanment dem an di Laad wi gi ar tu yu frii;

en: for the fear of the Lord is wisdom and instruction. Faith and humility are his good pleasure.
target: kaa di fia a di Laad a wizdom an instrokshan. Fiet an yuomiliti a im gud pleja.

en: Don’t disobey the fear of the Lord. Don’t come to him with a double heart.
target: No disuobie di fia a di Laad. No kom tu im wid a dobl aat.

en: Don’t be a hypocrite in men’s sight. Keep watch over your lips.
target: No bi a ipokrit ina man dem sait. Kip wach uova yu lip dem.

en: Don’t exalt yourself, or you will fall and bring dishonor upon your soul. The Lord will reveal your secrets and will cast you down in the midst of the congregation, because you didn’t come to the fear of the Lord and your heart was full of deceit.
target: No lif op yuself, ar yu wi faal an bring disana pan yu suol. Di Laad wi shuo yu siikrit dem an wi chuo yu dong ina di migl a di kangrigieshan, kaa yu neva kom tu di fia a di Laad an yu aat ben ful a disiet.

en: My son, if you come to serve the Lord, prepare your soul for temptation.
target: Mi son, if yu kom fi sorv di Laad, pripier yu suol fi temptieshan.

en: Set your heart aright, constantly endure, and don’t make haste in time of calamity.
target: Set yu aat rait, kip on endior, an no mek ies ina taim a kalamiti.

en: Cling to him, and don’t depart, that you may be increased at your latter end.
target: Kling tu im, an no go we, so yu mait get biga a yu lata en.

en: Accept whatever is brought upon you, and be patient when you suffer humiliation.
target: Aksep wateva bring pan yu, an bi pieshent wen yu sofa yuomilieshan.

en: For gold is tried in the fire, and acceptable men in the furnace of humiliation.
target: Kaa guol a chrai ina di faiya, an man dem we aksep ina di fornis a yuomilieshan.

en: Put your trust in him, and he will help you. Make your ways straight, and set your hope on him.
target: Put yu chos ina im, an im wi elp yu. Mek yu wie dem striet, an set yu uop pan im.

en: All you who fear the Lord, wait for his mercy. Don’t turn aside, or you will fall.
target: Aal unu uu fia di Laad, wiet fi im mersi. No ton said, ar unu wi faal.

en: All you who fear the Lord, put your trust in him, and your reward will not fail.
target: Aal unu uu fia di Laad, put unu chos ina im, an unu riwaad wi no fiel.

en: All you who fear the Lord, hope for good things, and for eternal gladness and mercy.
target: Aal unu uu fia di Laad, uop fi gud ting dem, an fi iternal gladnis an mersi.

en: Look at the generations of old, and see: Who ever put his trust in the Lord, and was ashamed? Or who remained in his fear, and was forsaken? Or who called upon him, and he neglected him?
target: Luk pan di jenarieshan dem a uol taim, an si: Uu eva put im chos ina di Laad, an get shiem? Ar uu tan ina im fia, an ben lef beain? Ar uu kaal pan im, an im neva lisn tu im?

en: For the Lord is full of compassion and mercy. He forgives sins and saves in time of affliction.
target: Kaa di Laad ful a kompashan an mersi. Im fagiv sin dem an siev ina taim a aflikshan.

en: Woe to fearful hearts, to faint hands, and to the sinner who goes two ways!
target: Wuo tu aat dem we fia, tu fient an dem, an tu di sinna uu go tuu wie!

en: Woe to the faint heart! For it doesn’t believe. Therefore it won’t be defended.
target: Wuo tu di fient aat! Kaa it no biliiv. So it wi no get difen.

en: Woe to you who have lost your patience! And what will you all do when the Lord visits you?
target: Wuo tu unu uu av laas unu pieshens! An wa unu aal wi du wen di Laad vizit unu?

en: Those who fear the Lord will not disobey his words. Those who love him will keep his ways.
target: Dem uu fia di Laad wi no disuobie im wod dem. Dem uu lov im wi kip im wie dem.

en: Those who fear the Lord will seek his good pleasure. Those who love him will be filled with the law.
target: Dem uu fia di Laad wi siik im gud pleja. Dem uu lov im wi ful op wid di laa.

en: Those who fear the Lord will prepare their hearts, and will humble their souls in his sight.
target: Dem uu fia di Laad wi pripier dem aat, an wi ombl dem suol ina im sait.

en: We will fall into the hands of the Lord, and not into the hands of men; for as his majesty is, so also is his mercy.
target: Wi wi faal ina di an a di Laad, an no ina di an a man dem; kaa az im majesti a, so tu im mersi a.

en: Hear me, your father, O my children, and do what you hear, that you all may be safe.
target: Ier mi, unu faada, O mi pikni dem, an du wa unu ier, so unu aal mait siev.

en: For the Lord honors the father over the children, and has confirmed the judgment of the mother over her sons.
target: Kaa di Laad ana di faada uova di pikni dem, an av kanform di jojment a di mada uova ar son dem.

en: He who honors his father will make atonement for sins.
target: Ii uu ana im faada wi mek atonment fi sin dem.

en: He who gives glory to his mother is as one who lays up treasure.
target: Ii uu gi gluori tu im mada a laik wan uu a put dong treja.

en: Whoever honors his father will have joy in his own children. He will be heard in the day of his prayer.
target: Uueva ana im faada wi av jai ina im uon pikni dem. Im wi ier ina di die a im prier.

en: He who gives glory to his father will have length of days. He who listens to the Lord will bring rest to his mother,
target: Ii uu gi gluori tu im faada wi av lent a die dem. Ii uu lisn tu di Laad wi bring res tu im mada,

en: and will serve under his parents, as to masters.
target: an wi sorv anda im pierent dem, az tu maasta dem.

en: Honor your father in deed and word, that a blessing may come upon you from him.
target: Ana yu faada ina diid an wod, so a blesin mait kom pan yu fram im.

en: For the blessing of the father establishes the houses of children, but the curse of the mother roots out the foundations.
target: Kaa di blesin a di faada bil op di ous dem a pikni dem, bot di kos a di mada ruut out di foundieshan dem.

en: Don’t glorify yourself in the dishonor of your father, for your father’s dishonor is no glory to you.
target: No gluorifai yuself ina di disana a yu faada, kaa yu faada disana a no gluori tu yu.

en: For the glory of a man is from the honor of his father, and a mother in dishonor is a reproach to her children.
target: Kaa di gluori a a man kom fram di ana a im faada, an a mada ina disana a a riprooch tu ar pikni dem.

en: My son, help your father in his old age, and don’t grieve him as long as he lives.
target: Mi son, elp yu faada ina im uol iej, an no griiv im az lang az im liv.

en: If he fails in understanding, have patience with him. Don’t dishonor him in your full strength.
target: If im fiel ina andastandin, av pieshens wid im. No disana im ina yu ful strent.

en: For the kindness to your father will not be forgotten. Instead of sins it will be added to build you up.
target: Kaa di kainnis tu yu faada wi no fagat. Insiid a sin dem it wi ad op fi bil yu op.

en: In the day of your affliction it will be remembered for you, as fair weather upon ice, so your sins will also melt away.
target: Ina di die a yu aflikshan it wi memba fi yu, az fier weda pan ais, so yu sin dem wi melt we tu.

en: He who forsakes his father is as a blasphemer. He who provokes his mother is cursed by the Lord.
target: Ii uu lef im faada a laik a blasfiima. Ii uu provuok im mada a kos bai di Laad.

en: My son, go on with your business in humility; so you will be loved by an acceptable man.
target: Mi son, go aan wid yu biznis ina yuomiliti; so a man we aksep wi lov yu.

en: The greater you are, humble yourself the more, and you will find favor before the Lord.
target: Di muo big yu a, di muo ombl yuself, an yu wi fain fieva bifuo di Laad.

en: [Reader’s note: Some manuscripts add Many are lofty and renowned, but he reveals his secrets to the humble.]
target: [Riida nuot: Som manuskrip ad: Nof a laafti an big niem, bot im shuo im siikrit dem tu di ombl.]

en: For the power of the Lord is great, and he is glorified by those who are lowly.
target: Kaa di powa a di Laad a griet, an dem uu a luo ana im.

en: Don’t seek things that are too hard for you, and don’t search out things that are above your strength.
target: No siik ting we tuu aad fi yu, an no saach out ting we abov yu strent.

en: Think about the things that have been commanded you, for you have no need of the things that are secret.
target: Tink bout di ting dem we ben koman yu, kaa yu no niid di ting dem we a siikrit.

en: Don’t be overly busy in tasks that are beyond you, for more things are shown to you than men can understand.
target: No bi uova bizi ina taak dem we beyand yu, kaa muo ting shuo tu yu dan man dem kyan andastan.

en: For the conceit of many has led them astray. Evil opinion has caused their judgment to slip.
target: Kaa di kansiet a nof av liid dem astre. Iivl opinyan av mek dem jojment slip.

en: There is no light without eyes. There is no wisdom without knowledge.
target: De no lait widout ai dem. De no wizdom widout nalij.

en: A stubborn heart will do badly at the end. He who loves danger will perish in it.
target: A stobarn aat wi du bad a di en. Ii uu lov dienja wi ded ina it.

en: A stubborn heart will be burdened with troubles. The sinner will heap sin upon sins.
target: A stobarn aat wi borden wid chobl dem. Di sinna wi iip sin pan sin dem.

en: The calamity of the proud has no healing, for a weed of wickedness has taken root in him.
target: Di kalamiti a di proud av no iilin, kaa a wiid a wikidnis av tek ruut ina im.

en: The heart of the prudent will understand a proverb. A wise man desires the ear of a listener.
target: Di aat a di prudent wi andastan a provereb. A waiz man waant di ier a a lisna.

en: Water will quench a flaming fire; almsgiving will make atonement for sins.
target: Waata wi kwench a fliemin faiya; aamz-givin wi mek atonment fi sin dem.

en: He who repays good turns is mindful of that which comes afterward. In the time of his falling he will find a support.
target: Ii uu ripie gud ton dem a memba wa a kom afta. Ina di taim a im faalin im wi fain a sopuort.

en: My son, don’t deprive the poor of his living. Don’t make the needy eyes wait long.
target: Mi son, no tek we di puo man livin. No mek di niidi ai dem wiet lang.

en: Don’t make a hungry soul sorrowful, or provoke a man in his distress.
target: No mek a ongri suol saro-ful, ar provuok a man ina im distres.

en: Don’t add more trouble to a heart that is provoked. Don’t put off giving to him who is in need.
target: No ad muo chobl tu a aat we provuok. No put aaf givin tu im uu a ina niid.

en: Don’t reject a suppliant in his affliction. Don’t turn your face away from a poor man.
target: No rijek a wan uu a beg ina im aflikshan. No ton yu fies we fram a puo man.

en: Don’t turn your eye away from one who asks. Give no occasion to a man to curse you.
target: No ton yu ai we fram wan uu aaks. No gi no okiezhan tu a man fi kos yu.

en: For if he curses you in the bitterness of his soul, he who made him will hear his supplication.
target: Kaa if im kos yu ina di bitanis a im suol, ii uu mek im wi ier im beg.

en: Endear yourself to the assembly. Bow your head to a great man.
target: Mek piipl lov yu ina di asembli. Bou yu ed tu a griet man.

en: Incline your ear to a poor man. Answer him with peaceful words in humility.
target: Bend yu ier tu a puo man. Ansa im wid piisful wod dem ina yuomiliti.

en: Deliver him who is wronged from the hand of him who wrongs him; Don’t be hesitant in giving judgment.
target: Diliva im uu rang fram di an a im uu rang im; No bi ezitant ina givin jojment.

en: Be as a father to the fatherless, and like a husband to their mother. So you will be as a son of the Most High, and he will love you more than your mother does.
target: Bi az a faada tu di faadales, an laik a ozban tu dem mada. So yu wi bi az a son a di Mos Ai, an im wi lov yu muo dan yu mada du.

en: Wisdom exalts her sons, and takes hold of those who seek her.
target: Wizdom lif op ar son dem, an uol aan tu dem uu siik ar.

en: He who loves her loves life. Those who seek her early will be filled with gladness.
target: Ii uu lov ar lov laif. Dem uu siik ar orli wi ful op wid gladnis.

en: He who holds her fast will inherit glory. Where he enters, the Lord will bless.
target: Ii uu uol ar faas wi inherit gluori. We im go in, di Laad wi bles.

en: Those who serve her minister to the Holy One. The Lord loves those who love her.
target: Dem uu sorv ar minista tu di Uoli Wan. Di Laad lov dem uu lov ar.

en: He who listens to her will judge the nations. He who heeds her will dwell securely.
target: Ii uu lisn tu ar wi joj di nieshan dem. Ii uu iid ar wi tan siev.

en: If he trusts her, he will inherit her, and his generations will possess her.
target: If im chos ar, im wi inherit ar, an im jenarieshan dem wi uon ar.

en: For at the first she will walk with him in crooked ways, and will bring fear and dread upon him, and torment him with her discipline, until she may trust his soul, and try him by her judgments.
target: Kaa a di fos shi wi waak wid im ina krukid wie dem, an wi bring fia an dred pan im, an taament im wid ar disipline, til shi mait chos im suol, an chrai im bai ar jojment dem.

en: Then she will return him again to the straight way, and will gladden him, and reveal to him her secrets.
target: Den shi wi ton im agen tu di striet wie, an wi mek im api, an shuo tu im ar siikrit dem.

en: If he goes astray, she will forsake him, and hand him over to his fall.
target: If im go astre, shi wi lef im, an an im uova tu im faal.

en: Watch for the opportunity, and beware of evil. Don’t be ashamed of your soul.
target: Wach fi di apachuniti, an biwier a iivl. No bi ashiem a yu suol.

en: For there is a shame that brings sin, and there is a shame that is glory and grace.
target: Kaa de a shiem we bring sin, an de a shiem we a gluori an gries.

en: Don’t show partiality, discrediting your soul. Don’t revere any man to your falling.
target: No shuo paashialiti, a diskredit yu suol. No riva eni man tu yu faalin.

en: Don’t refrain from speaking when it is for safety. Don’t hide your wisdom for the sake of seeming fair.
target: No rifrien fram spiikin wen it a fi siefi. No aid yu wizdom fi di siek a lukin fier.

en: For wisdom will be known by speech, and instruction by the word of the tongue.
target: Kaa wizdom wi nuo bai spiich, an instrokshan bai di wod a di tong.

en: Don’t speak against the truth and be shamed for your ignorance.
target: No spiik gens di chuut an bi ashiem fi yu ignorans.

en: Don’t be ashamed to confess your sins. Don’t fight the river’s current.
target: No bi ashiem fi kanfes yu sin dem. No fait di riva korent.

en: Don’t lay yourself down for a fool to tread upon. Don’t be partial to one who is mighty.
target: No lie yuself dong fi a fuul fi tred pan. No bi paashal tu wan uu a maiti.

en: Strive for the truth to death, and the Lord God will fight for you.
target: Fait fi di chuut tu det, an di Laad Gad wi fait fi yu.

en: Don’t be hasty with your tongue, or slack and negligent in your deeds.
target: No bi iesti wid yu tong, ar slak an neglient ina yu diid dem.

en: Don’t be like a lion in your house, or suspicious of your servants.
target: No bi laik a laian ina yu ous, ar sospishos a yu sorvant dem.

en: Don’t let your hand be stretched out to receive, and closed when you should repay.
target: No mek yu an strech out fi risiiv, an kluoz wen yu shud ripie.

en: Don’t set your heart upon your goods. Don’t say, “They are sufficient for me.”
target: No set yu aat pan yu gud dem. No se, “Dem a inof fi mi.”

en: Don’t follow your own mind and your strength to walk in the desires of your heart.
target: No fala yu uon main an yu strent fi waak ina di dizaiya dem a yu aat.

en: Don’t say, “Who will have dominion over me?” for the Lord will surely take vengeance on you.
target: No se, “Uu wi av daminian uova mi?” kaa di Laad wi shuor tek venjans pan yu.

en: Don’t say, “I sinned, and what happened to me?” for the Lord is patient.
target: No se, “Mi sin, an wa apn tu mi?” kaa di Laad a pieshent.

en: Don’t be so confident of atonement that you add sin upon sins.
target: No bi so kanfident a atonment dat yu ad sin pan sin dem.

en: Don’t say, “His compassion is great. He will be pacified for the multitude of my sins,” for mercy and wrath are with him, and his indignation will rest on sinners.
target: No se, “Im kompashan a griet. Im wi kiet fi di moltitiuud a mi sin dem,” kaa mersi an raat de wid im, an im indignieshan wi res pan sinna dem.

en: Don’t wait to turn to the Lord. Don’t put off from day to day; for suddenly the wrath of the Lord will come on you, and you will perish in the time of vengeance.
target: No wiet fi ton tu di Laad. No put aaf fram die tu die; kaa sodnli di raat a di Laad wi kom pan yu, an yu wi ded ina di taim a venjans.

en: Don’t set your heart upon unrighteous gains, for you will profit nothing in the day of calamity.
target: No set yu aat pan onraichos gien dem, kaa yu wi prafit notn ina di die a kalamiti.

en: Don’t winnow with every wind. Don’t walk in every path. This is what the sinner who has a double tongue does.
target: No winou wid evri win. No waak ina evri paat. Dis a wa di sinna uu av a dobl tong du.

en: Be steadfast in your understanding. Let your speech be consistent.
target: Bi stedfaas ina yu andastandin. Mek yu spiich tan wan wie.

en: Be swift to hear and answer with patience.
target: Bi kwik fi ier an ansa wid pieshens.

en: If you have understanding, answer your neighbor; but if not, put your hand over your mouth.
target: If yu av andastandin, ansa yu nieba; bot if no, put yu an uova yu mout.

en: Glory and dishonor is in talk. A man’s tongue may be his downfall.
target: Gluori an disana de ina taak. A man tong mait bi im dongfaal.

en: Don’t be called a whisperer. Don’t lie in wait with your tongue; for shame is on the thief, and an evil condemnation is on him who has a double tongue.
target: No get kaal a wispara. No lie ina wiet wid yu tong; kaa shiem de pan di tiif, an a iivl kandemnieshan de pan im uu av a dobl tong.

en: Don’t be ignorant in a great or small matter.
target: No bi ignorant ina a griet ar smol mata.

en: Don’t become an enemy instead of a friend; for an evil name will inherit shame and reproach. So it is with the sinner who has a double tongue.
target: No bikam a enimi insiid a a fren; kaa a iivl niem wi inherit shiem an riprooch. So it a wid di sinna uu av a dobl tong.

en: Don’t exalt yourself in the counsel of your soul, that your soul not be torn in pieces like a bull.
target: No lif op yuself ina di kounsl a yu suol, so yu suol no tier op ina piis laik a bul.

en: You will eat up your leaves, destroy your fruit, and leave yourself like a dry tree.
target: Yu wi iit op yu liif dem, distrai yu fruut, an lef yuself laik a jrai chrii.

en: A wicked soul will destroy him who has it, and will make him a laughing stock to his enemies.
target: A wikid suol wi distrai im uu av it, an wi mek im a laafin stok tu im enimi dem.

en: Sweet words will multiply a man’s friends. A gracious tongue will multiply courtesies.
target: Swiit wod dem wi moltriplai a man fren dem. A grieshos tong wi moltriplai kortisi dem.

en: Let those that are at peace with you be many, but your advisers one of a thousand.
target: Mek dem we de a piis wid yu bi nof, bot yu advaiza dem wan a a touzn.

en: If you want to gain a friend, get him in a time of testing, and don’t be in a hurry to trust him.
target: If yu waant fi get a fren, get im ina a taim a testin, an no bi ina a ori fi chos im.

en: For there is a friend just for an occasion. He won’t continue in the day of your affliction.
target: Kaa de a fren jos fi a okiezhan. Im wi no kantiniu ina di die a yu aflikshan.

en: And there is a friend who turns into an enemy. He will discover strife to your reproach.
target: An de a fren uu ton intu a enimi. Im wi diskova straif tu yu riprooch.

en: And there is a friend who is a companion at the table, but he won’t continue in the day of your affliction.
target: An de a fren uu a kompanyan a di tiebl, bot im wi no kantiniu ina di die a yu aflikshan.

en: In your prosperity he will be as yourself, and will be bold over your servants.
target: Ina yu prasperiti im wi bi az yuself, an wi buol uova yu sorvant dem.

en: If you are brought low, he will be against you, and will hide himself from your face.
target: If yu bring luo, im wi gens yu, an wi aid imself fram yu fies.

en: Separate yourself from your enemies, and beware of your friends.
target: Sepriet yuself fram yu enimi dem, an biwier a yu fren dem.

en: A faithful friend is a strong defense. He who has found him has found a treasure.
target: A fietful fren a a strang difens. Ii uu av fain im av fain a treja.

en: There is nothing that can be taken in exchange for a faithful friend. His excellency is beyond price.
target: Notn no de we kyan tek ina exchienj fi a fietful fren. Im ekselensi a beyand prais.

en: A faithful friend is a life-saving medicine. Those who fear the Lord will find him.
target: A fietful fren a a laif-sievin medsin. Dem uu fia di Laad wi fain im.

en: He who fears the Lord directs his friendship properly; for as he is, so is his neighbor also.
target: Ii uu fia di Laad dairek im frenship prapali; kaa az im a, so im nieba a tu.

en: My son, gather instruction from your youth up. Even when you have gray hair you will find wisdom.
target: Mi son, gyada instrokshan fram yu yuut op. Iivn wen yu av grie ier yu wi fain wizdom.

en: Come to her as one who plows and sows and wait for her good fruit; for your toil will be little in her cultivation, and you will soon eat of her fruit.
target: Kom tu ar az wan uu plou an suo an wiet fi ar gud fruut; kaa yu tail wi bi likl ina ar koltivieshan, an yu wi suun iit a ar fruut.

en: How exceedingly harsh she is to the unlearned! He who is without understanding will not remain in her.
target: Ou grietli aash shi a tu di onlornd! Ii uu a widout andastandin wi no tan ina ar.

en: She will rest upon him as a mighty stone of trial. He won’t hesitate to cast her from him.
target: Shi wi res pan im az a maiti stuon a traial. Im wi no ezitiet fi chuo ar fram im.

en: For wisdom is according to her name. She isn’t manifest to many.
target: Kaa wizdom a akadin tu ar niem. Shi no shuo tu nof piipl.

en: Give ear, my son, and accept my judgment. Don’t refuse my counsel.
target: Gi ier, mi son, an aksep mi jojment. No rifiuz mi kounsl.

en: Bring your feet into her chains, and your neck into her chain.
target: Bring yu fut dem intu ar chien dem, an yu nek intu ar chien.

en: Put your shoulder under her and bear her. Don’t be grieved with her bonds.
target: Put yu shuolda anda ar an bier ar. No bi griiv wid ar ban dem.

en: Come to her with all your soul. Keep her ways with your whole power.
target: Kom tu ar wid aal yu suol. Kip ar wie dem wid yu uol powa.

en: Search and seek, and she will be made known to you. When you get hold of her, don’t let her go.
target: Saach an siik, an shi wi mek nuo tu yu. Wen yu get uol a ar, no mek ar go.

en: For at the last you will find her rest; and she will be turned for you into gladness.
target: Kaa a di laas yu wi fain ar res; an shi wi ton fi yu intu gladnis.

en: Her chains will be to you for a covering of strength, and her chains for a robe of glory.
target: Ar chien dem wi bi tu yu fi a kovrin a strent, an ar chien dem fi a ruob a gluori.

en: For there is a golden ornament upon her, and her bands are a purple cord.
target: Kaa de a guoldn aanament pan ar, an ar ban dem a a porpl kaad.

en: You will put her on as a robe of glory, and will put her on as a crown of rejoicing.
target: Yu wi put ar aan az a ruob a gluori, an wi put ar aan az a kroun a rijaisin.

en: My son, if you are willing, you will be instructed. If you will yield your soul, you will be prudent.
target: Mi son, if yu wilin, yu wi get instrokshan. If yu wi gi op yu suol, yu wi bi prudent.

en: If you love to hear, you will receive. If you incline your ear, you will be wise.
target: If yu lov fi ier, yu wi risiiv. If yu bend yu ier, yu wi bi waiz.

en: Stand in the multitude of the elders. Attach yourself to whomever is wise.
target: Tan ina di moltitiuud a di elda dem. Tach yuself tu uueva a waiz.

en: Be willing to listen to every godly discourse. Don’t let the proverbs of understanding escape you.
target: Bi wilin fi lisn tu evri raichos diskos. No mek di provereb dem a andastandin eskiep yu.

en: If you see a man of understanding, get to him early. Let your foot wear out the steps of his doors.
target: If yu si a man a andastandin, get tu im orli. Mek yu fut wier out di step dem a im duo dem.

en: Let your mind dwell on the ordinances of the Lord and meditate continually on his commandments. He will establish your heart and your desire for wisdom will be given to you.
target: Mek yu main tan pan di aadnans dem a di Laad an medtiet kantiniuli pan im komanment dem. Im wi establis yu aat an yu dizaiya fi wizdom wi gi tu yu.

en: Do no evil, so no evil will overtake you.
target: No du iivl, so no iivl wi tek yu.

en: Depart from wrong, and it will turn away from you.
target: Go we fram rang, an it wi ton we fram yu.

en: My son, don’t sow upon the furrows of unrighteousness, and you won’t reap them sevenfold.
target: Mi son, no suo pan di foro dem a onraichosnis, an yu wi no riip dem sevn-fuol.

en: Don’t seek preeminence from the Lord, nor the seat of honor from the king.
target: No siik pri-eminens fram di Laad, nar di siit a ana fram di king.

en: Don’t justify yourself in the presence of the Lord, and don’t display your wisdom before the king.
target: No jostifai yuself ina di prezens a di Laad, an no disple yu wizdom bifuo di king.

en: Don’t seek to be a judge, for you may not be able to take away sins, and you may fear the person of a mighty man, and lay a stumbling block in the way of your uprightness.
target: No siik fi bi a joj, kaa yu mait no ebl fi tek we sin dem, an yu mait fia di porsn a a maiti man, an put a stomblin blak ina di wie a yu opraitnis.

en: Don’t sin against the multitude of the city. Don’t disgrace yourself in the crowd.
target: No sin gens di moltitiuud a di siti. No disgries yuself ina di kroud.

en: Don’t commit a sin twice, for even in one you will not be unpunished.
target: No komit a sin twais, kaa iivn ina wan yu wi no go onponish.

en: Don’t say, “He will look upon the multitude of my gifts. When I make an offering to the Most High God, he will accept it.”
target: No se, “Im wi luk pan di moltitiuud a mi gif dem. Wen mi mek a aafrin tu di Mos Ai Gad, im wi aksep it.”

en: Don’t be faint-hearted in your prayer. Don’t neglect almsgiving.
target: No bi fient-aatid ina yu prier. No neglek aamz-givin.

en: Don’t laugh a man to scorn when he is in the bitterness of his soul, for there is one who humbles and exalts.
target: No laaf a man tu skaan wen im a ina di bitanis a im suol, kaa de a wan uu ombl an lif op.

en: Don’t devise a lie against your brother, or do the same to a friend.
target: No mek op a lai gens yu breda, ar du di siem tu a fren.

en: Refuse to utter a lie, for that habit results in no good.
target: Rifiuz fi ota a lai, kaa dat abit rizolt ina no gud.

en: Don’t babble in the assembly of elders. Don’t repeat your words in your prayer.
target: No babl ina di asembli a elda dem. No ripiit yu wod dem ina yu prier.

en: Don’t hate hard labor or farm work, which the Most High has created.
target: No iet aad lieba ar faam wok, we di Mos Ai av kriet.

en: Don’t number yourself among the multitude of sinners. Remember that wrath will not wait.
target: No nomba yuself mong di moltitiuud a sinna dem. Memba dat raat wi no wiet.

en: Humble your soul greatly, for the punishment of the ungodly man is fire and the worm.
target: Ombl yu suol grietli, kaa di ponishment a di onraichos man a faiya an di worm.

en: Don’t exchange a friend for something, neither a true brother for the gold of Ophir.
target: No exchienj a fren fi sinting, niida a chuu breda fi di guol a Ofir.

en: Don’t deprive yourself of a wise and good wife, for her grace is worth more than gold.
target: No dipraiv yuself a a waiz an gud waif, kaa ar gries a wot muo dan guol.

en: Don’t abuse a servant who works faithfully, or a hireling who gives you his life.
target: No abiuz a sorvant uu wok fietfuli, ar a aialing uu gi yu im laif.

en: Let your soul love a wise servant. Don’t defraud him of liberty.
target: Mek yu suol lov a waiz sorvant. No chit im a libati.

en: Do you have cattle? Look after them. If they are profitable to you, let them stay by you.
