target: Yu av kyatl? Luk afta dem. If dem a prafit tu yu, mek dem tan bai yu.

en: Do you have children? Correct them, and make them obedient from their youth.
target: Yu av pikni dem? Korek dem, an mek dem uobie fram dem yuut.

en: Do you have daughters? Take care of their bodies, and don’t be overly indulgent toward them.
target: Yu av daata dem? Tek kier a dem badi dem, an no bi uova indoljant tu dem.

en: Give your daughter in marriage, and you will have accomplished a great matter. Give her to a man of understanding.
target: Gi yu daata ina marij, an yu wi av du a griet mata. Gi ar tu a man a andastandin.

en: Do you have a wife who pleases you? Don’t cast her out. But don’t trust yourself to one who is hateful.
target: Yu av a waif uu pliiz yu? No chuo ar out. Bot no chos yuself tu wan uu a ietful.

en: Honor your father with your whole heart, and don’t forget the birth pangs of your mother.
target: Ana yu faada wid yu uol aat, an no faget di bort pang dem a yu mada.

en: Remember that you were born of them. What will you repay them for the things that they have done for you?
target: Memba dat yu ben baan a dem. Wa yu wi ripie dem fi di ting dem we dem av du fi yu?

en: Fear the Lord with all your soul; and revere his priests.
target: Fia di Laad wid aal yu suol; an riva im priis dem.

en: With all your strength love him who made you. Don’t forsake his ministers.
target: Wid aal yu strent lov im uu mek yu. No lef im minista dem.

en: Fear the Lord and honor the priest. Give him his portion, even as it is commanded you: the first fruits, the trespass offering, the gift of the shoulders, the sacrifice of consecration, and the first fruits of holy things.
target: Fia di Laad an ana di priis. Gi im im puoshan, iivn az it koman yu: di fos fruut dem, di trespas aafrin, di gif a di shuolda dem, di sakrifais a kansikrieshan, an di fos fruut dem a uoli ting dem.

en: Also stretch out your hand to the poor man, that your blessing may be complete.
target: Tu strech out yu an tu di puo man, so yu blesin mait bi kompliit.

en: A gift has grace in the sight of every living man. Don’t withhold grace for a dead man.
target: A gif av gries ina di sait a evri livin man. No widuol gries fi a ded man.

en: Don’t avoid those who weep, and mourn with those who mourn.
target: No avaid dem uu wiip, an muorn wid dem uu muorn.

en: Don’t be slow to visit a sick man, for by such things you will gain love.
target: No bi sluo fi vizit a sik man, kaa bai soch ting dem yu wi get lov.

en: In all your words, remember eternity, and you will never sin.
target: Ina aal yu wod dem, memba iterniti, an yu wi neva sin.

en: Don’t contend with a mighty man, or you may fall into his hands.
target: No kantend wid a maiti man, ar yu mait faal intu im an dem.

en: Don’t strive with a rich man, or he may overpower you; for gold has destroyed many, and turned away the hearts of kings.
target: No straiv wid a rich man, ar im mait uovapowa yu; kaa guol av distrai nof piipl, an ton we di aat dem a king dem.

en: Don’t argue with a loudmouthed man. Don’t heap wood upon his fire.
target: No aagiu wid a loud-mout man. No iip wud pan im faiya.

en: Don’t make fun of a rude man, or your ancestors will be dishonored.
target: No mek fon a a ruud man, ar yu ansesta dem wi disana.

en: Don’t reproach a man when he turns from sin. Remember that we are all worthy of punishment.
target: No riprooch a man wen im ton fram sin. Memba dat wi aal woti a ponishment.

en: Don’t dishonor a man in his old age, for some of us are also growing old.
target: No disana a man ina im uol iej, kaa som a wi a gro uol tu.

en: Don’t rejoice over anyone’s death. Remember that we all die.
target: No rijais uova eniwan det. Memba dat wi aal ded.

en: Don’t neglect the discourse of the wise. Be conversant with their proverbs; for from them you will learn discipline and how to serve great men.
target: No neglek di diskos a di waiz dem. Bi frenli wid dem provereb dem; kaa fram dem yu wi lorn disipline an ou fi sorv griet man dem.

en: Don’t miss the discourse of the aged, for they also learned from their parents, because from them you will learn understanding, and to give an answer in time of need.
target: No mis di diskos a di iej piipl, kaa dem tu lorn fram dem pierent dem, kaa fram dem yu wi lorn andastandin, an fi gi a ansa ina taim a niid.

en: Don’t kindle the coals of a sinner, or you will be burned with the flame of his fire.
target: No kindl di kual dem a a sinna, ar yu wi bon wid di fliem a im faiya.

en: Don’t rise up from the presence of an insolent man, or he will lie in wait as an ambush for your mouth.
target: No raiz op fram di prezens a a insolent man, ar im wi lie ina wiet az a ambush fi yu mout.

en: Don’t lend to a man who is stronger than you; and if you lend, count it as a loss.
target: No len tu a man uu a stranga dan yu; an if yu len, kount it az a laas.

en: Don’t be surety beyond your means. If you give surety, think as one who will have to pay.
target: No bi shuoriti beyand yu miinz. If yu gi shuoriti, tink az wan uu wi av fi pie.

en: Don’t go to law with a judge; for according to his honor they will give judgment for him.
target: No go tu laa wid a joj; kaa akadin tu im ana dem wi gi jojment fi im.

en: Don’t travel with a reckless man, or he will be burdensome to you; for he will do as he pleases, and you will perish with his folly.
target: No chravl wid a reklis man, ar im wi bi borden tu yu; kaa im wi du az im pliiz, an yu wi ded wid im fulishnis.

en: Don’t fight with a wrathful man. Don’t travel with him through the desert, for blood is as nothing in his sight. Where there is no help, he will overthrow you.
target: No fait wid a raatful man. No chravl wid im chuu di dezat, kaa blod a az notn ina im sait. We no elp no de, im wi uovachuo yu.

en: Don’t consult with a fool, for he will not be able to keep a secret.
target: No kansolt wid a fuul, kaa im wi no ebl fi kip a siikrit.

en: Do no secret thing before a stranger, for you don’t know what it will cause.
target: No du no siikrit ting bifuo a strienja, kaa yu no nuo wa it wi kaaz.

en: Don’t open your heart to every man. Don’t let him return you a favor.
target: No opn yu aat tu evri man. No mek im riton yu a fieva.

en: Don’t be jealous over the wife in your arms, and don’t teach her an evil lesson against yourself.
target: No bi jelos uova di waif ina yu aam dem, an no tiich ar a iivl lesn gens yuself.

en: Don’t give your soul to a woman and let her trample down your strength.
target: No gi yu suol tu a uman an mek ar trampl dong yu strent.

en: Don’t go to meet a woman who plays the prostitute, or you may fall into her snares.
target: No go fi miit a uman uu plie di prastitiuut, ar yu mait faal intu ar snier dem.

en: Don’t associate with a woman who is a singer, or you may be caught by her tricks.
target: No asosiet wid a uman uu a singa, ar yu mait get kaat bai ar chrik dem.

en: Don’t gaze at a virgin, or you may stumble and incur penalties for her.
target: No giez pan a vorjin, ar yu mait stombl an get penalti dem fi ar.

en: Don’t give your soul to prostitutes, that you not lose your inheritance.
target: No gi yu suol tu prastitiuut dem, so yu no luuz yu inheritans.

en: Don’t look around in the streets of the city. Don’t wander in its deserted places.
target: No luk roun ina di striit dem a di siti. No wanda ina it dezatid plies dem.

en: Turn your eye away from a beautiful woman, and don’t gaze at another’s beauty. Many have been led astray by the beauty of a woman; and with this, passion is kindled like a fire.
target: Ton yu ai we fram a byuutiful uman, an no giez pan anoda biuti. Nof av liid astre bai di biuti a a uman; an wid dis, pashan a kindl laik a faiya.

en: Don’t dine at all with a woman who has a husband, or revel with her at wine, or your soul may turn away to her, and with your spirit you may slide into destruction.
target: No dain aal tugeda wid a uman uu av a ozban, ar revel wid ar a wain, ar yu suol mait ton we tu ar, an wid yu spirit yu mait slaid intu distrokshan.

en: Don’t forsake an old friend; for a new one is not comparable to him. A new friend is like new wine: if it becomes old, you will drink it with gladness.
target: No lef a uol fren; kaa a niu wan no kompier tu im. A niu fren a laik niu wain: if it bikam uol, yu wi jrink it wid gladnis.

en: Don’t envy the success of a sinner; for you don’t know what his end will be.
target: No envi di sokses a a sinna; kaa yu no nuo wa im en wi bi.

en: Don’t delight in the delights of the ungodly. Remember they will not go unpunished to the grave.
target: No dilait ina di dilait dem a di onraichos dem. Memba dem wi no go onponish tu di griev.

en: Keep yourself far from the man who has power to kill, and you will not be troubled by the fear of death. If you come to him, commit no fault, or he will take away your life. Know surely that you go about in the midst of snares, and walk upon the battlements of a city.
target: Kip yuself faar fram di man uu av powa fi kil, an yu wi no chobl bai di fia a det. If yu kom tu im, komit no faalt, ar im wi tek we yu laif. Nuo shuorli dat yu go bout ina di migl a snier dem, an waak pan di batlment dem a a siti.

en: As well as you can, aim to know your neighbors, and take counsel with the wise.
target: Az wel az yu kyan, iem fi nuo yu nieba dem, an tek kounsl wid di waiz dem.

en: Let your conversation be with men of understanding. Let all your discourse be in the law of the Most High.
target: Mek yu kanvasieshan bi wid man dem a andastandin. Mek aal yu diskos bi ina di laa a di Mos Ai.

en: Let righteous people be companions at your table. Let your glorying be in the fear of the Lord.
target: Mek raichos piipl bi kompanyan a yu tiebl. Mek yu gluoriin bi ina di fia a di Laad.

en: A work is commended because of the skill of the artisan; so he who rules the people will be considered wise for his speech.
target: A wok a komend kaa a di skil a di aatizan; so ii uu ruul di piipl wi kansida waiz fi im spiich.

en: A loudmouthed man is dangerous in his city. He who is reckless in his speech will be hated.
target: A loud-mout man a dienjaros ina im siti. Ii uu a reklis ina im spiich wi iet.

en: A wise judge will instruct his people. The government of a man of understanding will be well ordered.
target: A waiz joj wi instrok im piipl. Di govament a a man a andastandin wi wel aada.

en: As is the judge of his people, so are his officials. As the city’s ruler is, so are all those who dwell in it.
target: Az di joj a im piipl a, so im ofishal dem a. Az di siti ruula a, so aal dem uu tan ina it a.

en: An undisciplined king will destroy his people. A city will be established through the understanding of the powerful.
target: A king widout disipline wi distrai im piipl. A siti wi establis chuu di andastandin a di powaful.

en: The government of the earth is in the Lord’s hand. In due time, he will raise up over it the right person at the right time.
target: Di govament a di ort de ina di Laads an. Ina juu taim, im wi raiz op uova it di rait porsn a di rait taim.

en: A man’s prosperity is in the Lord’s hand. He will lay his honor upon the person of the scribe.
target: A man prasperiti de ina di Laads an. Im wi put im ana pan di porsn a di skraib.

en: Don’t be angry with your neighbor for every wrong. Do nothing by works of violence.
target: No bi angri wid yu nieba fi evri rang. No du notn bai wok dem a vailens.

en: Pride is hateful before the Lord and men. Arrogance is abhorrent in the judgment of both.
target: Praid a ietful bifuo di Laad an man dem. Aragans a aborrent ina di jojment a buot.

en: Sovereignty is transferred from nation to nation because of injustice, violence, and greed for money.
target: Savrinti a chansfa fram nieshan tu nieshan kaa a injostis, vailens, an griid fi moni.

en: Why are dirt and ashes proud? Because in life, my body decays.
target: Wai dot an ashiz proud? Kaa ina laif, mi badi dikie.

en: A long disease mocks the physician. The king of today will die tomorrow.
target: A lang diziiz maak di fizishan. Di king a tide wi ded tumaro.

en: For when a man is dead, he will inherit maggots, vermin, and worms.
target: Kaa wen a man ded, im wi inherit magot dem, vormin, an worm dem.

en: It is the beginning of pride when a man departs from the Lord. His heart has departed from him who made him.
target: It a di biginin a praid wen a man go we fram di Laad. Im aat av go we fram im uu mek im.

en: For the beginning of pride is sin. He who keeps it will pour out a detestable thing. For this cause the Lord brought upon them strange calamities and utterly overthrew them.
target: Kaa di biginin a praid a sin. Ii uu kip it wi puor out a ting we iet. Fi dis kaaz di Laad bring pan dem strienj kalamiti dem an otli uovachuo dem.

en: The Lord cast down the thrones of rulers and set the lowly in their place.
target: Di Laad chuo dong di chuon dem a ruula dem an set di luoli ina dem plies.

en: The Lord plucked up the roots of nations and planted the lowly in their place.
target: Di Laad plok op di ruut dem a nieshan dem an plant di luoli ina dem plies.

en: The Lord overthrew the lands of nations and destroyed them to the foundations of the earth.
target: Di Laad uovachuo di lan dem a nieshan dem an distrai dem tu di foundieshan dem a di ort.

en: He took some of them away and destroyed them, and made their memory to cease from the earth.
target: Im tek som a dem we an distrai dem, an mek dem memri siiz fram di ort.

en: Pride has not been created for men, nor wrathful anger for the offspring of women.
target: Praid no ben kriet fi man dem, nar raatful anga fi di pikni dem a uman dem.

en: Whose offspring has honor? Human offspring who fear the Lord. Whose offspring has no honor? Human offspring who break the commandments.
target: Uuz pikni av ana? Yuuman pikni uu fia di Laad. Uuz pikni av no ana? Yuuman pikni uu briek di komanment dem.

en: In the midst of kindred he who rules them has honor. Those who fear the Lord have honor in his eyes.
target: Ina di migl a kindred ii uu ruul dem av ana. Dem uu fia di Laad av ana ina im ai dem.

en: [Reader’s note: Verse 21 is omitted by the best authorities: Fear of the Lord is the beginning of acceptance, but obstinance and pride are the beginning of rejection.]
target: [Riida nuot: Vors twenti-wan a lef out bai di bes atariti dem: Fia a di Laad a di biginin a akseptans, bot obstinans an praid a di biginin a rijekshan.]

en: The rich man, the honorable, and the poor all glory in the fear of the Lord.
target: Di rich man, di anarebl, an di puo aal gluori ina di fia a di Laad.

en: It is not right to dishonor a poor man who has understanding. It is not fitting to glorify a man who is a sinner.
target: It no rait fi disana a puo man uu av andastandin. It no fitin fi gluorifai a man uu a a sinna.

en: The prince, the judge, and the mighty man will be honored. There is not one of them greater than he who fears the Lord.
target: Di prins, di joj, an di maiti man wi ana. No wan a dem no grieta dan ii uu fia di Laad.

en: Free men will minister to a wise servant. A man who has knowledge will not complain.
target: Frii man dem wi minista tu a waiz sorvant. A man uu av nalij wi no komplien.

en: Don’t flaunt your wisdom in doing your work. Don’t boast in the time of your distress.
target: No flaant yu wizdom ina duin yu wok. No buos ina di taim a yu distres.

en: Better is he who labors and abounds in all things, than he who boasts and lacks bread.
target: Beta a ii uu lieba an abound ina aal ting, dan ii uu buos an lak bred.

en: My son, glorify your soul in humility, and give yourself honor according to your worthiness.
target: Mi son, gluorifai yu suol ina yuomiliti, an gi yuself ana akadin tu yu wotinis.

en: Who will justify him who sins against his own soul? Who will honor him who dishonors his own life?
target: Uu wi jostifai im uu sin gens im uon suol? Uu wi ana im uu disana im uon laif?

en: A poor man is honored for his knowledge. A rich man is honored for his riches.
target: A puo man a ana fi im nalij. A rich man a ana fi im richiz.

en: But he who is honored in poverty, how much more in riches? He who is dishonored in riches, how much more in poverty?
target: Bot ii uu a ana ina pavati, ou moch muo ina richiz? Ii uu a disana ina richiz, ou moch muo ina pavati?

en: The wisdom of the lowly will lift up his head, and make him sit in the midst of great men.
target: Di wizdom a di luoli wi lif op im ed, an mek im sidong ina di migl a griet man dem.

en: Don’t commend a man for his good looks. Don’t abhor a man for his outward appearance.
target: No komend a man fi im gud luk dem. No iet a man fi im outwod apierans.

en: The bee is little among flying creatures, but what it produces is the best of confections.
target: Di bii a likl mong flaiin kriicha dem, bot wa it mek a di bes a swiit ting dem.

en: Don’t boast about the clothes you wear, and don’t exalt yourself in the day of honor; for the Lord’s works are wonderful, and his works are hidden among men.
target: No buos bout di kluoz yu wier, an no lif op yuself ina di die a ana; kaa di Laads wok dem a wandaful, an im wok dem a aid mong man dem.

en: Many kings have sat down upon the ground, but one who was never thought of has worn a crown.
target: Nof king dem av sidong pan di grong, bot wan uu neva taat a av wier a kroun.

en: Many mighty men have been greatly disgraced. Men of renown have been delivered into other men’s hands.
target: Nof maiti man dem av grietli disgries. Man dem a big niem av diliva intu ada man dem an dem.

en: Don’t blame before you investigate. Understand first, and then rebuke.
target: No bliem bifuo yu investigiet. Andastan fos, an den ribiuuk.

en: Don’t answer before you have heard. Don’t interrupt while someone else is speaking.
target: No ansa bifuo yu av ier. No intarop wail somwan els a taak.

en: Don’t argue about a matter that doesn’t concern you. Don’t sit with sinners when they judge.
target: No aagiu bout a mata we no kansorn yu. No sidong wid sinna dem wen dem joj.

en: My son, don’t be busy about many matters; for if you meddle much, you will not be unpunished. If you pursue, you will not overtake, and you will not escape by fleeing.
target: Mi son, no bi bizi bout nof mata dem; kaa if yu medl moch, yu wi no go onponish. If yu posiuu, yu wi no uovatiek, an yu wi no eskiep bai fliiin.

en: There is one who toils, labors, and hurries, and is even more behind.
target: De a wan uu tail, lieba, an ori, an a iivn muo beain.

en: There is one who is sluggish, and needs help, lacking in strength, and who abounds in poverty, but the Lord’s eyes looked upon him for good, and he raised him up from his low condition,
target: De a wan uu a slogish, an niid elp, lakin ina strent, an uu abound ina pavati, bot di Laads ai dem luk pan im fi gud, an im raiz im op fram im luo kandishan,

en: and lifted up his head so that many marveled at him.
target: an lif op im ed so dat nof piipl maavl a im.

en: Good things and bad, life and death, poverty and riches, are from the Lord.
target: Gud ting dem an bad, laif an det, pavati an richiz, kom fram di Laad.

en: [Reader’s note: Verses 15 and 16 are omitted by the best authorities.]
target: [Riida nuot: Vors fiftin an sikstiin a lef out bai di bes atariti dem.]

en: [Reader’s note: Verses 15 and 16 are omitted by the best authorities.]
target: [Riida nuot: Vors fiftin an sikstiin a lef out bai di bes atariti dem.]

en: The Lord’s gift remains with the godly. His good pleasure will prosper forever.
target: Di Laads gif tan wid di raichos dem. Im gud pleja wi prasper fareva.

en: One grows rich by his diligence and self-denial, and this is the portion of his reward:
target: Wan gro rich bai im dilijens an self-dinaiyal, an dis a di puoshan a im riwaad:

en: when he says, “I have found rest, and now I will eat of my goods!” he doesn’t know how much time will pass until he leaves them to others and dies.
target: wen im se, “Mi av fain res, an nou mi wi iit a mi gud dem!” im no nuo ou moch taim wi paas til im lef dem tu ada dem an ded.

en: Be steadfast in your covenant and be doing it, and grow old in your work.
target: Bi stedfaas ina yu kovnant an bi duin it, an gro uol ina yu wok.

en: Don’t marvel at the works of a sinner, but trust the Lord and stay in your labor; for it is an easy thing in the sight of the Lord to swiftly and suddenly make a poor man rich.
target: No maavl a di wok dem a a sinna, bot chos di Laad an tan ina yu lieba; kaa it a a iizi ting ina di sait a di Laad fi kwikli an sodnli mek a puo man rich.

en: The Lord’s blessing is in the reward of the godly. He makes his blessing flourish in an hour that comes swiftly.
target: Di Laads blesin de ina di riwaad a di raichos dem. Im mek im blesin flourish ina a owa we kom kwikli.

en: Don’t say, “What use is there of me? What further good things can be mine?”
target: No se, “Wa yuus de a mi? Wa forda gud ting dem kyan bi main?”

en: Don’t say, “I have enough. What harm could happen to me now?”
target: No se, “Mi av inof. Wa aam kuda apn tu mi nou?”

en: In the day of good things, bad things are forgotten. In the day of bad things, a man will not remember things that are good.
target: Ina di die a gud ting dem, bad ting dem fagat. Ina di die a bad ting dem, a man wi no memba ting dem we a gud.

en: For it is an easy thing in the sight of the Lord to reward a man in the day of death according to his ways.
target: Kaa it a a iizi ting ina di sait a di Laad fi riwaad a man ina di die a det akadin tu im wie dem.

en: The affliction of an hour causes delights to be forgotten. In the end, a man’s deeds are revealed.
target: Di aflikshan a a owa kaaz dilait dem fi fagat. A di en, a man diid dem shuo.

en: Call no man happy before his death. A man will be known in his children.
target: Kaal no man api bifuo im det. A man wi nuo ina im pikni dem.

en: Don’t bring every man into your house, for many are the tricks of a deceitful man.
target: No bring evri man intu yu ous, kaa nof a di chrik dem a a disietful man.

en: Like a decoy partridge in a cage, so is the heart of a proud man. Like a spy, he looks for your weakness.
target: Laik a dikoi paatrij ina a kiej, so a di aat a a proud man. Laik a spai, im luk fi yu wiiknis.

en: For he lies in wait to turn things that are good into evil, and assigns blame in things that are praiseworthy.
target: Kaa im lie ina wiet fi ton ting dem we a gud intu iivl, an asain bliem ina ting dem we a priez-woti.

en: From a spark of fire, a heap of many coals is kindled, and a sinful man lies in wait to shed blood.
target: Fram a spaak a faiya, a iip a nof kual dem a kindl, an a sinful man lie ina wiet fi shed blod.

en: Take heed of an evil-doer, for he plans wicked things, and may ruin your reputation forever.
target: Tek iid a a iivl-dua, kaa im plan wikid ting dem, an mait ruin yu repiutieshan fareva.

en: Receive a stranger into your house, and he will distract you with arguments and estrange you from your own family.
target: Risiiv a strienja intu yu ous, an im wi distraak yu wid aagiumen dem an mek yu strienj fram yu uon fambili.

en: If you do good, know to whom you do it, and your good deeds will have thanks.
target: If yu du gud, nuo tu uum yu du it, an yu gud diid dem wi av tanks.

en: Do good to a godly man, and you will find a reward— if not from him, then from the Most High.
target: Du gud tu a raichos man, an yu wi fain a riwaad— if no fram im, den fram di Mos Ai.

en: No good will come to him who continues to do evil, nor to him who gives no almsgiving.
target: No gud wi kom tu im uu kantiniu fi du iivl, nar tu im uu gi no aamz-givin.

en: Give to the godly man, and don’t help the sinner.
target: Gi tu di raichos man, an no elp di sinna.

en: Do good to one who is lowly. Don’t give to an ungodly man. Keep back his bread, and don’t give it to him, or he will subdue you with it; for you would receive twice as much evil for all the good you would have done to him.
target: Du gud tu wan uu a luo. No gi tu a onraichos man. Kip bak im bred, an no gi it tu im, ar im wi uovapowa yu wid it; kaa yu wuda risiiv twais az moch iivl fi aal di gud yu wuda av du tu im.

en: For the Most High also hates sinners, and will repay vengeance to the ungodly.
target: Kaa di Mos Ai tu iet sinna dem, an wi ripie venjans tu di onraichos dem.

en: Give to the good man, and don’t help the sinner.
target: Gi tu di gud man, an no elp di sinna.

en: A man’s friend won’t be fully tried in prosperity. His enemy won’t be hidden in adversity.
target: A man fren wi no fuli chrai ina prasperiti. Im enimi wi no aid ina advorsiti.

en: In a man’s prosperity, his enemies are grieved. In his adversity, even his friend leaves.
target: Ina a man prasperiti, im enimi dem griiv. Ina im advorsiti, iivn im fren go we.

en: Never trust your enemy, for his wickedness is like corrosion in copper.
target: Neva chos yu enimi, kaa im wikidnis a laik koruozhan ina kapa.

en: Though he humbles himself and walks bowed down, still be careful and beware of him. You will be to him as one who has wiped a mirror, to be sure it doesn’t completely tarnish.
target: Aalduo im ombl imself an waak bou dong, stil bi kierful an biwier a im. Yu wi bi tu im az wan uu av waip a mira, fi mek shuor it no fuli taanish.

en: Don’t set him next to you, or he will overthrow you and stand in your place. Don’t let him sit on your right hand, or he will seek to take your seat, and at the last you acknowledge my words, and be pricked with my sayings.
target: No set im neks tu yu, ar im wi uovachuo yu an tan ina yu plies. No mek im sidong pan yu rait an, ar im wi siik fi tek yu siit, an a di laas yu aknalij mi wod dem, an get prik wid mi seyin dem.

en: Who will pity a charmer that is bitten by a snake, or any who come near wild beasts?
target: Uu wi piti a chaama we get bait bai a sniek, ar eni uu kom nier wail biis dem?

en: Even so, who will pity him who goes to a sinner, and is associated with him in his sins?
target: Iivn so, uu wi piti im uu go tu a sinna, an asosiet wid im ina im sin dem?

en: For a while he will stay with you, and if you falter, he will not stay.
target: Fi a wail im wi tan wid yu, an if yu falta, im wi no tan.

en: The enemy will speak sweetly with his lips, and in his heart plan to throw you into a pit. The enemy may weep with his eyes, but if he finds opportunity, he will want more blood.
target: Di enimi wi spiik swiitli wid im lip dem, an ina im aat plan fi chuo yu ina a pit. Di enimi mait wiip wid im ai dem, bot if im fain apachuniti, im wi waant muo blod.

en: If adversity meets you, you will find him there before you. Pretending to help you, he will trip you.
target: If advorsiti miit yu, yu wi fain im de bifuo yu. A pritend fi elp yu, im wi chrip yu.

en: He will shake his head, clap his hands, whisper much, and change his countenance.
target: Im wi shiek im ed, klap im an dem, wispa moch, an chienj im fies.

en: He who touches pitch will be defiled. He who has fellowship with a proud man will become like him.
target: Ii uu toch pich wi difail. Ii uu av feloship wid a proud man wi bikam laik im.

en: Don’t take up a burden above your strength. Have no fellowship with one who is mightier and richer than yourself. What fellowship would the clay pot have with the kettle? The kettle will strike, and the pot will be dashed in pieces.
target: No tek op a borden abov yu strent. Av no feloship wid wan uu a maitia an richa dan yuself. Wa feloship di klie pat wuda av wid di ketl? Di ketl wi straik, an di pat wi dash ina piis dem.

en: The rich man does a wrong and threatens. The poor is wronged and apologizes.
target: Di rich man du a rang an chretn. Di puo a rang an apalajaiz.

en: If you are profitable, he will exploit you. If you are in need, he will forsake you.
target: If yu a prafit, im wi eksplait yu. If yu a ina niid, im wi lef yu.

en: If you own something, he will live with you. He will drain your resources and will not be sorry.
target: If yu uon sinting, im wi liv wid yu. Im wi jrien yu risuos dem an wi no sari.

en: Does he need you? Then he will deceive you, smile at you, and give you hope. He will speak kindly to you and say, “What do you need?”
target: Im niid yu? Den im wi disiiv yu, smail a yu, an gi yu uop. Im wi spiik kainli tu yu an se, “Wa yu niid?”

en: He will shame you by his delicacies until he has made you bare twice or thrice, and in the end he will laugh you to scorn. Afterward he will see you, will forsake you, and shake his head at you.
target: Im wi shiem yu bai im delikesi dem til im av mek yu bier twais ar chrais, an a di en im wi laaf yu tu skaan. Afta dat im wi si yu, wi lef yu, an shiek im ed a yu.

en: Beware that you are not deceived and brought low in your enjoyment.
target: Biwier dat yu no disiiv an bring luo ina yu enjaiment.

en: If a mighty man invites you, be reserved, and he will invite you more.
target: If a maiti man invait yu, bi rizorv, an im wi invait yu muo.

en: Don’t press him, or you will be thrust back. Don’t stand far off, or you will be forgotten.
target: No pres im, ar yu wi chros bak. No tan faar aaf, ar yu wi fagat.

en: Don’t try to speak with him as an equal, and don’t believe his many words; for he will test you with much talk, and will examine you in a smiling manner.
target: No chrai fi spiik wid im az a iikwal, an no biliiv im nof wod dem; kaa im wi tes yu wid moch taak, an wi egzamin yu ina a smailin mana.

en: He who doesn’t keep secrets to himself is unmerciful. He won’t hesitate to harm and to bind.
target: Ii uu no kip siikrit dem tu imself a onmersiful. Im wi no ezitiet fi aam an fi bain.

en: Keep them to yourself and be careful, for you walk in danger of falling.
target: Kip dem tu yuself an bi kierful, kaa yu waak ina dienja a faalin.

en: [Reader’s note: The remainder of verse 13, and verse 14, are omitted by the best authorities.]
target: [Riida nuot: Di res a vors totiin, an vors fuotiin, a lef out bai di bes atariti dem.]

en: Every living creature loves its own kind, and every man loves his neighbor.
target: Evri livin kriicha lov it uon kain, an evri man lov im nieba.

en: All flesh associates with their own kind. A man will stick to people like himself.
target: Aal flesh asosiet wid dem uon kain. A man wi stik tu piipl laik imself.

en: What fellowship would the wolf have with the lamb? So is the sinner to the godly.
target: Wa feloship di wulf wuda av wid di lam? So a di sinna tu di raichos dem.

en: What peace is there between a hyena and a dog? What peace is there between a rich man and the poor?
target: Wa piis de bitwiin a aiyina an a daag? Wa piis de bitwiin a rich man an di puo?

en: Wild donkeys are the prey of lions in the wilderness; likewise poor men are feeding grounds for the rich.
target: Wail dongki dem a di prie a laian dem ina di wildanis; laikwaiz puo man dem a fiidin grong fi di rich.

en: Lowliness is a detestable thing to a proud man; likewise a poor man is a detestable thing to the rich.
target: Luolinis a a ting we proud man iet; laikwaiz a puo man a a ting we rich iet.

en: When a rich man is shaken, he is supported by his friends, but when the humble is down, he is pushed away even by his friends.
target: Wen a rich man shiek, im fren dem sopuort im, bot wen di ombl a dong, iivn im fren dem push im we.

en: When a rich man falls, there are many helpers. He speaks things not to be spoken, and men justify him. A humble man falls, and men rebuke him. He utters wisdom, and is not listened to.
target: Wen a rich man faal, de a nof elpa dem. Im spiik ting we no fi spiik, an man dem jostifai im. A ombl man faal, an man dem ribiuuk im. Im ota wizdom, an dem no lisn tu im.

en: A rich man speaks, and all keep silence. They lift up what he says to the clouds. A poor man speaks, and they say, “Who is this?” If he stumbles, they will help to overthrow him.
target: A rich man spiik, an aal kip sailens. Dem lif op wa im se tu di kloud dem. A puo man spiik, an dem se, “Uu a dis?” If im stombl, dem wi elp fi uovachuo im.

en: Riches are good if they have no sin. Poverty is evil only in the opinion of the ungodly.
target: Richiz a gud if dem av no sin. Pavati a iivl onli ina di opinyan a di onraichos dem.

en: The heart of a man changes his countenance, whether it is for good or for evil.
target: Di aat a a man chienj im fies, weda it a fi gud ar fi iivl.

en: A cheerful countenance is a sign of a prosperous heart. Devising proverbs takes strenuous thinking.
target: A chierful fies a a sain a a prasperos aat. Mekin op provereb dem tek aad tinkin.

en: Blessed is the man who has not slipped with his mouth, and doesn’t suffer from sorrow for sins.
target: Bles a di man uu av no slip wid im mout, an no sofa fram saro fi sin dem.

en: Blessed is he whose soul does not condemn him, and who has not given up hope.
target: Bles a ii uuz suol no kandem im, an uu av no gi op uop.

en: Riches are not appropriate for a stingy person. What would a miser do with money?
target: Richiz no apuopriet fi a stinji porsn. Wa a maiza wuda du wid moni?

en: He who gathers by denying himself gathers for others. Others will revel in his goods.
target: Ii uu gyada bai dinaiin imself gyada fi ada dem. Ada dem wi revel ina im gud dem.

en: If one is mean to himself, to whom will he be good? He won’t enjoy his possessions.
target: If wan a miin tu imself, tu uum im wi bi gud? Im wi no enjai im pozeshan dem.

en: There is none more evil than he who is grudging to himself. This is a punishment for his wickedness.
target: Notn no muo iivl dan ii uu a groj tu imself. Dis a a ponishment fi im wikidnis.

en: Even if he does good, he does it in forgetfulness. In the end, he reveals his wickedness.
target: Iivn if im du gud, im du it ina fagetfulnis. A di en, im shuo im wikidnis.

en: A miser is evil. He turns away and disregards people.
target: A maiza a iivl. Im ton we an disrigaad piipl.

en: A covetous man’s eye is not satisfied with his portion. Wicked injustice dries up his soul.
target: A kovetos man ai no satisfai wid im puoshan. Wikid injostis jrai op im suol.

en: A miser begrudges bread, and it is lacking at his table.
target: A maiza bigroj bred, an it a lak a im tiebl.

en: My son, according to what you have, treat yourself well, and bring worthy offerings to the Lord.
target: Mi son, akadin tu wa yu av, chriit yuself wel, an bring woti aafrin dem tu di Laad.

en: Remember that death will not wait, and that the covenant of Hades hasn’t been shown to you.
target: Memba dat det wi no wiet, an dat di kovnant a Iidis no ben shuo tu yu.

en: Do good to your friends before you die. According to your ability, reach out and give to them.
target: Du gud tu yu fren dem bifuo yu ded. Akadin tu yu abiliti, riich out an gi tu dem.

en: Don’t deprive yourself of a good day. Don’t let your share of a desired good pass you by.
target: No dipraiv yuself a a gud die. No mek yu shier a a dizaiya gud paas yu bai.

en: Won’t you leave your labors to another, and your toils be divided by lot?
target: Yu wi no lef yu lieba dem tu anoda, an yu tail dem divaid bai laat?

en: Give, take, and treat yourself well, because there is no seeking of luxury in Hades.
target: Gi, tek, an chriit yuself wel, kaa de no siikin a lokjri ina Iidis.

en: All flesh grows old like a garment, for the covenant from the beginning is, “You must die!”
target: Aal flesh gro uol laik a gaament, kaa di kovnant fram di biginin a, “Yu mos ded!”

en: Like the leaves flourishing on a thick tree, some it sheds, and some grow, so also are the generations of flesh and blood: one comes to an end and another is born.
target: Laik di liif dem flourishing pan a tik chrii, som it shed, an som gro, so tu a di jenarieshan dem a flesh an blod: wan kom tu a en an anoda baan.

en: Every work rots and falls away, and its builder will depart with it.
target: Evri wok raat an faal we, an it bilda wi go we wid it.

en: Blessed is the man who meditates on wisdom, and who reasons by his understanding.
target: Bles a di man uu medtiet pan wizdom, an uu riizn bai im andastandin.

en: He who considers her ways in his heart will also have knowledge of her secrets.
target: Ii uu kansida ar wie dem ina im aat wi tu av nalij a ar siikrit dem.

en: Go after her like a hunter, and lie in wait in her paths.
target: Go afta ar laik a onta, an lie ina wiet ina ar paat dem.

en: He who peers in at her windows will also listen at her doors.
target: Ii uu piip in a ar winda dem wi tu lisn a ar duo dem.

en: He who lodges close to her house will also fasten a nail in her walls.
target: Ii uu laj kluos tu ar ous wi tu faasn a niel ina ar waal dem.

en: He will pitch his tent near at hand to her, and will lodge in a lodging where good things are.
target: Im wi pich im tent nier a an tu ar, an wi laj ina a lajin we gud ting dem de.

en: He will set his children under her shelter, and will rest under her branches.
target: Im wi set im pikni dem anda ar shelta, an wi res anda ar branch dem.

en: By her he will be covered from heat, and will lodge in her glory.
target: Bai ar im wi kova fram iit, an wi laj ina ar gluori.

en: He who fears the Lord will do this. He who has possession of the law will obtain her.
target: Ii uu fia di Laad wi du dis. Ii uu av pozeshan a di laa wi get ar.

en: She will meet him like a mother, and receive him like a wife married in her virginity.
target: Shi wi miit im laik a mada, an risiiv im laik a waif marid ina ar vorjininiti.

en: She will feed him with bread of understanding and give him water of wisdom to drink.
target: Shi wi fiid im wid bred a andastandin an gi im waata a wizdom fi jrink.

en: He will be stayed upon her, and will not be moved. He will rely upon her, and will not be confounded.
target: Im wi tan pan ar, an wi no muuv. Im wi rilai pan ar, an wi no kanfound.

en: She will exalt him above his neighbors. She will open his mouth in the midst of the congregation.
target: Shi wi lif im op abov im nieba dem. Shi wi opn im mout ina di migl a di kangrigieshan.

en: He will inherit joy, a crown of gladness, and an everlasting name.
target: Im wi inherit jai, a kroun a gladnis, an a eva-lastin niem.

en: Foolish men will not obtain her. Sinners will not see her.
target: Fuulish man dem wi no get ar. Sinna dem wi no si ar.

en: She is far from pride. Liars will not remember her.
target: Shi a faar fram praid. Laiya dem wi no memba ar.

en: Praise is not attractive in the mouth of a sinner; for it was not sent to him from the Lord.
target: Priez no atraktiv ina di mout a a sinna; kaa it neva sen tu im fram di Laad.

en: For praise will be spoken in wisdom; The Lord will prosper it.
target: Kaa priez wi spiik ina wizdom; Di Laad wi prasper it.

en: Don’t say, “It is through the Lord that I fell away;” for you must not do the things that he hates.
target: No se, “A chuu di Laad dat mi faal we;” kaa yu mos no du di ting dem we im iet.

en: Don’t say, “It is he that caused me to err;” for he has no need of a sinful man.
target: No se, “A im we kaaz mi fi era;” kaa im av no niid a a sinful man.

en: The Lord hates every detestable thing; and those who fear him don’t love them.
target: Di Laad iet evri ting we iet; an dem uu fia im no lov dem.

en: He himself made man from the beginning and left him in the hand of his own counsel.
target: Im imself mek man fram di biginin an lef im ina di an a im uon kounsl.

en: If you choose, you can keep the commandments. To be faithful is a matter of your choice.
target: If yu chuuz, yu kyan kip di komanment dem. Fi bi fietful a a mata a yu chuais.

en: He has set fire and water before you. You will stretch forth your hand to whichever you desire.
target: Im av set faiya an waata bifuo yu. Yu wi strech fuot yu an tu wicheva yu dizaiya.

en: Before man is life and death. Whichever he likes, it will be given to him.
target: Bifuo man a laif an det. Wicheva im laik, it wi gi tu im.

en: For the wisdom of the Lord is great. He is mighty in power, and sees all things.
target: Kaa di wizdom a di Laad a griet. Im a maiti ina powa, an si aal ting.

en: His eyes are upon those who fear him. He knows every act of man.
target: Im ai dem de pan dem uu fia im. Im nuo evri ak a man.

en: He has not commanded any man to be ungodly. He has not given any man license to sin.
target: Im av no koman eni man fi bi onraichos. Im av no gi eni man laisens fi sin.

en: Don’t desire a multitude of unprofitable children, neither delight in ungodly sons.
target: No dizaiya a moltitiuud a onprafitabl pikni dem, niida dilait ina onraichos son dem.

en: If they multiply, don’t delight in them unless the fear of the Lord is in them.
target: If dem moltriplai, no dilait ina dem onles di fia a di Laad de ina dem.

en: Don’t trust in their life. Don’t rely on their numbers; for one can be better than a thousand, and to die childless than to have ungodly children.
target: No chos ina dem laif. No rilai pan dem nomba dem; kaa wan kyan bi beta dan a touzn, an fi ded widout pikni dan fi av onraichos pikni dem.

en: For from one who has understanding, a city will be populated, but a tribe of wicked men will be made desolate.
target: Kaa fram wan uu av andastandin, a siti wi ful op wid piipl, bot a chraib a wikid man dem wi mek desolet.

en: I have seen many such things with my eyes. My ear has heard mightier things than these.
target: Mi av si nof soch ting dem wid mi ai dem. Mi ier av ier maitia ting dem dan diiz.

en: In a congregation of sinners, a fire will be kindled. In a disobedient nation, wrath is kindled.
target: Ina a kangrigieshan a sinna dem, a faiya wi kindl. Ina a disuobidient nieshan, raat a kindl.

en: He was not pacified toward the giants of old time, who revolted in their strength.
target: Im neva kiet tu di jaiant dem a uol taim, uu rivolt ina dem strent.

en: He didn’t spare Lot’s neighbors, whom he abhorred for their pride.
target: Im neva spier Laats nieba dem, uu im iet fi dem praid.

en: He didn’t pity the people of perdition who were taken away in their sins,
target: Im neva piti di piipl a perdishan uu tek we ina dem sin dem,

en: or in like manner, the six hundred thousand footmen who were gathered together in the hardness of their hearts.
target: ar ina laik mana, di siks onjred touzn futman dem uu ben gyada tugeda ina di aadnis a dem aat.

en: Even if there is one stiff-necked person, it is a marvel if he will be unpunished; for mercy and wrath are both with him who is mighty to forgive, and he pours out wrath.
target: Iivn if de a wan stif-nek porsn, it a a wandaful ting if im wi go onponish; kaa mersi an raat buot de wid im uu a maiti fi fagiv, an im puor out raat.

en: As his mercy is great, so is his correction also. He judges a man according to his works.
target: Az im mersi a griet, so im korekshan a tu. Im joj a man akadin tu im wok dem.

en: The sinner will not escape with plunder. The perseverance of the godly will not be frustrated.
target: Di sinna wi no eskiep wid plonda. Di posivierans a di raichos dem wi no frustriet.

en: He will make room for every work of mercy. Each man will receive according to his works.
target: Im wi mek ruum fi evri wok a mersi. Iich man wi risiiv akadin tu im wok dem.

en: [Reader’s note: Verses 15 and 16 are omitted by the best authorities.]
target: [Riida nuot: Vors fiftin an sikstiin a lef out bai di bes atariti dem.]

en: [Reader’s note: Verses 15 and 16 are omitted by the best authorities.]
target: [Riida nuot: Vors fiftin an sikstiin a lef out bai di bes atariti dem.]

en: Don’t say, “I will be hidden from the Lord,” and “Who will remember me from on high?” I will not be known among so many people, for what is my soul in a boundless creation?
target: No se, “Mi wi aid fram di Laad,” an “Uu wi memba mi fram pan ai?” Mi wi no nuo mong so nof piipl, kaa wa a mi suol ina a boundles krieshan?

en: See, heaven, the heaven of heavens, the deep, and the earth, will be moved when he visits.
target: Si, evn, di evn a evn dem, di diip, an di ort, wi muuv wen im vizit.

en: The mountains and the foundations of the earth together are shaken with trembling when he looks at them.
target: Di mountn dem an di foundieshan dem a di ort tugeda shiek wid chremblin wen im luk pan dem.

en: No heart will think about these things. Who could comprehend his ways?
target: No aat wi tink bout diiz ting dem. Uu kuda andastan im wie dem?

en: Like a tempest which no man can see, so, the majority of his works are hidden.
target: Laik a tempest we no man kyan si, so, di majariti a im wok dem a aid.

en: Who will declare his works of righteousness? Who will wait for them? For his covenant is afar off.
target: Uu wi diklier im wok dem a raichosnis? Uu wi wiet fi dem? Kaa im kovnant a faar aaf.

en: He who is lacking in understanding thinks about these things. An unwise and erring man thinks foolishly.
target: Ii uu a lakin ina andastandin tink bout diiz ting dem. A man widout wizdom an a erin man tink fuulishli.

en: My son, listen to me, learn knowledge, and heed my words with your heart.
target: Mi son, lisn tu mi, lorn nalij, an iid mi wod dem wid yu aat.

en: I will impart instruction with precision, and declare knowledge exactly.
target: Mi wi gi instrokshan wid prisizhan, an diklier nalij egzaktli.

en: In the judgment of the Lord are his works from the beginning. From the making of them he determined their boundaries.
target: Ina di jojment a di Laad a im wok dem fram di biginin. Fram di mekin a dem im ditermin dem boundri dem.

en: He arranged his works for all time, and their beginnings to their generations. They aren’t hungry or weary, and they don’t cease from their works.
target: Im arienj im wok dem fi aal taim, an dem biginin dem tu dem jenarieshan dem. Dem no ongri ar wiiri, an dem no siiz fram dem wok dem.

en: No one pushes aside his neighbor. They will never disobey his word.
target: No wan push said im nieba. Dem wi neva disuobie im wod.

en: After this also the Lord looked at the earth and filled it with his blessings.
target: Afta dis tu di Laad luk pan di ort an ful it wid im blesin dem.

en: All manner of living things covered its surface, and they return into it.
target: Aal mana a livin ting dem kova it sorfis, an dem riton intu it.

en: The Lord created mankind out of earth, and turned them back to it again.
target: Di Laad kriet mankaind out a ort, an ton dem bak tu it agen.

en: He gave them days by number, and a set time, and gave them authority over the things that are on it.
target: Im gi dem die dem bai nomba, an a set taim, an gi dem atariti uova di ting dem we de pan it.

en: He endowed them with strength proper to them, and made them according to his own image.
target: Im gi dem strent prapa tu dem, an mek dem akadin tu im uon imij.

en: He put the fear of man upon all flesh, and gave him dominion over beasts and birds.
target: Im put di fia a man pan aal flesh, an gi im daminian uova biis dem an bord dem.

en: [Reader’s note: Verse 5 is omitted by the best authorities.]
target: [Riida nuot: Vors faib a lef out bai di bes atariti dem.]

en: He gave them counsel, tongue, eyes, ears, and heart to have understanding.
target: Im gi dem kounsl, tong, ai dem, ier dem, an aat fi av andastandin.

en: He filled them with the knowledge of wisdom, and showed them good and evil.
target: Im ful dem wid di nalij a wizdom, an shuo dem gud an iivl.

en: He set his eye upon their hearts, to show them the majesty of his works.
target: Im set im ai pan dem aat, fi shuo dem di majesti a im wok dem.

en: [Reader’s note: Verse 9 is omitted by the best authorities.]
target: [Riida nuot: Vors nain a lef out bai di bes atariti dem.]

en: And they will praise his holy name, that they may declare the majesty of his works.
target: An dem wi priez im uoli niem, so dem mait diklier di majesti a im wok dem.

en: He added to them knowledge, and gave them a law of life for a heritage.
target: Im ad tu dem nalij, an gi dem a laa a laif fi a eritej.

en: He made an everlasting covenant with them, and showed them his judgments.
target: Im mek a eva-lastin kovnant wid dem, an shuo dem im jojment dem.

en: Their eyes saw the majesty of his glory. Their ears heard the glory of his voice.
target: Dem ai dem si di majesti a im gluori. Dem ier dem ier di gluori a im vais.

en: He said to them, “Beware of all unrighteousness.” So he gave them commandment, each man concerning his neighbor.
target: Im se tu dem, “Biwier a aal onraichosnis.” So im gi dem komanment, iich man kansornin im nieba.

en: Their ways are ever before him. They will not be hidden from his eyes.
target: Dem wie dem a eva bifuo im. Dem wi no aid fram im ai dem.

en: [Reader’s note: Verses 16, 18, and 21 are omitted by the best authorities.]
target: [Riida nuot: Vors sikstiin, ietiin, an twenti-wan a lef out bai di bes atariti dem.]

en: For every nation he appointed a ruler, but Israel is the Lord’s portion.
target: Fi evri nieshan im apaint a ruula, bot Izrel a di Laads puoshan.

en: [Reader’s note: Verses 16, 18, and 21 are omitted by the best authorities.]
target: [Riida nuot: Vors sikstiin, ietiin, an twenti-wan a lef out bai di bes atariti dem.]

en: All their works are as clear as the sun before him. His eyes are continually upon their ways.
target: Aal dem wok dem a az klier az di son bifuo im. Im ai dem a kantiniuli pan dem wie dem.

en: Their sins are not hidden from him. All their sins are before the Lord.
target: Dem sin dem no aid fram im. Aal dem sin dem de bifuo di Laad.

en: [Reader’s note: Verses 16, 18, and 21 are omitted by the best authorities.]
target: [Riida nuot: Vors sikstiin, ietiin, an twenti-wan a lef out bai di bes atariti dem.]

en: With him a man’s almsgiving is as a signet. He will keep a man’s kindness as the pupil of the eye.
target: Wid im a man aamz-givin a az a signet. Im wi kip a man kainnis az di piupl a di ai.

en: Afterwards he will rise up and repay them, and give their repayment upon their head.
target: Aftawod im wi raiz op an ripie dem, an gi dem ripiement pan dem ed.

en: However to those who repent he grants a return. He comforts those who are losing hope.
target: Bot tu dem uu ripent im grant a riton. Im komfat dem uu a luuz uop.

en: Return to the Lord, and forsake sins. Pray before his face, and lessen offense.
target: Riton tu di Laad, an lef sin dem. Prie bifuo im fies, an lesn ofens.

en: Turn again to the Most High, and turn away from sin. Greatly hate the detestable thing.
target: Ton agen tu di Mos Ai, an ton we fram sin. Grietli iet di ting we iet.

en: Who will give praise to the Most High in Hades, in place of the living who return thanks?
target: Uu wi gi priez tu di Mos Ai ina Iidis, ina plies a di livin uu riton tanks?

en: Thanksgiving perishes from the dead, as from one who doesn’t exist. He who is in life and health will praise the Lord.
target: Tanksgivin ded fram di ded, az fram wan uu no egzis. Ii uu a ina laif an elt wi priez di Laad.

en: How great is the mercy of the Lord, and his forgiveness to those who turn to him!
target: Ou griet a di mersi a di Laad, an im fagivnis tu dem uu ton tu im!

en: For humans are not capable of everything, because the son of man is not immortal.
target: Kaa yuuman dem no kiepabl a evriting, kaa di son a man no imaatl.

en: What is brighter than the sun? Yet even this can be eclipsed. So flesh and blood devise evil.
target: Wa a braita dan di son? Yet iivn dis kyan get eklips. So flesh an blod mek op iivl.

en: He looks upon the power of the height of heaven, while all men are earth and ashes.
target: Im luk pan di powa a di ait a evn, wail aal man dem a ort an ashiz.

en: He who lives forever created the whole universe.
target: Ii uu liv fareva kriet di uol yuunivors.

en: The Lord alone is just.
target: Di Laad aluon a jos.

en: [Reader’s note: The remainder of verse 2, and verse 3, are omitted by the best authorities.]
target: [Riida nuot: Di res a vors tuu, an vors chrii, a lef out bai di bes atariti dem.]

en: He has given power to declare his works to no one. Who could trace out his mighty deeds?
target: Im av gi powa fi diklier im wok dem tu no wan. Uu kuda chries out im maiti diid dem?

en: Who could measure the strength of his majesty? Who could also proclaim his mercies?
target: Uu kuda meja di strent a im majesti? Uu kuda tu proklie im mersi dem?

en: As for the wondrous works of the Lord, it is not possible to take from them nor add to them, neither is it possible to explore them.
target: Az fi di wandros wok dem a di Laad, it no pasibl fi tek fram dem nar ad tu dem, niida it pasibl fi ekspluor dem.

en: When a man has finished, then he is just at the beginning. When he stops, then he will be perplexed.
target: Wen a man av finish, den im a jos a di biginin. Wen im stap, den im wi popleks.

en: What is mankind, and what purpose do they serve? What is their good, and what is their evil?
target: Wa a mankaind, an wa porpos dem sorv? Wa a dem gud, an wa a dem iivl?

en: The number of man’s days at the most are a hundred years.
target: Di nomba a man die dem a di muos a a onjred ier.

en: As a drop of water from the sea, and a pebble from the sand, so are a few years in the day of eternity.
target: Az a jrap a waata fram di sii, an a pebl fram di san, so a a fiu ier ina di die a iterniti.

en: For this cause the Lord was patient over them, and poured out his mercy upon them.
target: Fi dis kaaz di Laad ben pieshent uova dem, an puor out im mersi pan dem.

en: He saw and perceived their end, that it is evil. Therefore he multiplied his forgiveness.
target: Im si an posiiv dem en, dat it a iivl. So im moltriplai im fagivnis.

en: The mercy of a man is on his neighbor; but the mercy of the Lord is on all flesh: reproving, disciplining, teaching, and bringing back, as a shepherd does his flock.
target: Di mersi a a man de pan im nieba; bot di mersi a di Laad de pan aal flesh: a riproov, a disipline, a tiich, an a bring bak, az a shepad du im flak.

en: He has mercy on those who accept discipline, and that diligently seek after his judgments.
target: Im av mersi pan dem uu aksep disipline, an dat dilijentli siik afta im jojment dem.

en: My son, don’t add reproach to your good deeds, and no harsh words in any of your giving.
target: Mi son, no ad riprooch tu yu gud diid dem, an no aash wod dem ina eni a yu givin.

en: Doesn’t the dew relieve the scorching heat? So a word is better than a gift.
target: Di juu no riliiv di skaachin iit? So a wod a beta dan a gif.

en: See, isn’t a word better than a gift? Both are with a gracious person.
target: Si, a wod no beta dan a gif? Buot de wid a grieshos porsn.

en: A fool is ungracious and abusive. The gift of a grudging person consumes the eyes.
target: A fuul a ongrieshos an abiusiv. Di gif a a grojin porsn kansiuum di ai dem.

en: Learn before you speak. Take care of your health before you get sick.
target: Lorn bifuo yu spiik. Tek kier a yu elt bifuo yu get sik.

en: Before judgment, examine yourself, and in the hour of scrutiny you will find forgiveness.
target: Bifuo jojment, egzamin yuself, an ina di owa a skruutini yu wi fain fagivnis.

en: Humble yourself before you get sick. In the time of sins, repent.
target: Ombl yuself bifuo yu get sik. Ina di taim a sin dem, ripent.

en: Let nothing hinder you to pay your vow in due time. Don’t wait until death to be released.
target: Mek notn inda yu fi pie yu vou ina juu taim. No wiet til det fi get riliis.

en: Before you make a vow, prepare yourself. Don’t be like a man who tests the Lord.
target: Bifuo yu mek a vou, pripier yuself. No bi laik a man uu tes di Laad.

en: Think about the wrath coming in the days of the end, and the time of vengeance, when he turns away his face.
target: Tink bout di raat a kom ina di die dem a di en, an di taim a venjans, wen im ton we im fies.

en: In the days of fullness remember the time of hunger. Remember poverty and lack in the days of wealth.
target: Ina di die dem a fulnis memba di taim a onga. Memba pavati an lak ina di die dem a welt.

en: From morning until evening, the time changes. All things are speedy before the Lord.
target: Fram maanin til iivnin, di taim chienj. Aal ting dem a spiidi bifuo di Laad.

en: A wise man is cautious in everything. In days of sinning, he will beware of offense.
target: A waiz man a kaashos ina evriting. Ina die dem a sinin, im wi biwier a ofens.

en: Every man of understanding knows wisdom. He will give thanks to him who found her.
target: Evri man a andastandin nuo wizdom. Im wi gi tanks tu im uu fain ar.

en: They who were of understanding in sayings also became wise themselves, and poured out apt proverbs.
target: Dem uu ben a andastandin ina seyin dem tu bikam waiz demself, an puor out apt provereb dem.

en: Don’t go after your lusts. Restrain your appetites.
target: No go afta yu los dem. Ristrien yu apitait dem.

en: If you give fully to your soul the delight of her desire, she will make you the laughing stock of your enemies.
target: If yu gi fuli tu yu suol di dilait a ar dizaiya, shi wi mek yu di laafin stok a yu enimi dem.

en: Don’t make merry in much luxury, and don’t be tied to its expense.
target: No mek meri ina moch lokjri, an no tai tu it ekspens.

en: Don’t be made a beggar by banqueting with borrowed money when you have nothing in your purse.
target: No get mek a bega bai bankwetin wid baro moni wen yu av notn ina yu pors.

en: A worker who is a drunkard will not become rich. He who despises small things will fall little by little.
target: A woka uu a a jronkad wi no bikam rich. Ii uu despais smol ting dem wi faal likl bai likl.

en: Wine and women will make men of understanding go astray. He who joins with prostitutes is reckless.
target: Wain an uman dem wi mek man dem a andastandin go astre. Ii uu jain wid prastitiuut dem a reklis.

en: Decay and worms will have him as their heritage. A reckless soul will be taken away.
target: Dikie an worm dem wi av im az dem eritej. A reklis suol wi tek we.

en: He who is hasty to trust is shallow-hearted. He who sins offends against his own soul.
target: Ii uu a iesti fi chos a shalo-aatid. Ii uu sin ofens gens im uon suol.

en: He who rejoices in wickedness will be condemned.
target: Ii uu rijais ina wikidnis wi kandem.

en: He who hates gossip has less wickedness.
target: Ii uu iet gasip av les wikidnis.

en: Never repeat what is told you, and you won’t lose anything.
target: Neva ripiit wa tel yu, an yu wi no luuz eniting.

en: Whether it is of friend or foe, don’t tell it. Unless it is a sin to you, don’t reveal it.
target: Weda it a a fren ar fuo, no tel it. Onles it a a sin tu yu, no shuo it.

en: For if he has heard you and observed you, when the time comes, he will hate you.
target: Kaa if im av ier yu an obzorv yu, wen di taim kom, im wi iet yu.

en: Have you heard something? Let it die with you. Be brave: it will not make you burst!
target: Yu av ier sinting? Mek it ded wid yu. Bi briev: it wi no mek yu bos!

en: A fool will travail in pain with a word, as a woman in labor with a child.
target: A fuul wi chravail ina pien wid a wod, az a uman ina lieba wid a pikni.

en: As an arrow that sticks in the flesh of the thigh, so is gossip in a fool.
target: Az a aro we stik ina di flesh a di tai, so a gasip ina a fuul.

en: Question a friend; it may be he didn’t do it. If he did something, it may be that he may do it no more.
target: Kweschan a fren; it mait bi im neva du it. If im du sinting, it mait bi dat im mait du it no muo.

en: Question your neighbor; it may be he didn’t say it. If he has said it, it may be that he may not say it again.
target: Kweschan yu nieba; it mait bi im neva se it. If im av se it, it mait bi dat im mait no se it agen.

en: Question a friend; for many times there is slander. Don’t trust every word.
target: Kweschan a fren; kaa nof taim de a slanda. No chos evri wod.

en: There is one who slips, and not from the heart. Who is he who hasn’t sinned with his tongue?
target: De a wan uu slip, an no fram di aat. Uu a ii uu av no sin wid im tong?

en: Reprove your neighbor before you threaten him; and give place to the law of the Most High.
target: Riproov yu nieba bifuo yu chretn im; an gi plies tu di laa a di Mos Ai.

en: [Reader’s note: Verses 18 and 19 are omitted by the best authorities.]
target: [Riida nuot: Vors ietiin an naintiin a lef out bai di bes atariti dem.]

en: [Reader’s note: Verses 18 and 19 are omitted by the best authorities.]
target: [Riida nuot: Vors ietiin an naintiin a lef out bai di bes atariti dem.]

en: All wisdom is the fear of the Lord. In all wisdom is the doing of the law.
target: Aal wizdom a di fia a di Laad. Ina aal wizdom a di duin a di laa.

en: [Reader’s note: The remainder of verse 20 and verse 21 are omitted by the best authorities.]
target: [Riida nuot: Di res a vors twenti an vors twenti-wan a lef out bai di bes atariti dem.]

en: The knowledge of wickedness is not wisdom. The prudence of sinners is not counsel.
target: Di nalij a wikidnis no a wizdom. Di prudens a sinna dem no a kounsl.

en: There is a wickedness, and it is a detestable thing. There is a fool lacking in wisdom.
target: De a a wikidnis, an it a a ting we iet. De a a fuul lakin ina wizdom.

en: Better is one who has little understanding, and fears God, than one who has much intelligence and transgresses the law.
target: Beta a wan uu av likl andastandin, an fia Gad, dan wan uu av moch intelijens an chransgres di laa.

en: There is an exquisite subtlety, and it is unjust. And there is one who perverts favor to gain a judgment.
target: De a a eksquisit sotlti, an it a onjos. An de a wan uu povort fieva fi get a jojment.

en: There is one who does wickedly, who hangs down his head with mourning; but inwardly he is full of deceit,
target: De a wan uu du wikidli, uu ang dong im ed wid muornin; bot inwodli im ful a disiet,

en: bowing down his face, and pretending to be deaf in one ear. Where he isn’t known, he will take advantage of you.
target: a bou dong im fies, an a pritend fi bi def ina wan ier. We im no nuo, im wi tek avantaj a yu.

en: And if for lack of power he is hindered from sinning, if he finds opportunity, he will do mischief.
target: An if fi lak a powa im inda fram sinin, if im fain apachuniti, im wi du mischif.

en: A man will be known by his appearance. One who has understanding will be known by his face when you meet him.
target: A man wi nuo bai im apierans. Wan uu av andastandin wi nuo bai im fies wen yu miit im.

en: A man’s attire, grinning laughter, and the way he walks show what he is.
target: A man ataiya, grinin laafta, an di wie im waak shuo wa im a.

en: There is a reproof that is not timely; and there is a person who is wise enough to keep silent.
target: De a a riproov we no taimli; an de a a porsn uu a waiz inof fi kip sailent.

en: How good is it to reprove, rather than to be angry. He who confesses will be kept back from harm.
target: Ou gud it a fi riproov, raada dan fi bi angri. Ii uu kanfes wi kip bak fram aam.

en: [Reader’s note: Verse 3 is omitted by the best authorities.]
target: [Riida nuot: Vors chrii a lef out bai di bes atariti dem.]

en: As is the lust of a eunuch to violate a virgin, so is he who executes judgments with violence.
target: Az a di los a a yuunak fi vaioliet a vorjin, so a ii uu egzikiuut jojment dem wid vailens.

en: There is one who keeps silent and is found wise; and there is one who is hated for his much talk.
target: De a wan uu kip sailent an get fain waiz; an de a wan uu get iet fi im moch taak.

en: There is one who keeps silent, for he has no answer to make; And there is one who keeps silent, knowing when to speak.
target: De a wan uu kip sailent, kaa im av no ansa fi mek; An de a wan uu kip sailent, a nuo wen fi spiik.

en: A wise man will be silent until his time has come, but the braggart and fool will miss his time.
target: A waiz man wi bi sailent til im taim av kom, bot di bragat an fuul wi mis im taim.

en: He who uses many words will be hated. He who takes authority for himself will be hated in it.
target: Ii uu yuuz nof wod dem wi iet. Ii uu tek atariti fi imself wi iet ina it.

en: There is a prosperity that a man finds in misfortunes; and there is a gain that turns to loss.
target: De a a prasperiti we a man fain ina misfaachun dem; an de a a gien we ton tu laas.

en: There is a gift that will not profit you; and there is a gift that pays back double.
target: De a a gif we wi no prafit yu; an de a a gif we pie bak dobl.

en: There are losses because of glory; and there is one who has lifted up his head from a low estate.
target: De a laas dem kaa a gluori; an de a wan uu av lif op im ed fram a luo estiet.

en: There is one who buys much for a little, and pays for it again sevenfold.
target: De a wan uu bai moch fi a likl, an pie fi it agen sevn-fuol.

en: He who is wise in words will make himself beloved; but the pleasantries of fools will be wasted.
target: Ii uu a waiz ina wod dem wi mek imself lov; bot di plezantri dem a fuul dem wi wies.

en: The gift of a fool will not profit you, for he looks for repayment many times instead of one.
target: Di gif a a fuul wi no prafit yu, kaa im luk fi ripiement nof taim insiid a wan.

en: He will give little and insult much. He will open his mouth like a crier. Today he will lend, and tomorrow he will ask for it back. Such a one is a hateful man.
target: Im wi gi likl an insult moch. Im wi opn im mout laik a kraia. Tide im wi len, an tumaro im wi aaks fi it bak. Soch a wan a a ietful man.

en: The fool will say, “I have no friend, and I have no thanks for my good deeds. Those who eat my bread have an evil tongue.”
target: Di fuul wi se, “Mi av no fren, an mi av no tanks fi mi gud diid dem. Dem uu iit mi bred av a iivl tong.”

en: How often, and of how many, will he be laughed to scorn!
target: Ou aften, an a ou nof, im wi laaf tu skaan!

en: A slip on a pavement is better than a slip with the tongue. So the fall of the wicked will come speedily.
target: A slip pan a pievment a beta dan a slip wid di tong. So di faal a di wikid wi kom spiidili.

en: A man without grace is a tale out of season. It will be continually in the mouth of the ignorant.
target: A man widout gries a a tiel out a siizn. It wi bi kantiniuli ina di mout a di ignorant.

en: A parable from a fool’s mouth will be rejected; for he won’t tell it at the proper time.
target: A parabl fram a fuul mout wi rijek; kaa im wi no tel it a di prapa taim.

en: There is one who is hindered from sinning through lack. When he rests, he will not be troubled.
target: De a wan uu a inda fram sinin chuu lak. Wen im res, im wi no chobl.

en: There is one who destroys his soul through bashfulness. By a foolish countenance, he will destroy it.
target: De a wan uu distrai im suol chuu bashfulnis. Bai a fuulish fies, im wi distrai it.

en: There is one who for bashfulness makes promises to his friend; and he makes him his enemy for nothing.
target: De a wan uu fi bashfulnis mek pramis dem tu im fren; an im mek im im enimi fi notn.

en: A lie is an ugly blot on a person. It will be continually in the mouth of the ignorant.
target: A lai a a ogli blat pan a porsn. It wi bi kantiniuli ina di mout a di ignorant.

en: A thief is better than a man who is continually lying, but they both will inherit destruction.
target: A tiif a beta dan a man uu a kantiniuli laiin, bot dem buot wi inherit distrokshan.

en: The destination of a liar is dishonor. His shame is with him continually.
target: Di destinieshan a a lai a a disana. Im shiem de wid im kantiniuli.

en: He who is wise in words will advance himself. And one who is prudent will please great men.
target: Ii uu a waiz ina wod dem wi advans imself. An wan uu a prudent wi pliiz griet man dem.

en: He who tills his land will raise his harvest high. He who pleases great men will get pardon for sin.
target: Ii uu til im lan wi raiz im aaves ai. Ii uu pliiz griet man dem wi get paadn fi sin.

en: Favors and gifts blind the eyes of the wise, and as a muzzle on the mouth, turn away reproofs.
target: Fieva dem an gif dem blain di ai dem a di waiz, an az a mozl pan di mout, ton we riproov dem.

en: Wisdom that is hidden, and treasure that is out of sight— what profit is in either of them?
target: Wizdom we a aid, an treja we a out a sait— wa prafit de ina iida a dem?

en: Better is a man who hides his folly than a man who hides his wisdom.
target: Beta a a man uu aid im fulishnis dan a man uu aid im wizdom.

en: [Reader’s note: Verse 32 is omitted by the best authorities.]
target: [Riida nuot: Vors toti-tuu a lef out bai di bes atariti dem.]

en: My son, have you sinned? Do it no more; and ask forgiveness for your past sins.
target: Mi son, yu av sin? No du it no muo; an aaks fagivnis fi yu paas sin dem.

en: Flee from sin as from the face of a snake; for if you go near, it will bite you. Its teeth are like lion’s teeth, slaying people’s souls.
target: Flii fram sin az fram di fies a a sniek; kaa if yu go nier, it wi bait yu. It tiit dem a laik laian tiit dem, a slie piipl suol dem.

en: All sin is as a two-edged sword. Its stroke has no healing.
target: Aal sin a az a tuu-ej suod. It chruok av no iilin.

en: Terror and violence will waste away riches. So the house of an arrogant man will be laid waste.
target: Tera an vailens wi wies we richiz. So di ous a a aragant man wi lie wies.

en: Supplication from a poor man’s mouth reaches to the ears of God, and his judgment comes speedily.
target: Beg fram a puo man mout riich tu di ier dem a Gad, an im jojment kom spiidili.

en: One who hates reproof is in the path of the sinner. He who fears the Lord will repent in his heart.
target: Wan uu iet riproov de ina di paat a di sinna. Ii uu fia di Laad wi ripent ina im aat.

en: He who is mighty in tongue is known far away; but the man of understanding knows when he slips.
target: Ii uu a maiti ina tong a nuo faar we; bot di man a andastandin nuo wen im slip.

en: He who builds his house with other men’s money is like one who gathers stones for his own tomb.
target: Ii uu bil im ous wid ada man dem moni a laik wan uu gyada stuon dem fi im uon tuum.

en: The congregation of wicked men is as a bundle of tow with a flame of fire at the end of them.
target: Di kangrigieshan a wikid man dem a az a bondl a tou wid a fliem a faiya a di en a dem.

en: The way of sinners is paved with stones; and at the end of it is the pit of Hades.
target: Di wie a sinna dem a piev wid stuon dem; an a di en a it a di pit a Iidis.

en: He who keeps the law becomes master of its intent. The fulfilment of the fear of the Lord is wisdom.
target: Ii uu kip di laa bikam maasta a it intent. Di fulfilment a di fia a di Laad a wizdom.

en: He who is not clever will not be instructed. There is a cleverness which makes bitterness abound.
target: Ii uu no kleva wi no get instrokshan. De a a klevanis we mek bitanis abound.

en: The knowledge of a wise man will be made to abound as a flood, and his counsel as a fountain of life.
target: Di nalij a a waiz man wi mek fi abound az a flod, an im kounsl az a fountn a laif.

en: The inward parts of a fool are like a broken vessel. He will hold no knowledge.
target: Di inwod paat dem a a fuul a laik a brokn vesl. Im wi uol no nalij.

en: If a man of knowledge hears a wise word, he will commend it and add to it. The wanton man hears it, and it displeases him, so he throws it away behind his back.
target: If a man a nalij ier a waiz wod, im wi komend it an ad tu it. Di wantan man ier it, an it displiiz im, so im chuo it we beain im bak.

en: The chatter of a fool is like a burden in the way, but grace will be found on the lips of the wise.
target: Di chata a a fuul a laik a borden ina di wie, bot gries wi fain pan di lip dem a di waiz.

en: The utterance of the prudent man will be sought for in the congregation. They will ponder his words in their heart.
target: Di otarans a di prudent man wi saat fi ina di kangrigieshan. Dem wi panda im wod dem ina dem aat.

en: As a house that is destroyed, so is wisdom to a fool. The knowledge of an unwise man is talk without sense.
target: Az a ous we distrai, so a wizdom tu a fuul. Di nalij a a man widout wizdom a taak widout sens.

en: Instruction is as chains on the feet of an unwise man, and as manacles on the right hand.
target: Instrokshan a az chien dem pan di fut dem a a man widout wizdom, an az manakl dem pan di rait an.

en: A fool lifts up his voice with laughter, but a clever man smiles quietly.
target: A fuul lif op im vais wid laafta, bot a kleva man smail kwaietli.

en: Instruction is to a prudent man as an ornament of gold, and as a bracelet upon his right arm.
target: Instrokshan a tu a prudent man az a aanament a guol, an az a brieslet pan im rait aam.

en: The foot of a fool rushes into a house, but a man of experience will be ashamed of entering.
target: Di fut a a fuul rosh intu a ous, bot a man a ekspiriens wi bi ashiem a entrin.

en: A foolish man peers into the door of a house, but a man who is instructed will stand outside.
target: A fuulish man piip intu di duo a a ous, bot a man uu a instrok wi tan outsaid.

en: It is rude for someone to listen at a door, but a prudent person will be grieved with the disgrace.
target: It a ruud fi somwan fi lisn a a duo, bot a prudent porsn wi griiv wid di disgries.

en: The lips of strangers will be grieved at these things, but the words of prudent men will be weighed in the balance.
target: Di lip dem a strienja dem wi griiv a diiz ting dem, bot di wod dem a prudent man dem wi wie ina di balans.

en: The heart of fools is in their mouth, but the mouth of wise men is their heart.
target: Di aat a fuul dem de ina dem mout, bot di mout a waiz man dem a dem aat.

en: When the ungodly curses an adversary, he curses his own soul.
target: Wen di onraichos wan kos a advarsari, im kos im uon suol.

en: A whisperer defiles his own soul, and will be hated wherever he travels.
target: A wispara difail im uon suol, an wi iet weeva im chravl.

en: A slothful man is compared to a stone that is defiled. Everyone will hiss at him in his disgrace.
target: A slotful man a kompier tu a stuon we difail. Evriwan wi is a im ina im disgries.

en: A slothful man is compared to the filth of a dunghill. Anyone who picks it up will shake it out of his hand.
target: A slotful man a kompier tu di filt a a dongil. Eniwan uu pik it op wi shiek it out a im an.

en: An undisciplined child is a disgrace to his father, and a foolish daughter is born to his loss.
target: A pikni widout disipline a a disgries tu im faada, an a fuulish daata baan tu im laas.

en: A prudent daughter will inherit a husband of her own. She who brings shame is the grief of her father.
target: A prudent daata wi inherit a ozban a ar uon. Shi uu bring shiem a di griif a ar faada.

en: She who is arrogant brings shame on father and husband. She will be despised by both of them.
target: Shi uu a aragant bring shiem pan faada an ozban. Shi wi despais bai buot a dem.

en: Ill-timed conversation is like music in mourning, but stripes and correction are wisdom in every season.
target: Il-taim kanvasieshan a laik miuzik ina muornin, bot straip dem an korekshan a wizdom ina evri siizn.

en: He who teaches a fool is like one who glues potsherds together, even like one who wakes a sleeper out of a deep sleep.
target: Ii uu tiich a fuul a laik wan uu glu patshord dem tugeda, iivn laik wan uu wiek a sliipa out a a diip sliip.

en: He who teaches a fool is as one who teaches a man who slumbers. In the end he will say, “What is it?”
target: Ii uu tiich a fuul a az wan uu tiich a man uu slomba. A di en im wi se, “Wa a it?”

en: [Reader’s note: Verses 9 and 10 are omitted by the best authorities.]
target: [Riida nuot: Vors nain an ten a lef out bai di bes atariti dem.]

en: [Reader’s note: Verses 9 and 10 are omitted by the best authorities.]
target: [Riida nuot: Vors nain an ten a lef out bai di bes atariti dem.]

en: Weep for the dead, for he lacks light. Weep for a fool, for he lacks understanding. Weep more sweetly for the dead, because he has found rest, but the life of the fool is worse than death.
target: Wiip fi di ded, kaa im lak lait. Wiip fi a fuul, kaa im lak andastandin. Wiip muo swiitli fi di ded, kaa im av fain res, bot di laif a di fuul a wors dan det.

en: Mourning for the dead lasts seven days, but for a fool and an ungodly man, it lasts all the days of his life.
target: Muornin fi di ded laas sevn die, bot fi a fuul an a onraichos man, it laas aal di die dem a im laif.

en: Don’t talk much with a foolish man, and don’t go to one who has no understanding. Beware of him, or you will have trouble and be defiled in his onslaught. Turn away from him, and you will find rest, and you won’t be wearied in his madness.
target: No taak moch wid a fuulish man, an no go tu wan uu av no andastandin. Biwier a im, ar yu wi av chobl an get difail ina im ansaat. Ton we fram im, an yu wi fain res, an yu wi no wiiri ina im madnis.

en: What would be heavier than lead? What is its name, but “Fool”?
target: Wa wuda bi evia dan led? Wa a it niem, bot “Fuul”?

en: Sand, salt, and a mass of iron is easier to bear than a man without understanding.
target: San, saalt, an a mas a aian a iizia fi bier dan a man widout andastandin.

en: Timber girded and bound into a building will not be released with shaking. So a heart established in due season on well advised counsel will not be afraid.
target: Timba gerd an bain intu a bildin wi no riliis wid shiekin. So a aat establis ina juu siizn pan wel advaiz kounsl wi no fried.

en: A heart settled upon a thoughtful understanding is as an ornament of plaster on a polished wall.
target: A aat setl pan a taatful andastandin a az a aanament a plaasta pan a palish waal.

en: Fences set on a high place will not stand against the wind; so a fearful heart in the imagination of a fool will not stand against any fear.
target: Fens dem set pan a ai plies wi no tan gens di win; so a fiaful aat ina di imajinieshan a a fuul wi no tan gens eni fia.

en: He who pricks the eye will make tears fall. He who pricks the heart makes it show feeling.
target: Ii uu prik di ai wi mek tiir dem faal. Ii uu prik di aat mek it shuo fiilin.

en: Whoever casts a stone at birds scares them away. He who insults a friend will dissolve friendship.
target: Uueva chuo a stuon a bord dem skie dem we. Ii uu insult a fren wi dizaalv frenship.

en: If you have drawn a sword against a friend, don’t despair, for there may be a way back.
target: If yu av jraa a suod gens a fren, no dispeer, kaa de mait bi a wie bak.

en: If you have opened your mouth against a friend, don’t be afraid, for there may be reconciliation, unless it is for insulting, arrogance, disclosing of a secret, or a treacherous blow— for these things any friend will flee.
target: If yu av opn yu mout gens a fren, no bi fried, kaa de mait bi rekansilieshan, onles it a fi insultin, aragans, diskluozin a a siikrit, ar a trecharos bluo— kaa fi diiz ting dem eni fren wi flii.

en: Gain trust with your neighbor in his poverty, that in his prosperity you may have gladness. Stay steadfast to him in the time of his affliction, that you may be heir with him in his inheritance.
target: Get chos wid yu nieba ina im pavati, so ina im prasperiti yu mait av gladnis. Tan stedfaas tu im ina di taim a im aflikshan, so yu mait bi ier wid im ina im inheritans.

en: Before fire is the vapor and smoke of a furnace, so insults precede bloodshed.
target: Bifuo faiya a di viepa an smuok a a fornis, so insult dem kom bifuo blodshed.

en: I won’t be ashamed to shelter a friend. I won’t hide myself from his face.
target: Mi wi no bi ashiem fi shelta a fren. Mi wi no aid miself fram im fies.

en: If any evil happens to me because of him, everyone who hears it will beware of him.
target: If eni iivl apn tu mi kaa a im, evriwan uu ier it wi biwier a im.

en: Who will set a watch over my mouth, and a seal of shrewdness upon my lips, that I may not fall from it, and that my tongue may not destroy me?
