target: Uu wi set a wach uova mi mout, an a siil a shruudnis pan mi lip dem, so mi mait no faal fram it, an so mi tong mait no distrai mi?

en: O Lord, Father and Master of my life, don’t abandon me to their counsel. Don’t let me fall because of them.
target: O Laad, Faada an Maasta a mi laif, no lef mi tu dem kounsl. No mek mi faal kaa a dem.

en: Who will set scourges over my thought, and a discipline of wisdom over my heart, that they spare me not for my errors, and not overlook their sins?
target: Uu wi set skoorj dem uova mi taat, an a disipline a wizdom uova mi aat, so dem no spier mi fi mi era dem, an no uovaluk dem sin dem?

en: Otherwise my errors might be multiplied, and my sins abound, I fall before my adversaries, and my enemy rejoice over me.
target: Adawaiz mi era dem mait moltriplai, an mi sin dem abound, mi faal bifuo mi advarsari dem, an mi enimi rijais uova mi.

en: O Lord, Father and God of my life, don’t give me a haughty eyes,
target: O Laad, Faada an Gad a mi laif, no gi mi a aati ai dem,

en: and turn away evil desire from me.
target: an ton we iivl dizaiya fram mi.

en: Let neither gluttony nor lust overtake me. Don’t give me over to a shameless mind.
target: Mek niida glotni nar los uovatiek mi. No gi mi uova tu a shiemles main.

en: Listen, my children, to the discipline of the mouth. He who keeps it will not be caught.
target: Lisn, mi pikni dem, tu di disipline a di mout. Ii uu kip it wi no get kaat.

en: The sinner will be overpowered through his lips. By them, the insulter and the arrogant will stumble.
target: Di sinna wi uovapowa chuu im lip dem. Bai dem, di insolta an di aragant wi stombl.

en: Don’t accustom your mouth to an oath, and don’t be accustomed to naming the Holy One,
target: No akostom yu mout tu a uot, an no bi akostom tu niemin di Uoli Wan,

en: for as a servant who is continually scourged will not lack bruises, so he also who swears and continually utters the Name will not be cleansed from sin.
target: kaa az a sorvant uu a kantiniuli skoorj wi no lak bruuz dem, so im tu uu swier an kantiniuli ota di Niem wi no kliinz fram sin.

en: A man of many oaths will be filled with sin. The scourge will not depart from his house. If he offends, his sin will be upon him. If he disregards it, he has sinned doubly. If he has sworn falsely, he will not be justified, for his house will be filled with calamities.
target: A man a nof uot dem wi ful op wid sin. Di skoorj wi no go we fram im ous. If im ofens, im sin wi bi pan im. If im disrigaad it, im av sin dobli. If im av sworn faalsli, im wi no jostifai, kaa im ous wi ful op wid kalamiti dem.

en: There is a manner of speech that is clothed with death. Let it not be found in the heritage of Jacob, for all these things will be far from the godly, and they will not wallow in sins.
target: De a a mana a spiich we a kluod wid det. No mek it fain ina di eritej a Jiekob, kaa aal diiz ting dem wi bi faar fram di raichos dem, an dem wi no wala ina sin dem.

en: Don’t accustom your mouth to gross rudeness, for it involves sinful speech.
target: No akostom yu mout tu gruos ruudnis, kaa it invalv sinful spiich.

en: Remember your father and your mother, for you sit in the midst of great men, that you be not forgetful before them, and become a fool by your bad habit; so you may wish that you had not been born, and curse the day of your birth.
target: Memba yu faada an yu mada, kaa yu sidong ina di migl a griet man dem, so yu no fagetful bifuo dem, an bikam a fuul bai yu bad abit; so yu mait wish dat yu neva ben baan, an kos di die a yu bort.

en: A man who is accustomed to abusive language won’t be corrected all the days of his life.
target: A man uu a akostom tu abiusiv langwij wi no korek aal di die dem a im laif.

en: Two sorts of people multiply sins, and the third will bring wrath: a hot passion, like a burning fire, will not be quenched until it is consumed; a fornicator in the body of his flesh will never cease until he has burned out the fire.
target: Tuu saat a piipl moltriplai sin dem, an di tord wi bring raat: a at pashan, laik a bornin faiya, wi no kwench til it kansiuum; a faanikieta ina di badi a im flesh wi neva siiz til im av bon out di faiya.

en: All bread is sweet to a fornicator. He will not cease until he dies.
target: Aal bred a swiit tu a faanikieta. Im wi no siiz til im ded.

en: A man who goes astray from his own marriage bed says in his heart, “Who sees me? Darkness is around me, and the walls hide me. No one sees me. Of whom am I afraid? The Most High will not remember my sins.”
target: A man uu go astre fram im uon marij bed se ina im aat, “Uu si mi? Daaknis de roun mi, an di waal dem aid mi. No wan si mi. A uum mi fried? Di Mos Ai wi no memba mi sin dem.”

en: The eyes of men are his terror. He doesn’t know that the eyes of the Lord are ten thousand times brighter than the sun, seeing all the ways of men, and looking into secret places.
target: Di ai dem a man dem a im tera. Im no nuo dat di ai dem a di Laad a ten touzn taim braita dan di son, a si aal di wie dem a man dem, an a luk intu siikrit plies dem.

en: All things were known to him before they were created, and also after they were completed.
target: Aal ting dem ben nuo tu im bifuo dem ben kriet, an tu afta dem ben kompliit.

en: This man will be punished in the streets of the city. He will be seized where he least expects it.
target: Dis man wi ponish ina di striit dem a di siti. Im wi siiz we im liis ekspek it.

en: So also is a wife who leaves her husband, and produces an heir by another man.
target: So tu a a waif uu lef ar ozban, an prodiuus a ier bai anoda man.

en: For first, she was disobedient in the law of the Most High. Second, she trespassed against her own husband. Third, she played the adulteress in fornication, and had children by another man.
target: Kaa fos, shi ben disuobidient ina di laa a di Mos Ai. Sekan, shi chrespaas gens ar uon ozban. Tord, shi plie di adoltres ina faanikieshan, an av pikni dem bai anoda man.

en: She will be brought out into the congregation. Her punishment will extend to her children.
target: Shi wi bring out intu di kangrigieshan. Ar ponishment wi ekstend tu ar pikni dem.

en: Her children will not take root. Her branches will bear no fruit.
target: Ar pikni dem wi no tek ruut. Ar branch dem wi bier no fruut.

en: She will leave her memory for a curse. Her reproach won’t be blotted out.
target: Shi wi lef ar memri fi a kos. Ar riprooch wi no blat out.

en: And those who are left behind will know that there is nothing better than the fear of the Lord, and nothing sweeter than to heed the commandments of the Lord.
target: An dem uu a lef beain wi nuo dat de notn beta dan di fia a di Laad, an notn swiita dan fi iid di komanment dem a di Laad.

en: [Reader’s note: Verse 28 is omitted by the best authorities.]
target: [Riida nuot: Vors twenti-iet a lef out bai di bes atariti dem.]

en: Wisdom will praise her own soul, and will proclaim her glory in the midst of her people.
target: Wizdom wi priez ar uon suol, an wi proklie ar gluori ina di migl a ar piipl.

en: She will open her mouth in the congregation of the Most High, and proclaim her glory in the presence of his power.
target: Shi wi opn ar mout ina di kangrigieshan a di Mos Ai, an proklie ar gluori ina di prezens a im powa.

en: “I came out of the mouth of the Most High, and covered the earth as a mist.
target: “Mi kom out a di mout a di Mos Ai, an kova di ort az a mis.

en: I lived in high places, and my throne is in the pillar of the cloud.
target: Mi liv ina ai plies dem, an mi chuon de ina di pila a di kloud.

en: Alone I surrounded the circuit of heaven, and walked in the depth of the abyss.
target: Aluon mi soround di sorkit a evn, an waak ina di dept a di abis.

en: In the waves of the sea, and in all the earth, and in every people and nation, I obtained a possession.
target: Ina di wiev dem a di sii, an ina aal di ort, an ina evri piipl an nieshan, mi get a pozeshan.

en: With all these I sought rest. In whose inheritance will I lodge?
target: Wid aal diiz mi saat res. Ina uuz inheritans mi wi laj?

en: Then the Creator of all things gave me a command. He who created me made my tent to rest, and said, ‘Let your dwelling be in Jacob, and your inheritance in Israel.’
target: Den di Krieta a aal ting dem gi mi a koman. Ii uu kriet mi mek mi tent fi res, an se, ‘Mek yu dwelin bi ina Jiekob, an yu inheritans ina Izrel.’

en: He created me from the beginning, before the ages. For all ages, I will not cease to exist.
target: Im kriet mi fram di biginin, bifuo di iej dem. Fi aal iej dem, mi wi no siiz fi egzis.

en: In the holy tabernacle, I ministered before him. So I was established in Zion.
target: Ina di uoli tabanakl, mi minista bifuo im. So mi ben establis ina Zaian.

en: In the beloved city, likewise he gave me rest. In Jerusalem was my domain.
target: Ina di bilov siti, laikwaiz im gi mi res. Ina Jeruusalem ben mi daminian.

en: I took root in a people that was honored, even in the portion of the Lord’s own inheritance.
target: Mi tek ruut ina a piipl we ben ana, iivn ina di puoshan a di Laads uon inheritans.

en: I was exalted like a cedar in Lebanon, And like a cypress tree on the mountains of Hermon.
target: Mi ben lif op laik a siida ina Lebanan, An laik a saipres chrii pan di mountn dem a Erman.

en: I was exalted like a palm tree on the sea shore, like rose bushes in Jericho, and like a fair olive tree in the plain. I was exalted like a plane tree.
target: Mi ben lif op laik a paam chrii pan di sii shuor, laik ruoz bush dem ina Jeriko, an laik a fier aliv chrii ina di plien. Mi ben lif op laik a plien chrii.

en: Like cinnamon and aspalathus, I have given a scent to perfumes. Like choice myrrh, I spread abroad a pleasant fragrance, like galbanum, onycha, stacte, and as the smell of frankincense in the tabernacle.
target: Laik sinaman an aspalatos, mi av gi a sent tu porfiuum dem. Laik chuais mor, mi spred abroad a plezant friegrans, laik galbanom, onika, stakti, an az di smel a frankinsens ina di tabanakl.

en: Like the terebinth, I stretched out my branches. My branches are glorious and graceful.
target: Laik di terebint, mi strech out mi branch dem. Mi branch dem a gluorios an griesful.

en: Like the vine, I put forth grace. My flowers are the fruit of glory and riches.
target: Laik di vain, mi put fuot gries. Mi flowa dem a di fruut a gluori an richiz.

en: [Reader’s note: Verse 18 is omitted by the best authorities.]
target: [Riida nuot: Vors ietiin a lef out bai di bes atariti dem.]

en: “Come to me, all you who desire me, and be filled with my fruits.
target: “Kom tu mi, aal unu uu dizaiya mi, an bi ful op wid mi fruut dem.

en: For my memory is sweeter than honey, and my inheritance than the honeycomb.
target: Kaa mi memri a swiita dan oni, an mi inheritans dan di onikuom.

en: Those who eat me will be hungry for more. Those who drink me will be thirsty for more.
target: Dem uu iit mi wi bi ongri fi muo. Dem uu jrink mi wi bi torsti fi muo.

en: He who obeys me will not be ashamed. Those who work with me will not sin.”
target: Ii uu uobie mi wi no bi ashiem. Dem uu wok wid mi wi no sin.”

en: All these things are the book of the covenant of the Most High God, the law which Moses commanded us for an inheritance for the assemblies of Jacob.
target: Aal diiz ting dem a di buk a di kovnant a di Mos Ai Gad, di laa we Muoziz koman wi fi a inheritans fi di asembli dem a Jiekob.

en: [Reader’s note: Verse 24 is omitted by the best authorities.]
target: [Riida nuot: Vors twenti-fuo a lef out bai di bes atariti dem.]

en: It is he who makes wisdom abundant, as Pishon, and as Tigris in the days of first fruits.
target: A im uu mek wizdom abound, az Pishan, an az Taigris ina di die dem a fos fruut dem.

en: He makes understanding full as the Euphrates, and as the Jordan in the days of harvest,
target: Im mek andastandin ful az di Yuufrietiz, an az di Jaadn ina di die dem a aaves,

en: who makes instruction shine forth as the light, as Gihon in the days of vintage.
target: uu mek instrokshan shain fuot az di lait, az Giihan ina di die dem a vintej.

en: The first man didn’t know her perfectly. In like manner, the last has not explored her.
target: Di fos man neva nuo ar porfekli. Ina laik mana, di laas av no ekspluor ar.

en: For her thoughts are filled from the sea, and her counsels from the great deep.
target: Kaa ar taat dem a ful fram di sii, an ar kounsl dem fram di griet diip.

en: I came out as a canal stream from a river, and as an irrigation ditch into a garden.
target: Mi kom out az a kanal striim fram a riva, an az a irigieshan dich intu a gaadn.

en: I said, “I will water my garden, and will drench my garden bed.” See, my stream became a river, and my river became a sea.
target: Mi se, “Mi wi waata mi gaadn, an wi jrench mi gaadn bed.” Si, mi striim bikam a riva, an mi riva bikam a sii.

en: I will yet bring instruction to light as the morning, and will make these things clear from far away.
target: Mi wi yet bring instrokshan tu lait az di maanin, an wi mek diiz ting dem klier fram faar we.

en: I will continue to pour out teaching like prophecy, and leave it to all generations.
target: Mi wi kantiniu fi puor out tiichin laik prafisi, an lef it tu aal jenarieshan dem.

en: See that I have not labored for myself only, but for all those who diligently seek wisdom.
target: Si dat mi av no lieba fi miself onli, bot fi aal dem uu dilijentli siik wizdom.

en: These are the words of the book which Baruch the son of Nerias, the son of Maaseas, the son of Sedekias, the son of Asadias, the son of Helkias, wrote in Babylon,
target: Dem ya a di wod dem a di buk we Baruuk di son a Neraias, di son a Maasiias, di son a Sedekaias, di son a Asadaias, di son a Elkaias, ruot ina Babilan,

en: in the fifth year, in the seventh day of the month, at the time when the Chaldeans took Jerusalem and burned it with fire.
target: ina di fif ier, ina di sebnt die a di mont, a di taim wen di Kaldiian dem tek Jeruusalem an bon it wid faiya.

en: Baruch read the words of this book in the hearing of Jechonias the son of Joakim king of Judah, and in the hearing of all the people who came to hear the book,
target: Baruuk riid di wod dem a dis buk ina di ierin a Jekonaias di son a Juoakim king a Juuda, an ina di ierin a aal di piipl uu kom fi ier di buk,

en: and in the hearing of the mighty men, and of the kings’ sons, and in the hearing of the elders, and in the hearing of all the people, from the least to the greatest, even of all those who lived at Babylon by the river Sud.
target: an ina di ierin a di maiti man dem, an a di king dem son dem, an ina di ierin a di elda dem, an ina di ierin a aal di piipl, fram di liis tu di grietis, iivn a aal dem uu liv a Babilan bai di riva Sud.

en: Then they wept, fasted, and prayed before the Lord.
target: Den dem baal, faas, an prier bifuo di Laad.

en: They also made a collection of money according to every man’s ability;
target: Dem tu mek a kalekshan a moni akaadin tu evri man abiliti;

en: and they sent it to Jerusalem to Joakim the high priest, the son of Helkias, the son of Salom, and to the priests and to all the people who were found with him at Jerusalem,
target: an dem sen it tu Jeruusalem tu Juoakim di ai priis, di son a Elkaias, di son a Saalom, an tu di priis dem an tu aal di piipl uu fain wid im a Jeruusalem,

en: at the same time when he took the vessels of the house of the Lord, that had been carried out of the temple, to return them into the land of Judah, the tenth day of Sivan—silver vessels which Sedekias the son of Josias king of Judah had made,
target: a di siem taim wen im tek di vesl dem a di ous a di Laad, we did kyari out a di templ, fi riton dem ina di lan a Juuda, di tent die a Sivan—silva vesl dem we Sedekaias di son a Josaias king a Juuda did mek,

en: after Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon had carried away Jechonias, the princes, the captives, the mighty men, and the people of the land from Jerusalem, and brought them to Babylon.
target: afta Nabukodonosor king a Babilan did kyari we Jekonaias, di prins dem, di kiaptiv dem, di maiti man dem, an di piipl a di lan fram Jeruusalem, an bring dem tu Babilan.

en: And they said: See, we have sent you money; therefore buy with the money burnt offerings, sin offerings, and incense, and prepare a grain offering, and offer upon the altar of the Lord our God;
target: An dem se: Si, wi sen unu moni; so bai wid di moni bont aafrin dem, sin aafrin dem, an insens, an pripier a grien aafrin, an aafa pan di aalta a di Laad wi Gad;

en: and pray for the life of Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon, and for the life of Baltasar his son, that their days may be as the days of heaven above the earth.
target: an prier fi di laif a Nabukodonosor king a Babilan, an fi di laif a Baltasaar im son, dat dem die dem mien bi az di die dem a evn abov di ort.

en: The Lord will give us strength and light to our eyes. We will live under the shadow of Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon and under the shadow of Baltasar his son, and we will serve them many days, and find favor in their sight.
target: Di Laad wi gi wi schrengt an lait tu wi ai dem. Wi wi liv anda di shada a Nabukodonosor king a Babilan an anda di shada a Baltasaar im son, an wi wi sorv dem nof die, an fain fieva ina dem sait.

en: Pray for us also to the Lord our God, for we have sinned against the Lord our God. To this day the wrath of the Lord and his indignation is not turned from us.
target: Prier fi wi tu tu di Laad wi Gad, kaa wi sin gens di Laad wi Gad. Tu dis die di raat a di Laad an im indignieshan no ton fram wi.

en: You must read this book which we have sent to you, to make confession in the house of the Lord upon the day of the feast and on the appointed days.
target: Unu mos riid dis buk we wi sen tu unu, fi mek kanfeshan ina di ous a di Laad pan di die a di fiis an pan di apointid die dem.

en: You must say: To the Lord our God belongs righteousness, but to us shame of face, as at this day—to the men of Judah, to the inhabitants of Jerusalem,
target: Unu mos se: Tu di Laad wi Gad bilang raichosnis, bot tu wi shiem a fies, az a dis die—tu di man dem a Juuda, tu di inabitant dem a Jeruusalem,

en: to our kings, to our princes, to our priests, to our prophets, and to our fathers,
target: tu wi king dem, tu wi prins dem, tu wi priis dem, tu wi prafit dem, an tu wi faada dem,

en: because we have sinned before the Lord.
target: bikaaz wi sin bifuo di Laad.

en: We have disobeyed him and have not listened to the voice of the Lord our God, to walk in the commandments of the Lord that he has set before us.
target: Wi disuobie im an no lisn tu di vais a di Laad wi Gad, fi waak ina di komanment dem a di Laad we im set bifuo wi.

en: Since the day that the Lord brought our fathers out of the land of Egypt to this present day, we have been disobedient to the Lord our God, and we have been negligent in not listening to his voice.
target: Sins di die dat di Laad bring wi faada dem out a di lan a Iijipt tu dis prezent die, wi did disuobiidient tu di Laad wi Gad, an wi did neglient ina no lisn tu im vais.

en: Therefore the plagues have clung to us, along with the curse which the Lord declared through Moses his servant in the day that he brought our fathers out of the land of Egypt to give us a land that flows with milk and honey, as at this day.
target: So di plieg dem klong tu wi, alang wid di kors we di Laad diklier chruu Muoziz im saavant ina di die we im bring wi faada dem out a di lan a Iijipt fi gi wi a lan we fluo wid milk an oni, az a dis die.

en: Nevertheless we didn’t listen to the voice of the Lord our God, according to all the words of the prophets whom he sent to us,
target: Yet wi no lisn tu di vais a di Laad wi Gad, akaadin tu aal di wod dem a di prafit dem uu im sen tu wi,

en: but we each walked in the thoughts of his own wicked heart, to serve strange gods and to do what is evil in the sight of the Lord our God.
target: bot wi iich waak ina di taat dem a im uon wikid aart, fi sorv schrienj ila dem an fi du we iivl ina di sait a di Laad wi Gad.

en: Therefore the Lord has made good his word which he pronounced against us, and against our judges who judged Israel, and against our kings, and against our princes, and against the men of Israel and Judah,
target: So di Laad mek gud im wod we im pronauns gens wi, an gens wi joj dem uu joj Izrel, an gens wi king dem, an gens wi prins dem, an gens di man dem a Izrel an Juuda,

en: to bring upon us great plagues such as never happened before under the whole heaven, as happened in Jerusalem, according to the things that are written in the law of Moses,
target: fi bring pan wi griet plieg dem laik we neva apn bifuo anda di uol evn, az apn ina Jeruusalem, akaadin tu di ting dem we rait ina di laa a Muoziz,

en: that we should each eat the flesh of our own son, and each eat the flesh of our own daughter.
target: dat wi shud iich iit di flesh a wi uon son, an iich iit di flesh a wi uon daata.

en: Moreover he has given them to be in subjection to all the kingdoms that are around us, to be a reproach and a desolation among all the people around us, where the Lord has scattered them.
target: Muuova im gi dem fi bi ina sobjekshan tu aal di kindom dem we roun wi, fi bi a riproach an a desolieshan mongks aal di piipl roun wi, we di Laad skata dem.

en: Thus they were cast down and not exalted, because we sinned against the Lord our God in not listening to his voice.
target: So dem kyas dong an no egzalt, bikaaz wi sin gens di Laad wi Gad ina no lisn tu im vais.

en: To the Lord our God belongs righteousness, but to us and to our fathers shame of face, as at this day.
target: Tu di Laad wi Gad bilang raichosnis, bot tu wi an tu wi faada dem shiem a fies, az a dis die.

en: All these plagues have come upon us which the Lord has pronounced against us.
target: Aal dem plieg ya kom pan wi we di Laad pronauns gens wi.

en: Yet we have not pleaded for the favor of the Lord by everyone turning from the thoughts of his wicked heart.
target: Yet wi no pliid fi di fieva a di Laad bai evriwan a ton fram di taat dem a im wikid aart.

en: Therefore the Lord has kept watch over the plagues. The Lord has brought them upon us, for the Lord is righteous in all his works which he has commanded us.
target: So di Laad kip waach uova di plieg dem. Di Laad bring dem pan wi, kaa di Laad raichos ina aal im wok dem we im koman wi.

en: Yet we have not listened to his voice, to walk in the commandments of the Lord that he has set before us.
target: Yet wi no lisn tu im vais, fi waak ina di komanment dem a di Laad we im set bifuo wi.

en: And now, O Lord, you God of Israel who have brought your people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, with signs, with wonders, with great power, and with a high arm, and have gotten yourself a name, as at this day:
target: An nou, O Laad, yu Gad a Izrel uu bring yu piipl out a di lan a Iijipt wid a maiti an, wid sain dem, wid wanda dem, wid griet powa, an wid a ai aam, an get yuself a niem, az a dis die:

en: O Lord our God, we have sinned. We have been ungodly. We have done wrong in all your ordinances.
target: O Laad wi Gad, wi sin. Wi bi ongadli. Wi du rang ina aal yu aadinans dem.

en: Let your wrath turn from us, for we are but a few left among the nations where you have scattered us.
target: Mek yu raat ton fram wi, kaa wi bot a fyuu lef mongks di nieshan dem we yu skata wi.

en: Hear our prayer, O Lord, and our petition, and deliver us for your own sake. Give us favor in the sight of those who have led us away captive,
target: Ier wi prier, O Laad, an wi pitishan, an diliva wi fi yu uon siek. Gi wi fieva ina di sait a dem uu liid wi we kiaptiv,

en: that all the earth may know that you are the Lord our God, because Israel and his posterity is called by your name.
target: dat aal di ort mien nuo dat yu a di Laad wi Gad, bikaaz Izrel an im pasteriti kaal bai yu niem.

en: O Lord, look down from your holy house and consider us. Incline your ear, O Lord, and hear.
target: O Laad, luk dong fram yu uoli ous an kansida wi. Inklain yu ier, O Laad, an ier.

en: Open your eyes, and see; for the dead that are in Hades, whose breath is taken from their bodies, will give to the Lord neither glory nor righteousness;
target: Uopm yu ai dem, an si; kaa di ded we de ina Iidis, uu bret tek fram dem badi, wi gi tu di Laad niida gluori nor raichosnis;

en: but the soul who is greatly grieved, who goes stooping and feeble, and the eyes that fail, and the hungry soul, will declare your glory and righteousness, O Lord.
target: bot di suol uu grietli griiv, uu go a stuup an fiibl, an di ai dem we fiel, an di ongri suol, wi diklier yu gluori an raichosnis, O Laad.

en: For we do not present our supplication before you, O Lord our God, for the righteousness of our fathers and of our kings.
target: Kaa wi no prizent wi soplikieshan bifuo yu, O Laad wi Gad, fi di raichosnis a wi faada dem an a wi king dem.

en: For you have sent your wrath and your indignation upon us, as you have spoken by your servants the prophets, saying,
target: Kaa yu sen yu raat an yu indignieshan pan wi, az yu taak bai yu saavant dem di prafit dem, a se,

en: “The Lord says, ‘Bow your shoulders to serve the king of Babylon, and remain in the land that I gave to your fathers.
target: “Di Laad se, ‘Bou unu shuolda fi sorv di king a Babilan, an rimien ina di lan we mi gi tu unu faada dem.

en: But if you won’t hear the voice of the Lord to serve the king of Babylon,
target: Bot ef unu no ier di vais a di Laad fi sorv di king a Babilan,

en: I will cause to cease out of the cities of Judah and from the region near Jerusalem the voice of mirth, the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride. The whole land will be desolate without inhabitant.’ ”
target: Mi wi kaaz fi siis out a di siti dem a Juuda an fram di riijan nier Jeruusalem di vais a mirt, di vais a gladnis, di vais a di braidgruum, an di vais a di braid. Di uol lan wi desolet widout inabitant.’ ”

en: But we wouldn’t listen to your voice, to serve the king of Babylon. Therefore you have made good your words that you spoke by your servants the prophets, that the bones of our kings and the bones of our fathers would be taken out of their places.
target: Bot wi wudn lisn tu yu vais, fi sorv di king a Babilan. So yu mek gud yu wod dem we yu taak bai yu saavant dem di prafit dem, dat di buon dem a wi king dem an di buon dem a wi faada dem wuda tek out a dem plies.

en: See, they are cast out to the heat by day and to the frost by night. They died in great miseries by famine, by sword, and by pestilence.
target: Si, dem kyas out tu di iit bai die an tu di fraas bai nait. Dem ded ina griet mizri bai famin, bai suod, an bai pestilens.

en: You have made the house that is called by your name as it is today because of the wickedness of the house of Israel and the house of Judah.
target: Yu mek di ous we kaal bai yu niem az it bi tide bikaaz a di wikidnis a di ous a Izrel an di ous a Juuda.

en: Yet, O Lord our God, you have dealt with us after all your kindness and according to all your great mercy,
target: Yet, O Laad wi Gad, yu diil wid wi afta aal yu kainnis an akaadin tu aal yu griet mersi,

en: as you spoke by your servant Moses in the day when you commanded him to write your law in the presence of the children of Israel, saying,
target: az yu taak bai yu saavant Muoziz ina di die wen yu koman im fi rait yu laa ina di prezens a di pikni dem a Izrel, a se,

en: “If you won’t hear my voice, surely this very great multitude will be turned into a small number among the nations where I will scatter them.
target: “Ef unu no ier mi vais, syuorli dis veri griet moltityuud wi ton ina a smol nomba mongks di nieshan dem we mi wi skata dem.

en: For I know that they will not hear me, because they are a stiff-necked people; but in the land of their captivity they will take it to heart,
target: Kaa mi nuo dat dem wi no ier mi, bikaaz dem a a stif-nek piipl; bot ina di lan a dem kiaptiviti dem wi tek it tu aart,

en: and will know that I am the Lord their God. I will give them a heart and ears to hear.
target: an wi nuo dat mi a di Laad dem Gad. Mi wi gi dem a aart an ierz fi ier.

en: Then they will praise me in the land of their captivity, and think about my name,
target: Den dem wi priez mi ina di lan a dem kiaptiviti, an tingk bout mi niem,

en: and will return from their stiff neck and from their wicked deeds; for they will remember the way of their fathers who sinned before the Lord.
target: an wi riton fram dem stif nek an fram dem wikid diid dem; kaa dem wi rememba di wie a dem faada dem uu sin bifuo di Laad.

en: I will bring them again into the land which I swore to their fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, and they will rule over it. I will increase them, and they won’t be diminished.
target: Mi wi bring dem agen ina di lan we mi swier tu dem faada dem, tu Iebraham, tu Aizak, an tu Jiekob, an dem wi ruul uova it. Mi wi inkriis dem, an dem no wi diminish.

en: And I will make an everlasting covenant with them to be their God, and they will be my people. I will no more remove my people Israel out of the land that I have given them.”
target: An mi wi mek a evaalastin kovnant wid dem fi bi dem Gad, an dem wi bi mi piipl. Mi wi no muo rimuuv mi piipl Izrel out a di lan we mi gi dem.”

en: O Lord Almighty, you God of Israel, the soul in anguish and the troubled spirit cries to you.
target: O Laad Olmaiti, yu Gad a Izrel, di suol ina angwish an di chrobl spirit krai tu yu.

en: Hear, O Lord, and have mercy; for you are a merciful God. Yes, have mercy upon us, because we have sinned before you.
target: Ier, O Laad, an av mersi; kaa yu a a mersiful Gad. Yes, av mersi pan wi, bikaaz wi sin bifuo yu.

en: For you are enthroned forever, and we keep perishing.
target: Kaa yu chruon faareva, an wi kip a perish.

en: O Lord Almighty, you God of Israel, hear now the prayer of the dead Israelites, and of the children of those who were sinners before you, who didn’t listen to the voice of you their God; because of this, these plagues cling to us.
target: O Laad Olmaiti, yu Gad a Izrel, ier nou di prier a di ded Izrelait dem, an a di pikni dem a dem uu a sina bifuo yu, uu no lisn tu di vais a yu dem Gad; bikaaz a dis, dem plieg ya klong tu wi.

en: Don’t remember the sins of our fathers, but remember your power and your name at this time.
target: No rememba di sin dem a wi faada dem, bot rememba yu powa an yu niem a dis taim.

en: For you are the Lord our God, and we will praise you, O Lord.
target: Kaa yu a di Laad wi Gad, an wi wi priez yu, O Laad.

en: For this cause, you have put your fear in our hearts, so that we should call upon your name. We will praise you in our captivity, for we have called to mind all the sin of our fathers who sinned before you.
target: Fi dis kaaz, yu put yu fier ina wi aart dem, so dat wi shud kaal pan yu niem. Wi wi priez yu ina wi kiaptiviti, kaa wi kaal tu main aal di sin a wi faada dem uu sin bifuo yu.

en: See, we are yet this day in our captivity where you have scattered us, as an object of reproach and a curse, and to be subject to penalty according to all the sins of our fathers who departed from the Lord our God.
target: Si, wi stil tide ina wi kiaptiviti we yu skata wi, az a abjek a riproach an a kors, an fi bi sobjek tu penalti akaadin tu aal di sin dem a wi faada dem uu dipaat fram di Laad wi Gad.

en: Hear, O Israel, the commandments of life! Give ear to understand wisdom!
target: Ier, O Izrel, di komanment dem a laif! Gi ier fi andastan wizdam!

en: How is it, O Israel, that you are in your enemies’ land, that you have become old in a strange country, that you are defiled with the dead,
target: Ou it bi, O Izrel, dat yu de ina yu enimi dem lan, dat yu ton uol ina a schrienj konchri, dat yu difail wid di ded,

en: that you are counted with those who are in Hades?
target: dat yu kount wid dem uu de ina Iidis?

en: You have forsaken the fountain of wisdom.
target: Yu fosiek di fountn a wizdam.

en: If you had walked in the way of God, you would have dwelled in peace forever.
target: Ef yu did waak ina di wie a Gad, yu wuda dwel ina piis faareva.

en: Learn where there is wisdom, where there is strength, and where there is understanding, that you may also know where there is length of days and life, where there is the light of the eyes and peace.
target: Lan we wizdam de, we schrengt de, an we andastandin de, dat yu mien tu nuo we lent a die an laif de, we di lait a di ai dem an piis de.

en: Who has found out her place? Who has come into her treasuries?
target: Uu fain out ar plies? Uu kom ina ar chrezhari dem?

en: Where are the princes of the nations, and those who ruled the beasts that are on the earth,
target: We di prins dem a di nieshan dem de, an dem uu ruul di biis dem we de pan di ort,

en: those who had their pastime with the fowls of the air, and those who hoarded up silver and gold, in which people trust, and of their getting there is no end?
target: dem uu av dem paastaim wid di foul dem a di ier, an dem uu uord op silva an guol, ina we piipl chros, an a dem getin de no en?

en: For those who diligently sought silver, and were so anxious, and whose works are past finding out,
target: Kaa dem uu dilijentli soch silva, an a so angkshos, an uu wok dem paas fainin out,

en: they have vanished and gone down to Hades, and others have come up in their place.
target: dem vanish an go dong tu Iidis, an ada dem kom op ina dem plies.

en: Younger men have seen the light and lived upon the earth, but they haven’t known the way of knowledge,
target: Yonga man dem si di lait an liv pan di ort, bot dem no nuo di wie a nalij,

en: nor understood its paths. Their children haven’t embraced it. They are far off from their way.
target: nor andastan it paat dem. Dem pikni no embries it. Dem faar aaf fram dem wie.

en: It has not been heard of in Canaan, neither has it been seen in Teman.
target: It no ier a ina Kienan, niida it no si ina Tiiman.

en: The sons also of Agar who seek understanding, which are in the land, the merchants of Merran and Teman, and the authors of fables, and the searchers out of understanding—none of these have known the way of wisdom or remembered her paths.
target: Di son dem tu a Aagar uu siik andastandin, we de ina di lan, di morchant dem a Meran an Tiiman, an di aata dem a fiebl, an di sorcha dem out a andastandin—non a dem no nuo di wie a wizdam or rememba ar paat dem.

en: O Israel, how great is the house of God! How large is the place of his possession!
target: O Izrel, ou griet a di ous a Gad! Ou laaj a di plies a im pozeshan!

en: It is great and has no end. It is high and unmeasurable.
target: It griet an av no en. It ai an onmezhrabl.

en: Giants were born that were famous of old, great of stature, and expert in war.
target: Jaiant dem baan we fiemos a uol, griet a stacha, an ekspart ina waar.

en: God didn’t choose these, nor did he give the way of knowledge to them,
target: Gad no chuuz dem, nor im no gi di wie a nalij tu dem,

en: so they perished, because they had no wisdom. They perished through their own foolishness.
target: so dem perish, bikaaz dem av no wizdam. Dem perish chruu dem uon fuulishnis.

en: Who has gone up into heaven, taken her, and brought her down from the clouds?
target: Uu go op ina evn, tek ar, an bring ar dong fram di kloud dem?

en: Who has gone over the sea, found her, and will bring her for choice gold?
target: Uu go uova di sii, fain ar, an wi bring ar fi chais guol?

en: There is no one who knows her way, nor any who comprehend her path.
target: No wan no de uu nuo ar wie, nor eni uu kamprihen ar paat.

en: But he that knows all things knows her, he found her out with his understanding. He who prepared the earth for all time has filled it with four-footed beasts.
target: Bot im we nuo aal ting nuo ar, im fain ar out wid im andastandin. Im uu pripier di ort fi aal taim ful it wid fuor-futid biis dem.

en: It is he who sends forth the light, and it goes. He called it, and it obeyed him with fear.
target: A im uu sen fuot di lait, an it go. Im kaal it, an it uobie im wid fier.

en: The stars shone in their watches, and were glad. When he called them, they said, “Here we are.” They shone with gladness to him who made them.
target: Di staar dem shain ina dem waach dem, an glad. Wen im kaal dem, dem se, “Ya wi de.” Dem shain wid gladnis tu im uu mek dem.

en: This is our God. No other can be compared to him.
target: Dis a wi Gad. No ada kyan kompier tu im.

en: He has found out all the way of knowledge, and has given it to Jacob his servant and to Israel who is loved by him.
target: Im fain out aal di wie a nalij, an gi it tu Jiekob im saavant an tu Izrel uu im lov.

en: Afterward she appeared upon earth, and lived with men.
target: Aftawod shi apier pan ort, an liv wid man dem.

en: This is the book of God’s commandments and the law that endures forever. All those who hold it fast will live, but those who leave it will die.
target: Dis a di buk a Gads komanment dem an di laa we endyuor faareva. Aal dem uu uol it faas wi liv, bot dem uu lef it wi ded.

en: Turn, O Jacob, and take hold of it. Walk toward the shining of its light.
target: Ton, O Jiekob, an tek uol a it. Waak tuwaad di shainin a it lait.

en: Don’t give your glory to another, nor the things that are to your advantage to a foreign nation.
target: No gi yu gluori tu aneda, nor di ting dem we a tu yu advantej tu a farin nieshan.

en: O Israel, we are happy; for the things that are pleasing to God are made known to us.
target: O Izrel, wi api; kaa di ting dem we pliiz Gad mek nuo tu wi.

en: Be of good cheer, my people, the memorial of Israel.
target: Bi a gud chier, mi piipl, di memuorial a Izrel.

en: You were not sold to the nations for destruction, but because you moved God to wrath, you were delivered to your adversaries.
target: Unu no sel tu di nieshan dem fi dischroshon, bot bikaaz unu muuv Gad tu raat, unu diliva tu unu adverzeri dem.

en: For you provoked him who made you by sacrificing to demons and not to God.
target: Kaa unu provuok im uu mek unu bai sakrifais tu diimon dem an no tu Gad.

en: You forgot the everlasting God who brought you up. You also grieved Jerusalem, who nursed you.
target: Unu faget di evaalastin Gad uu bring unu op. Unu tu griiv Jeruusalem, uu nors unu.

en: For she saw the wrath that came upon you from God, and said, “Listen, you who dwell near Zion; for God has brought upon me great mourning.
target: Kaa shi si di raat we kom pan unu fram Gad, an se, “Lisn, unu uu dwel nier Zaian; kaa Gad bring pan mi griet muornin.

en: For I have seen the captivity of my sons and daughters, which the Everlasting has brought upon them.
target: Kaa mi si di kiaptiviti a mi son dem an daata dem, we di Evaalastin bring pan dem.

en: For with joy I nourished them, but sent them away with weeping and mourning.
target: Kaa wid jai mi norish dem, bot sen dem we wid baalin an muornin.

en: Let no man rejoice over me, a widow and forsaken by many. For the sins of my children, I am left desolate, because they turned away from the law of God
target: Mek no man rijais uova mi, a wida an fosiek bai nof. Fi di sin dem a mi pikni, mi lef desolet, bikaaz dem ton we fram di laa a Gad

en: and had no regard for his ordinances. They didn’t walk in the ways of God’s commandments or tread in the paths of discipline in his righteousness.
target: an av no rigaad fi im aadinans dem. Dem no waak ina di wie dem a Gads komanment dem or chred ina di paat dem a disiplin ina im raichosnis.

en: Let those who dwell near Zion come and remember the captivity of my sons and daughters, which the Everlasting has brought upon them.
target: Mek dem uu dwel nier Zaian kom an rememba di kiaptiviti a mi son dem an daata dem, we di Evaalastin bring pan dem.

en: For he has brought a nation upon them from afar, a shameless nation with a strange language, who didn’t respect old men or pity children.
target: Kaa im bring a nieshan pan dem fram afaar, a shiemles nieshan wid a schrienj langwij, uu no rispek uol man dem or piti pikni.

en: They have carried away the dear beloved sons of the widow, and left her who was alone desolate of her daughters.”
target: Dem kyari we di dier bilov son dem a di wida, an lef ar uu a aluon desolet a ar daata dem.”

en: But I—how can I help you?
target: Bot mi—ou mi kyan elp unu?

en: For he who brought these calamities upon you will deliver you from the hand of your enemies.
target: Kaa im uu bring dem kalamiti ya pan unu wi diliva unu fram di an a unu enimi dem.

en: Go your way, O my children. Go your way, for I am left desolate.
target: Go unu wie, O mi pikni dem. Go unu wie, kaa mi lef desolet.

en: I have put off the garment of peace, and put on the sackcloth of my petition. I will cry to the Everlasting as long as I live.
target: Mi put aaf di gaament a piis, an put pan di sakklaat a mi pitishan. Mi wi krai tu di Evaalastin az lang az mi liv.

en: Take courage, my children. Cry to God, and he will deliver you from the power and hand of the enemies.
target: Tek korij, mi pikni dem. Krai tu Gad, an im wi diliva unu fram di powa an an a di enimi dem.

en: For I have trusted in the Everlasting, that he will save you; and joy has come to me from the Holy One, because of the mercy that will soon come to you from your Everlasting Savior.
target: Kaa mi chros ina di Evaalastin, dat im wi siev unu; an jai kom tu mi fram di Uoli Wan, bikaaz a di mersi we suun wi kom tu unu fram unu Evaalastin Sievior.

en: For I sent you out with mourning and weeping, but God will give you to me again with joy and gladness forever.
target: Kaa mi sen unu out wid muornin an baalin, bot Gad wi gi unu tu mi agen wid jai an gladnis faareva.

en: For as now those who dwell near Zion have seen your captivity, so they will shortly see your salvation from our God which will come upon you with great glory and brightness of the Everlasting.
target: Kaa az nou dem uu dwel nier Zaian si unu kiaptiviti, so dem wi shuortli si unu salvieshan fram wi Gad we wi kom pan unu wid griet gluori an braitnis a di Evaalastin.

en: My children, suffer patiently the wrath that has come upon you from God, for your enemy has persecuted you; but shortly you will see his destruction and will tread upon their necks.
target: Mi pikni dem, sofa pieshentli di raat we kom pan unu fram Gad, kaa unu enimi persikyuut unu; bot shuortli unu wi si im dischroshon an wi chred pan dem nek.

en: My delicate ones have traveled rough roads. They were taken away like a flock carried off by enemies.
target: Mi deliket wan dem chrabl raf ruod dem. Dem tek we laik a flak kyari aaf bai enimi dem.

en: Take courage, my children, and cry to God; for you will be remembered by him who has brought this upon you.
target: Tek korij, mi pikni dem, an krai tu Gad; kaa unu wi rememba bai im uu bring dis pan unu.

en: For as it was your decision to go astray from God, return and seek him ten times more.
target: Kaa az it a unu disizhan fi go aschrie fram Gad, riton an siik im ten taim muo.

en: For he who brought these calamities upon you will bring you everlasting joy again with your salvation.
target: Kaa im uu bring dem kalamiti ya pan unu wi bring unu evaalastin jai agen wid unu salvieshan.

en: Take courage, O Jerusalem, for he who called you by name will comfort you.
target: Tek korij, O Jeruusalem, kaa im uu kaal yu bai niem wi komfot yu.

en: Woe to those who afflicted you and rejoiced at your fall.
target: Wuo tu dem uu aflik yu an rijais a yu faal.

en: Woe to the cities which your children served. Woe to her who received your sons.
target: Wuo tu di siti dem we unu pikni sorv. Wuo tu ar uu risiiv yu son dem.

en: For as she rejoiced at your fall and was glad of your ruin, so she will be grieved at her own desolation.
target: Kaa az shi rijais a yu faal an glad a yu ruin, so shi wi griiv a ar uon desolieshan.

en: And I will take away her pride in her great multitude and her boasting will be turned into mourning.
target: An mi wi tek we ar praid ina ar griet moltityuud an ar buostin wi ton ina muornin.

en: For fire will come upon her from the Everlasting for many days; and she will be inhabited by demons for a long time.
target: Kaa faiya wi kom pan ar fram di Evaalastin fi nof die; an diimon dem wi inabit ar fi a lang taim.

en: O Jerusalem, look around you toward the east, and see the joy that comes to you from God.
target: O Jeruusalem, luk roun yu tuwaad di iis, an si di jai we kom tu yu fram Gad.

en: See, your sons come, whom you sent away. They come gathered together from the east to the west at the word of the Holy One, rejoicing in the glory of God.
target: Si, yu son dem kom, uu yu sen we. Dem kom gyada tugeda fram di iis tu di wes a di wod a di Uoli Wan, a rijais ina di gluori a Gad.

en: Take off the garment of your mourning and affliction, O Jerusalem, and put on forever the beauty of the glory from God.
target: Tek aaf di gaament a yu muornin an aflikshan, O Jeruusalem, an put pan faareva di byuuti a di gluori fram Gad.

en: Put on the robe of the righteousness from God. Set on your head a diadem of the glory of the Everlasting.
target: Put pan di ruob a di raichosnis fram Gad. Set pan yu ed a daiadem a di gluori a di Evaalastin.

en: For God will show your splendor everywhere under heaven.
target: Kaa Gad wi shuo yu splenda evriwe anda evn.

en: For your name will be called by God forever “Righteous Peace, Godly Glory”.
target: Kaa yu niem wi kaal bai Gad faareva “Raichos Piis, Divain Gluori”.

en: Arise, O Jerusalem, and stand upon the height. Look around you toward the east and see your children gathered from the going down of the sun to its rising at the word of the Holy One, rejoicing that God has remembered them.
target: Araiz, O Jeruusalem, an stan pan di ait. Luk roun yu tuwaad di iis an si yu pikni dem gyada fram di go dong a di son tu it raizin a di wod a di Uoli Wan, a rijais dat Gad rememba dem.

en: For they went from you on foot, being led away by their enemies, but God brings them in to you carried on high with glory, on a royal throne.
target: Kaa dem go fram yu pan fut, a liid we bai dem enimi dem, bot Gad bring dem in tu yu kyari pan ai wid gluori, pan a raayal chruon.

en: For God has appointed that every high mountain and the everlasting hills should be made low, and the valleys filled up to make the ground level, that Israel may go safely in the glory of God.
target: Kaa Gad apoint dat evri ai mountn an di evaalastin il dem shud mek luo, an di vali dem fil op fi mek di grong levl, dat Izrel mien go siefli ina di gluori a Gad.

en: Moreover the woods and every sweet smelling tree have shaded Israel by the commandment of God.
target: Muuova di wud dem an evri swiit-smelin chrii shied Izrel bai di komanment a Gad.

en: For God will lead Israel with joy in the light of his glory with the mercy and righteousness that come from him.
target: Kaa Gad wi liid Izrel wid jai ina di lait a im gluori wid di mersi an raichosnis we kom fram im.

en: A copy of a letter that Jeremy sent to those who were to be led captives into Babylon by the king of the Babylonians, to give them the message that God commanded him.
target: A kapi a a leta we Jeremi sen tu dem uu a fi liid kiaptiv ina Babilan bai di king a di Babiluoniyan dem, fi gi dem di mesij we Gad koman im.

en: Because of the sins which you have committed before God, you will be led away captives to Babylon by Nabuchodonosor king of the Babylonians.
target: Bikaaz a di sin dem we unu komit bifuo Gad, unu wi liid we kiaptiv tu Babilan bai Nabukodonosor king a di Babiluoniyan dem.

en: So when you come to Babylon, you will remain there many years, and for a long season, even for seven generations. After that, I will bring you out peacefully from there.
target: So wen unu kom tu Babilan, unu wi rimien de nof ier, an fi a lang siizn, iivn fi sevn jenerieshan. Afta dat, mi wi bring unu out piisfuli fram de.

en: But now you will see in Babylon gods of silver, gold, and wood carried on shoulders, which cause the nations to fear.
target: Bot nou unu wi si ina Babilan ila dem a silva, guol, an wud kyari pan shuolda, we kaaz di nieshan dem fi fier.

en: Beware therefore that you in no way become like these foreigners. Don’t let fear take hold of you because of them when you see the multitude before them and behind them, worshiping them.
target: Biwier so dat unu ina no wie no ton laik dem farina ya. No mek fier tek uol a unu bikaaz a dem wen unu si di moltityuud bifuo dem an biajin dem, a woship dem.

en: But say in your hearts, “O Lord, we must worship you.”
target: Bot se ina unu aart dem, “O Laad, wi mos woship yu.”

en: For my angel is with you, and I myself care for your souls.
target: Kaa mi ienjel de wid unu, an mi miself kier fi unu suol dem.

en: For their tongue is polished by the workman, and they themselves are overlaid with gold and with silver; yet they are only fake, and can’t speak.
target: Kaa dem tong palish bai di wokman, an dem demself uovalie wid guol an wid silva; yet dem onli fiek, an kyaan taak.

en: And taking gold, as if it were for a virgin who loves adornment, they make crowns for the heads of their gods.
target: An a tek guol, az ef it a fi a vorjin uu lov adoanment, dem mek kroun dem fi di ed dem a dem ila dem.

en: Sometimes also the priests take gold and silver from their gods, and spend it on themselves.
target: Somtaim tu di priis dem tek guol an silva fram dem ila dem, an spen it pan demself.

en: They will even give some of it to the prostitutes on the roof. They dress them like men with garments, even the gods of silver, gods of gold, and gods of wood.
target: Dem wi iivn gi som a it tu di prastityuut dem pan di ruuf. Dem jres dem laik man wid gaament dem, iivn di ila dem a silva, ila dem a guol, an ila dem a wud.

en: Yet these gods can’t save themselves from rust and moths, even though they are covered with purple garments.
target: Yet dem ila ya kyaan siev demself fram ros an maat dem, iivn duo dem kova wid porpl gaament dem.

en: They wipe their faces because of the dust of the temple, which is thick upon them.
target: Dem waip dem fies bikaaz a di dos a di templ, we tik pan dem.

en: And he who can’t put to death one who offends against him holds a sceptre, as though he were judge of a country.
target: An im uu kyaan put tu det wan uu afen gens im uol a septa, az duo im a joj a a konchri.

en: He has also a dagger in his right hand, and an axe, but can’t deliver himself from war and robbers.
target: Im av tu a daga ina im rait an, an a aks, bot kyaan diliva imself fram waar an raba dem.

en: By this they are known not to be gods. Therefore don’t fear them.
target: Bai dis dem nuo fi no bi ila dem. So no fier dem.

en: For like a vessel that a man uses is worth nothing when it is broken, even so it is with their gods. When they are set up in the temples, their eyes are full of dust through the feet of those who come in.
target: Kaa laik a vesl we a man yuuz a notn wen it bruk, iivn so it bi wid dem ila dem. Wen dem set op ina di templ dem, dem ai ful a dos chruu di fut dem a dem uu kom in.

en: As the courts are secured on every side upon him who offends the king, as being committed to suffer death, even so the priests secure their temples with doors, with locks, and bars, so that they may not be carried off by robbers.
target: Az di kuot dem sikyuor pan evri said pan im uu afen di king, az a komit fi sofa det, iivn so di priis dem sikyuor dem templ dem wid duor dem, wid lak dem, an baar dem, so dat raba dem mien no kyari dem aaf.

en: They light candles for them, yes, more than for themselves, even though they can’t see one.
target: Dem lait kyandl dem fi dem, yes, muo dan fi demself, iivn duo dem kyaan si wan.

en: They are like one of the beams of the temple. Men say their hearts are eaten out when things creeping out of the earth devour both them and their clothing. They don’t feel it
target: Dem laik wan a di biim dem a di templ. Man se dem aart iit out wen ting a kriip out a di ort divour buot dem an dem kluodin. Dem no fiil it

en: when their faces are blackened through the smoke that comes out of the temple.
target: wen dem fies blakn chruu di smuok we kom out a di templ.

en: Bats, swallows, and birds land on their bodies and heads. So do the cats.
target: Bat dem, swala dem, an bod dem lan pan dem badi an ed dem. So du di kyat dem.

en: By this you may know that they are no gods. Therefore don’t fear them.
target: Bai dis unu mien nuo dat dem a no ila. So no fier dem.

en: Notwithstanding the gold with which they are covered to make them beautiful, unless someone wipes off the tarnish, they won’t shine; for they didn’t even feel it when they were molten.
target: Notwidstandin di guol we dem kova wid fi mek dem byuutiful, onles sombadi waip aaf di taanish, dem no wi shain; kaa dem no iivn fiil it wen dem melt.

en: Things in which there is no breath are bought at any cost.
target: Ting dem ina we no bret de bai a eni kaas.

en: Having no feet, they are carried upon shoulders. By this, they declare to men that they are worth nothing.
target: As dem av no fut, dem kyari pan shuolda dem. Bai dis, dem diklier tu man dem dat dem a notn.

en: Those who serve them are also ashamed, for if they fall to the ground at any time, they can’t rise up again by themselves. If they are bowed down, they can’t make themselves straight; but the offerings are set before them, as if they were dead men.
target: Dem uu sorv dem tu ashiem, kaa ef dem faal tu di grong a eni taim, dem kyaan raiz op agen bai demself. Ef dem bou dong, dem kyaan mek demself schriet; bot di aafrin dem set bifuo dem, az ef dem a ded man dem.

en: And the things that are sacrificed to them, their priests sell and spend. In like manner, their wives also lay up part of it in salt; but to the poor and to the powerless they give none of it.
target: An di ting dem we sakrifais tu dem, dem priis dem sel an spen. Ina laik mana, dem waif dem tu lie op paat a it ina saalt; bot tu di pua an tu di powales dem gi non a it.

en: The menstruous woman and the woman in childbed touch their sacrifices, knowing therefore by these things that they are no gods. Don’t fear them.
target: Di uman we ina ar montli taim an di uman ina chaailbed toch dem sakrifais dem, a nuo so bai dem ting ya dat dem a no ila. No fier dem.

en: For how can they be called gods? Because women set food before the gods of silver, gold, and wood.
target: Kaa ou dem kyan kaal ila? Bikaaz uman dem set fuud bifuo di ila dem a silva, guol, an wud.

en: And in their temples the priests sit on seats, having their clothes torn and their heads and beards shaven, and nothing on their heads.
target: An ina dem templ dem di priis dem sidong pan siit dem, an dem kluoz tuor an dem ed an biird shiev, an notn pan dem ed.

en: They roar and cry before their gods, as men do at the feast when one is dead.
target: Dem ruor an krai bifuo dem ila dem, az man du a di fiis wen wan ded.

en: The priests also take off garments from them and clothe their wives and children with them.
target: Di priis dem tu tek aaf gaament dem fram dem an kluod dem waif dem an pikni dem wid dem.

en: Whether it is evil or good what one does to them, they are not able to repay it. They can’t set up a king or put him down.
target: Weda it iivl or gud we wan du tu dem, dem no iebl fi ripie it. Dem kyaan set op a king or put im dong.

en: In like manner, they can neither give riches nor money. Though a man make a vow to them and doesn’t keep it, they will never exact it.
target: Ina laik mana, dem kyaan niida gi richiz nor moni. Duo a man mek a vou tu dem an no kip it, dem wi neva egzakt it.

en: They can save no man from death. They can’t deliver the weak from the mighty.
target: Dem kyaan siev no man fram det. Dem kyaan diliva di wiik fram di maiti.

en: They can’t restore a blind man to his sight, or deliver anyone who is in distress.
target: Dem kyaan ristuor a blain man tu im sait, or diliva enibadi uu ina jischres.

en: They can show no mercy to the widow, or do good to the fatherless.
target: Dem kyaan shuo no mersi tu di wida, or du gud tu di faadales.

en: They are like the stones that are cut out of the mountain, these gods of wood that are overlaid with gold and with silver. Those who minister to them will be confounded.
target: Dem laik di stuon dem we kot out a di mountn, dem ila ya a wud we uovalie wid guol an wid silva. Dem uu minista tu dem wi kanfound.

en: How could a man then think or say that they are gods, when even the Chaldeans themselves dishonor them?
target: Ou a man den kuda tingk or se dat dem a ila, wen iivn di Kaldiian dem demself disona dem?

en: If they will see one mute who can’t speak, they bring him and ask him to call upon Bel, as though he were able to understand.
target: Ef dem wi si wan myuut uu kyaan taak, dem bring im an aks im fi kaal pan Bel, az duo im iebl fi andastan.

en: Yet they can’t perceive this themselves, and forsake them; for they have no understanding.
target: Yet dem kyaan porsiiv dis demself, an fosiek dem; kaa dem av no andastandin.

en: The women also with cords around them sit in the ways, burning bran for incense; but if any of them, drawn by someone who passes by, lies with him, she reproaches her fellow, that she was not thought as worthy as herself and her cord wasn’t broken.
target: Di uman dem tu wid kaad dem roun dem sidong ina di wie dem, a bon bran fi insens; bot ef eni a dem, jraan bai sombadi uu paas bai, lai wid im, shi riproach ar fela, dat shi no taat az woerti az arself an ar kaad no bruk.

en: Whatever is done among them is false. How could a man then think or say that they are gods?
target: Eniting we du mongks dem a faals. Ou a man den kuda tingk or se dat dem a ila?

en: They are fashioned by carpenters and goldsmiths. They can be nothing else than what the workmen make them to be.
target: Dem fashan bai kyapenta dem an guolsmit dem. Dem kyaan bi notn els dan we di wokman dem mek dem fi bi.

en: And they themselves who fashioned them can never continue long. How then should the things that are fashioned by them?
target: An dem demself uu fashan dem kyaan neva kantinyu lang. Ou den shud di ting dem we fashan bai dem?

en: For they have left lies and reproaches to those who come after.
target: Kaa dem lef lai dem an riproach dem tu dem uu kom afta.

en: For when there comes any war or plague upon them, the priests consult with themselves, where they may be hidden with them.
target: Kaa wen eni waar or plieg kom pan dem, di priis dem kansolt wid demself, we dem mien aid wid dem.

en: How then can’t men understand that they are no gods, which can’t save themselves from war or from plague?
target: Ou den man dem kyaan andastan dat dem a no ila, we kyaan siev demself fram waar or fram plieg?

en: For seeing they are only wood and overlaid with gold and silver, it will be known hereafter that they are false.
target: Kaa a si dem onli wud an uovalie wid guol an silva, it wi nuo ier afta dat dem faals.

en: It will be manifest to all nations and kings that they are no gods, but the works of men’s hands, and that there is no work of God in them.
target: It wi manifest tu aal nieshan dem an king dem dat dem a no ila, bot di wok dem a man an dem, an dat no wok a Gad no de ina dem.

en: Who then may not know that they are not gods?
target: Uu den mien no nuo dat dem a no ila?

en: For they can’t set up a king in a land or give rain to men.
target: Kaa dem kyaan set op a king ina a lan or gi rien tu man dem.

en: They can’t judge their own cause, or redress a wrong, being unable; for they are like crows between heaven and earth.
target: Dem kyaan joj dem uon kaaz, or rijres a rang, a bi oniebl; kaa dem laik kruo dem bitwiin evn an ort.

en: For even when fire falls upon the house of gods of wood overlaid with gold or with silver, their priests will flee away, and escape, but they themselves will be burned apart like beams.
target: Kaa iivn wen faiya faal pan di ous a ila dem a wud uovalie wid guol or wid silva, dem priis dem wi ron we, an eskiep, bot dem demself wi bon apaat laik biim dem.

en: Moreover they can’t withstand any king or enemies. How could a man then admit or think that they are gods?
target: Muuova dem kyaan widstan eni king or enimi dem. Ou a man den kuda admit or tingk dat dem a ila?

en: Those gods of wood overlaid with silver or with gold aren’t able to escape from thieves or robbers.
target: Dem ila de a wud uovalie wid silva or wid guol no iebl fi eskiep fram tiif dem or raba dem.

en: The gold, silver, and garments with which they are clothed—those who are strong will take from them, and go away with them. They won’t be able to help themselves.
target: Di guol, silva, an gaament dem we dem kluod wid—dem uu schrang wi tek fram dem, an go we wid dem. Dem no wi iebl fi elp demself.

en: Therefore it is better to be a king who shows his bravery, or else a vessel in a house profitable for whatever the owner needs, than such false gods—or even a door in a house, to keep the things safe that are in it, than such false gods; or better to be a pillar of wood in a palace than such false gods.
target: So it beta fi bi a king uu shuo im brievri, or els a vesl ina a ous prafitabl fi eniting di uona niid, dan soch faals ila dem—or iivn a duor ina a ous, fi kip di ting dem sief we de ina it, dan soch faals ila dem; or beta fi bi a pila a wud ina a palis dan soch faals ila dem.

en: For sun, moon, and stars, being bright and sent to do their jobs, are obedient.
target: Kaa son, muun, an staar dem, a bi brait an sen fi du dem jab dem, a uobiidient.

en: Likewise also the lightning when it flashes is beautiful to see. In the same way, the wind also blows in every country.
target: Laikwaiz tu di laitnin wen it flash byuutiful fi si. Ina di siem wie, di win tu bluo ina evri konchri.

en: And when God commands the clouds to go over the whole world, they do as they are told.
target: An wen Gad koman di kloud dem fi go uova di uol wol, dem du az dem tuol.

en: And the fire sent from above to consume mountains and woods does as it is commanded; but these are to be compared to them neither in show nor power.
target: An di faiya sen fram abov fi kansyuum mountn dem an wud dem du az it koman; bot dem ya a fi kompier tu dem niida ina shuo nor powa.

en: Therefore a man shouldn’t think or say that they are gods, seeing they aren’t able to judge causes or to do good to men.
target: So a man shudn tingk or se dat dem a ila, a si dem no iebl fi joj kaaz dem or fi du gud tu man dem.

en: Knowing therefore that they are no gods, don’t fear them.
target: A nuo so dat dem a no ila, no fier dem.

en: For they can neither curse nor bless kings.
target: Kaa dem kyaan niida kors nor bles king dem.

en: They can’t show signs in the heavens among the nations, or shine as the sun, or give light as the moon.
target: Dem kyaan shuo sain dem ina di evn dem mongks di nieshan dem, or shain az di son, or gi lait az di muun.

en: The beasts are better than they, for they can find shelter and help themselves.
target: Di biis dem beta dan dem, kaa dem kyaan fain shelta an elp demself.

en: In no way then is it manifest to us that they are gods. Therefore don’t fear them.
target: Ina no wie den it manifest tu wi dat dem a ila. So no fier dem.

en: For as a scarecrow in a garden of cucumbers that keeps nothing, so are their gods of wood overlaid with gold and silver.
target: Kaa az a skiekro ina a gaadn a kyukomba we kip notn, so a dem ila dem a wud uovalie wid guol an silva.

en: Likewise also their gods of wood overlaid with gold and with silver are like a white thorn in an orchard that every bird sits upon. They are also like a dead body that is thrown out into the dark.
target: Laikwaiz tu dem ila dem a wud uovalie wid guol an wid silva laik a wait taarn ina a aachad we evri bod sidong pan. Dem tu laik a ded badi we chruo out ina di daak.

en: You will know them to be no gods by the bright purple that rots upon them. They themselves will be consumed afterwards, and will be a reproach in the country.
target: Unu wi nuo dem fi bi no ila bai di brait porpl we rat pan dem. Dem demself wi kansyuum aftawod, an wi bi a riproach ina di konchri.

en: A righteous man who has no idols is better off, for he will be far from reproach.
target: A raichos man uu av no aidol beta aaf, kaa im wi faar fram riproach.

en: After Alexander the Macedonian, the son of Philip, who came out of the land of Chittim, and struck Darius king of the Persians and Medes, it came to pass, after he had struck him, that he reigned in his place, in former time, over Greece.
target: Afta Alekanda di Maseduoniyan, di son a Filip, we kom out a di lan a Kitim, an lik dong Daraiyos king a di Poerjan dem an di Miidz dem, i kom tu paas, afta im did lik im dong, se im ruul ina im plies, ina faama taim, uova Griis.

en: He fought many battles, won many strongholds, killed the kings of the earth,
target: Im fait nof bakl, win nof strangold, kil di king dem a di ort,

en: went through to the ends of the earth, and took spoils of a multitude of nations. The earth was quiet before him. He was exalted. His heart was lifted up.
target: an go chuu tu di enz a di ort, an tek spail fram a huol hiip a nieshan. Di ort ben kwaiyat bifuor im. Im get egzalt. Im aat get lif op.

en: He gathered together an exceedingly strong army and ruled over countries, nations, and principalities, and they paid him tribute.
target: Im gyada tugeda wan aami we strang uova tuu, an ruul uova konchri, nieshan, an prinsipaliti dem, an dem pie im chribiut.

en: After these things he fell sick, and perceived that he was going to die.
target: Afta dem ting ya im get sik, an si se im a go ded.

en: He called his honorable servants, which had been brought up with him from his youth, and he divided to them his kingdom while he was still alive.
target: Im kaal im sorvant dem we piipl anar, we did gro op wid im fram im yuut, an im divaid im kindom tu dem wail im stil alaiv.

en: Alexander reigned twelve years, then he died.
target: Alekanda ruul twelv ier, den im ded.

en: Then his servants ruled, each one in his place.
target: Den im sorvant dem ruul, evri wan ina im uon plies.

en: They all put crowns upon themselves after he was dead, and so did their sons after them many years; and they multiplied evils on the earth.
target: Dem aal put kroun pan demself afta im ded, an so dem son dem du afta dem fi nof ier; an dem moltplai iivl pan di ort.

en: There came out of them a sinful root, Antiochus Epiphanes, son of Antiochus the king, who had been a hostage at Rome, and he reigned in the one hundred thirty seventh year of the kingdom of the Greeks.
target: Out a dem kom wan sinful ruut, Antiokos Epifaniiz, son a Antiokos di king, we did bi wan astij a Ruom, an im ruul ina di wan onjred toti-sevnt ier a di kindom a di Griik dem.

en: In those days transgressors of the law came out of Israel and persuaded many, saying, “Let’s go make a covenant with the Gentiles around us; for since we were separated from them many evils have befallen us.”
target: Ina dem die de transgresa a di laa kom out a Izrel an posuied nof piipl, a se, “Mek wi go mek wan kovnant wid di Jentailz roun wi; kaa sens wi sepret fram dem, nof iivl kom pan wi.”

en: That proposal was good in their eyes.
target: Da prapuozal de luk gud ina dem ai.

en: Some of the people eagerly went to the king, and he authorized them to observe the ordinances of the Gentiles.
target: Som a di piipl iiga go tu di king, an im gi dem permishan fi fala di aadinans dem a di Jentailz.

en: So they built a gymnasium in Jerusalem according to the laws of the Gentiles.
target: So dem bil wan jimnieziom ina Jeruusalem akadin tu di laa dem a di Jentailz.

en: They made themselves uncircumcised, forsook the holy covenant, joined themselves to the Gentiles, and sold themselves to do evil.
target: Dem mek demself no sorkomsaiz, lef di uoli kovnant, jain demself tu di Jentailz, an sel demself fi du iivl.

en: The kingdom was established in the sight of Antiochus, and he planned to reign over Egypt, that he might reign over both kingdoms.
target: Di kindom set op gud ina Antiokos sait, an im plan fi ruul uova Iijipt, so im mait ruul uova buot kindom.

en: He entered into Egypt with a great multitude, with chariots, with elephants, with cavalry, and with a great navy.
target: Im go ina Iijipt wid wan big-big kroud, wid chariot, wid elifant, wid aasman, an wid wan big nievi.

en: He made war against Ptolemy king of Egypt. Ptolemy was put to shame before him, and fled; and many fell wounded to death.
target: Im mek waar gens Tolimi king a Iijipt. Tolimi get shiem bifuor im, an ron we; an nof piipl fell, wuund til dem ded.

en: They took possession of the strong cities in the land of Egypt, and he took the spoils of Egypt.
target: Dem tek pozeshan a di strang siti dem ina di lan a Iijipt, an im tek di spail a Iijipt.

en: Antiochus, after he had defeated Egypt, returned in the one hundred forty third year, and went up against Israel and Jerusalem with a great multitude,
target: Antiokos, afta im did difiit Iijipt, kom bak ina di wan onjred faati-tord ier, an go op gens Izrel an Jeruusalem wid wan big-big kroud,

en: and entered presumptuously into the sanctuary, and took the golden altar, the lampstand for the light, and all its utensils.
target: an go ina di sangchueri wid presomshan, an tek di guolin aalta, di lampstan fi di lait, an aal a im yuutensil dem.

en: He took the table of the show bread, the cups for the drink offerings, the bowls, the golden censers, the veil, the crowns, and the gold decoration on the front of the temple. He peeled it all off.
target: Im tek di tiebl a di shuo-bred, di kop dem fi di jringk aafrin dem, di buol dem, di guolin sensa dem, di viel, di kroun dem, an di guol dekarieshan pan di front a di templ. Im piil i aal aaf.

en: He took the silver, the gold, and the precious vessels. He took the hidden treasures which he found.
target: Im tek di silva, di guol, an di preshos vesl dem. Im tek di aid-we chrezha dem we im fain.

en: When he had taken all of these, he went away into his own land. He made a great slaughter, and spoke very arrogantly.
target: Wen im tek aal a dem ya, im go we ina im uon lan. Im mek wan big slaata, an taak muor dan arogant.

en: Great mourning came upon Israel, in every place where they were.
target: Big muornin kom pan Izrel, ina evri plies we dem de.

en: The rulers and elders groaned. The virgins and young men were made feeble. The beauty of the women was changed.
target: Di ruula dem an elda dem gruon. Di vorjin dem an di yong man dem mek fiibl. Di byuuti a di uman dem chienj.

en: Every bridegroom took up lamentation. She who sat in the marriage chamber was mourning.
target: Evri braigruum tek op lamentieshan. Shi we sidong ina di marid chiemba ben a muorn.

en: The land was moved for its inhabitants, and all the house of Jacob was clothed with shame.
target: Di lan muuv fi di piipl dem we liv ina i, an aal di ous a Jiekob wier shiem laik klot.

en: After two full years, the king sent a chief collector of tribute to the cities of Judah, and he came to Jerusalem with a great multitude.
target: Afta tuu ful ier, di king sen wan chiif kalekta a chribiut tu di siti dem a Juuda, an im kom tu Jeruusalem wid wan big-big kroud.

en: He spoke words of peace to them in subtlety, and they believed him. Then he fell upon the city suddenly, struck it very severely, and destroyed many people of Israel.
target: Im taak wod a piis tu dem wid sotl trik, an dem biliiv im. Den im fell pan di siti sodnli, lik i aad-aad, an dischrai nof piipl a Izrel.

en: He took the spoils of the city, set it on fire, and pulled down its houses and its walls on every side.
target: Im tek di spail a di siti, set i pan faiya, an pul dong im ous dem an im waal dem pan evri said.

en: They led captive the women and the children, and seized the livestock.
target: Dem liid di uman dem an di pikni dem we kiaptiv, an siiz di laivstak.

en: Then they fortified the city of David with a large, strong wall and with strong towers, and it became their citadel.
target: Den dem faatifi di siti a Dievid wid wan laaj, strang waal an wid strang towa dem, an i kom fi bi dem sitadel.

en: They put a sinful nation, transgressors of the law, there, and they strengthened themselves in it.
target: Dem put wan sinful nieshan, transgresa a di laa, de, an dem mek demself strang ina i.

en: They stored up weapons and food, and gathering together the spoils of Jerusalem, they stored them there, and they became a great menace.
target: Dem stuor op wepan an fuud, an gyada tugeda di spail a Jeruusalem, dem stuor dem de, an dem kom fi bi wan big danja.

en: It became a place to lie in wait against the sanctuary, and an evil adversary to Israel continually.
target: I kom fi bi wan plies fi lai ina wiet gens di sangchueri, an wan iivl enimi tu Izrel aal di taim.

en: They shed innocent blood on every side of the sanctuary, and defiled the sanctuary.
target: Dem shed inosent blod pan evri said a di sangchueri, an difail di sangchueri.

en: The inhabitants of Jerusalem fled because of them. She became a dwelling place of foreigners. She became foreign to those who were born in her, and her children forsook her.
target: Di piipl dem we liv a Jeruusalem ron we bikaaz a dem. Shi kom fi bi wan dwelin plies fi farina dem. Shi kom farin tu dem we baan ina ar, an ar pikni dem lef ar.

en: Her sanctuary was laid waste like a wilderness, her feasts were turned into mourning, her Sabbaths into reproach, and her honor into contempt.
target: Ar sangchueri laid wies laik wan wildanis, ar fiis dem ton ina muornin, ar Sabat dem ina ripruoch, an ar ana ina kontempt.

en: According to her glory, so was her dishonor multiplied, and her exaltation was turned into mourning.
target: Akaadin tu ar gluori, so ar disana moltplai, an ar egzaltieshan ton ina muornin.

en: King Antiochus wrote to his whole kingdom that all should be one people,
target: King Antiokos ruot tu im huol kindom se aal fi bi wan piipl,

en: and that each should forsake his own laws. All the nations agreed according to the word of the king.
target: an se evri wan fi lef im uon laa dem. Aal di nieshan dem agrii akadin tu di wod a di king.

en: Many of Israel consented to his worship, sacrificed to the idols, and profaned the Sabbath.
target: Nof a Izrel konsent tu im worsip, sakrifais tu di aidol dem, an profien di Sabat.

en: The king sent letters by the hand of messengers to Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, that they should follow laws strange to the land,
target: Di king sen leta bai di an a mesenja dem tu Jeruusalem an di siti dem a Juuda, se dem fi fala laa we chrienj tu di lan,

en: and should forbid whole burnt offerings and sacrifice and drink offerings in the sanctuary; and should profane the Sabbaths and feasts,
target: an fi faabid huol bon aafrin an sakrifais an jringk aafrin ina di sangchueri; an fi profien di Sabat dem an fiis dem,

en: and defile the sanctuary and those who were holy;
target: an difail di sangchueri an dem we uoli;

en: that they should build altars, and temples, and shrines for idols, and should sacrifice swine’s flesh and unclean animals;
target: se dem fi bil aalta, an templ, an shrain fi aidol, an fi sakrifais swain flesh an onkliin animal dem;

en: and that they should leave their sons uncircumcised, that they should make their souls detestable with all manner of uncleanness and profanation;
target: an se dem fi lef dem son dem no sorkomsaiz, se dem fi mek dem suol detestabl wid aal kain a onkliinnis an profenieshan;

en: so that they might forget the law, and change all the ordinances.
target: so se dem mait faget di laa, an chienj aal di aadinans dem.

en: Whoever doesn’t do according to the word of the king, he will die.
target: Enibadi we no du akadin tu di wod a di king, im wi ded.

en: He wrote according to all these words to his whole kingdom. He appointed overseers over all the people, and he commanded the cities of Judah to sacrifice, city by city.
target: Im ruot akadin tu aal dem wod ya tu im huol kindom. Im apaint uovasiia dem uova aal di piipl, an im komaan di siti dem a Juuda fi sakrifais, siti bai siti.

en: From the people were gathered together to them many, everyone who had forsaken the law; and they did evil things in the land.
target: Fram di piipl, nof gyada tugeda tu dem, evri wan we did lef di laa; an dem du iivl ting ina di lan.

en: They made Israel to hide themselves in every place of refuge which they had.
target: Dem mek Izrel aid demself ina evri plies a refyuuj we dem did av.

en: On the fifteenth day of Chislev, in the one hundred forty fifth year, they built a detestable thing of desolation upon the altar, and in the cities of Judah on every side they built idol altars.
target: Pan di fiftiint die a Kislev, ina di wan onjred faati-fift ier, dem bil wan detestabl ting a desolieshan pan di aalta, an ina di siti dem a Juuda pan evri said dem bil aidol aalta.

en: At the doors of the houses and in the streets they burned incense.
target: A di duor dem a di ous dem an ina di schriit dem dem bon insens.

en: They tore the books of the law which they found in pieces and set them on fire.
target: Dem tier di buk dem a di laa we dem fain ina piis-piis an set dem pan faiya.

en: Anyone who was found with any a book of the covenant, and if any consented to the law, the king’s sentence delivered him to death.
target: Enibadi we dem fain wid wan buk a di kovnant, an ef enibadi konsent tu di laa, di king sentans diliva im tu det.

en: Thus did they in their might to Israel, to those who were found month by month in the cities.
target: So dem du ina dem mait tu Izrel, tu dem we dem fain mont bai mont ina di siti dem.

en: On the twenty-fifth day of the month they sacrificed upon the idol altar that was on top of the altar of burnt offering.
target: Pan di twenti-fift die a di mont dem sakrifais pan di aidol aalta we ben pan tap a di aalta a bon aafrin.

en: They put to death women who had circumcised their children, according to the commandment.
target: Dem put tu det uman we did sorkomsaiz dem pikni, akadin tu di komaanment.

en: They hung their babies around their necks, and their houses, and those who had circumcised them.
target: Dem ang dem biebi dem roun dem nek, an dem ous dem, an dem we did sorkomsaiz dem.

en: Many in Israel were fully resolved and confirmed in themselves not to eat unclean things.
target: Nof ina Izrel did fuli rizaalv an konfaarm ina demself no fi iit onkliin ting.

en: They chose to die, that they might not be defiled with the food, and that they might not profane the holy covenant; and they died.
target: Dem chuuz fi ded, so dem mait no get difail wid di fuud, an so dem mait no profien di uoli kovnant; an dem ded.

en: Exceedingly great wrath came upon Israel.
target: Raat kom pan Izrel big uova tuu.

en: In those days Mattathias the son of John, the son of Simeon, a priest of the sons of Joarib, from Jerusalem rose up; and he lived at Modin.
target: Ina dem die de Matataias di son a Jan, di son a Simion, wan priis a di son dem a Juoarib, fram Jeruusalem, raiz op; an im liv a Muodin.

en: And he had five sons: John, who was surnamed Gaddis;
target: An im did av faiv son: Jan, we dem did kaal Gyadis;

en: Simon, who was called Thassi;
target: Saiman, we dem did kaal Tasi;

en: Judas, who was called Maccabaeus;
target: Juudas, we dem did kaal Makabius;

en: Eleazar, who was called Avaran; and Jonathan, who was called Apphus.
target: Eliaza, we dem did kaal Avaran; an Jonatan, we dem did kaal Afos.

en: He saw the blasphemies that were committed in Judah and in Jerusalem,
target: Im si di blasfemi dem we dem komit ina Juuda an ina Jeruusalem,
