en: and he said, “Woe is me! Why was I born to see the destruction of my people and the destruction of the holy city, and to dwell there when it was given into the hand of the enemy, the sanctuary into the hand of foreigners?
target: an im se, “Wuo iz mi! Wa mek mi baan fi si di dischrokshan a mi piipl an di dischrokshan a di uoli siti, an fi dwel de wen i gi ina di an a di enimi, di sangchueri ina di an a farina dem?

en: Her temple has become like a man who was glorious.
target: Ar templ kom laik wan man we did gluorios.

en: Her vessels of glory are carried away into captivity. Her infants are slain in her streets. Her young men are slain with the enemy’s sword.
target: Ar vesl dem a gluori kyari we ina kiaptiviti. Ar biebi dem slie ina ar schriit dem. Ar yong man dem slie wid di enimi suod.

en: What nation has not inherited her palaces and taken possession of her spoils?
target: Wat nieshan no inherit ar palis dem an tek pozeshan a ar spail dem?

en: Her adornment has all been taken away. Instead of a free woman, she has become a slave.
target: Ar adoanment aal tek we. Insted a wan frii uman, shi kom wan sliev.

en: See, our holy things, our beauty, and our glory are laid waste. The Gentiles have profaned them.
target: Si, wi uoli ting dem, wi byuuti, an wi gluori laid wies. Di Jentailz profien dem.

en: Why should we live any longer?”
target: Wa mek wi fi liv eni langga?”

en: Mattathias and his sons tore their clothes, put on sackcloth, and mourned exceedingly.
target: Matataias an im son dem tier dem kluoz, put aan sakklaat, an muorn big uova tuu.

en: And the king’s officers who were enforcing the apostasy came into the city Modin to sacrifice.
target: An di king afisa dem we ben a enfuos di apastasi kom ina di siti Muodin fi sakrifais.

en: Many of Israel came to them, and Mattathias and his sons were gathered together.
target: Nof a Izrel kom tu dem, an Matataias an im son dem gyada tugeda.

en: The king’s officers answered and spoke to Mattathias, saying, “You are a ruler and an honorable and great man in this city, and strengthened with sons and brothers.
target: Di king afisa dem ansa an taak tu Matataias, a se, “Yu a wan ruula an wan man we piipl anar an big ina dis siti, an strang wid son dem an breda dem.

en: Now therefore come first and do the commandment of the king, as all the nations have done, including the men of Judah and those who remain in Jerusalem. You and your house will be numbered among the king’s friends, and you and your sons will be honored with silver and gold and many gifts.”
target: Nou so kom fos an du di komaanment a di king, laik aal di nieshan dem du, inkluudin di man dem a Juuda an dem we rimien ina Jeruusalem. Yu an yu ous wi get nomba mongx di king fren dem, an yu an yu son dem wi get ana wid silva an guol an nof gif.”

en: And Mattathias answered and said with a loud voice, “If all the nations that are in the house of the king’s dominion listen to him, to fall away each one from the worship of his fathers, and have chosen to follow his commandments,
target: An Matataias ansa an se wid wan loud vais, “Ef aal di nieshan dem we de ina di ous a di king dominion lisn tu im, fi falo we evri wan fram di worsip a im faada dem, an chuuz fi fala im komaanment dem,

en: yet I and my sons and my brothers will walk in the covenant of our fathers.
target: yet mi an mi son dem an mi breda dem wi waak ina di kovnant a wi faada dem.

en: Far be it from us that we should forsake the law and the ordinances.
target: Faar i fram wi se wi fi lef di laa an di aadinans dem.

en: We will not listen to the king’s words, to turn aside from our worship, to the right hand, or to the left.”
target: Wi naa go lisn tu di king wod dem, fi ton asaida fram wi worsip, tu di rait an, ar tu di lef.”

en: When he had finished speaking these words, a Jew came in the sight of all to sacrifice on the altar which was at Modin, according to the king’s commandment.
target: Wen im don taak dem wod ya, wan Juu kom ina di sait a aal fi sakrifais pan di aalta we ben a Muodin, akadin tu di king komaanment.

en: Mattathias saw it, so his zeal was kindled, and his guts trembled, and he vented his wrath according to judgment, and ran and killed him upon the altar.
target: Matataias si i, so im ziil kindl, an im gots chrembl, an im vent im raat akadin tu jojment, an ron an kil im pan di aalta.

en: He killed the king’s officer, who compelled men to sacrifice, at the same time, and pulled down the altar.
target: Im kil di king afisa, we did kompel man dem fi sakrifais, a di siem taim, an pul dong di aalta.

en: He was zealous for the law, even as Phinehas did to Zimri the son of Salu.
target: Im ben ziilos fi di laa, jos laik Finias du tu Zimrai di son a Saalu.

en: Mattathias cried out in the city with a loud voice, saying, “Whoever is zealous for the law and maintains the covenant, let him follow me!”
target: Matataias krai out ina di siti wid wan loud vais, a se, “Enibadi we ziilos fi di laa an mientien di kovnant, mek im fala mi!”

en: He and his sons fled into the mountains, and left all that they had in the city.
target: Im an im son dem ron we ina di mountin dem, an lef aal we dem did av ina di siti.

en: Then many who sought justice and judgment went down into the wilderness to live there—
target: Den nof we did siik jostis an jojment go dong ina di wildanis fi liv de—

en: they, their children, their wives, and their livestock—because evils were multiplied upon them.
target: dem, dem pikni, dem waif, an dem laivstak—bikaaz iivl dem moltplai pan dem.

en: It was told to the king’s officers and the forces that were in Jerusalem, the city of David, that certain men who had broken the king’s commandment had gone down into the secret places in the wilderness;
target: I get tuol tu di king afisa dem an di fuos dem we ben ina Jeruusalem, di siti a Dievid, se som man we did brok di king komaanment go dong ina di siikret plies dem ina di wildanis;

en: and many pursued after them, and having overtaken them, they encamped against them and set the battle in array against them on the Sabbath day.
target: an nof posyuu afta dem, an wen dem uovatiek dem, dem kiamp gens dem an set di bakl ina arie gens dem pan di Sabat die.

en: They said to them, “Enough of this! Come out and do according to the word of the king, and you will all live!”
target: Dem se tu dem, “Inof a dis! Kom out an du akadin tu di wod a di king, an unu aal wi liv!”

en: They said, “We won’t come out. We won’t do the word of the king, to profane the Sabbath day.”
target: Dem se, “Wi naa go kom out. Wi naa go du di wod a di king, fi profien di Sabat die.”

en: Then the enemy hurried to attack them.
target: Den di enimi ori fi atak dem.

en: They didn’t answer them. They didn’t cast a stone at them, or block their secret places,
target: Dem no ansa dem. Dem no chuo wan stuon a dem, ar blak dem siikret plies dem,

en: saying, “Let’s all die in our innocence. Heaven and earth testify for us, that you put us to death unjustly.”
target: a se, “Mek wi aal ded ina wi inosens. Evn an ort testifai fi wi, se unu put wi tu det onjostli.”

en: So they attacked them on the Sabbath, and they died—they, their wives, their children, and their livestock—in number a thousand people of men.
target: So dem atak dem pan di Sabat, an dem ded—dem, dem waif, dem pikni, an dem laivstak—ina nomba wan touzn piipl a man.

en: When Mattathias and his friends found out about it, they mourned over them exceedingly.
target: Wen Matataias an im fren dem fain out bout i, dem muorn uova dem big uova tuu.

en: One said to another, “If we all do as our brothers have done, and don’t fight against the Gentiles for our lives and our ordinances, they will quickly destroy us from off the earth.”
target: Wan se tu wan neda, “Ef wi aal du laik wi breda dem du, an no fait gens di Jentailz fi wi laif an wi aadinans dem, dem wi kwikli dischrai wi fram aaf di ort.”

en: So they decided that day, saying, “Whoever comes against us to battle on the Sabbath day, let’s fight against him, and we will in no way all die, as our brothers died in the secret places.”
target: So dem disaid da die de, a se, “Enibadi we kom gens wi fi bakl pan di Sabat die, mek wi fait gens im, an wi naa go aal ded, laik wi breda dem ded ina di siikret plies dem.”

en: Then a company of the Hasidaeans, mighty men of Israel, everyone who offered himself willingly for the law, were gathered together to them.
target: Den wan kompani a di Asidiyan dem, maiti man a Izrel, evri wan we aafa imself wilinli fi di laa, gyada tugeda tu dem.

en: All those who fled from the evils were added to them, and supported them.
target: Aal dem we ron we fram di iivl dem ad tu dem, an sopuot dem.

en: They mustered an army, and struck sinners in their anger, and lawless men in their wrath. The rest fled to the Gentiles for safety.
target: Dem mosta wan aami, an lik sina dem ina dem angga, an laalis man dem ina dem raat. Di res ron we tu di Jentailz fi siefi.

en: And Mattathias and his friends went around and pulled down the altars.
target: An Matataias an im fren dem go roun an pul dong di aalta dem.

en: They forcibly circumcised the boys who were uncircumcised, as many as they found in the borders of Israel.
target: Dem sorkomsaiz bai fuos di bwai dem we no sorkomsaiz, az nof az dem fain ina di baada dem a Izrel.

en: They pursued the arrogant, and the work prospered in their hand.
target: Dem posyuu di arogant dem, an di wok prasper ina dem an.

en: They rescued the law out of the hand of the Gentiles and out of the hand of the kings. They never allowed the sinner to triumph.
target: Dem reskyu di laa out a di an a di Jentailz an out a di an a di king dem. Dem neva lou di sina fi chraiomf.

en: The days of Mattathias drew near that he should die, and he said to his sons, “Now pride and scorn have gained strength. It is a season of overthrow and indignant wrath.
target: Di die dem a Matataias jraa nier se im fi ded, an im se tu im son dem, “Nou praid an skaarn get chrent. I a wan siizn a uovachuo an indignan raat.

en: Now, my children, be zealous for the law, and give your lives for the covenant of your fathers.
target: Nou, mi pikni dem, bi ziilos fi di laa, an gi unu laif fi di kovnant a unu faada dem.

en: Call to remembrance the deeds of our fathers which they did in their generations; and receive great glory and an everlasting name.
target: Kaal tu rimembrans di diid dem a wi faada dem we dem du ina dem jenarieshan; an risiiv big gluori an wan evalaastin niem.

en: Wasn’t Abraham found faithful in temptation, and it was reckoned to him for righteousness?
target: Iebraham no fain fietful ina temptieshan, an i rekna tu im fi raichosnis?

en: Joseph in the time of his distress kept the commandment, and became lord of Egypt.
target: Juozif ina di taim a im dischres kip di komaanment, an kom uona a Iijipt.

en: Phinehas our father, because he was exceedingly zealous, obtained the covenant of an everlasting priesthood.
target: Finias wi faada, bikaaz im ben ziilos uova tuu, abtien di kovnant a wan evalaastin priisud.

en: Joshua became a judge in Israel for fulfilling the word.
target: Jashua kom wan joj ina Izrel fi fulfilin di wod.

en: Caleb obtained a heritage in the land for testifying in the congregation.
target: Kielib abtien wan eritaj ina di lan fi testifaiin ina di kanggrigieshan.

en: David inherited the throne of a kingdom forever and ever for being merciful.
target: Dievid inherit di chuon a wan kindom far eva an eva fi biin mersiful.

en: Elijah was taken up into heaven because he was exceedingly zealous for the law.
target: Iilaija get tek op ina evn bikaaz im ben ziilos uova tuu fi di laa.

en: Hananiah, Azariah, and Mishael believed, and were saved out of the flame.
target: Ananaiya, Azaraiya, an Mishayel biliiv, an get siev out a di fliem.

en: Daniel was delivered from the mouth of lions for his innocence.
target: Danyel get diliva fram di mout a laiyan dem fi im inosens.

en: “Thus consider from generation to generation that no one who put their trust in him will lack for strength.
target: “Jos so konsida fram jenarieshan tu jenarieshan se nobadi we put dem chros ina im wi lak fi chrent.

en: Don’t be afraid of the words of a sinful man; for his glory will be dung and worms.
target: No fried fi di wod dem a wan sinful man; kaa im gluori wi bi dong an worm.

en: Today he will be lifted up, and tomorrow he will in no way be found, because he has returned to dust, and his thought has perished.
target: Tide im wi get lif op, an tumaro im naa go fain eni wie, bikaaz im ton bak tu dos, an im taat don perish.

en: You, my children, be strong, and show yourselves men on behalf of the law; for in it you will obtain glory.
target: Unu, mi pikni dem, bi strang, an shuo unuself man pan biyaaf a di laa; kaa ina i unu wi abtien gluori.

en: See, Simon your brother, whom I know to be a man of counsel. Always listen to him. He will be a father to you.
target: Si, Saiman unu breda, we mi nuo fi bi wan man a kounsl. Aalwiez lisn tu im. Im wi bi wan faada tu unu.

en: Judas Maccabaeus has been strong and mighty from his youth. He will be your captain and will fight the battle of the people.
target: Juudas Makabius ben strang an maiti fram im yuut. Im wi bi unu kiaptin an wi fait di bakl a di piipl.

en: Gather to yourselves all the doers of the law, and avenge the wrong done to your people.
target: Gyada tu unuself aal di duer dem a di laa, an avenj di rang we dem du tu unu piipl.

en: Repay the Gentiles, and obey the commandments of the law.”
target: Ripie di Jentailz, an obie di komaanment dem a di laa.”

en: He blessed them, and was gathered to his ancestors.
target: Im bles dem, an gyada tu im ansesta dem.

en: He died in the one hundred forty sixth year, and his sons buried him in the tombs of his ancestors at Modin. All Israel made great lamentation for him.
target: Im ded ina di wan onjred faati-sikst ier, an im son dem beri im ina di tuum dem a im ansesta dem a Muodin. Aal Izrel mek big lamentieshan fi im.

en: His son Judas, who was called Maccabaeus, rose up in his place.
target: Im son Juudas, we dem did kaal Makabius, raiz op ina im plies.

en: All his brothers helped him, and so did all those who joined with his father, and they fought with gladness the battle of Israel.
target: Aal im breda dem elp im, an so du aal dem we jain wid im faada, an dem fait wid gladnis di bakl a Izrel.

en: He got his people great glory, and put on a breastplate like a giant, and bound his warlike harness around him, and set battles in array, protecting the army with his sword.
target: Im get im piipl big gluori, an put aan wan brespliet laik wan jaiyant, an bain im waar-laik aanis roun im, an set bakl ina arie, a protek di aami wid im suod.

en: He was like a lion in his deeds, and like a lion’s cub roaring for prey.
target: Im ben laik wan laiyan ina im diid dem, an laik wan laiyan kob a ruor fi prie.

en: He hunted and pursued the lawless, and he burned up those who troubled his people.
target: Im ont an posyuu di laalis dem, an im bon op dem we chrobl im piipl.

en: The lawless shrunk back for fear of him, and all the workers of lawlessness were very troubled, and deliverance prospered in his hand.
target: Di laalis dem shrink bak fi fieri a im, an aal di woka dem a laalisnis get chrobl bad, an dilivarans prasper ina im an.

en: He angered many kings and made Jacob glad with his acts. His memory is blessed forever.
target: Im angga nof king an mek Jiekob glad wid im ak dem. Im memori bles far eva.

en: He went through the cities of Judah, destroyed the ungodly out of the land, and turned away wrath from Israel.
target: Im go chuu di siti dem a Juuda, dischrai di ongadli dem out a di lan, an ton we raat fram Izrel.

en: He was renowned to the utmost part of the earth. He gathered together those who were ready to perish.
target: Im get rinuon tu di faris paat a di ort. Im gyada tugeda dem we ben redi fi perish.

en: Apollonius gathered the Gentiles together with a great army from Samaria to fight against Israel.
target: Apoluonios gyada di Jentailz tugeda wid wan big aami fram Samieriya fi fait gens Izrel.

en: Judas learned of it, and he went out to meet him, struck him, and killed him. Many fell wounded to death, and the rest fled.
target: Juudas lorn a i, an im go out fi miit im, lik im, an kil im. Nof fell, wuund til dem ded, an di res ron we.

en: They took their spoils, and Judas took Apollonius’ sword, and he fought with it all his days.
target: Dem tek dem spail, an Juudas tek Apoluonios suod, an im fait wid i aal im die dem.

en: Seron, the commander of the army of Syria, heard that Judas had gathered a large company, including a body of faithful men who stayed with him, went out to war.
target: Siiron, di komanda a di aami a Siiriya, ier se Juudas gyada wan laaj kompani, inkluudin wan badi a fietful man we tan wid im, an go out tu waar.

en: He said, “I will make myself a name and get myself glory in the kingdom. I will fight against Judas and those who are with him, who despise the king’s command.
target: Im se, “Mi wi mek miself wan niem an get miself gluori ina di kindom. Mi wi fait gens Juudas an dem we de wid im, we despais di king komaanment.

en: A mighty army of the ungodly went up with him to help him, to take vengeance on the children of Israel.
target: Wan maiti aami a di ongadli dem go op wid im fi elp im, fi tek venjans pan di pikni dem a Izrel.

en: He came near to the ascent of Bethhoron, and Judas went out to meet him with a small company.
target: Im kom nier tu di asent a Betuoran, an Juudas go out fi miit im wid wan smol kompani.

en: But when they saw the army coming to meet them, they said to Judas, “What? Will we be able, being a small company, to fight against so great and strong a multitude? We for our part are faint, having tasted no food this day.”
target: Bot wen dem si di aami a kom fi miit dem, dem se tu Juudas, “Wa? Wi wi ebl, a bi wan smol kompani, fi fait gens so big an strang a moltityuud? Wi fi wi paat fient, kaa wi no ties no fuud tide.”

en: Judas said, “It is an easy thing for many to be hemmed in by the hands of a few. Before the God of heaven it makes no difference, to save by many or by few;
target: Juudas se, “I a wan iizi ting fi nof fi get em in bai di an dem a fyuu. Bifuor di Gad a evn i no mek no difrans, fi siev bai nof ar bai fyuu;

en: for victory in battle stands not in the multitude of an army, but strength is from heaven.
target: kaa viktri ina bakl no tan pan di moltityuud a wan aami, bot chrent a fram evn.

en: They come to us in fullness of insolence and lawlessness, to destroy us and our wives and our children, and to plunder us,
target: Dem kom tu wi ina fulnis a insulens an laalisnis, fi dischrai wi an wi waif dem an wi pikni dem, an fi plonda wi,

en: but we fight for our lives and our laws.
target: bot wi fait fi wi laif an wi laa dem.

en: He himself will crush them before our face; but as for you, don’t be afraid of them.
target: Imself wi krosh dem bifuor wi fies; bot az fi unu, no fried fi dem.

en: Now when he had finished speaking, he rushed suddenly against Seron and his army, and they were defeated before him.
target: Nou wen im don taak, im rosh sodnli gens Siiron an im aami, an dem get difiit bifuor im.

en: They pursued them down the descent of Bethhoron to the plain, and about eight hundred men of them fell; but the rest fled into the land of the Philistines.
target: Dem posyuu dem dong di disent a Betuoran tu di plien, an bout iet onjred man a dem fell; bot di res ron we ina di lan a di Filistain dem.

en: The fear of Judas and his brothers, and the dread of them, began to fall on the nations around them.
target: Di fieri a Juudas an im breda dem, an di jred a dem, bigin fi faal pan di nieshan dem roun dem.

en: His fame reached the king, and every nation told of the battles of Judas.
target: Im fiem riich di king, an evri nieshan tuol a di bakl dem a Juudas.

en: But when King Antiochus heard these words, he was full of indignation; and he sent and gathered together all the forces of his realm, an exceedingly strong army.
target: Bot wen King Antiokos ier dem wod ya, im ful a indignieshan; an im sen an gyada tugeda aal di fuos dem a im relm, wan aami we strang uova tuu.

en: He opened his treasury and gave his forces pay for a year, and commanded them to be ready for every need.
target: Im uopm im chrezhari an gi im fuos dem pie fi wan ier, an komaan dem fi bi redi fi evri niid.

en: He saw that the money was gone from his treasures, and that the tributes of the country were small, because of the dissension and disaster which he had brought upon the land, to the end that he might take away the laws which had been from the first days.
target: Im si se di moni don fram im chrezha dem, an se di chribiut dem a di konchri smol, bikaaz a di disenshan an dizaasta we im did bring pan di lan, tu di en se im mait tek we di laa dem we ben de fram di fos die dem.

en: He was afraid that he wouldn’t have enough as at other times for the charges and the gifts which he used to give with a liberal hand, more abundantly than the kings who were before him.
target: Im fried se im naa go av inof az a ada taim dem fi di chaaj dem an di gif dem we im yuus tu gi wid wan libaral an, muor abundanli dan di king dem we ben bifuor im.

en: And he was exceedingly perplexed in his mind, and he determined to go into Persia, and to take the tributes of those countries, and to gather much money.
target: An im get dairekli perplex ina im main, an im ditoermin fi go ina Poerja, an fi tek di chribiut dem a dem konchri de, an fi gyada nof moni.

en: He left Lysias, an honorable man, and one of royal lineage, to be over the affairs of the king from the river Euphrates to the borders of Egypt,
target: Im lef Lisias, wan man we piipl anar, an wan a raayal linij, fi de uova di afier dem a di king fram di riva Yuufrietiz tu di baada dem a Iijipt,

en: and to bring up his son Antiochus, until he came again.
target: an fi bring op im son Antiokos, til im kom agen.

en: He delivered to Lysias half of his forces and the elephants, and gave him charge of all the things that he would have done, and concerning those who lived in Judea and in Jerusalem,
target: Im diliva tu Lisias aaf a im fuos dem an di elifant dem, an gi im chaaj a aal di ting dem we im wud av du, an konsornin dem we liv ina Juudia an ina Jeruusalem,

en: that he should send an army against them to root out and destroy the strength of Israel and the remnant of Jerusalem, and to take away their memory from the place,
target: se im fi sen wan aami gens dem fi ruut out an dischrai di chrent a Izrel an di remnant a Jeruusalem, an fi tek we dem memori fram di plies,

en: and that he should make foreigners live in all their territory, and should divide their land to them by lot.
target: an se im fi mek farina dem liv ina aal dem teritari, an fi divaid dem lan tu dem bai lat.

en: The king took the half that remained of the forces, and left Antioch, his royal city, in the one hundred forty seventh year; and he passed over the river Euphrates, and went through the upper countries.
target: Di king tek di aaf we rimien a di fuos dem, an lef Antiok, im raayal siti, ina di wan onjred faati-sevnt ier; an im paas uova di riva Yuufrietiz, an go chuu di opa konchri dem.

en: Lysias chose Ptolemy the son of Dorymenes, Nicanor, and Gorgias, mighty men of the king’s friends;
target: Lisias chuuz Tolimi di son a Dorimeniz, Nikanor, an Gaagias, maiti man a di king fren dem;

en: and with them, he sent forty thousand infantry and seven thousand cavalry to go into the land of Judah and to destroy it, according to the word of the king.
target: an wid dem, im sen faati touzn infantri an sevn touzn aasman fi go ina di lan a Juuda an fi dischrai i, akadin tu di wod a di king.

en: They set out with all their army, and came and encamped near Emmaus in the plain country.
target: Dem set out wid aal dem aami, an kom an kiamp nier Emeyos ina di plien konchri.

en: The merchants of the country heard of their fame, and took silver and gold in large quantities, and iron chains, and came into the camp to take the children of Israel for slaves. Forces of Syria and of the land of the Philistines joined with them.
target: Di morchant dem a di konchri ier a dem fiem, an tek silva an guol ina laaj kwantiti, an aiyan chien, an kom ina di kiamp fi tek di pikni dem a Izrel fi sliev. Fuos a Siiriya an a di lan a di Filistain dem jain wid dem.

en: Judas and his brothers saw that evils were multiplied, and that the forces were encamping in their borders. They learned about the king’s words which he had commanded, to destroy the people and make an end of them.
target: Juudas an im breda dem si se iivl dem moltplai, an se di fuos dem a kiamp ina dem baada dem. Dem lorn bout di king wod dem we im did komaan, fi dischrai di piipl an mek wan en a dem.

en: Then they each said to his neighbor, “Let’s repair the ruins of our people. Let’s fight for our people and the holy place.”
target: Den dem iich se tu im nieba, “Mek wi ripier di ruin dem a wi piipl. Mek wi fait fi wi piipl an di uoli plies.”

en: The congregation was gathered together, that they might be ready for battle, and that they might pray and ask for mercy and compassion.
target: Di kanggrigieshan gyada tugeda, se dem mait bi redi fi bakl, an se dem mait prie an aks fi mersi an kompashan.

en: Jerusalem was without inhabitant like a wilderness. There was none of her offspring who went in or went out. The sanctuary was trampled down. Children of foreigners were in the citadel. The Gentiles lived there. Joy was taken away from Jacob, and the pipe and the harp ceased.
target: Jeruusalem ben widout inhabitant laik wan wildanis. Non a ar aafspring no de we go in ar go out. Di sangchueri chrampl dong. Pikni a farina dem ben ina di sitadel. Di Jentailz liv de. Jai tek we fram Jiekob, an di paip an di aap don.

en: They gathered themselves together, and came to Mizpeh, near Jerusalem; for in Mizpeh there used to be a place of prayer for Israel.
target: Dem gyada demself tugeda, an kom tu Mizpa, nier Jeruusalem; kaa ina Mizpa yuus tu bi wan plies a prier fi Izrel.

en: They fasted that day, put on sackcloth, put ashes on their heads, tore their clothes,
target: Dem faas da die de, put aan sakklaat, put ashiz pan dem ed, tier dem kluoz,

en: and opened the book of the law, to learn about the things for which the Gentiles consulted the images of their idols.
target: an uopm di buk a di laa, fi lorn bout di ting dem we di Jentailz did konsolt di imij dem a dem aidol bout.

en: They brought the priests’ garments, the first fruits, and the tithes. They stirred up the Nazarites, who had accomplished their days.
target: Dem bring di priis dem gaament, di fos fruut dem, an di tait dem. Dem stor op di Nazarait dem, we did akomplish dem die dem.

en: They cried aloud toward heaven, saying, “What should we do with these men? Where should we carry them away?
target: Dem krai aloud tuwaadz evn, a se, “Wa wi fi du wid dem man ya? We wi fi kyari dem we?

en: Your holy place is trampled down and profaned. Your priests mourn in humiliation.
target: Yu uoli plies chrampl dong an profien. Yu priis dem muorn ina yuumilieshan.

en: See, the Gentiles are assembled together against us to destroy us. You know what things they imagine against us.
target: Si, di Jentailz asembl tugeda gens wi fi dischrai wi. Yu nuo wa ting dem imajin gens wi.

en: How will we be able to stand against them, unless you help us?”
target: O wi wi ebl fi tan gens dem, onles yu elp wi?”

en: They sounded with the trumpets, and gave a loud shout.
target: Dem soun wid di chompit dem, an gi wan loud shout.

en: And after this Judas appointed leaders of the people: captains of thousands, captains of hundreds, captains of fifties, and captains of tens.
target: An afta dis Juudas apaint liida dem a di piipl: kiaptin a touzn dem, kiaptin a onjred dem, kiaptin a fifti dem, an kiaptin a ten dem.

en: He said to those who were building houses, were betrothing wives, were planting vineyards, and were fearful, that they should return, each man to his own house, according to the law.
target: Im se tu dem we ben a bil ous, ben a bichruod waif, ben a plaant vainyaad, an ben fieri, se dem fi ton bak, iich man tu im uon ous, akadin tu di laa.

en: The army marched out and encamped upon the south side of Emmaus.
target: Di aami maach out an kiamp pan di sout said a Emeyos.

en: Judas said, “Arm yourselves and be valiant men! Be ready in the morning to fight with these Gentiles who are assembled together against us to destroy us and our holy place.
target: Juudas se, “Aam unuself an bi valiant man! Bi redi ina di maanin fi fait wid dem Jentailz ya we asembl tugeda gens wi fi dischrai wi an wi uoli plies.

en: For it is better for us to die in battle than to see the calamities of our nation and the holy place.
target: Kaa i beta fi wi fi ded ina bakl dan fi si di kalamiti dem a wi nieshan an di uoli plies.

en: Nevertheless, as may be the will in heaven, so will he do.
target: Nevadeles, az mait bi di wil ina evn, so im wi du.

en: Gorgias took five thousand infantry, a thousand chosen cavalry, and the army moved out at night,
target: Gaagias tek faiv touzn infantri, wan touzn chuozn aasman, an di aami muuv out a nait,

en: that it might fall upon the army of the Jews and strike them suddenly. The men of the citadel were his guides.
target: so i mait faal pan di aami a di Juu dem an lik dem sodnli. Di man dem a di sitadel ben im gaid dem.

en: Judas heard of this, and he and the valiant men moved, that he might strike the king’s army which was at Emmaus
target: Juudas ier a dis, an im an di valiant man dem muuv, so im mait lik di king aami we ben a Emeyos

en: while the forces were still dispersed from the camp.
target: wail di fuos dem stil dispoers fram di kiamp.

en: Gorgias came into the camp of Judas at night and found no man. He sought them in the mountains; for he said, “These men are running away from us.”
target: Gaagias kom ina di kiamp a Juudas a nait an fain no man. Im soerch fi dem ina di mountin dem; kaa im se, “Dem man ya a ron we fram wi.”

en: As soon as it was day, Judas appeared in the plain with three thousand men. However they didn’t have the armor and swords they desired.
target: Aaz suun az i ben die, Juudas apiier ina di plien wid trii touzn man. Bot dem no av di aama an suod dem we dem dizaiya.

en: They saw the camp of the Gentiles strong and fortified, with cavalry all around it; and these were expert in war.
target: Dem si di kiamp a di Jentailz strang an faatifi, wid aasman aal roun i; an dem ya ben expaart ina waar.

en: Judas said to the men who were with him, “Don’t be afraid of their numbers, or when they charge.
target: Juudas se tu di man dem we ben wid im, “No fried fi dem nomba, ar wen dem chaaj.

en: Remember how our fathers were saved in the Red sea, when Pharaoh pursued them with an army.
target: Rimemba ou wi faada dem get siev ina di Red Sii, wen Fiero posyuu dem wid wan aami.

en: Now let’s cry to heaven, if he will have mercy on us, and will remember the covenant of our fathers, and destroy this army before our face today.
target: Nou mek wi krai tu evn, ef im wi av mersi pan wi, an wi rimemba di kovnant a wi faada dem, an dischrai dis aami bifuor wi fies tide.

en: Then all the Gentiles will know that there is one who redeems and saves Israel.
target: Den aal di Jentailz wi nuo se wan de we ridiim an siev Izrel.

en: The foreigners lifted up their eyes, and saw them coming near them.
target: Di farina dem lif op dem ai, an si dem a kom nier dem.

en: They went out of the camp to battle. Those who were with Judas sounded their trumpets
target: Dem go out a di kiamp tu bakl. Dem we ben wid Juudas soun dem chompit

en: and joined battle. The Gentiles were defeated, and fled into the plain.
target: an jain bakl. Di Jentailz get difiit, an ron we ina di plien.

en: But all those in the rear fell by the sword. They pursued them to Gazara, and to the plains of Idumaea, Azotus, and Jamnia. About three thousand of those men fell.
target: Bot aal dem ina di rier fell bai di suod. Dem posyuu dem tu Gazara, an tu di plien dem a Aidyuumia, Azuotos, an Jamniya. Bout trii touzn a dem man de fell.

en: Then Judas and his army returned from pursuing them;
target: Den Juudas an im aami ton bak fram posyuu dem;

en: and he said to the people, “Don’t be greedy for the spoils, because there is a battle before us.
target: an im se tu di piipl, “No griidi fi di spail dem, bikaaz wan bakl de bifuor wi.

en: Gorgias and his army are near us on the mountain. But stand now against our enemies and fight against them, and afterwards take the spoils with boldness.”
target: Gaagias an im aami de nier wi pan di mountin. Bot tan nou gens wi enimi dem an fait gens dem, an aftawod tek di spail dem wid buolnis.”

en: While Judas was finishing this speech, a part of them appeared looking out from the mountain.
target: Wail Juudas a finish dis spiich, wan paat a dem apiier a luk out fram di mountin.

en: They saw that their army had been put to flight, and that the Jews were burning the camp; for the smoke that was seen declared what was done.
target: Dem si se dem aami get put tu flait, an se di Juu dem a bon di kiamp; kaa di smuok we dem si diklier wa don.

en: But when they perceived these things, they were very afraid. Perceiving also the army of Judas in the plain ready for battle,
target: Bot wen dem posiiv dem ting ya, dem fried bad. A posiiv tu di aami a Juudas ina di plien redi fi bakl,

en: they all fled into the land of the Philistines.
target: dem aal ron we ina di lan a di Filistain dem.

en: Judas returned to plunder the camp, and they took much gold, silver, blue, sea purple, and great riches.
target: Juudas ton bak fi plonda di kiamp, an dem tek nof guol, silva, bluu, sii porpl, an big richiz.

en: Then they returned home, and sang a song of thanksgiving, and gave praise to Heaven, because he is good, because his mercy endures forever.
target: Den dem ton bak uom, an sing wan sang a tangksgivin, an gi priez tu Evn, bikaaz im gud, bikaaz im mersi endyuor far eva.

en: Israel had a great deliverance that day.
target: Izrel did av wan big dilivarans da die de.

en: The foreigners who had escaped came and told Lysias all the things that had happened.
target: Di farina dem we did eskiep kom an tuol Lisias aal di ting dem we apn.

en: When he heard of it, he was confounded and discouraged, because the things he desired had not been done to Israel, nor had such things happened as the king commanded him.
target: Wen im ier a i, im get konfound an diskorij, bikaaz di ting dem we im dizaiya no don tu Izrel, an no soch ting no apn az di king komaan im.

en: In the next year, he gathered together sixty thousand chosen infantry and five thousand cavalry, that he might subdue them.
target: Ina di neks ier, im gyada tugeda siksti touzn chuozn infantri an faiv touzn aasman, so im mait sobdyuu dem.

en: They came into Idumaea and encamped at Bethsura. Judas met them with ten thousand men.
target: Dem kom ina Aidyuumia an kiamp a Betsuura. Juudas miit dem wid ten touzn man.

en: He saw that the army was strong, and he prayed and said, “Blessed are you, O Savior of Israel, who defeated the attack of the mighty warrior by the hand of your servant David, and delivered the army of the Philistines into the hands of Jonathan the son of Saul, and of his armor bearer.
target: Im si se di aami strang, an im prie an se, “Bles yu, O Sievior a Izrel, we difiit di atak a di maiti wariya bai di an a yu sorvant Dievid, an diliva di aami a di Filistain dem ina di an dem a Jonatan di son a Saal, an a im aama-biera.

en: Hem in this army in the hand of your people Israel, and let them be ashamed for their army and their cavalry.
target: Em in dis aami ina di an a yu piipl Izrel, an mek dem shiem fi dem aami an dem aasman.

en: Give them faintness of heart. Cause the boldness of their strength to melt away, and let them quake at their destruction.
target: Gi dem fientnis a aat. Kaaz di buolnis a dem chrent fi melt we, an mek dem kwiek a dem dischrokshan.

en: Strike them down with the sword of those who love you, and let all who know your name praise you with thanksgiving.”
target: Lik dem dong wid di suod a dem we lov yu, an mek aal we nuo yu niem priez yu wid tangksgivin.”

en: They joined in battle; and about five thousand men of Lysias’ army fell. They fell down near them.
target: Dem jain ina bakl; an bout faiv touzn man a Lisias aami fell. Dem fell dong nier dem.

en: But when Lysias saw that his troops were put to flight, and the boldness that had come upon those who were with Judas, and how they were ready either to live or to die nobly, he withdrew to Antioch, and gathered together hired soldiers, that he might come again into Judea with an even greater army.
target: Bot wen Lisias si se im chuup dem get put tu flait, an di buolnis we kom pan dem we ben wid Juudas, an ou dem redi aider fi liv ar fi ded nuobli, im widjraa tu Antiok, an gyada tugeda aiya suolja dem, so im mait kom agen ina Juudia wid wan aami iivn bigga.

en: But Judas and his brothers said, “See, our enemies are defeated. Let’s go up to cleanse the holy place and to rededicate it.”
target: Bot Juudas an im breda dem se, “Si, wi enimi dem difiit. Mek wi go op fi klenz di uoli plies an fi riidedikiet i.”

en: All the army was gathered together, and they went up to mount Zion.
target: Aal di aami gyada tugeda, an dem go op tu mount Zaian.

en: They saw the sanctuary laid desolate, the altar profaned, the gates burned up, shrubs growing in the courts as in a forest or as on one of the mountains, and the priests’ chambers pulled down;
target: Dem si di sangchueri laid desolet, di aalta profien, di giet dem bon op, shrob a gro ina di kuot dem az ina wan faris ar az pan wan a di mountin dem, an di priis dem chiemba pul dong;

en: and they tore their clothes, made great lamentation, put ashes upon their heads,
target: an dem tier dem kluoz, mek big lamentieshan, put ashiz pan dem ed,

en: fell on their faces to the ground, blew with the solemn trumpets, and cried toward heaven.
target: fell pan dem fies tu di grong, bluo wid di solem chompit dem, an krai tuwaadz evn.

en: Then Judas appointed certain men to fight against those who were in the citadel until he had cleansed the holy place.
target: Den Juudas apaint som man fi fait gens dem we ben ina di sitadel til im did klenz di uoli plies.

en: He chose blameless priests who were devoted to the law;
target: Im chuuz bliemles priis we did divuot tu di laa;

en: and they cleansed the holy place and carried the defiled stones out to an unclean place.
target: an dem klenz di uoli plies an kyari di difail stuon dem out tu wan onkliin plies.

en: They deliberated what to do with the altar of burnt offerings, which had been profaned.
target: Dem dilibariet wa fi du wid di aalta a bon aafrin dem, we did get profien.

en: A good plan came into their mind, that they should pull it down, so that it would not become a reproach to them, because the Gentiles had defiled it. So they pulled down the altar
target: Wan gud plan kom ina dem main, se dem fi pul i dong, so i wudn kom wan ripruoch tu dem, bikaaz di Jentailz did difail i. So dem pul dong di aalta

en: and laid up the stones on the temple hill in a fitting place, until a prophet would come to give an answer concerning them.
target: an laid op di stuon dem pan di templ il ina wan fitin plies, til wan prafit wud kom fi gi wan ansa konsornin dem.

en: They took whole stones according to the law, and built a new altar like the former.
target: Dem tek huol stuon akadin tu di laa, an bil wan nyuu aalta laik di faama wan.

en: They built the holy place and the inner parts of the house; and they consecrated the courts.
target: Dem bil di uoli plies an di ina paat dem a di ous; an dem kansikriet di kuot dem.

en: They made new holy vessels, and they brought the lampstand, the altar of incense, and the table into the temple.
target: Dem mek nyuu uoli vesl, an dem bring di lampstan, di aalta a insens, an di tiebl ina di templ.

en: They burned incense on the altar, and they lit the lamps that were upon the lampstand, and they gave light in the temple.
target: Dem bon insens pan di aalta, an dem lait di lamp dem we ben pan di lampstan, an dem gi lait ina di templ.

en: They set loaves upon the table, hung up the curtains, and finished all the work which they had done.
target: Dem set luov pan di tiebl, ang op di koertn dem, an finish aal di wok we dem did du.

en: They rose up early in the morning, on the twenty-fifth day of the ninth month, which is the month Chislev, in the one hundred forty eighth year,
target: Dem raiz op orli ina di maanin, pan di twenti-fift die a di naint mont, we a di mont Kislev, ina di wan onjred faati-iet ier,

en: and offered sacrifice according to the law on the new altar of burnt offerings which they had made.
target: an aafa sakrifais akadin tu di laa pan di nyuu aalta a bon aafrin dem we dem did mek.

en: At the time and day the Gentiles had profaned it, even then it was dedicated with songs, harps, lutes, and with cymbals.
target: A di taim an die di Jentailz did profien i, iivn den i get dedikiet wid sang, aap, luut, an wid simbal dem.

en: All the people fell on their faces, worshiped, and gave praise toward heaven, which had given them good success.
target: Aal di piipl fell pan dem fies, worsip, an gi priez tuwaadz evn, we did gi dem gud sokses.

en: They celebrated the dedication of the altar eight days, and offered burnt offerings with gladness, and sacrificed a sacrifice of deliverance and praise.
target: Dem selibriet di dedikieshan a di aalta iet die, an aafa bon aafrin wid gladnis, an sakrifais wan sakrifais a dilivarans an priez.

en: They decorated the front of the temple with crowns of gold and small shields. They dedicated the gates and the priests’ chambers, and made doors for them.
target: Dem dekariet di front a di templ wid kroun a guol an smol shiil dem. Dem dedikiet di giet dem an di priis dem chiemba, an mek duor fi dem.

en: There was exceedingly great gladness among the people, and the reproach of the Gentiles was turned away.
target: Wan gladnis big uova tuu ben mongx di piipl, an di ripruoch a di Jentailz ton we.

en: Judas and his brothers and the whole congregation of Israel ordained that the days of the dedication of the altar should be kept in their seasons from year to year for eight days, from the twenty-fifth day of the month Chislev, with gladness and joy.
target: Juudas an im breda dem an di huol kanggrigieshan a Izrel aaden se di die dem a di dedikieshan a di aalta fi kip ina dem siizn fram ier tu ier fi iet die, fram di twenti-fift die a di mont Kislev, wid gladnis an jai.

en: At that time, they fortified mount Zion with high walls and strong towers around it, so that the Gentiles would not come and trample them down, as they had done before.
target: A da taim de, dem faatifi mount Zaian wid ai waal an strang towa dem roun i, so di Jentailz wudn kom an chrampl dem dong, az dem did du bifuor.

en: Judas stationed a garrison to guard it. They fortified Bethsura to keep it, that the people might have a stronghold near Idumaea.
target: Juudas stieshan wan gyarisn fi gyaad i. Dem faatifi Betsuura fi kip i, se di piipl mait av wan strangold nier Aidyuumia.

en: When the Gentiles all around heard that the altar had been rebuilt and the sanctuary dedicated as before, they were exceedingly angry.
target: Wen di Jentailz aal roun ier se di aalta get ribil an di sangchueri dedikiet az bifuor, dem angri uova tuu.

en: They took counsel to destroy the people of Jacob that was in the midst of them, and they began to kill and destroy among the people.
target: Dem tek kounsl fi dischrai di piipl a Jiekob we ben ina di migl a dem, an dem bigin fi kil an dischrai mongx di piipl.

en: Judas fought against the children of Esau in Idumaea at Akrabattine, because they besieged Israel. He struck them with a great slaughter, humbled them, and took their spoils.
target: Juudas fait gens di pikni dem a Iisaw ina Aidyuumia a Akrabatin, bikaaz dem bisiij Izrel. Im lik dem wid wan big slaata, ombl dem, an tek dem spail.

en: He remembered the wickedness of the children of Baean, who were a snare and a stumbling block to the people, lying in wait for them on the highways.
target: Im rimemba di wikidnis a di pikni dem a Baayan, we ben wan snier an wan stomblin blak tu di piipl, a lai ina wiet fi dem pan di aiwie dem.

en: They were shut up by him in the towers. He encamped against them, and destroyed them utterly, and burned with fire the towers of the place with all who were in them.
target: Dem get shut op bai im ina di towa dem. Im kiamp gens dem, an dischrai dem otli, an bon wid faiya di towa dem a di plies wid aal we ben ina dem.

en: He passed over to the children of Ammon, and found a mighty band and many people, with Timotheus for their leader.
target: Im paas uova tu di pikni dem a Amon, an fain wan maiti band an nof piipl, wid Timuotios fi dem liida.

en: He fought many battles with them, and they were defeated before his face. He struck them,
target: Im fait nof bakl wid dem, an dem get difiit bifuor im fies. Im lik dem,

en: and took possession of Jazer and its villages, and returned again into Judea.
target: an tek pozeshan a Jieza an im vilij dem, an ton bak agen ina Juudia.

en: The Gentiles who were in Gilead gathered themselves together against the Israelites who were on their borders, to destroy them. They fled to the stronghold of Dathema,
target: Di Jentailz we ben ina Giliad gyada demself tugeda gens di Izrelait dem we ben pan dem baada dem, fi dischrai dem. Dem ron we tu di strangold a Datema,

en: and sent letters to Judas and his brothers, saying, “The Gentiles who are around us are gathered together against us to destroy us.
target: an sen leta tu Juudas an im breda dem, a se, “Di Jentailz we roun wi gyada tugeda gens wi fi dischrai wi.

en: They are preparing to come and get possession of the stronghold where we fled for refuge, and Timotheus is the leader of their army.
target: Dem a pripier fi kom an get pozeshan a di strangold we wi ron we tu fi refyuuj, an Timuotios a di liida a dem aami.

en: Now therefore come and deliver us from their hand, for many of us have fallen.
target: Nou so kom an diliva wi fram dem an, kaa nof a wi don fell.

en: All our brothers who were in the land of Tubias have been put to death. They have carried their wives, their children, and their stuff into captivity. They destroyed about a thousand men there.”
target: Aal wi breda dem we ben ina di lan a Tuubias get put tu det. Dem kyari dem waif, dem pikni, an dem stof ina kiaptiviti. Dem dischrai bout wan touzn man de.”

en: While the letters were still being read, see, other messengers came from Galilee with their clothes torn, bringing a similar report,
target: Wail di leta dem stil a get red, si, ada mesenja dem kom fram Gyalalii wid dem kluoz tier, a bring wan simila ripuot,

en: saying, “People of Ptolemais, of Tyre, of Sidon, and all Galilee of the Gentiles have gathered together to destroy us.”
target: a se, “Piipl a Tolimeis, a Taiya, a Saidon, an aal Gyalalii a di Jentailz gyada tugeda fi dischrai wi.”

en: Now when Judas and the people heard these words, a great congregation assembled together to determine what they should do for their brothers who were in distress and under attack.
target: Nou wen Juudas an di piipl ier dem wod ya, wan big kanggrigieshan asembl tugeda fi ditoermin wa dem fi du fi dem breda dem we ben ina dischres an onda atak.

en: Judas said to Simon his brother, “Choose men and go deliver your brothers who are in Galilee, but Jonathan my brother and I will go into the land of Gilead.”
target: Juudas se tu Saiman im breda, “Chuuz man an go diliva yu breda dem we de ina Gyalalii, bot Jonatan mi breda an mi wi go ina di lan a Giliad.”

en: He left Joseph the son of Zacharias, and Azarias, as leaders of the people, with the remnant of the army, in Judea, to guard it.
target: Im lef Juozif di son a Zakaraayas, an Azaraayas, az liida dem a di piipl, wid di remnant a di aami, ina Juudia, fi gyaad i.

en: He commanded them, saying, “Take charge of this people, and fight no battle with the Gentiles until we return.”
target: Im komaan dem, a se, “Tek chaaj a dis piipl, an fait no bakl wid di Jentailz til wi ton bak.”

en: Then three thousand men were assigned to go into Galilee with Simon, but eight thousand men were assigned to Judas to go into the land of Gilead.
target: Den trii touzn man get asain fi go ina Gyalalii wid Saiman, bot iet touzn man get asain tu Juudas fi go ina di lan a Giliad.

en: Simon went into Galilee and fought many battles with the Gentiles, and the Gentiles were defeated before him.
target: Saiman go ina Gyalalii an fait nof bakl wid di Jentailz, an di Jentailz get difiit bifuor im.

en: He pursued them to the gate of Ptolemais. About three thousand men of the Gentiles fell, and he took their spoils.
target: Im posyuu dem tu di giet a Tolimeis. Bout trii touzn man a di Jentailz fell, an im tek dem spail.

en: They took to them those who were in Galilee and in Arbatta, with their wives, their children, and all that they had, and brought them into Judea with great gladness.
target: Dem tek tu dem dem we ben ina Gyalalii an ina Aarbata, wid dem waif, dem pikni, an aal we dem did av, an bring dem ina Juudia wid big gladnis.

en: Judas Maccabaeus and his brother Jonathan passed over the Jordan, and went three days’ journey in the wilderness.
target: Juudas Makabius an im breda Jonatan paas uova di Jaadan, an go trii die jorni ina di wildanis.

en: They met with the Nabathaeans, and these met them in a peaceful manner and told them all things that had happened to their brothers in the land of Gilead,
target: Dem miit wid di Nabatiyan dem, an dem ya miit dem ina wan piisful mana an tuol dem aal ting we did apn tu dem breda dem ina di lan a Giliad,

en: and how many of them were shut up in Bosora, Bosor, Alema, Casphor, Maked, and Carnaim—all these cities are strong and large—
target: an ou nof a dem get shut op ina Bosora, Buosor, Aliima, Kasfor, Maked, an Kaarniim—aal dem siti ya strang an laaj—

en: and how they were shut up in the rest of the cities of the land of Gilead, and that tomorrow they planned to encamp against the strongholds, and to take them, and to destroy all these men in one day.
target: an ou dem get shut op ina di res a di siti dem a di lan a Giliad, an se tumaro dem plan fi kiamp gens di strangold dem, an fi tek dem, an fi dischrai aal dem man ya ina wan die.

en: Judas and his army turned suddenly by the way of the wilderness to Bosora; and he took the city, and killed all the males with the edge of the sword, took all their spoils, and burned the city with fire.
target: Juudas an im aami ton sodnli bai di wie a di wildanis tu Bosora; an im tek di siti, an kil aal di miel dem wid di ej a di suod, tek aal dem spail, an bon di siti wid faiya.

en: He left there at night, and went until he came to the stronghold.
target: Im lef de a nait, an go til im kom tu di strangold.

en: When the morning came, they lifted up their eyes and saw many people who couldn’t be counted, bearing ladders and engines of war, to take the stronghold; and they were fighting against them.
target: Wen di maanin kom, dem lif op dem ai an si nof piipl we dem kudn kount, a bier lada an enjin a waar, fi tek di strangold; an dem ben a fait gens dem.

en: Judas saw that the battle had begun, and that the cry of the city went up to heaven, with trumpets and a great sound,
target: Juudas si se di bakl don bigin, an se di krai a di siti go op tu evn, wid chompit an wan big soun,

en: and he said to the men of his army, “Fight today for your brothers!”
target: an im se tu di man dem a im aami, “Fait tide fi unu breda dem!”

en: Then he went out behind them in three companies. They sounded with their trumpets and cried out in prayer.
target: Den im go out biyain dem ina trii kompani. Dem soun wid dem chompit an krai out ina prier.

en: And the army of Timotheus perceived that it was Maccabaeus, and they fled from before him. He struck them with a great slaughter. About eight thousand men of them fell on that day.
target: An di aami a Timuotios posiib se i ben Makabius, an dem ron we fram bifuor im. Im lik dem wid wan big slaata. Bout iet touzn man a dem fell da die de.

en: He turned away to Mizpeh and fought against it, took it, killed all its males, took its spoils, and burned it with fire.
target: Im ton we tu Mizpa an fait gens i, tek i, kil aal im miel dem, tek im spail, an bon i wid faiya.

en: From there he marched and took Casphor, Maked, Bosor, and the other cities of the land of Gilead.
target: Fram de im maach an tek Kasfor, Maked, Buosor, an di ada siti dem a di lan a Giliad.

en: Now after these things, Timotheus gathered another army and encamped near Raphon beyond the brook.
target: Nou afta dem ting ya, Timuotios gyada wan neda aami an kiamp nier Raafon biyaan di bruk.

en: Judas sent men to spy on the army; and they brought him word, saying, “All the Gentiles who are around us are gathered together to them, an exceedingly great army.
target: Juudas sen man fi spai pan di aami; an dem bring im wod, a se, “Aal di Jentailz we roun wi gyada tugeda tu dem, wan aami big uova tuu.

en: They have hired Arabians to help them, and are encamped beyond the brook, ready to come against you to battle.” So Judas went to meet them.
target: Dem aiya Ariebian dem fi elp dem, an a kiamp biyaan di bruk, redi fi kom gens yu tu bakl.” So Juudas go fi miit dem.

en: Timotheus said to the captains of his army when Judas and his army drew near to the brook of water, “If he crosses over to us first, we won’t be able to withstand him, for he will certainly defeat us;
target: Timuotios se tu di kiaptin dem a im aami wen Juudas an im aami jraa nier tu di bruk a waata, “Ef im kraas uova tu wi fos, wi naa go ebl fi widstan im, kaa im wi fi shuor difiit wi;

en: but if he is afraid, and encamps beyond the river, we will cross over to him, and defeat him.”
target: bot ef im fried, an kiamp biyaan di riva, wi wi kraas uova tu im, an difiit im.”

en: Now when Judas came near to the water brook, he caused the scribes of the people to remain by the brook, and commanded them, saying, “Allow no man to encamp, but let all come to the battle.”
target: Nou wen Juudas kom nier tu di waata bruk, im kaaz di skraib dem a di piipl fi rimien bai di bruk, an komaan dem, a se, “No lou no man fi kiamp, bot mek aal kom tu di bakl.”

en: Then he crossed over against them first, and all the people after him; and all the Gentiles were defeated before his face, and threw away their weapons, and fled to the temple at Carnaim.
target: Den im kraas uova gens dem fos, an aal di piipl afta im; an aal di Jentailz get difiit bifuor im fies, an chuo we dem wepan, an ron we tu di templ a Kaarniim.

en: They took the city and burned the temple with fire, together with all who were in it. Carnaim was subdued. They couldn’t stand any longer before the face of Judas.
target: Dem tek di siti an bon di templ wid faiya, tugeda wid aal we ben ina i. Kaarniim get sobdyuu. Dem kudn tan eni langga bifuor di fies a Juudas.

en: Judas gathered together all Israel, those who were in the land of Gilead, from the least to the greatest, with their wives, their children, and their stuff, an exceedingly great army, that they might come into the land of Judah.
target: Juudas gyada tugeda aal Izrel, dem we ben ina di lan a Giliad, fram di liis tu di bigis, wid dem waif, dem pikni, an dem stof, wan aami big uova tuu, so dem mait kom ina di lan a Juuda.

en: They came as far as Ephron, and this same city was large and very strong. It was on the road where they were going. They couldn’t turn away from it on the right hand or on the left, but needed to pass through the middle of it.
target: Dem kom az faar az Efron, an dis siem siti ben laaj an veri strang. I ben pan di ruod we dem ben a go. Dem kudn ton we fram i pan di rait an ar pan di lef, bot niid fi paas chuu di migl a i.

en: The people of the city shut them out and blocked the gates with stones.
target: Di piipl a di siti shut dem out an blak di giet dem wid stuon.

en: Judas sent to them with words of peace, saying, “We will pass through your land to go into our own land, and no one will harm you. We will only pass by on our feet.” But they wouldn’t open to him.
target: Juudas sen tu dem wid wod a piis, a se, “Wi wi paas chuu unu lan fi go ina wi uon lan, an nobadi naa go aam unu. Wi wi onggl paas bai pan wi fut.” Bot dem wudn uopm tu im.

en: Then Judas commanded proclamation to be made in the army, that each man should encamp in the place where he was.
target: Den Juudas komaan proklamieshan fi mek ina di aami, se iich man fi kiamp ina di plies we im de.

en: So the men of the army encamped, and fought against the city all that day and all that night, and the city was delivered into his hands.
target: So di man dem a di aami kiamp, an fait gens di siti aal da die de an aal da nait de, an di siti get diliva ina im an dem.

en: He destroyed all the males with the edge of the sword, razed the city, took its plunder, and passed through the city over those who were slain.
target: Im dischrai aal di miel dem wid di ej a di suod, riez di siti, tek im plonda, an paas chuu di siti uova dem we get slie.

en: They went over the Jordan into the great plain near Bethshan.
target: Dem go uova di Jaadan ina di big plien nier Betshan.

en: And Judas gathered together those who lagged behind and encouraged the people all the way through, until he came into the land of Judah.
target: An Juudas gyada tugeda dem we lag biyain an enkorij di piipl aal di wie chuu, til im kom ina di lan a Juuda.

en: They went up to mount Zion with gladness and joy, and offered whole burnt offerings, because not so much as one of them was slain until they returned in peace.
target: Dem go op tu mount Zaian wid gladnis an jai, an aafa huol bon aafrin, bikaaz no so moch az wan a dem get slie til dem ton bak ina piis.

en: In the days when Judas and Jonathan were in the land of Gilead, and Simon his brother in Galilee before Ptolemais,
target: Ina di die dem wen Juudas an Jonatan ben ina di lan a Giliad, an Saiman im breda ina Gyalalii bifuor Tolimeis,

en: Joseph the son of Zacharias, and Azarias, rulers of the army, heard of their exploits and of the war, and what things they had done.
target: Juozif di son a Zakaraayas, an Azaraayas, ruula dem a di aami, ier a dem explait an a di waar, an wa ting dem did du.

en: They said, “Let’s also get us a name, and let’s go fight against the Gentiles who are around us.”
target: Dem se, “Mek wi tu get wiself wan niem, an mek wi go fait gens di Jentailz we roun wi.”

en: So they gave orders to the men of the army that was with them, and went toward Jamnia.
target: So dem gi aada tu di man dem a di aami we ben wid dem, an go tuwaadz Jamniya.

en: Gorgias and his men came out of the city to meet them in battle.
target: Gaagias an im man dem kom out a di siti fi miit dem ina bakl.

en: Joseph and Azarias were put to flight, and were pursued to the borders of Judea. About two thousand men of Israel fell on that day.
target: Juozif an Azaraayas get put tu flait, an get posyuu tu di baada dem a Juudia. Bout tuu touzn man a Izrel fell da die de.

en: There was a great overthrow among the people, because they didn’t listen to Judas and his brothers, thinking to do some exploit.
target: Wan big uovachuo ben mongx di piipl, bikaaz dem no lisn tu Juudas an im breda dem, a tingk fi du som explait.

en: But they were not of the family of those men by whose hand deliverance was given to Israel.
target: Bot dem no ben a di fambili a dem man de bai uu an dilivarans get gi tu Izrel.

en: The man Judas and his brothers were glorified exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and of all the Gentiles, wherever their name was heard of.
target: Di man Juudas an im breda dem get gluorifai big uova tuu ina di sait a aal Izrel, an a aal di Jentailz, we so eva dem niem ier a.

en: Men gathered together to them, acclaiming them.
target: Man dem gyada tugeda tu dem, a akliem dem.

en: Judas and his brothers went out and fought against the children of Esau in the land toward the south. He struck Hebron and its villages, pulled down its strongholds, and burned its towers all around.
target: Juudas an im breda dem go out an fait gens di pikni dem a Iisaw ina di lan tuwaadz di sout. Im lik Ibran an im vilij dem, pul dong im strangold dem, an bon im towa dem aal roun.

en: He marched to go into the land of the Philistines, and he went through Samaria.
target: Im maach fi go ina di lan a di Filistain dem, an im go chuu Samieriya.

en: In that day certain priests, desiring to do exploits there, were slain in battle, when they went out to battle unadvisedly.
target: Ina da die de som priis, a dizaiya fi du explait de, get slie ina bakl, wen dem go out tu bakl onadvaizidli.

en: But Judas turned toward Azotus, to the land of the Philistines, pulled down their altars, burned the carved images of their gods with fire, took the plunder of their cities, and returned into the land of Judah.
target: Bot Juudas ton tuwaadz Azuotos, tu di lan a di Filistain dem, pul dong dem aalta, bon di kaav imij dem a dem iladem wid faiya, tek di plonda a dem siti dem, an ton bak ina di lan a Juuda.

en: King Antiochus was traveling through the upper countries; and he heard that in Elymais in Persia there was a city renowned for riches, for silver and gold,
target: King Antiokos ben a chravl chuu di opa konchri dem; an im ier se ina Elimais ina Poerja wan siti de rinuon fi richiz, fi silva an guol,

en: and that the temple which was in it was exceedingly rich, and that in it were golden shields, breastplates, and weapons which Alexander, son of Philip, the Macedonian king, who reigned first among the Greeks, left behind there.
target: an se di templ we ben ina i rich uova tuu, an se ina i guolin shiil, brespliet, an wepan de we Alekanda, son a Filip, di Maseduoniyan king, we ruul fos mongx di Griik dem, lef biyain de.

en: So he came and tried to take the city and to pillage it; and he was not able, because his plan was known to them of the city,
target: So im kom an chrai fi tek di siti an fi pilij i; an im kudn, bikaaz im plan get nuo tu dem a di siti,

en: and they rose up against him in battle. He fled and returned to Babylon with great disappointment.
target: an dem raiz op gens im ina bakl. Im ron we an ton bak tu Babilan wid big disapaintment.

en: Then someone came into Persia bringing him news that the armies which went against the land of Judah had been put to flight,
target: Den sombadi kom ina Poerja a bring im nyuuz se di aami dem we go gens di lan a Juuda get put tu flait,

en: and that Lysias went first with a strong army and was put to shame before them, and that they had grown strong because of weapons, power, and a supply of plunder which they took from the armies that they had cut off,
target: an se Lisias go fos wid wan strang aami an get put tu shiem bifuor dem, an se dem gruo strang bikaaz a wepan, powa, an wan soplai a plonda we dem tek fram di aami dem we dem did kot aaf,

en: and that they had pulled down the detestable thing which he had built upon the altar that was in Jerusalem, and that they had surrounded the sanctuary with high walls, as before, and also Bethsura, his city.
target: an se dem pul dong di detestabl ting we im did bil pan di aalta we ben ina Jeruusalem, an se dem soroun di sangchueri wid ai waal, az bifuor, an aalso Betsuura, im siti.

en: When the king heard these words, he was astonished and moved exceedingly. He laid himself down on his bed, and fell sick for grief, because it had not turned out for him as he had planned.
target: Wen di king ier dem wod ya, im get astanish an muuv uova tuu. Im lai imself dong pan im bed, an get sik fi griif, bikaaz i no ton out fi im az im did plan.

en: He was there many days, because great grief continually gripped him, and he realized that he would die.
target: Im ben de nof die, bikaaz big griif kantinyuali grip im, an im rialaiz se im wud ded.

en: He called for all his friends, and said to them, “Sleep departs from my eyes, and my heart fails because of worry.
target: Im kaal fi aal im fren dem, an se tu dem, “Sliip dipaat fram mi ai, an mi aat fiel bikaaz a wori.

en: I said in my heart, ‘To what suffering I have come! How great a flood it is that I’m in, now! For I was gracious and loved in my power.’
target: Mi se ina mi aat, ‘Tu wa sofa mi kom! Ou big a flod i we mi ina, nou! Kaa mi ben grieshos an lov ina mi powa.’

en: But now I remember the evils which I did at Jerusalem, and that I took all the vessels of silver and gold that were in it, and sent out to destroy the inhabitants of Judah without a cause.
target: Bot nou mi rimemba di iivl dem we mi du a Jeruusalem, an se mi tek aal di vesl dem a silva an guol we ben ina i, an sen out fi dischrai di piipl dem we liv a Juuda widout wan kaaz.

en: I perceive that it is because of this that these evils have come upon me. See, I am perishing through great grief in a strange land.”
target: Mi posiib se i bikaaz a dis se dem iivl ya kom pan mi. Si, mi a perish chuu big griif ina wan chrienj lan.”

en: Then he called for Philip, one of his friends, and set him over all his kingdom.
target: Den im kaal fi Filip, wan a im fren dem, an set im uova aal im kindom.

en: He gave him his crown, his robe, and his signet ring, so that he could guide Antiochus his son, and nourish him up that he might be king.
target: Im gi im im kroun, im ruob, an im signet ring, so im kud gaid Antiokos im son, an norish im op so im mait bi king.

en: Then King Antiochus died there in the one hundred forty-ninth year.
target: Den King Antiokos ded de ina di wan onjred faati-naint ier.

en: When Lysias learned that the king was dead, he set up Antiochus his son to reign, whom he had nourished up being young, and he called his name Eupator.
target: Wen Lisias lorn se di king ded, im set op Antiokos im son fi ruul, we im did norish op a bi yong, an im kaal im niem Yuupator.

en: Those who were in the citadel kept hemming Israel in around the sanctuary, and always sought to harm them and to strengthen the Gentiles.
target: Dem we ben ina di sitadel kip a em in Izrel roun di sangchueri, an aalwiez siik fi aam dem an fi chrentn di Jentailz.

en: Judas planned to destroy them, and called all the people together to besiege them.
target: Juudas plan fi dischrai dem, an kaal aal di piipl tugeda fi bisiij dem.

en: They were gathered together, and besieged them in the one hundred fiftieth year, and he made mounds to shoot from, and engines of war.
target: Dem gyada tugeda, an bisiij dem ina di wan onjred fiftiet ier, an im mek mound fi shuut fram, an enjin a waar.

en: Some of those who were hemmed in came out, and some of the ungodly men of Israel were joined to them.
target: Som a dem we get em in kom out, an som a di ongadli man dem a Izrel jain tu dem.

en: They went to the king, and said, “How long will you not execute judgment, and avenge our brothers?
target: Dem go tu di king, an se, “Ou lang yu naa go egzikiuut jojment, an avenj wi breda dem?

en: We were willing to serve your father and to live by his words, and to follow his commandments.
target: Wi ben wilin fi sorv yu faada an fi liv bai im wod dem, an fi fala im komaanment dem.

en: Because of this, the children of our people besieged the citadel and were alienated from us; but as many of us as they could catch, they killed, and plundered our inheritances.
target: Bikaaz a dis, di pikni dem a wi piipl bisiij di sitadel an get ielieniet fram wi; bot az nof a wi az dem kud kech, dem kil, an plonda wi inheritans dem.

en: Not against us only did they stretch out their hand, but also against all their borders.
target: No gens wi onggl dem chrech out dem an, bot aalso gens aal dem baada.

en: See, they are encamped this day against the citadel at Jerusalem to take it. They have fortified the sanctuary and Bethsura.
target: Si, dem a kiamp tide gens di sitadel a Jeruusalem fi tek i. Dem faatifi di sangchueri an Betsuura.

en: If you don’t quickly prevent them, they will do greater things than these, and you won’t be able to control them.
target: Ef yu no kwikli privent dem, dem wi du bigga ting dan dem ya, an yu naa go ebl fi kanchuol dem.

en: When the king heard this, he was angry, and gathered together all his friends, the rulers of his army, and those who were over the cavalry.
target: Wen di king ier dis, im angri, an gyada tugeda aal im fren dem, di ruula dem a im aami, an dem we ben uova di aasman dem.

en: Bands of hired soldiers came to him from other kingdoms and from islands of the sea.
target: Band a aiya suolja dem kom tu im fram ada kindom an fram ailan dem a di sii.

en: The number of his forces was one hundred thousand infantry, and twenty thousand cavalry, and thirty-two elephants trained for war.
target: Di nomba a im fuos dem ben wan onjred touzn infantri, an twenti touzn aasman, an toti-tuu elifant chrien fi waar.

en: They went through Idumaea, and encamped against Bethsura, and fought against it many days, and made engines of war. The Jews came out and burned them with fire, and fought valiantly.
target: Dem go chuu Aidyuumia, an kiamp gens Betsuura, an fait gens i nof die, an mek enjin a waar. Di Juu dem kom out an bon dem wid faiya, an fait valiantli.

en: Judas marched away from the citadel and encamped at Bethzacharias, near the king’s camp.
target: Juudas maach we fram di sitadel an kiamp a Betzakaraayas, nier di king kiamp.

en: The king rose early in the morning, and marched his army at full speed along the road to Bethzacharias. His forces made themselves ready to battle and sounded their trumpets.
target: Di king raiz orli ina di maanin, an maach im aami a ful spiid alang di ruod tu Betzakaraayas. Im fuos dem mek demself redi tu bakl an soun dem chompit.

en: They offered the elephants the juice of grapes and mulberries, that they might prepare them for the battle.
target: Dem aafa di elifant dem di juus a griep an molberi, so dem mait pripier dem fi di bakl.

en: They distributed the animals among the phalanxes. They set by each elephant a thousand men armed with coats of mail and helmets of brass on their heads. Five hundred chosen cavalry were appointed for each elephant.
target: Dem dischribiut di animal dem mongx di falanks dem. Dem set bai iich elifant wan touzn man aam wid kuot a miel an elmit a braas pan dem ed. Faiv onjred chuozn aasman get apaint fi iich elifant.

en: These were ready beforehand, wherever the elephant was. Wherever the elephant went, they went with it. They didn’t leave it.
target: Dem ya ben redi bifuoran, we so eva di elifant de. We so eva di elifant go, dem go wid i. Dem no lef i.

en: Strong, covered wooden towers were upon them, one upon each elephant, fastened upon it with secure harnesses. Upon each were four valiant men who fought upon them, beside his Indian driver.
target: Strang, kova wodn towa dem ben pan dem, wan pan iich elifant, faasn pan i wid sikyuor aanis. Pan iich fuor valiant man de we fait pan dem, bisaid im Indiyan draiva.

en: The rest of the cavalry he set on this side and that side on the two flanks of the army, striking terror into the enemy, and protected by the phalanxes.
target: Di res a di aasman dem im set pan dis said an da said pan di tuu flank dem a di aami, a chrai tera ina di enimi, an protek bai di falanks dem.

en: Now when the sun shone upon the shields of gold and brass, the mountains lit up, and blazed like flaming torches.
target: Nou wen di son shain pan di shiil dem a guol an braas, di mountin dem lait op, an bliez laik fliemin taach.

en: A part of the king’s army was spread upon the high hills and some on the low ground, and they went on firmly and in order.
target: Wan paat a di king aami chrech out pan di ai il dem an som pan di luo grong, an dem go aan faarmli an ina aada.

en: All who heard the noise of their multitude, the marching of the multitude, and the rattling of the weapons trembled; for the army was exceedingly great and strong.
target: Aal we ier di naiz a dem moltityuud, di maachin a di moltityuud, an di ratlin a di wepan dem chrembl; kaa di aami big uova tuu an strang.

en: Judas and his army drew near for battle, and six hundred men of the king’s army fell.
target: Juudas an im aami jraa nier fi bakl, an siks onjred man a di king aami fell.

en: Eleazar, who was called Avaran, saw one of the animals armed with royal breastplates, and it was taller than all the animals, and the king seemed to be on it.
target: Eliaza, we dem did kaal Avaran, si wan a di animal dem aam wid raayal brespliet, an i ben taala dan aal di animal dem, an di king siim fi de pan i.

en: He gave his life to deliver his people, and to get himself an everlasting name.
target: Im gi im laif fi diliva im piipl, an fi get imself wan evalaastin niem.

en: He ran upon him courageously into the midst of the phalanx, and killed on the right hand and on the left, and they parted away from him on this side and on that.
target: Im ron pan im koriejosli ina di migl a di falanks, an kil pan di rait an an pan di lef, an dem paat we fram im pan dis said an pan da.

en: He crept under the elephant, and stabbed it from beneath, and killed it. The elephant fell to the earth upon him, and he died there.
target: Im kriip onda di elifant, an stab i fram biniit, an kil i. Di elifant fell tu di ort pan im, an im ded de.

en: They saw the strength of the kingdom and the fierce attack of the army, and turned away from them.
target: Dem si di chrent a di kindom an di fiers atak a di aami, an ton we fram dem.

en: But the soldiers of the king’s army went up to Jerusalem to meet them, and the king encamped toward Judea and toward mount Zion.
target: Bot di suolja dem a di king aami go op tu Jeruusalem fi miit dem, an di king kiamp tuwaadz Juudia an tuwaadz mount Zaian.

en: He made peace with the people of Bethsura. He came out of the city because they had no food there to endure the siege, because it was a Sabbath to the land.
target: Im mek piis wid di piipl a Betsuura. Im kom out a di siti bikaaz dem no av no fuud de fi endyuor di siij, bikaaz i ben wan Sabat tu di lan.

en: The king took Bethsura, and appointed a garrison there to keep it.
target: Di king tek Betsuura, an apaint wan gyarisn de fi kip i.

en: He encamped against the sanctuary many days; and set there mounds to shoot from, and engines of war, and machines for throwing fire and stones, and weapons to throw darts, and slings.
target: Im kiamp gens di sangchueri nof die; an set de mound fi shuut fram, an enjin a waar, an mashiin fi chuoin faiya an stuon, an wepan fi chuo daat, an sling.

en: The Jews also made engines of war against their engines, and fought for many days.
target: Di Juu dem tu mek enjin a waar gens dem enjin, an fait fi nof die.

en: But there was no food in the sanctuary, because it was the seventh year, and those who fled for safety into Judea from among the Gentiles had eaten up the rest of the stores.
target: Bot no fuud no ben ina di sangchueri, bikaaz i ben di sevnt ier, an dem we ron we fi siefi ina Juudia fram mongx di Jentailz did iit op di res a di stuor dem.

en: There were only a few people left in the sanctuary, because the famine prevailed against them, and they were scattered, each man to his own place.
target: Onggl fyuu piipl lef ina di sangchueri, bikaaz di famin priviel gens dem, an dem get skyata, iich man tu im uon plies.

en: Lysias heard that Philip, whom Antiochus the king, while he was yet alive, appointed to raise his son Antiochus to be king,
target: Lisias ier se Filip, we Antiokos di king, wail im stil alaiv, apaint fi riez im son Antiokos fi bi king,

en: had returned from Persia and Media, and with him the forces that went with the king, and that he was seeking to take control of the government.
target: did ton bak fram Poerja an Miidiya, an wid im di fuos dem we go wid di king, an se im ben a siik fi tek kanchuol a di govament.

en: He made haste, and gave orders to depart. He said to the king and the leaders of the army and to the men, “We get weaker daily, our food is scant, the place where we encamp is strong, and the affairs of the kingdom lie upon us.
target: Im mek ies, an gi aada fi dipaat. Im se tu di king an di liida dem a di aami an tu di man dem, “Wi get wiika dieli, wi fuud skiant, di plies we wi a kiamp strang, an di afier dem a di kindom lai pan wi.

en: Now therefore let’s negotiate with these men, and make peace with them and with all their nation,
target: Nou so mek wi nigoshiet wid dem man ya, an mek piis wid dem an wid aal dem nieshan,

en: and covenant with them, that they may walk after their own laws, as before; for because of their laws which we abolished they were angered, and did all these things.”
target: an kovnant wid dem, se dem mait waak afta dem uon laa dem, az bifuor; kaa bikaaz a dem laa dem we wi abalish dem get angga, an du aal dem ting ya.”

en: The speech pleased the king and the princes, and he sent to them to make peace; and they accepted it.
target: Di spiich pliiz di king an di prins dem, an im sen tu dem fi mek piis; an dem aksep i.

en: The king and the princes swore to them. On these conditions, they came out from the stronghold.
target: Di king an di prins dem swier tu dem. Pan dem kandishan ya, dem kom out fram di strangold.

en: Then the king entered into mount Zion. He saw the strength of the place, and broke the oath which he had sworn, and gave orders to pull down the wall all around.
target: Den di king enta ina mount Zaian. Im si di chrent a di plies, an brok di uot we im did swier, an gi aada fi pul dong di waal aal roun.

en: Then he left in haste and returned to Antioch, and found Philip master of the city. He fought against him, and took the city by force.
target: Den im lef ina ies an ton bak tu Antiok, an fain Filip maasta a di siti. Im fait gens im, an tek di siti bai fuos.

en: In the one hundred fifty first year, Demetrius the son of Seleucus came out of Rome, and went up with a few men to a city by the sea, and reigned there.
target: Ina di wan onjred fifti-fos ier, Dimetrios di son a Seluukos kom out a Ruom, an go op wid fyuu man tu wan siti bai di sii, an ruul de.

en: When he was entering the house of the kingdom of his fathers, that the army laid hands on Antiochus and Lysias, to bring them to him.
target: Wen im ben a enta di ous a di kindom a im faada dem, di aami laid an pan Antiokos an Lisias, fi bring dem tu im.

en: The thing became known to him, and he said, “Don’t show me their faces!”
target: Di ting get nuo tu im, an im se, “No shuo mi dem fies!”

en: So the army killed them. Then Demetrius sat upon the throne of his kingdom.
target: So di aami kil dem. Den Dimetrios sidong pan di chuon a im kindom.

en: All the lawless and ungodly men of Israel came to him. Alcimus was their leader, desiring to be high priest.
target: Aal di laalis an ongadli man dem a Izrel kom tu im. Alsimos ben dem liida, a dizaiya fi bi ai priis.

en: They accused the people to the king, saying, “Judas and his brothers have destroyed all your friends, and have scattered us from our own land.
target: Dem akyuuz di piipl tu di king, a se, “Juudas an im breda dem dischrai aal yu fren dem, an skyata wi fram wi uon lan.

en: Now therefore send a man whom you trust, and let him go and see all the destruction which he has brought on us and the king’s country, and how he has punished them and all who helped them.”
