target: Nou so sen wan man we yu chros, an mek im go an si aal di dischrokshan we im bring pan wi an di king konchri, an ou im ponish dem an aal we elp dem.”

en: So the king chose Bacchides, one of the king’s friends, who was ruler in the country beyond the river, and was a great man in the kingdom, and faithful to the king.
target: So di king chuuz Bakidis, wan a di king fren dem, we ben ruula ina di konchri biyaan di riva, an ben wan big man ina di kindom, an fietful tu di king.

en: He sent him and that ungodly Alcimus, whom he made the high priest; and he commanded him to take vengeance upon the children of Israel.
target: Im sen im an da ongadli Alsimos de, we im mek di ai priis; an im komaan im fi tek venjans pan di pikni dem a Izrel.

en: They marched away and came with a great army into the land of Judah. He sent messengers to Judas and his brothers with words of peace deceitfully.
target: Dem maach we an kom wid wan big aami ina di lan a Juuda. Im sen mesenja tu Juudas an im breda dem wid wod a piis disietfuli.

en: They paid no attention to their words; for they saw that they had come with a great army.
target: Dem no pie no atenshan tu dem wod; kaa dem si se dem did kom wid wan big aami.

en: A group of scribes gathered together to Alcimus and Bacchides to seek just terms.
target: Wan gruup a skraib gyada tugeda tu Alsimos an Bakidis fi siik jos torm dem.

en: The Hasidaeans were the first among the children of Israel who sought peace from them,
target: Di Asidiyan dem ben di fos mongx di pikni dem a Izrel we siik piis fram dem,

en: for they said, “One who is a priest of the seed of Aaron has come with the army, and he will do us no wrong.”
target: kaa dem se, “Wan we a wan priis a di siid a Ieran kom wid di aami, an im naa go du wi no rang.”

en: He spoke with them words of peace, and swore to them, saying, “We won’t seek to harm you or your friends.”
target: Im taak wid dem wod a piis, an swier tu dem, a se, “Wi naa go siik fi aam unu ar unu fren dem.”

en: They trusted him. Then he seized sixty men of them, and killed them in one day, according to the word which was written,
target: Dem chros im. Den im siiz siksti man a dem, an kil dem ina wan die, akadin tu di wod we did ritn,

en: The flesh of your saints and their blood was shed all around Jerusalem, and there was no one to bury them.
target: Di flesh a yu sient dem an dem blod shed aal roun Jeruusalem, an nobadi no de fi beri dem.

en: The fear and the dread of them fell upon all the people, for they said, “There is neither truth nor justice in them; for they have broken the covenant and the oath which they swore.”
target: Di fieri an di jred a dem fell pan aal di piipl, kaa dem se, “No chuut nar jostis no de ina dem; kaa dem brok di kovnant an di uot we dem swier.”

en: Bacchides withdrew from Jerusalem, and encamped in Bezeth. He sent and seized many of the deserters who were with him, and some of the people, and he killed them, throwing them into a large pit.
target: Bakidis widjraa fram Jeruusalem, an kiamp ina Biezet. Im sen an siiz nof a di dizoerta dem we ben wid im, an som a di piipl, an im kil dem, a chuo dem ina wan laaj pit.

en: He placed Alcimus in charge of the country and left with him a force to aid him. Then Bacchides went away to the king.
target: Im plies Alsimos ina chaaj a di konchri an lef wid im wan fuos fi ied im. Den Bakidis go we tu di king.

en: Alcimus struggled to maintain his high priesthood.
target: Alsimos chrogl fi mientien im ai priisud.

en: All those who troubled their people joined him, and they took control of the land of Judah, and did great damage in Israel.
target: Aal dem we chrobl dem piipl jain im, an dem tek kanchuol a di lan a Juuda, an du big damij ina Izrel.

en: Judas saw all the wrongs that Alcimus and his company had done among the children of Israel, even more than the Gentiles.
target: Juudas si aal di rang dem we Alsimos an im kompani did du mongx di pikni dem a Izrel, iivn muor dan di Jentailz.

en: He went out into all the borders of Judea and took vengeance on the men who had deserted from him, and they were restrained from going out into the country.
target: Im go out ina aal di baada dem a Juudia an tek venjans pan di man dem we did dizoert fram im, an dem get rischrien fram go out ina di konchri.

en: But when Alcimus saw that Judas and his company had grown strong, and knew that he was not able to withstand them, he returned to the king, and brought evil accusations against them.
target: Bot wen Alsimos si se Juudas an im kompani gruo strang, an nuo se im kudn widstan dem, im ton bak tu di king, an bring iivl akyuzieshan gens dem.

en: Then the king sent Nicanor, one of his honorable princes, a man who hated Israel and was their enemy, and commanded him to destroy the people.
target: Den di king sen Nikanor, wan a im prins dem we piipl anar, wan man we iet Izrel an ben dem enimi, an komaan im fi dischrai di piipl.

en: Nicanor came to Jerusalem with a great army. He sent to Judas and his brothers deceitfully with words of peace, saying,
target: Nikanor kom tu Jeruusalem wid wan big aami. Im sen tu Juudas an im breda dem disietfuli wid wod a piis, a se,

en: “Let there be no battle between me and you; I will come with a few men, that I may see your faces in peace.”
target: “Mek no bakl no de bitwiin mi an unu; mi wi kom wid fyuu man, so mi mait si unu fies ina piis.”

en: He came to Judas, and they saluted one another peaceably. The enemies were ready to seize Judas by violence.
target: Im kom tu Juudas, an dem saluut wan neda piisabli. Di enimi dem ben redi fi siiz Juudas bai vailens.

en: This was known to Judas, that he came to him with deceit, and he was very afraid of him, and would see his face no more.
target: Dis get nuo tu Juudas, se im kom tu im wid disiet, an im fried a im bad, an wud si im fies no muor.

en: Nicanor found out that his plan was disclosed; and he went out to meet Judas in battle beside Capharsalama.
target: Nikanor fain out se im plan get diskluoz; an im go out fi miit Juudas ina bakl bisaid Kafarsalama.

en: About five hundred men of Nicanor’s army fell, and the rest fled into the city of David.
target: Bout faiv onjred man a Nikanor aami fell, an di res ron we ina di siti a Dievid.

en: After these things, Nicanor went up to mount Zion. Some of the priests came out of the sanctuary, with some of the elders of the people, to salute him peaceably, and to show him the whole burned sacrifice that was being offered for the king.
target: Afta dem ting ya, Nikanor go op tu mount Zaian. Som a di priis dem kom out a di sangchueri, wid som a di elda dem a di piipl, fi saluut im piisabli, an fi shuo im di huol bon sakrifais we ben a get aafa fi di king.

en: He mocked them, laughed at them, derided them shamefully, spoke arrogantly,
target: Im maak dem, laaf a dem, diraad dem shiemfuli, taak arogantli,

en: and swore in a rage, saying, “Unless Judas and his army are now delivered into my hands, it will be that, if I return safely, I will burn up this house!” And he went out in a great rage.
target: an swier ina wan riej, a se, “Onles Juudas an im aami nou diliva ina mi an dem, i wi bi se, ef mi ton bak siefli, mi wi bon op dis ous!” An im go out ina wan big riej.

en: The priests entered in, and stood before the altar and the temple; and they wept, and said,
target: Di priis dem enta in, an tan bifuor di aalta an di templ; an dem wiiip, an se,

en: “You chose this house to be called by your name, to be a house of prayer and supplication for your people.
target: “Yu chuuz dis ous fi get kaal bai yu niem, fi bi wan ous a prier an soplikieshan fi yu piipl.

en: Take vengeance on this man and his army, and let them fall by the sword. Remember their blasphemies, and don’t allow them to live any longer.”
target: Tek venjans pan dis man an im aami, an mek dem faal bai di suod. Rimemba dem blasfemi dem, an no lou dem fi liv eni langga.”

en: Then Nicanor went out from Jerusalem and encamped in Bethhoron, and there the Syrian army met him.
target: Den Nikanor go out fram Jeruusalem an kiamp ina Betuoran, an de di Siiriyan aami miit im.

en: Judas encamped in Adasa with three thousand men. Judas prayed and said,
target: Juudas kiamp ina Adasa wid trii touzn man. Juudas prie an se,

en: “When those who came from the king blasphemed, your angel went out, and struck among them one hundred eighty-five thousand.
target: “Wen dem we kom fram di king blasfiim, yu ienjel go out, an lik mongx dem wan onjred ieti-faiv touzn.

en: Even so, crush this army before us today, and let all the rest know that he has spoken wickedly against your sanctuary. Judge him according to his wickedness.”
target: Iivn so, krosh dis aami bifuor wi tide, an mek aal di res nuo se im taak wikidli gens yu sangchueri. Joj im akadin tu im wikidnis.”

en: On the thirteenth day of the month Adar, the armies met in battle. Nicanor’s army was defeated, and he himself was the first to fall in the battle.
target: Pan di tortiint die a di mont Adaar, di aami dem miit ina bakl. Nikanor aami get difiit, an im imself ben di fos fi faal ina di bakl.

en: Now when his army saw that Nicanor had fallen, they threw away their weapons and fled.
target: Nou wen im aami si se Nikanor don fell, dem chuo we dem wepan an ron we.

en: They pursued them a day’s journey from Adasa until you come to Gazara, and they sounded an alarm after them with the signal trumpets.
target: Dem posyuu dem wan die jorni fram Adasa til yu kom tu Gazara, an dem soun wan alaam afta dem wid di signal chompit dem.

en: Men came out of all the surrounding villages of Judea, and outflanked them. These turned them back on those, and they all fell by the sword. There wasn’t one of them left.
target: Man dem kom out a aal di soroundin vilij dem a Juudia, an outflank dem. Dem ya ton dem bak pan dem de, an dem aal fell bai di suod. Non a dem no lef.

en: The Jews took the spoils and the booty, and they cut off Nicanor’s head and his right hand, which he had stretched out so arrogantly, and brought them, and hung them up beside Jerusalem.
target: Di Juu dem tek di spail an di buuti, an dem kot aaf Nikanor ed an im rait an, we im did chrech out so arogantli, an bring dem, an ang dem op bisaid Jeruusalem.

en: The people were exceedingly glad, and they kept that day as a day of great gladness.
target: Di piipl glad uova tuu, an dem kip da die de az wan die a big gladnis.

en: They ordained to keep this day year by year on the thirteenth day of Adar.
target: Dem aaden fi kip dis die ier bai ier pan di tortiint die a Adaar.

en: So the land of Judah had rest a few days.
target: So di lan a Juuda did av res fyuu die.

en: Judas heard of the fame of the Romans, that they are valiant men, and have pleasure in all who join themselves to them, and make friends with all who come to them,
target: Juudas ier a di fiem a di Ruoman dem, se dem a valiant man, an av plezha ina aal we jain demself tu dem, an mek fren wid aal we kom tu dem,

en: and that they are valiant men. They told him of their wars and exploits which they do among the Gauls, and how they conquered them, and forced them to pay tribute;
target: an se dem a valiant man. Dem tuol im a dem waar an explait dem we dem du mongx di Gaal dem, an ou dem kangka dem, an fuos dem fi pie chribiut;

en: and what things they did in the land of Spain, that they might take control of the silver and gold mines which were there;
target: an wa ting dem du ina di lan a Spien, so dem mait tek kanchuol a di silva an guol main dem we ben de;

en: and how by their policy and persistence they conquered all the place (and the place was exceedingly far from them), and the kings who came against them from the farthest part of the earth, until they had defeated them, and struck them severely; and how the rest give them tribute year by year.
target: an ou bai dem palisi an posistans dem kangka aal di plies (an di plies ben faar uova tuu fram dem), an di king dem we kom gens dem fram di faris paat a di ort, til dem did difiit dem, an lik dem sibierli; an ou di res gi dem chribiut ier bai ier.

en: Philip, and Perseus, king of Chittim, and those who lifted up themselves against them, they defeated in battle, and conquered them.
target: Filip, an Poersios, king a Kitim, an dem we lif op demself gens dem, dem difiit ina bakl, an kangka dem.

en: Antiochus also, the great king of Asia, came against them to battle, having one hundred twenty elephants, with cavalry, chariots, and an exceedingly great army, and he was defeated by them.
target: Antiokos aalso, di big king a Iezha, kom gens dem tu bakl, a av wan onjred twenti elifant, wid aasman, chariot, an wan aami big uova tuu, an im get difiit bai dem.

en: They took him alive, and decreed that both he and those who reigned after him should give them a great tribute, and should give hostages, and a parcel of land from the best of their provinces:
target: Dem tek im alaiv, an dikrii se buot im an dem we ruul afta im fi gi dem wan big chribiut, an fi gi astij dem, an wan paasl a lan fram di bes a dem provins dem:

en: the countries of India, Media, and Lydia. They took them from him, and gave them to King Eumenes.
target: di konchri dem a Indiya, Miidiya, an Lidiya. Dem tek dem fram im, an gi dem tu King Yuumeniz.

en: Judas heard how the Greeks planned to come and destroy them,
target: Juudas ier ou di Griik dem plan fi kom an dischrai dem,

en: but this became known to them, and they sent against them a general who fought against them, and many of them fell down wounded to death, and they made captive their wives and their children, and plundered them, and conquered their land, and pulled down their strongholds, and plundered them, and brought them into bondage to this day.
target: bot dis get nuo tu dem, an dem sen gens dem wan jeneral we fait gens dem, an nof a dem fell dong, wuund til dem ded, an dem mek dem waif an dem pikni kiaptiv, an plonda dem, an kangka dem lan, an pul dong dem strangold dem, an plonda dem, an bring dem ina bandij tu dis die.

en: The remaining kingdoms and islands, as many as rose up against them at any time, they destroyed and made them to be their servants;
target: Di rimienin kindom an ailan dem, az nof az raiz op gens dem a eni taim, dem dischrai an mek dem fi bi dem sorvant;

en: but with their friends and those who relied on them they stayed friends. They conquered the kingdoms that were near and those that were far off, and all that heard of their fame were afraid of them.
target: bot wid dem fren dem an dem we rilai pan dem dem tan fren. Dem kangka di kindom dem we ben nier an dem we ben faar aaf, an aal we ier a dem fiem fried fi dem.

en: Moreover, whoever they desired to help and to make kings, these they make kings; and whoever they desired, they depose. They are exalted exceedingly.
target: Muoruova, uuseva dem dizaiya fi elp an fi mek king, dem ya dem mek king; an uuseva dem dizaiya, dem dipuoz. Dem egzalt uova tuu.

en: For all this, none of them ever put on a crown, neither did they clothe themselves with purple, as a display of grandeur.
target: Fi aal dis, non a dem eva put aan wan kroun, an dem no kluoz demself wid porpl niida, az wan displie a granjor.

en: Judas heard how they had made for themselves a senate house, and day by day, three hundred twenty men sat in council, consulting always for the people, to the end they might be well governed,
target: Juudas ier ou dem did mek fi demself wan senet ous, an die bai die, trii onjred twenti man sidong ina kounsl, a konsolt aalwiez fi di piipl, tu di en dem mait bi wel govarn,

en: and how they commit their government to one man year by year, that he should rule over them, and control all their country, and all are obedient to that one, and there is neither envy nor jealousy among them.
target: an ou dem komit dem govament tu wan man ier bai ier, se im fi ruul uova dem, an kanchuol aal dem konchri, an aal obie tu da wan de, an no envi nar jelosi no de mongx dem.

en: So Judas chose Eupolemus the son of John, the son of Accos, and Jason the son of Eleazar, and sent them to Rome, to establish friendship and alliance with them,
target: So Juudas chuuz Yuupolemos di son a Jan, di son a Akos, an Jiesn di son a Eliaza, an sen dem tu Ruom, fi istablish frenship an alaiyans wid dem,

en: and that they should free the yoke from themselves; for they saw that the kingdom of the Greeks kept Israel in bondage.
target: an se dem fi frii di yuok fram demself; kaa dem si se di kindom a di Griik dem kip Izrel ina bandij.

en: Then they went to Rome, a very long journey, and they entered into the senate house, and said,
target: Den dem go tu Ruom, wan veri lang jorni, an dem enta ina di senet ous, an se,

en: “Judas, who is also called Maccabaeus, and his brothers, and the people of the Jews, have sent us to you, to make an alliance and peace with you, and that we might be registered as your allies and friends.”
target: “Juudas, we aalso get kaal Makabius, an im breda dem, an di piipl a di Juu dem, sen wi tu unu, fi mek wan alaiyans an piis wid unu, an se wi mait get rejista az unu alai an fren dem.”

en: This thing was pleasing to them.
target: Dis ting ben pliizin tu dem.

en: This is the copy of the writing which they wrote back again on tables of brass, and sent to Jerusalem, that it might be with them there for a memorial of peace and alliance:
target: Dis a di kapi a di raitin we dem ruot bak agen pan tiebl a braas, an sen tu Jeruusalem, so i mait bi wid dem de fi wan memuorial a piis an alaiyans:

en: “Good success be to the Romans, and to the nation of the Jews, by sea and by land forever. May the sword and the enemy be far from them.
target: “Gud sokses bi tu di Ruoman dem, an tu di nieshan a di Juu dem, bai sii an bai lan far eva. Mek di suod an di enimi bi faar fram dem.

en: But if war arises for Rome first, or any of their allies in all their dominion,
target: Bot ef waar raiz fi Ruom fos, ar eni a dem alai ina aal dem dominion,

en: the nation of the Jews must help them as allies, as the occasion will indicate to them, with all their heart.
target: di nieshan a di Juu dem mos elp dem az alai, az di okiezhan wi indikiet tu dem, wid aal dem aat.

en: To those who make war upon them, they must not give supplies, food, weapons, money, or ships, as it has seemed good to Rome, and they must keep their ordinances without taking anything in return.
target: Tu dem we mek waar pan dem, dem mos no gi soplai, fuud, wepan, moni, ar ship, az i siim gud tu Ruom, an dem mos kip dem aadinans widout a tek eniting ina ritoern.

en: In the same way, moreover, if war comes first upon the nation of the Jews, the Romans must willingly help them as allies, as the occasion will indicate to them;
target: Ina di siem wie, muoruova, ef waar kom fos pan di nieshan a di Juu dem, di Ruoman dem mos wilinli elp dem az alai, az di okiezhan wi indikiet tu dem;

en: and to those who are fighting with them, there will not be given food, weapons, money, or ships, as it has seemed good to Rome. They must keep these ordinances, and that without deceit.
target: an tu dem we a fait wid dem, no fuud, wepan, moni, ar ship naa go gi, az i siim gud tu Ruom. Dem mos kip dem aadinans ya, an da widout disiet.

en: According to these terms, the Romans made a treaty with the Jewish people.
target: Akaadin tu dem torm ya, di Ruoman dem mek wan chriiti wid di Juush piipl.

en: But if hereafter the one party and the other will determine to add or diminish anything, they will do it at their pleasure, and whatever they add or take away will be ratified.
target: Bot ef ier afta di wan paati an di ada wi ditoermin fi ad ar diminish eniting, dem wi du i a dem plezha, an wateva dem ad ar tek we wi get ratifai.

en: Concerning the evils which King Demetrius is doing to them, we have written to him, saying, ‘Why have you made your yoke heavy on our friends and allies the Jews?
target: Konsornin di iivl dem we King Dimetrios a du tu dem, wi ruot tu im, a se, ‘Wa mek yu mek yu yuok ebi pan wi fren an alai dem di Juu dem?

en: If therefore they plead any more against you, we will do them justice, and fight with you on sea and on land.’ ”
target: Ef so dem pliid eni muor gens yu, wi wi du dem jostis, an fait wid yu pan sii an pan lan.’ ”

en: Demetrius heard that Nicanor had fallen with his forces in battle, and he sent Bacchides and Alcimus again into the land of Judah a second time, and the right wing of his army with them.
target: Dimetrios ier se Nikanor did faal wid im fuos dem ina batl, an im sen Bakidis an Alsimos agen ina di lan a Juuda a sekan taim, an di rait wing a im aami wid dem.

en: They went by the way that leads to Gilgal, and encamped against Mesaloth, which is in Arbela, and took possession of it, and killed many people.
target: Dem go bai di wie we liid tu Gilgal, an set op kamp gens Mesalot, we de ina Aabela, an tek ouva it, an kil nof piipl.

en: The first month of the one hundred fifty-second year, they encamped against Jerusalem.
target: Di fos mont a di wan ondred fifti-sekan ier, dem set op kamp gens Jeruusalem.

en: Then they marched away and went to Berea with twenty thousand infantry and two thousand cavalry.
target: Afta dat dem maach we an go tu Beriia wid twenti tauzan fut suolja an tuu tauzan aasman.

en: Judas was encamped at Elasa with three thousand chosen men.
target: Juudas did set op kamp a Elasa wid trii tauzan chuozn man.

en: They saw the multitude of the forces, that they were many, and they were terrified. Many slipped away out of the army. There were not left of them more than eight hundred men.
target: Dem si di big gruup a fuos dem, se dem a nof, an dem fraitn. Nof man ron we fram di aami. No muor dan iet ondred man did lef fram dem.

en: Judas saw that his army slipped away and that the battle pressed upon him, and he was very troubled in spirit, because he had no time to gather them together, and he became faint.
target: Juudas si se im aami did ron we an se di batl did a pres pan im, an im aat did chrobl bad, bikaaz im no av no taim fi gyada dem tugyeda, an im get wiik.

en: He said to those who were left, “Let’s arise and go up against our adversaries, if perhaps we may be able to fight with them.”
target: Im se tu dem we did lef, “Mek wi araiz an go op gens wi enimi dem, ef paraps wi wi ebl fi fait wid dem.”

en: They tried to dissuade him, saying, “There is no way we are able; but let’s rather save our lives now. Let’s return again with our brothers, and fight against them; but we are too few.”
target: Dem trai fi tan im bak, an se, “Wi no ebl eni wie; bot mek wi siev wi laif nou insted. Mek wi ton bak agen wid wi breda dem, an fait gens dem; bot wi tuu fyuu.”

en: Judas said, “Let it not be so that I should do this thing, to flee from them. If our time has come, let’s die in a manly way for our brothers’ sake, and not leave a cause of reproach against our honor.”
target: Juudas se, “Mek it no so se mi fi du dis ting, fi ron we fram dem. Ef wi taim kom, mek wi dai ina manli wie fi wi breda dem siek, an no liiv no kaaz a riproch gens wi ana.”

en: The army marched out from the camp, and stood to encounter them. The cavalry was divided into two companies, and the slingers and the archers went before the army, and all the mighty men that fought in the front of the battle.
target: Di aami maach out fram di kamp, an tan op fi miit dem. Di aasman dem did divaid ina tuu kompini, an di slinga dem an di aacha dem go bifuor di aami, an aal di maita man dem we fait a di front a di batl.

en: Bacchides was in the right wing. The phalanx advanced on the two parts, and they blew with their trumpets.
target: Bakidis did de ina di rait wing. Di falanks kom forwad pan di tuu paat dem, an dem bluo wid dem chompit.

en: The men by Judas’ side sounded with their trumpets, and the earth shook with the shout of the armies, and the battle was joined, and continued from morning until evening.
target: Di man dem bai Juudas said saund wid dem chompit tu, an di ort shiek wid di shout a di aami dem, an di batl jain, an it gwaan fram maanin til iivnin.

en: Judas saw that Bacchides and the strength of his army were on the right side, and all that were brave in heart went with him,
target: Juudas si se Bakidis an di chrent a im aami did de pan di rait said, an aal we did briev ina aat go wid im,

en: and the right wing was defeated by them, and he pursued after them to the mount Azotus.
target: an di rait wing did biit bai dem, an im fala dem op tu di mount Azotos.

en: Those who were on the left wing saw that the right wing was defeated, and they turned and followed in the footsteps of Judas and of those who were with him.
target: Dem we did de pan di lef wing si se di rait wing did biit, an dem ton an fala ina di futstep a Juudas an a dem we did wid im.

en: The battle became desperate, and many on both sides fell wounded to death.
target: Di batl get aad, an nof pan buot said faal wuund op tu det.

en: Judas fell, and the rest fled.
target: Juudas faal, an di res ron we.

en: Jonathan and Simon took Judas their brother, and buried him in the tomb of his ancestors at Modin.
target: Jonatan an Saiman tek Juudas dem breda, an beri im ina di tuum a im ansesta dem a Muodin.

en: They wept for him. All Israel made great lamentation for him, and mourned many days, and said,
target: Dem krai fi im. Aal Izrel mek big lamentieshan fi im, an mourn nof die, an se,

en: “How the mighty has fallen, the savior of Israel!”
target: “Ou di maita wan faal, di sieva a Izrel!”

en: The rest of the acts of Judas, and his wars, and the valiant deeds which he did, and his greatness, are not written; for they were exceedingly many.
target: Di res a di akt dem a Juudas, an im waar dem, an di valiant diid dem we im du, an im grietnis, dem no rait dong; kaa dem did tuu nof.

en: After the death of Judas, that the lawless emerged within all the borders of Israel. All those who did sin rose up.
target: Afta Juudas ded, di laalis piipl kom out widin aal di baada dem a Izrel. Aal dem we du sin kom op.

en: In those days there was an exceedingly great famine, and the country went over to their side.
target: Ina dem die de aalmuos wan griet famin did de, an di konchri go ouva tu dem said.

en: Bacchides chose the ungodly men and made them rulers of the country.
target: Bakidis chuuz di ongodli man dem an mek dem ruula a di konchri.

en: They inquired and searched for the friends of Judas, and brought them to Bacchides, and he took vengeance on them and used them spitefully.
target: Dem aks an saach fi di fren dem a Juudas, an bring dem tu Bakidis, an im tek venjans pan dem an chriit dem wid spait.

en: There was great suffering in Israel, such as was not since the time prophets stopped appearing to them.
target: A griet sofarin did de ina Izrel, laik we no did de sins di taim we prafit tap apiir tu dem.

en: All the friends of Judas were gathered together, and they said to Jonathan,
target: Aal di fren dem a Juudas gyada tugyeda, an dem se tu Jonatan,

en: “Since your brother Judas has died, we have no man like him to go out against our enemies and Bacchides, and among those of our nation who hate us.
target: “Sins yu breda Juudas ded, wi no av no man laik im fi go out gens wi enimi dem an Bakidis, an mongst dem a wi nieshan we iet wi.

en: Now therefore we have chosen you this day to be our prince and leader in his place, that you may fight our battles.”
target: Nou so wi chuuz yu tide fi bi wi prins an liida ina im plies, so yu kyan fait wi batl dem.”

en: So Jonathan took the governance upon him at that time, and rose up in the place of his brother Judas.
target: So Jonatan tek di govnans pan im a dat taim, an kom op ina di plies a im breda Juudas.

en: When Bacchides found out, he tried to kill him.
target: Wen Bakidis fain out, im trai fi kil im.

en: Jonathan, and Simon his brother, and all who were with him, knew it; and they fled into the wilderness of Tekoah, and encamped by the water of the pool of Asphar.
target: Jonatan, an Saiman im breda, an aal we did wid im, nuo it; an dem ron go ina di dezert a Tekuoa, an set op kamp bai di waata a di puul a Asfaar.

en: Bacchides found this out on the Sabbath day, and came—he and all his army—over the Jordan.
target: Bakidis fain dis out pan di Sabat die, an kom — im an aal im aami — ouva di Jaadn.

en: Jonathan sent his brother, a leader of the multitude, and implored his friends the Nabathaeans, that they might store their baggage, which was much, with them.
target: Jonatan sen im breda, a liida a di big gruup, an beg im fren dem di Nabatiian dem, so dem kuda stuor dem bagij, we did nof, wid dem.

en: The children of Jambri came out of Medaba, and seized John and all that he had, and went their way with it.
target: Di pikni dem a Jambrai kom out fram Medaba, an siiz Jan an aal we im av, an go dem wie wid it.

en: But after these things, they brought word to Jonathan and Simon his brother that the children of Jambri were celebrating a great wedding, and were bringing the bride, a daughter of one of the great nobles of Canaan, from Nadabath with a large escort.
target: Bot afta dem ting ya, dem bring wod tu Jonatan an Saiman im breda se di pikni dem a Jambrai did a selibriet a griet wedn, an did a bring di braid, a daata a wan a di griet nuobl dem a Kienan, fram Nadabat wid a big eskaat.

en: They remembered John their brother, and went up, and hid themselves under the cover of the mountain.
target: Dem memba Jan dem breda, an go op, an aid demself anda di kova a di mountn.

en: They lifted up their eyes and looked, and saw a great procession with much baggage. The bridegroom came out with his friends and his brothers to meet them with timbrels, musicians, and many weapons.
target: Dem lif op dem ai an luk, an si a griet proseshan wid nof bagij. Di braidgruum kom out wid im fren dem an im breda dem fi miit dem wid timbrel, myuuzishan, an nof wepan.

en: They rose up against them from their ambush and killed them, and many fell wounded to death. The remnant fled into the mountain, and the Jews took all their spoils.
target: Dem kom op gens dem fram dem ambush an kil dem, an nof faal wuund op tu det. Di res ron go ina di mountn, an di Juu dem tek aal dem spail.

en: So the wedding was turned into mourning, and the voice of their musicians into lamentation.
target: So di wedn ton ina mournin, an di vais a dem myuuzishan ton ina lamentieshan.

en: They avenged fully the blood of their brother, and turned back to the marshes of the Jordan.
target: Dem tek ful venjans fi di blod a dem breda, an ton bak tu di maarsh dem a di Jaadn.

en: Bacchides heard it, and he came on the Sabbath day to the banks of the Jordan with a great army.
target: Bakidis ier it, an im kom pan di Sabat die tu di bank dem a di Jaadn wid a griet aami.

en: Jonathan said to his company, “Let’s stand up now and fight for our lives, for things are different today than they were yesterday and the day before.
target: Jonatan se tu im kompini, “Mek wi tan op nou an fait fi wi laif, kaa tingz difrant tide dan dem did yestide an di die bifuor.

en: For, see, the battle is before us and behind us. Moreover the water of the Jordan is on this side and on that side, and marsh and thicket. There is no place to escape.
target: Kaa, si, di batl de bifuor wi an biyaind wi. Muorouva di waata a di Jaadn de pan dis said an pan dat said, an maarsh an tik bush. No plies no de fi eskiep.

en: Now therefore cry to heaven, that you may be delivered out of the hand of your enemies.”
target: Nou so krai tu evn, so unu kyan diliva out a di an a unu enimi dem.”

en: So the battle was joined, and Jonathan stretched out his hand to strike Bacchides, and he turned away back from him.
target: So di batl jain, an Jonatan chrech out im an fi chraik Bakidis, an im ton we bak fram im.

en: Jonathan and those who were with him leapt into the Jordan, and swam over to the other side. The enemy didn’t pass over the Jordan against them.
target: Jonatan an dem we did wid im jomp ina di Jaadn, an swim ouva tu di ada said. Di enimi no paas ouva di Jaadn gens dem.

en: About a thousand men of Bacchides’ company fell that day;
target: About wan tauzan man a Bakidis kompini faal dat die;

en: and he returned to Jerusalem. They built strong cities in Judea, the stronghold that was in Jericho, and Emmaus, Bethhoron, Bethel, Timnath, Pharathon, and Tephon, with high walls and gates and bars.
target: an im ton bak tu Jeruusalem. Dem bil chrang siti ina Juudia, di chrangold we did de ina Jeriko, an Emaus, Bethoron, Betel, Timnat, Faraton, an Tefon, wid ai waal an giet an baar.

en: He set garrisons in them to harass Israel.
target: Im set gyarison ina dem fi araas Izrel.

en: He fortified the city Bethsura, Gazara, and the citadel, and put troops and stores of food in them.
target: Im mek di siti Betsuura chrang, Gazaara, an di sitadel, an put chruup an stuor a fuud ina dem.

en: He took the sons of the chief men of the country for hostages, and put them under guard in the citadel at Jerusalem.
target: Im tek di son dem a di chiif man dem a di konchri fi astij, an put dem anda gyaad ina di sitadel a Jeruusalem.

en: And in the one hundred fifty-third year, in the second month, Alcimus gave orders to pull down the wall of the inner court of the sanctuary. He also pulled down the works of the prophets.
target: An ina di wan ondred fifti-taad ier, ina di sekan mont, Alsimos giiv aada fi pul dong di waal a di ina kuot a di sankchueri. Im pul dong di wok dem a di prafit dem tu.

en: He began to pull down. At that time was Alcimus stricken, and his works were hindered; and his mouth was stopped, and he was taken with a palsy, and he could no more speak anything and give orders concerning his house.
target: Im bigin fi pul dong. A dat taim Alsimos chraik dong, an im wok dem did inda; an im mout tap op, an paalzi tek im, an im kud no muor chat eniting an giiv aada bout im ous.

en: Alcimus died at that time with great torment.
target: Alsimos dai a dat taim wid griet taament.

en: Bacchides saw that Alcimus was dead, and he returned to the king. Then the land of Judah had rest for two years.
target: Bakidis si se Alsimos ded, an im ton bak tu di king. Den di lan a Juuda get res fi tuu ier.

en: Then all the lawless men took counsel, saying, “See, Jonathan and his men are dwelling at ease and in security. Now therefore we will bring Bacchides, and he will capture them all in one night.
target: Den aal di laalis man dem tek kounsl, an se, “Si, Jonatan an im man dem a liv a iiz an ina sekiuriti. Nou so wi wi bring Bakidis, an im wi kech aal a dem ina wan nait.

en: They went and consulted with him.
target: Dem go an kansolt wid im.

en: He marched out and came with a great army, and sent letters secretly to all his allies who were in Judea, that they should seize Jonathan and those who were with him; but they couldn’t, because their plan was known to them.
target: Im maach out an kom wid a griet aami, an sen leta siikritli tu aal im alai dem we did de ina Juudia, so dem fi siiz Jonatan an dem we did wid im; bot dem kudn, bikaaz dem plan did nuo tu dem.

en: Jonathan’s men seized about fifty of the men of the country who were authors of the wickedness, and he killed them.
target: Jonatan man dem siiz about fifti a di man dem a di konchri we did aata a di wikidnis, an im kil dem.

en: Jonathan, Simon, and those who were with him, went away to Bethbasi, which is in the wilderness, and he built up that which had been pulled down, and they made it strong.
target: Jonatan, Saiman, an dem we did wid im, go we tu Betbasi, we de ina di dezert, an im bil op dat we did pul dong, an dem mek it chrang.

en: Bacchides found out about it, and he gathered together all his multitude, and sent orders to those who were of Judea.
target: Bakidis fain out bout it, an im gyada tugyeda aal im big gruup, an sen aada tu dem we did a Juudia.

en: He went and encamped against Bethbasi and fought against it many days, and made engines of war.
target: Im go an set op kamp gens Betbasi an fait gens it nof die, an mek enjin a waar.

en: Jonathan left his brother Simon in the city, and went out into the country, and he went with a few men.
target: Jonatan lef im breda Saiman ina di siti, an go out ina di konchri, an im go wid a fyuu man.

en: He struck Odomera and his brothers, and the children of Phasiron in their tents.
target: Im chraik Odomera an im breda dem, an di pikni dem a Fasiron ina dem tent.

en: They began to strike them, and to go up with their forces. Then Simon and those who were with him went out of the city, and set the engines of war on fire,
target: Dem bigin fi chraik dem, an fi go op wid dem fuos. Den Saiman an dem we did wid im go out a di siti, an set di enjin dem a waar pan faiya,

en: and fought against Bacchides, and he was defeated by them. They afflicted him severely; for his counsel and expedition was in vain.
target: an fait gens Bakidis, an im did biit bai dem. Dem aflict im bad; kaa im kounsl an im ekspedishan did vain.

en: They were very angry with the lawless men who gave him counsel to come into the country, and they killed many of them. Then he decided to depart into his own land.
target: Dem did wel angri wid di laalis man dem we giiv im kounsl fi kom ina di konchri, an dem kil nof a dem. Den im disaidi fi go we ina im uon lan.

en: Jonathan learned of this and sent ambassadors to him, to the end that they should make peace with him, and that he should restore to them the captives.
target: Jonatan lern bout dis an sen ambasada tu im, fi di en se dem fi mek piis wid im, an se im fi ristuor tu dem di kyaptiv dem.

en: He accepted the thing, and did according to his words, and swore to him that he would not seek his harm all the days of his life.
target: Im aksep di ting, an du akordin tu im wod dem, an swier tu im se im wudn siik im aarm aal di die dem a im laif.

en: He restored to him the captives which he had taken before out of the land of Judah, and he returned and departed into his own land, and didn’t come any more into their borders.
target: Im ristuor tu im di kyaptiv dem we im did tek bifuor out a di lan a Juudia, an im ton bak an go we ina im uon lan, an no kom eni muor ina dem baada.

en: Thus the sword ceased from Israel. Jonathan lived at Michmash. Jonathan began to judge the people; and he destroyed the ungodly out of Israel.
target: So di suod tap fram Izrel. Jonatan liv a Mikmash. Jonatan bigin fi joj di piipl; an im dichroi di ongodli dem out a Izrel.

en: In the one hundred sixtieth year, Alexander Epiphanes, the son of Antiochus, went up and took possession of Ptolemais. They received him, and he reigned there.
target: Ina di wan ondred sixtiit ier, Alekanda Epifaniiz, di son a Antiokos, go op an tek ouva Tolimeis. Dem risiv im, an im rien de.

en: King Demetrius heard about this, and he gathered together exceedingly great forces, and went out to meet him in battle.
target: King Dimetrios ier bout dis, an im gyada tugyeda griet fuos, an go out fi miit im ina batl.

en: Demetrius sent a letter to Jonathan with words of peace, so as to honor him.
target: Dimetrios sen a leta tu Jonatan wid wod a piis, so fi ana im.

en: For he said, “Let’s go beforehand to make peace with them, before he makes peace with Alexander against us;
target: Kaa im se, “Mek wi go bifuor fi mek piis wid dem, bifuor im mek piis wid Alekanda gens wi;

en: for he will remember all the evils that we have done against him, and to his brothers and to his nation.”
target: kaa im wi memba aal di iivl dem we wi du gens im, an tu im breda dem an tu im nieshan.”

en: So he gave him authority to gather together forces, and to provide weapons, and that he should be his ally. He also commanded that they should release the hostages that were in the citadel to him.
target: So im giiv im atoriti fi gyada tugyeda fuos, an fi provaid wepan, an se im fi bi im alai. Im komaan tu se dem fi riliis di astij dem we did de ina di sitadel tu im.

en: Jonathan came to Jerusalem, and read the letter in the hearing of all the people, and of those who were in the citadel.
target: Jonatan kom tu Jeruusalem, an riid di leta ina di ierin a aal di piipl, an a dem we did de ina di sitadel.

en: They were very afraid when they heard that the king had given him authority to gather together an army.
target: Dem fraitn bad wen dem ier se di king did giiv im atoriti fi gyada tugyeda aami.

en: Those in the citadel released the hostages to Jonathan, and he restored them to their parents.
target: Dem ina di sitadel riliis di astij dem tu Jonatan, an im ristuor dem tu dem pierent.

en: Jonathan lived in Jerusalem and began to build and renew the city.
target: Jonatan liv ina Jeruusalem an bigin fi bil an rinyuu di siti.

en: He commanded those who did the work to build the walls and encircle Mount Zion with square stones for defense; and they did so.
target: Im komaan dem we du di wok fi bil di waal dem an roun op Mount Zaian wid skwier stuon fi difans; an dem du so.

en: The foreigners who were in the strongholds which Bacchides had built fled away.
target: Di farina dem we did de ina di chrangold dem we Bakidis did bil ron we.

en: Each man left his place and departed into his own land.
target: Iich man lef im plies an go we ina im uon lan.

en: Only at Bethsura, there were left some of those who had forsaken the law and the commandments, for it was a place of refuge to them.
target: Bot a Betsuura ongl, som a dem we did forsiek di laa an di komaanment dem did lef, kaa it did a plies a refyuuj tu dem.

en: King Alexander heard all the promises which Demetrius had sent to Jonathan. They told him of the battles and the valiant deeds which he and his brothers had done, and of the troubles which they had endured.
target: King Alekanda ier aal di pramis dem we Dimetrios did sen tu Jonatan. Dem tel im bout di batl dem an di valiant diid dem we im an im breda dem did du, an bout di chrobl dem we dem did fi bier.

en: So he said, “Could we find another man like him? Now we will make him our friend and ally.”
target: So im se, “Kud wi fain anada man laik im? Nou wi wi mek im wi fren an alai.”

en: He wrote a letter and sent it to him, in these words, saying,
target: Im rait a leta an sen it tu im, ina dem wod ya, an se,

en: “King Alexander to his brother Jonathan, greetings.
target: “King Alekanda tu im breda Jonatan, griitin.

en: We have heard of you, that you are a mighty man of valor, and worthy to be our friend.
target: Wi ier bout yu, se yu a wan maita man a vala, an wodi fi bi wi fren.

en: Now we have appointed you this day to be high priest of your nation, and to be called the king’s friend, and to take our side, and to keep friendship with us.” He also sent to him a purple robe and a golden crown.
target: Nou wi apaint yu tide fi bi ai priis a yu nieshan, an fi kaal di king fren, an fi tek wi said, an fi kiip frenship wid wi.” Im sen tu im a porpl ruob an a guoln kroun tu.

en: And Jonathan put on the holy garments in the seventh month of the one hundred sixtieth year, at the feast of tabernacles; and he gathered together forces and provided weapons in abundance.
target: An Jonatan put aan di uoli gaament dem ina di sevent mont a di wan ondred sixtiit ier, a di fiis a tabanaakl; an im gyada tugyeda fuos an provaid wepan ina abundans.

en: When Demetrius heard these things, he was grieved and said,
target: Wen Dimetrios ier dem ting ya, im griiv an se,

en: “What is this that we have done, that Alexander has gotten ahead of us in establishing friendship with the Jews to strengthen himself?
target: “Wa dis we wi du, se Alekanda get aed a wi ina mek frenship wid di Juu dem fi mek imself chrang?

en: I also will write to them words of encouragement and of honor and of gifts, that they may be with me to aid me.”
target: Wi tu wi rait tu dem wod a enkorijment an a ana an a gif, so dem kyan de wid wi fi ied wi.”

en: So he sent to them this message: “King Demetrius to the nation of the Jews, greetings.
target: So im sen tu dem dis mesij: “King Dimetrios tu di nieshan a di Juu dem, griitin.

en: Since as you have kept your covenants with us, and continued in our friendship, and have not joined yourselves to our enemies, we have heard of this, and are glad.
target: Sins unu kiip unu kovnant dem wid wi, an kantinyu ina wi frenship, an no jain unuself tu wi enimi dem, wi ier bout dis, an wi glad.

en: Now continue still to keep faith with us, and we will repay you with good in return for your dealings with us.
target: Nou kantinyu stil fi kiip fiet wid wi, an wi wi ripie unu wid gud fi unu diilin wid wi.

en: We will grant you many immunities and give you gifts.
target: Wi wi grant unu nof imyuuniti an giiv unu gif.

en: “Now I free you and release all the Jews from the tributes, from the salt tax, and from the crown levies.
target: “Nou mi frii unu an riliis aal di Juu dem fram di chribyuut dem, fram di saalt taks, an fram di kroun levi dem.

en: Instead of the third part of the seed, and instead of half of the fruit of the trees, which falls to me to receive, I release it from this day and henceforth, so that I will not take it from the land of Judah, and from the three districts which are added to it from the country of Samaria and Galilee, from this day forth and for all time.
target: Insted a di taad paat a di siid, an insted a aaf a di fruut a di chrii dem, we faal tu mi fi risiv, mi riliis it fram tide an fram nou aan, so mi wi no tek it fram di lan a Juuda, an fram di trii dischrik we ad tu it fram di konchri a Samieria an Gyalalii, fram tide forwad an fi aal taim.

en: Let Jerusalem be holy and free, with her borders, tithes, and taxes.
target: Mek Jeruusalem bi uoli an frii, wid aar baada dem, taid dem, an taks dem.

en: I yield up also my authority over the citadel which is at Jerusalem, and give it to the high priest, that he may appoint in it men whom he chooses to keep it.
target: Mi giiv op mi atoriti ouva di sitadel we de a Jeruusalem tu, an giiv it tu di ai priis, so im kyan apaint ina it man we im chuuz fi kiip it.

en: Every person of the Jews who has been carried captive from the land of Judah into any part of my kingdom, I set at liberty without payment. Let all officials also cancel the taxes on their livestock.
target: Ebri poosn a di Juu dem we dem kyari kyaptiv fram di lan a Juuda ina eni paat a mi kindom, mi set frii widout piemant. Mek aal afishal kansel di taks dem pan dem laivstok tu.

en: “All the feasts, the Sabbaths, new moons, appointed days, three days before a feast, and three days after a feast, let them all be days of immunity and release for all the Jews who are in my kingdom.
target: “Aal di fiis dem, di Sabat dem, nyuu muun dem, apaintid die dem, trii die bifuor a fiis, an trii die afta a fiis, mek aal a dem bi die a imyuuniti an riliis fi aal di Juu dem we de ina mi kindom.

en: No man must have authority to exact anything from any of them, or to trouble them concerning any matter.
target: No man mos no av atoriti fi egzakt eniting fram eni a dem, ar fi chrobl dem bout eni mata.

en: “Let there be enrolled among the king’s forces about thirty thousand men of the Jews, and pay will be given to them, as is due to all the king’s forces.
target: “Mek about taati tauzan man a di Juu dem inruol mongst di king fuos dem, an pie wi giiv tu dem, laik we dyuu tu aal di king fuos dem.

en: Of them, some will be placed in the king’s great strongholds, and some of them will be placed over the affairs of the kingdom, which are positions of trust. Let those who are over them and their rulers be of themselves, and let them walk after their own laws, even as the king has commanded in the land of Judah.
target: A dem, som wi plies ina di king griet chrangold dem, an som a dem wi plies ouva di afier dem a di kindom, we a pozishan a chros. Mek dem we de ouva dem an dem ruula bi a demself, an mek dem waak afta dem uon laa, iivn az di king komaan ina di lan a Juuda.

en: “The three districts that have been added to Judea from the country of Samaria, let them be annexed to Judea, that they may be reckoned to be under one ruler, that they may not obey any other authority than the high priest’s.
target: “Di trii dischrik we dem ad tu Juudia fram di konchri a Samieria, mek dem aneks tu Juudia, so dem kyan rekon fi de anda wan ruula, so dem kyan no obe eni ada atoriti dan di ai priis wan.

en: As for Ptolemais and its land, I have given it as a gift to the sanctuary that is at Jerusalem, for the expenses of the sanctuary.
target: Fi Tolimeis an it lan, mi giiv it az a gif tu di sankchueri we de a Jeruusalem, fi di ekspens dem a di sankchueri.

en: I also give every year fifteen thousand shekels of silver from the king’s revenues from the places that are appropriate.
target: Mi giiv evri ier fiftiin tauzan shekl a silva fram di king revenyuu dem fram di plies dem we a apruopriet tu.

en: And all the additional funds which those who manage the king’s affairs didn’t pay as in the first years, they must give from now on toward the works of the temple.
target: An aal di adishanal fond dem we dem we manij di king afier dem no pie az ina di fos ier dem, dem mos giiv fram nou aan tuwad di wok dem a di templ.

en: Besides this, the five thousand shekels of silver which they received from the uses of the sanctuary from the revenue year by year is also released, because it belongs to the priests who minister there.
target: Bisaid dis, di faiv tauzan shekl a silva we dem risiv fram di yuus dem a di sankchueri fram di revenyuu ier bai ier riliis tu, bikaaz it bilang tu di priis dem we minista de.

en: Whoever flees to the temple that is at Jerusalem, and within all of its borders, whether owing money to the king, or any other matter, let them go free, along with all that they have in my kingdom.
target: Enibadi we ron go tu di templ we de a Jeruusalem, an widin aal a it baada dem, weda im uo moni tu di king, ar eni ada mata, mek dem go frii, alang wid aal we dem av ina mi kindom.

en: For the building and renewing of the structures of the sanctuary, the expense will also be given out of the king’s revenue.
target: Fi di bildin an rinyuuin a di chrokcha dem a di sankchueri, di ekspens wi giiv out a di king revenyuu tu.

en: For the building of the walls of Jerusalem and fortifying it all around, the expense will also be given out of the king’s revenue, also for the building of the walls in Judea.”
target: Fi di bildin a di waal dem a Jeruusalem an fi mek dem chrang aal roun, di ekspens wi giiv out a di king revenyuu tu, an fi di bildin a di waal dem ina Juudia tu.”

en: Now when Jonathan and the people heard these words, they gave no credence to them, and didn’t accept them, because they remembered the great evil which he had done in Israel, and that he had afflicted them very severely.
target: Nou wen Jonatan an di piipl ier dem wod ya, dem no giiv no kriidans tu dem, an no aksep dem, bikaaz dem memba di griet iivl we im did du ina Izrel, an se im did aflikt dem bad.

en: They were well pleased with Alexander, because he was the first who spoke words of peace to them, and they were allies with him always.
target: Dem did wel pliiz wid Alekanda, bikaaz im did a di fos we chat wod a piis tu dem, an dem did alai wid im aalwiez.

en: King Alexander gathered together great forces and encamped near Demetrius.
target: King Alekanda gyada tugyeda griet fuos an set op kamp nier Dimetrios.

en: The two kings joined battle, and the army of Alexander fled; and Demetrius followed after him, and prevailed against them.
target: Di tuu king jain batl, an di aami a Alekanda ron we; an Dimetrios fala afta im, an priviel gens dem.

en: He strengthened the battle exceedingly until the sun went down; and Demetrius fell that day.
target: Im mek di batl chrang bad til di son go dong; an Dimetrios faal dat die.

en: Alexander sent ambassadors to Ptolemy king of Egypt with this message:
target: Alekanda sen ambasada tu Tolimi king a Iijipt wid dis mesij:

en: “Since I have returned to my kingdom, and am seated on the throne of my fathers, and have established my dominion, and have overthrown Demetrius, and have taken possession of our country—
target: “Sins mi ton bak tu mi kindom, an siddong pan di chruon a mi faada dem, an set op mi dominyan, an ouva chruo Dimetrios, an tek ouva wi konchri —

en: yes, I joined the battle with him, and he and his army were defeated by us, and we sat on the throne of his kingdom—
target: yes, mi jain di batl wid im, an im an im aami did biit bai wi, an wi siddong pan di chruon a im kindom —

en: now also let’s make friends with one another. Give me now your daughter as my wife. I will be joined with you, and will give both you and her gifts worthy of you.”
target: nou mek wi mek fren wid wan anada tu. Giiv mi nou yu daata az mi waif. Mi wi jain wid yu, an wi giiv buot yu an aar gif we wodi a unu.”

en: Ptolemy the king answered, saying, “Happy is the day you returned to the land of your ancestors and sat on the throne of their kingdom.
target: Tolimi di king ansa, an se, “Api a di die yu ton bak tu di lan a yu ansesta dem an siddong pan di chruon a dem kindom.

en: Now I will do to you as you have written, but meet me at Ptolemais, that we may see one another; and I will join with you, even as you have said.”
target: Nou mi wi du tu yu az yu rait, bot miit mi a Tolimeis, so wi kyan si wan anada; an mi wi jain wid yu, iivn az yu se.”

en: So Ptolemy went out of Egypt, himself and Cleopatra his daughter, and came to Ptolemais in the one hundred sixty-second year.
target: So Tolimi go out a Iijipt, imself an Kliopatra im daata, an kom tu Tolimeis ina di wan ondred siksti-sekan ier.

en: King Alexander met him, and he gave him his daughter Cleopatra, and celebrated her wedding at Ptolemais with great pomp, as kings do.
target: King Alekanda miit im, an im giiv im im daata Kliopatra, an selibriet aar wedn a Tolimeis wid griet pomp, az king dem du.

en: King Alexander wrote to Jonathan, that he should come to meet him.
target: King Alekanda rait tu Jonatan, se im fi kom fi miit im.

en: He went with pomp to Ptolemais, and met the two kings. He gave them and their friends silver and gold, and many gifts, and found favor in their sight.
target: Im go wid pomp tu Tolimeis, an miit di tuu king. Im giiv dem an dem fren silva an guol, an nof gif, an fain fieva ina dem sait.

en: Some malcontents out of Israel, men who were transgressors of the law, gathered together against him to complain against him; but the king paid no attention to them.
target: Som malcontent out a Izrel, man we did chransgresa a di laa, gyada tugyeda gens im fi komplien gens im; bot di king no pie no atenshan tu dem.

en: The king commanded that they take off Jonathan’s garments and clothe him in purple, and they did so.
target: Di king komaan se dem fi tek aaf Jonatan gaament dem an kluoz im ina porpl, an dem du so.

en: The king made him sit with him, and said to his princes, “Go out with him into the midst of the city, and proclaim that no man may complain against him of any matter, and let no man trouble him for any reason.”
target: Di king mek im siddong wid im, an se tu im prins dem, “Go out wid im ina di migl a di siti, an proklaim se no man kyan no komplien gens im bout eni mata, an mek no man chrobl im fi eni riizn.”

en: When those who complained against him saw his honor according to the proclamation, and saw him clothed in purple, they all fled away.
target: Wen dem we komplien gens im si im ana akordin tu di proklamieshan, an si im kluoz ina porpl, dem aal ron we.

en: The king gave him honor, and enrolled him among his chief friends, and made him a captain and governor of a province.
target: Di king giiv im ana, an inruol im mongst im chiif fren dem, an mek im a kyaptin an govna a a pravins.

en: Then Jonathan returned to Jerusalem with peace and gladness.
target: Den Jonatan ton bak tu Jeruusalem wid piis an gladnis.

en: In the one hundred sixty-fifth year, Demetrius, son of Demetrius, came out of Crete into the land of his ancestors.
target: Ina di wan ondred siksti-fif ier, Dimetrios, son a Dimetrios, kom out a Kriit ina di lan a im ansesta dem.

en: When King Alexander heard of it, he grieved exceedingly and returned to Antioch.
target: Wen King Alekanda ier bout it, im griiv bad an ton bak tu Antiok.

en: Demetrius appointed Apollonius, who was over Coelesyria, and he gathered together a great army, and encamped against Jamnia, and sent to Jonathan the high priest, saying,
target: Dimetrios apaint Apoluonios, we did ouva Siilisiiria, an im gyada tugyeda a griet aami, an set op kamp gens Jamnia, an sen tu Jonatan di ai priis, an se,

en: “You alone lift up yourself against us, but I am ridiculed and in reproach because of you. Why do you assume authority against us in the mountains?
target: “Yu aluon lif op yuself gens wi, bot mi a ridikyuul an ina riproch bikaaz a yu. Wai yu tekovo atoriti gens wi ina di mountn dem?

en: Now therefore, if you trust in your forces, come down to us into the plain, and let’s match strength with each other there; for the power of the cities is with me.
target: Nou so, ef yu chros ina yu fuos dem, kom dong tu wi ina di plien, an mek wi mach chrent wid iich ada de; kaa di powa a di siti dem de wid mi.

en: Ask and learn who I am, and the rest who help us. They say, ‘Your foot can’t stand before our face; for your ancestors have been put to flight twice in their own land.’
target: Aks an lern uu mi a, an di res we elp wi. Dem se, ‘Yu fut kyaan tan bifuor wi fies; kaa yu ansesta dem did put tu flait twais ina dem uon lan.’

en: Now you won’t be able to withstand the cavalry and such an army as this in the plain, where there is no stone or pebble, or place to flee.”
target: Nou yu wi no ebl fi widstan di aasman dem an soch a aami laik dis ina di plien, we no stuon ar pebl no de, ar plies fi ron go.”

en: Now when Jonathan heard the words of Apollonius, he was moved in his mind, and he chose ten thousand men, and went out from Jerusalem; and Simon his brother met him to help him.
target: Nou wen Jonatan ier di wod dem a Apoluonios, im muuv ina im main, an im chuuz ten tauzan man, an go out fram Jeruusalem; an Saiman im breda miit im fi elp im.

en: Then he encamped against Joppa. The people of the city shut him out, because Apollonius had a garrison in Joppa.
target: Den im set op kamp gens Jopa. Di piipl a di siti shot im out, bikaaz Apoluonios did av a gyarison ina Jopa.

en: So they fought against it. The people of the city were afraid, and opened to him; and Jonathan became master of Joppa.
target: So dem fait gens it. Di piipl a di siti fraitn, an uopn tu im; an Jonatan get ouva Jopa.

en: Apollonius heard about that, and he gathered an army of three thousand cavalry, and a great army, and went to Azotus as though he were on a journey, and at the same time advanced onward into the plain, because he had a multitude of cavalry which he trusted.
target: Apoluonios ier bout dat, an im gyada a aami a trii tauzan aasman, an a griet aami, an go tu Azotos az if im did pan a jorni, an a di siem taim go forwad ina di plien, bikaaz im did av nof aasman we im chros.

en: He pursued him to Azotus, and the armies joined battle.
target: Im fala im tu Azotos, an di aami dem jain batl.

en: Apollonius had secretly left a thousand cavalry behind them.
target: Apoluonios did siikritli lef wan tauzan aasman biyaind dem.

en: Jonathan learned that there was an ambush behind him. They surrounded his army, and shot their arrows at the people, from morning until evening;
target: Jonatan lern se a ambush did de biyaind im. Dem soroum im aami, an shuut dem aro a di piipl, fram maanin til iivnin;

en: but the people stood fast, as Jonathan commanded them; and the enemy’s horses grew tired.
target: bot di piipl tan faas, az Jonatan komaan dem; an di enimi aas dem get taiyad.

en: Then Simon brought forward his army and joined battle with the phalanx (for the cavalry were exhausted), and they were defeated by him and fled.
target: Den Saiman bring forwad im aami an jain batl wid di falanks (kaa di aasman dem did egzaast), an dem did biit bai im an ron we.

en: The cavalry were scattered in the plain. They fled to Azotus and entered into Beth-dagon, their idol’s temple, to save themselves.
target: Di aasman dem skyata ina di plien. Dem ron go tu Azotos an go ina Bet-Daagan, dem aidol templ, fi siev demself.

en: Jonathan burned Azotus and the cities around it and took their spoils. He burned the temple of Dagon and those who fled into it with fire.
target: Jonatan bon Azotos an di siti dem roun it an tek dem spail. Im bon di templ a Daagan an dem we ron go ina it wid faiya.

en: Those who had fallen by the sword plus those who were burned were about eight thousand men.
target: Dem we did faal bai di suod plos dem we did bon a did about iet tauzan man.

en: From there, Jonathan left and encamped against Ascalon. The people of the city came out to meet him with great pomp.
target: Fram de, Jonatan lef an set op kamp gens Askalan. Di piipl a di siti kom out fi miit im wid griet pomp.

en: Jonathan, with those who were on his side, returned to Jerusalem, having many spoils.
target: Jonatan, wid dem we did pan im said, ton bak tu Jeruusalem, an av nof spail.

en: When King Alexander heard these things, he honored Jonathan even more.
target: Wen King Alekanda ier dem ting ya, im ana Jonatan iivn muor.

en: He sent him a gold buckle, as the custom is to give to the king’s kindred. He gave him Ekron and all its land for a possession.
target: Im sen im a guol bokl, az di kostom a fi giiv tu di king kin dem. Im giiv im Ekron an aal it lan fi a pozeshan.

en: Then the king of Egypt gathered together great forces, as the sand which is by the sea shore, and many ships, and sought to make himself master of Alexander’s kingdom by deceit, and to add it to his own kingdom.
target: Den di king a Iijipt gyada tugyeda griet fuos, az di san we de bai di sii shuor, an nof ship, an siik fi mek imself maasta a Alekanda kindom bai disiit, an fi ad it tu im uon kindom.

en: He went out into Syria with words of peace, and the people of the cities opened their gates to him and met him; for King Alexander’s command was that they should meet him, because he was his father-in-law.
target: Im go out ina Siiria wid wod a piis, an di piipl a di siti dem uopn dem giet tu im an miit im; kaa King Alekanda komaan did a se dem fi miit im, bikaaz im did a im faada-in-laa.

en: Now as he entered into the cities of Ptolemais, he set his forces for a garrison in each city.
target: Nou az im go ina di siti dem a Tolimeis, im set im fuos dem fi a gyarison ina iich siti.

en: But when he came near to Azotus, they showed him the temple of Dagon burned with fire, and Azotus and its pasture lands destroyed, and the bodies cast out, and those who had been burned, whom he burned in the war, for they had made heaps of them in his way.
target: Bot wen im kom nier tu Azotos, dem shuo im di templ a Daagan bon wid faiya, an Azotos an it paascha lan dem dichroi, an di badi dem kyas out, an dem we did bon, uu im bon ina di waar, kaa dem did mek iip a dem ina im wie.

en: They told the king what Jonathan had done, that they might cast blame on him; but the king kept silent.
target: Dem tel di king wa Jonatan did du, so dem kyan kyas bliem pan im; bot di king kiip sailant.

en: Jonathan met the king with pomp at Joppa, and they greeted one another, and they slept there.
target: Jonatan miit di king wid pomp a Jopa, an dem griit wan anada, an dem sliip de.

en: Jonathan went with the king as far as the river that is called Eleutherus, then returned to Jerusalem.
target: Jonatan go wid di king az faar az di riva we kaal Eluuteros, den ton bak tu Jeruusalem.

en: But King Ptolemy took control of the cities along the sea coast, to Selucia which is by the sea, and he devised evil plans concerning Alexander.
target: Bot King Tolimi tek kanchruol a di siti dem alang di sii kuos, tu Seluusia we de bai di sii, an im divaiz iivl plan dem bout Alekanda.

en: He sent ambassadors to King Demetrius, saying, “Come! Let’s make a covenant with one another, and I will give you my daughter whom Alexander has, and you will reign over your father’s kingdom;
target: Im sen ambasada tu King Dimetrios, an se, “Kom! Mek wi mek a kovnant wid wan anada, an mi wi giiv yu mi daata uu Alekanda av, an yu wi rien ouva yu faada kindom;

en: for I regret that I gave my daughter to him, for he tried to kill me.
target: kaa mi rigret se mi giiv mi daata tu im, kaa im trai fi kil mi.

en: He accused him, because he coveted his kingdom.
target: Im akyuuz im, bikaaz im did kuovet im kindom.

en: Taking his daughter from him, he gave her to Demetrius, and was estranged from Alexander, and their enmity was openly seen.
target: Im tek im daata fram im, giiv aar tu Dimetrios, an get eschrienj fram Alekanda, an dem enmiti did uopnli siin.

en: Ptolemy entered into Antioch, and put on himself the crown of Asia. He put two crowns upon his head, the crown of Egypt and that of Asia.
target: Tolimi go ina Antiok, an put aan imself di kroun a Iezha. Im put tuu kroun pan im ed, di kroun a Iijipt an dat a Iezha.

en: But King Alexander was in Cilicia at that time, because the people of that region were in revolt.
target: Bot King Alekanda did de ina Silisia a dat taim, bikaaz di piipl a dat riijan did ina rivolt.

en: When Alexander heard of it, he came against him in war. Ptolemy marched out and met him with a strong force, and put him to flight.
target: Wen Alekanda ier bout it, im kom gens im ina waar. Tolimi maach out an miit im wid a chrang fuos, an put im tu flait.

en: Alexander fled into Arabia, that he might be sheltered there; but King Ptolemy was triumphant.
target: Alekanda ron go ina Ariebia, so im kyan get shelta de; bot King Tolimi did chraiomfant.

en: Zabdiel the Arabian took off Alexander’s head, and sent it to Ptolemy.
target: Zabdiel di Ariebian tek aaf Alekanda ed, an sen it tu Tolimi.

en: King Ptolemy died the third day after, and those who were in his strongholds were slain by the inhabitants of the strongholds.
target: King Tolimi dai di taad die afta, an dem we did de ina im chrangold dem did slie bai di inabitant dem a di chrangold dem.

en: Demetrius became king in the one hundred sixty-seventh year.
target: Dimetrios get king ina di wan ondred siksti-sevent ier.

en: In those days Jonathan gathered together the Judeans to take the citadel that was at Jerusalem. He made many engines of war to use against it.
target: Ina dem die de Jonatan gyada tugyeda di Juudian dem fi tek di sitadel we did de a Jeruusalem. Im mek nof enjin a waar fi yuuz gens it.

en: Some transgressors of the law who hated their own nation went to the king and reported to him that Jonathan was besieging the citadel.
target: Som chransgresa a di laa we iet dem uon nieshan go tu di king an ripuort tu im se Jonatan did a bisiij di sitadel.

en: He heard, and was angry, but when he heard it, he set out immediately, and came to Ptolemais, and wrote to Jonathan, that he should not besiege it, and that he should meet him and speak with him at Ptolemais with all speed.
target: Im ier, an get angri, bot wen im ier it, im set out kwik, an kom tu Tolimeis, an rait tu Jonatan, se im fi no bisiij it, an se im fi miit im an chat wid im a Tolimeis wid aal spiid.

en: But when Jonathan heard this, he gave orders to continue the siege. He chose some of the elders of Israel and of the priests, and put himself in peril
target: Bot wen Jonatan ier dis, im giiv aada fi kantinyu di siij. Im chuuz som a di elda dem a Izrel an a di priis dem, an put imself ina peril

en: by taking silver, gold, clothing, and various other presents, and went to Ptolemais to the king. Then he found favor in his sight.
target: bai tek silva, guol, kluodin, an vierios ada prezent, an go tu Tolimeis tu di king. Den im fain fieva ina im sait.

en: Some lawless men of those who were of the nation made complaints against him,
target: Som laalis man a dem we did a di nieshan mek komplient gens im,

en: and the king did to him even as his predecessors had done to him, and exalted him in the sight of all his friends,
target: an di king du tu im iivn az im predisesa dem did du tu im, an egzalt im ina di sait a aal im fren dem,

en: and confirmed to him the high priesthood, and all the other honors that he had before, and gave him preeminence among his chief friends.
target: an kanform tu im di ai priishud, an aal di ada ana dem we im did av bifuor, an giiv im prieminens mongst im chiif fren dem.

en: And Jonathan requested of the king that he would make Judea free from tribute, along with the three provinces and the country of Samaria, and promised him three hundred talents.
target: An Jonatan rikwes fram di king se im fi mek Juudia frii fram chribyuut, alang wid di trii pravins an di konchri a Samieria, an pramis im trii ondred talent.

en: The king consented, and wrote letters to Jonathan concerning all these things as follows:
target: Di king kansent, an rait leta tu Jonatan bout aal dem ting ya az fala:

en: “King Demetrius to his brother Jonathan, and to the nation of the Jews, greetings.
target: “King Dimetrios tu im breda Jonatan, an tu di nieshan a di Juu dem, griitin.

en: The copy of the letter which we wrote to Lasthenes our kinsman concerning you, we have written also to you, that you may see it.
target: Di kapi a di leta we wi rait tu Lasteniiz wi kinzman bout unu, wi rait tu unu tu, so unu kyan si it.

en: ‘King Demetrius to Lasthenes his father, greetings.
target: ‘King Dimetrios tu Lasteniiz im faada, griitin.

en: We have determined to do good to the nation of the Jews, who are our friends, and observe what is just toward us, because of their good will toward us.
target: Wi ditermin fi du gud tu di nieshan a di Juu dem, uu a wi fren, an obsorv wa a jos tuwad wi, bikaaz a dem gud wil tuwad wi.

en: We have confirmed therefore to them the borders of Judea, and also the three governments of Aphaerema, Lydda, and Ramathaim (these were added to Judea from the country of Samaria), and all their territory to them, for all who do sacrifice in Jerusalem, instead of the king’s dues which the king received of them yearly before from the produce of the earth and the fruits of trees.
target: Wi kanform so tu dem di baada dem a Juudia, an di trii govnment a Afiriima, Lida, an Ramatayim tu (dem ya did ad tu Juudia fram di konchri a Samieria), an aal dem teritri tu dem, fi aal uu du sakrifais ina Jeruusalem, insted a di king dyuu dem we di king risiv fram dem ierli bifuor fram di prodjuus a di ort an di fruut dem a chrii.

en: As for the other payments to us from henceforth, of the tithes and the taxes that pertain to us, and the salt pits, and the crown taxes due to us, all these we will give back to them.
target: Fi di ada piemant dem tu wi fram nou aan, a di taid dem an di taks dem we patien tu wi, an di saalt pit dem, an di kroun taks dem dyuu tu wi, aal a dem wi wi giiv bak tu dem.

en: Not one of these grants will be annulled from this time forth and forever.
target: Not wan a dem grant ya wi get anol fram dis taim forwad an fareva.

en: Now therefore be careful to make a copy of these things, and let it be given to Jonathan, and let it be set up on the holy mountain in a suitable and conspicuous place.’ ”
target: Nou so bi kierful fi mek a kapi a dem ting ya, an mek it giiv tu Jonatan, an mek it set op pan di uoli mountn ina a suutabl an kanspikiuos plies.’ ”

en: When King Demetrius saw that the land was quiet before him, and that no resistance was made to him, he sent away all his troops, each man to his own place, except the foreign troops, which he had raised from the islands of the Gentiles. So all the troops of his fathers hated him.
target: Wen King Dimetrios si se di lan did kwaiet bifuor im, an se no rezistans no mek tu im, im sen we aal im chruup dem, iich man tu im uon plies, eksep di farin chruup dem, we im did riez fram di ailan dem a di Jentailz. So aal di chruup dem a im faada dem iet im.

en: Now Tryphon was one of those who previously had been on Alexander’s side, and he saw that all the forces murmured against Demetrius. So he went to Imalcue the Arabian, who was raising up Antiochus the young child of Alexander,
target: Nou Traifon did a wan a dem we priiviosli did de pan Alekanda said, an im si se aal di fuos dem did a morma gens Dimetrios. So im go tu Imalkue di Ariebian, uu did a riez op Antiokos di yong pikni a Alekanda,

en: and urgently insisted to him that he should deliver him to him, that he might reign in his father’s place. He told him all that Demetrius had done, and the hatred with which his forces hated him; and he stayed there many days.
target: an orjantli insist tu im se im fi diliva im tu im, so im kyan rien ina im faada plies. Im tel im aal we Dimetrios did du, an di ietrid we im fuos dem iet im wid; an im stie de nof die.

en: Now Jonathan sent to King Demetrius, that he should remove the troops of the citadel from Jerusalem, and the troops who were in the strongholds; for they fought against Israel continually.
target: Nou Jonatan sen tu King Dimetrios, se im fi rimuuv di chruup dem a di sitadel fram Jeruusalem, an di chruup dem we did de ina di chrangold dem; kaa dem fait gens Izrel kantinyuali.

en: Demetrius sent to Jonathan, saying, “I will not only do this for you and your nation, but I will greatly honor you and your nation, if I find an opportunity.
target: Dimetrios sen tu Jonatan, an se, “Mi wi no ongl du dis fi yu an yu nieshan, bot mi wi grietli ana yu an yu nieshan, ef mi fain a apachuuniti.

en: Now therefore you will do well if you send me men who will fight for me; for all my forces have revolted.”
target: Nou so yu wi du wel ef yu sen mi man uu wi fait fi mi; kaa aal mi fuos dem rivolt.”

en: So Jonathan sent him three thousand valiant men to Antioch. They came to the king, and the king was glad at their coming.
target: So Jonatan sen im trii tauzan valiant man tu Antiok. Dem kom tu di king, an di king did glad a dem komin.

en: The people of the city gathered themselves together into the midst of the city, to the number of one hundred and twenty thousand men, and they wanted to kill the king.
target: Di piipl a di siti gyada demself tugyeda ina di migl a di siti, tu di nomba a wan ondred an twenti tauzan man, an dem waahn fi kil di king.

en: The king fled into the court of the palace, and the people of the city seized the main streets of the city and began to fight.
target: Di king ron go ina di kuot a di palas, an di piipl a di siti siiz di mien chriit dem a di siti an bigin fi fait.

en: The king called the Jews to help him, and they were gathered together to him all at once, and they dispersed themselves in the city, and killed that day about one hundred thousand.
target: Di king kaal di Juu dem fi elp im, an dem gyada tugyeda tu im aal a wan taim, an dem skyata demself ina di siti, an kil dat die about wan ondred tauzan.

en: They set the city on fire, and seized many spoils that day, and saved the king.
target: Dem set di siti pan faiya, an siiz nof spail dat die, an siev di king.

en: The people of the city saw that the Jews had taken control of the city as they pleased, and they became faint in their hearts, and they cried out to the king with supplication, saying,
target: Di piipl a di siti si se di Juu dem did tek kanchruol a di siti az dem pliiz, an dem get fient ina dem aat, an dem krai out tu di king wid soplikieshan, an se,

en: “Give us your right hand, and let the Jews cease from fighting against us and the city.”
target: “Giiv wi yu rait an, an mek di Juu dem tap fait gens wi an di siti.”

en: They threw away their weapons and made peace. The Jews were glorified in the sight of the king, and before all who were in his kingdom. Then they returned to Jerusalem, having much plunder.
target: Dem chruo we dem wepan an mek piis. Di Juu dem did gluorifai ina di sait a di king, an bifuor aal uu did de ina im kindom. Den dem ton bak tu Jeruusalem, an av nof plonda.

en: So King Demetrius sat on the throne of his kingdom, and the land was quiet before him.
target: So King Dimetrios siddong pan di chruon a im kindom, an di lan did kwaiet bifuor im.

en: He lied in all that he spoke, and estranged himself from Jonathan, and didn’t repay him according to the benefits with which he had repaid him, and treated him very harshly.
target: Im lai ina aal we im chat, an get eschrienj fram Jonatan, an no ripie im akordin tu di benefit dem we im did ripie im wid, an chriit im veri aarsh.

en: Now after this, Tryphon returned, and with him the young child Antiochus, who reigned and put on a crown.
target: Nou afta dis, Traifon ton bak, an wid im di yong pikni Antiokos, uu rien an put aan a kroun.

en: All the forces which Demetrius had sent away with disgrace were gathered to him, and they fought against him, and he fled and was routed.
target: Aal di fuos dem we Dimetrios did sen we wid disgriec gyada tu im, an dem fait gens im, an im ron we an did rout.

en: Tryphon took the elephants, and took control of Antioch.
target: Traifon tek di elifant dem, an tek kanchruol a Antiok.

en: The young Antiochus wrote to Jonathan, saying, “I confirm to you the high priesthood, and appoint you over the four districts, and to be one of the king’s friends.”
target: Di yong Antiokos rait tu Jonatan, an se, “Mi kanform tu yu di ai priishud, an apaint yu ouva di fuor dischrik, an fi bi wan a di king fren dem.”

en: He sent to him golden vessels and furniture for the table, and gave him permission to drink in golden vessels, and to be clothed in purple, and to have a golden buckle.
target: Im sen tu im guoln vesl an fornicha fi di tiebl, an giiv im pamishan fi drink ina guoln vesl, an fi kluoz ina porpl, an fi av a guoln bokl.

en: He made his brother Simon governor from the Ladder of Tyre to the borders of Egypt.
target: Im mek im breda Saiman govna fram di Lada a Taiya tu di baada dem a Iijipt.

en: Jonathan went out and took his journey beyond the river and through the cities. All the forces of Syria gathered themselves to him to be his allies. He came to Ascalon, and the people of the city met him honorably.
target: Jonatan go out an tek im jorni biyaand di riva an chruu di siti dem. Aal di fuos dem a Siiria gyada demself tu im fi bi im alai dem. Im kom tu Askalan, an di piipl a di siti miit im anarabli.

en: He departed from there to Gaza, and the people of Gaza shut him out. So he besieged it and burned its pasture lands with fire, and plundered them.
target: Im go we fram de tu Gaaza, an di piipl a Gaaza shot im out. So im bisiij it an bon it paascha lan dem wid faiya, an plonda dem.

en: The people of Gaza pleaded with Jonathan, and he gave them his right hand, and took the sons of their princes for hostages, and sent them away to Jerusalem. Then he passed through the country as far as Damascus.
target: Di piipl a Gaaza beg Jonatan, an im giiv dem im rait an, an tek di son dem a dem prins fi astij, an sen dem we tu Jeruusalem. Den im paas chruu di konchri az faar az Damaskos.

en: Then Jonathan heard that Demetrius’ princes had come to Kedesh, which is in Galilee, with a great army, intending to remove him from his office.
target: Den Jonatan ier se Dimetrios prins dem did kom tu Kiedesh, we de ina Gyalalii, wid a griet aami, an intend fi rimuuv im fram im afis.

en: He went to meet them, but he left Simon his brother in the country.
target: Im go fi miit dem, bot im lef Saiman im breda ina di konchri.

en: Simon encamped against Bethsura, and fought against it many days, and hemmed it in.
target: Saiman set op kamp gens Betsuura, an fait gens it nof die, an em it in.

en: They asked him to give them his right hand, and he gave it to them. He removed them from there, took possession of the city, and set a garrison over it.
