target: Dem aks im fi giiv dem im rait an, an im giiv it tu dem. Im rimuuv dem fram de, tek ouva di siti, an set a gyarison ouva it.

en: Jonathan and his army encamped at the water of Gennesareth, and early in the morning they marched to the plain of Hazor.
target: Jonatan an im aami set op kamp a di waata a Genesaaret, an orli ina di maanin dem maach tu di plien a Heizaar.

en: See, an army of foreigners met him in the plain. They laid an ambush for him in the mountains, but they themselves met him face to face.
target: Si, a aami a farina miit im ina di plien. Dem set a ambush fi im ina di mountn dem, bot dem demself miit im fies tu fies.

en: But those who lay in ambush rose out of their places and joined battle. All those who were on Jonathan’s side fled.
target: Bot dem we did a aid ina ambush kom op out a dem plies an jain batl. Aal dem we did pan Jonatan said ron we.

en: Not one of them was left, except Mattathias the son of Absalom, and Judas the son of Chalphi, captains of the forces.
target: Not wan a dem did lef, eksep Matataias di son a Absalom, an Juudas di son a Kalfi, kyaptin dem a di fuos dem.

en: Jonathan tore his clothes, put dirt on his head, and prayed.
target: Jonatan tier im kluoz, put dort pan im ed, an prie.

en: He turned again to them in battle, and routed them, and they fled.
target: Im ton agen tu dem ina batl, an rout dem, an dem ron we.

en: When the men on his side who had fled saw this, they returned to him and pursued with him to Kedesh to their camp, and they encamped there.
target: Wen di man dem pan im said we did ron we si dis, dem ton bak tu im an fala wid im tu Kiedesh tu dem kamp, an dem set op kamp de.

en: About three thousand men of the foreigners fell on that day. Then Jonathan returned to Jerusalem.
target: About trii tauzan man a di farina dem faal pan dat die. Den Jonatan ton bak tu Jeruusalem.

en: Jonathan saw that the time was favorable for him, so he chose men and sent them to Rome to confirm and renew the friendship that they had with them.
target: Jonatan si se di taim did fievarabl fi im, so im chuuz man an sen dem tu Ruom fi kanform an rinyuu di frenship we dem did av wid dem.

en: He also sent similar letters to the Spartans, and to other places.
target: Im sen simila leta tu di Spaatan dem tu, an tu ada plies.

en: They went to Rome, entered into the senate house, and said, “Jonathan the high priest and the nation of the Jews have sent us to renew for them the friendship and the alliance, as in former time.”
target: Dem go tu Ruom, go ina di senet ous, an se, “Jonatan di ai priis an di nieshan a di Juu dem sen wi fi rinyuu fi dem di frenship an di alaians, az ina faama taim.”

en: They gave them letters to the men in every place, that they should provide safe conduct for them on their way to the land of Judah.
target: Dem giiv dem leta tu di man dem ina ebri plies, so dem fi provaid sief kondokt fi dem pan dem wie tu di lan a Juuda.

en: This is the copy of the letters which Jonathan wrote to the Spartans:
target: Dis a di kapi a di leta dem we Jonatan rait tu di Spaatan dem:

en: “Jonathan the high priest, and the council of elders of the nation, and the priests, and the rest of the people of the Jews, to their brothers the Spartans, greetings.
target: “Jonatan di ai priis, an di kounsl a elda dem a di nieshan, an di priis dem, an di res a di piipl a di Juu dem, tu dem breda di Spaatan dem, griitin.

en: Even before this time letters were sent to Onias the high priest from Arius, who was reigning among you, to signify that you are our brothers, as the copy written below shows.
target: Iivn bifuor dis taim leta did sen tu Onaias di ai priis fram Ierios, uu did a rien mongst unu, fi signifai se unu a wi breda, az di kapi we rait biluo shuo.

en: Onias welcomed honorably the man who was sent and received the letters, in which declaration was made of alliance and friendship.
target: Onaias welkom anarabli di man we did sen an risiv di leta dem, ina wech deklarieshan did mek a alaians an frenship.

en: Therefore we also, even though we need none of these things, having for our encouragement the holy books which are in our hands,
target: So wi tu, iivn duo wi no niid non a dem ting ya, an av fi wi enkorijment di uoli buk dem we de ina wi an,

en: have undertaken to send that we might renew our brotherhood and friendship with you, to the end that we should not become estranged from you altogether; for a long time has passed since you sent your letter to us.
target: tek aan fi sen so wi kyan rinyuu wi bredahud an frenship wid unu, tu di en se wi fi no get eschrienj fram unu aaltugyeda; kaa a lang taim paas sins unu sen unu leta tu wi.

en: We therefore at all times without ceasing, both in our feasts, and on the other appointed days, remember you in the sacrifices which we offer, and in our prayers, as it is right and proper to be mindful of brothers.
target: Wi so a aal taim widout tap, buot ina wi fiis dem, an pan di ada apaintid die dem, memba unu ina di sakrifais dem we wi aafa, an ina wi prier dem, az it rait an prapa fi bi mainful a breda.

en: Moreover, we are glad for your glory.
target: Muorouva, wi glad fi unu gluori.

en: But as for ourselves, many afflictions and many wars have encompassed us, and the kings who are around us have fought against us.
target: Bot fi wiself, nof aflikshan an nof waar soroum wi, an di king dem we de roun wi fait gens wi.

en: We were unwilling to be troublesome to you, and to the rest of our allies and friends, in these wars;
target: Wi did no waahn fi chrobl unu, an di res a wi alai an fren dem, ina dem waar ya;

en: for we have the help which is from heaven to help us, and we have been delivered from our enemies, and our enemies have been humbled.
target: kaa wi av di elp we kom fram evn fi elp wi, an wi did diliva fram wi enimi dem, an wi enimi dem did ombl.

en: We chose therefore Numenius the son of Antiochus and Antipater the son of Jason, and have sent them to the Romans, to renew the friendship that we had with them, and the former alliance.
target: Wi chuuz so Nyuuminios di son a Antiokos an Antipata di son a Jiesn, an sen dem tu di Ruoman dem, fi rinyuu di frenship we wi did av wid dem, an di faama alaians.

en: We commanded them therefore to go also to you, and to salute you, and to deliver you our letters concerning the renewing of friendship and our brotherhood.
target: Wi komaan dem so fi go tu unu tu, an fi salyuut unu, an fi diliva tu unu wi leta dem bout di rinyuuin a frenship an wi bredahud.

en: And now you will do well if you give us a reply.”
target: An nou unu wi du wel ef unu giiv wi a riplai.”

en: And this is the copy of the letters which they sent to Onias:
target: An dis a di kapi a di leta dem we dem sen tu Onaias:

en: “Arius king of the Spartans to Onias the chief priest, greetings.
target: “Ierios king a di Spaatan dem tu Onaias di chiif priis, griitin.

en: It has been found in writing, concerning the Spartans and the Jews, that they are brothers, and that they are of the descendants of Abraham.
target: It fain ina raitin, bout di Spaatan dem an di Juu dem, se dem a breda, an se dem a a di desendant dem a Iebraham.

en: Now, since this has come to our knowledge, you will do well to write to us of your prosperity.
target: Nou, sins dis kom tu wi nalij, unu wi du wel fi rait tu wi bout unu prasperiti.

en: We moreover write on our part to you, that your livestock and goods are ours, and ours are yours. We do command therefore that they make report to you accordingly.”
target: Wi muorouva rait pan wi paat tu unu, se unu laivstok an gud a wi uon, an wi uon a unu uon. Wi komaan so se dem fi mek ripuort tu unu akordinli.”

en: Now Jonathan heard that Demetrius’ princes had returned to fight against him with a greater army than before,
target: Nou Jonatan ier se Dimetrios prins dem did ton bak fi fait gens im wid a grieta aami dan bifuor,

en: so he marched away from Jerusalem, and met them in the country of Hamath; for he gave them no opportunity to set foot in his country.
target: so im maach we fram Jeruusalem, an miit dem ina di konchri a Hamat; kaa im giiv dem no apachuuniti fi set fut ina im konchri.

en: He sent spies into his camp, and they came again, and reported to him that they were preparing to attack them at night.
target: Im sen spai ina im kamp, an dem kom agen, an ripuort tu im se dem did a pripier fi atak dem a nait.

en: But as soon as the sun was down, Jonathan commanded his men to watch, and to be armed, that all the night long they might be ready for battle. He stationed sentinels around the camp.
target: Bot az suun az di son go dong, Jonatan komaan im man dem fi wach, an fi bi aam, so aal di nait lang dem kyan redi fi batl. Im stieshan sentinl roun di kamp.

en: The adversaries heard that Jonathan and his men were ready for battle, and they feared, and trembled in their hearts, and they kindled fires in their camp then withdrew.
target: Di advesari dem ier se Jonatan an im man dem did redi fi batl, an dem fraitn, an chrembl ina dem aat, an dem kindl faiya ina dem kamp den lef.

en: But Jonathan and his men didn’t know it until the morning; for they saw the fires burning.
target: Bot Jonatan an im man dem no nuo it til di maanin; kaa dem si di faiya dem a bon.

en: Jonathan pursued after them, but didn’t overtake them; for they had gone over the river Eleutherus.
target: Jonatan fala afta dem, bot no ouva tek dem; kaa dem did go ouva di riva Eluuteros.

en: Then Jonathan turned toward the Arabians, who are called Zabadaeans, and struck them, and took their spoils.
target: Den Jonatan ton tuwad di Ariebian dem, uu kaal Zabadiian dem, an chraik dem, an tek dem spail.

en: He came out from there, and came to Damascus, and took his journey through all the country.
target: Im kom out fram de, an kom tu Damaskos, an tek im jorni chruu aal di konchri.

en: Simon went out, and took his journey as far as Ascalon, and the strongholds that were near it. Then he turned toward Joppa and took possession of it;
target: Saiman go out, an tek im jorni az faar az Askalan, an di chrangold dem we did nier it. Den im ton tuwad Jopa an tek ouva it;

en: for he had heard that they were planning to hand over the stronghold to Demetrius’ men. He set a garrison there to guard it.
target: kaa im did ier se dem did a plan fi an ouva di chrangold tu Dimetrios man dem. Im set a gyarison de fi gyaad it.

en: Then Jonathan returned and called the elders of the people together. He planned with them to build strongholds in Judea,
target: Den Jonatan ton bak an kaal di elda dem a di piipl tugyeda. Im plan wid dem fi bil chrangold ina Juudia,

en: and to make the walls of Jerusalem higher, and to raise a great mound between the citadel and the city, to separate it from the city, that so it might be isolated, that its garrison might neither buy nor sell.
target: an fi mek di waal dem a Jeruusalem aiya, an fi riez a griet mound bitwiin di sitadel an di siti, fi separeit it fram di siti, so it kyan aisoliet, so it gyarison kyan no bai ar sel.

en: They were gathered together to build the city. Part of the wall of the brook that is on the east side had fallen down, and he repaired the section called Chaphenatha.
target: Dem gyada tugyeda fi bil di siti. Paat a di waal a di brok we de pan di iis said did faal dong, an im ripier di sekshan kaal Kafenata.

en: Simon also built Adida in the plain country, made it strong, and set up gates and bars.
target: Saiman bil Adiida ina di plien konchri tu, mek it chrang, an set op giet an baar.

en: And Tryphon sought to reign over Asia and to crown himself, and to stretch out his hand against Antiochus the king.
target: An Traifon siik fi rien ouva Iezha an fi kroun imself, an fi chrech out im an gens Antiokos di king.

en: He was afraid that Jonathan wouldn’t allow him, and that he would fight against him; and he sought a way to seize him, that he might destroy him. So he marched out and came to Bethshan.
target: Im fraitn se Jonatan wudn alou im, an se im wuda fait gens im; an im siik a wie fi siiz im, so im kyan dichroi im. So im maach out an kom tu Betshan.

en: Jonathan came out to meet him with forty thousand men chosen for battle, and came to Bethshan.
target: Jonatan kom out fi miit im wid faati tauzan man chuozn fi batl, an kom tu Betshan.

en: Tryphon saw that he came with a great army, and he was afraid to stretch out his hand against him.
target: Traifon si se im kom wid a griet aami, an im fraitn fi chrech out im an gens im.

en: He received him honorably, and commended him to all his friends, and gave him gifts, and commanded his forces to be obedient to him, as to himself.
target: Im risiv im anarabli, an komend im tu aal im fren dem, an giiv im gif, an komaan im fuos dem fi obe im, az tu imself.

en: He said to Jonathan, “Why have you put all these people to so much trouble, seeing there is no war between us?
target: Im se tu Jonatan, “Wai yu put aal dem piipl ya tu so moch chrobl, an si no waar no de bitwiin wi?

en: Now send them away to their homes, but choose for yourself a few men who will be with you, and come with me to Ptolemais, and I will give it to you, and the rest of the strongholds and the rest of the forces, and all the king’s officers. Then I will turn around and depart; for this is why I came.”
target: Nou sen dem we tu dem uom, bot chuuz fi yuself a fyuu man uu wi de wid yu, an kom wid mi tu Tolimeis, an mi wi giiv it tu yu, an di res a di chrangold dem an di res a di fuos dem, an aal di king afisa dem. Den mi wi ton roun an go we; kaa a dis mek mi kom.”

en: He put his trust in him, and did even as he said, and sent away his forces, and they departed into the land of Judah.
target: Im put im chros ina im, an du iivn az im se, an sen we im fuos dem, an dem go we ina di lan a Juuda.

en: But he reserved to himself three thousand men, of whom he left two thousand in Galilee, but one thousand went with him.
target: Bot im rizaav tu imself trii tauzan man, a uu im lef tuu tauzan ina Gyalalii, bot wan tauzan go wid im.

en: Now as soon as Jonathan entered into Ptolemais, the people of Ptolemais shut the gates and seized him. They killed all those who came in with him with the sword.
target: Nou az suun az Jonatan go ina Tolimeis, di piipl a Tolimeis shot di giet dem an siiz im. Dem kil aal dem we kom in wid im wid di suod.

en: Tryphon sent troops and cavalry into Galilee, and into the Great Plain, to destroy all Jonathan’s men.
target: Traifon sen chruup an aasman ina Gyalalii, an ina di Griet Plien, fi dichroi aal Jonatan man dem.

en: They perceived that he had been seized and had perished, along with those who were with him. They encouraged one another and went on their way close together, prepared to fight.
target: Dem si se im did kech an ded, alang wid dem we did wid im. Dem enkorij wan anada an go pan dem wie klos tugyeda, pripier fi fait.

en: Those who followed them saw that they were ready to fight for their lives, and turned back again.
target: Dem we fala dem si se dem did redi fi fait fi dem laif, an ton bak agen.

en: They all came in peace into the land of Judah, and they mourned for Jonathan and those who were with him, and they were very afraid. All Israel mourned with a great mourning.
target: Dem aal kom ina piis ina di lan a Juuda, an dem mourn fi Jonatan an dem we did wid im, an dem fraitn bad. Aal Izrel mourn wid a griet mournin.

en: And all the Gentiles who were around them sought to destroy them utterly; for they said, “They have no ruler nor anyone to help them. Now therefore let’s fight against them, and take away their memory from among men.”
target: An aal di Jentailz we did roun dem siik fi dichroi dem kompliitli; kaa dem se, “Dem no av no ruula nar enibadi fi elp dem. Nou so mek wi fait gens dem, an tek we dem memri fram mongst man.”

en: Simon heard that Tryphon had gathered together a mighty army to come into the land of Judah and destroy it utterly.
target: Saiman ier se Traifon did gyada tugyeda a maita aami fi kom ina di lan a Juuda an dichroi it kompliitli.

en: He saw that the people were trembling in great fear. So he went up to Jerusalem and gathered the people together.
target: Im si se di piipl did a chrembl ina griet fier. So im go op tu Jeruusalem an gyada di piipl tugyeda.

en: He encouraged them, and said to them, “You yourselves know all the things that I, my brothers, and my father’s house have done for the laws and the sanctuary, and the battles and the distresses which we have seen.
target: Im enkorij dem, an se tu dem, “Unuself nuo aal di ting dem we mi, mi breda dem, an mi faada ous du fi di laa dem an di sankchueri, an di batl dem an di dischres dem we wi si.

en: Because of this, all my brothers have perished for Israel’s sake, and I am left alone.
target: Bikaaz a dis, aal mi breda dem ded fi Izrel siek, an mi lef aluon.

en: Now be it far from me, that I should spare my own life in any time of affliction, for I am not better than my brothers.
target: Nou mek it faar fram mi, se mi fi spier mi uon laif ina eni taim a aflikshan, kaa mi no beta dan mi breda dem.

en: However, I will take vengeance for my nation, for the sanctuary, and for our wives and children, because all the Gentiles have gathered out of hatred to destroy us.”
target: Bot mi wi tek venjans fi mi nieshan, fi di sankchueri, an fi wi waif dem an pikni dem, bikaaz aal di Jentailz gyada out a ietrid fi dichroi wi.”

en: The spirit of the people revived as soon as they heard these words.
target: Di spirit a di piipl rivaiv az suun az dem ier dem wod ya.

en: They answered with a loud voice, saying, “You are our leader in the place of Judas and Jonathan your brothers.
target: Dem ansa wid a loud vais, an se, “Yu a wi liida ina di plies a Juudas an Jonatan yu breda dem.

en: Fight our battles, and we will do all that you tell us to do.”
target: Fait wi batl dem, an wi wi du aal we yu tel wi fi du.”

en: He gathered together all the men of war, and hurried to finish the walls of Jerusalem. He fortified it all around.
target: Im gyada tugyeda aal di man dem a waar, an ori fi finish di waal dem a Jeruusalem. Im mek dem chrang aal roun.

en: He sent Jonathan the son of Absalom, and with him a great army, to Joppa. He threw out those who were in it, and lived there.
target: Im sen Jonatan di son a Absalom, an wid im a griet aami, tu Jopa. Im chruo out dem we did de ina it, an liv de.

en: Tryphon left Ptolemais with a mighty army to enter into the land of Judah, and Jonathan was with him under guard.
target: Traifon lef Tolimeis wid a maita aami fi go ina di lan a Juuda, an Jonatan did wid im anda gyaad.

en: But Simon encamped at Adida, near the plain.
target: Bot Saiman set op kamp a Adiida, nier di plien.

en: Tryphon knew that Simon had risen up in the place of his brother Jonathan, and meant to join battle with him, so he sent ambassadors to him, saying,
target: Traifon nuo se Saiman did kom op ina di plies a im breda Jonatan, an miin fi jain batl wid im, so im sen ambasada tu im, an se,

en: “It is for money which Jonathan your brother owed to the king’s treasury, by reason of the offices which he had, that we are detaining him.
target: “A fi moni we Jonatan yu breda did uo tu di king chrejari, bikaaz a di afis dem we im did av, mek wi a ditien im.

en: Now send one hundred talents of silver and two of his sons for hostages, so that when he is released he may not revolt against us, and we will release him.”
target: Nou sen wan ondred talent a silva an tuu a im son dem fi astij, so wen im riliis im kyan no rivolt gens wi, an wi wi riliis im.”

en: Simon knew that they spoke to him deceitfully, but he sent to get the money and the children, so that he would not arouse great hostility among the people,
target: Saiman nuo se dem chat tu im disiitfuli, bot im sen fi get di moni an di pikni dem, so im wudn arauz griet astiliti mongst di piipl,

en: who might say, “Because I didn’t send him the money and the children, he perished.”
target: uu mait se, “Bikaaz mi no sen im di moni an di pikni dem, im ded.”

en: So he sent the children and the hundred talents, but Tryphon lied, and didn’t release Jonathan.
target: So im sen di pikni dem an di ondred talent, bot Traifon lai, an no riliis Jonatan.

en: After this, Tryphon came to invade the land and destroy it, and he went around by the way that leads to Adora. Simon and his army marched near him to every place, wherever he went.
target: Afta dis, Traifon kom fi invied di lan an dichroi it, an im go roun bai di wie we liid tu Aduora. Saiman an im aami maach nier im tu ebri plies, weebaso im go.

en: Now the people of the citadel sent to Tryphon ambassadors, urging him to come to them through the wilderness, and to send them food.
target: Nou di piipl a di sitadel sen ambasada tu Traifon, an orj im fi kom tu dem chruu di dezert, an fi sen dem fuud.

en: So Tryphon prepared all his cavalry to come, but on that night a very heavy snow fell, and he didn’t come because of the snow. He marched off and went into the land of Gilead.
target: So Traifon pripier aal im aasman fi kom, bot pan dat nait a veri evi snuo faal, an im no kom bikaaz a di snuo. Im maach aaf an go ina di lan a Giliad.

en: When he came near to Bascama, he killed Jonathan, and he was buried there.
target: Wen im kom nier tu Baskama, im kil Jonatan, an im beri de.

en: Then Tryphon turned back, and went away into his own land.
target: Den Traifon ton bak, an go we ina im uon lan.

en: Simon sent, and took the bones of Jonathan his brother, and buried him at Modin, the city of his fathers.
target: Saiman sen, an tek di buon dem a Jonatan im breda, an beri im a Muodin, di siti a im faada dem.

en: All Israel made great lamentation over him, and mourned for him many days.
target: Aal Izrel mek griet lamentieshan ouva im, an mourn fi im nof die.

en: Simon built a monument on the tomb of his father and his brothers, and raised it high so that it could be seen, with polished stone on the front and back.
target: Saiman bil a monyument pan di tuum a im faada an im breda dem, an riez it ai so it kud si, wid palish stuon pan di front an bak.

en: He also set up seven pyramids, one near another, for his father, his mother, and his four brothers.
target: Im set op sevn piramid tu, wan nier anada, fi im faada, im mada, an im fuor breda dem.

en: For these, he made an elaborate setting, erecting great pillars around them, and upon the pillars he made suits of armor for a perpetual memorial, and beside the suits of armor, he carved ships, so that they could be seen by all who sail on the sea.
target: Fi dem ya, im mek a elabaret setin, an put op griet pila roun dem, an pan di pila dem im mek suut a aama fi a papetyual memorial, an bisaid di suut dem a aama, im kaav ship, so dem kud si bai aal uu siel pan di sii.

en: This is the tomb which he made at Modin. It remains to this day.
target: Dis a di tuum we im mek a Muodin. It rimien tu tide.

en: Now Tryphon deceived the young King Antiochus and killed him,
target: Nou Traifon disiiv di yong King Antiokos an kil im,

en: and reigned in his place. He put on himself the crown of Asia and brought a great calamity upon the land.
target: an rien ina im plies. Im put aan imself di kroun a Iezha an bring a griet kalamiti pan di lan.

en: Simon built up the strongholds of Judea, and walled them all around with high towers, great walls, gates, and bars; and he stored food in the strongholds.
target: Saiman bil op di chrangold dem a Juudia, an waal dem aal roun wid ai towa, griet waal, giet, an baar; an im stuor fuud ina di chrangold dem.

en: Simon chose men, and sent to King Demetrius with a request that he grant the country an immunity, because all that Tryphon did was to plunder.
target: Saiman chuuz man, an sen tu King Dimetrios wid a rikwes se im fi grant di konchri a imyuuniti, bikaaz aal we Traifon du a plonda.

en: King Demetrius sent to him according to these words, and answered him, and wrote a letter to him, as follows:
target: King Dimetrios sen tu im akordin tu dem wod ya, an ansa im, an rait a leta tu im, az fala:

en: “King Demetrius to Simon the high priest and friend of kings, and to the elders and nation of the Jews, greetings.
target: “King Dimetrios tu Saiman di ai priis an fren a king dem, an tu di elda dem an nieshan a di Juu dem, griitin.

en: The golden crown and the palm branch, which you sent, we have received. We are ready to make a steadfast peace with you, yes, and to write to our officers to release you from tribute.
target: Di guoln kroun an di paam branch, we unu sen, wi risiv. Wi redi fi mek a stedfaas piis wid unu, yes, an fi rait tu wi afisa dem fi riliis unu fram chribyuut.

en: Whatever things we confirmed to you, they are confirmed. The strongholds, which you have built, let them be your own.
target: Eniting we wi kanform tu unu, dem kanform. Di chrangold dem, we unu bil, mek dem bi unu uon.

en: As for any oversights and faults committed to this day, we forgive them, and the crown tax which you owed us. If there were any other tax collected in Jerusalem, let it be collected no longer.
target: Fi eni ouvasait an faalt we komit tu tide, wi fagiiv dem, an di kroun taks we unu did uo wi. Ef eni ada taks did kalek ina Jeruusalem, mek it no kalek no langa.

en: If any among you are qualified to be enrolled in our court, let them be enrolled, and let there be peace between us.”
target: Ef eni mongst unu kwalifai fi inruol ina wi kuot, mek dem inruol, an mek piis de bitwiin wi.”

en: In the one hundred seventieth year, the yoke of the Gentiles was taken away from Israel.
target: Ina di wan ondred seventiit ier, di yuok a di Jentailz did tek we fram Izrel.

en: The people began to write in their instruments and contracts, “In the first year of Simon, the great high priest and captain and leader of the Jews.”
target: Di piipl bigin fi rait ina dem inchrument an kanchrak, “Ina di fos ier a Saiman, di griet ai priis an kyaptin an liida a di Juu dem.”

en: In those days Simon encamped against Gazara, and surrounded it with troops. He made a siege engine, and brought it up to the city, and struck a tower, and captured it.
target: Ina dem die de Saiman set op kamp gens Gazaara, an soroum it wid chruup. Im mek a siij enjin, an bring it op tu di siti, an chraik a towa, an kyapcha it.

en: Those who were in the engine leaped out into the city; and there was a great uproar in the city.
target: Dem we did de ina di enjin liip out ina di siti; an a griet oproar did de ina di siti.

en: The people of the city tore their clothes, and went up on the walls with their wives and children, and cried with a loud voice, asking Simon to give them his right hand.
target: Di piipl a di siti tier dem kluoz, an go op pan di waal dem wid dem waif an pikni, an krai wid a loud vais, an aks Saiman fi giiv dem im rait an.

en: They said, “Don’t deal with us according to our wickednesses, but according to your mercy.”
target: Dem se, “No diil wid wi akordin tu wi wikidnis dem, bot akordin tu yu mersi.”

en: So Simon was reconciled to them, and didn’t fight against them; but he expelled them from the city and cleansed the houses where the idols were, and then entered into it with singing and giving praise.
target: So Saiman rekansail tu dem, an no fait gens dem; bot im ekspel dem fram di siti an klenz di ous dem we di aidol dem did de, an den go ina it wid singin an giiv priez.

en: He removed all uncleanness out of it, and placed in it men who would keep the law, and made it stronger than it was before, and built a dwelling place for himself in it.
target: Im rimuuv aal onkliinis out a it, an plies ina it man uu wuda kiip di laa, an mek it chranga dan it did bifuor, an bil a dwelin plies fi imself ina it.

en: But the people of the citadel in Jerusalem were hindered from going out and from going into the country, and from buying and selling. So they were very hungry, and a great number of them perished from famine.
target: Bot di piipl a di sitadel ina Jeruusalem did inda fram go out an fram go ina di konchri, an fram bai an sel. So dem did veri ongri, an a griet nomba a dem ded fram famin.

en: Then they cried out to Simon, that he should give them his right hand; and he gave it to them; but he expelled them from there, and he cleansed the citadel from its defilements.
target: Den dem krai out tu Saiman, se im fi giiv dem im rait an; an im giiv it tu dem; bot im ekspel dem fram de, an im klenz di sitadel fram it difailment dem.

en: He entered into it on the twenty-third day of the second month, in the one hundred seventy-first year, with praise and palm branches, with harps, with cymbals, and with stringed instruments, with hymns, and with songs, because a great enemy had been destroyed out of Israel.
target: Im go ina it pan di twenti-taad die a di sekan mont, ina di wan ondred seventi-fos ier, wid priez an paam branch, wid aap, wid simbal, an wid chring inchrument, wid im, an wid sang, bikaaz a griet enimi did dichroi out a Izrel.

en: Simon ordained that they should keep that day every year with gladness. He made the hill of the temple that was by the citadel stronger than before, and he lived there with his men.
target: Saiman aadein se dem fi kiip dat die ebri ier wid gladnis. Im mek di il a di templ we did bai di sitadel chranga dan bifuor, an im liv de wid im man dem.

en: Simon saw that his son John was a man, so he made him leader of all his forces; and he lived in Gazara.
target: Saiman si se im son Jan did a man, so im mek im liida a aal im fuos dem; an im liv ina Gazaara.

en: In the one hundred seventy-second year, King Demetrius gathered his forces together, and went into Media to get help, that he might fight against Tryphon.
target: Ina di wan ondred seventi-sekan ier, King Dimetrios gyada im fuos dem tugyeda, an go ina Miidia fi get elp, so im kyan fait gens Traifon.

en: When Arsaces, the king of Persia and Media, heard that Demetrius had come into his borders, he sent one of his princes to take him alive.
target: Wen Aasasiiz, di king a Persha an Miidia, ier se Dimetrios did kom ina im baada, im sen wan a im prins dem fi tek im alaiv.

en: He went and struck the army of Demetrius, and seized him and brought him to Arsaces, who put him under guard.
target: Im go an chraik di aami a Dimetrios, an siiz im an bring im tu Aasasiiz, uu put im anda gyaad.

en: The land had rest all the days of Simon. He sought the good of his nation. His authority and his honor was pleasing to them all his days.
target: Di lan get res aal di die dem a Saiman. Im siik di gud a im nieshan. Im atoriti an im ana did pliiz dem aal im die.

en: Amid all his honors, he took Joppa for a harbor, and made it an entrance for the islands of the sea.
target: Mongst aal im ana dem, im tek Jopa fi a aaba, an mek it a entranz fi di ailan dem a di sii.

en: He enlarged the borders of his nation and took possession of the country.
target: Im enlaaj di baada dem a im nieshan an tek ouva di konchri.

en: He gathered together a great number of captives, and took control of Gazara, Bethsura, and the citadel, and he removed its uncleannesses from it. There was no one who resisted him.
target: Im gyada tugyeda a griet nomba a kyaptiv, an tek kanchruol a Gazaara, Betsuura, an di sitadel, an im rimuuv it onkliinis dem fram it. No wan no did rezis im.

en: They tilled their land in peace, and the land gave her increase, and the trees of the plains gave their fruit.
target: Dem til dem lan ina piis, an di lan giiv aar inkriis, an di chrii dem a di plien dem giiv dem fruut.

en: The old men sat in the streets; they all conversed together about good things. The young men put on glorious and warlike apparel.
target: Di uol man dem sidong ina di chriit dem; dem aal chat tugyeda bout gud ting. Di yong man dem put aan gluorios an waarlaik kluoz.

en: He provided food for the cities and furnished them with means of defense, until the glory of his name was known to the end of the earth.
target: Im provaid fuud fi di siti dem an fornish dem wid miinz a difans, til di gluori a im niem did nuo tu di en a di ort.

en: He made peace in the land, and Israel rejoiced with great joy.
target: Im mek piis ina di lan, an Izrel rijais wid griet jai.

en: Each man sat under his vine and his fig tree, and there was no one to make them afraid.
target: Iich man sidong anda im vain an im fig chrii, an no wan no did de fi mek dem fraitn.

en: No one was left in the land who fought against them. The kings were defeated in those days.
target: No wan no did lef ina di lan uu fait gens dem. Di king dem did biit ina dem die de.

en: He strengthened all those of his people who were humble. He searched out the law, and every lawless and wicked person he took away.
target: Im chrentn aal dem a im piipl uu did ombl. Im saach out di laa, an ebri laalis an wikid poosn im tek we.

en: He glorified the sanctuary, and added to the vessels of the temple.
target: Im gluorifai di sankchueri, an ad tu di vesl dem a di templ.

en: It was heard at Rome that Jonathan was dead, and even in Sparta, and they were exceedingly grieved.
target: It ier a Ruom se Jonatan ded, an iivn ina Spaata, an dem griiv bad.

en: But as soon as they heard that his brother Simon was made high priest in his place, and ruled the country and the cities in it,
target: Bot az suun az dem ier se im breda Saiman did mek ai priis ina im plies, an ruul di konchri an di siti dem ina it,

en: they wrote to him on brass tablets to renew with him the friendship and the alliance which they had confirmed with his brothers Judas and Jonathan.
target: dem rait tu im pan braas tablet fi rinyuu wid im di frenship an di alaians we dem did kanform wid im breda dem Juudas an Jonatan.

en: These were read before the congregation at Jerusalem.
target: Dem ya did riid bifuor di kanggrigieshan a Jeruusalem.

en: This is the copy of the letter which the Spartans sent: “The rulers and the city of the Spartans, to Simon the high priest, to the elders, the priests, and the rest of the people of the Jews, our brothers, greetings.
target: Dis a di kapi a di leta we di Spaatan dem sen: “Di ruula dem an di siti a di Spaatan dem, tu Saiman di ai priis, tu di elda dem, di priis dem, an di res a di piipl a di Juu dem, wi breda, griitin.

en: The ambassadors who were sent to our people reported to us about your glory and honor. We were glad for their coming,
target: Di ambasada dem we did sen tu wi piipl ripuort tu wi bout unu gluori an ana. Wi did glad fi dem komin,

en: and we registered the things that were spoken by them in the public records as follows: ‘Numenius son of Antiochus, and Antipater son of Jason, the Jews’ ambassadors, came to us to renew the friendship they had with us.
target: an wi rejista di ting dem we dem chat bai dem ina di poblik rekaad az fala: ‘Nyuuminios son a Antiokos, an Antipata son a Jiesn, di Juu dem ambasada, kom tu wi fi rinyuu di frenship dem did av wid wi.

en: It pleased the people to entertain the men honorably, and to put the copy of their words in the public records, to the end that the people of the Spartans might have a record of them. Moreover they wrote a copy of these things to Simon the high priest.’ ”
target: It pliiz di piipl fi entatien di man dem anarabli, an fi put di kapi a dem wod ina di poblik rekaad, tu di en se di piipl a di Spaatan dem kyan av a rekaad a dem. Muorouva dem rait a kapi a dem ting ya tu Saiman di ai priis.’ ”

en: After this, Simon sent Numenius to Rome with a great shield of gold weighing one thousand minas, in order to confirm the alliance with them.
target: Afta dis, Saiman sen Nyuuminios tu Ruom wid a griet shiil a guol we wie wan tauzan maina, fi kanform di alaians wid dem.

en: But when the people heard these things, they said, “What thanks should we give to Simon and his sons?
target: Bot wen di piipl ier dem ting ya, dem se, “Wa tank wi fi giiv tu Saiman an im son dem?

en: For he and his brothers and the house of his father have made themselves strong, and have fought and chased away Israel’s enemies, and confirmed liberty to Israel.”
target: Kaa im an im breda dem an di ous a im faada mek demself chrang, an fait an chies we Izrel enimi dem, an kanform libati tu Izrel.”

en: So they wrote on tablets of brass, and set them on pillars on mount Zion. This is the copy of the writing: “On the eighteenth day of Elul, in the one hundred seventy-second year, which is the third year of Simon the high priest,
target: So dem rait pan tablet a braas, an set dem pan pila pan mount Zaian. Dis a di kapi a di raitin: “Pan di iitiint die a Ilul, ina di wan ondred seventi-sekan ier, we a di taad ier a Saiman di ai priis,

en: in Asaramel, in a great congregation of priests and people and princes of the nation, and of the elders of the country, it was proclaimed to us:
target: ina Asaramel, ina a griet kanggrigieshan a priis an piipl an prins a di nieshan, an a di elda dem a di konchri, it proklaim tu wi:

en: ‘Since wars often occurred in the country, Simon the son of Mattathias, the son of the sons of Joarib, and his brothers, put themselves in jeopardy and withstood the enemies of their nation, that their sanctuary and the law might be established, and glorified their nation with great glory.
target: ‘Sins waar ofn okor ina di konchri, Saiman di son a Matataias, di son a di son dem a Juoarib, an im breda dem, put demself ina jepadi an widstan di enimi dem a dem nieshan, so dem sankchueri an di laa kyan set op, an gluorifai dem nieshan wid griet gluori.

en: Jonathan rallied the nation, became their high priest, and was gathered to his people.
target: Jonatan rali di nieshan, get dem ai priis, an gyada tu im piipl.

en: Their enemies planned to invade their country, that they might destroy their country utterly, and stretch out their hands against their sanctuary.
target: Dem enimi plan fi invied dem konchri, so dem kyan dichroi dem konchri kompliitli, an chrech out dem an gens dem sankchueri.

en: Then Simon rose up and fought for his nation. He spent much of his own money to arm the valiant men of his nation and give them wages.
target: Den Saiman kom op an fait fi im nieshan. Im spen moch a im uon moni fi aam di valiant man dem a im nieshan an giiv dem wiej.

en: He fortified the cities of Judea and Bethsura that lies on the borders of Judea, where the weapons of the enemies had been stored, and there he placed a garrison of Jews.
target: Im mek di siti dem a Juudia chrang an Betsuura we lai pan di baada dem a Juudia, we di wepan dem a di enimi dem did stuor, an de im plies a gyarison a Juu dem.

en: He fortified Joppa which is upon the sea, and Gazara which is upon the borders of Azotus, where the enemies used to live, and placed Jews there, and set in there all things necessary for their restoration.
target: Im mek Jopa chrang we de pan di sii, an Gazaara we de pan di baada dem a Azotos, we di enimi dem yuus tu liv, an plies Juu dem de, an set ina de aal ting nesiseri fi dem restarieshan.

en: The people saw Simon’s faith, and the glory which he resolved to bring to his nation, and they made him their leader and high priest, because he had done all these things, and for the justice and the faith which he kept to his nation, and because he sought by all means to exalt his people.
target: Di piipl si Saiman fiet, an di gluori we im rizalv fi bring tu im nieshan, an dem mek im dem liida an ai priis, bikaaz im did du aal dem ting ya, an fi di jostis an di fiet we im kiip tu im nieshan, an bikaaz im siik bai aal miinz fi egzalt im piipl.

en: In his days, things prospered in his hands, so that the Gentiles were taken away out of their country, and they also who were in the city of David, those who were in Jerusalem, who had made themselves a citadel, out of which they used to go, and defiled everything around the sanctuary, and did great damage to its purity.
target: Ina im die, ting did prasper ina im an, so di Jentailz did tek we out a dem konchri, an dem tu uu did de ina di siti a Dievid, dem uu did de ina Jeruusalem, uu did mek demself a sitadel, out a wech dem yuus tu go, an difail ebriting roun di sankchueri, an du griet damij tu it pyuuriti.

en: He placed Jews in it and fortified it for the safety of the country and the city, and made high the walls of Jerusalem.
target: Im plies Juu dem ina it an mek it chrang fi di siefti a di konchri an di siti, an mek ai di waal dem a Jeruusalem.

en: King Demetrius confirmed to him the high priesthood according to these things,
target: King Dimetrios kanform tu im di ai priishud akordin tu dem ting ya,

en: and made him one of his friends, and honored him with great honor;
target: an mek im wan a im fren dem, an ana im wid griet ana;

en: for he had heard that the Jews had been called by the Romans friends, allies, and brothers, and that they had met the ambassadors of Simon honorably;
target: kaa im did ier se di Juu dem did kaal bai di Ruoman dem fren, alai, an breda, an se dem did miit di ambasada dem a Saiman anarabli;

en: and that the Jews and the priests were well pleased that Simon should be their leader and high priest forever, until there should arise a faithful prophet;
target: an se di Juu dem an di priis dem did wel pliiz se Saiman fi bi dem liida an ai priis fareva, til a fietful prafit fi kom op;

en: and that he should be governor over them, and should take charge of the sanctuary, to set them over their works, and over the country, and over the weapons, and over the strongholds; and that he should take charge of the sanctuary,
target: an se im fi bi govna ouva dem, an fi tek chaaj a di sankchueri, fi set dem ouva dem wok, an ouva di konchri, an ouva di wepan dem, an ouva di chrangold dem; an se im fi tek chaaj a di sankchueri,

en: and that he should be obeyed by all, and that all contracts in the country should be written in his name, and that he should be clothed in purple, and wear gold;
target: an se im fi obe bai aal, an se aal kanchrak ina di konchri fi rait ina im niem, an se im fi kluoz ina porpl, an wier guol;

en: and that it should not be lawful for any of the people or of the priests to nullify any of these things, or to oppose the words that he should speak, or to gather an assembly in the country without him, or to be clothed in purple, or wear a buckle of gold;
target: an se it fi no laaful fi eni a di piipl ar a di priis dem fi nolifai eni a dem ting ya, ar fi opuoz di wod dem we im fi chat, ar fi gyada a asembli ina di konchri widout im, ar fi kluoz ina porpl, ar wier a bokl a guol;

en: but whoever should do otherwise, or nullify any of these things, he will be liable to punishment.’ ”
target: bot uu eva fi du adaiz, ar nolifai eni a dem ting ya, im wi laiebl tu ponishment.’ ”

en: All the people consented to ordain for Simon that he should do according to these words.
target: Aal di piipl kansent fi aadein fi Saiman se im fi du akordin tu dem wod ya.

en: So Simon accepted this, and consented to be high priest, and to be captain and governor of the Jews and of the priests, and to be protector of all.
target: So Saiman aksep dis, an kansent fi bi ai priis, an fi bi kyaptin an govna a di Juu dem an a di priis dem, an fi bi protekta a aal.

en: They commanded to put this writing on tablets of brass, and to set them up within the precinct of the sanctuary in a conspicuous place,
target: Dem komaan fi put dis raitin pan tablet a braas, an fi set dem op widin di prisinkt a di sankchueri ina a kanspikiuos plies,

en: and moreover to put copies of them in the treasury, so that Simon and his sons might have them.
target: an muorouva fi put kapi a dem ina di chrejari, so Saiman an im son dem kyan av dem.

en: Antiochus son of Demetrius the king sent a letter from the islands of the sea to Simon the priest and governor of the Jews, and to all the nation.
target: Antiokos son a Dimetrios di king sen a leta fram di ailan dem a di sii tu Saiman di priis an govna a di Juu dem, an tu aal di nieshan.

en: Its contents follow: “King Antiochus to Simon the chief priest and governor, and to the nation of the Jews, greetings.
target: It kantent fala: “King Antiokos tu Saiman di chiif priis an govna, an tu di nieshan a di Juu dem, griitin.

en: Whereas certain troublemakers have made themselves masters of the kingdom of our fathers, but my purpose is to claim the kingdom, that I may restore it as it was before; and moreover I have raised a multitude of foreign soldiers, and have prepared warships;
target: Wieraz som chroblmeka mek demself maasta a di kindom a wi faada dem, bot mi porpos a fi kliem di kindom, so mi kyan ristuor it az it did bifuor; an muorouva mi riez nof farin suolja, an pripier waarship;

en: moreover I plan to land in the country, that I may punish those who have destroyed our country, and those who have made many cities in the kingdom desolate;
target: muorouva mi plan fi lan ina di konchri, so mi kyan ponish dem uu dichroi wi konchri, an dem uu mek nof siti ina di kindom desolet;

en: now therefore I confirm to you all the tax remissions which the kings who were before me remitted to you, and whatever gifts besides they remitted to you,
target: nou so mi kanform tu unu aal di taks rimishan dem we di king dem uu did bifuor mi rimit tu unu, an eni gif bisaid we dem rimit tu unu,

en: and I permit you to coin money for your country with your own stamp,
target: an mi pamit unu fi kain moni fi unu konchri wid unu uon stamp,

en: but that Jerusalem and the sanctuary should be free. All the weapons that you have prepared, and the strongholds that you have built, which you have in your possession, let them remain yours.
target: bot se Jeruusalem an di sankchueri fi bi frii. Aal di wepan dem we unu pripier, an di chrangold dem we unu bil, we unu av ina unu pozeshan, mek dem rimien unu uon.

en: Every debt owed to the king, and the things that will be owed to the king from henceforth and for evermore, let them be remitted to you.
target: Ebri det uo tu di king, an di ting dem we wi uo tu di king fram nou aan an fareva, mek dem rimit tu unu.

en: Moreover, when we have established our kingdom, we will glorify you and your nation and the temple with great glory, so that your glory will be made manifest in all the earth.
target: Muorouva, wen wi set op wi kindom, wi wi gluorifai unu an unu nieshan an di templ wid griet gluori, so unu gluori wi mek manifes ina aal di ort.

en: In the one hundred seventy-fourth year, Antiochus went into the land of his fathers; and all the forces came together to him, so that there were few men with Tryphon.
target: Ina di wan ondred seventi-fuor ier, Antiokos go ina di lan a im faada dem; an aal di fuos dem kom tugyeda tu im, so a fyuu man did de wid Traifon.

en: King Antiochus pursued him, and he came, as he fled, to Dor, which is by the sea;
target: King Antiokos fala im, an im kom, az im did a ron, tu Duor, we de bai di sii;

en: for he knew that troubles had come upon him all at once, and that his forces had deserted him.
target: kaa im nuo se chrobl did kom pan im aal a wan taim, an se im fuos dem did dizaat im.

en: Antiochus encamped against Dor, and with him one hundred twenty thousand men of war and eight thousand cavalry.
target: Antiokos set op kamp gens Duor, an wid im wan ondred twenti tauzan man a waar an iet tauzan aasman.

en: He surrounded the city, and the ships joined in the attack from the sea. He harassed the city by land and sea, and permitted no one to go out or in.
target: Im soroum di siti, an di ship dem jain ina di atak fram di sii. Im araas di siti bai lan an sii, an pamit no wan fi go out ar in.

en: Numenius and his company came from Rome, having letters to the kings and to the countries, in which were written these things:
target: Nyuuminios an im kompini kom fram Ruom, an av leta tu di king dem an tu di konchri dem, ina wech dem ting ya did rait:

en: “Lucius, consul of the Romans, to King Ptolemy, greetings.
target: “Luusios, kansol a di Ruoman dem, tu King Tolimi, griitin.

en: The Jews’ ambassadors came to us as our friends and allies, to renew the old friendship and alliance, being sent from Simon the high priest, and from the people of the Jews.
target: Di Juu dem ambasada kom tu wi az wi fren an alai, fi rinyuu di uol frenship an alaians, an sen fram Saiman di ai priis, an fram di piipl a di Juu dem.

en: Moreover they brought a shield of gold weighing one thousand minas.
target: Muorouva dem bring a shiil a guol we wie wan tauzan maina.

en: It pleased us therefore to write to the kings and to the countries, that they should not seek their harm or fight against them, their cities, and their country, or be allies with those who fight against them.
target: It pliiz wi so fi rait tu di king dem an tu di konchri dem, se dem fi no siik dem aarm ar fait gens dem, dem siti, an dem konchri, ar bi alai wid dem uu fait gens dem.

en: Moreover, it seemed good to us to receive the shield from them.
target: Muorouva, it siim gud tu wi fi risiv di shiil fram dem.

en: If therefore any troublemakers have fled from their country to you, deliver them to Simon the high priest, that he may take vengeance on them according to their law.”
target: Ef so eni chroblmeka ron we fram dem konchri tu unu, diliva dem tu Saiman di ai priis, so im kyan tek venjans pan dem akordin tu dem laa.”

en: He wrote the same things to King Demetrius, to Attalus, to Arathes, to Arsaces,
target: Im rait di siem ting dem tu King Dimetrios, tu Atalos, tu Aratiiz, tu Aasasiiz,

en: to all the countries, to Sampsames, to the Spartans, to Delos, to Myndos, to Sicyon, to Caria, to Samos, to Pamphylia, to Lycia, to Halicarnassus, to Rhodes, to Phaselis, to Cos, to Side, to Aradus, Gortyna, Cnidus, Cyprus, and Cyrene.
target: tu aal di konchri dem, tu Sampsamiiz, tu di Spaatan dem, tu Diilos, tu Mindos, tu Sision, tu Kieria, tu Samos, tu Pamfilia, tu Lisia, tu Alikanasos, tu Ruodz, tu Faselis, tu Kos, tu Saidi, tu Arados, Gaataina, Naidos, Saiprus, an Sairiini.

en: They also wrote this copy to Simon the high priest.
target: Dem rait dis kapi tu Saiman di ai priis tu.

en: But King Antiochus encamped against Dor the second day, bringing his forces up to it continually, and making engines of war; and he shut up Tryphon from going in or out.
target: Bot King Antiokos set op kamp gens Duor di sekan die, an bring im fuos dem op tu it kantinyuali, an mek enjin a waar; an im shot op Traifon fram go in ar out.

en: Simon sent him two thousand chosen men to fight on his side, with silver, gold, and instruments of war in abundance.
target: Saiman sen im tuu tauzan chuozn man fi fait pan im said, wid silva, guol, an inchrument a waar ina abundans.

en: He would not receive them, but nullified all the covenants which he had made with him before, and was estranged from him.
target: Im wudn no risiv dem, bot nolifai aal di kovnant dem we im did mek wid im bifuor, an get eschrienj fram im.

en: He sent to him Athenobius, one of his friends, to confer with him, saying, “You hold possession of Joppa, Gazara, and the citadel that is in Jerusalem, cities of my kingdom.
target: Im sen tu im Atenuobios, wan a im fren dem, fi kanfar wid im, an se, “Yu uol pozeshan a Jopa, Gazaara, an di sitadel we de ina Jeruusalem, siti dem a mi kindom.

en: You have devastated their territory, and done great harm in the land, and control many places in my kingdom.
target: Yu devestiet dem teritri, an du griet aarm ina di lan, an kanchruol nof plies ina mi kindom.

en: Now therefore hand over the cities which you have taken, and the tributes of the places which you have taken control of outside of the borders of Judea;
target: Nou so an ouva di siti dem we yu tek, an di chribyuut dem a di plies dem we yu tek kanchruol a outsaid a di baada dem a Juudia;

en: or else give me for them five hundred talents of silver; and for the harm that you have done, and the tributes of the cities, another five hundred talents. Otherwise we will come and subdue you.”
target: ar els giiv mi fi dem faiv ondred talent a silva; an fi di aarm we yu du, an di chribyuut dem a di siti dem, anada faiv ondred talent. Adaiz wi wi kom an sobdyuu yu.”

en: Athenobius, the king’s friend, came to Jerusalem. When he saw the glory of Simon, the cupboard of gold and silver vessels, and his great attendance, he was amazed. He reported to him the king’s words.
target: Atenuobios, di king fren, kom tu Jeruusalem. Wen im si di gluori a Saiman, di kobad a guol an silva vesl, an im griet atendans, im amiez. Im ripuort tu im di king wod dem.

en: Simon answered, and said to him, “We have not taken other men’s land nor do we have possession of that which belongs to others, but of the inheritance of our fathers. However, it had been in possession of our enemies wrongfully for a while.
target: Saiman ansa, an se tu im, “Wi no tek ada man lan nar wi av pozeshan a dat we bilang tu ada, bot a di ineritans a wi faada dem. Bot it did de ina pozeshan a wi enimi dem rangfuli fi a wail.

en: But we, having opportunity, firmly hold the inheritance of our fathers.
target: Bot wi, an av apachuuniti, faamli uol di ineritans a wi faada dem.

en: As for Joppa and Gazara, which you demand, they did great harm among the people throughout our country. We will give one hundred talents for them.” Athenobius didn’t answer even one word,
target: Fi Jopa an Gazaara, we yu dimaan, dem du griet aarm mongst di piipl chruuout wi konchri. Wi wi giiv wan ondred talent fi dem.” Atenuobios no ansa iivn wan wod,

en: but returned in a rage to the king, and reported to him these words, and the glory of Simon, and all that he had seen; and the king was exceedingly angry.
target: bot ton bak ina a riej tu di king, an ripuort tu im dem wod ya, an di gluori a Saiman, an aal we im did si; an di king get angri bad.

en: Meanwhile, Tryphon embarked on board a ship, and fled to Orthosia.
target: A di siem taim, Traifon go aan buord a ship, an ron go tu Aartuosia.

en: The king appointed Cendebaeus chief captain of the sea coast, and gave him troops of infantry and cavalry.
target: Di king apaint Kendebeos chiif kyaptin a di sii kuos, an giiv im chruup a fut suolja an aasman.

en: He commanded him to encamp against Judea, and he commanded him to build up Kidron, and to fortify the gates, and that he should fight against the people; but the king pursued Tryphon.
target: Im komaan im fi set op kamp gens Juudia, an im komaan im fi bil op Kidron, an fi mek di giet dem chrang, an se im fi fait gens di piipl; bot di king fala Traifon.

en: So Cendebaeus came to Jamnia and began to provoke the people, and to invade Judea, and to take the people captive and kill them.
target: So Kendebeos kom tu Jamnia an bigin fi provuok di piipl, an fi invied Juudia, an fi tek di piipl kyaptiv an kil dem.

en: He built Kidron and stationed cavalry and infantry there, to the end that going out they might make raids on the highways of Judea, as the king had commanded him.
target: Im bil Kidron an stieshan aasman an fut suolja de, tu di en se wen dem go out dem kyan mek ried pan di aiwie dem a Juudia, az di king did komaan im.

en: John went up from Gazara and told Simon his father what Cendebaeus was doing.
target: Jan go op fram Gazaara an tel Saiman im faada wa Kendebeos did a du.

en: Simon called his two oldest sons, Judas and John, and said to them, “I and my brothers and my father’s house have fought the battles of Israel from our youth, even to this day; and things have prospered in our hands, so that we have often delivered Israel.
target: Saiman kaal im tuu uoldest son dem, Juudas an Jan, an se tu dem, “Mi an mi breda dem an mi faada ous fait di batl dem a Izrel fram wi yuut, iivn tu tide; an ting did prasper ina wi an, so wi ofn diliva Izrel.

en: But now I am old, and you moreover, by his mercy, are of a sufficient age. Take the place of me and my brother, and go out and fight for our nation; and let the help which is from heaven be with you.
target: Bot nou mi uol, an unu muorouva, bai im mersi, a a sofisant iej. Tek di plies a mi an mi breda, an go out an fait fi wi nieshan; an mek di elp we kom fram evn de wid unu.

en: He chose out of the country twenty thousand men of war and cavalry, and they went against Cendebaeus, and slept at Modin.
target: Im chuuz out a di konchri twenti tauzan man a waar an aasman, an dem go gens Kendebeos, an sliip a Muodin.

en: Rising up in the morning, they went into the plain, and, see, a great army of infantry and cavalry came to meet them. There was a brook between them.
target: Dem kom op ina di maanin, go ina di plien, an, si, a griet aami a fut suolja an aasman kom fi miit dem. A brok did de bitwiin dem.

en: He encamped near them, he and his people. He saw that the people were afraid to pass over the brook, and he passed over first. When the men saw him, they passed over after him.
target: Im set op kamp nier dem, im an im piipl. Im si se di piipl fraitn fi paas ouva di brok, an im paas ouva fos. Wen di man dem si im, dem paas ouva afta im.

en: He divided the people, and placed the cavalry in the midst of the infantry; but the enemies’ cavalry were exceedingly many.
target: Im divaid di piipl, an plies di aasman dem ina di migl a di fut suolja dem; bot di enimi aasman dem did tuu nof.

en: They sounded the trumpets; and Cendebaeus and his army were put to flight, and many of them fell wounded to death, but those who were left fled to the stronghold.
target: Dem saund di chompit dem; an Kendebeos an im aami did put tu flait, an nof a dem faal wuund op tu det, bot dem we did lef ron go tu di chrangold.

en: At that time Judas, John’s brother, was wounded; but John pursued after them until he came to Kidron, which Cendebaeus had built.
target: A dat taim Juudas, Jan breda, did wuund; bot Jan fala afta dem til im kom tu Kidron, we Kendebeos did bil.

en: They fled to the towers that are in the fields of Azotus; and he burned them with fire. About two thousand men of them fell. Then he returned into Judea in peace.
target: Dem ron go tu di towa dem we de ina di fiil dem a Azotos; an im bon dem wid faiya. About tuu tauzan man a dem faal. Den im ton bak ina Juudia ina piis.

en: Ptolemy the son of Abubus had been appointed governor over the plain of Jericho, and he had much silver and gold;
target: Tolimi di son a Abuubos did apaint govna ouva di plien a Jeriko, an im did av nof silva an guol;

en: for he was the high priest’s son-in-law.
target: kaa im did a di ai priis son-in-laa.

en: His heart was lifted up, and he planned to make himself master of the country, and he made deceitful plans against Simon and his sons, to do away with them.
target: Im aat lif op, an im plan fi mek imself maasta a di konchri, an im mek disiitful plan gens Saiman an im son dem, fi du we wid dem.

en: Now Simon was visiting the cities that were in the country, and attending to their needs. He went down to Jericho—himself with Mattathias and Judas his sons—in the one hundred seventy-seventh year, in the eleventh month, which is the month Sebat.
target: Nou Saiman did a vizit di siti dem we did de ina di konchri, an a atend tu dem niid. Im go dong tu Jeriko — imself wid Matataias an Juudas im son dem — ina di wan ondred seventi-sevent ier, ina di ilevent mont, we a di mont Siibat.

en: The son of Abubus received them deceitfully into the little stronghold that is called Dok, which he had built, and made them a great banquet, and hid men there.
target: Di son a Abuubos risiv dem disiitfuli ina di likl chrangold we kaal Dok, we im did bil, an mek dem a griet bankwet, an aid man de.

en: When Simon and his sons had drunk freely, Ptolemy and his men rose up, took their weapons, rushed in against Simon in the banqueting place, and killed him, his two sons, and some of his servants.
target: Wen Saiman an im son dem did drink friili, Tolimi an im man dem kom op, tek dem wepan, rosh in gens Saiman ina di bankwetin plies, an kil im, im tuu son dem, an som a im saavant dem.

en: He committed a great sin, and repaid evil for good.
target: Im komit a griet sin, an ripie iivl fi gud.

en: Ptolemy wrote these things and sent to the king, that he should send him forces to aid him, and should deliver him their country and the cities.
target: Tolimi rait dem ting ya an sen tu di king, se im fi sen im fuos fi ied im, an fi diliva tu im dem konchri an di siti dem.

en: He sent others to Gazara to do away with John. To the captains of thousands, he sent letters to come to him, that he might give them silver, gold, and gifts.
target: Im sen ada tu Gazaara fi du we wid Jan. Tu di kyaptin dem a tauzan, im sen leta fi kom tu im, so im kyan giiv dem silva, guol, an gif.

en: He sent others to take possession of Jerusalem and the temple hill.
target: Im sen ada fi tek ouva Jeruusalem an di templ il.

en: One ran before to Gazara, and told John that his father and brothers had perished, and that he has sent to kill you also.
target: Wan ron bifuor tu Gazaara, an tel Jan se im faada an breda dem ded, an se im sen fi kil yu tu.

en: When he heard, he was greatly shocked. He seized the men who came to destroy him and killed them; for he perceived that they were seeking to destroy him.
target: Wen im ier, im shak bad. Im siiz di man dem we kom fi dichroi im an kil dem; kaa im si se dem did a siik fi dichroi im.

en: And the rest of the acts of John and of his wars and of his valiant deeds which he did, and of the building of the walls which he built, and of his achievements,
target: An di res a di akt dem a Jan an a im waar dem an a im valiant diid dem we im du, an a di bildin a di waal dem we im bil, an a im achiivment dem,

en: see, they are written in the chronicles of his high priesthood, from the time that he was made high priest after his father.
target: si, dem rait ina di kranikl dem a im ai priishud, fram di taim we im did mek ai priis afta im faada.

en: The brothers, the Jews who are in Jerusalem and those who are in the country of Judea, send greetings and good peace to the brothers, the Jews who are throughout Egypt.
target: Di breda dem, di Juu dem we de ina Jeruusalem an dem we de ina di kontri a Juudia, sen griitin an gud piis tu di breda dem, di Juu dem we de aal uova Iijipt.

en: May God do good to you, and remember his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, his faithful servants,
target: Mie Gad du gud tu unu, an memba im kovnant wid Iebraham, Aizak, an Jiekob, im fietful saavant dem,

en: and give you all a heart to worship him and do his will with a strong heart and a willing soul.
target: an giv unu aal wan aat fi worship im an du im wil wid wan strang aat an wan wilin suol.

en: May God open your heart to his law and his commands, and make peace,
target: Mie Gad uopn unu aat tu im laa an im komaan dem, an mek piis,

en: and listen to your requests, and be reconciled with you, and not forsake you in an evil time.
target: an lisn tu unu rikwes dem, an setl wid unu, an no lef unu ina iivl taim.

en: Now we are praying for you here.
target: Nou wi a prie fi unu ya.

en: In the reign of Demetrius, in the one hundred sixty-ninth year, we the Jews have already written to you in the suffering and in the distress that has come upon us in these years, from the time that Jason and his company revolted from the holy land and the kingdom,
target: Ina di rien a Dimetrios, ina di wan onjred siksti-naint ier, wi di Juu dem don rait tu unu aredi ina di sofarin an ina di distres we kom pan wi ina dem ier ya, fram di taim we Jiesn an im kompini ton we fram di uoli lan an di kindom,

en: and set the gate on fire, and shed innocent blood. We prayed to the Lord, and were heard. We offered sacrifices and meal offerings. We lit the lamps. We set out the show bread.
target: an set di giet pan faiya, an shed inosent blod. Wi prie tu di Laad, an im ier wi. Wi aafa sakrifais dem an miil aafrin dem. Wi lait di lamp dem. Wi set out di shuo bred.

en: Now see that you keep the days of the feast of tabernacles in the month Chislev in the one hundred eighty-eighth year.
target: Nou si se unu kip di die dem a di fiis a tabernakl dem ina di mont Kislev ina di wan onjred ieti-iet ier.

en: The people of Jerusalem and those who are in Judea, with the council of elders and Judas, to Aristobulus, King Ptolemy’s teacher, who is also of the line of the anointed priests, and to the Jews who are in Egypt, we send greetings and health.
target: Di piipl a Jeruusalem an dem we de ina Juudia, wid di kounsl a elda dem an Juudas, tu Aristobulos, King Tolimi tiicha, we aal a di lain a di anaintid priis dem tu, an tu di Juu dem we de ina Iijipt, wi sen griitin an elt.

en: Having been saved by God out of great perils, as men arrayed against a king, we thank him greatly.
target: Kaa wi ben siev bai Gad out a griet perel dem, laik man dem arienj gens wan king, wi tank im grietli.

en: For he threw out into Persia those who fought against us in the holy city.
target: Kaa im chruo out ina Persha dem we fait gens wi ina di uoli siti.

en: For when the prince had come there, with an army that seemed irresistible, they were cut to pieces in the temple of Nanaea by the treachery of Nanaea’s priests.
target: Kaa wen di prins ben kom de, wid wan aami we luk laik notn kuda tap dem, dem kot op ina piis ina di templ a Naniia bai di chrichri a Naniia priis dem.

en: For Antiochus, on the pretense that he would marry her, came into the place, he and his friends who were with him, that they might take a large part of the treasures as a dowry.
target: Kaa Antiokos, pan di pritens se im wuda mari ar, kom ina di plies, im an im fren dem we de wid im, so dem mait tek wan laaj paat a di trezha dem laik wan douri.

en: And when the priests of Nanaea’s temple had set the treasures out, and he had come there with a small company within the wall of the sacred precinct, they locked the temple when Antiochus had come in.
target: An wen di priis dem a Naniia templ ben set out di trezha dem, an im ben kom de wid wan smol kompini widin di waal a di siekrid plies, dem lak di templ wen Antiokos ben kom in.

en: Opening the secret door of the paneled ceiling, they threw stones and struck down the prince. They cut him and his company in pieces, and cut off their heads, and threw them to the people who were outside.
target: Dem uopn di siikrit duor a di panel siilin, chruo stuon an lik dong di prins. Dem kot im an im kompini ina piis, an kot aaf dem ed, an chruo dem tu di piipl we de outsaid.

en: Blessed be our God in all things, who handed over those who had committed impiety.
target: Bles bi wi Gad ina aal ting, we an uova dem we ben du wikidnis gens im.

en: Since we are now about to celebrate the purification of the temple in the month Chislev, on the twenty-fifth day, we thought it necessary to notify you, so that you may also keep a feast of tabernacles, and remember the fire which was given when Nehemiah offered sacrifices, after he had built both the temple and the altar.
target: Kaa wi nou bout fi selibriet di pyuurifikieshan a di templ ina di mont Kislev, pan di twenti-fif die, wi tingk se i nesiseri fi tel unu, so unu mait kip wan fiis a tabernakl dem tu, an memba di faiya we ben giv wen Niemaia aafa sakrifais dem, afta im ben bil buot di templ an di aalta.

en: For indeed when our fathers were about to be led into the land of Persia, the godly priests of that time took some of the fire of the altar, and hid it secretly in the hollow of a well that was without water, where they made sure that the place was unknown to anyone.
target: Kaa fi chuu wen wi faada dem ben bout fi liid we ina di lan a Persha, di uoli priis dem a da taim tek som a di faiya a di aalta, an aid i siikritli ina di olo a wan wel we no av no waata, we dem mek shuor se no wan no nuo di plies.

en: Now after many years, when it pleased God, Nehemiah, having received a charge from the king of Persia, sent in quest of the fire the descendants of the priests who hid it. When they declared to us that they had found no fire, but thick liquid,
target: Nou afta meni ier, wen i pliz Gad, Niemaia, we ben get wan chaaj fram di king a Persha, sen di pikni-pikni dem a di priis dem we aid i fi go luk fi di faiya. Wen dem tel wi se dem no fain no faiya, bot tik likwid,

en: he commanded them to draw some of it out and bring it to him. When the sacrifices had been offered, Nehemiah commanded the priests to sprinkle with that liquid both the wood and the things laid on it.
target: im komaan dem fi jraa som a i out an bring i tu im. Wen di sakrifais dem ben aafa, Niemaia komaan di priis dem fi sprinkl wid da likwid de buot di wud an di ting dem we lied pan i.

en: When that was done and some time had passed, and the sun shone out, which before was hidden with clouds, a great blaze was kindled, so that all men marveled.
target: Wen dat don an som taim ben paas, an di son shain out, we bifuo ben aid wid kloud, wan griet bliez kindl, so aal man maavl.

en: The priests made a prayer while the sacrifice was being consumed—both the priests and all the others. Jonathan led and the rest responded, as Nehemiah did.
target: Di priis dem mek wan prier wail di sakrifais a bon op — buot di priis dem an aal di ada dem. Jonatan liid an di res ansa, laik Niemaia du.

en: The prayer was like this: “O Lord, Lord God, the Creator of all things, you are awesome, strong, righteous, and merciful, you alone are King and gracious,
target: Di prier go laik dis: “O Laad, Laad Gad, di Krietor a aal ting, yu aasom, strang, raichos, an mersiful, yu aluon a King an grieshos,

en: you alone supply every need, you alone are righteous, almighty, and eternal, you who save Israel out of all evil, who chose the ancestors and consecrated them,
target: yu aluon soplai evri niid, yu aluon raichos, olmaiti, an iternal, yu we siev Izrel out a aal iivl, we chuuz di ansesta dem an mek dem uoli,

en: accept the sacrifice for all your people Israel, and preserve your own portion, and consecrate it.
target: aksept di sakrifais fi aal yu piipl Izrel, an kip yu uon puoshan saif, an mek i uoli.

en: Gather together our scattered people, set at liberty those who are in bondage among the heathen, look upon those who are despised and abhorred, and let the heathen know that you are our God.
target: Gyada tugeda wi skyata piipl, set fri dem we de ina bandij mong di iitn dem, luk pan dem we dem despais an atiet, an mek di iitn dem nuo se yu a wi Gad.

en: Punish those who oppress us and in arrogance shamefully entreat us.
target: Ponish dem we opres wi an ina arogans shiemfuli triit wi bad.

en: Plant your people in your holy place, even as Moses said.”
target: Plaant yu piipl ina yu uoli plies, jos laik Muoziz se.”

en: Then the priests sang the hymns.
target: Den di priis dem sing di im dem.

en: As soon as the sacrifice was consumed, then Nehemiah commanded that the rest of the liquid be poured on large stones.
target: Az suun az di sakrifais bon op, den Niemaia komaan se di res a di likwid puor pan laaj stuon dem.

en: When this was done, a flame was kindled; but when the light from the altar shone back, it went out.
target: Wen dis don, wan fliem kindl; bot wen di lait fram di aalta shain bak, i go out.

en: When the matter became known, and king of the Persians was told that in the place where the priests who were led away had hid the fire, the liquid appeared which Nehemiah and those who were with him purified the sacrifice,
target: Wen di mata bikom nuo, an di king a di Pershan dem get tel se ina di plies we di priis dem we ben liid we aid di faiya, di likwid apier we Niemaia an dem we de wid im mek di sakrifais pyuur,

en: then the king enclosed the place and made it sacred after he had investigated the matter.
target: den di king kloz op di plies an mek i siekrid afta im ben luk ina di mata.

en: When the king would show favor to any, he would exchange many presents and give them some of this liquid.
target: Wen di king wuda shuo fieva tu eni wan, im wuda exchienj meni prezent an giv dem som a dis likwid.

en: Nehemiah and those who were with him called this thing “Nephthar”, which is by interpretation, “Cleansing”; but most men call it Nephthai.
target: Niemaia an dem we de wid im kaal dis ting “Neftar”, we bai intapritieshan a, “Klensin”; bot muos man kaal i Neftai.

en: It is also found in the records that Jeremiah the prophet commanded those who were carried away to take some of the fire, as has been mentioned,
target: I fain ina di rekaad dem tu se Jeremaia di prafit komaan dem we ben kyari we fi tek som a di faiya, laik dem menshan aredi,

en: and how that the prophet charged those who were carried away, having given them the law, that they should not forget the commands of the Lord or be led astray in their minds when they saw images of gold and silver, and their adornment.
target: an ou di prafit chaaj dem we ben kyari we, afta im giv dem di laa, se dem no fi figet di komaan dem a di Laad ar get liid astre ina dem main wen dem si imij a guol an silva, an dem adoanment.

en: With other such words he exhorted them, that the law should not depart from their hearts.
target: Wid ada soch wod im beg dem strang, se di laa no fi lef dem aat.

en: It was in the writing that the prophet, being warned by God, commanded that the tabernacle and the ark should follow with him, when he went out to the mountain where Moses had gone up and saw God’s inheritance.
target: I de ina di raitin se di prafit, we get waan bai Gad, komaan se di tabernakl an di aak shud fala wid im, wen im go out tu di mountn we Muoziz ben go op an si Gad ineritans.

en: Jeremiah came and found a cave, he brought the tabernacle, the ark, and the altar of incense into it; then he sealed the entrance.
target: Jeremaia kom an fain wan kiev, im bring di tabernakl, di aak, an di aalta a insens ina i; den im siil op di entrans.

en: Some of those who followed with him came there that they might mark the way, and could not find it.
target: Som a dem we fala wid im kom de so dem mait maak di wie, an kuda no fain i.

en: But when Jeremiah learned about that, he rebuked them, saying, “The place will be unknown until God gathers the people together again and shows mercy.
target: Bot wen Jeremaia lorn bout dat, im tel dem aaf, a se, “Di plies wi tan unnuo til Gad gyada di piipl tugeda agen an shuo mersi.

en: Then the Lord will disclose these things, and the glory of the Lord will be seen with the cloud, as it was also shown to Moses, also as Solomon implored that the place might be consecrated greatly,
target: Den di Laad wi shuo dem ting ya, an di gluori a di Laad wi si wid di kloud, laik i ben shuo tu Muoziz tu, laik Soloman beg se di plies mait mek uoli grietli,

en: and it was also declared that he, having wisdom, offered a sacrifice of dedication, and of the finishing of the temple.
target: an i ben diklier tu se im, we av wizdom, aafa wan sakrifais a dedikieshan, an a di finishin a di templ.

en: As Moses prayed to the Lord and fire came down out of heaven and consumed the sacrifice, even so Solomon also prayed, and the fire came down and consumed the burnt offerings.
target: Laik Muoziz prie tu di Laad an faiya kom dong out a evn an bon op di sakrifais, so Soloman prie tu, an di faiya kom dong an bon op di bont aafrin dem.

en: Moses said, ‘Because the sin offering had not been eaten, it was consumed in like manner.’
target: Muoziz se, ‘Kaa di sin aafrin no ben iit, i bon op ina siem wie.’

en: Likewise Solomon kept the eight days.”
target: Laikwaiz Soloman kip di iet die dem.”

en: The same things were reported both in the public archives and in Nehemiah’s records, and also how he, founding a library, gathered together the books about the kings and prophets, and the writings of David, and letters of kings about sacred gifts.
target: Di siem ting dem ripuot buot ina di poblik aakaiv dem an ina Niemaia rekaad dem, an tu ou im, we found wan laibreri, gyada tugeda di buk dem bout di king dem an prafit dem, an di raitin dem a Dievid, an leta dem a king dem bout siekrid gif dem.

en: In like manner Judas also gathered together for us all those books that had been scattered by reason of the war, and they are still with us.
target: Ina siem wie Juudas gyada tugeda fi wi aal dem buk de we ben skyata bikaa a di waar, an dem stil de wid wi.

en: If therefore you have need of them, send some people to bring them to you.
target: If so unu av niid a dem, sen som piipl fi bring dem tu unu.

en: Seeing then that we are about to celebrate the purification, we write to you. You will therefore do well if you celebrate the days.
target: Kaa wi bout fi selibriet di pyuurifikieshan, wi rait tu unu. So unu wi du wel if unu selibriet di die dem.

en: Now God, who saved all his people, and restored the heritage to all, with the kingdom, the priesthood, and the consecration,
target: Nou Gad, we siev aal im piipl, an bring bak di eritaj tu aal, wid di kindom, di priisud, an di kansikrieshan,

en: even as he promised through the law—in God have we hope, that he will soon have mercy upon us, and gather us together out of everywhere under heaven into his holy place; for he delivered us out of great evils, and purified the place.
target: jos laik im pramis chruu di laa — ina Gad wi av uop, se im wi suun av mersi pan wi, an gyada wi tugeda out a evriwie anda evn ina im uoli plies; kaa im diliva wi out a griet iivl dem, an mek di plies pyuur.

en: Now the things concerning Judas Maccabaeus and his brothers, the purification of the greatest temple, the dedication of the altar,
target: Nou di ting dem bout Juudas Makabius an im breda dem, di pyuurifikieshan a di grietis templ, di dedikieshan a di aalta,

en: and further the wars against Antiochus Epiphanes and Eupator his son,
target: an forda di waar dem gens Antiokos Epifaniiz an Yuupator im son,

en: and the manifestations that came from heaven to those who fought with one another in brave deeds for the religion of the Jews; so that, being but a few, they seized the whole country, chased the barbarous multitudes,
target: an di shuo dem we kom fram evn tu dem we fait wid wan aneda ina briev diid dem fi di rilijan a di Juu dem; so se, duo dem a onli fyuu, dem tek di uol kontri, chies di baabaros moltityuud dem,

en: recovered again the temple renowned all the world over, freed the city, and restored the laws which were about to be overthrown, seeing the Lord became gracious to them with all kindness.
target: tek bak agen di templ we nuo aal uova di worl, frii di siti, an bring bak di laa dem we ben bout fi ton uova, kaa di Laad bikom grieshos tu dem wid aal kainnis.

en: These things which have been declared by Jason of Cyrene in five books, we will attempt to abridge in one book.
target: Dem ting ya we Jiesn a Sairiin diklier ina faiv buk, wi wi temp fi bring shaat ina wan buk.

en: For having in view the confused mass of the numbers, and the difficulty which awaits those who would enter into the narratives of the history, by reason of the abundance of the matter,
target: Kaa wi av ina vyuu di konfyuuz mas a di nomba dem, an di difikolti we await dem we wuda go ina di telin dem a di istri, bikaa a di abondans a di mata,

en: we were careful that those who choose to read may be attracted, and that those who wish us well may find it easy to recall, and that all readers may benefit.
target: wi ben kierful se dem we chuuz fi riid mait get atrak, an se dem we wish wi wel mait fain i iizi fi memba, an se aal riida dem mait benefit.

en: Although to us, who have taken upon ourselves the painful labor of the abridgement, the task is not easy, but a matter of sweat and sleeplessness,
target: Duo fi wi, we tek pan wiself di pienful lieba a di shaatnin, di taask no iizi, bot wan mata a swet an sliiplisnis,

en: even as it is no light thing to him who prepares a banquet, and seeks the benefit of others. Nevertheless, for the sake of the gratitude of the many we will gladly endure the painful labor,
