target: jos laik i no lait ting fi im we pripier wan bankwet, an siik di benefit a ada dem. Bot stil, fi di siek a di gratityuud a di meni wi wi gladli kip di pienful lieba,

en: leaving to the historian the exact handling of every particular, and again having no strength to fill in the outlines of our abridgement.
target: an lef tu di istuorian di egzakt andlin a evri patikyula, an agen av no strengt fi fil in di outlain dem a wi shaatnin.

en: For as the masterbuilder of a new house must care for the whole structure, and again he who undertakes to decorate and paint it must seek out the things fit for its adorning; even so I think it is also with us.
target: Kaa laik di maasta-bilda a wan nyuu ous mos kier fi di uol strukcha, an agen im we tek pan fi dekoret an pient i mos siik out di ting dem fit fi i adoanment; so mi tingk i de wid wi tu.

en: To occupy the ground, and to indulge in long discussions, and to be curious in particulars, is fitting for the first author of the history;
target: Fi okupai di groun, an fi go ina lang diskoshan dem, an fi bi kyuorios ina patikyula dem, fit di fos aata a di istri;

en: but to strive after brevity of expression, and to avoid a labored fullness in the treatment, is to be granted to him who would bring a writing into a new form.
target: bot fi strive afta briiviti a expreshan, an fi avaid wan lieba fulnis ina di triitment, a fi grant tu im we wuda bring wan raitin ina wan nyuu faam.

en: Here then let’s begin the narration, only adding this much to that which has already been said; for it is a foolish thing to make a long prologue to the history, and to abridge the history itself.
target: Ya den mek wi bigin di telin, onli ad dis moch tu dat we don se aredi; kaa i a fuulish ting fi mek wan lang pruolog tu di istri, an fi shaatn di istri iself.

en: When the holy city was inhabited with unbroken peace and the laws were kept very well because of the godliness of Onias the high priest and his hatred of wickedness,
target: Wen di uoli siti ben liv wid piis we no bruk, an di laa dem kip veri wel bikaa a di uoli livin a Onaias di ai priis an im iet a wikidnis,

en: even the kings themselves honored the place and glorified the temple with the noblest presents,
target: iivn di king dem demself ana di plies an gluorifai di templ wid di nuoblis prezent dem,

en: so that even King Seleucus of Asia bore all the costs belonging to the services of the sacrifices out of his own revenues.
target: so se iivn King Selyuukos a Iesha bier aal di kaas dem we bilang tu di servis dem a di sakrifais dem out a im uon moni.

en: But a man named Simon of the tribe of Benjamin, having been made guardian of the temple, disagreed with the high priest about the ruling of the market in the city.
target: Bot wan man niem Saiman a di traib a Benjamin, we ben mek gaadian a di templ, disagree wid di ai priis bout di ruulin a di maakit ina di siti.

en: When he couldn’t overcome Onias, he went to Apollonius of Tarsus, who at that time was governor of Coelesyria and Phoenicia.
target: Wen im kuda no uovakom Onaias, im go tu Apolonyos a Taasos, we a da taim ben govna a Siilisiria an Finiisha.

en: He brought him word how that the treasury in Jerusalem was full of untold sums of money, so that the multitude of the funds was innumerable, and that they didn’t pertain to the account of the sacrifices, but that it was possible that these should fall under the king’s power.
target: Im bring im wod ou di trezhari ina Jeruusalem ful a moni we no wan kyan tel, so di moltityuud a di fond dem kyaan kount, an se dem no bilang tu di akount a di sakrifais dem, bot i pasibl se dem shuda faal anda di king powa.

en: When Apollonius met the king, he informed him of the money about which he had been told. So the king appointed Heliodorus, who was his chancellor, and sent him with a command to accomplish the removal of the reported money.
target: Wen Apolonyos miit di king, im tel im bout di moni we im ben get tel bout. So di king apoint Eliodorus, we ben im chansla, an sen im wid wan komaan fi akomplish di rimuval a di ripuot moni.

en: So Heliodorus set out on his journey at once, ostensibly to visit the cities of Coelesyria and Phoenicia, but in fact to execute the king’s purpose.
target: So Eliodorus set out pan im jerni at wons, laik se fi vizit di siti dem a Siilisiria an Finiisha, bot fi chuu fi du di king poerpos.

en: When he had come to Jerusalem and had been courteously received by the high priest of the city, he told him about the information which had been given, and declared why he had come; and he inquired if in truth these things were so.
target: Wen im ben kom tu Jeruusalem an di ai priis a di siti ben risiv im kourtesli, im tel im bout di infamieshan we ben giv, an diklier wai im ben kom; an im aks if fi chuu dem ting ya so.

en: The high priest explained to him that there were in the treasury deposits of widows and orphans,
target: Di ai priis eksplien tu im se de ben ina di trezhari dipazit a wido dem an aafan dem,

en: and moreover some money belonging to Hyrcanus the son of Tobias, a man in very high place, not as that impious Simon falsely alleged; and that in all there were four hundred talents of silver and two hundred of gold,
target: an muor di moni a Erkanos di son a Tobaias, wan man ina veri ai plies, no laik da ongadli Saiman faalsli se; an se ina aal de ben fuor onjred talent a silva an tuu onjred a guol,

en: and that it was altogether impossible that wrong should be done to those who had put trust in the holiness of the place, and in the majesty and inviolable sanctity of the temple, honored over all the world.
target: an se i ben altugeda impasibl se rang shuda du tu dem we ben put chros ina di uolinis a di plies, an ina di majesti an invaiolabl uolinis a di templ, we ana uova aal di worl.

en: But Heliodorus, because of the king’s command given him, said that in any case this money must be confiscated for the king’s treasury.
target: Bot Eliodorus, bikaa a di king komaan we giv im, se se ina eni kies dis moni mos tek we fi di king trezhari.

en: So having appointed a day, he entered in to direct the inquiry concerning these matters; and there was no small distress throughout the whole city.
target: So afta im apoint wan die, im go in fi dairek di inkwaieri bout dem mata ya; an de ben no smol distres chruuout di uol siti.

en: The priests, prostrating themselves before the altar in their priestly garments, and called toward heaven upon him who gave the law concerning deposits, that he should preserve these treasures safe for those who had deposited them.
target: Di priis dem, we pudong demself flat bifuo di aalta ina dem priisli gaament dem, kaal tuwaadz evn pan im we giv di laa bout dipazit dem, se im shuda kip dem trezha de sief fi dem we ben dipazit dem.

en: Whoever saw the appearance of the high priest was wounded in mind; for his countenance and the change of his color betrayed the distress of his soul.
target: Enibadi we si di apierans a di ai priis get wuun ina main; kaa im fies an di chienj a im kola shuo di distres a im suol.

en: For a terror and a shuddering of the body had come over the man, by which the pain that was in his heart was plainly shown to those who looked at him.
target: Kaa wan tera an wan shodarin a di badi ben kom uova di man, we mek di pien we de ina im aat plien fi dem we luk pan im.

en: Those who were in the houses rushed out in crowds to make a universal supplication, because the place was about to come into dishonor.
target: Dem we de ina di ous dem rosh out ina kroud fi mek wan yuuniversal beg, bikaa di plies ben bout fi kom ina disana.

en: The women, girded with sackcloth under their breasts, thronged the streets. The virgins who were kept indoors ran together, some to the gates, others to the walls, and some looked out through the windows.
target: Di uman dem, we gird wid sakklaat anda dem bres, trang di striit dem. Di verjin dem we ben kip induor ron tugeda, som tu di giet dem, ada tu di waal dem, an som luk out chruu di winda dem.

en: All, stretching out their hands toward heaven, made their solemn supplication.
target: Aal, we strech out dem an tuwaadz evn, mek dem solem beg.

en: Then it was pitiful to see the multitude prostrating themselves all mixed together, and the anxiety of the high priest in his great distress.
target: Den i ben pitiful fi si di moltityuud pudong demself flat aal miks tugeda, an di angzaieti a di ai priis ina im griet distres.

en: While therefore they called upon the Almighty Lord to keep the things entrusted to them safe and secure for those who had entrusted them,
target: Wail so dem kaal pan di Olmaiti Laad fi kip di ting dem we entros tu dem sief an sikyuor fi dem we ben entros dem,

en: Heliodorus went on to execute that which had been decreed.
target: Eliodorus go aan fi du dat we ben dikrii.

en: But when he was already present there with his guards near the treasury, the Sovereign of the fathers and of all authority caused a great manifestation, so that all who had presumed to come with him, stricken with dismay at the power of God, fainted in terror.
target: Bot wen im ben aredi de de wid im gaad dem nier di trezhari, di Sovrin a di faada dem an a aal atariti mek wan griet shuo, so aal we ben prizyuum fi kom wid im, we lik dong wid dismie a di powa a Gad, faint ina tera.

en: For they saw a horse with a frightening rider, adorned with beautiful trappings, and he rushed fiercely and struck at Heliodorus with his forefeet. It seemed like he who sat on the horse had complete armor of gold.
target: Kaa dem si wan aas wid wan fraitnin raida, we adoan wid byuutiful trapins, an im rosh fiers an lik a Eliodorus wid im fuorfuut dem. I luk laik im we sidong pan di aas av kompliet aama a guol.

en: Two others also appeared to him, young men notable in their strength, and beautiful in their glory, and splendid in their apparel, who stood by him on either side, and scourged him unceasingly, inflicting on him many sore stripes.
target: Tuu ada tu apier tu im, yong man dem nuotabl ina dem strengt, an byuutiful ina dem gluori, an splendid ina dem klouz, we tan bai im pan iida said, an skerj im widout siisin, a giv im meni suer straip dem.

en: When he had fallen suddenly to the ground, and great darkness had come over him, his guards picked him up and put him on a stretcher,
target: Wen im ben faal sodnli tu di groun, an griet daaknis ben kom uova im, im gaad dem pik im op an put im pan wan strecha,

en: and carried him—this man who had just now entered with a great retinue and all his guard into the aforesaid treasury, himself now brought to utter helplessness, manifestly made to recognize the sovereignty of God.
target: an kyari im — dis man we jos nou go in wid wan griet kompini an aal im gaad ina di trezhari we menshan bifuo, imself nou bring tu elplisnis we kyaan don, plienli mek fi nuo di sovrinti a Gad.

en: So, while he, through the working of God, speechless and bereft of all hope and deliverance, lay prostrate,
target: So, wail im, chruu di workin a Gad, spiichlis an widout aal uop an dilivarans, lie flat,

en: they blessed the Lord who acted marvelously for his own place. The temple, which a little before was full of terror and alarm, was filled with joy and gladness after the Almighty Lord appeared.
target: dem bles di Laad we akt maavilosli fi im uon plies. Di templ, we likl bifuo ful a tera an alaam, ful a jai an gladnis afta di Olmaiti Laad apier.

en: But quickly some of Heliodorus’s familiar friends implored Onias to call upon the Most High to grant life to him who lay quite at the last gasp.
target: Bot kwikli som a Eliodorus fren dem we nuo im wel beg Onaias fi kaal pan di Mos Ai fi grant laif tu im we lie kwait a di laas gasp.

en: The high priest, secretly fearing that the king might come to think that some treachery toward Heliodorus had been perpetrated by the Jews, brought a sacrifice for the recovery of the man.
target: Di ai priis, siikritli a fier se di king mait kom fi tingk se som chrichri gens Eliodorus ben du bai di Juu dem, bring wan sakrifais fi di rikovri a di man.

en: But as the high priest was making the atoning sacrifice, the same young men appeared again to Heliodorus, arrayed in the same garments. They stood and said, “Give Onias the high priest great thanks, for for his sake the Lord has granted you life.
target: Bot az di ai priis a mek di aton sakrifais, di siem yong man dem apier agen tu Eliodorus, we dres ina di siem gaament dem. Dem tan an se, “Giv Onaias di ai priis griet tanks, kaa fi im siek di Laad don grant yu laif.

en: See that you, since you have been scourged from heaven, proclaim to all men the sovereign majesty of God.” When they had spoken these words, they vanished out of sight.
target: Si se yu, sins yu ben skerj fram evn, pro kliem tu aal man di sovrin majesti a Gad.” Wen dem ben taak dem wod ya, dem vanish out a sait.

en: So Heliodorus, having offered a sacrifice to the Lord and vowed great vows to him who had saved his life, and having bidden Onias farewell, returned with his army to the king.
target: So Eliodorus, afta im aafa wan sakrifais tu di Laad an vow griet vow dem tu im we ben siev im laif, an afta im se fiewel tu Onaias, ton bak wid im aami tu di king.

en: He testified to all men the works of the greatest God, which he had seen with his eyes.
target: Im testifai tu aal man di work dem a di grietis Gad, we im ben si wid im yai dem.

en: When the king asked Heliodorus what sort of man was fit to be sent yet once again to Jerusalem, he said,
target: Wen di king aks Eliodorus wa saat a man fit fi sen wan muor taim agen tu Jeruusalem, im se,

en: “If you have any enemy or conspirator against the state, send him there, and you will receive him back well scourged, if he even escapes with his life; because truly there is some power of God in that place.
target: “If yu av eni enimi ar konspireta gens di stiet, sen im de, an yu wi get im bak wel skerj, if im iivn eskiep wid im laif; bikaa fi chuu de som powa a Gad ina da plies de.

en: For he who has his dwelling in heaven himself has his eyes on that place and helps it. Those who come to hurt it, he strikes and destroys.”
target: Kaa im we av im dwelin ina evn imself av im yai dem pan da plies de an elp i. Dem we kom fi ort i, im lik an distrai dem.”

en: This was the history of Heliodorus and the keeping of the treasury.
target: Dis ben di istri a Eliodorus an di kipin a di trezhari.

en: The previously mentioned Simon, who had given information about the money against his country, slandered Onias, saying that it was he who had incited Heliodorus and had been the real cause of these evils.
target: Di Saiman we menshan bifuo, we ben giv infamieshan bout di moni gens im kontri, slanda Onaias, a se se a im we ben mek Eliodorus staat, an ben di riil kaaz a dem iivl ya.

en: He dared to call him a conspirator against the state who was actually the benefactor of the city, the guardian of his fellow countrymen, and a zealot for the laws.
target: Im dier fi kaal im wan konspireta gens di stiet we akchuali ben di benefakta a di siti, di gaadian a im felo kontriman dem, an wan man we aat de pan di laa dem.

en: When his hatred grew so great that even murders were perpetrated through one of Simon’s approved agents,
target: Wen im ietrid gro so griet se iivn morda dem ben du chruu wan a Saiman apruuv ejent dem,

en: Onias, seeing the danger of the contention, and that Apollonius the son of Menestheus, the governor of Coelesyria and Phoenicia, was increasing Simon’s malice,
target: Onaias, we si di dienja a di kontenshan, an se Apolonyos di son a Menesteos, di govna a Siilisiria an Finiisha, ben inkriis Saiman malis,

en: appealed to the king, not to be an accuser of his fellow citizens, but looking to the good of all the people, both public and private;
target: go tu di king, no fi bi wan akyuuza a im felo sitizn dem, bot a luk tu di gud a aal di piipl, buot poblik an praivit;

en: for he saw that without the king’s involvement it was impossible for the state to obtain peace any more, and that Simon would not cease from his madness.
target: kaa im si se widout di king invalvment i ben impasibl fi di stiet fi get piis eni muor, an se Saiman wuda no stap fram im madnis.

en: When Seleucus was deceased, and Antiochus, who was called Epiphanes, succeeded to the kingdom, Jason the brother of Onias supplanted his brother in the high priesthood,
target: Wen Selyuukos ben ded, an Antiokos, we dem kaal Epifaniiz, tek uova di kindom, Jiesn di breda a Onaias tek im breda plies ina di ai priisud,

en: having promised to the king at an audience three hundred sixty talents of silver, and out of another fund eighty talents.
target: afta im pramis tu di king a wan aadiens chrii onjred siksti talent a silva, an out a wan nada fond ieti talent.

en: In addition to this, he undertook to assign one hundred fifty more, if it might be allowed him through the king’s authority to set him up a gymnasium and a body of youths to be trained in it, and to register the inhabitants of Jerusalem as citizens of Antioch.
target: Ina adishan tu dis, im tek pan imself fi asain wan onjred fifti muor, if i mait lou im chruu di king atariti fi set op wan jimnieziom an wan badi a yuut dem fi trien ina i, an fi rejista di piipl we liv ina Jeruusalem az sitizn a Antiok.

en: When the king had assented, and Jason had taken possession of the office, he immediately shifted those of his own race to the Greek way of life.
target: Wen di king ben agrii, an Jiesn ben tek poezeshan a di afis, im imediietli shift dem a im uon ries tu di Griik wie a laif.

en: Setting aside the royal privileges granted to the Jews through John the father of Eupolemus, who went on the mission to the Romans to establish friendship and alliance, and seeking to overthrow the lawful ways of living, he brought in new customs forbidden by the law.
target: Im set asaide di raayal privilej dem we grant tu di Juu dem chruu Jan di faada a Yuupolemos, we go pan di mishan tu di Ruoman dem fi establis frenship an alaians, an a siik fi ton uova di laaful wie dem a livin, im bring in nyuu kostom dem we di laa faabid.

en: For he eagerly established a gymnasium under the citadel itself, and caused the noblest of the young men to wear the Greek hat.
target: Kaa im iigali establis wan jimnieziom anda di sitadel iself, an mek di nuoblis a di yong man dem wier di Griik at.

en: Thus there was an extreme of hellenization, and an advance of a foreign religion, by reason of the exceeding profaneness of Jason, who was an ungodly man and not a high priest;
target: So de ben wan ekstriim a elinaizieshan, an wan advans a wan farin rilijan, bikaa a di griet profiennis a Jiesn, we ben wan ongadli man an no wan ai priis;

en: so that the priests had no more any zeal for the services of the altar; but despising the sanctuary and neglecting the sacrifices, they hastened to enjoy that which was unlawfully provided in the wrestling arena, after the summons to the discus-throwing.
target: so di priis dem no av no muor ziil fi di servis dem a di aalta; bot dem despais di sankchuari an neglek di sakrifais dem, dem ies fi enjai dat we ben onlaafuli provaid ina di reslin ariina, afta di somonz tu di diskos-chruoin.

en: They despised the honors of their fathers, and valued the prestige of the Greeks best of all.
target: Dem despais di ana dem a dem faada dem, an valyu di prestiij a di Griik dem bes a aal.

en: For this reason, severe calamity overtook them. The men whose ways of living they earnestly followed, and to whom they desired to be made like in all things, these became their enemies and punished them.
target: Fi dis riizn, seviir kalamiti uovatek dem. Di man dem uufa wie a livin dem earnesli fala, an tu uum dem dizair fi mek laik ina aal ting, dem bikom dem enimi an ponish dem.

en: For it is not a light thing to show irreverence to God’s laws, but later events will make this clear.
target: Kaa i no lait ting fi shuo no rispek tu Gad laa dem, bot lieta ivent dem wi mek dis klier.

en: Now when certain games that came every fifth year were kept at Tyre, and the king was present,
target: Nou wen som gien dem we kom evri fif ier ben kip a Taiya, an di king ben de de,

en: the vile Jason sent sacred envoys, as being Antiochians of Jerusalem, bearing three hundred drachmas of silver to the sacrifice of Hercules, which even those who carried it thought not right to use for any sacrifice, because it was not fit, but to spend it for another purpose.
target: di vail Jiesn sen siekrid envai dem, az Antiokian dem a Jeruusalem, a kyari chrii onjred drakma a silva tu di sakrifais a Erkyuliiz, we iivn dem we kyari i tingk no rait fi yuuz fi eni sakrifais, bikaa i no fit, bot fi spen i fi wan nada poerpos.

en: Although the sender intended that this money was for the sacrifice of Hercules, yet on account of present circumstances it went to the construction of trireme warships.
target: Duo di senda inten se dis moni ben fi di sakrifais a Erkyuliiz, stil bikaa a di prezant sorkomstans dem i go tu di bil a trairiim waaship dem.

en: Now when Apollonius the son of Menestheus was sent into Egypt for the enthronement of Philometor as king, Antiochus, learning that Philometor had shown himself hostile toward the government, took precautions for the security of his realm. Therefore, going to Joppa, he travelled on to Jerusalem.
target: Nou wen Apolonyos di son a Menesteos ben sen ina Iijipt fi di entruonment a Filometor az king, Antiokos, we lorn se Filometor ben shuo imself astail tuwaadz di govament, tek prikaashan fi di sikyuoriti a im relm. So im go tu Japa, an chravl aan tu Jeruusalem.

en: Being magnificently received by Jason and the city, he was brought in with torches and shouting. Then he led his army down into Phoenicia.
target: Im get risiv magnifisentli bai Jiesn an di siti, an dem bring im in wid taach dem an shoutin. Den im liid im aami dong ina Finiisha.

en: Now after a space of three years, Jason sent Menelaus, the previously mentioned Simon’s brother, to carry the money to the king, and to make reports concerning some necessary matters.
target: Nou afta wan spies a chrii ier, Jiesn sen Menilaos, di breda a di Saiman we menshan bifuo, fi kyari di moni tu di king, an fi mek ripuot dem bout som nesiseri mata dem.

en: But he being commended to the king, and having been glorified by the display of his authority, secured the high priesthood for himself, outbidding Jason by three hundred talents of silver.
target: Bot im, we get komend tu di king, an we get gluorifai bai di displie a im atariti, sikyuor di ai priisud fi imself, a outbid Jiesn bai chrii onjred talent a silva.

en: After receiving the royal mandates, he returned bringing nothing worthy of the high priesthood, but having the passion of a cruel tyrant and the rage of a savage animal.
target: Afta im risiv di raayal komaan dem, im ton bak a bring notn woerti a di ai priisud, bot av di pashan a wan kruel tairant an di riej a wan savij animal.

en: So Jason, who had supplanted his own brother, was supplanted by another and driven as a fugitive into the country of the Ammonites.
target: So Jiesn, we ben tek im uon breda plies, get tek uova bai wan nada an draiv az wan fyuujitiv ina di kontri a di Amonait dem.

en: Menelaus had possession of the office, but of the money that had been promised to the king nothing was regularly paid, even though Sostratus the governor of the citadel demanded it—
target: Menilaos av poezeshan a di afis, bot a di moni we ben pramis tu di king notn ben pie rigyulali, iivn duo Sostratos di govna a di sitadel dimaan i —

en: for his job was the gathering of the revenues—so they were both called by the king to his presence.
target: kaa im jab ben di gyadarin a di revenyuu dem — so dem buot get kaal bai di king tu im prezans.

en: Menelaus left his own brother Lysimachus for his deputy in the high priesthood; and Sostratus left Crates, who was over the Cyprians.
target: Menilaos lef im uon breda Lisimakos fi im depyuti ina di ai priisud; an Sostratos lef Kretiz, we ben uova di Siprian dem.

en: Now while this was the state of things, the people of Tarsus and Mallus revolted because they were to be given as a present to Antiochis, the king’s concubine.
target: Nou wail dis ben di stiet a ting dem, di piipl a Taasos an Malos ribel bikaa dem ben fi giv az wan prezent tu Antiokis, di king konkubain.

en: The king therefore quickly came to settle matters, leaving for his deputy Andronicus, a man of high rank.
target: Di king so kwikli kom fi setl mata dem, an lef fi im depyuti Andronikos, wan man a ai rangk.

en: Then Menelaus, supposing that he had gotten a favorable opportunity, presented to Andronicus certain vessels of gold belonging to the temple, which he had stolen. He had already sold others into Tyre and the neighboring cities.
target: Den Menilaos, we sopuoz se im ben get wan fievarabl apatyuniti, prezent tu Andronikos som vesl a guol we bilang tu di templ, we im ben stiil. Im ben don sel ada dem ina Taiya an di niebarin siti dem aredi.

en: When Onias had sure knowledge of this, he sharply reproved him, having withdrawn himself into a sanctuary at Daphne, that lies by Antioch.
target: Wen Onaias av shuor nalij a dis, im tel im aaf shaap, afta im widraa imself ina wan sankchuari a Dafni, we lie bai Antiok.

en: Therefore Menelaus, taking Andronicus aside, asked him to kill Onias. Coming to Onias, and being persuaded to use treachery, and being received as a friend, Andronicus gave him his right hand with oaths and, though he was suspicious, persuaded him to come out of the sanctuary. Then, with no regard for justice, he immediately put him to death.
target: So Menilaos, tek Andronikos asaide, aks im fi kil Onaias. Im kom tu Onaias, an get pasuied fi yuuz chrichri, an get risiv az wan fren, Andronikos giv im im rait an wid uot dem an, duo im ben sospishos, pasuied im fi kom out a di sankchuari. Den, wid no rigaad fi jostis, im imediietli put im tu det.

en: For this reason not only Jews, but many also of the other nations, had indignation and displeasure at the unjust murder of the man.
target: Fi dis riizn no onli Juu dem, bot meni a di ada nieshan dem tu, av indignieshan an displiezha a di onjos morda a di man.

en: And when the king had come back from the places in Cilicia, the Jews who were in the city appealed to him against Andronicus (the Greeks also joining with them in hatred of the wickedness), urging that Onias had been wrongfully slain.
target: An wen di king ben kom bak fram di plies dem ina Silisha, di Juu dem we de ina di siti go tu im gens Andronikos (di Griik dem tu jain wid dem ina ietrid a di wikidnis), a beg se Onaias ben rangfuli slain.

en: Antiochus therefore was heartily sorry, and was moved to mercy, and wept, because of the sober and well ordered life of him who was dead.
target: Antiokos so ben aatili sari, an get muuv tu mersi, an baal, bikaa a di suoba an wel aada laif a im we ben ded.

en: Being inflamed with anger, he immediately stripped off Andronicus’s purple robe, and tore off his under garments, and when he had led him round through the whole city to that very place where he had committed the outrage against Onias, there he put the murderer out of the way, the Lord rendering to him the punishment he had deserved.
target: Im get enflame wid anga, im imediietli strip aaf Andronikos porpl ruob, an tier aaf im anda gaament dem, an wen im ben liid im roun chruu di uol siti tu da veri plies de we im ben komit di outrage gens Onaias, de im put di mordara out a di wie, di Laad a giv im di ponishment we im dizerv.

en: Now when many sacrileges had been committed in the city by Lysimachus with the consent of Menelaus, and when the report of them had spread abroad outside, the people gathered themselves together against Lysimachus, after many vessels of gold had already been stolen.
target: Nou wen meni sakrileg dem ben komit ina di siti bai Lisimakos wid di konsent a Menilaos, an wen di ripuot a dem ben spred abraad outsaid, di piipl gyada demself tugeda gens Lisimakos, afta meni vesl a guol ben don stiil aredi.

en: When the multitudes were rising against him and were filled with anger, Lysimachus armed about three thousand men, and with unrighteous violence began the attack under the leadership of Hauran, a man far gone in years and no less also in folly.
target: Wen di moltityuud dem a raiz gens im an ful a anga, Lisimakos aam bout chrii touzn man, an wid onraichos vailens bigin di atak anda di liidaship a Oran, wan man we faar gaan ina ier an no les ina fuulishnis tu.

en: But when they perceived the assault of Lysimachus, some caught up stones, others logs of wood, and some took handfuls of the ashes that lay near, and they flung them all in wild confusion at Lysimachus and those who were with him.
target: Bot wen dem si di asolt a Lisimakos, som kach op stuon, ada lag a wud, an som tek anful a di ashiz we lie nier, an dem fling dem aal ina wail konfyuuzhan a Lisimakos an dem we de wid im.

en: As a result, they wounded many of them, they killed some, and they forced the rest of them to flee, but the author of the sacrilege himself they killed beside the treasury.
target: Az wan rizolt, dem wuun meni a dem, dem kil som, an dem fuos di res a dem fi flii, bot di aata a di sakrileg imself dem kil bisaid di trezhari.

en: But about these matters, there was an accusation laid against Menelaus.
target: Bot bout dem mata ya, de ben wan akyuzieshan lied gens Menilaos.

en: When the king had come to Tyre, the three men who were sent by the council of elders pleaded the cause before him.
target: Wen di king ben kom tu Taiya, di chrii man we di kounsl a elda dem sen pliid di kaaz bifuo im.

en: But Menelaus, seeing himself now defeated, promised much money to Ptolemy the son of Dorymenes, that he might win over the king.
target: Bot Menilaos, we si imself nou difiet, pramis moch moni tu Tolimi di son a Dorimeniz, so im mait win uova di king.

en: Therefore Ptolemy taking the king aside into a cloister, as if to get some fresh air, convinced him to change his mind.
target: So Tolimi tek di king asaide ina wan klaista, laik fi get som fresh ier, an konvins im fi chienj im main.

en: He who was the cause of all the evil, Menelaus, he discharged from the accusations; but these hapless men, who, if they had pleaded even before Scythians, would have been discharged uncondemned, them he sentenced to death.
target: Im we ben di kaaz a aal di iivl, Menilaos, im dischaaj fram di akyuzieshan dem; bot dem aplis man de, we, if dem ben pliid iivn bifuo Sitian dem, wuda get dischaaj onkondem, dem im sentens tu det.

en: Those who were spokesmen for the city and the people and the holy vessels soon suffered that unrighteous penalty.
target: Dem we ben spuuoksman fi di siti an di piipl an di uoli vesl dem suun sofa da onraichos penalti de.

en: Therefore even certain Tyrians, moved with hatred of the wickedness, provided magnificently for their burial.
target: So iivn som Tairian dem, we get muuv wid ietrid a di wikidnis, provaid magnifisentli fi dem berial.

en: But Menelaus, through the covetous dealings of those who were in power, remained still in his office, growing in wickedness, established as a great conspirator against his fellow citizens.
target: Bot Menilaos, chruu di kovetos diilin dem a dem we de ina powa, tan stil ina im afis, a gro ina wikidnis, establis az wan griet konspireta gens im felo sitizn dem.

en: Now about this time Antiochus made his second invasion into Egypt.
target: Nou bout dis taim Antiokos mek im sekan inviezhan ina Iijipt.

en: It happened that throughout all the city, for almost forty days, cavalry appeared in the midst of the sky in swift motion, wearing robes woven with gold and carrying spears, equipped with troops for battle—
target: I apn se chruuout aal di siti, fi aalmuos faati die, kavalri apier ina di migl a di skai ina kwik muoshan, a wier ruob dem we wuov wid guol an a kyari spier, we ikwip wid chruup dem fi batl —

en: drawing swords, squadrons of cavalry in array, encounters and pursuits of both armies, shaking shields, multitudes of lances, throwing of missiles, flashing of golden trappings, and putting on all sorts of armor.
target: a jraa suord, skwaadran a kavalri ina arie, enkaunta an posyuut a buot aami dem, a shiek shiil dem, moltityuud a lans dem, a chruo misail dem, a flash guol trapins, an a put aan aal saat a aama.

en: Therefore everyone prayed that the manifestation might have been given for good.
target: So evriwan prie se di shuo mait ben giv fi gud.

en: When a false rumor had arisen that Antiochus was dead, Jason took not less than a thousand men, and suddenly made an assault upon the city. When those who were on the wall were being routed, and the city was at length nearly taken, Menelaus took refuge in the citadel.
target: Wen wan faals ryuuma ben raiz se Antiokos ded, Jiesn tek no les dan wan touzn man, an sodnli mek wan asolt pan di siti. Wen dem we de pan di waal ben a get rout, an di siti a lengt nieli tek, Menilaos tek refyuuj ina di sitadel.

en: But Jason slaughtered his own citizens without mercy, not considering that good success against kinsmen is the greatest misfortune, but supposing himself to be setting up trophies over enemies, and not over fellow countrymen.
target: Bot Jiesn slaata im uon sitizn dem widout mersi, no a konsida se gud sokses gens kinsman a di grietis misfaachun, bot a sopuoz imself fi a set op chruofi dem uova enimi dem, an no uova felo kontriman dem.

en: He didn’t win control of the government, but receiving shame as the result of his conspiracy, he fled again as a fugitive into the country of the Ammonites.
target: Im no win kontrol a di govament, bot get shiem az di rizolt a im konspirasi, im flii agen az wan fyuujitiv ina di kontri a di Amonait dem.

en: At last therefore he met with a miserable end. Having been imprisoned at the court of Aretas the prince of the Arabians, fleeing from city to city, pursued by all men, hated as a rebel against the laws, and abhorred as the executioner of his country and his fellow citizens, he was cast ashore in Egypt.
target: A laas so im miit wid wan mizrabl en. Afta im get imprizn a di kuot a Aretas di prins a di Arabian dem, a flii fram siti tu siti, posyuu bai aal man, iet az wan rebel gens di laa dem, an atiet az di eksikyuushana a im kontri an im felo sitizn dem, dem kaas im ashuor ina Iijipt.

en: He who had driven many from their own country into exile perished in exile, having crossed the sea to the Lacedaemonians, hoping to find shelter there because they were near of kin.
target: Im we ben draiv meni fram dem uon kontri ina egzail ded ina egzail, afta im kraas di sii tu di Lasidimonian dem, a uop fi fain shelta de bikaa dem ben nier kin.

en: He who had thrown out a multitude unburied had none to mourn for him. He didn’t have any funeral at all and no place in the tomb of his ancestors.
target: Im we ben chruo out wan moltityuud onberi av non fi muorn fi im. Im no av eni fyuuneral at aal an no plies ina di tuum a im ansesta dem.

en: Now when news came to the king concerning that which was done, he thought that Judea was in revolt. So, setting out from Egypt in a rage, he took the city by force of weapons,
target: Nou wen nyuuz kom tu di king bout dat we ben du, im tingk se Juudia de ina ribel. So, im set out fram Iijipt ina wan riej, im tek di siti bai fuos a wepon dem,

en: and commanded his soldiers to cut down without mercy those who came in their way, and to kill those who went into their houses.
target: an komaan im suolja dem fi kot dong widout mersi dem we kom ina dem wie, an fi kil dem we go ina dem ous dem.

en: Then there was killing of young and old, destruction of boys, women, and children, and slaying of virgins and infants.
target: Den de ben kilin a yong an uol, distrokshan a bwai dem, uman dem, an pikni dem, an sliein a verjin dem an infant dem.

en: In a total of three days, eighty thousand were destroyed, of which forty thousand were slain in close combat, and no fewer were sold into slavery than slain.
target: Ina wan tuotal a chrii die, ieti touzn get distrai, a we faati touzn get slain ina kluos kombat, an no fyuuwa get suol ina slievri dan slain.

en: Not content with this, he presumed to enter into the most holy temple of all the earth, having Menelaus for his guide (who had proved himself a traitor both to the laws and to his country),
target: No kontent wid dis, im prizyuum fi go ina di muos uoli templ a aal di ort, a av Menilaos fi im gaid (we ben pruuv imself wan chrieta buot tu di laa dem an tu im kontri),

en: even taking the sacred vessels with his polluted hands, and dragging down with his profane hands the offerings that had been dedicated by other kings to enhance the glory and honor of the place.
target: iivn a tek di siekrid vesl dem wid im polyuuted an dem, an a jrag dong wid im profien an dem di aafrin dem we ada king dem ben dedikiet fi mek di gluori an ana a di plies biga.

en: Antiochus was lifted up in mind, not seeing that because of the sins of those who lived in the city the Sovereign Lord had been provoked to anger a little while, and therefore his eye was turned away from the place.
target: Antiokos get lif op ina main, no a si se bikaa a di sin dem a dem we liv ina di siti di Sovrin Laad ben provuok tu anga wan likl wail, an so im yai ton we fram di plies.

en: But had it not been so that they were already bound by many sins, this man, even as Heliodorus who was sent by King Seleucus to view the treasury, would, as soon as he came forward, have been scourged and turned back from his daring deed.
target: Bot if i no ben so se dem ben aredi boun bai meni sin, dis man, iivn laik Eliodorus we King Selyuukos sen fi vyuu di trezhari, wuda, az suun az im kom faawad, get skerj an ton bak fram im dier diid.

en: However the Lord didn’t choose the nation for the place’s sake, but the place for the nation’s sake.
target: Bot di Laad no chuuz di nieshan fi di plies siek, bot di plies fi di nieshan siek.

en: Therefore also the place itself, having shared in the calamities that happened to the nation, did afterward share in its benefits; and the place which was forsaken in the wrath of the Almighty was, at the reconciliation of the great Sovereign, restored again with all glory.
target: So di plies iself tu, afta i shier ina di kalamiti dem we apn tu di nieshan, afta shier ina i benefit dem; an di plies we get lef ina di raat a di Olmaiti ben, a di setlin a di griet Sovrin, bring bak agen wid aal gluori.

en: As for Antiochus, when he had carried away out of the temple one thousand eight hundred talents, he hurried away to Antioch, thinking in his arrogance that he could sail on land and walk on the sea, because his heart was lifted up.
target: Az fi Antiokos, wen im ben kyari we out a di templ wan touzn iet onjred talent, im ori we tu Antiok, a tingk ina im arogans se im kuda siel pan lan an waak pan di sii, bikaa im aat ben lif op.

en: Moreover he left governors to afflict the people: at Jerusalem, Philip, a Phrygian by birth, and in character more barbarous than him who set him there;
target: Muor im lef govna dem fi aflik di piipl: a Jeruusalem, Filip, wan Frijian bai bort, an ina kyarakta muor baabaros dan im we set im de;

en: and at Gerizim, Andronicus; and besides these, Menelaus, who worse than all the rest, exalted himself against his fellow citizens. Having a malicious mind toward the Jews whom he had made his citizens,
target: an a Gerizim, Andronikos; an bisaid dem ya, Menilaos, we wors dan aal di res, egzalt imself gens im felo sitizn dem. Im av wan malishos main tuwaadz di Juu dem we im ben mek im sitizn dem,

en: he sent that lord of pollutions Apollonius with an army of twenty-two thousand, commanding him to kill all those who were of full age, and to sell the women and the boys as slaves.
target: im sen da smol-laad a polyuushan de Apolonyos wid wan aami a twenti-tuu touzn, a komaan im fi kil aal dem we a ful iej, an fi sel di uman dem an di bwai dem az sliev.

en: He came to Jerusalem, and pretending to be a man of peace, waited till the holy day of the Sabbath, and finding the Jews at rest from work, he commanded his men to parade fully armed.
target: Im kom tu Jeruusalem, an a pritend fi bi wan man a piis, wiet til di uoli die a di Sabat, an fain di Juu dem a res fram work, im komaan im man dem fi paried fuli aam.

en: He put to the sword all those who came out to the spectacle. Running into the city with the armed men, he killed great multitudes.
target: Im put tu di suord aal dem we kom out tu di spektakl. Im ron ina di siti wid di aam man dem, im kil griet moltityuud dem.

en: But Judas, who is also called Maccabaeus, with about nine others, withdrew himself, and with his company kept himself alive in the mountains like wild animals do. They continued feeding on what grew wild, that they might not be partakers of the defilement.
target: Bot Juudas, we dem kaal Makabius tu, wid bout nain ada, widraa imself, an wid im kompini kip imself alaiv ina di mountn dem laik wail animal dem du. Dem kip a fiid pan dat we gro wail, so dem mait no shier ina di difailment.

en: Not long after this, the king sent out an old man of Athens to compel the Jews to depart from the laws of their fathers and not to live by the laws of God,
target: No lang afta dis, di king sen out wan uol man a Atens fi fuos di Juu dem fi lef di laa dem a dem faada dem an no liv bai di laa dem a Gad,

en: and also to pollute the sanctuary in Jerusalem and to call it by the name of Olympian Zeus, and to call the sanctuary in Gerizim by the name of Zeus the Protector of foreigners, even as the people who lived in that place did.
target: an tu fi polyuut di sankchuari ina Jeruusalem an fi kaal i bai di niem a Olimpia Zuus, an fi kaal di sankchuari ina Gerizim bai di niem a Zuus di Protekta a farina dem, jos laik di piipl we liv ina da plies de du.

en: The visitation of this evil was harsh and utterly grievous.
target: Di vizitieshan a dis iivl ben aash an utali griivos.

en: For the temple was filled with debauchery and reveling by the heathen, who dallied with prostitutes, and had intercourse with women within the sacred precincts, and moreover brought inside things that were not appropriate.
target: Kaa di templ ful a debachri an revelin bai di iitn dem, we a plie wid prastityuut dem, an av intakuos wid uman dem widin di siekrid plies dem, an muor bring insaid ting dem we no ben aproopriet.

en: The altar was filled with those detestable things which had been prohibited by the laws.
target: Di aalta ful a dem ditestabl ting de we di laa dem ben faabid.

en: A man could neither keep the Sabbath, nor observe the feasts of their ancestors, nor so much as confess himself to be a Jew.
target: Wan man kuda niida kip di Sabat, nar obzerv di fiis dem a dem ansesta dem, nar so moch az konfes imself fi bi wan Juu.

en: On the day of the king’s birth every month, they were led along with bitter constraint to eat of the sacrifices. When the feast of Dionysia came, they were compelled to go in procession in honor of Dionysus, wearing wreaths of ivy.
target: Pan di die a di king bort evri mont, dem liid alang wid bita fuos fi iit a di sakrifais dem. Wen di fiis a Daionishia kom, dem fuos dem fi go ina proseshan ina ana a Daionisos, a wier riit a aivi.

en: A decree went out to the neighboring Greek cities, by the suggestion of Ptolemy, that they should observe the same conduct against the Jews, and should make them eat of the sacrifices,
target: Wan dikrii go out tu di niebarin Griik siti dem, bai di sogjeshan a Tolimi, se dem shuda obzerv di siem kondok gens di Juu dem, an shuda mek dem iit a di sakrifais dem,

en: and that they should kill those who didn’t choose to go over to the Greek rites. So the present misery was for all to see.
target: an se dem shuda kil dem we no chuuz fi go uova tu di Griik rait dem. So di prezant mizri ben fi aal fi si.

en: For example, two women were brought in for having circumcised their children. These, when they had led them publicly around the city with the babes hung from their breasts, they threw down headlong from the wall.
target: Fi egzampl, tuu uman get bring in fi av sorkomsaiz dem pikni dem. Dem ya, wen dem ben liid dem poblikli roun di siti wid di biebi dem a ang fram dem bres, dem chruo dong edlang fram di waal.

en: Others who had run together into the caves nearby to keep the seventh day secretly, were betrayed to Philip and were all burned together, because their piety kept them from defending themselves, in view of the honor of that most solemn day.
target: Ada dem we ben ron tugeda ina di kiev dem nierbai fi kip di sevent die siikritli, get bitrie tu Filip an aal bon tugeda, bikaa dem paieti kip dem fram difen demself, ina vyuu a di ana a da muos solem die de.

en: I urge those who read this book to not be discouraged because of the calamities, but recognize that these punishments were not for the destruction, but for the chastening of our people.
target: Mi beg dem we riid dis buk no fi get diskorij bikaa a di kalamiti dem, bot fi nuo se dem ponishment ya ben no fi di distrokshan, bot fi di chiesnin a wi piipl.

en: For indeed it is a sign of great kindness that those who act impiously are not let alone for a long time, but immediately meet with retribution.
target: Kaa fi chuu i a wan sain a griet kainnis se dem we akt ongadli no get lef aluon fi wan lang taim, bot imediietli miit wid retribyuushan.

en: For in the case of the other nations, the Sovereign Lord waits patiently to punish them until they have attained to the full measure of their sins; but not with us,
target: Kaa ina di kies a di ada nieshan dem, di Sovrin Laad wiet pieshentli fi ponish dem til dem ben atien tu di ful mezha a dem sin dem; bot no wid wi,

en: that he may not take vengeance on us afterward, when we have come to the height of our sins.
target: se im mait no tek venjans pan wi afta, wen wi ben kom tu di ait a wi sin dem.

en: Therefore he never withdraws his mercy from us; but though he chastens with calamity, he doesn’t forsake his own people.
target: So im neva widraa im mersi fram wi; bot duo im chiesn wid kalamiti, im no lef im uon piipl.

en: However let this that we have spoken suffice to remind you; but after a few words, we must come to the narrative.
target: Bot mek dis we wi taak sota fi rimaind unu; bot afta wan fyuu wod, wi mos kom tu di telin.

en: Eleazar, one of the principal scribes, a man already well advanced in years, and of a noble countenance, was compelled to open his mouth to eat swine’s flesh.
target: Eliaza, wan a di prinsipal skraib dem, wan man aredi wel advans ina ier, an a nuobl kountinans, get fuos fi uopn im mout fi iit swain flesh.

en: But he, welcoming death with honor rather than life with defilement, advanced of his own accord to the instrument of torture, but first spat out the flesh,
target: Bot im, a welkom det wid ana rada dan laif wid difailment, advans a im uon akaad tu di instument a taacha, bot fos spit out di flesh,

en: as men ought to come who are resolute to repel such things as not even for the natural love of life is it lawful to taste.
target: laik man shuda kom we rezolyuut fi ripel soch ting dem az no iivn fi di nachral lov a laif i laaful fi ties.

en: But those who had the charge of that forbidden sacrificial feast took the man aside, for the acquaintance which of old times they had with him, and privately implored him to bring flesh of his own providing, such as was proper for him to use, and to make as if he did eat of the flesh from the sacrifice, as had been commanded by the king;
target: Bot dem we av di chaaj a da faabidn sakrifishal fiis de tek di man asaide, fi di akwaintans we fram uol taim dem av wid im, an praivitli beg im fi bring flesh a im uon provaidin, soch az ben praper fi im fi yuuz, an fi mek laik im du iit a di flesh fram di sakrifais, laik di king ben komaan;

en: that by so doing he might be delivered from death, and so his ancient friendship with them might be treated kindly.
target: se bai so duin im mait get diliva fram det, an so im ienshent frenship wid dem mait get triit kainli.

en: But he, having formed a high resolve, and one that became his years, the dignity of old age, and the gray hairs which he had reached with honor, and his excellent education from a child, or rather the holy laws of God’s ordaining, declared his mind accordingly, bidding them to quickly send him to Hades.
target: Bot im, afta im faam wan ai rizolv, an wan we bikom im ier dem, di digniti a uol iej, an di grie ier dem we im ben riich wid ana, an im ekselent edyukieshan fram wan pikni, ar rada di uoli laa dem a Gad aada, diklier im main so, a bid dem fi kwikli sen im tu Iidis.

en: “For it doesn’t become our years to dissemble,” he said, “that many of the young should suppose that Eleazar, the man of ninety years, had gone over to an alien religion;
target: “Kaa i no bikom wi ier dem fi disembl,” im se, “se meni a di yong shuda sopuoz se Eliaza, di man a nainti ier, ben go uova tu wan ielian rilijan;

en: and so they, by reason of my deception, and for the sake of this brief and momentary life, would be led astray because of me, and I defile and disgrace myself in my old age.
target: an so dem, bikaa a mai disepshan, an fi di siek a dis briif an muomentari laif, wuda get liid astre bikaa a mi, an mi difail an disgries miself ina mai uol iej.

en: For even if for the present time I would remove from me the punishment of men, yet whether I live or die, I wouldn’t escape the hands of the Almighty.
target: Kaa iivn if fi di prezant taim mi wuda rimuuv fram mi di ponishment a man dem, stil weda mi liv ar dai, mi wuda no eskiep di an dem a di Olmaiti.

en: Therefore, by bravely parting with my life now, I will show myself worthy of my old age,
target: So, bai brievli paatin wid mai laif nou, mi wi shuo miself woerti a mai uol iej,

en: and leave behind a noble example to the young to die willingly and nobly a glorious death for the revered and holy laws.” When he had said these words, he went immediately to the instrument of torture.
target: an liiv baka wan nuobl egzampl tu di yong fi dai wilinli an nuobli wan gluorios det fi di rivier an uoli laa dem.” Wen im ben se dem wod ya, im go imediietli tu di instument a taacha.

en: When they changed the good will they bore toward him a little before into ill will because these words of his were, as they thought, sheer madness,
target: Wen dem chienj di gud wil dem bier tuwaadz im wan likl bifuo ina il wil bikaa dem wod ya a im ben, laik dem tingk, shiir madnis,

en: and when he was at the point to die with the blows, he groaned aloud and said, “To the Lord, who has the holy knowledge, it is manifest that, while I might have been delivered from death, I endure severe pains in my body by being scourged; but in soul I gladly suffer these things because of my fear of him.”
target: an wen im ben a di point fi dai wid di bluo dem, im gruon aloud an se, “Tu di Laad, we av di uoli nalij, i klier se, wail mi mait ben get diliva fram det, mi endyuur seviir pien dem ina mai badi bai a get skerj; bot ina suol mi gladli sofa dem ting ya bikaa a mai fier a im.”

en: So this man also died like this, leaving his death for an example of nobleness and a memorial of virtue, not only to the young but also to the great body of his nation.
target: So dis man ded laik dis tu, a liiv im det fi wan egzampl a nuoblnis an wan memorial a voertyuu, no onli tu di yong bot tu di griet badi a im nieshan tu.

en: Seven brothers and their mother were at the king’s command taken and shamefully handled with scourges and cords, to compel them to taste of the detestable swine’s flesh.
target: Sevn breda an dem mada get tek a di king komaan an shiemfuli andl wid skerj dem an kaad dem, fi fuos dem fi ties a di ditestabl swain flesh.

en: One of them made himself the spokesman and said, “What would you ask and learn from us? For we are ready to die rather than transgress the laws of our ancestors.”
target: Wan a dem mek imself di spuuoksman an se, “Wa yu wuda aks an lorn fram wi? Kaa wi redi fi dai rada dan chransgres di laa dem a wi ansesta dem.”

en: The king fell into a rage, and commanded that pans and caldrons be heated.
target: Di king faal ina wan riej, an komaan se pan dem an kaldran dem fi iit op.

en: When these were immediately heated, he gave orders to cut out the tongue of him who had been their spokesman, and to scalp him, and to cut off his extremities, with the rest of his brothers and his mother looking on.
target: Wen dem ya get iit op imediietli, im giv aada fi kot out di tong a im we ben dem spuuoksman, an fi skalp im, an fi kot aaf im an an fut dem, wid di res a im breda dem an im mada a luk aan.

en: And when he was utterly maimed, the king gave orders to bring him to the fire, being yet alive, and to fry him in the pan. And as the smoke from the pan spread far, they and their mother also exhorted one another to die nobly, saying this:
target: An wen im ben utali miem, di king giv aada fi bring im tu di faiya, a stil alaiv, an fi frai im ina di pan. An az di smuok fram di pan spred faar, dem an dem mada tu beg wan aneda strang fi dai nuobli, a se dis:

en: “The Lord God sees, and in truth is entreated for us, as Moses declared in his song, which witnesses against the people to their faces, saying, ‘And he will have compassion on his servants.’ ”
target: “Di Laad Gad si, an ina chuut get beg fi wi, laik Muoziz diklier ina im sang, we witnis gens di piipl tu dem fies, a se, ‘An im wi av kompashan pan im saavant dem.’ ”

en: And when the first had died like this, they brought the second to the mocking; and they pulled off the skin of his head with the hair and asked him, “Will you eat, before your body is punished in every limb?”
target: An wen di fos ben ded laik dis, dem bring di sekan tu di makin; an dem pul aaf di skin a im ed wid di ier an aks im, “Yu wi iit, bifuo yu badi get ponish ina evri lim?”

en: But he answered in the language of his ancestors and said to them, “No.” Therefore he also underwent the next torture in succession, as the first had done.
target: Bot im ansa ina di langwij a im ansesta dem an se tu dem, “Nuo.” So im tu go chruu di neks taacha ina sokseshan, laik di fos ben du.

en: When he was at the last gasp, he said, “You, miscreant, release us out of this present life, but the King of the world will raise us who have died for his laws up to an everlasting renewal of life.”
target: Wen im ben a di laas gasp, im se, “Yu, wikid man, riliis wi out a dis prezant laif, bot di King a di worl wi riez wi we ben dai fi im laa dem op tu wan evalaastin rinyuual a laif.”

en: After him, the third was made a victim of their mocking. When he was required, he quickly put out his tongue, and stretched out his hands courageously,
target: Afta im, di tord get mek wan viktim a dem makin. Wen dem rikwaiya im, im kwikli put out im tong, an strech out im an dem koriejosli,

en: and nobly said, “I got these from heaven. For his laws’ sake I treat these with contempt. From him, I hope to receive these back again.”
target: an nuobli se, “Mi get dem ya fram evn. Fi im laa dem siek mi triit dem ya wid kontempt. Fram im, mi uop fi get dem ya bak agen.”

en: As a result, the king himself and those who were with him were astonished at the young man’s soul, for he regarded the pains as nothing.
target: Az wan rizolt, di king imself an dem we de wid im get astanish a di yong man suol, kaa im rigaad di pien dem az notn.

en: When he too was dead, they shamefully handled and tortured the fourth in the same way.
target: Wen im tu ben ded, dem shiemfuli andl an taacha di fuot ina di siem wie.

en: Being near to death he said this: “It is good to die at the hands of men and look for the hope which is given by God, that we will be raised up again by him. For as for you, you will have no resurrection to life.”
target: A de nier tu det im se dis: “I gud fi dai a di an dem a man an luk fi di uop we Gad giv, se wi wi get riez op agen bai im. Kaa az fi yu, yu wi av no rezoreckshan tu laif.”

en: Next after him, they brought the fifth and shamefully handled him.
target: Neks afta im, dem bring di fif an shiemfuli andl im.

en: But he looked toward the king and said, “Because you have authority among men, though you are corruptible, you do what you please. But don’t think that our people has been forsaken by God.
target: Bot im luk tuwaadz di king an se, “Bikaa yu av atariti mong man dem, duo yu koroptibl, yu du wa yu pliz. Bot no tingk se wi piipl get lef bai Gad.

en: But hold on to your ways, and see how his sovereign majesty will torture you and your descendants!”
target: Bot tan pan yu wie dem, an si ou im sovrin majesti wi taacha yu an yu pikni-pikni dem!”

en: After him they brought the sixth. When he was about to die, he said, “Don’t be vainly deceived, for we suffer these things for our own doings, as sinning against our own God. Astounding things have come to pass;
target: Afta im dem bring di siks. Wen im ben bout fi dai, im se, “No get vienli disiiv, kaa wi sofa dem ting ya fi wi uon duin dem, az a sin gens wi uon Gad. Astoundin ting dem don kom tu paas;

en: but don’t think that you will be unpunished, having tried to fight against God!”
target: bot no tingk se yu wi go onponish, afta yu trai fi fait gens Gad!”

en: But above all, the mother was marvelous and worthy of honorable memory; for when she watched seven sons perishing within the space of one day, she bore the sight with a good courage because of her hope in the Lord.
target: Bot abov aal, di mada ben maavilos an woerti a anarabl memri; kaa wen shi wach sevn son a ded widin di spies a wan die, shi bier di sait wid wan gud korij bikaa a ar uop ina di Laad.

en: She exhorted each one of them in the language of their fathers, filled with a noble spirit and stirring up her woman’s thoughts with manly courage, saying to them,
target: Shi beg iich wan a dem strang ina di langwij a dem faada dem, ful a wan nuobl spirit an a stir op ar uman taat dem wid manli korij, a se tu dem,

en: “I don’t know how you came into my womb. It wasn’t I who gave you your spirit and your life. It wasn’t I who brought into order the first elements of each one of you.
target: “Mi no nuo ou unu kom ina mai wuum. A no mi we giv unu unu spirit an unu laif. A no mi we bring ina aada di fos eliment dem a iich wan a unu.

en: Therefore the Creator of the world, who shaped the first origin of man and devised the first origin of all things, in mercy gives back to you again both your spirit and your life, as you now treat yourselves with contempt for his laws’ sake.”
target: So di Krietor a di worl, we shiep di fos orijin a man an divaiz di fos orijin a aal ting, ina mersi giv bak tu unu agen buot unu spirit an unu laif, az unu nou triit unuself wid kontempt fi im laa dem siek.”

en: But Antiochus, thinking himself to be despised, and suspecting the reproachful voice, while the youngest was yet alive didn’t only make his appeal to him by words, but also at the same time promised with oaths that he would enrich him and raise him to high honor if he would turn from the ways of his ancestors, and that he would take him for his friend and entrust him with public affairs.
target: Bot Antiokos, a tingk imself fi get despais, an a sospeck di riproochful vais, wail di yongis ben stil alaiv no onli mek im apiil tu im bai wod dem, bot tu a di siem taim pramis wid uot dem se im wuda mek im rich an riez im tu ai ana if im wuda ton fram di wie dem a im ansesta dem, an se im wuda tek im fi im fren an entros im wid poblik afier dem.

en: But when the young man would in no way listen, the king called to him his mother, and urged her to advise the youth to save himself.
target: Bot wen di yong man wuda ina no wie lisn, di king kaal tu im im mada, an beg ar fi advais di yuut fi siev imself.

en: When he had urged her with many words, she undertook to persuade her son.
target: Wen im ben beg ar wid meni wod, shi tek pan arself fi pasuied ar son.

en: But bending toward him, laughing the cruel tyrant to scorn, she spoke this in the language of her fathers: “My son, have mercy on me who carried you nine months in my womb, and nursed you three years, and nourished and brought you up to this age, and sustained you.
target: Bot a ben tuwaadz im, a laaf di kruel tairant tu skaan, shi taak dis ina di langwij a ar faada dem: “Mai son, av mersi pan mi we kyari yu nain mont ina mai wuum, an nors yu chrii ier, an norish an bring yu op tu dis iej, an sostien yu.

en: I beg you, my child, to lift your eyes to the sky and the earth, and to see all things that are in it, and thus to recognize that God made them not of things that were, and that mankind in this way comes into being.
target: Mi beg yu, mai pikni, fi lif yu yai dem tu di skai an di ort, an fi si aal ting we de ina i, an so fi nuo se Gad mek dem no a ting dem we ben de, an se mankaind ina dis wie kom ina biin.

en: Don’t be afraid of this butcher, but, proving yourself worthy of your brothers, accept your death, that in God’s mercy I may receive you again with your brothers.”
target: No fried a dis bucha, bot, a pruuv yuself woerti a yu breda dem, aksept yu det, se ina Gad mersi mi mait get yu agen wid yu breda dem.”

en: But before she had finished speaking, the young man said, “What are you all waiting for? I don’t obey the command of the king, but I listen to the command of the law that was given to our fathers through Moses.
target: Bot bifuo shi ben finish a taak, di yong man se, “Wa unu aal a wiet fi? Mi no obie di komaan a di king, bot mi lisn tu di komaan a di laa we ben giv tu wi faada dem chruu Muoziz.

en: But you, who have devised all kinds of evil against the Hebrews, will in no way escape God’s hands.
target: Bot yu, we ben divaiz aal kain a iivl gens di Ibruu dem, wi ina no wie eskiep Gad an dem.

en: For we are suffering because of our own sins.
target: Kaa wi a sofa bikaa a wi uon sin dem.

en: If for rebuke and chastening, our living Lord has been angered a little while, yet he will again be reconciled with his own servants.
target: If fi ribyuuk an chiesnin, wi livin Laad ben anga wan likl wail, stil im wi agen setl wid im uon saavant dem.

en: But you, O unholy man and of all most vile, don’t be vainly lifted up in your wild pride with uncertain hopes, raising your hand against the heavenly children.
target: Bot yu, O onuoli man an a aal muos vail, no get vienli lif op ina yu wail praid wid onsaten uop dem, a riez yu an gens di evnli pikni dem.

en: For you have not yet escaped the judgment of the Almighty God who sees all things.
target: Kaa yu no eskiep yet di jojment a di Olmaiti Gad we si aal ting.

en: For these our brothers, having endured a short pain that brings everlasting life, have now died under God’s covenant. But you, through God’s judgment, will receive in just measure the penalties of your arrogance.
target: Kaa dem breda ya a wi, afta dem endyuur wan shaat pien we bring evalaastin laif, nou ded anda Gad kovnant. Bot yu, chruu Gad jojment, wi get ina jos mezha di penalti dem a yu arogans.

en: But I, as my brothers, give up both body and soul for the laws of our fathers, calling upon God that he may speedily become gracious to the nation, and that you, amidst trials and plagues, may confess that he alone is God,
target: Bot mi, laik mai breda dem, giv op buot badi an suol fi di laa dem a wi faada dem, a kaal pan Gad se im mait kwikli bikom grieshos tu di nieshan, an se yu, ina migl a chraial dem an plieg dem, mait konfes se im aluon a Gad,

en: and that in me and my brothers you may bring to an end the wrath of the Almighty which has been justly brought upon our whole people.”
target: an se ina mi an mai breda dem yu mait bring tu wan en di raat a di Olmaiti we ben josli bring pan wi uol piipl.”

en: But the king, falling into a rage, handled him worse than all the rest, being exasperated at his mocking.
target: Bot di king, a faal ina wan riej, andl im wors dan aal di res, a get beks a im makin.

en: So he also died pure, putting his whole trust in the Lord.
target: So im ded pyuur tu, a put im uol chros ina di Laad.

en: Last of all, after her sons, the mother died.
target: Laas a aal, afta ar son dem, di mada ded.

en: Let it then suffice to have said thus much concerning the sacrificial feasts and the extreme tortures.
target: Mek i so sota fi don se so moch bout di sakrifishal fiis dem an di ekstriim taacha dem.

en: But Judas, who is also called Maccabaeus, and those who were with him, making their way secretly into the villages, called together their kindred. Enlisting those who had continued in the Jews’ religion, they gathered together about six thousand.
target: Bot Juudas, we dem kaal Makabius tu, an dem we de wid im, a mek dem wie siikritli ina di vilij dem, kaal tugeda dem kin dem. Dem enlist dem we ben kontinyu ina di Juu dem rilijan, dem gyada tugeda bout siks touzn.

en: They called upon the Lord to look at the people who were oppressed by all, and to have compassion on the sanctuary that had been profaned by the ungodly men,
target: Dem kaal pan di Laad fi luk a di piipl we ben opres bai aal, an fi av kompashan pan di sankchuari we ongadli man dem ben profien,

en: and to have mercy on the city that was suffering ruin and ready to be leveled to the ground, and to listen to the blood that cried out to him,
target: an fi av mersi pan di siti we ben a sofa ryuin an redi fi get level tu di groun, an fi lisn tu di blod we krai out tu im,

en: and to remember the lawless destruction of the innocent infants, and concerning the blasphemies that had been committed against his name, and to show his hatred of wickedness.
target: an fi memba di laalis distrokshan a di inosent infant dem, an bout di blasfimi dem we ben komit gens im niem, an fi shuo im ietrid a wikidnis.

en: When Maccabaeus had trained his men for service, the heathen at once found him irresistible, for the wrath of the Lord was turned into mercy.
target: Wen Makabius ben trien im man dem fi servis, di iitn dem at wons fain im kyaan stop, kaa di raat a di Laad ben ton ina mersi.

en: Coming without warning, he set fire to cities and villages. And in winning back the most important positions, putting to flight no small number of the enemies,
target: A kom widout waanin, im set faiya tu siti dem an vilij dem. An ina a win bak di muos impuotant pozishan dem, a put tu flait no smol nomba a di enimi dem,

en: he especially took advantage of the nights for such assaults. His courage was loudly talked of everywhere.
target: im espeshal tek advantij a di nait dem fi soch asolt dem. Im korij get taak bout loud evriwie.

en: But when Philip saw the man gaining ground little by little, and increasing more and more in his success, he wrote to Ptolemy, the governor of Coelesyria and Phoenicia, that he should support the king’s cause.
target: Bot wen Filip si di man a gien groun likl bai likl, an a inkriis muor an muor ina im sokses, im rait tu Tolimi, di govna a Siilisiria an Finiisha, se im shuda sopuot di king kaaz.

en: Ptolemy quickly appointed Nicanor the son of Patroclus, one of the king’s chief friends, and sent him, in command of no fewer than twenty thousand of all nations, to destroy the whole people of Judea. With him he joined Gorgias also, a captain and one who had experience in matters of war.
target: Tolimi kwikli apoint Nikanor di son a Patroklos, wan a di king chiif fren dem, an sen im, ina komaan a no fyuuwa dan twenti touzn a aal nieshan, fi distrai di uol piipl a Juudia. Wid im im jain Goerjias tu, wan kaptin an wan we av eksperiens ina mata dem a waar.

en: Nicanor resolved by the sale of the captive Jews to make up for the king the tribute of two thousand talents which he was to pay to the Romans.
target: Nikanor rizolv bai di siel a di kyaptiv Juu dem fi mek op fi di king di chribyuut a tuu touzn talent we im ben fi pie tu di Ruoman dem.

en: Immediately he sent to the cities upon the sea coast, inviting them to buy Jewish slaves, promising to deliver seventy slaves for a talent, not expecting the judgment that was to overtake him from the Almighty.
target: Imediietli im sen tu di siti dem pan di sii kuos, a invait dem fi bai Juu sliev dem, a pramis fi diliva seventi sliev fi wan talent, no a ekspek di jojment we ben fi uovatek im fram di Olmaiti.

en: News came to Judas concerning Nicanor’s invasion. When he communicated to those who were with him the presence of the army,
target: Nyuuz kom tu Juudas bout Nikanor inviezhan. Wen im tel dem we de wid im bout di prezans a di aami,

en: those who were cowardly and distrustful of God’s judgment ran away and left the country.
target: dem we ben kouadli an no chros Gad jojment ron we an lef di kontri.

en: Others sold all that they had left, and at the same time implored the Lord to deliver those who had been sold as slaves by the impious Nicanor before he ever met them,
target: Ada dem sel aal we dem av lef, an a di siem taim beg di Laad fi diliva dem we ben suol az sliev bai di ongadli Nikanor bifuo im eva miit dem,

en: if not for their own sakes, then for the covenants made with their ancestors, and because he had called them by his holy and glorious name.
target: if no fi dem uon siek, den fi di kovnant dem we mek wid dem ansesta dem, an bikaa im ben kaal dem bai im uoli an gluorios niem.

en: So Maccabaeus gathered his men together, six thousand in number, and exhorted them not to be frightened by the enemy, nor to fear the great multitude of the heathen who came wrongfully against them, but to fight nobly,
target: So Makabius gyada im man dem tugeda, siks touzn ina nomba, an beg dem strang no fi get fraitn bai di enimi, nar fier di griet moltityuud a di iitn dem we kom rangfuli gens dem, bot fi fait nuobli,

en: setting before their eyes the outrage that had been lawlessly perpetrated upon the holy place, and the torture of the city that had been turned to mockery, and further the overthrow of the way of life received from their ancestors.
target: a set bifuo dem yai di outrage we ben laalisli du pan di uoli plies, an di taacha a di siti we ben ton tu makin, an forda di uovatruo a di wie a laif we dem get fram dem ansesta dem.

en: “For they,” he said, “trust their weapons and daring deeds, but we trust in the almighty God, since he is able at a nod to cast down those who are coming against us, and even the whole world.”
target: “Kaa dem,” im se, “chros dem wepon dem an dier diid dem, bot wi chros ina di olmaiti Gad, sins im iebl a wan nad fi kaas dong dem we a kom gens wi, an iivn di uol worl.”

en: Moreover, he recounted to them the help given from time to time in the days of their ancestors, both in the days of Sennacherib, when one hundred eighty-five thousand perished,
target: Muor, im tel dem agen bout di elp we giv fram taim tu taim ina di die dem a dem ansesta dem, buot ina di die dem a Senakerib, wen wan onjred ieti-faiv touzn ded,

en: and in the land of Babylon, in the battle that was fought against the Gauls, how they came to the battle with eight thousand in all, with four thousand Macedonians, and how, the Macedonians being hard pressed, the six thousand destroyed the hundred and twenty thousand because of the help which they had from heaven, and took a great deal of plunder.
target: an ina di lan a Babilan, ina di batl we fait gens di Gaal dem, ou dem kom tu di batl wid iet touzn ina aal, wid fuor touzn Masedonian dem, an ou, di Masedonian dem a get aad pres, di siks touzn distrai di onjred an twenti touzn bikaa a di elp we dem av fram evn, an tek wan griet diil a plonda.

en: And when he had with these words filled them with courage and made them ready to die for the laws and their country, he divided his army into four parts.
target: An wen im ben wid dem wod ya fil dem wid korij an mek dem redi fi dai fi di laa dem an dem kontri, im divaid im aami ina fuor paat.

en: He appointed his brothers, Simon, Joseph, and Jonathan, to be leaders of the divisions with him, giving each the command of one thousand five hundred men.
target: Im apoint im breda dem, Saiman, Juozif, an Jonatan, fi bi liida dem a di divizhan dem wid im, a giv iich di komaan a wan touzn faiv onjred man.

en: Moreover Eleazer also, having read aloud the sacred book, and having given as watchword, “THE HELP OF GOD”, leading the first band himself, joined battle with Nicanor.
target: Muor Eliaza tu, afta im riid aloud di siekrid buk, an afta im giv az wachwod, “DI ELP A GAD”, a liid di fos ban imself, jain batl wid Nikanor.

en: Since the Almighty fought on their side, they killed more than nine thousand of the enemy, and wounded and disabled most of Nicanor’s army, and compelled them all to flee.
target: Sins di Olmaiti fait pan dem said, dem kil muor dan nain touzn a di enimi, an wuun an disiebl muos a Nikanor aami, an fuos dem aal fi flii.

en: They took the money of those who had come there to buy them as slaves. After they had pursued them for some distance, they returned, being constrained by the time of the day;
target: Dem tek di moni a dem we ben kom de fi bai dem az sliev. Afta dem ben posyuu dem fi som distans, dem ton bak, a get konstrien bai di taim a di die;

en: for it was the day before the Sabbath, and for this reason they made no effort to chase them far.
target: kaa i ben di die bifuo di Sabat, an fi dis riizn dem mek no efort fi chies dem faar.

en: When they had gathered the weapons of the enemy together, and had stripped off their spoils, they kept the Sabbath, greatly blessing and thanking the Lord who had saved them to this day, because he had begun to show mercy to them.
target: Wen dem ben gyada di wepon dem a di enimi tugeda, an ben strip aaf dem spail dem, dem kip di Sabat, a bles grietli an a tank di Laad we ben siev dem tu dis die, bikaa im ben bigin fi shuo mersi tu dem.

en: After the Sabbath, when they had given some of the spoils to the maimed, and to the widows and orphans, they distributed the rest among themselves and their children.
target: Afta di Sabat, wen dem ben giv som a di spail dem tu di miem dem, an tu di wido dem an aafan dem, dem distribbyuut di res mong demself an dem pikni dem.

en: When they had accomplished these things and had made a common supplication, they implored the merciful Lord to be wholly reconciled with his servants.
target: Wen dem ben akomplish dem ting ya an ben mek wan koman beg, dem beg di mersiful Laad fi setl fuli wid im saavant dem.

en: Having had an encounter with the forces of Timotheus and Bacchides, they killed more than twenty thousand of them, and made themselves masters of exceedingly high strongholds, and divided very much plunder, giving the maimed, orphans, widows, and the aged an equal share with themselves.
target: Afta dem av wan enkaunta wid di fuos dem a Timoteos an Bakidis, dem kil muor dan twenti touzn a dem, an mek demself maasta a eksiedinli ai strangol dem, an divaid veri moch plonda, a giv di miem dem, aafan dem, wido dem, an di iej man dem wan iikwal shier wid demself.

en: When they had gathered the weapons of the enemy together, they stored them all up carefully in the most strategic positions, and they carried the rest of the spoils to Jerusalem.
target: Wen dem ben gyada di wepon dem a di enimi tugeda, dem stuor dem aal op kierfuli ina di muos stratiijik pozishan dem, an dem kyari di res a di spail dem tu Jeruusalem.

en: They killed the phylarch of Timotheus’s forces, a most unholy man, and one who had done the Jews much harm.
target: Dem kil di failaak a Timoteos fuos dem, wan muos onuoli man, an wan we ben du di Juu dem moch aam.

en: As they celebrated the feast of victory in the city of their fathers, they burned those who had set the sacred gates on fire, including Callisthenes, who had fled into a little house. So they received the proper reward for their impiety.
target: Az dem selibriet di fiis a viktori ina di siti a dem faada dem, dem bon dem we ben set di siekrid giet dem pan faiya, inkluudin Kalisteniiz, we ben flii ina wan likl ous. So dem get di praper riwaad fi dem ongadlinis.

en: The thrice-accursed Nicanor, who had brought the thousand merchants to buy the Jews as slaves,
target: Di chrais-akors Nikanor, we ben bring di touzn morchant dem fi bai di Juu dem az sliev,

en: being through the help of the Lord humbled by them who in his eyes were held to be of least account, took off his glorious apparel, and passing through the country, shunning all company like a fugitive slave, arrived at Antioch, having, as he thought, had the greatest possible good fortune, though his army was destroyed.
target: a get, chruu di elp a di Laad, ombl bai dem we ina im yai dem ben eld fi bi a liis akount, tek aaf im gluorios klouz, an a paas chruu di kontri, a shon aal kompini laik wan fyuujitiv sliev, araiv a Antiok, a av, laik im tingk, di grietis pasibl gud faachun, duo im aami ben distrai.

en: He who had taken upon himself to make tribute sure for the Romans by the captivity of the men of Jerusalem published abroad that the Jews had One who fought for them, and that because this was so, the Jews were invulnerable, because they followed the laws ordained by him.
target: Im we ben tek pan imself fi mek chribyuut shuor fi di Ruoman dem bai di kyaptiviti a di man dem a Jeruusalem poblish abraad se di Juu dem av Wan we fait fi dem, an se bikaa dis ben so, di Juu dem ben invulnarabl, bikaa dem fala di laa dem we im aada.

en: Now about that time, Antiochus retreated in disorder from the region of Persia.
target: Nou bout da taim de, Antiokos ritriit ina disada fram di riijan a Persha.

en: For he had entered into the city called Persepolis, and he attempted to rob a temple and to control the city. Therefore the multitudes rushed in and the people of the country turned to defend themselves with weapons; and Antiochus was put to flight by the people of the country and broke his camp with disgrace.
target: Kaa im ben go ina di siti we dem kaal Persepolis, an im temp fi rab wan templ an fi kontrol di siti. So di moltityuud dem rosh in an di piipl a di kontri ton fi difen demself wid wepon dem; an Antiokos get put tu flait bai di piipl a di kontri an bruk im kamp wid disgries.

en: While he was at Ecbatana, news was brought to him about what had happened to Nicanor and the forces of Timotheus.
target: Wail im de a Ekbatana, nyuuz bring tu im bout wa ben apn tu Nikanor an di fuos dem a Timoteos.

en: Being overcome by his anger, he planned to make the Jews suffer for the evil deeds of those who had put him to flight. Therefore, with judgment from heaven even now accompanying him, he ordered his charioteer to drive without ceasing until he completed the journey; for he arrogantly said this: “I will make Jerusalem a common graveyard of Jews when I come there.”
target: A get uovakom bai im anga, im plan fi mek di Juu dem sofa fi di iivl diid dem a dem we ben put im tu flait. So, wid jojment fram evn iivn nou a fala im, im aada im chariet draiva fi draiv widout stapin til im kompliet di jerni; kaa im arogantli se dis: “Mi wi mek Jeruusalem wan koman griebyaad a Juu dem wen mi kom de.”

en: But the All-seeing Lord, the God of Israel, struck him with a fatal and invisible stroke. As soon as he had finished speaking this word, an incurable pain of the bowels seized him, with bitter torments of the inner parts—
target: Bot di Aal-siin Laad, di Gad a Izrel, lik im wid wan fietal an invizibl struok. Az suun az im ben finish a taak dis wod, wan onkyuurabl pien a di bouel dem siiz im, wid bita taament dem a di ina paat dem —

en: and that most justly, for he had tormented other men’s bowels with many and strange sufferings.
target: an dat muos josli, kaa im ben taament ada man dem bouel wid meni an strienj sofarin dem.
