en: But he in no way ceased from his rude insolence. No, he was filled with even more arrogance, breathing fire in his passion against the Jews, and giving orders to hasten the journey. But he also fell from his chariot as it rushed along, and having a grievous fall was tortured in all of the members of his body.
target: Bot im ina no wie stap fram im ruud insolens. Nuo, im ful wid iivn muor arogans, a briid faiya ina im pashan gens di Juu dem, an a giv aada fi iestn di jerni. Bot im faal fram im chariet tu az i rosh alang, an a av wan griivos faal get taacha ina aal di memba dem a im badi.

en: He who had just supposed himself to have the waves of the sea at his bidding because he was so superhumanly arrogant, and who thought to weigh the heights of the mountains in a balance, was now brought to the ground and carried in a litter, showing to all that the power was obviously God’s,
target: Im we ben jos sopuoz imself fi av di wiev dem a di sii a im biddin bikaa im ben so syuupa-yuumanli arogant, an we tingk fi wie di ait dem a di mountn dem ina wan balans, nou bring tu di groun an kyari ina wan lita, a shuo tu aal se di powa ben abviosli Gad,

en: so that worms swarmed out of the impious man’s body, and while he was still living in anguish and pain, his flesh fell off, and by reason of the stench all the army turned with loathing from his decay.
target: so se worm dem swaam out a di ongadli man badi, an wail im ben stil a liv ina angwish an pien, im flesh faal aaf, an bikaa a di stench aal di aami ton wid luodin fram im dikie.

en: The man who a little before supposed himself to touch the stars of heaven, no one could endure to carry because of his intolerable stench.
target: Di man we wan likl bifuo sopuoz imself fi toch di staar dem a evn, no wan kuda endyuur fi kyari bikaa a im intalarabl stench.

en: Therefore he began in great part to cease from his arrogance, being broken in spirit, and to come to knowledge under the scourge of God, his pains increasing every moment.
target: So im bigin ina griet paat fi stap fram im arogans, a get bruk ina spirit, an fi kom tu nalij anda di skerj a Gad, im pien dem a inkriis evri muoment.

en: When he himself could not stand his own smell, he said these words: “It is right to be subject to God, and that one who is mortal should not think they are equal to God.”
target: Wen im imself kuda no tan im uon smel, im se dem wod ya: “I rait fi bi sobjek tu Gad, an se wan we a mortal shuda no tingk dem iikwal tu Gad.”

en: The vile man vowed to the sovereign Lord, who now no more would have mercy on him, saying
target: Di vail man vow tu di sovrin Laad, we nou no muor wuda av mersi pan im, a se

en: that the holy city, to which he was going in haste to lay it even with the ground and to make it a common graveyard, he would declare free.
target: se di uoli siti, tu we im ben a go ina ies fi lie i iivn wid di groun an fi mek i wan koman griebyaad, im wuda diklier frii.

en: Concerning the Jews, whom he had decided not even to count worthy of burial, but to cast them out to the animals with their infants for the birds to devour, he would make them all equal to citizens of Athens.
target: Bout di Juu dem, we im ben disaid no iivn fi kount woerti a berial, bot fi kaas dem out tu di animal dem wid dem infant dem fi di bord dem fi devour, im wuda mek dem aal iikwal tu sitizn a Atens.

en: The holy sanctuary, which before he had plundered, he would adorn with the best offerings, and would restore all the sacred vessels many times multiplied, and out of his own revenues would defray the charges that were required for the sacrifices.
target: Di uoli sankchuari, we bifuo im ben plonda, im wuda adoan wid di bes aafrin dem, an wuda bring bak aal di siekrid vesl dem meni taim multiply, an out a im uon moni wuda pie di chaaj dem we ben rikwaiya fi di sakrifais dem.

en: Beside all this, he said that he would become a Jew and would visit every inhabited place, proclaiming the power of God.
target: Bisaid aal dis, im se se im wuda bikom wan Juu an wuda vizit evri plies we piipl liv ina, a pro kliem di powa a Gad.

en: But when his sufferings did in no way cease, for the judgment of God had come upon him in righteousness, having given up all hope for himself, he wrote to the Jews the letter written below, having the nature of a supplication, to this effect:
target: Bot wen im sofarin dem ina no wie stap, kaa di jojment a Gad ben kom pan im ina raichosnis, afta im giv op aal uop fi imself, im rait tu di Juu dem di leta we rait biluo, we av di niecha a wan beg, tu dis efek:

en: “To the worthy Jewish citizens, Antiochus, king and general, wishes much joy and health and prosperity.
target: “Tu di woerti Juu sitizn dem, Antiokos, king an jenaral, wish moch jai an elt an prasperiti.

en: May you and your children fare well, and may your affairs be as you wish. Having my hope in heaven,
target: Mie unu an unu pikni dem fier wel, an mie unu afier dem bi az unu wish. A av mai uop ina evn,

en: I remembered with affection your honor and good will. Returning out of the region of Persia, and being taken with an annoying sickness, I deemed it necessary to take thought for the common safety of all,
target: mi memba wid afekshan unu ana an gud wil. A ton bak out a di riijan a Persha, an a get tek wid wan anaiin siknis, mi tingk i nesiseri fi tek taat fi di koman siefti a aal,

en: not despairing of myself, but having great hope to escape from the sickness.
target: no a dispeir a miself, bot a av griet uop fi eskiep fram di siknis.

en: But considering that my father also, at the time he led an army into the upper country, appointed his successor,
target: Bot a konsida se mai faada tu, a di taim im liid wan aami ina di opa kontri, apoint im soksesa,

en: to the end that, if anything fell out contrary to expectation, or if any unwelcome tidings were brought, the people in the country, knowing to whom the state had been left, might not be troubled,
target: tu di en se, if eniting faal out kontreri tu ekspektieshan, ar if eni onwelkom nyuuz bring, di piipl ina di kontri, we nuo tu uum di stiet ben lef, mait no get trobl,

en: and, moreover, observing how the princes who are along the borders and neighbors to my kingdom watch for opportunities and look for the future event, I have appointed my son Antiochus to be king, whom I often entrusted and commended to most of you when I was hurrying to the upper provinces. I have written to him what is written below.
target: an, muor, a obzerv ou di prins dem we de alang di baada dem an nieba tu mai kindom wach fi apatyuniti dem an luk fi di fyuuucha ivent, mi don apoint mai son Antiokos fi bi king, we mi aafn entros an komend tu muos a unu wen mi ben a ori tu di opa provins dem. Mi don rait tu im wa rait biluo.

en: I therefore urge you and beg you, having in your remembrance the benefits done to you in common and severally, to preserve your present good will, each of you, toward me and my son.
target: Mi so beg unu an beg unu strang, a av ina unu memri di benefit dem we du tu unu ina koman an wan bai wan, fi prizerv unu prezant gud wil, iich a unu, tuwaadz mi an mai son.

en: For I am persuaded that he in gentleness and kindness will follow my purpose and treat you with moderation and kindness.
target: Kaa mi pasuied se im ina jentlnis an kainnis wi fala mai poerpos an triit unu wid madarieshan an kainnis.

en: So the murderer and blasphemer, having endured the most intense sufferings, even as he had dealt with other men, ended his life among the mountains by a most pitiful fate in a strange land.
target: So di mordara an blasfiima, afta im endyuur di muos intens sofarin dem, iivn laik im ben diil wid ada man dem, en im laif mong di mountn dem bai wan muos pitiful fiet ina wan strienj lan.

en: Philip his foster brother took the body home and then, fearing the son of Antiochus, he withdrew himself to Ptolemy Philometor in Egypt.
target: Filip im fosta breda tek di badi uom an den, a fier di son a Antiokos, im widraa imself tu Tolimi Filometor ina Iijipt.

en: Then Maccabaeus and those who were with him, the Lord leading them on, recovered the temple and the city.
target: Den Makabius an dem we de wid im, di Laad a liid dem aan, get bak di templ an di siti.

en: They pulled down the altars that had been built in the marketplace by the foreigners, and also the sacred enclosures.
target: Dem pul dong di aalta dem we ben bil ina di maakitplies bai di farina dem, an di siekrid enkluozha dem tu.

en: Having cleansed the sanctuary, they made another altar of sacrifice. Striking flint and starting a fire, they offered sacrifices after they had ceased for two years, burned incense, lit lamps, and set out the show bread.
target: Afta dem klenz di sankchuari, dem mek wan nada aalta a sakrifais. Dem straik flint an staat wan faiya, dem aafa sakrifais dem afta dem ben stap fi tuu ier, bon insens, lait lamp dem, an set out di shuo bred.

en: When they had done these things, they fell prostrate and implored the Lord that they might fall no more into such evils; but that, if they ever did sin, they might be chastened by him with forbearance, and not be delivered to blaspheming and barbarous heathen.
target: Wen dem ben du dem ting ya, dem faal flat an beg di Laad se dem mait faal no muor ina soch iivl dem; bot se, if dem eva du sin, dem mait get chiesn bai im wid fierans, an no get diliva tu blasfiimin an baabaros iitn dem.

en: Now on the same day that the sanctuary was profaned by foreigners, upon that very day the sanctuary was cleansed, even on the twenty-fifth day of the same month, which is Chislev.
target: Nou pan di siem die we di farina dem profien di sankchuari, pan da veri die de di sankchuari get klenz, iivn pan di twenti-fif die a di siem mont, we a Kislev.

en: They observed eight days with gladness in the manner of the feast of tabernacles, remembering how not long before, during the feast of tabernacles, they were wandering in the mountains and in the caves like wild animals.
target: Dem obzerv iet die wid gladnis ina di wie a di fiis a tabernakl dem, a memba ou no lang bifuo, juurin di fiis a tabernakl dem, dem ben a wandara ina di mountn dem an ina di kiev dem laik wail animal dem.

en: Therefore carrying wands wreathed with leaves, and beautiful branches, and palm fronds also, they offered up hymns of thanksgiving to him who had successfully brought to pass the cleansing of his own place.
target: So a kyari wand dem we riit wid liiv dem, an byuutiful branch dem, an paam fran dem tu, dem aafa im dem a tanks tu im we ben soksesfuli bring tu paas di klensin a im uon plies.

en: They ordained also with a common command and decree, for all the nation of the Jews, that they should observe these days every year.
target: Dem aada tu wid wan koman komaan an dikrii, fi aal di nieshan a di Juu dem, se dem shuda obzerv dem die ya evri ier.

en: Such were the events of the end of Antiochus, who was called Epiphanes.
target: Soch ben di ivent dem a di en a Antiokos, we dem kaal Epifaniiz.

en: Now we will declare what came to pass under Antiochus Eupator, who proved himself a son of that ungodly man, and will summarize the main evils of the wars.
target: Nou wi wi diklier wa kom tu paas anda Antiokos Yuupator, we pruuv imself wan son a da ongadli man de, an wi wi somaraiz di mien iivl dem a di waar dem.

en: For this man, when he succeeded to the kingdom, appointed one Lysias to be chancellor and supreme governor of Coelesyria and Phoenicia.
target: Kaa dis man, wen im tek uova di kindom, apoint wan Lisias fi bi chansla an supriim govna a Siilisiria an Finiisha.

en: For Ptolemy who was called Macron, setting an example of observing justice toward the Jews because of the wrong that had been done to them, endeavored to deal with them on peaceful terms.
target: Kaa Tolimi we dem kaal Makron, a set wan egzampl a obzervin jostis tuwaadz di Juu dem bikaa a di rang we ben du tu dem, temp fi diil wid dem pan piisful torm dem.

en: Whereupon being accused by the king’s friends before Eupator, and hearing himself called traitor at every turn because he had abandoned Cyprus which Philometor had entrusted to him, and had withdrawn himself to Antiochus Epiphanes, and failing to uphold the honor of his office, he took poison and did away with himself.
target: So a get akyuuz bai di king fren dem bifuo Yuupator, an a ier imself kaal chrieta a evri ton bikaa im ben abandon Saipros we Filometor ben entros tu im, an ben widraa imself tu Antiokos Epifaniiz, an a fiel fi ophuol di ana a im afis, im tek paizn an du we wid imself.

en: But when Gorgias was made governor of the district, he maintained a force of mercenaries, and at every turn kept up war with the Jews.
target: Bot wen Goerjias get mek govna a di distrik, im mentien wan fuos a morsineri dem, an a evri ton kip op waar wid di Juu dem.

en: Together with him the Idumaeans also, being masters of important strongholds, harassed the Jews; and received those who had taken refuge from Jerusalem, they endeavored to keep up the war.
target: Tugeda wid im di Idumian dem tu, a bi maasta a impuotant strangol dem, aras di Juu dem; an risiv dem we ben tek refyuuj fram Jeruusalem, dem temp fi kip op di waar.

en: But Maccabaeus and his men, having made solemn supplication and having implored God to fight on their side, rushed upon the strongholds of the Idumaeans.
target: Bot Makabius an im man dem, afta dem mek solem beg an afta dem beg Gad fi fait pan dem said, rosh pan di strangol dem a di Idumian dem.

en: Assaulting them vigorously, they took control of the positions, and kept off all who fought upon the wall, and killed those whom they encountered, killing no fewer than twenty thousand.
target: Dem asolt dem vigarosli, dem tek kontrol a di pozishan dem, an kip aaf aal we fait pan di waal, an kil dem we dem enkaunta, a kil no fyuuwa dan twenti touzn.

en: Because no fewer than nine thousand had fled into two very strong towers having everything needed for a siege,
target: Bikaa no fyuuwa dan nain touzn ben flii ina tuu veri strang towa dem we av evriting niid fi wan siij,

en: Maccabaeus, having left Simon and Joseph, and also Zacchaeus and those who were with him, a force sufficient to besiege them, departed himself to places where he was most needed.
target: Makabius, afta im lef Saiman an Juozif, an Zakaios tu an dem we de wid im, wan fuos sofisent fi bisiij dem, go imself tu plies dem we im ben muos niid.

en: But Simon and those who were with him, yielding to covetousness, were bribed by some of those who were in the towers, and receiving seventy thousand drachmas, let some of them slip away.
target: Bot Saiman an dem we de wid im, a yiil tu kovetosnis, get braib bai som a dem we de ina di towa dem, an a get seventi touzn drakma, let som a dem slip we.

en: But when word was brought to Maccabaeus of what was done, he gathered the leaders of the people together, and accused those men of having sold their brothers for money by setting their enemies free to fight against them.
target: Bot wen wod bring tu Makabius a wa ben du, im gyada di liida dem a di piipl tugeda, an akyuuz dem man de a av sel dem breda dem fi moni bai a set dem enimi dem frii fi fait gens dem.

en: So he killed these men for having turned traitors, and immediately took possession of the two towers.
target: So im kil dem man ya fi av ton chrieta, an imediietli tek poezeshan a di tuu towa dem.

en: Prospering with his weapons in everything he undertook, he destroyed more than twenty thousand in the two strongholds.
target: A prosper wid im wepon dem ina evriting im tek pan, im distrai muor dan twenti touzn ina di tuu strangol dem.

en: Now Timotheus, who had been defeated by the Jews before, having gathered together foreign forces in great multitudes, and having collected the cavalry which belonged to Asia, not a few, came as though he would take Judea by force of weapons.
target: Nou Timoteos, we ben get difiet bai di Juu dem bifuo, afta im gyada tugeda farin fuos dem ina griet moltityuud dem, an afta im kolek di kavalri we bilang tu Iesha, no fyuu, kom laik im wuda tek Juudia bai fuos a wepon dem.

en: But as he drew near, Maccabaeus and his men sprinkled dirt on their heads and girded their loins with sackcloth, in supplication to God,
target: Bot az im jraa nier, Makabius an im man dem sprinkl dort pan dem ed an gird dem lain dem wid sakklaat, ina beg tu Gad,

en: and falling down upon the step in front of the altar, implored him to become gracious to them, and be an enemy to their enemies and an adversary to their adversaries, as the law declares.
target: an a faal dong pan di step ina front a di aalta, beg im fi bikom grieshos tu dem, an bi wan enimi tu dem enimi dem an wan adverseri tu dem adverseri dem, laik di laa diklier.

en: Rising from their prayer they took up their weapons, and advanced some distance from the city. When they had come near to their enemies, they halted.
target: Dem raiz fram dem prier dem tek op dem wepon dem, an advans som distans fram di siti. Wen dem ben kom nier tu dem enimi dem, dem aalt.

en: When the dawn was now breaking, the two armies joined in battle, the one part having this, beside virtue, for a pledge of success and victory, that they had fled to the Lord for refuge, the others making their passion their leader in the fight.
target: Wen di daan ben nou a briek, di tuu aami dem jain ina batl, di wan paat a av dis, bisaid voertyuu, fi wan plej a sokses an viktori, se dem ben flii tu di Laad fi refyuuj, di ada dem a mek dem pashan dem liida ina di fait.

en: When the battle became strong, there appeared out of heaven to their adversaries five splendid men on horses with bridles of gold, and two of them, leading on the Jews,
target: Wen di batl bikom strang, de apier out a evn tu dem adverseri dem faiv splendid man pan aas dem wid braidl a guol, an tuu a dem, a liid aan di Juu dem,

en: and taking Maccabaeus in the midst of them, and covering him with their own armor, guarded him from wounds, while they shot arrows and thunderbolts at the enemies. For this reason, they were blinded and thrown into confusion, and were cut to pieces, filled with bewilderment.
target: an a tek Makabius ina di migl a dem, an a kova im wid dem uon aama, gaad im fram wuun dem, wail dem shuut ara dem an tondabolt dem a di enimi dem. Fi dis riizn, dem get blain an chruo ina konfyuuzhan, an get kot tu piis, ful a biwildament.

en: Twenty thousand five hundred were slain, beside six hundred cavalry.
target: Twenti touzn faiv onjred get slain, bisaid siks onjred kavalri.

en: Timotheus himself fled into a stronghold called Gazara, a fortress of great strength, where Chaereas was in command.
target: Timoteos imself flii ina wan strangol we dem kaal Gazara, wan faartres a griet strengt, we Kairias ben ina komaan.

en: Then Maccabaeus and his men were glad and laid siege to the fortress for four days.
target: Den Makabius an im man dem glad an lied siij tu di faartres fi fuor die.

en: Those who were within, trusting in the strength of the place, blasphemed exceedingly, and hurled out impious words.
target: Dem we de widin, a chros ina di strengt a di plies, blasfiim eksiedinli, an orl out ongadli wod dem.

en: But at dawn of the fifth day, certain young men of Maccabaeus’ company, inflamed with anger because of the blasphemies, assaulted the wall with masculine force and with furious anger, and cut down whoever came in their way.
target: Bot a daan a di fif die, som yong man a Makabius kompini, we get enflame wid anga bikaa a di blasfimi dem, asolt di waal wid maskulin fuos an wid fyuorios anga, an kot dong enibadi we kom ina dem wie.

en: Others climbing up in the same way, while the enemies were distracted with those who had made their way within, set fire to the towers, and kindled fires that burned the blasphemers alive, while others broke open the gates, and, having given entrance to the rest of the band, occupied the city.
target: Ada dem a klaim op ina di siem wie, wail di enimi dem ben distrak wid dem we ben mek dem wie widin, set faiya tu di towa dem, an kindl faiya dem we bon di blasfiima dem alaiv, wail ada dem bruk uopn di giet dem, an, afta dem giv entrans tu di res a di ban, okupai di siti.

en: They killed Timotheus, who was hidden in a cistern, and his brother Chaereas, and Apollophanes.
target: Dem kil Timoteos, we ben aid ina wan sistern, an im breda Kairias, an Apolofaniiz.

en: When they had accomplished these things, they blessed the Lord with hymns and thanksgiving, blessing him who provides great benefits to Israel and gives them the victory.
target: Wen dem ben akomplish dem ting ya, dem bles di Laad wid im dem an tangksgivin, a bles im we provaid griet benefit dem tu Izrel an giv dem di viktori.

en: Now after a very little time, Lysias, the king’s guardian, kinsman, and chancellor, being very displeased about the things that had happened,
target: Nou afta wan veri likl taim, Lisias, di king gaadian, kinsman, an chansla, a get veri displiz bout di ting dem we ben apn,

en: collected about eighty thousand infantry and all his cavalry and came against the Jews, planning to make the city a home for Greeks,
target: kolek bout ieti touzn infantri an aal im kavalri an kom gens di Juu dem, a plan fi mek di siti wan uom fi Griik dem,

en: and to levy tribute on the temple, as on the other sacred places of the nations, and to put up the high priesthood for sale every year.
target: an fi levi chribyuut pan di templ, laik pan di ada siekrid plies dem a di nieshan dem, an fi put op di ai priisud fi siel evri ier.

en: He took no account of God’s power, but was puffed up with his ten thousands of infantry, his thousands of cavalry, and his eighty elephants.
target: Im tek no akount a Gad powa, bot get pof op wid im ten touzn dem a infantri, im touzn dem a kavalri, an im ieti elifant dem.

en: Coming into Judea and approaching Bethsuron, which was a strong place and about five stadia away from Jerusalem, he pressed it hard.
target: A kom ina Juudia an a aprooch Betsuuron, we ben wan strang plies an bout faiv stadia we fram Jeruusalem, im pres i aad.

en: When Maccabaeus and his men learned that he was besieging the strongholds, they and all the people with lamentations and tears made supplication to the Lord to send a good angel to save Israel.
target: Wen Makabius an im man dem lorn se im ben a bisiij di strangol dem, dem an aal di piipl wid lamentieshan dem an tier dem mek beg tu di Laad fi sen wan gud ienjel fi siev Izrel.

en: Maccabaeus himself took up weapons first, and exhorted the others to put themselves in jeopardy together with him and help their brothers; and they went out with him very willingly.
target: Makabius imself tek op wepon dem fos, an beg di ada dem strang fi put demself ina jepadi tugeda wid im an elp dem breda dem; an dem go out wid im veri wilinli.

en: As they were there, close to Jerusalem, a horseman appeared at their head in white apparel, brandishing weapons of gold.
target: Az dem de de, kluos tu Jeruusalem, wan aasman apier a dem ed ina wait klouz, a brandish wepon a guol.

en: They all together praised the merciful God, and were yet more strengthened in heart, being ready to assail not only men but the wildest animals and walls of iron,
target: Dem aal tugeda priez di mersiful Gad, an get yet muor strengt ina aat, a redi fi asiel no onli man bot di wailis animal dem an waal a aian dem,

en: they advanced in array, having him who is in heaven to fight on their side, for the Lord had mercy on them.
target: dem advans ina arie, a av im we de ina evn fi fait pan dem said, kaa di Laad av mersi pan dem.

en: Hurling themselves like lions against the enemy, they killed eleven thousand infantry and one thousand six hundred cavalry, and forced all the rest to flee.
target: Dem orl demself laik laian dem gens di enimi, dem kil ilevn touzn infantri an wan touzn siks onjred kavalri, an fuos aal di res fi flii.

en: Most of them escaped wounded and naked. Lysias himself also escaped by shameful flight.
target: Muos a dem eskiep wuun an niekid. Lisias imself eskiep tu bai shiemful flait.

en: But as he was a man not void of understanding, pondering the defeat which had befallen him, and considering that the Hebrews could not be overcome because the Almighty God fought on their side, he sent again
target: Bot az im ben wan man no widout andastandin, a panda di difiet we ben kom pan im, an a konsida se di Ibruu dem kuda no get uovakom bikaa di Olmaiti Gad fait pan dem said, im sen agen

en: and persuaded them to come to terms on condition that all their rights were acknowledged, and promised that he would also persuade the king to become their friend.
target: an pasuied dem fi kom tu torm dem pan kondishan se aal dem rait dem get aknalij, an pramis se im wuda pasuied di king tu fi bikom dem fren.

en: Maccabaeus gave consent upon all the conditions which Lysias proposed to him, being careful of the common good; for whatever requests Maccabaeus delivered in writing to Lysias concerning the Jews the king allowed.
target: Makabius giv konsent pan aal di kondishan dem we Lisias propoz tu im, a bi kierful a di koman gud; kaa eni rikwes dem we Makabius diliva ina raitin tu Lisias bout di Juu dem di king lou.

en: The letter written to the Jews from Lysias was to this effect: “Lysias to the people of the Jews, greetings.
target: Di leta we rait tu di Juu dem fram Lisias ben tu dis efek: “Lisias tu di piipl a di Juu dem, griitin.

en: John and Absalom, who were sent from you, having delivered the document written below, made request concerning the things written in it.
target: Jan an Absalom, we ben sen fram unu, afta dem diliva di dokyument we rait biluo, mek rikwes bout di ting dem we rait ina i.

en: Whatever things therefore needed to be brought before the king I declared to him, and what things were possible he allowed.
target: Eni ting dem so we niid fi bring bifuo di king mi diklier tu im, an wa ting dem ben pasibl im lou.

en: If then you will all preserve your good will toward the government, I will also endeavor in the future to contribute to your good.
target: If so unu wi aal prizerv unu gud wil tuwaadz di govament, mi wi temp tu ina di fyuuucha fi kontribyuut tu unu gud.

en: Concerning this, I have given order in detail, both to these men and to those who are sent from me, to confer with you.
target: Bout dis, mi don giv aada ina diitiel, buot tu dem man ya an tu dem we sen fram mi, fi taak wid unu.

en: Farewell. Written in the one hundred forty-eighth year, on the twenty-fourth day of the month Dioscorinthius.”
target: Fiewel. Rait ina di wan onjred faati-iet ier, pan di twenti-fuot die a di mont Daioskorintios.”

en: And the king’s letter contained these words: “King Antiochus to his brother Lysias, greetings.
target: An di king leta kontien dem wod ya: “King Antiokos tu im breda Lisias, griitin.

en: Seeing that our father passed to the gods having the wish that the subjects of his kingdom should be undisturbed and give themselves to the care of their own affairs,
target: A si se wi faada paas tu di iladem a av di wish se di sobjek dem a im kindom shuda bi ondisturb an giv demself tu di kier a dem uon afier dem,

en: we, having heard that the Jews do not consent to our father’s purpose to turn them to the customs of the Greeks, but choose rather their own way of living, and make request that the customs of their law be allowed to them—
target: wi, afta wi ier se di Juu dem no konsent tu wi faada poerpos fi ton dem tu di kostom dem a di Griik dem, bot chuuz rada dem uon wie a livin, an mek rikwes se di kostom dem a dem laa get lou tu dem —

en: choosing therefore that this nation also should be free from disturbance, we determine that their temple is to be restored to them, and that they live according to the customs that were in the days of their ancestors.
target: a chuuz so se dis nieshan tu shuda bi frii fram distorbans, wi ditermin se dem templ a fi bring bak tu dem, an se dem liv akordin tu di kostom dem we ben de ina di die dem a dem ansesta dem.

en: You will therefore do well to send messengers to them and give them the right hand of friendship, that they, knowing our mind, may be of good heart, and gladly occupy themselves with the conduct of their own affairs.”
target: Yu wi so du wel fi sen mesenja dem tu dem an giv dem di rait an a frenship, se dem, we nuo wi main, mait bi a gud aat, an gladli okupai demself wid di kondok a dem uon afier dem.”

en: And to the nation, the king’s letter was as follows: “King Antiochus to the council of elders of the Jews and to the other Jews, greetings.
target: An tu di nieshan, di king leta ben az faloz: “King Antiokos tu di kounsl a elda dem a di Juu dem an tu di ada Juu dem, griitin.

en: If you are all well, it is as we desire. We ourselves also are in good health.
target: If unu aal wel, i az wi dizair. Wi wiself wel tu ina gud elt.

en: Menelaus informed us that your desire was to return home and follow your own business.
target: Menilaos infaam wi se unu dizair ben fi ton uom an fala unu uon biznes.

en: They therefore who depart home up to the thirtieth day of Xanthicus will have our friendship, with full permission
target: Dem so we go uom op tu di tortiet die a Zantikos wi av wi frenship, wid ful pamishan

en: that the Jews use their own foods and observe their own laws, even as formerly. None of them will be in any way molested for the things that have been done in ignorance.
target: se di Juu dem yuuz dem uon fuud dem an obzerv dem uon laa dem, iivn laik bifuo. Non a dem wi ina eni wie get molest fi di ting dem we ben du ina ignorans.

en: Moreover I have sent Menelaus also, that he may encourage you.
target: Muor mi don sen Menilaos tu, se im mait enkorij unu.

en: Farewell. Written in the one hundred forty-eighth year, on the fifteenth day of Xanthicus.”
target: Fiewel. Rait ina di wan onjred faati-iet ier, pan di fiftiin die a Zantikos.”

en: The Romans also sent to them a letter in these words: “Quintus Memmius and Titus Manius, ambassadors of the Romans, to the people of the Jews, greetings.
target: Di Ruoman dem sen tu dem wan leta tu ina dem wod ya: “Kwintos Memios an Taitos Manios, ambasada dem a di Ruoman dem, tu di piipl a di Juu dem, griitin.

en: In regard to the things which Lysias the king’s kinsman granted you, we also give consent.
target: Bout di ting dem we Lisias di king kinsman grant unu, wi giv konsent tu.

en: But as for the things which he judged should be referred to the king, send someone promptly, after you have considered them, that we may publish such decrees as are appropriate for your case; for we are on our way to Antioch.
target: Bot az fi di ting dem we im joj shuda get rifa tu di king, sen somwan pramptli, afta unu ben konsida dem, se wi mait poblish soch dikrii dem az aproopriet fi unu kies; kaa wi de pan wi wie tu Antiok.

en: Therefore send someone with speed, that we also may learn what is your mind.
target: So sen somwan wid spiid, se wi mait lorn tu wa a unu main.

en: Farewell. Written in the one hundred forty-eighth year, on the fifteenth day of Xanthicus.
target: Fiewel. Rait ina di wan onjred faati-iet ier, pan di fiftiin die a Zantikos.

en: So when this agreement had been made, Lysias departed to the king, and the Jews went about their farming.
target: So wen dis agriiment ben mek, Lisias go tu di king, an di Juu dem go bout dem faamin.

en: But some of the governors of districts, Timotheus and Apollonius the son of Gennaeus, and also Hieronymus and Demophon, and beside them Nicanor the governor of Cyprus, would not allow them to enjoy tranquillity and live in peace.
target: Bot som a di govna dem a distrik dem, Timoteos an Apolonyos di son a Geneos, an Ieronimos an Demofon tu, an bisaid dem Nikanor di govna a Saipros, wuda no lou dem fi enjai trangkwiliti an liv ina piis.

en: Men of Joppa perpetrated this great impiety: they invited the Jews who lived among them to go with their wives and children into the boats which they had provided, as though they had no ill will toward them.
target: Man dem a Japa du dis griet ongadlinis: dem invait di Juu dem we liv mong dem fi go wid dem waif dem an pikni dem ina di buot dem we dem ben provaid, laik dem av no il wil tuwaadz dem.

en: When the Jews, relying on the public vote of the city, accepted the invitation, as men desiring to live in peace and suspecting nothing, they took them out to sea and drowned not less than two hundred of them.
target: Wen di Juu dem, a rilay pan di poblik vuot a di siti, aksept di invitieshan, az man dem we dizair fi liv ina piis an a sospeck notn, dem tek dem out tu sii an jroun no les dan tuu onjred a dem.

en: When Judas heard of the cruelty done to his fellow countrymen, giving command to the men that were with him
target: Wen Juudas ier bout di kruelti we du tu im felo kontriman dem, a giv komaan tu di man dem we de wid im

en: and calling upon God the righteous Judge, he came against the murderers of his brothers, and set the harbor on fire at night, burned the boats, and put to the sword those who had fled there.
target: an a kaal pan Gad di raichos Joj, im kom gens di mordara dem a im breda dem, an set di aaba pan faiya a nait, bon di buot dem, an put tu di suord dem we ben flii de.

en: But when the town gates were closed, he withdrew, intending to come again to root out the whole community of the men of Joppa.
target: Bot wen di toun giet dem ben kloz, im widraa, a inten fi kom agen fi ruut out di uol komyuuniti a di man dem a Japa.

en: But learning that the men of Jamnia intended to do the same thing to the Jews who lived among them,
target: Bot a lorn se di man dem a Jamnia inten fi du di siem ting tu di Juu dem we liv mong dem,

en: he attacked the Jamnites at night, and set fire to the harbor together with the fleet, so that the glare of the light was seen at Jerusalem, two hundred forty furlongs distant.
target: im atak di Jamnait dem a nait, an set faiya tu di aaba tugeda wid di fliet, so se di glier a di lait get si a Jeruusalem, tuu onjred faati forlang distans.

en: Now when they had drawn off nine furlongs from there, as they marched against Timotheus, an army of Arabians attacked him, no fewer than five thousand infantry and five hundred cavalry.
target: Nou wen dem ben jraa aaf nain forlang fram de, az dem maach gens Timoteos, wan aami a Arabian dem atak im, no fyuuwa dan faiv touzn infantri an faiv onjred kavalri.

en: And when a hard battle had been fought, and Judas and his company, by the help of God, had good success, the nomads being overcome implored Judas to grant them friendship, promising to give him livestock, and to help his people in all other ways.
target: An wen wan aad batl ben fait, an Juudas an im kompini, bai di elp a Gad, av gud sokses, di nuomad dem get uovakom an beg Juudas fi grant dem frenship, a pramis fi giv im laivstak, an fi elp im piipl ina aal ada wie dem.

en: So Judas, thinking that they would indeed be profitable in many things, agreed to live in peace with them; and receiving pledges of friendship they departed to their tents.
target: So Juudas, a tingk se dem wuda fi chuu bi profitabl ina meni ting, agrii fi liv ina piis wid dem; an a get plej dem a frenship dem go tu dem tent dem.

en: He also attacked a certain city, strong and fenced with earthworks and walls, and inhabited by a mixed multitude of various nations. It was named Caspin.
target: Im atak wan som siti tu, strang an fens wid ortwork dem an waal dem, an we piipl liv ina bai wan miks moltityuud a vierios nieshan dem. I ben niem Kaspin.

en: Those who were within, trusting in the strength of the walls and their store of provisions, behaved themselves rudely toward Judas and those who were with him, railing, and furthermore blaspheming and speaking impious words.
target: Dem we de widin, a chros ina di strengt a di waal dem an dem stuor a provizhan dem, biyev demself ruudli tuwaadz Juudas an dem we de wid im, a riel, an forda a blasfiim an a taak ongadli wod dem.

en: But Judas and his company, calling upon the great Sovereign of the world, who without rams and cunning engines of war hurled down Jericho in the times of Joshua, rushed wildly against the wall.
target: Bot Juudas an im kompini, a kaal pan di griet Sovrin a di worl, we widout ram dem an konin enjin dem a waar orl dong Jeriko ina di taim dem a Joshua, rosh waili gens di waal.

en: Having taken the city by the will of God, they made unspeakable slaughter, so much that the adjoining lake, which was two furlongs broad, appeared to be filled with the deluge of blood.
target: Afta dem tek di siti bai di wil a Gad, dem mek onspiikabl slaata, so moch se di liek we jain, we ben tuu forlang braad, apier fi ful wid di delyuuj a blod.

en: When they had gone seven hundred fifty furlongs from there, they made their way to Charax, to the Jews that are called Tubieni.
target: Wen dem ben go sevn onjred fifti forlang fram de, dem mek dem wie tu Karaks, tu di Juu dem we dem kaal Tubieni.

en: They didn’t find Timotheus in that district, for he had by then departed from the district without accomplishing anything, but had left behind a very strong garrison in one place.
target: Dem no fain Timoteos ina da distrik de, kaa im ben bai den go fram di distrik widout akomplish eniting, bot ben lef baka wan veri strang gyarisn ina wan plies.

en: But Dositheus and Sosipater, who were captains under Maccabaeus, went out and destroyed those who had been left by Timotheus in the stronghold, more than ten thousand men.
target: Bot Dositeos an Sosipata, we ben kaptin dem anda Makabius, go out an distrai dem we Timoteos ben lef ina di strangol, muor dan ten touzn man.

en: Maccabaeus, arranging his own army in divisions, set these two over the bands, and marched in haste against Timotheus, who had with him one hundred twenty thousand infantry and two thousand five hundred cavalry.
target: Makabius, a arienj im uon aami ina divizhan dem, set dem tuu ya uova di ban dem, an maach ina ies gens Timoteos, we av wid im wan onjred twenti touzn infantri an tuu touzn faiv onjred kavalri.

en: When Timotheus heard of the approach of Judas, he at once sent away the women and the children with the baggage into the fortress called Carnion; for the place was hard to besiege and difficult to access by reason of the narrowness of the approaches on all sides.
target: Wen Timoteos ier bout di aprooch a Juudas, im at wons sen we di uman dem an di pikni dem wid di bagij ina di faartres we dem kaal Karnion; kaa di plies ben aad fi bisiij an difikolt fi akses bikaa a di naro a di aprooch dem pan aal said.

en: When the band of Judas, who led the first division, appeared in sight, and when terror and fear came upon the enemy, because the manifestation of him who sees all things came upon them, they fled in every direction, carried this way and that, so that they were often injured by their own men, and pierced with the points of their own swords.
target: Wen di ban a Juudas, we liid di fos divizhan, apier ina sait, an wen tera an fier kom pan di enimi, bikaa di shuo a im we si aal ting kom pan dem, dem flii ina evri dairekshan, a kyari dis wie an dat, so se dem aafn get inja bai dem uon man dem, an piers wid di point dem a dem uon suord dem.

en: Judas continued the pursuit more vigorously, putting the wicked wretches to the sword, and he destroyed as many as thirty thousand men.
target: Juudas kontinyu di posyuut muor vigarosli, a put di wikid rech dem tu di suord, an im distrai az meni az torti touzn man.

en: Timotheus himself, falling in with the company of Dositheus and Sosipater, implored them with much crafty guile to let him go with his life, because he had in his power the parents of many of them and the brothers of some. “Otherwise, he said, little regard will be shown to these.”
target: Timoteos imself, a faal in wid di kompini a Dositeos an Sosipata, beg dem wid moch kraafti gail fi let im go wid im laif, bikaa im av ina im powa di pierent dem a meni a dem an di breda dem a som. “Adawaiz, im se, likl rigaad wi shuo tu dem ya.”

en: So when he had with many words confirmed the agreement to restore them without harm, they let him go that they might save their brothers.
target: So wen im ben wid meni wod konform di agriiment fi bring dem bak widout aam, dem let im go se dem mait siev dem breda dem.

en: Then Judas, marching against Carnion and the temple of Atergatis, killed twenty-five thousand people.
target: Den Juudas, a maach gens Karnion an di templ a Atergatis, kil twenti-faiv touzn piipl.

en: After he had put these to flight and destroyed them, he marched against Ephron also, a strong city, in which were multitudes of people of all nations. Stalwart young men placed on the walls made a vigorous defense. There were great stores of war engines and darts there.
target: Afta im ben put dem ya tu flait an distrai dem, im maach gens Efron tu, wan strang siti, ina we de moltityuud a piipl a aal nieshan. Staalwat yong man dem we plies pan di waal dem mek wan vigaros difens. De ben griet stuor a waar enjin dem an daat dem de.

en: But calling upon the Sovereign who with might shatters the strength of the enemy, they took the city into their hands, and killed as many as twenty-five thousand of those who were in it.
target: Bot a kaal pan di Sovrin we wid mait shata di strengt a di enimi, dem tek di siti ina dem an, an kil az meni az twenti-faiv touzn a dem we de ina i.

en: Setting out from there, they marched in haste against Scythopolis, which is six hundred furlongs away from Jerusalem.
target: Dem set out fram de, dem maach ina ies gens Skaitopolis, we a siks onjred forlang we fram Jeruusalem.

en: But when the Jews who were settled there testified of the good will that the Scythopolitans had shown toward them, and of their kind treatment of them in the times of their misfortune,
target: Bot wen di Juu dem we ben setl de testifai a di gud wil we di Skaitopolitan dem ben shuo tuwaadz dem, an a dem kain triitment a dem ina di taim dem a dem misfaachun,

en: they gave thanks, and further exhorted them to remain well disposed toward the people for the future. Then they went up to Jerusalem, the feast of weeks being close at hand.
target: dem giv tanks, an forda beg dem strang fi tan wel dispuoz tuwaadz di piipl fi di fyuuucha. Den dem go op tu Jeruusalem, di fiis a wiik dem a de kluos a an.

en: But after the feast called Pentecost, they marched in haste against Gorgias the governor of Idumaea.
target: Bot afta di fiis we dem kaal Pentikost, dem maach ina ies gens Goerjias di govna a Idumia.

en: He came out with three thousand infantry and four hundred cavalry.
target: Im kom out wid chrii touzn infantri an fuor onjred kavalri.

en: When they had set themselves in array, a few of the Jews fell.
target: Wen dem ben set demself ina arie, wan fyuu a di Juu dem faal.

en: A certain Dositheus, one of Bacenor’s company, who was on horseback and was a strong man, pressed hard on Gorgias, and taking hold of his cloke dragged him along by main force. While he planned to take the accursed man alive, one of the Thracian cavalry bore down on him and disabled his shoulder, and so Gorgias escaped to Marisa.
target: Wan som Dositeos, wan a Basenor kompini, we de pan aasbak an ben wan strang man, pres aad pan Goerjias, an a tek uol a im kluok jrag im alang bai mien fuos. Wail im plan fi tek di akors man alaiv, wan a di Trieshan kavalri dem bier dong pan im an disiebl im shuolda, an so Goerjias eskiep tu Marisa.

en: When those who were with Esdris had been fighting long and were weary, Judas called upon the Lord to show himself, fighting on their side and leading in the battle.
target: Wen dem we de wid Esdris ben a fait lang an ben wiiri, Juudas kaal pan di Laad fi shuo imself, a fait pan dem said an a liid ina di batl.

en: Then in the language of his ancestors he raised the battle cry joined with hymns. Then he rushed against Gorgias’ troops when they were not expecting it, and put them to flight.
target: Den ina di langwij a im ansesta dem im riez di batl krai we jain wid im dem. Den im rosh gens Goerjias chruup dem wen dem no ben a ekspek i, an put dem tu flait.

en: Judas gathered his army and came to the city of Adullam. As the seventh day was coming on, they purified themselves according to the custom, and kept the Sabbath there.
target: Juudas gyada im aami an kom tu di siti a Adulam. Az di sevent die ben a kom aan, dem pyuurifai demself akordin tu di kostom, an kip di Sabat de.

en: On the following day, when it had become necessary, Judas and his company came to take up the bodies of those who had fallen, and in company with their kinsmen to bring them back to the sepulchres of their ancestors.
target: Pan di fala die, wen i ben bikom nesiseri, Juudas an im kompini kom fi tek op di badi dem a dem we ben faal, an ina kompini wid dem kin dem fi bring dem bak tu di sepulka dem a dem ansesta dem.

en: But under the garments of each one of the dead they found consecrated tokens of the idols of Jamnia, which the law forbids the Jews to have anything to do with. It became clear to all that it was for this cause that they had fallen.
target: Bot anda di gaament dem a iich wan a di ded dem fain kansikriet tuokn dem a di aidol dem a Jamnia, we di laa faabid di Juu dem fi av eniting fi du wid. I bikom klier tu aal se i ben fi dis kaaz se dem ben faal.

en: All therefore, blessing the ways of the Lord, the righteous Judge, who makes manifest the things that are hidden,
target: Aal so, a bles di wie dem a di Laad, di raichos Joj, we mek klier di ting dem we aid,

en: turned themselves to supplication, praying that the sin committed might be wholly blotted out. The noble Judas exhorted the multitude to keep themselves from sin, for they had seen with their own eyes what happened because of the sin of those who had fallen.
target: ton demself tu beg, a prie se di sin we komit mait get uoli blat out. Di nuobl Juudas beg di moltityuud strang fi kip demself fram sin, kaa dem ben si wid dem uon yai dem wa apn bikaa a di sin a dem we ben faal.

en: When he had made a collection man by man to the sum of two thousand drachmas of silver, he sent to Jerusalem to offer a sacrifice for sin, doing very well and honorably in this, in that he took thought for the resurrection.
target: Wen im ben mek wan kolekshan man bai man tu di som a tuu touzn drakma a silva, im sen tu Jeruusalem fi aafa wan sakrifais fi sin, a du veri wel an anaribli ina dis, ina se im tek taat fi di rezoreckshan.

en: For if he wasn’t expecting that those who had fallen would rise again, it would be superfluous and idle to pray for the dead.
target: Kaa if im no ben a ekspek se dem we ben faal wuda raiz agen, i wuda bi syuupoerfluos an aidl fi prie fi di ded.

en: But if he was looking forward to an honorable memorial of gratitude laid up for those who die in godliness, then the thought was holy and godly. Therefore he made the atoning sacrifice for those who had died, that they might be released from their sin.
target: Bot if im ben a luk faawad tu wan anarabl memorial a gratityuud we lied op fi dem we dai ina uoli livin, den di taat ben uoli an gud. So im mek di aton sakrifais fi dem we ben ded, se dem mait get riliis fram dem sin.

en: In the one hundred forty-ninth year, news was brought to Judas and his company that Antiochus Eupator was coming with multitudes against Judea,
target: Ina di wan onjred faati-naint ier, nyuuz bring tu Juudas an im kompini se Antiokos Yuupator ben a kom wid moltityuud dem gens Juudia,

en: and with him Lysias his guardian and chancellor, each having a Greek force of one hundred ten thousand infantry, five thousand three hundred cavalry, twenty-two elephants, and three hundred chariots armed with scythes.
target: an wid im Lisias im gaadian an chansla, iich a av wan Griik fuos a wan onjred ten touzn infantri, faiv touzn chrii onjred kavalri, twenti-tuu elifant, an chrii onjred chariet dem we aam wid sait dem.

en: And Menelaus also joined himself with them, and with great hypocrisy encouraged Antiochus, not for the saving of his country, but because he thought that he would be set over the government.
target: An Menilaos jain imself wid dem tu, an wid griet iipakrisi enkorij Antiokos, no fi di sievin a im kontri, bot bikaa im tingk se im wuda get set uova di govament.

en: But the King of kings stirred up the anger of Antiochus against the wicked wretch. When Lysias informed him that this man was the cause of all the evils, the king commanded to bring him to Beroea, and to put him to death in the way customary in that place.
target: Bot di King a king dem stir op di anga a Antiokos gens di wikid rech. Wen Lisias infaam im se dis man ben di kaaz a aal di iivl dem, di king komaan fi bring im tu Beruia, an fi put im tu det ina di wie kostomari ina da plies de.

en: Now there is in that place a tower that is fifty cubits high, full of ashes, and it had all around it a circular rim sloping steeply on every side into the ashes.
target: Nou de ina da plies de wan towa we a fifti kyuubit ai, ful a ashiz, an i av aal roun i wan sorkyula rim we sluop stiip pan evri said ina di ashiz.

en: Here one who is guilty of sacrilege or notorious for other crimes is pushed down to destruction.
target: Ya wan we gilti a sakrileg ar nuotuorios fi ada kraim dem get push dong tu distrokshan.

en: By such a fate it happened that the breaker of the law, Menelaus, died, without obtaining so much as a grave in the earth, and that justly;
target: Bai soch wan fiet i apn se di laa-brieka, Menilaos, ded, widout get so moch az wan griev ina di ort, an dat josli;

en: for because he had committed many sins against the altar, whose fire and whose ashes were holy, he received his death in ashes.
target: kaa bikaa im ben komit meni sin gens di aalta, uufa faiya an uufa ashiz ben uoli, im get im det ina ashiz.

en: Now the king, infuriated in spirit, was coming with intent to inflict on the Jews the very worst of the sufferings that had been done in his father’s time.
target: Nou di king, we get infyuoriet ina spirit, ben a kom wid intent fi inflick pan di Juu dem di veri wors a di sofarin dem we ben du ina im faada taim.

en: But when Judas heard of these things, he commanded the multitude to call upon the Lord day and night, if ever at any other time, so now to help those who were at the point of being deprived of the law, their country, and the holy temple,
target: Bot wen Juudas ier bout dem ting ya, im komaan di moltityuud fi kaal pan di Laad die an nait, if eva a eni ada taim, so nou fi elp dem we ben a di point a get dipraiv a di laa, dem kontri, an di uoli templ,

en: and not to allow the people who had just begun to be revived to fall into the hands of those profane heathen.
target: an no fi lou di piipl we ben jos bigin fi get rivaiv fi faal ina di an dem a dem profien iitn de.

en: So when they had all done the same thing together, begging the merciful Lord with weeping and fastings and prostration for three days without ceasing, Judas exhorted them and commanded they should join him.
target: So wen dem ben aal du di siem ting tugeda, a beg di mersiful Laad wid baalin an faastin dem an a pudong demself flat fi chrii die widout stapin, Juudas beg dem strang an komaan se dem shuda jain im.

en: Having consulted privately with the elders, he resolved that before the king’s army entered into Judea and made themselves masters of the city, they should go out and decide the matter by the help of God.
target: Afta im konsolt praivitli wid di elda dem, im rizolv se bifuo di king aami go ina Juudia an mek demself maasta a di siti, dem shuda go out an disaid di mata bai di elp a Gad.

en: And committing the decision to the Lord of the world, and exhorting those who were with him to contend nobly even to death for laws, temple, city, country, and way of life, he pitched his camp by Modin.
target: An a komit di disizhan tu di Laad a di worl, an a beg dem we de wid im strang fi kontend nuobli iivn tu det fi laa dem, templ, siti, kontri, an wie a laif, im pich im kamp bai Muodin.

en: He gave out to his men the watchword, “VICTORY IS GOD’S”, with a chosen force of the bravest young men he attacked the king’s pavilion by night, and killed of his army as many as two thousand men, and brought down the leading elephant with him who was in the tower on him.
target: Im giv out tu im man dem di wachwod, “VIKTORI A GAD”, wid wan chuozn fuos a di brievis yong man dem im atak di king pavilion bai nait, an kil a im aami az meni az tuu touzn man, an bring dong di liidin elifant wid im we ben ina di towa pan im.

en: At last they filled the army with terror and alarm, and departed with good success.
target: A laas dem fil di aami wid tera an alaam, an go we wid gud sokses.

en: This had been accomplished when the day was just dawning, because of the Lord’s protection that gave Judas help.
target: Dis ben akomplish wen di die ben jos a daan, bikaa a di Laad protekshan we giv Juudas elp.

en: But the king, having had a taste of the exceeding boldness of the Jews, made strategic attacks on their positions,
target: Bot di king, afta im av wan ties a di eksiedin bouldnis a di Juu dem, mek stratiijik atak dem pan dem pozishan dem,

en: and on a strong fortress of the Jews at Bethsura. He advanced, was turned back, failed, and was defeated.
target: an pan wan strang faartres a di Juu dem a Betsuura. Im advans, get ton bak, fiel, an get difiet.

en: Judas sent the things that were necessary to those who were within.
target: Juudas sen di ting dem we ben nesiseri tu dem we de widin.

en: But Rhodocus, from the Jewish ranks, made secrets known to the enemy. He was sought out, arrested, and shut up in prison.
target: Bot Rodokos, fram di Juu rangk dem, mek siikrit dem nuo tu di enimi. Dem siik im out, ares im, an shot im op ina prizn.

en: The king negotiated with them in Bethsura the second time, gave his hand, took theirs, departed, attacked the forces of Judas, was put to the worse,
target: Di king nigoshiet wid dem ina Betsuura di sekan taim, giv im an, tek fi dem, go we, atak di fuos dem a Juudas, get put tu di wors,

en: heard that Philip who had been left as chancellor in Antioch had become reckless, was confounded, made to the Jews an overture of peace, submitted himself and swore to acknowledge all their rights, came to terms with them and offered sacrifice, honored the sanctuary and the place,
target: ier se Filip we ben lef az chansla ina Antiok ben bikom recles, get konfound, mek tu di Juu dem wan uovachuor a piis, sobmit imself an swier fi aknalij aal dem rait dem, kom tu torm dem wid dem an aafa sakrifais, ana di sankchuari an di plies,

en: showed kindness and graciously received Maccabaeus, left Hegemonides governor from Ptolemais even to the Gerrenians,
target: shuo kainnis an grieshosli risiv Makabius, lef Egemonidiiz govna fram Tolimeis iivn tu di Gerenian dem,

en: and came to Ptolemais. The men of Ptolemais were displeased at the treaty, for they had exceedingly great indignation against the Jews. They desired to annul the articles of the agreement.
target: an kom tu Tolimeis. Di man dem a Tolimeis ben displiz a di chriiti, kaa dem av eksiedinli griet indignieshan gens di Juu dem. Dem dizair fi anul di aatikl dem a di agriiment.

en: Lysias came forward to speak, made the best defense that was possible, persuaded, pacified, gained their good will, and departed to Antioch. This was the issue of the attack and departure of the king.
target: Lisias kom faawad fi taak, mek di bes difens we ben pasibl, pasuied, pasifai, gien dem gud wil, an go we tu Antiok. Dis ben di ishuu a di atak an dipaacha a di king.

en: Three years later, news was brought to Judas and his company that Demetrius the son of Seleucus, having sailed into the harbor of Tripolis with a mighty army and a fleet,
target: Chrii ier lieta, nyuuz bring tu Juudas an im kompini se Dimetrios di son a Selyuukos, afta im siel ina di aaba a Tripolis wid wan maiti aami an wan fliet,

en: had taken possession of the country, having made away with Antiochus and his guardian Lysias.
target: ben tek poezeshan a di kontri, afta im du we wid Antiokos an im gaadian Lisias.

en: But one Alcimus, who had formerly been high priest, and had willfully polluted himself in the times when there was no mingling with the Gentiles, considering that there was no deliverance for him in any way, nor any more access to the holy altar,
target: Bot wan Alsimos, we ben faamali bi ai priis, an ben wilfuli polyuut imself ina di taim dem wen de ben no minglin wid di Jentailz, a konsida se de ben no dilivarans fi im ina eni wie, nar eni muor akses tu di uoli aalta,

en: came to King Demetrius in about the one hundred fifty-first year, presenting to him a crown of gold and a palm, and beside these some of the festal olive boughs of the temple. For that day, he held his peace;
target: kom tu King Dimetrios ina bout di wan onjred fifti-fos ier, a prezent tu im wan kroun a guol an wan paam, an bisaid dem som a di festal aliv bou dem a di templ. Fi da die de, im eld im piis;

en: but having gotten opportunity to further his own madness, being called by Demetrius into a meeting of his council, and asked how the Jews stood affected and what they intended, he answered:
target: bot afta im get apatyuniti fi forda im uon madnis, a get kaal bai Dimetrios ina wan miitin a im kounsl, an a get aks ou di Juu dem tan afek an wa dem inten, im ansa:

en: “Those of the Jews called Hasidaeans, whose leader is Judas Maccabaeus, keep up war and are seditious, not allowing the kingdom to find tranquillity.
target: “Dem a di Juu dem we dem kaal Asidian dem, uufa liida a Juudas Makabius, kip op waar an a sedit, no a lou di kindom fi fain trangkwiliti.

en: Therefore, having laid aside my ancestral glory—I mean the high priesthood—I have now come here,
target: So, afta mi lied asaide mai ansestral gluori — mi miin di ai priisud — mi don nou kom ya,

en: first for the genuine care I have for the things that concern the king, and secondly because I have regard also to my own fellow citizens. For through the unadvised dealing of those of whom I spoke before, our whole people is in no small misfortune.
target: fos fi di jenyuin kier mi av fi di ting dem we konsorn di king, an sekanli bikaa mi av rigaad tu mai uon felo sitizn dem tu. Kaa chruu di onadvaiz diilin a dem we mi taak bout bifuo, wi uol piipl de ina no smol misfaachun.

en: O king, having informed yourself of these things, take thought both for our country and for our people, which is surrounded by enemies, according to the gracious kindness with which you receive all.
target: O king, afta yu infaam yuself a dem ting ya, tek taat buot fi wi kontri an fi wi piipl, we get soroun bai enimi dem, akordin tu di grieshos kainnis wid we yu risiv aal.

en: For as long as Judas remains alive, it is impossible for the government to find peace.
target: Kaa az lang az Juudas tan alaiv, i impasibl fi di govament fi fain piis.

en: When he had spoken such words as these, at once the rest of the king’s friends, having ill will against Judas, inflamed Demetrius yet more.
target: Wen im ben taak soch wod dem laik dem ya, at wons di res a di king fren dem, we av il wil gens Juudas, enflame Dimetrios yet muor.

en: He immediately appointed Nicanor, who had been master of the elephants, and made him governor of Judea. He sent him out,
target: Im imediietli apoint Nikanor, we ben bi maasta a di elifant dem, an mek im govna a Juudia. Im sen im out,

en: giving him orders to kill Judas himself and to scatter those who were with him, and to set up Alcimus as high priest of the great temple.
target: a giv im aada fi kil Juudas imself an fi skyata dem we de wid im, an fi set op Alsimos az ai priis a di griet templ.

en: Those in Judea who had driven Judas into exile thronged to Nicanor in flocks, supposing that the misfortunes and calamities of the Jews would be successes to themselves.
target: Dem ina Juudia we ben draiv Juudas ina egzail trang tu Nikanor ina flak dem, a sopuoz se di misfaachun dem an kalamiti dem a di Juu dem wuda bi sokses dem tu demself.

en: But when the Jews heard of Nicanor’s advance and the assault of the heathen, they sprinkled dirt on their heads and made solemn prayers to him who had established his own people for evermore, and who always, making manifest his presence, upholds those who are his own heritage.
target: Bot wen di Juu dem ier bout Nikanor advans an di asolt a di iitn dem, dem sprinkl dort pan dem ed an mek solem prier dem tu im we ben establis im uon piipl fi evamuor, an we aalwiez, a mek im prezans klier, ophuol dem we a im uon eritaj.

en: When the leader had given orders, he immediately set out from there and joined battle with them at a village called Dessau.
target: Wen di liida ben giv aada dem, im imediietli set out fram de an jain batl wid dem a wan vilij we dem kaal Desau.

en: But Simon, the brother of Judas, had encountered Nicanor, yet not till late, having been delayed by reason of the sudden consternation caused by his adversaries.
target: Bot Saiman, di breda a Juudas, ben enkaunta Nikanor, yet no til liet, a get dilie bikaa a di sodn konstaneshan we im adverseri dem kaaz.

en: Nevertheless Nicanor, hearing of the valor of those who were with Judas, and their courage in fighting for their country, shrank from bringing the matter to the decision of the sword.
target: Bot stil Nikanor, a ier bout di vala a dem we de wid Juudas, an dem korij ina a fait fi dem kontri, shrink fram bring di mata tu di disizhan a di suord.

en: Therefore he sent Posidonius, Theodotus, and Mattathias to give and receive pledges of friendship.
target: So im sen Posidonyos, Teodotos, an Matataias fi giv an risiv plej dem a frenship.

en: So when these proposals had been long considered, and the leader had made the troops acquainted with them, and it appeared that they were all of like mind, they consented to the covenants.
target: So wen dem propozal ya ben lang konsida, an di liida ben mek di chruup dem nuo dem, an i apier se dem ben aal a laik main, dem konsent tu di kovnant dem.

en: They appointed a day on which to meet together by themselves. A chariot came forward from each army. They set up seats of honor.
target: Dem apoint wan die pan we fi miit tugeda bai demself. Wan chariet kom faawad fram iich aami. Dem set op siit dem a ana.

en: Judas stationed armed men ready in convenient places, in case there should suddenly be treachery on the part of the enemy. They held a conference as was appropriate.
target: Juudas stieshan aam man dem redi ina konvinient plies dem, ina kies de shuda sodnli bi chrichri pan di paat a di enimi. Dem eld wan konferens az ben aproopriet.

en: Nicanor waited in Jerusalem, and did nothing to cause disturbance, but dismissed the flocks of people that had gathered together.
target: Nikanor wiet ina Jeruusalem, an du notn fi kaaz distorbans, bot dismis di flak dem a piipl we ben gyada tugeda.

en: He kept Judas always in his presence. He had gained a hearty affection for the man.
target: Im kip Juudas aalwiez ina im prezans. Im ben gien wan aati afekshan fi di man.

en: He urged him to marry and have children. He married, settled quietly, and took part in common life.
target: Im beg im fi mari an av pikni dem. Im mari, setl kwaietli, an tek paat ina koman laif.

en: But Alcimus, perceiving the good will that was between them, and having taken possession of the covenants that had been made, came to Demetrius and told him that Nicanor was disloyal to the government, for he had appointed that conspirator against his kingdom, Judas, to be his successor.
target: Bot Alsimos, a si di gud wil we ben bitwin dem, an afta im tek poezeshan a di kovnant dem we ben mek, kom tu Dimetrios an tel im se Nikanor ben dislaial tu di govament, kaa im ben apoint da konspireta de gens im kindom, Juudas, fi bi im soksesa.

en: The king, falling into a rage, and being exasperated by the false accusations of that most wicked man, wrote to Nicanor, signifying that he was displeased at the covenants, and commanding him to send Maccabaeus prisoner to Antioch in all haste.
target: Di king, a faal ina wan riej, an a get egzaspiret bai di faals akyuzieshan dem a da muos wikid man de, rait tu Nikanor, a shuo se im ben displiz a di kovnant dem, an a komaan im fi sen Makabius prizna tu Antiok ina aal ies.

en: When this message came to Nicanor, he was confounded, and was very troubled at the thought of annulling the articles that had been agreed upon, the man having done no wrong;
target: Wen dis mesij kom tu Nikanor, im get konfound, an ben veri trobl a di taat a anul di aatikl dem we ben agrii pan, di man a du no rang;

en: but because there was no opposing the king, he watched his time to execute this purpose by strategy.
target: bot bikaa de ben no opuozin di king, im wach im taim fi eksikyuut dis poerpos bai stratiiji.

en: But Maccabaeus, when he perceived that Nicanor was behaving more harshly in his dealings with him, and that he had become ruler in his customary bearing, understanding that this harshness came not of good, gathered together not a few of his men, and concealed himself from Nicanor.
target: Bot Makabius, wen im si se Nikanor ben a biyev muor aashli ina im diilin dem wid im, an se im ben bikom ruula ina im kostomari bierin, a andastan se dis aashnis kom no a gud, gyada tugeda no wan fyuu a im man dem, an konsiil imself fram Nikanor.

en: But the other, when he became aware that he had been bravely defeated by the strategy of Judas, came to the great and holy temple, while the priests were offering the usual sacrifices, and commanded them to hand over the man.
target: Bot di ada, wen im bikom awier se im ben get brievli difiet bai di stratiiji a Juudas, kom tu di griet an uoli templ, wail di priis dem ben a aafa di yuuzhual sakrifais dem, an komaan dem fi an uova di man.

en: When they declared with oaths that they had no knowledge where the man was whom he sought,
target: Wen dem diklier wid uot dem se dem av no nalij we di man de we im siik,

en: he stretched out his right hand toward the sanctuary, and swore this oath: “If you won’t deliver up to me Judas as a prisoner, I will level this temple of God even with the ground, break down the altar, and I will erect here a temple to Dionysus for all to see.
target: im strech out im rait an tuwaadz di sankchuari, an swier dis uot: “If unu wi no diliva op tu mi Juudas az wan prizna, mi wi level dis templ a Gad iivn wid di groun, briek dong di aalta, an mi wi erek ya wan templ tu Daionisos fi aal fi si.

en: And having said this, he departed. But the priests, stretching forth their hands toward heaven, called upon him who always fights for our nation, in these words:
target: An afta im se dis, im go we. Bot di priis dem, a strech fort dem an dem tuwaadz evn, kaal pan im we aalwiez fait fi wi nieshan, ina dem wod ya:

en: “You, O Lord of the universe, who in yourself have need of nothing, were well pleased that a sanctuary of your dwelling should be set among us.
target: “Yu, O Laad a di yuunivers, we ina yuself av niid a notn, ben wel pliz se wan sankchuari a yu dwelin shuda set mong wi.

en: So now, O holy Lord of all holiness, keep undefiled forever this house that has been recently cleansed.”
target: So nou, O uoli Laad a aal uolinis, kip ondifail fi eva dis ous we ben riisentli klenz.”

en: Now information was given to Nicanor against one Razis, an elder of Jerusalem, who was a lover of his countrymen and a man of very good report, and one called Father of the Jews for his good will.
target: Nou infamieshan giv tu Nikanor gens wan Razis, wan elda a Jeruusalem, we ben wan lova a im kontriman dem an wan man a veri gud ripuot, an wan we dem kaal Faada a di Juu dem fi im gud wil.

en: For in the former times when there was no mingling with the Gentiles, he had been accused of following the Jews’ religion, and had risked body and life with all earnestness for the religion of the Jews.
target: Kaa ina di faama taim dem wen de ben no minglin wid di Jentailz, im ben get akyuuz a fala di Juu dem rilijan, an ben risk badi an laif wid aal ornestnis fi di rilijan a di Juu dem.

en: Nicanor, wishing to make evident the ill will that he bore against the Jews, sent above five hundred soldiers to seize him;
target: Nikanor, a wish fi mek evident di il wil we im bier gens di Juu dem, sen abov faiv onjred suolja fi siiz im;

en: for he thought by seizing him to inflict an injury on them.
target: kaa im tingk bai a siiz im fi inflick wan injari pan dem.

en: But when the troops were at the point of taking the tower, and were forcing the door of the court, and asked for fire to burn the doors, he, being surrounded on every side, fell upon his sword,
target: Bot wen di chruup dem ben a di point a tek di towa, an ben a fuos di duor a di kuot, an aks fi faiya fi bon di duor dem, im, a get soroun pan evri said, faal pan im suord,

en: choosing rather to die nobly than to fall into the hands of the wicked wretches, and suffer outrage unworthy of his own nobleness.
target: a chuuz rada fi dai nuobli dan fi faal ina di an dem a di wikid rech dem, an sofa outrage onwoerti a im uon nuoblnis.

en: But since he missed his stroke through the excitement of the struggle, and the crowds were now rushing within the door, he ran bravely up to the wall and cast himself down bravely among the crowds.
target: Bot sins im mis im struok chruu di eksaitment a di strogl, an di kroud dem ben nou a rosh widin di duor, im ron brievli op tu di waal an kaas imself dong brievli mong di kroud dem.

en: But as they quickly gave back, a space was made, and he fell on the middle of his side.
target: Bot az dem kwikli giv bak, wan spies get mek, an im faal pan di migl a im said.

en: Still having breath within him, and being inflamed with anger, he rose up, and though his blood gushed out in streams and his wounds were grievous, he ran through the crowds, and standing upon a steep rock,
target: Stil a av bret widin im, an a get enflame wid anga, im raiz op, an duo im blod gosh out ina striim dem an im wuun dem ben griivos, im ron chruu di kroud dem, an a tan pan wan stiip rak,

en: when as his blood was now well near spent, he drew forth his bowels through the wound, and taking them in both his hands he shook them at the crowds. Calling upon him who is Lord of life and spirit to restore him these again, he died like this.
target: wen az im blod ben nou wel nier spent, im jraa fort im bouel dem chruu di wuun, an a tek dem ina buot im an dem im shiek dem a di kroud dem. A kaal pan im we a Laad a laif an spirit fi bring im dem ya agen, im ded laik dis.

en: But Nicanor, hearing that Judas and his company were in the region of Samaria, resolved to attack them with complete safety on the day of rest.
target: Bot Nikanor, a ier se Juudas an im kompini de ina di riijan a Sameria, rizolv fi atak dem wid kompliet siefti pan di die a res.

en: When the Jews who were compelled to follow him said, “Don’t destroy so savagely and barbarously, but give due glory to the day which he who sees all things has honored with holiness above other days.”
target: Wen di Juu dem we get fuos fi fala im se, “No distrai so savijli an baabarosli, bot giv dyuu gluori tu di die we im we si aal ting don ana wid uolinis abov ada die dem.”

en: Then the thrice-accursed wretch asked if there were a Sovereign in heaven who had commanded to keep the Sabbath day.
target: Den di chrais-akors rech aks if de ben wan Sovrin ina evn we ben komaan fi kip di Sabat die.

en: When they declared, “There is the Lord, living himself as Sovereign in heaven, who told us observe the seventh day.”
target: Wen dem diklier, “De di Laad, a liv imself az Sovrin ina evn, we tel wi obzerv di sevent die.”

en: He replied, “I also am a sovereign on the earth, who commands you to take up weapons and execute the king’s business.” Nevertheless he didn’t prevail to execute his cruel plan.
target: Im riplai, “Mi tu a wan sovrin pan di ort, we komaan unu fi tek op wepon dem an eksikyuut di king biznes.” Bot stil im no priviel fi eksikyuut im kruel plan.

en: And Nicanor, in his utter boastfulness and arrogance, had determined to set up a monument of complete victory over Judas and all those who were with him.
target: An Nikanor, ina im uta buosfulnis an arogans, ben ditermin fi set op wan monyument a kompliet viktori uova Juudas an aal dem we de wid im.

en: But Maccabaeus still trusted unceasingly, with all hope that he should obtain help from the Lord.
target: Bot Makabius stil chros onsiisinli, wid aal uop se im shuda obtien elp fram di Laad.

en: He exhorted his company not to be fearful at the assault of the heathen, but keeping in mind the help which in former times they had often received from heaven, so now also to look for the victory which would come to them from the Almighty,
target: Im beg im kompini strang no fi bi fierful a di asolt a di iitn dem, bot a kip ina main di elp we ina faama taim dem dem ben aafn get fram evn, so nou tu fi luk fi di viktori we wuda kom tu dem fram di Olmaiti,

en: and encouraging them out of the law and the prophets, and reminding them of the conflicts that they had won, he made them more eager.
target: an a enkorij dem out a di laa an di prafit dem, an a rimaind dem a di konflikt dem we dem ben win, im mek dem muor iiga.

en: And when he had aroused their courage, he gave them orders, at the same time pointing out the faithlessness of the heathen and their breach of their oaths.
target: An wen im ben arouz dem korij, im giv dem aada dem, a di siem taim a point out di fietlisnis a di iitn dem an dem briich a dem uot dem.

en: Arming each one of them, not so much with the sure defense of shields and spears as with the encouragement of good words, and moreover relating to them a dream worthy to be believed, he made them all exceedingly glad.
target: A aam iich wan a dem, no so moch wid di shuor difens a shiil dem an spier dem az wid di enkorijment a gud wod dem, an muor a rilet tu dem wan driim woerti fi biliiv, im mek dem aal eksiedinli glad.

en: The vision of that dream was this: Onias, he who had been high priest, a noble and good man, modest in bearing, yet gentle in manner and well-spoken, and trained from a child in all points of virtue, with outstretched hands invoking blessings on the whole body of the Jews.
target: Di vizhan a da driim de ben dis: Onaias, im we ben bi ai priis, wan nuobl an gud man, mades ina bierin, yet jentl ina mana an wel-spuokn, an trien fram wan pikni ina aal point dem a voertyuu, wid outstrech an dem a invuok blesin dem pan di uol badi a di Juu dem.

en: Then he saw a man appear, of venerable age and exceeding glory, and the dignity around him was wonderful and most majestic.
target: Den im si wan man apier, a venerabl iej an eksiedin gluori, an di digniti roun im ben wandaful an muos majestik.

en: Onias answered and said, “This is the lover of the brothers, he who prays much for the people and the holy city: Jeremiah the prophet of God.
target: Onaias ansa an se, “Dis a di lova a di breda dem, im we prie moch fi di piipl an di uoli siti: Jeremaia di prafit a Gad.

en: Jeremiah stretched out his right hand and delivered to Judas a gold sword, and in giving it addressed him thus:
target: Jeremaia strech out im rait an an diliva tu Juudas wan guol suord, an ina a giv i adres im so:

en: “Take this holy sword, a gift from God, with which you will strike down the adversaries.”
target: “Tek dis uoli suord, wan gif fram Gad, wid we yu wi lik dong di adverseri dem.”

en: Being encouraged by the words of Judas, which were noble and effective, and able to incite to virtue and to stir the souls of the young to manly courage, they determined not to carry on a campaign, but nobly to bear down upon the enemy, and fighting hand to hand with all courage bring the matter to a conclusion, because the city, the sanctuary, and the temple were in danger.
target: A get enkorij bai di wod dem a Juudas, we ben nuobl an efektif, an iebl fi insait tu voertyuu an fi stir di suol dem a di yong tu manli korij, dem ditermin no fi kyari aan wan kampien, bot nuobli fi bier dong pan di enimi, an a fait an tu an wid aal korij bring di mata tu wan konklyuuzhan, bikaa di siti, di sankchuari, an di templ ben ina dienja.

en: For their fear for wives and children, and furthermore for brothers and relatives, was less important to them; but greatest and first was their fear for the consecrated sanctuary.
target: Kaa dem fier fi waif dem an pikni dem, an forda fi breda dem an relitiv dem, ben les impuotant tu dem; bot grietis an fos ben dem fier fi di kansikriet sankchuari.

en: Also those who were shut up in the city were in no light distress, being troubled because of the encounter in the open country.
target: Dem we get shot op ina di siti tu ben ina no lait distres, a get trobl bikaa a di enkaunta ina di uopn kontri.

en: When all were now waiting for the decision of the issue, and the enemy had already joined battle, and the army had been set in array, and the elephants brought back to a convenient post, and the cavalry deployed on the flanks,
target: Wen aal ben nou a wiet fi di disizhan a di ishuu, an di enimi ben aredi jain batl, an di aami ben set ina arie, an di elifant dem bring bak tu wan konvinient puos, an di kavalri diplai pan di flank dem,

en: Maccabaeus, perceiving the presence of the troops, and the various weapons with which they were equipped, and the savageness of the elephants, holding up his hands to heaven called upon the Lord who works wonders, knowing that success comes not by weapons, but that, according to how the Lord judges, he gains the victory for those who are worthy.
target: Makabius, a si di prezans a di chruup dem, an di vierios wepon dem wid we dem ben ikwip, an di savijnis a di elifant dem, a uol op im an dem tu evn kaal pan di Laad we work wanda dem, a nuo se sokses kom no bai wepon dem, bot se, akordin tu ou di Laad joj, im gien di viktori fi dem we woerti.

en: And calling upon God, he said this: “You, O Sovereign Lord, sent your angel in the time of King Hezekiah of Judea, and he killed of the army of Sennacherib as many as one hundred eighty-five thousand.
target: An a kaal pan Gad, im se dis: “Yu, O Sovrin Laad, sen yu ienjel ina di taim a King Ezekaia a Juudia, an im kil a di aami a Senakerib az meni az wan onjred ieti-faiv touzn.

en: So now also, O Sovereign of the heavens, send a good angel before us to bring terror and trembling.
target: So nou tu, O Sovrin a di evn dem, sen wan gud ienjel bifuo wi fi bring tera an tremblin.

en: Through the greatness of your arm let them be stricken with dismay who with blasphemy have come here against your holy people.” As he finished these words,
target: Chruu di grietnis a yu aam mek dem get lik wid dismie we wid blasfimi don kom ya gens yu uoli piipl.” Az im finish dem wod ya,

en: Nicanor and his company advanced with trumpets and victory songs;
target: Nikanor an im kompini advans wid trompet dem an viktori sang dem;

en: but Judas and his company joined battle with the enemy with invocation and prayers.
target: bot Juudas an im kompini jain batl wid di enimi wid invokieshan an prier dem.

en: Fighting with their hands and praying to God with their hearts, they killed no less than thirty-five thousand men, being made exceedingly glad by the manifestation of God.
target: A fait wid dem an dem an a prie tu Gad wid dem aat dem, dem kil no les dan torti-faiv touzn man, a get mek eksiedinli glad bai di shuo a Gad.

en: When the engagement was over and they were returning again with joy, they recognized Nicanor lying dead in full armor.
target: Wen di engiejment ben uova an dem ben a ton agen wid jai, dem rekognaiz Nikanor a lie ded ina ful aama.

en: Then there was shouting and noise, and they blessed the Sovereign Lord in the language of their ancestors.
target: Den de ben shoutin an naiz, an dem bles di Sovrin Laad ina di langwij a dem ansesta dem.

en: He who in all things was in body and soul the foremost champion of his fellow citizens, he who kept through life the good will of his youth toward his countrymen, ordered that Nicanor’s head be cut off with his hand and arm, and that they be brought to Jerusalem.
target: Im we ina aal ting ben ina badi an suol di fuomuos champian a im felo sitizn dem, im we kip chruu laif di gud wil a im yuut tuwaadz im kontriman dem, aada se Nikanor ed fi kot aaf wid im an an aam, an se dem fi bring tu Jeruusalem.

en: When he had arrived there and had called his countrymen together and set the priests before the altar, he sent for those who were in the citadel.
target: Wen im ben araiv de an ben kaal im kontriman dem tugeda an set di priis dem bifuo di aalta, im sen fi dem we de ina di sitadel.

en: Showing the head of the vile Nicanor and the hand of that profane man, which with proud brags he had stretched out against the holy house of the Almighty,
target: A shuo di ed a di vail Nikanor an di an a da profien man de, we wid proud brag dem im ben strech out gens di uoli ous a di Olmaiti,

en: and cutting out the tongue of the impious Nicanor, he said that he would give it in pieces to the birds, and hang up these rewards of his folly near the sanctuary.
target: an a kot out di tong a di ongadli Nikanor, im se se im wuda giv i ina piis tu di bord dem, an ang op dem riwaad ya a im fuulishnis nier di sankchuari.

en: They all, looking up to heaven, blessed the Lord who had manifested himself, saying, “Blessed is he who has preserved his own place undefiled!”
target: Dem aal, a luk op tu evn, bles di Laad we ben shuo imself, a se, “Bles bi im we don prizerv im uon plies ondifail!”

en: He hung Nicanor’s head and shoulder from the citadel, a clear sign evident to all of the help of the Lord.
target: Im ang Nikanor ed an shuolda fram di sitadel, wan klier sain evident tu aal a di elp a di Laad.

en: They all ordained with a common decree to in no way let this day pass undistinguished, but to mark with honor the thirteenth day of the twelfth month (it is called Adar in the Syrian language), the day before the day of Mordecai.
target: Dem aal aada wid wan koman dikrii tu ina no wie let dis die paas ondistinguish, bot fi maak wid ana di tortiin die a di twelf mont (i get kaal Adar ina di Sirian langwij), di die bifuo di die a Maadekai.

en: This then having been the account of the attempt of Nicanor, and the city having from those times been held by the Hebrews, I also will here make an end of my book.
target: Dis den a get bi di akount a di atemp a Nikanor, an di siti a get fram dem taim de eld bai di Ibruu dem, mi tu wi ya mek wan en a mai buk.

en: If I have written well and to the point in my story, this is what I myself desired; but if its poorly done and mediocre, this is the best I could do.
target: If mi don rait wel an tu di point ina mai stuori, dis a wa mi miself dizair; bot if i puorli don an miidiokra, dis a di bes mi kuda du.

en: For as it is distasteful to drink wine alone and likewise to drink water alone, while the mingling of wine with water at once gives full pleasantness to the flavor; so also the fashioning of the language delights the ears of those who read the story. Here is the end.
target: Kaa laik i distiesful fi jrink wain aluon an laikwaiz fi jrink waata aluon, wail di minglin a wain wid waata at wons giv ful plezantnis tu di flieva; so tu di fashonin a di langwij dilait di ier dem a dem we riid di stuori. Ya a di en.
